Het faciliteren en reguleren van demonstraties is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de voorgenomen gebiedssluiting voor de visserij in de Voordelta

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen about a proposed partial area closure of the Voordelta to bottom-disturbing fishing, questioning whether fishers were pressured into accepting it, who bears compensation costs, and whether the closure is scientifically justified as nature compensation for the Second Maasvlakte. The minister replies that the closure is a legal obligation because the required habitat quality improvement was not achieved, that Rijk rather than Havenbedrijf Rotterdam bears the risk under a 2008 agreement, and that she is delaying the decision and exploring flanking measures.
I therefore intend to put a Access Restriction Decision into effect. However, I am taking more time to arrive at a balanced package of measures.
Ik ben daarom voornemens een Toegangsbeperkend Besluit in werking te laten treden. Ik neem echter meer tijd om tot een evenwichtig pakket met maatregelen te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Universiteit Leiden keurt demonstratie locatie Wijnhaven af’

An SGP MP asked the Education Minister whether universities can prevent unauthorised demonstrations that cause insecurity among Jewish students, what powers they have to stop repeated pro-Palestinian events that voiced support for Hamas, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replied that universities set their own house rules, can act proportionately including reporting crimes to police, and that Leiden has tightened security and is evaluating the matter, so no further intervention is currently warranted.
Universities have, appropriate to the context of their institution, further rules on how demonstrations may take place on their campuses.
Universiteiten hebben, passend bij de context van hun instelling, nadere regels over de wijze waarop er demonstraties kunnen plaatsvinden op hun campussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Tot hoever kan XR gaan met snelwegblokkades?’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about Extinction Rebellion motorway blockades and whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) was right not to prosecute arrested protesters under the Public Assemblies Act, given the disruption to police capacity. The minister answered that the OM decides prosecution independently, that arrests and registration were made, that registration was dropped due to disproportionate capacity strain, and that the local triangle handles demonstrations.
The OM has decided not to prosecute persons arrested for violating the Public Assemblies Act.
Het OM heeft besloten om geen strafvervolging in te stellen tegen personen die zijn aangehouden voor overtreding van de Wet openbare manifestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Joodse school Cheider opnieuw dicht uit angst voor antisemitische incidenten' en 'Gepeste Joodse leerlingen wisselen van school'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that Jewish schools closed due to antisemitic threats and that bullied Jewish pupils are switching schools. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says schools should stay open, notes school boards close buildings on municipal and security advice, and points to existing support and inspection channels while committing to visit the schools.
Precise figures are not known to us or the inspectorate, because parents are free to enrol their children at another school.
Precieze cijfers zijn ons en de inspectie niet bekend, omdat ouders vrij zijn om hun kinderen op een andere school in te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over het vaccin voor blauwtong

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister about the bluetongue vaccine timeline, the South African Blu-Vax vaccine, possible links to water management, farmers' financial risk, producers, wildlife and reporting of cases. The minister said no suitable vaccine is yet available, declined to grant an exemption for Blu-Vax on safety and efficacy grounds, and said farmers bear the financial risk while the government engages with producers and neighbouring countries.
I decide not to grant an exemption at this time to allow this vaccine to be used in the Netherlands.
besluit ik om op dit moment geen vrijstelling te verlenen dit vaccin in Nederland toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over biostimulanten

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the use of biostimulants, including legal uncertainties, the expansion of the EU list of micro-organisms and a national assessment framework for products without CE marking. The minister answered that the EU fertiliser regulation has clarified boundaries, that expanding the EU micro-organism list will take time, and that no national assessment framework exists yet, to be considered when the fertiliser rules are revised.

It is my aim to expand the possibilities for biostimulants under the European Fertilising Products Regulation (EU 2019/1009) and to extend the group of micro-organisms listed in annex II of this regulation.

Het is mijn inzet om de mogelijkheden voor biostimulanten onder Europese Meststoffenverordening (EU 2019/1009) te vergroten, en de groep van micro-organismen, die worden benoemd onder bijlage II van deze verordening uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over Het Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)-rapport inzake stikstofdepositie

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister about a UvA study on nitrogen deposition near dairy farms, including the piekbelasters policy, dry deposition measurement, ammonia from fertilised grassland and combustion, and ammonia emission factors for cattle barns. The minister answered that the study largely confirms existing knowledge, so no policy change is needed, and that research and monitoring expansions are underway (e.g. ten dry-deposition measurement points by mid-2024).
As indicated in the aforementioned letter, the study is primarily a confirmation of existing knowledge.
Zoals aangegeven in de genoemde brief is het onderzoek vooral een bevestiging van bestaande kennis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Pouw-Verweij en Bisschop over het bericht dat Joodse studenten zich onveilig en ongewenst voelen op de Universiteit van Amsterdam

MPs Beertema, Pouw-Verweij and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that Jewish students feel unsafe and unwelcome at the University of Amsterdam, including a pro-Palestinian occupation and a professor's alleged promotion of BDS. The minister condemned the calls for violence, said institutions are responsible for safe environments and complaint procedures, announced an integrated social safety approach and review of complaint procedures, but declined to see grounds for further talks with the UvA or for a broader pattern.
Institutions are responsible for providing a safe learning and working environment in which everyone feels at home and can develop.
Instellingen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van een veilige leer- en werkomgeving, waarin iedereen zich thuis voelt en zich kan ontplooien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Anje dreigt haar boerderij kwijt te raken’

MPs Bisschop and Boswijk asked the minister about reports that farmers feel pushed out of business under the peak-load nitrogen scheme, including the independence of case supervisors, data use, notarial safeguards, PAS cases, municipal zoning delays, and interim operators. The minister answered that participation is voluntary, that schemes will be published by end 2023, and that data sharing is limited to consented parties, but gave only partial or procedural answers on several points, such as the PAS case still being verified and no list of interim operators.
I have asked the RIVM to map the size of the interim operator group.
Ik heb het RIVM verzocht de omvang van de interimmers in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Valstar, Bisschop en Grinwis ten aanzien van de garnalenvissers die per 1 oktober een nieuwe vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig hebben

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie, SGP and VVD asked about the shrimp fishing fleet needing new Wet natuurbescherming permits from 1 October, including catalyst subsidy uptake, the code of conduct, the nitrogen assessment model and a possible extension of the tolerance period. The minister answered that installation numbers are unknown, that a tolerance extension to permit issuance is planned, that a 15-month extension to 2025 is refused, and that talks with the sector on the model and permits are ongoing.
I intend to extend the existing tolerance period until the permit is issued and, within those permits, to give all permit applicants nitrogen space up to a specific date to be fixed.

Ik ben voornemens de bestaande gedoogperiode te verlengen tot de vergunning is afgegeven en binnen die vergunningen alle vergunningaanvragers tot een specifiek vast te leggen datum de stikstofruimte te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Plas, Eppink en Bisschop over de stikstofuitstoot van Schiphol

Four MPs asked the environment and nitrogen minister why Schiphol is absent from the RIVM list of large nitrogen emitters and whether aviation emissions escape the Aerius model, and asked about the status of Schiphol's permit applications and the promised disclosure of nitrogen space purchases. The minister replied that Schiphol falls outside the industry and energy sectors covered by the report, that aviation emissions are calibrated into RIVM's national deposition figures, that the requested purchase data will be included in an ongoing evaluation, and that the Schiphol nature permit decision is still pending.
Following commitments made to Mr Omtzigt and Mr Boswijk, I have requested part of the information on an accelerated basis.
Naar aanleiding van toezeggingen aan de heer Omtzigt 13 en de heer Boswijk 14 heb ik een deel van de informatie versneld uitgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de verkoop van rauwe melk

A MP asked why direct sale of raw milk to consumers is limited to the farm where it is produced, and about food safety risks of selling milk from neighbouring farms. The Minister cites pathogen and outbreak risks, confirms transport and sale risks, and announces a draft amendment allowing frozen raw milk to be sold locally and shipped, with publication expected in early 2024.
Based on the Buro report and a supplementary 2022 advice, an amendment to the legal provisions on raw milk is being prepared.
Op basis van het Buro-rapport en een aanvullende advies uit 2022 4 is een wijziging van de wettelijke bepalingen over rauwe melk in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de verkoop van rauwe melk

An MP asked the ministers whether raw milk sold at farm shops could come from neighbouring dairy farms rather than only the seller's own farm, while keeping other hygiene conditions. The minister answered yes in principle, announcing a planned amendment allowing sale and delivery of frozen raw milk in local shops and farm shops, with rules expected to be published in early 2024.
Yes, I do see those possibilities.
Ja, die mogelijkheden zie ik wel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Joodse student voelt zich onveilig’

An SGP MP asked ministers about a Jewish student feeling unsafe, a 'Israeli Apartheid Week' at the University of Groningen, a moderator's ties to a pro-Palestine group, BDS, and recording antisemitic incidents. The government condemned antisemitism, said universities must allow controversial views within legal limits while ensuring safe environments, and referred prosecution decisions to the prosecutor and courts.
In individual cases it is for the public prosecutor to assess whether there is discrimination or criminal liability under the articles of the Criminal Code.
Het is in individuele gevallen aan het openbaar ministerie om te beoordelen of er sprake is van discriminatie, c.q. strafbaarheid op grond van de artikelen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'RVO maakt dieraantallen en adressen veehouderijen toch openbaar'

An MP asked ministers whether RVO's public release of livestock numbers and farm addresses, which are business data, undermines trust in confidential data provided to government and whether the Woo rules should be clarified. The minister answered that such data counts as emission-related environmental information that must be disclosed under the Woo, that the requester's identity is not disclosed, and that no regulatory change is planned.
Information on numbers of animals and on locations where animals are kept must be regarded as information on emissions into the environment.
Informatie over aantallen dieren en over locaties waar dieren worden gehouden moet worden gezien als informatie over emissies in het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over juridische belemmeringen voor composteren gft met wormen

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality when the promised exploration of allowing hygienised kitchen waste on the same site as composting worms would be concluded, and for its outcome. The Minister replied that the exploration is complete: a permit under the Regeling dierlijke producten can be requested from the NVWA, with a 70°C for 60 minutes hygienisation condition, which is considered workable.
This exploration has already been completed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Boswijk en Van Campen over het ontbreken van consumptieaardappelen op de lijst met winterteelten

MPs Bisschop, Boswijk and Van Campen asked why late-harvested consumption potatoes were left off the winter-crop list, which exempts fields from the cover-crop rule and the nitrogen-norm cut, and whether exceptions could be granted based on residue measurements or sustainability scores. The minister answers that potatoes fail all three winter-crop criteria, that the 1 October cover-crop deadline and the reduced nitrogen norm are required under the 7th Nitrates Directive action programme, and that no exceptions are possible for now.
There is therefore no room for alternatives that are less effective at improving water quality.
Er is dan ook geen ruimte voor alternatieven die minder effectief zijn voor het verbeteren van de waterkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over de financiering van de Stichting Schooldakrevolutie

SGP MPs asked whether central government funding for the Stichting Schooldakrevolutie (a foundation supporting schools with solar panels) is being stopped and why. The minister denies that funding stops, explains the subsidy is being phased out with a final one-off payment in 2024 and that the foundation must operate independently from 2025, while pointing to the Maatschappelijk Vastgoed programme and agreeing to the value of continued work.
A one-off subsidy will still be granted for the year 2024.
Er wordt nog eenmalig subsidie toegekend voor het jaar 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het opschorten van de vergunningverlening door de provincie Noord-Brabant en de gepubliceerde natuurdoelanalyses

MPs Bisschop asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen about Noord-Brabant's suspension of permit granting based on nature target analyses and how deterioration of Natura 2000 habitats should be assessed. The minister answered that the analyses are not permit assessments but inform them, that deterioration criteria follow the EU Commission guidance and the Dutch profiles document, and that the analyses will be improved in an iterative cycle with the Ecological Authority's advice.
The nature target analyses are not intended to draw conclusions about granting permission.
De natuurdoelanalyses zijn niet bedoeld om conclusies te trekken over toestemmingverlening.
Antwoord op van de leden Valstar, Van Campen, Bisschop, Grinwis en Boswijk over ‘bestaand gebruik’ in relatie tot de toetsing van de garnalenvisserij aan de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs from VVD, SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about the Landsadvocaat's advice on whether shrimp fishing licences under the Visserijwet can count as existing use (bestaand gebruik) for Wet natuurbescherming permits, and whether the 1994 licences should be investigated. The minister answered that the legal route is highly complex, that the sector must itself reconstruct licence and emission data via AIS and logbooks, and that the sector remains responsible for the nitrogen deposition calculations.
I share that observation and gladly give these fishers the opportunity and room to demonstrate this.
Ik deel die constatering en biedt deze vissers graag de kans en ruimte om dit aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over ‘de ammoniakuitstoot van bronnen buiten de landbouw’

An SGP MP asked whether the minister would adopt scientists' recommendation to use isotope research to separate livestock ammonia from combustion ammonia regionally, and why RIVM sees no reason to revise combustion emission factors given the Nature study. The minister replied that combustion accounts for only 3% of Dutch ammonia, RIVM sees no need to revise the factors, and the Nature study's European data are limited and dated.
RIVM sees no reason to adjust the emission figures from combustion processes.
Het RIVM ziet geen aanleiding om de emissiecijfers uit verbrandingsprocessen aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Drost, Bisschop, Pouw-Verweij, Beertema en Van der Plas over de antwoorden op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog al

Five MPs asked the minister about a school identity statement that was misquoted in earlier answers as rejecting homosexuality. The minister confirmed the statement does not address sexual orientation, apologised, rectified the record, and said a broader review of the motions on identity statements will be reported to parliament later this year.

In the wording of the parliamentary questions and in the answers to them, a link was unintentionally made between a passage from the Gomarus College identity document and views on marriage and sexual orientation.

In de vraagstelling van de Kamervragen en de beantwoording van de Kamervragen is onbedoeld de link gelegd tussen een passage uit het identiteitsdocument van het Gomarus College en opvattingen over het huwelijk en seksuele oriëntatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Aruba: in cassatie tegen homohuwelijk’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about Aruba's cassation appeal against a Joint Court ruling legalising same-sex marriage, questioning judicial overreach, EU-style harmonisation, and respect for democratic primacy. The State Secretary answered that cassation is legitimate, that the matter concerns internal separation of powers rather than Statute autonomy, that family law is primarily for the countries to decide, and that the Kingdom would object to pressure to copy Dutch law.
In the countries, the courts traditionally take a restrained position on such issues and guard against taking the seat of the political state powers.
De rechter neemt in de landen rondom dergelijke kwesties traditioneel een terughoudende plaats in en waakt ervoor om plaats te nemen op de stoel van de politieke staatsmachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Beertema over het artikel ‘Hoe wokecultuur docent het zwijgen oplegt’

MPs Bisschop and Beertema asked whether student complaints about exposure to opposing views, and a programme director distancing himself from a lecturer's views on non-binary identity, undermine academic freedom and the university's duties. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that social safety does not mean shielding students from disagreeable views, that free speech and academic freedom are not unlimited, and that he cannot judge the specific Amsterdam case, which is under independent review.
I can only answer your question in general terms and not specifically with regard to the reporting about the University of Amsterdam
Ik kan uw vraag alleen in algemene zin beantwoorden en niet specifiek met betrekking tot de berichtgeving over de Universiteit van Amsterdam
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitspraken van de heer Samsom over verplichte uitkoop van boeren

An SGP MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about reported statements by Diederik Samsom, chief of staff to Eurocommissioner Timmermans, favouring compulsory buyout of farms, and about the Commission's role in Dutch Natura 2000 compliance and state-aid approval of buyout schemes. The minister answered that the meeting was an ambient policy exchange, declined to release the internal meeting report as a staff document, denied that buyouts are less effective than voluntary schemes, and reported that the schemes are under state-aid review.
For such internal official drafts, existing cabinet policy is that they are not provided.
Voor dergelijke ambtelijke concepten geldt staand kabinetsbeleid dat deze niet worden verstrekt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de beoordeling van habitats in de standaardgegevensformulieren

An MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why Natura 2000 standard data forms rarely classify habitat types as category D (present but non-significant), why some marginal habitats are still designated, and how representativeness and conservation status are assessed. The minister answers that habitats below the minimum area or not matching the defined vegetation type are not listed, that other member states apply category D inconsistently, and that designations follow defined criteria and remain relative to other Dutch sites.
The report states in principle 13 in which exceptional cases a habitat type is listed as 'D' in the Dutch implementation.
In het rapport is in uitgangspunt 13 aangegeven in welke uitzonderingsgevallen in de Nederlandse invulling een habitattype als «D» wordt vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over juridische belemmeringen voor composteren gft met wormen

An SGP MP asked why worms are excluded from the definition of farm animals in environmental rules but included under animal welfare rules, and whether worms used for vermicomposting could be exempted from the ban on feeding kitchen waste. The minister replied that the definitions serve different purposes, that EU rules classify compost worms as farm animals so the ban cannot be lifted, and that a hygienisation-based exemption is being explored with a focus on short-term practical solutions.
I am currently also exploring the possibilities of allowing the hygienisation of kitchen waste and food residues at the same location where the worms are kept.
Ik verken op dit moment ook de mogelijkheden om het hygiëniseren van keukenafval en etensresten toe te staan op dezelfde locatie als waar de wormen gehouden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Bijna kwart jongere Nederlanders twijfelt aan Holocaust’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to a survey finding that nearly a quarter of young Dutch people doubt the Holocaust, and whether further research, education and a ban on explicit Holocaust denial will follow. The minister is shocked by the knowledge gap, points to existing education measures, supports the National Coordinator's recommendations, and says the bill on denial is expected before summer 2023.
The bill is expected to be submitted to your House before summer 2023.
Het wetsvoorstel zal naar verwachting voor de zomer van 2023 bij uw Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Vorig jaar 3,4 miljoen euro uitgekeerd aan dwangsommen' op de website van de IND

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about IND payouts of 3.4 million euro in penalty payments for late asylum and residence decisions, the rise in default notices (ingebrekestellingen) in 2022, the reasons behind the missing 2022 figures, and plans to limit the penalty scheme. The State Secretary gave detailed answers on figures and scenarios but declined several requests for breakdowns, pointed to pending court rulings and a bill being revised, and promised to inform parliament once alternatives are examined.
That cannot be provided, because the IND works with a case management system.
Dat kan niet gegeven worden, omdat de IND met een zaaksysteem werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Verenigde Naties bereikt nieuw dieptepunt in campagne tegen Israël’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why three Dutch publicly funded higher education institutions appeared as signatories to a pro-Palestinian statement on the ECCP website, and whether this compromised institutional neutrality and student safety. The minister replied that the institutions say they did not sign or know of the statement, that no board decision lay behind it, and that no political position was taken, so no roundtable with sector bodies is planned.
The signing was not based on any decisions by the institutions' boards, so no position was taken by the institutions.
Aan de ondertekening liggen geen besluiten van de instellingsbesturen ten grondslag, er is dus ook geen positie gekozen door de instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de ammoniakuitstoot van bronnen buiten de landbouw

An SGP MP asked whether ammonia emissions from combustion processes are underestimated in the Netherlands and Europe, citing a 2022 study that puts their share far above the national figure. The State Secretary replied that the RIVM sees no reason to revise Dutch combustion emission factors, though it is still checking coal-combustion implications and will report back if needed.
The RIVM is checking whether this has implications for Dutch ammonia emissions from coal combustion.
Het RIVM gaat na of dit implicaties heeft voor de Nederlandse ammoniakemissies uit steenkoolverbranding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het getouwtrek met de provincie Overijssel over het legaliseren van PAS-melders

The MP Bisschop asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the dispute with Overijssel over legalising PAS-notifiers, funding, external netting, the ADC-test, nitrogen space for legalisation and compensation for affected firms. The minister answered mostly by describing the programme, government commitments and legal limits, promising to keep working with the provinces without firm new deadlines.
The cabinet feels that responsibility strongly and does everything to realise those solutions as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet voelt die verantwoordelijkheid zwaar en doet er alles aan om die oplossingen zo snel mogelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de belemmerende regels voor multifunctionele landbouw

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about regulatory obstacles for multifunctional farming, including zoning permits, the 50 percent turnover rule and the Wtza law affecting care farms, and what the government would do about them. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to joint work with the VNG and the sector on a revised handbook, reviewing municipal rules, and more key figures, while offering no firm timetable or binding commitments.
Yes, I am willing to do that. I have contacted the VNG about this, and a proposal is currently being prepared to update the 2011 'Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening'.
Ik heb contact gelegd met de VNG hierover, en op dit moment wordt er aan een voorstel gewerkt om de «Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening» uit 2011 4 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het sombere toekomstperspectief voor de slateelt

An SGP MP asked the minister about the bleak future for Dutch endive (slateelt) growers after loss of pest-control products, including the seed coating and spirotetramat, and whether a temporary exemption could be granted and quality demands adjusted. The minister said the sector must apply for any exemption, that Dutch restrictions on neonicotinoids will be respected so a temporary exemption does not fit, and that the landbouwakkoord will address grower expertise and chain partners.
The sector is free to submit an application for a temporary exemption.
Het staat de sector vrij een aanvraag voor een tijdelijke vrijstelling in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Bisschop over het bericht 'Wolf blijft zorgen voor problemen: ook kalveren en pony’s slachtoffer'

Three MPs (Boswijk, Van Campen, Bisschop) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rising wolf attacks on livestock, the handling of damage compensation, the legal status and management options for the wolf, and related policy. The minister replied that the issues are known, that prevention measures under the Interprovincial Wolf Plan are considered adequate, that management is not currently permitted because no favourable conservation status has been reached, and that an international wolf plan with Germany is in preparation.
That is why I, together with the provinces, am committed to properly protecting livestock and hobby animals in order to prevent animal suffering.
Daarom zet ik, samen met de provincies, in op het goed beschermen van vee en hobbydieren om daarmee het dierenleed te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitspoeling van nitraat bij drijfmest

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about preliminary research showing lower nitrate leaching from high slurry application on drought-sensitive grassland, and why this was not used in derogation negotiations. The minister said the final report is due in autumn 2022, refused to share preliminary results with the European Commission, and noted derogation negotiations had concluded.
The interim results of the mentioned practical research were not published and had not yet gone through a scientific review process.
De tussenresultaten van het genoemde praktijkonderzoek waren niet gepubliceerd en ook nog niet door een wetenschappelijk reviewproces gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over het bericht ‘Veel EU-landen rapporteren cijfers stikstof niet aan Brussel’

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked the minister whether Dutch reporting on nitrogen impacts on Natura 2000 sites distorts comparisons with other EU states and whether EU assessment of conservation status is uniform. The minister answered that the nitrogen reporting option is optional, that the SDF does not measure emissions, that EU harmonisation is ongoing, and that nitrogen reduction effort is weighed in assessing conservation status.
The Standard Data Form on Natura 2000 areas used in the article contains no data on how much nitrogen is emitted.
Het Standaard Gegevens Formulier over Natura 2000-gebieden dat in het artikel wordt gebruikt, bevat geen gegevens over hoeveel stikstof wordt uitgestoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Opsporing komt in gevaar door disfunctioneren tapkamer politie’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the police wiretap system is malfunctioning, endangering investigations, and about the Elbit contract, the discontinued Fox-IT Replay system, and the risk of having no backup. The minister acknowledged recurring disruptions and an end-of-life system being replaced, said no cases of endangered safety were known, defended the procurement, and gave a contract-continuity assurance.
Replay was already operationally phased out several years ago because telecom providers switched to another standard and this functionality is included in the current system.
Replay is enkele jaren geleden al operationeel uitgefaseerd omdat telecomaanbieders zijn overgegaan op een andere standaard en deze functionaliteit in het huidige systeem is opgenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over Het beroep op vrijstelling wegens richtingbezwaren

MP Bisschop asked the government whether a Zuid-Holland Zuid truancy region's practice of asking parents for their specific religion or belief when claiming exemption on grounds of objection to a school's denomination is lawful, whether it breaches GDPR and due-care principles, and whether it wrongly involves youth health care and Veilig Thuis. Minister Wiersma answered that asking for the specific belief is necessary and lawful under the Supreme Court's case law and the GDPR, that the municipality rather than the minister is responsible for enforcement, that a well-argued exemption alone is not grounds for a Veilig Thuis report, and that the regional policy document has been adjusted on that point.
Enforcement of compulsory education is first and foremost a matter for the municipal authorities concerned.
De handhaving van de leerplicht is op de eerste plaats een zaak van de betrokken gemeentebesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het oordeel van het College voor de rechten van de mens van 23 mei 2022 over de taaleis van de Haagse Hogeschool

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the College voor de rechten van de mens's ruling that the Haagse Hogeschool's requirement of excellent Dutch language skills for certain vacancies was not shown to be necessary, and about the administrative burden and wider culture of lowering standards. The minister replied that requiring good Dutch can be legitimate where necessary, supports the independent institute's role in judging equal treatment, and said the school was asked to better justify the requirement, while declining to start talks with sector bodies on excellence beyond exploring the future of higher education.

The College voor de rechten van de mens ruled in this case that the Haagse Hogeschool 'did not demonstrate that it was necessary for all vacancies open at the time to set a language requirement', let alone that the highest level of proficiency was necessary for all of them.

Het College voor de rechten van de mens heeft in dit geval geoordeeld dat de Haagse Hogeschool «niet heeft aangetoond dat het voor alle op dat moment opengestelde vacatures noodzakelijk was om een taaleis te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Metselaarstekens op tiental Walcherse kerken verminkt door restauratie’

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether heritage masonry marks on Walcheren churches were damaged by restoration, and what the RCE's role was, and whether similar problems exist elsewhere. The secretary answered that no removal or sanding was found, that weathering explains reduced visibility, and that the RCE stays in contact with municipalities and runs knowledge sessions.
Nowhere has it been established that masonry marks were sanded down or removed.
Nergens is geconstateerd dat metseltekens zijn afgeschaafd of verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Dorpen samen in het geweer tegen komst aanmeldcentrum: 'Toezegging geschonden''

MP Bisschop asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the purchase of a site in Bant for a new asylum registration centre, the alleged broken promise to villages, the role of the Commissioner of the King as state organ, and the lack of municipal support. The State Secretary answered that the COA bought the site after provincial talks, that municipal and village consultation is ongoing, and that binding legal instruments may be needed in the long term.
In the further elaboration, cooperation with the municipality, residents and stakeholders will be explicitly sought.
Bij de verdere uitwerking zal nadrukkelijk de samenwerking met gemeente, omwonenden en belanghebbenden worden gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over burgerschapsonderwijs

Parliamentary questions from MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the Minister whether the Inspectorate's framework for new schools, which rejected applications over civic education, was vague, overly detailed, and poorly explained. The Minister replied that the framework follows the legal civic education duty, requires only aimed and coherent education goals rather than detailed lesson-level plans, that the Inspectorate provides hearing rights and written motivation, and that the procedure will be evaluated and refined.
I attach value to the Inspectorate having motivated its advice in writing, and offering initiators the opportunity to request further explanation.
Ik hecht er waarde aan dat de inspectie de adviezen schriftelijk heeft gemotiveerd, en initiatiefnemers de gelegenheid biedt om een nadere toelichting te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de waarschuwing van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL) om van het stikstofdoel voor 2030 geen hoofddoel te maken

An SGP MP asked the minister to respond to the PBL warning against making the 2030 nitrogen target (74% of sensitive Natura 2000 hectares below critical deposition values) the main goal, and raised questions on regional flexibility, data gaps, socio-economic impacts, lichen research and traffic ammonia emissions. The minister defended the nitrogen target as an indispensable pillar, pointed to the area-based approach and upcoming natuurdoelanalyses reviewed by the Ecologische Autoriteit, and committed to a socio-economic impact analysis for agriculture.
In the NPLG I will include that a socio-economic impact analysis specifically for agriculture must be part of the area programmes.
In het NPLG zal ik opnemen dat een sociaaleconomische impact analyse specifiek voor de landbouw onderdeel van de gebiedsprogramma's moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over antwoorden op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over genderdysforie bij GGD’s, huisartsenpraktijken en apotheken

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked the minister about his earlier answers on a flyer on gender dysphoria distributed via GGDs, GP practices and pharmacies, questioning its neutrality, the evidence on youth gender treatment, and the rising number of care requests. The minister defended the affirmative approach to youth gender identity, said he is concerned about the flyer's advice to parents, declined to endorse foreign restrictive guidelines, and said he is monitoring waiting times and a research study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Oekraïense vluchtelingen met een beperking zijn blinde vlek voor Nederland’

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked how care and reception for Ukrainian refugees with disabilities is organised, given reports that a support organisation lacks government funding and coordination, and whether a national coordinator is needed. The minister answered that the EU distribution procedure applies, that care is available via the RMA/Wlz and municipal Wmo, that the ministry is exploring a contribution to the organisation's costs, and that a separate coordination point is not necessary given limited uptake.
On the basis of a request from Soft Tulip, the Ministry of Justice and Security is exploring the possibilities to contribute to the organisation's costs.
Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid verkent op basis van een verzoek van Soft Tulip de mogelijkheden om bij te dragen aan de kosten van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het lesmateriaal en de leerlijn van COC over genderdiversiteit en het voornemen tot doorontwikkeling

An SGP MP asked the minister whether COC's primary school materials on gender diversity, which tell young pupils that fluid gender identity is normal, respect children's psychological safety, and whether the inspectorate should review them. The minister answered that schools are free to choose materials within their legal duties on respect for sexual and gender diversity and social safety, that the government sees no current reason to consider the materials anti-democratic, and that a planned ban on anti-democratic learning materials is being worked out.
We currently have no reason to assume that COC's materials lead to anti-democratic or anti-rule-of-law education.
We hebben nu geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat materiaal van het COC leidt tot antidemocratisch of antirechtsstatelijk onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de opvolging van het advies van de commissie-Hordijk over AERIUS

Bisschop (SGP) asks why the government has not adopted areal-level assessment, a higher calculation threshold, kg-based units, or removed the measurement correction for the coastal dune gap in AERIUS nitrogen modelling, and how independence of the RIVM-managed tool is ensured. The minister replies that hexagon-level calculation is kept because heterogeneity would be lost at higher aggregation, that a threshold study (TNO) will report after summer, that units can be shown in kg, and that the coastal measurement correction remains until RIVM research clarifies the cause.
In phase 2 of this research, an exploration is carried out of the level of a computational lower bound supported by scientific physics-based arguments.
In fase 2 van dit onderzoek wordt onder meer een verkenning uitgevoerd naar de hoogte van een rekenkundige ondergrens die is onderbouwd met wetenschappelijke argumenten vanuit de fysica.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'The Rights Forum legt absurde eis op tafel'

An SGP MP asked ministers whether a Woo/Wob information request by The Rights Forum, which covered Israeli universities and institutions, could amount to antisemitism and whether institutions can refuse it or be protected from its burden and insecurity. The minister answered that the request is a legitimate Woo request to be assessed by each institution's board under the law's exemptions, such as privacy, while offering the IHRA definition as an aid and noting contact with Universiteiten van Nederland.
It is up to the institution's governing board to further handle this request along the lines of the law.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur van de universiteit dit verzoek langs de lijnen van de wet verder te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Waarom een moslimpoliticus de eed niet mag wijzigen' en 'Eed aan Allah door raadslid niet geldig'

MP Bisschop asked whether oaths by political office holders must follow the prescribed formula and how the government will ensure chairs and clerks know and apply the rules, and whether invalid oaths affect council decisions. The minister answered that the statutory oath wording must always be used, that invalid oaths make councillors unable to take part in decisions which can be challenged, and that chairs and clerks will be reminded at elections and the answers sent to municipal and provincial associations.

Since the oath or promise under article 14 of the Municipalities Act is a constitutive requirement for councillors to perform their function, a defect in taking it means the person concerned cannot validly take part in deliberation and decision-making.

Aangezien de eed of belofte ingevolge artikel 14 Gemeentewet een constitutief vereiste is voor raadsleden om hun functie te kunnen uitoefenen, leidt een gebrek bij het afleggen hiervan ertoe dat de persoon in kwestie niet geldig kan deelnemen aan de beraadslaging en besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zonder DigiD lukt zorgen bijna niet’

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked why legal representatives may not use a DigiD on behalf of the person they represent, and what is being done about the burden on informal carers and legal representatives. The State Secretary answers that DigiD is personal and non-transferable for protective reasons, that a technical register-based solution for legal representatives is being developed with an expected phased rollout early next year, and that interim alternatives and talks with stakeholders are underway.
To obtain government services, one must be identified, including digitally.
Om diensten af te nemen bij de overheid moet worden vastgesteld wie je bent, ook digitaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van Campen over het jachtbeleid

MPs Bisschop and Van Campen asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the hunting policy after a court annulled the national exemption for fox hunting, and about contested counts suggesting game populations are underestimated. The minister said she will appeal, is preparing a new exemption decree, and will not open the hunt for rabbit in any province and for hare in three provinces next season while reviewing the rest.
I therefore intend to appeal against the ruling.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om hoger beroep in te stellen tegen de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over het bericht 'Geen staatssteun voor bedrijven die worstelen met hoge energieprijzen'

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked the agriculture minister whether the cutter fishing sector is hit hard by high energy prices, why the Netherlands does not use the EU temporary state-aid option for firms hit by Russia sanctions, and whether a COVID-style idle-vessel scheme can be reinstated. The minister confirmed the problem, declined the broader EU state-aid framework and the idle scheme (citing EMFAF rules and innovation priorities), pointed to existing support instruments, and promised an impact study and structural innovation and decommissioning measures.
At my request, Wageningen Economic Research is mapping the short-term economic effects of the war in Ukraine on the fishing sector.
Wageningen Economic Research brengt op mijn verzoek de economische effecten op korte termijn in beeld van de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor de visserij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het bericht 'Agent werd onwel na vermoedelijk contact met zelfmoordpoeder'

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked about a police officer who became ill after possible contact with suicide powder, the safety of responders, the code on chemical substances, and calls for a ban. The ministers answered that the link to the substance is not confirmed, that responder risks are very limited, and that they see no reason to change the voluntary code or legislate, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal investigation.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation, the Minister of Justice and Security cannot make any statements about this.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek kan de Minister van JenV hierover geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt en de vergelijking met de kritische depositiewaarden

MP Bisschop asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen how nitrogen deposition is calculated in OPS/AERIUS, particularly whether forest-edge deposition effects and the 6.25-hectare terrain roughness scale are accounted for, and how Natura 2000 critical deposition values are assessed for juniper heath habitat near pine forest. The minister explained the model's scale basis, acknowledged the forest-edge effect is not modelled for practical reasons, and said no adjustment to AERIUS is planned, while committing to only limited further steps such as possible future correction and deciding on pine felling is left to the land manager.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de samenstellingsvoorschriften voor babyvoeding

MP Bisschop asks whether spreadable bread spread, as a ready-to-eat product consumed with bread, can be treated under the EU baby food composition rules, and whether those rules should target the total eaten product. The minister answers that spreads are ready-to-eat and not covered by the instructions requirement, and that Dutch baby food composition rules must follow EU Directive 2006/125/EC, so no change is planned.
Are you willing to amend or apply the Baby Food Regulation so that justice is done to the special position of spreadable bread spread?
Bent u bereid de Warenwetregeling Babyvoeding zo aan te passen of toe te passen dat recht wordt gedaan aan de bijzondere positie van smeerbaar broodbeleg?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over de procedure bij een geconstateerde overtreding door de NVWA met betrekking tot dierenwelzijn

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister how the NVWA follows up detected animal welfare violations, including delays of months before fines are announced, fine escalation and inconsistent inspection. The minister explains the two-step procedure, says steps have been taken to shorten delays and says the fine system will be evaluated.
The NVWA does not keep this data in this way.
De NVWA houdt deze gegevens niet op deze wijze bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Aruba: ongevaccineerde ambtenaar krijgt geen loon tijdens verplichte quarantaine’

The MP asked whether unvaccinated civil servants in Aruba must use leave or overtime during mandatory quarantine, and whether this violates Kingdom minimum standards. The State Secretary answered that the minister said unvaccinated civil servants will be paid during quarantine, and that Aruba itself is responsible for COVID-19 measures within legal frameworks.
It is up to Aruba itself to take mitigating measures to combat COVID-19, within the legal framework.
Het is aan Aruba zelf om mitigerende maatregelen te nemen om COVID-19 te bestrijden, passend binnen de juridische kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de samenstellingsvoorschriften voor babyvoeding

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the composition rules for baby food, including whether the old Directive 2006/125/EC still applies, how spreadable sandwich fillings fall under the rules, and whether the rules will be tightened. The Minister for Health answered that the directive remains in force until EU delegated acts are adopted, that enforcement follows the Warenwetbesluit, that the EU work has stalled, and that the Netherlands will push for stricter composition requirements.
The Netherlands will, in developing the delegated act for cereal-based foods and baby food, ensure that the composition requirements are strictly delimited.
Nederland zal bij de ontwikkeling van de gedelegeerd handeling voor op granen gebaseerde levensmiddelen en babyvoeding zorgen dat de samenstellingseisen strikt worden afgebakend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over ammoniakuitstoot van het bedrijf Aurora (onderdeel van Cargill) in Zaandam

An MP asked how the cocoa industry's ammonia emissions are regulated, whether it is included in the structural nitrogen approach, and whether underestimated industrial ammonia emissions could explain the RIVM model correction. The state secretary answered that a 30 mg/Nm3 emission limit applies via the Activiteitenbesluit, that a tightening to 5 mg/Nm3 is expected in 2026 under the new BAL, and that industry's contribution is too small to explain the model correction.

The RIVM does not expect that industrial ammonia emissions are a possible underlying cause of the correction to the nitrogen calculation models related to the spatial calibration based on measurement data.

Het RIVM verwacht niet dat de industriële ammoniakuitstoot een mogelijke onderliggende oorzaak is van de correctie van de stikstofrekenmodellen in verband met de ruimtelijke kalibratie op basis van meetgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Segers en Bisschop over antisemitische incidenten en bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about antisemitic incidents and threats against Jewish students, including how trust in reporting could be restored and how police and prosecutors respond. The minister condemned the statements, said he is concerned, pointed to existing complaint channels and prosecution guidelines on discrimination, and referred to new antisemitism and anti-discrimination coordinators.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service pay considerable attention to properly addressing criminal offences with a possible discriminatory aspect.
Bij de politie en het OM is veel aandacht voor het op een correcte wijze aandacht geven aan strafbare feiten met een mogelijk discriminatoir aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Wereldwijzer: carrouselmodel voor lessen levensbeschouwing – PO' en 'Levensbeschouwing, maar dan anders'

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked whether a carousel model giving all pupils mandatory lessons on all religions and worldviews, supplied by the Centrum voor Vormingsonderwijs, undermines parents' right to request religious education in a specific direction and how it fits schools' curriculum duty. Minister Slob answered that parents do decide on religious or worldview education under article 50 WPO, that schools' separate duty on religious currents in the regular curriculum (article 9 WPO) remains, and that the subsidy may only be used for article 50 education; he will keep talking with the Centrum.
The Centrum voor Vormingsonderwijs receives a subsidy from OCW to provide education within that framework.
Het Centrum voor Vormingsonderwijs krijgt vanuit OCW subsidie om het onderwijs in dat kader te verzorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de betrokkenheid van het mkb bij het Digitaal Stelsel Omgevingswet

MPs asked whether SMEs are sufficiently involved in testing the Digital Environment Act system (DSO), including whether agricultural and other sector organisations will be involved and how the promised independent SME test will be implemented. The minister replied that several SME trade organisations now take part in workshops and user tests, that the engagement has been intensified, and that a three-phase approach agreed with business organisations is underway, with further tests and communication planned.
With the business federations, including MKB-Nederland, I have made agreements on how to give effect to your request for an independent SME test of the DSO.
Met de koepels van het bedrijfsleven, waaronder MKB-Nederland, heb ik afspraken gemaakt over de wijze waarop invulling wordt gegeven aan uw verzoek om een onafhankelijke mkb-toets op het DSO.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over rechtsbescherming na Brexit

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked how legal protection in cross-border contract disputes with a British party has changed after Brexit, including the enforcement gap left by the Brussels I-bis and Rome I regimes, the 1967 bilateral treaty, and whether the UK should join the Lugano Convention. The minister replied that Dutch courts still apply Rome I, that enforcement now falls back on national rules and the 2019 Hague Judgments Convention (not yet in force for the UK), that the Commission opposes UK accession to Lugano, and that the government will push the Hague Convention and await an advisory report on article 431 Rv.
Finally, the Netherlands is working to reach a decision in the EU as quickly as possible to become a party to the 2019 Hague Conference Judgments Convention.
Ten slotte zet Nederland zich in om in de EU zo snel mogelijk tot een besluit te komen om partij te worden bij het Executieverdrag van de Haagse Conferentie van 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the minister whether AERIUS overestimates nitrogen deposition on habitat edges between forest and heath, and whether it should correct for this and exclude such hexagons from monitoring of the nitrogen environmental standard. Minister Schouten rejected each premise, arguing that forest does not necessarily capture more nitrogen than low vegetation and that no correction or change is warranted.
There is no reason to do so, given the answer to the first question.
Daartoe is geen aanleiding, gezien het antwoord op de eerste vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt

An SGP MP asked whether land-use roughness and vegetation transitions cause overestimation of nitrogen deposition in AERIUS near forest edges, and whether corrections or exclusion of such hexagons are needed. The minister rejected the premises, arguing that neighbouring forest increases turbulence and that the calculation is representative, and declined to correct or exclude hexagons.
There is therefore no reason to correct or to leave out hexagons.
Er is dus geen reden om te corrigeren of hexagonen weg te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de interpretatie van de grondwettelijke bepalingen inzake het erfelijk koningschap, met name de artikelen 24 en 25

Two SGP MPs asked whether the government's position that a crown heir may marry a same-sex partner without renouncing the throne, and that a consent law is a sufficient route, is consistent with the constitution's closed hereditary succession and with the earlier cabinet's view that marriage implies capacity for children. The minister replied that consent is a matter for the legislature in a concrete case, that the government sees no obstacle to a consent law, and that the earlier view was less firm, without citing new advice.

It is inevitable that there is a fundamental tension with the closed system of succession in the Constitution, which precisely aims to establish on objective and unambiguous grounds who the monarchy passes to.

Het is onvermijdelijk dat er fundamenteel een spanning is met het gesloten systeem van erfopvolging in de Grondwet, dat juist beoogt om op objectieve en eenduidige gronden vast te stellen op wie het koningschap overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Woede om zoektocht Halsema naar ’waarnemers’ bij preventief fouilleren: ’Klap in gezicht agenten’’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about Amsterdam's use of citizen observers during preventive stop-and-search operations and whether this undermines trust in police, and asked about wapen-related youth violence and the evaluation of the measure. The minister explained the legal basis, said the local authority decides on observers, stated confidence in police professionalism, and committed to an evaluation including surveys of observers and residents.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar discriminatie om geaardheid op Gomarus-scholen’

An SGP MP asked the minister about the criminal complaint (aangifte) filed by the Inspectorate of Education against the Gomarus schools over discrimination based on sexual orientation, including notice to the ministry, the handling of the complaint, and the school's policy on informing parents. The minister answered that the Inspectorate acts independently, that the ministry was informed beforehand, and that the Inspectorate found the school had not learned enough from 2016 and that its formal policy on informing parents remained unclear.
The Inspectorate is authorised to file a criminal complaint.
De inspectie is bevoegd om aangifte te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Ceder, Segers en Van der Staaij over de situatie van Afghaanse christenen

Four MPs asked the government about the situation of Afghan Christians and converts under the Taliban, and whether asylum policy should be loosened. The government said the situation of religious minorities was already concerning, that information is limited, and that a moratorium on decisions and departures has been imposed with a new country report and further consultation with parliament promised.
After receiving the country report, the House will be further informed about the conclusions that can be drawn from it for the country-based asylum policy.
Na ontvangst van het ambtsbericht wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de conclusies die uit dat ambtsbericht kunnen worden getrokken voor het landgeboden asielbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat Nederland op de vingers is getikt door Brussel vanwege het niet strafbaar stellen van ontkenning Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the Netherlands has not criminalised Holocaust denial after EU pressure, and whether a bill will be introduced to address it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that such denial is already punishable under Article 137c of the Criminal Code per Supreme Court case law, but that the Commission considers this insufficiently explicit, so a wording amendment via a re-implementation bill is being prepared.
In response, the Commission was informed that the Netherlands sees reason in the Commission's position to prepare a bill.
In reactie hierop is de Commissie bericht dat Nederland in het standpunt van de Commissie aanleiding ziet om een wetsvoorstel voor te bereiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de wijze waarop de stikstofdepositie berekend wordt en de vergelijking met de kritische depositiewaarden

An MP (Bisschop, SGP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether critical deposition values for active raised bogs, and the way nitrogen deposition is modelled per hexagon, overstate exceedance where trees and forest edges occur. The minister partly agrees, explains that the bog values are a midpoint expert judgment and that forest-edge effects are correctly modelled, rejects a correction, and commits to expanding dry-deposition monitoring and to considering tree belts in area-based measures.
There is no reason for such a correction.
Voor zo'n correctie bestaat geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de klachtenrapportage 2021 van de Jongeren Organisatie Beroepsonderwijs (JOB)

An MP asked the Education Minister about the JOB 2021 complaints report on premature digital education and sudden unjustified student deregistrations, and about inspectorate enforcement. The minister said the 1.5m distancing rule would be lifted for mbo and ho from 30 August, that deregistration rules will be clarified via the Versterken rechtsbescherming mbo studenten bill, and that the inspectorate considers deregistration policy in its supervision but does not rule on individual cases.
The inspectorate does not rule on individual situations of students.
De inspectie spreekt zich niet uit over individuele situaties van studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister dwingt universiteiten tot monsterplan diversiteit, anders geen subsidie'

An SGP MP asked the Education Minister whether the Horizon Europe gender equality plan requirement turns substantive gender criteria into funding conditions, threatening academic freedom, and why the national handbook uses gender-neutral wording and controls the physical environment. The minister replied that the plan is only an eligibility criterion checked for presence, not substance, that the national handbook goes beyond the EU minimum requirements, and that the handbook prescribes nothing on the physical environment.
The European Commission clarifies in its guidance that the gender equality plan is not assessed on its substance.
De Europese Commissie geeft in voorlichting over de eisen aan dat het gendergelijkheidsplan niet inhoudelijk wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bisschop over invoer van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara via Marokko naar de EU

MPs Segers and Bisschop asked why the Israel Producten Centrum was fined for labelling wine from the West Bank, whether such fines have occurred before, which occupied territories the rules apply to, and about export data for Western Sahara products imported via Morocco. The government answered that the labelling was misleading under EU food information rules, that the rules apply regardless of territory, that no overview of occupied areas exists, and provided tables of Moroccan export data, while stating that the NVWA's enforcement must remain objective.
It occurs very infrequently that a company is fined for an incorrect description of a product's origin.
Het komt zeer incidenteel voor dat een bedrijf wordt beboet voor een verkeerde omschrijving van de herkomst van een product.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Mijn kind wil niet meer Joods zijn’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that Jewish pupils face hostility at school during the Israel-Gaza conflict, including whether the Inspectorate is acting on such signals and how it coordinates with the National Coordinator against Antisemitism. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate received no reports of incidents against Jewish pupils, that it acts on serious signals on a risk basis, that teachers singling out Jewish pupils for Israel's conduct is unacceptable, and that he will consult the National Coordinator and support existing anti-antisemitism organisations.
The Inspectorate has received no reports in recent months of incidents directed at pupils of Jewish schools or Jewish pupils.
De inspectie heeft in de afgelopen maanden geen meldingen ontvangen van incidenten gericht tegen leerlingen van Joodse scholen of Joodse leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Ceder over het bericht dat een groep bekeerlingen door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) als niet geloofwaardig wordt bestempeld

Two MPs (Bisschop, Ceder) asked whether the IND's assessment of converts' asylum claims, including the work of its Taskforce, amounts to injustice and whether staff expertise and safeguards are adequate. The State Secretary answered that individual cases are assessed carefully with existing safeguards (legal aid, appeal, specialist coordinators, training) and that the IND sees no injustice, while promising only talks on training and continued dialogue with the legal profession.
The asylum system has several safeguards to ensure that the foreign national is treated justly.
Het asielsysteem kent meerdere waarborgen om ervoor te zorgen dat de vreemdeling recht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over knelgevallen in kader van het fosfaatrechtenstelsel

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked whether dairy farms with irreversible investment commitments that could not use their phosphate rights were excluded from the hardship category, whether a count or damage estimate exists, whether a Meststoffenwet exemption is possible, and whether such farms can be exempted. Minister Schouten answered that this group could not be clearly defined and no solution existed without extra general cuts for others, declined to make an inventory as disproportionate, and refused to reopen the exploration given the projected nitrogen overshoot.
I do not consider it useful to make the requested inventory.
Ik acht het niet zinvol de gevraagde inventarisatie te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het NRC-bericht ‘Nieuwe bouwcrisis dreigt door ‘onwerkbare’ megawet’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about large municipalities' concerns over the Environment and Planning Act implementation, including failed tests in Amsterdam and the coherence of the DSO digital system. The minister answered that testing has found issues being addressed, cooperation runs through interbestuurlijke structures, transitional rules protect housing projects, and the start date was moved to 1 July 2022.
It has emerged that both the national DSO facility and local systems still require improvement or supplementation in parts.
Er is gebleken dat zowel de landelijk voorziening DSO als lokale systemen op onderdelen nog verbetering dan wel aanvulling behoeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Bruins over het artikel ‘Zet kinderen niet onder druk met genderkeuze’

MPs Bisschop and Bruins asked whether a Rutgers teaching guide on intersex and sex diversity is scientifically sound, and about the rise in gender care referrals among young people. The ministers answered that schools are free to choose their sources, that Rutgers' subsidised role justifies the guide, and that research into the rise in referrals is being done in the Netherlands and abroad.
Schools have the freedom to choose which information sources they want to use.
Scholen hebben de vrijheid om zelf te kiezen welke informatiebronnen zij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de antwoorden op eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about experiments and uncertainties behind critical nitrogen deposition values, the Korenburgerveen and Binnenveld monitoring discrepancies, and whether water management should weigh more heavily. The minister answered that no local critical loads have been established from experiments, that the uncertainties raised are not 'enormous', that the KDW framework and AERIUS remain the basis, and that water management is a complementary but not substitute measure.
No, there is no question of 'enormous' scientific uncertainties.
Nee, van «enorme» wetenschappelijke onzekerheden is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Politie: in vijf jaar moet 35 procent agenten migratieachtergrond hebben’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that the national police aims for 35 percent officers with a migrant background within five years, raising concerns about capacity, quality of selection, handling of discrimination complaints, and police diversity networks. The Minister acknowledges the capacity shortfall until 2024, states that selection remains objective and quality-based, sets a 35 percent intake target for four Randstad units by 2025 while promising periodic reporting to parliament, and defends diversity networks.
Parliament will be informed about this periodically.
De Kamer zal hierover periodiek worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het afzeggen van NVWA-controles door code rood

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the NVWA's decision to cancel slaughterhouse inspections during a KNMI code red weather warning, including whether the sector was consulted and whether animal welfare was harmed. The minister defended the NVWA's decision as a responsible protection of staff safety, said the sector was informed and consulted afterwards, and stated the policy is to suspend inspections during code red without a government-wide framework.
There is no government-wide framework for the deployment of government services during a KNMI code red.
Er is geen rijksbreed kader is voor de inzet van overheidsdiensten tijdens code rood van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het niet verlagen van het afromingspercentage in het fosfaatrechtenstelsel

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture why the phosphate rights levy rate was kept at 20% rather than reduced to 10%, and about knelgevallen (hardship cases) and a planned bill on levy-free leasing. The minister refused to lower the rate for now, citing uncertainty about the phosphate production ceiling, said the phosphate bank is not a hardship instrument, and noted the leasing bill is being prepared pending EU state-aid consultation.
It is not possible to determine how much trade, and thus levy deduction, would have taken place at a sustained 10% rate.
Het is niet mogelijk te achterhalen hoeveel handel en daarmee afroming plaatsgevonden zou hebben bij een blijvend percentage op 10%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

An SGP MP asked the minister about nitrogen deposition research, critical deposition values, local habitat evidence, and the expansion of monitoring. The minister replied that the Wamelink report would follow in May, gave partial overviews, rejected the call for caution on local comparisons, and promised to expand ammonia measurement stations to ten, though she declined to add the MP's questions to the commissioned studies.
I cannot meet this request. The commission to WUR was not aimed at these questions and the report is substantively complete.
Ik kan niet aan dit verzoek voldoen. De opdracht aan WUR was niet op deze vragen gericht en het rapport is inhoudelijk afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het opkopen van zonneparken door buitenlandse investeerders

Two SGP MPs asked the ministers about foreign investors buying up large solar parks, the resulting outflow of subsidy money, and whether ownership and landscape-integration commitments could be enforced. The minister defended open resale and said there is no generic 50% local-ownership obligation, stating that participation remains voluntary and municipalities can only require good-faith efforts.
I therefore do not take a negative view of reselling solar parks to (foreign) investors.
Ik sta dan ook niet negatief tegenover het doorverkopen van zonneparken aan (buitenlandse) investeerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het sluiten van de subsidieregeling energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the SEEH subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, whether all 2020 applications can be honoured, and how the government will support VvE sustainability. Minister Ollongren answers that EUR 70 million will be made available so all valid 2020 applications are paid and the scheme reopens, while acknowledging that early closure may harm trust and promising an evaluation in 2021.
I make EUR 70 million in budget available on the BZK budget for the SEEH.
Ik stel 70 miljoen euro aan budget op de BZK begroting ter beschikking voor de SEEH.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het openbaar maken van de locatiegegevens van PAS-melders

An MP asked the agriculture minister about the Council of State ruling on publishing location data of PAS notifiers, the next steps, privacy and safety protection, and whether only map views could be released. The minister answered that location data will be published in March with names and addresses withheld, and that a legalisation programme will follow if the nitrogen bill passes.
Based on the ruling, only the location data of the businesses will be made public. The personal data of the initiators will remain redacted.
Op grond van de uitspraak worden enkel de locatiegegevens van de bedrijven openbaar gemaakt. De persoonsgegevens van de initiatiefnemers blijven gelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Johansson dat Europa meer migranten nodig heeft

An SGP MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Health about EU Commissioner Johansson's remarks that Europe needs more migrants, and about the implications for Dutch migration debate and policy. The government answers that the remarks have no consequences for the Dutch situation, that member states decide on labour migration numbers, that a general migration ceiling is not current policy, and that the relevant demographic and sectoral analyses (Verkenning 2050, WRR report) are still awaited.
The final report of the Verkenning 2050, which will contain a calculation of the societal implications, is expected in spring 2021.
Het eindrapport van de Verkenning 2050, dat een doorrekening van de maatschappelijke implicaties zal bevatten, is in het voorjaar van 2021 voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het Natura 2000-beleid

MP Bisschop (SGP) asks the minister about the Natura 2000 policy, including nitrogen thresholds, the Standard Data Forms versus Article 17 reports, critical deposition values, ammonia-deposition correlation, and the Holohan judgment regarding which species and habitats must be protected. The minister answers that the approach is sound and defensible, that the Arcadis analysis gives no reason to change policy, and that the foreign comparison is not yet conclusive.
As appears from the answers to questions 8 and 9, there is no reason to change the policy following the Arcadis report.
Zoals uit het antwoord bij vraag 8 en 9 blijkt, is er geen aanleiding om naar aanleiding van het Arcadis-rapport het beleid te wijzigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Bisschop, Madlener en Van Haga over het schrappen van artikel 8b uit het Besluit gebruik meststoffen ter uitvoering van het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn
