MPs from VVD, CDA, SGP, PVV and FvD asked whether the minister would drop article 8b of the manure decree (requiring drempels between potato ridges on clay and loess soils), citing hindrance to integrated cultivation and conflicting research findings. The minister answered that the article cannot be amended after publication, so it will be excluded from entry into force by royal decree, while stating that nutrient runoff measures remain important for the seventh action programme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het besluit om drempels in de ruggenteelt op kleigronden verplicht te stellen

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the mandatory use of drainage-blocking ridges in potato cultivation on clay soils, questioning whether runoff effects were studied for flat fields and whether the net effect on surface water is limited. The Minister answers that preliminary research shows drams reduce runoff on flat fields too, that quantification is ongoing with publication in 2022, and that the regulation will not be reconsidered.
Preliminary results indicate that on flat fields as well, drams have a blocking effect on the leaching and runoff of nutrients.
Voorlopige resultaten wijzen er op dat ook op vlakke percelen drempels een blokkerend effect hebben op uit- en afspoeling van nutriënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de situatie in de Griekse vluchtelingenkampen

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary about deteriorating conditions in Greek refugee camps, including rat bites on babies, winter unpreparedness, and whether a civil-military emergency operation under Frontex and faster asylum processing should be pursued. The government answered that conditions at the new Mavrovouni camp are better than at Moria, that the lead-contamination concerns were addressed, and that given Greek, EU and Frontex efforts it sees no reason for an emergency operation or faster-track measures.

Given the efforts of the Greek government, the support provided by the European Commission, EASO, Frontex, UNHCR and others, and the recent improvements in the situation of asylum seekers on the Greek islands that have resulted from this, I see no reason at this time for the mentioned civil-military emergency operation.

Gezien de inspanningen van de Griekse regering, de ondersteuning die hierbij wordt geboden door de Europese Commissie, EASO, Frontex, UNHCR en anderen en de recente verbeteringen van de situatie van asielzoekers op de Griekse eilanden die hiervan het resultaat zijn, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor genoemde civiel-militaire noodoperatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'De Jonge Akademie wil maatregelen tegen vliegverslaving'

MP Bisschop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report that De Jonge Akademie wants measures against academics' flying, including incomplete emissions data, reducing long-haul trips and funder conditions. The minister answered that data is incomplete and measurement methods vary, that the government prioritises cleaner aviation and offsetting over avoidance, and that she is willing to discuss measures with VSNU and NWO.
I am willing to discuss with the VSNU and NWO the measures they can take to reduce the number of international flights.
Ik ben bereid om met de VSNU en NWO in gesprek te gaan over maatregelen die zij kunnen treffen om het aantal internationale vluchten te doen afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie een Europees minimumloon wil

Two SGP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the European Commission's plan for a directive on adequate minimum wages, questioning its proportionality, legal basis and possible wage-raising effects. The minister said the Netherlands considers the directive partly proportionate, prefers a Council recommendation, reads the legal basis as leaving the minimum wage level a national competence, and will seek clarification in negotiations.

Given the importance of safeguarding the division of competences between the EU and the Member States, and because this subject may become a point of discussion, the government will ask additional questions during the negotiations.

Het kabinet zal hier wel, gezien het belang van het waarborgen van de bevoegdheidsverdeling tussen de EU en de lidstaten en het feit dat dit onderwerp van discussie zal kunnen worden, tijdens de onderhandelingen aanvullende vragen over stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bijtekenen van tienduizenden hectares stikstof gevoelige natuur in rekenmodel Aerius

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the addition of tens of thousands of hectares of nitrogen-sensitive nature, including species habitats, to the AERIUS habitat map, and who is responsible for drawing these areas. The minister replied that the 2017 expansion to species habitats was transparently announced and applied to PAS analyses, that provinces and the competent authorities are responsible for the habitat maps, and that the legal protection of species habitats is equal to that of habitat types.
The inclusion of nitrogen-sensitive habitats is first ecologically tested and then implemented in AERIUS under the administrative responsibility of the central government and provinces.
Het opnemen van stikstofgevoelige leefgebieden wordt eerst ecologisch getoetst en vervolgens onder bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid van Rijk en provincies doorgevoerd in AERIUS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bisschop over de handreiking levensbeschouwing van het COA

MPs Voordewind and Bisschop asked the State Secretary whether COA's religious neutrality rules, which ban political and religious group gatherings even in residents' rooms, are lawful given constitutional and ECHR freedom of religion, and how residents can reach religious institutions. The State Secretary defended the rules as necessary to protect residents' privacy and safety, said residents may hold small private religious studies and COA helps find outside venues, and said the handreiking is under evaluation.
As a politically and religiously neutral organisation, COA has a duty to protect the personal privacy of all residents and to ensure liveability and safety at the reception locations.
Het COA heeft als politiek en religieus neutrale organisatie een taak om de persoonlijke levenssfeer van alle bewoners te bewaken en de leefbaarheid en veiligheid op de opvanglocaties te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het krantenartikel 'Boerenfonds kent een magere oogst; Steunpakket helpt slechts één boer’

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the very low uptake of the Jonge Boerenfonds (Young Farmers Fund), including the investment threshold, whether the fund's rules could be made more attractive, the unspent 11 million euro for training and coaching, and how to prevent budget remaining unused. The Minister answered that the rules contain no formal investment threshold, that uptake is expected to grow once farmers' uncertainty eases, that a training programme of 4 million euro is underway, and that it is too early to judge the scheme's effectiveness, while promising to monitor it and run a promotional campaign.
I therefore consider it a premature conclusion to already adjust the scheme based on its use in 2020.
Ik vind het daarom een voorbarige conclusie om op basis van het gebruik in 2020 al tot aanpassing van de regeling over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het openzetten van extern salderen door verschillende provincies

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about differing provincial approaches to opening external netting of nitrogen rights, concerns about speculative buying-up of farms, the registration system, PAS-melders and a proposed nitrogen-leasing scheme. The minister acknowledged provincial differences, outlined monitoring, a one-year opening with evaluation and prior-notification duties, and said further measures would be considered in the bill or left to provincial policy rules.
If any undesirable effects occur, I will intervene together with the provinces.
Indien eventuele ongewenste effecten zich voordoen, zal ik samen met de provincies ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Rog en Van Meenen over LVS-instrumenten

MPs Bisschop, Rog and Van Meenen asked the minister whether the Expert Group on Primary Education Tests can assess observation instruments in the student tracking system (LVS) given the legal basis, and why the rules, criteria and transparency of the assessment framework are as they are. The minister answered that observation instruments count as LVS tests, that a Toetsbesluit amendment is needed to limit kindergartners to observation instruments, that no separate framework is needed, and that the framework was briefly unavailable online due to a website error.
An amendment to the Toetsbesluit PO is needed so that for kindergartners only observation instruments can qualify for approval by the Expert Group.
Een wijziging van het Toetsbesluit PO is nodig, zodat voor kleuters alleen observatie-instrumenten in aanmerking kunnen komen voor goedkeuring door de Expertgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de rechterlijke uitspraak inzake de voorgenomen veevoermaatregel

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a summary-proceedings case on the feed measure for dairy cattle, which was withdrawn at hearing, and about data availability, verifiability and the KNMvD's veterinary concerns. The Minister answered that the underlying data are public, that a meeting with the foundations is planned to explain the calculations, and that the PBL analysis and KNMvD follow-up will be sent to parliament by month end.
I will inform your House further on this at the end of this month, together with the availability of the PBL calculation.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier eind deze maand nader over informeren gelijktijdig met het beschikbaar komen van de doorrekening van het PBL
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de resultaten van het drijfmestonderzoek van Vanhoof en Nigten

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the findings of the Vanhoof and Nigten slurry study, including the role of feed quality, manure quality, soil biology, emission-poor floors, application techniques, and the mandatory row fertilisation from 2021. The minister acknowledged the study, said follow-up research depends on scientific peer review, noted the CDM advice and safety study on emission-poor floors, questioned the study's analysis, and decided to implement row fertilisation differently.
It would be valuable if the study were published in an international scientific journal, because such a publication requires scientific review.
Het zou waardevol zijn als het onderzoek in een internationaal wetenschappelijk tijdschrift wordt gepubliceerd omdat zo'n publicatie een wetenschappelijke review vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet en Moorlag over de tariefverhogingen van Rendac

MPs Bisschop, Geurts, Baudet and Moorlag asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Rendac's 2020 carcass-collection tariff increases, the lack of transparency in tariff calculations, and the status of the destruction-market review. The minister defended the tariffs as cost-based, said the ADR and the external auditor check compliance, and withheld Rendac's confidential figures from the Chamber while promising renegotiated agreements with Rendac.
The confidential business information obtained cannot be shared with third parties.
De verkregen bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie kan ik niet delen met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Van Meenen en Rog over het beoordelingskader voor LVS-instrumenten van de Expertgroep toetsen PO

MPs Bisschop, Van Meenen and Rog asked the minister why the Expert group on primary school tests applies its quality framework to observation instruments in early childhood (kleuters) and how that fits the legal basis and the pending bill removing mandatory normed tests. The minister answered that observation instruments tracking pupil growth must be approved by the Expert group, that the criteria are transparent, and that the Inspectorate will carry out an implementation check on the amendment before any change takes effect.
I therefore ask the Inspectorate to carry out an implementation check on the amendment, as is usual for regular legislative procedures.
Ik vraag de inspectie daarom een uitvoeringstoets uit te voeren op het amendement, zoals ook bij reguliere wetstrajecten gebruikelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de zeer korte termijn voor de internetconsultatie bij de Wet stikstofreductie en natuurverbetering

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked why the internet consultation on the Nitrogen Reduction and Nature Improvement Act closes on 3 June 2020, only a week after the draft was published, and whether the deadline could be extended. Minister Schouten answers that the cabinet's urgency to bring the law into force justifies the short period, that the deadline still allows adequate responses, and that an extension is not opportune.
I am aware that there is a short response period for stakeholders.
Ik ben ervan op de hoogte dat er een korte reactietermijn is voor de belanghebbenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de stikstofaanpak

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the nitrogen approach, including external netting, speculative buyouts of farms, a nitrogen registration system, voer measures and corona-related emission reductions. The Minister says provinces will require prior notification of buyouts, external netting will open for one year with a half-year review, and she will examine several proposals while rejecting market-protecting registration.
I intend to agree with the provinces that when externally netting, an initiator (both public and private) notifies the province in advance of a planned purchase.
Ik ben voornemens om met de provincies af te spreken dat bij extern salderen een initiatiefnemer (zowel publiek als privaat) zich vooraf meldt bij de provincie over een voorgenomen aankoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Leijten over uitbreiding van de Europese Unie

MPs Bisschop and Leijten asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands agreed to open EU accession talks with Albania and North Macedonia, given Copenhagen criteria, absorption capacity, rule-of-law and corruption concerns, and whether alternatives to membership were considered. The minister answered that the Netherlands agreed, that further progress by Albania is required before a formal intergovernmental conference, that the Commission found North Macedonia had achieved tangible results, and that the government is considering the EU perspective in the revised enlargement methodology.
The Netherlands agreed to the opening of accession negotiations with North Macedonia.
Nederland heeft ingestemd met de opening van de toetredingsonderhandelingen met Noord-Macedonië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over ongunstige fiscale regels voor de landbouw

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked about unfavourable tax rules for farmers facing volatile incomes from drought and animal disease, comparisons with Belgium, France, Denmark and Ireland, and whether a tax-free climate reserve or wider use of the reinvestment reserve is possible. The state secretary pointed to income averaging, loss relief, the tax exemption for broad weather insurance, and a sector proposal on a climate reserve that is still being studied.
The proposal was sent by the sector representatives on 16 January 2020 and will be studied further.
Het voorstel is op 16 januari 2020 door de vertegenwoordigers van de sector toegezonden en zal nader worden bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten ‘Rechter krijgt laatste woord’ en ‘Katwijk: Sloop van barakken bij voormalig vliegveld Valkenburg’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the planned demolition of fourteen wartime barracks at former Valkenburg airfield in Katwijk, which were delisted as municipal monuments, and whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had been involved. The minister said the heritage value remains largely intact, the RCE has not been involved so far, and she has asked the RCE to talk with the municipality about the area's future.
I have asked the Cultural Heritage Agency to hold consultations with the municipality.
Ik heb de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed gevraagd om overleg te voeren met de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Rog en Bisschop over het bericht “Bijzonder onderwijs furieus over intieme vragen bij inspectiebezoek”

MPs Bruins, Rog and Bisschop asked the minister about inspectors allegedly asking intimate questions of pupils during unannounced visits to about eighty schools for a thematic study of teaching materials. The minister replied that the Inspectorate acts independently, that the study is thematic stelseltoezicht with a broad sample, that unannounced visits are a legitimate instrument, and that the Inspectorate denies that intimate or personal questions were asked, with no complaints received.
The Inspectorate does not recognise the picture painted in the article you cite.
De inspectie herkent het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het door u aangehaalde artikel niet.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'De stagiair is vogelvrij'

An SGP MP asked the education ministers about reports that trainee teachers (stagiairs) are treated unequally and arbitrarily, performing lio-level duties without lio pay. The ministers said lio status and pay are set by the CAO, that stagiairs should not carry lio-level responsibilities, and that they will urge school boards via the PO-Raad and VO-Raad to pay stage allowances and to stop using stagiairs as lio.
We consider a remuneration for trainees desirable.
Daarbij vinden wij een vergoeding voor stagiairs wenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Wie beschermt onze fragiele Oude Kerk’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about expert concerns that the Oude Kerk monument and its organ suffer damage from dust, heavy installations and improper interventions, and who oversees such risks. The Minister replied that the municipality is the primary permit-granting and supervising authority, that the RCE checked fire safety and found no organ damage, that the RCE advised on the organ restoration which was carried out as permitted, and that the RCE maintains contact with the municipality.
In the first instance it is the municipality, as permit-granting authority and supervisor, that must ensure this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de gemeente als vergunningverlener en toezichthouder om daarop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels, Lodders en Bisschop over het artikel 'Grote onvrede over aanpak pootgoedfraude'

MPs from CDA, VVD and SGP asked the minister about NVWA and NAK handling of seed potato fraud (valse NAK-labels), the enforcement tools of the plant inspection services, and cooperation between the agencies. The minister answered that the NVWA acted within its powers, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that the inspection services' fines powers are limited under current law, and that an evaluation of enforcement instruments is planned by 2021.
I will evaluate the use of the enforcement instruments currently included in this legislation and will also involve the plant inspection services and the sector.
Ik zal de inzet van de nu in deze regelgeving opgenomen handhavingsinstrumenten evalueren en daarbij ook de plantaardige keuringsdiensten en de sector betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Bisschop over het bericht dat de EU honderden miljarden Euro’s niet uitgegeven krijgt

Two MPs (Leijten, Bisschop) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that about 300 billion euro of EU commitments remains unspent, questioning the MFF's goal-driven design, decommitment, audit efficiency findings and administrative costs. The minister answered that the RAL reflects multiannual investment timing, that Nederland seeks a smaller MFF with stricter decommitment and efficiency focus, and that the surplus mechanism returns unspent funds to member states.
To prevent this in 2021–2027, the Netherlands is working for stricter decommitment rules and lower pre-financing percentages.
Om dit in 2021–2027 te voorkomen zet Nederland zich in voor strengere decommitteringsbepalingen en lagere voorfinancieringspercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over uitgedeelde boetes op grond van de Meststoffenwet

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture how many fines under the Manure Act were imposed in 2017 and 2018, their total value, breakdowns by violation type and amount, the effect of mitigation policy, the cause of the rising trend, and the status of a study on economic gains from fraud. The minister answered with detailed figures, explained the rise as due to more advanced data analysis and larger criminal investigations, and said mitigation is case-specific and not fully tracked.
How many cases of mitigation and which amounts are involved is not tracked by RVO.nl in its entirety.
Om hoeveel gevallen van matiging en om welke bedragen het gaat wordt door RVO.nl niet in haar totaliteit bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de openbaarheid van de broncode van het rekenmodel OPS

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the source code of the OPS model underlying the AERIUS nitrogen calculator had been made public despite earlier transparency pledges, and asked for full release at short notice. The minister confirmed the code was made publicly available in the week of 4 November 2019, explaining the delay was caused by many questions put to RIVM, and pointed to the GitHub repository.
In the week of 4 November 2019, the source code of the OPS model was made publicly available.
In de week van 4 november 2019 is de broncode van het OPS-model openbaar beschikbaar gesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het niet handhaven van het boerkaverbod in het openbaar vervoer

An MP asked the government why police do not always enforce the partial burqa ban on public transport, whether fines are issued, what agreements exist between police, prosecutors and transport operators, and what role transport staff have. The minister answered that police first ask offenders to stop and only then draw up a report, that transport staff can address offenders but have no enforcement power, and that the government is monitoring implementation while no separate police-operator fining agreement exists.
The partial ban on face-covering clothing makes no distinction by type of clothing.
Het gedeeltelijk verbod gezichtsbedekkende kleding maakt geen onderscheid naar soort kleding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over branden in Aramese dorpen in Turkije

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether recent fires in Aramean villages in Mardin, Turkey, reflect systematic targeting of Christians, whether Turkish authorities were negligent, and whether the government would raise the matter. The minister answered that the fires damaged surrounding land but did not reach the villages or the Mor Hananyo monastery, that authorities appeared to fight the fires comparably to elsewhere, and that Dutch officials raised the matter at high level.
The Netherlands has raised this issue at a high level with the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Bovendien heeft Nederland dit onderwerp op hoog niveau onder de aandacht gebracht bij het Turkse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Te veel beperkingen voor Bijbelstudie in azc’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a group Bible study by asylum seekers in their own room at the Gilze-Rijen reception centre, which COA had not allowed, is consistent with freedom of religion and with COA rules. The State Secretary answered that group religious or political gatherings beyond the family are not permitted to protect other residents' privacy, that individuals may practise religion privately, and that no further talks with COA are planned.
Political and/or religious (organised) group gatherings, larger than the family unit, are not permitted.
Politieke en of religieuze (georganiseerde) groepsbijeenkomsten, groter dan het gezinsverband, zijn niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘IND schendt godsdienstvrijheid Chinese christenen’

MP Bisschop asked whether the IND may rule on theological questions about baptism and reincarnation, and whether its reasoning on Chinese Christian asylum claims fits the government's own analysis of restricted religious freedom in China. The Staatssecretaris answered that the IND does not take theological positions but may ask follow-up questions on the claimant's religious practice, that it relies on official country reports for facts, that state interference in China is acknowledged and assessed case by case, and that claimants need not conceal their faith or join only registered churches.
It is not the task nor the intention of the IND to take its own position on theological issues and the interpretation of the Bible.
Het is niet de taak en ook niet de intentie van de IND om een eigen standpunt in te nemen ten aanzien van theologische kwesties en de interpretatie van de Bijbel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het voorlopig akkoord over de import van kippenvlees uit Oekraïne

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked whether the EU-Ukraine provisional deal raising the duty-free poultry quota from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes would mean more Ukrainian chicken fillet on the EU market, and whether the government would push for tighter terms. The ministers answered that the Commission is still negotiating, that the government will assess the draft Council decision and the parliamentary motion before taking a final position, and that it has written to Commissioner Hogan raising concerns.
The cabinet will study the Commission's draft Council decision and on that basis take a definitive position.

Het kabinet zal het concept Raadsbesluit ten behoeve van goedkeuring met ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van de Europese Commissie bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Omtzigt, Bisschop en Stoffer over extra belastingdruk voor scholen die het lerarentekort proberen op te vangen middels een RTC

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether Dutch VAT rules penalise school boards that match teachers through regional transfer centres (RTCs) and whether the cooperation exemption applies. The government answered that matching is a different service from supplying staff, that the Tax Authority considers RTC matching outside the cooperation exemption, and that it will consult the PO-raad and RTC network on ways to avoid additional VAT burdens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Tielen, Beertema en Bisschop inzake het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs asked why no new application round was opened for the PhD education experiment, whether the experiment is being used improperly, and how it will be evaluated. The minister answered that no new round was opened because no other universities showed interest, that the evaluation is planned for 2021 with an interim review after three years, and that the number of participants and data gaps are acknowledged.
I am not terminating the experiment either in whole or in part.
Ik beëindig het experiment geheel noch gedeeltelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de afvoer van fosfor via melk

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether phosphate excretion from dairy cattle is overstated because milk phosphorus removal is underestimated and feed losses are counted, and why CBS only used the higher milk phosphorus value from 2017. The minister confirmed the points, explained that new milk phosphorus measurements were validated by WUR and will be considered in the forthcoming update of excretion norms, and said a decision will follow by summer 2019.
Based on this advice, I will make a decision before summer 2019 on any adjustment of the standard excretion norms.
Op basis van dit advies zal ik voor de zomer van 2019 een besluit nemen over eventuele aanpassing van forfaitaire excretienormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de vermeende overschrijding van het stikstofplafond

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about whether the agreed five-year averaging method (excluding the two most extreme values) should have been applied to the 2018 nitrogen excretion figures, which show a possible exceedance of the nitrogen ceiling. The minister confirmed the averaging will apply to the final 2018 figures due in summer, declined to pre-empt them, and said that the nitrogen production is near the ceiling so measures to reduce it remain important.
Ik kan hier dan ook niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘VLC heeft ruimtegebrek én leegstand’

An SGP MP asked the education minister about reports that a Barneveld secondary school faces both space shortages and vacancies, and how passend onderwijs funding and VNG model rules account for the extra housing needed for pupils with extra support needs. The minister answered that housing costs are not part of education funding and fall to municipalities, that he sees no reason to call huisvesting a forgotten chapter, that the zorgplicht exemption for lack of space exists by law, and that he will report on talks with the VNG in the progress report before summer.
Municipalities are responsible for making funds available for education housing, within the financial frameworks they set.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ter beschikking stellen van middelen voor de onderwijshuisvesting, binnen de door hen vastgestelde financiële kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Nederlands diploma te koop op Hogeschool in Qatar’

An MP asked the education minister about reports that Dutch diplomas were being sold at a university of applied sciences in Qatar, including what the government knew, what enhanced supervision after 2012 involved, and whether it had acted on expanding Qatar programmes. The minister answered that the ministry knew of 2012-2014 remedial agreements, that the inspectorate began a new inquiry after a 2018 signal, and that she will await the inspectorate's report before deciding whether to take measures.
I want to await the inspectorate's report and, on that basis, assess whether there is reason to take measures.
Ik wil het rapport van de inspectie afwachten en op basis daarvan beoordelen of er reden is om maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over antwoorden op Kamervragen over foutieve registratie in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked about the Council of State ruling on a disputed birthplace entry in the BRP, the legal basis for including non-recognised territories in the country table, and whether adding 'Gazastrook en Westelijke Jordaanoever' implies de facto recognition of Palestine. The State Secretary answered that the ruling was correctly applied, that exceptions for non-recognised areas are allowed in the country table, and that the change does not alter Dutch policy on Palestinian statehood.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Omtzigt, Lodders, Bisschop en Van Rooijen over een keurpunt voor levend vee voor de Brexit en de extra capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs asked whether the minister had led a public-private effort to set up live-animal inspection posts at Dutch seaports before a no-deal Brexit, and about NVWA staffing and preparedness. The minister replied that applications were sent to the European Commission before the 15 February deadline, that exact locations are confidential, that the NVWA has hired 100 of 143 needed staff, and that service levels may have to be adjusted for about a year.
I cannot go into the precise numbers and locations because of the confidentiality of this information.
Op de precieze aantallen en locaties kan ik niet in gaan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de gevolgen voor provincies bij het ontbreken van een goedkeurde jaarrekening

An SGP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the consequences for the province of Utrecht of lacking an approved 2017 annual account, which followed a possible overpayment to a contractor on the Uithoflijn project. The minister answered that she suspended 60% of Provinciefonds advances, declined for now to impose preventive financial supervision for 2019, and noted no other recent provincial cases are known.
On 15 July 2018 the province of Utrecht should have submitted the annual account and the auditor's statement as well as the auditor's report of findings.
Op 15 juli 2018 had de provincie Utrecht de jaarrekening en de controleverklaring alsmede het verslag van bevindingen van de accountant moeten inleveren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Leijten over het bericht dat lidstaten EU-miljarden niet op krijgen

MPs Bisschop and Leijten asked the Foreign Minister about reports that member states are not drawing down EU structural funds, with only 16% spent by end-2017 and large sums unspent, and asked about complexity, co-financing, OLAF referrals, unspent budgets, and reforms for the 2021-2027 MFF. The minister confirmed the low spending rate but argued unspent funds are committed to projects, defended national co-financing, declined to disclose OLAF referrals, and said the government favours simplification, a budget cut, and publishing Annual Control Reports.
The cabinet has no insight into the reports the European Court of Auditors made to OLAF regarding suspicious transactions.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de meldingen die de Europese Rekenkamer aan OLAF heeft gedaan met betrekking tot verdachte transacties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt en Bisschop over de uitvoering van de motie Geluk-Poortvliet en het behoud van het budget voor de instandhoudingssubsidie woonhuis-rijksmonumenten

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt and Bisschop asked whether the new subsidy scheme for owner-occupied and rented listed homes, and the transfer of budget from the tax deduction, is consistent with a parliamentary motion and whether budgets will suffice. The minister replied that the scheme is open to natural persons only, the full budget remains available to owners, the budget will be evaluated in 2020, and the 100% loan cannot be combined with the subsidy.
As I indicated in my policy letter Erfgoed Telt, budgetary room arises by subsidising only those costs that contribute to maintaining the monumental parts of the monument.

Zoals ik in mijn beleidsbrief Erfgoed Telt heb aangegeven, ontstaat budgettaire ruimte door alleen de kosten te subsidiëren die bijdragen aan de instandhouding van de monumentale onderdelen van het monument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht "Ik heb guns, TRRRRRRR"

An SGP MP asked the Minister for Education and Media how a public broadcaster's theme channel could give a platform to convicted rappers, whether this normalises crime, whether it fits the Media Act, and what will be done to stop it. The Minister replied that broadcasters set their own content, that freedom of expression and the absence of censorship apply, that the public may complain to BNNVARA, and that no investigation into criminal liability is known and enforcement is for police and prosecutors.
It is therefore not for me as Minister to judge the (un)desirability or quality of certain content or performances by persons.
Het is daarom niet aan mij als Minister om een oordeel te geven over de (on)wenselijkheid of kwaliteit van bepaalde inhoud of optredens van personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Arno Rutte en Bisschop over het bericht ‘Leren van geweld’

MPs Van Dam, Rutte and Bisschop asked whether police officers acquitted of criminal charges for use of force can be denied a VOG certificate and travel to the US, whether the new use-of-force rules apply retroactively, and whether protections can be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus said he does not recognise the described case, received no other signals of such problems, and that the new investigation framework could in principle apply to earlier cases while no change to VOG rules is planned.
I have received no other signals indicating that police officers face obstacles in obtaining a VOG because of a previous use of force.
Mij hebben geen andere signalen bereikt waaruit blijkt dat politieambtenaren vanwege een eerdere geweldsaanwending hinder ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van een VOG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Rog over de berichten 'Verus niet akkoord met nieuwe onderzoekskaders» en «Inspectie mag geen richting geven aan kwaliteit'

SGP and CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that Verus objected to new inspection frameworks and that the Inspectorate may not set quality direction, including concerns over mixing controlling and stimulating roles. The minister answered that consultation was held, Verus's concerns led to clarifications and removal of brackets, and the government intends to make the Inspectorate's power to correct funding for evident inefficient spending explicit in sector laws.
The brackets can indeed unintentionally cause confusion and have therefore been removed.
De haakjes kunnen inderdaad onbedoeld verwarring wekken en zijn daarom geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Dit zijn de schepen en organisaties die migranten oppikken’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about NGO rescue ships picking up migrants at sea, several of which sail under or are associated with the Dutch flag, and whether the government would act to stop them as Italy requests. The State Secretary answered that only one ship is Dutch-flagged, that the government supports lifesaving in general but shares Italy's concerns about safety and coordination, and that it will examine how to create better frameworks for such vessels.
The cabinet is examining the possibilities to create better frameworks for this.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden om hier betere kaders voor te scheppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'IND-beleid bekeerlingen geregeld onzorgvuldig'

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether the IND handles conversion-based asylum claims carelessly, citing an open letter from Stichting Gave, and asked about assessment criteria and implementation of the Groothuizen motion. The Secretary of State rejects Gave's conclusions, says the IND has the expertise for a careful integral assessment, and promises a letter before the summer recess covering the motion, third-party reports and the assessment framework.
As you know, I will send your House a response before the summer recess to the Groothuizen et al. motion on the IND's credibility assessment of LGBT asylum seekers and converts.
Zoals u bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces een reactie sturen op de motie Groothuizen c.s inzake de geloofwaardigheidsbeoordeling van lhbt-asielzoekers en bekeerlingen door de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het ILVO-onderzoek naar de effecten van de pulsvisserij

The MP asks the minister about the ILVO study on side effects of electric pulse beam trawling for shrimp, its implications for EU negotiations on the Technical Measures Regulation, and whether other member states are shifting position. The minister answers that the study is positive for pulse fishing, that it will be raised in international dialogue meetings, that the trilogue timeline is unclear, and that only France has explicitly sided with Parliament's proposed ban.
The cited study contributes to clarifying the side effects of pulses in the shrimp fishery.
Het genoemde onderzoek draagt bij aan het inzichtelijk maken van de neveneffecten van de pulsen in de garnalenvisserij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over onderschatting van de asbestsaneringsopgave

An SGP MP asked the state secretary whether asbestos roof inventories in Gelderland, Overijssel and Limburg imply underestimated remediation targets elsewhere, and how realistic the 2024 asbestos roof ban is given reported staff shortages. The state secretary answered that the regional inventories cannot be extrapolated to other provinces, that no reason exists to correct the monitoring figures, that a 2024 ban is ambitious but feasible, and promised further letters to parliament before summer and in the second half of 2018.
It is not possible to make a more accurate estimate of the remediation task in the other provinces based on these new inventories in Gelderland, Overijssel and Limburg.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van deze nieuwe inventarisaties in Gelderland, Overijssel en Limburg een nauwkeuriger inschatting te maken van de saneringsopgave in de overige provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het arrest van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over de vordering van een gezakte leerling

An MP asked the minister about a Court of Appeal ruling that a failed pupil's civil claim was inadmissible because administrative law remedies applied, and about whether exam correction rules and appeal notices should change. The minister said the Court made no substantive ruling on the exam body's conduct, that the pupil can appeal to the Supreme Court, that no talks with the exam body are planned, and that the exam body lacks legal personality so the State acts as party in civil cases.
Since the pupil was declared inadmissible, the State has no legal means to continue proceedings.
Nu de leerling niet-ontvankelijk was heeft de Staat juridisch geen middelen om verder te procederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de reactie op de steunmaatregelen aan pluimveehouders in België naar aanleiding van de fipronilcrisis

An MP asked the minister whether Dega-16, a product used in Belgium during the fipronil crisis, was unauthorised as a biocide in both countries and whether this justified state aid to affected poultry farms. The minister answered that Dega-16 was unauthorised in both countries, that its label claim makes it a biocide requiring authorisation regardless of natural origin, and that the government sees no basis for compensation since producers are primarily responsible for food safety.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Futselaar over onrecht als gevolg van de invoering van het leenstelsel voor studenten

MPs Bisschop and Futselaar asked the Minister of Education about the financial effects on 17-year-old students and their parents of the student loan system, comparing cases before and after the coalition agreement, and about how the government handled the overlap between child benefits and student finance for minors. The minister answered with tables showing that after the agreement a two-parent household loses about 1,389 euro per year (50 euro less than before) and a single-parent household about 2,280 euro (945 euro less than before), and said that 17- and 18-year-old students receive identical support and that the issue was discussed during the legislative process, while agreeing to answer before the plenary debate.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de uitbreiding van de lijst met ecologische aandachtsgebieden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about adding Miscanthus, Silphium perfoliatum and flower-rich fallow land to the list of ecological focus areas and about the timing given the EU omnibus regulation. The minister answered that the Wageningen research advice rates Silphium and flower-rich fallow well but Miscanthus poorly, and that the new options will open only for application year 2019 because the delegated regulation is delayed.
I intend to follow the advice of the WR.
Ik ben voornemens het advies van de WR te volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Ex-moslims regelmatig bedreigd in Nederland' (Reformatorisch Dagblad, 20 januari 2018) en 'Duits parlement wil antisemitische asielzoekers uitzetten'

An SGP MP asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports on threats against ex-Muslims in the Netherlands and German proposals to deport antisemitic asylum seekers, asking about frequency, response and whether asylum status should be affected. The government said it knows of no confirmed cases of secret gatherings, outlined victim-support and anti-discrimination measures, and said antisemitism and deportations for it are not separately registered.
Whether there is antisemitism among asylum seekers is not registered.
Of er sprake is van antisemitisme onder asielzoekers, wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht dat agrarische adviseurs de noodklok luiden over aanpassingen van het stikstofrekenmodel AERIUS

Member Bisschop (SGP) asked the minister about reports that changes to the AERIUS nitrogen calculation model cause unexpected rejections of permit applications where ammonia emissions stay the same or fall. The minister acknowledges that small relocations of emission points can cause unexpected deposition results, says only a few permit applications are affected, and promises to keep refining the model in the continuous development of the PAS, without committing to a formal evaluation with stakeholders.
The occurrence of this kind of unexpected calculation result is known.
Het voorkomen van dit soort onverwachte rekenresultaten is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Groeiende groep vluchtelingen uit Syrië wil terug naar huis’

MP Bisschop asked why IOM does not assist Syrian refugees who voluntarily want to return, whether asylum policy for Syria should be revised, how permits are reviewed, and what support for return is possible. The State Secretary answered that IOM's operational limits and UN considerations prevent its help, that DT&V can assist individuals, and that no policy change is planned before the new Syria country report expected in summer 2018.
On the basis of that country report I will determine whether a policy adjustment is needed.
Op basis van dat ambtsbericht zal ik bepalen of aanpassing van beleid aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden voor een intercity-stop in Harderwijk

An MP asked whether the Royal HaskoningDHV study on an intercity stop at Harderwijk could be sent to parliament and how the government views its conclusion that such a stop is not feasible. The State Secretary said the report is not yet public and the government is not its owner, so it cannot be sent, and that NS, which decides the timetable, has no plans for intercity stops at Harderwijk.
I am not the commissioning party or owner of the report. It is therefore not possible for me to send the report to the House.
Ik ben niet de opdrachtgever of eigenaar van het rapport. Het is voor mij daarom niet mogelijk het rapport naar de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de subsidieregeling werkdrukvermindering

An SGP MP asked the education minister why schools that applied early for the work-pressure subsidy were rejected after the funding ceiling was reached, and whether applications submitted before the website notice should be honoured. The minister replied that applications were granted in order of receipt up to the ceiling, that schools had advance notice, and pointed to the new Werkdrukakkoord providing extra funds to all primary schools.
I will not grant more applications for the subsidy scheme than the subsidy ceiling allows.
Ik zal daarbij voor de subsidieregeling niet meer aanvragen toekennen dan het subsidieplafond mij toelaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Onderwijs raakt in de knel door complexe regelgeving’

An MP asked about complex regulation burdening education, including identical annual reporting rules for small and large institutions, high administrative costs of the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT), its complex transitional rules, and enforcement gaps. The minister answered that rules apply regardless of size for transparency, that administrative costs are being reduced via simplifications and a new audit protocol, and that sanctions such as orders with penalty payments exist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de afschaffing van de huurtoeslag voor bewoners van vakantiewoningen

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked how residents of holiday homes were informed about the abolition of rent allowance, why notices came late, and whether municipalities were informed. The Minister replied that holiday-home renters were not separately registered and could not be informed individually, that the VNG was asked to inform municipalities, and that the statutory notice period cannot be extended.
Following this recent reporting, it has become apparent that communication about the change in rent allowance rules for holiday homes on holiday-use businesses was not clear to everyone.

Naar aanleiding van deze recente berichtgeving is gebleken dat de communicatie over de wijziging van de regels voor huurtoeslag voor vakantiewoningen op vakantiebestedingsbedrijven niet voor iedereen duidelijk is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inzet van 70-plussers

An MP asked whether the age limit of 70 for DUO exam surveillants (and whether governments can set age limits for employing 70-plussers) bars valued staff, and whether exceptions or a broader review are possible given the higher AOW age. The state secretary confirmed the 70 limit applies to CvTE/DUO exam staff, said it is not a uniform government rule, and agreed to have the CvTE explore adjusting the limit, with a report to parliament by end 2017.
I am willing to have the CvTE explore whether there are possibilities to adjust this age limit.
Ik ben bereid om het CvTE te laten verkennen of er mogelijkheden zijn om deze leeftijdsgrens aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de resolutie van het Europees parlement inzake de bestrijding van antisemitisme

An SGP MP asked the government about the European Parliament's resolution on combating antisemitism, including adopting the IHRA working definition, the BDS movement, separate registration, and a national coordinator. The government answered that it supports the non-binding IHRA definition but sees no added value in a binding one, that antisemitism is already registered separately by police, and that it sees no added value in a national coordinator given existing prevention efforts.
At present the cabinet sees no added value in adopting a legally binding international definition, because definitions have different effects in different legal systems.

Op dit moment ziet het kabinet geen toegevoegde waarde in het aannemen van een juridisch bindende internationale definitie, omdat definities een verschillende doorwerking hebben in verschillende rechtssystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de keuringsplicht voor noodstroomaggregaten

An MP asked why a mandatory inspection for emergency generators introduced on 1 January 2017 burdens farms and other firms with high costs, and whether it will be reconsidered. The state secretary defended the inspection as a safety measure for rarely used emergency equipment and said reconsideration is premature, though the regime may be revisited toward 2025.
To guarantee safety, it was chosen to still require an inspection.
Om de veiligheid te waarborgen is ervoor gekozen wel een keuring te eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de gewijzigde Regeling bijzondere bekostiging bij fusie van 22 mei 2017

An SGP MP asks the state secretary for Education why the amended 2017 merger-compensation scheme applies a 50% pupil-transfer criterion retroactively to mergers already decided under the 2015 rules, and why schools face clawbacks over an unquantified 'substantial' criterion. The state secretary answers that the criterion merely clarifies the concept of merger, that enforcement targets cases where no pupils transferred at all, and that boards bear the risk of their own enrolment assumptions.
To provide clarity on this, the condition was subsequently operationalised in the amended scheme of 22 May 2017.
Om hier duidelijkheid over te verstrekken is die voorwaarde in de gewijzigde regeling van 22 mei 2017 alsnog nader geoperationaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Fokker-opleiding is failliet, studenten zitten in onzekerheid’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether a macro-efficiency review had led to ending a Fokker/parts-certification course at VTOC, and why quality and student demand were not weighed. The minister replied that no decision was taken by the ministry; an independent advisory committee (CMMBO) advised ROC Aventus to phase out its aviation maintenance courses, Aventus adopted this, and students are being helped to finish their degrees elsewhere.
I have asked Aventus, as the body responsible for vocational education for these students, to ensure that students can complete their education.
Ik heb Aventus als verantwoordelijke voor het mbo-onderwijs aan deze studenten gevraagd om te zorgen dat studenten hun opleiding kunnen afronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Van taalachterstand naar taalenthousiasme'

MP Bisschop asked the state secretary about a report on language policy, questioning whether the debate on spelling and grammar is one-sided and whether teachers master Dutch grammar, and asked for consultation with the Vereniging Hogescholen. The minister answered that the remarks show a need for balanced language use, that teacher training standards already apply, and that there is currently insufficient reason to consult the association further.
In view of the above, in my opinion there is currently insufficient reason to enter into further consultation with the Vereniging Hogescholen on this matter.
Gelet op bovenstaande is er naar mijn mening nu onvoldoende aanleiding met de Vereniging Hogescholen hierover verder in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de overseksualisering van kinderen

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked about the Council of Europe's concern over the sexualisation of children, the role of media and advertising regulation, and whether sanctions via the Advertising Code Committee are adequate. The state secretary answered that existing youth-protection rules, education on sexuality, and self-regulation (RCC, NICAM) are sufficient for now, that a Dutch monitoring study is pending, and that OCW will raise modernisation of youth-protection rules with RCC and NICAM.
In contacts with the Advertising Code Committee (RCC) and the Netherlands Institute for the Classification of Audiovisual Media (NICAM), the Ministry of OCW will raise this matter.
In de contacten met de Reclame Code Commissie (RCC) en het Nederlands Instituut voor de Classificatie van Audiovisuele Media (NICAM) zal het Ministerie van OCW dit ter sprake brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de opstelling van Rijkswaterstaat inzake de oeverbestorting in de Oosterschelde

MP Bisschop asked whether Rijkswaterstaat's reaction to lobster fishers' concerns about the Oosterschelde bank protection conflicts with earlier answers on an 'ecotoplaag', and how lobster living and foraging conditions will be ensured. The minister replied that earlier answers caused confusion, that Rijkswaterstaat has structural consultation with lobster fishers' representatives on the design, that a varied hard and soft habitat is beneficial for lobsters, and that the sector will remain involved in the design.
In the future too, the lobster sector will remain involved in the design of the 'ecotoplaag'.
Ook in de toekomst zal de kreeftensector betrokken blijven bij het ontwerp van de «ecotoplaag».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Sjoerdsma en Bisschop over het bericht "Zorgeloos in Eritrea"

MPs asked whether Eritrean refugees holding asylum status who travel back to Eritrea should lose their status, how often this is checked and enforced, and whether travel can be traced. The State Secretary says such travel can trigger review or withdrawal of temporary permits, reports withdrawals of a few dozen permits, no Eritreans among checked cases, and that tracing all Eritrean travellers is not possible.
It is not possible to determine how many Eritreans from the Netherlands have travelled to Eritrea or neighbouring countries in recent years.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel Eritreeërs uit Nederland de afgelopen jaren naar Eritrea of omringende landen zijn gereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de aangescherpte regels voor gebruik van hoogwerkers bij asbestsanering

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bisschop asked whether the Inspectorate's stricter rules on aerial work platforms in asbestos removal make roof replacement impractical, and what support will be given. The minister replied that the rules were clarified in a brochure rather than tightened, that the existing exemption for occasional use remains available, and that a programmatic approach with financing options is being developed.
However, there is no question of tightening the rules.
Er is evenwel geen sprake van aanscherping van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het opspuiten van de Roggenplaat in de Oosterschelde

An SGP MP asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat's plan to spray sand onto the Roggenplaat in the Oosterschelde, as compensation for wrongly placed fine gravel on the shoreline, is sound, given lobster habitat and mussel-plot risks. The minister answered that the permits are being prepared for submission in May 2017, that an ecotoplaag will be added for lobsters, and that monitoring and consultation with fishing sectors are in place.
The intention is to submit these permits to the competent authority in May 2017.
Voornemen is om deze vergunningen in mei 2017 in te dienen bij Bevoegd Gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over onderbezetting van verkeersposten langs de Westerschelde

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether understaffing at the Westerschelde traffic posts causes economic damage and delays, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged staffing pressure at Terneuzen, said no economic damage resulted, described temporary task reductions and new traffic controller training, and denied that efficiency is at stake.
I am of the opinion that with the recruitment and training of new RWS traffic controllers, the pressure on staffing will be structurally removed.
Ik ben van mening dat met het aannemen en opleiden van nieuwe RWS-verkeersleiders de druk op de bezetting structureel weggenomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht dat ‘geheime’ wetten de EU nog minder democratisch maken

The MP Bisschop asks whether shortening EU legislation via skipping a second reading and trilogues reduces public information and democratic legitimacy, and what steps will be taken. Minister Koenders disputes that the trend shortens procedures or that the European Parliament debates less openly, says trilogues are needed for agreement, and points to Dutch efforts and earlier letters on improving transparency.
That does not detract from the fact that the Netherlands does see possibilities for improving the transparency surrounding trilogues.
Dat laat onverlet dat Nederland wel mogelijkheden ziet in de verbetering van de transparantie rondom trilogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inmenging in kerkelijke vieringen door de gemeente Eindhoven

An SGP MP asked whether the municipality of Eindhoven was pressuring the Catharina church parish over its services by tying organ maintenance to changes in worship, and whether this breached the state's duty to stay out of church affairs. The minister answered that the 1974 loan agreement governs use of the church, that maintenance is a statutory duty of the owner independent of the agreement, that government must not interfere in internal church matters, and that he will not intervene in the parties' agreements.
Every owner of a national monument is required under the Heritage Act to carry out the maintenance necessary for its preservation.
Iedere eigenaar van een rijksmonument is in het kader van de Erfgoedwet verplicht het voor de instandhouding noodzakelijke onderhoud te plegen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Bisschop inzake het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht niet in lijn handelt met de Leerplichtwet en het wettelijk vastgestelde model

MPs Bruins and Bisschop asked whether Utrecht's extra conditions on home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet, and its strict prosecution practice, conflict with the state secretary's 2016 letter to municipalities. The state secretary declined to judge the pending case, said all municipalities must act within the law, and noted that jurisprudence will clarify exemption requirements over time.
The case you refer to is before the court. It is not for me to judge this at this stage.
De zaak waar u naar verwijst is onder de rechter. Het is niet aan mij om daar in dit stadium over te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over een symposium over de Israëlische veiligheidsindustrie

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a symposium on the Israeli security industry, reportedly co-supported by the University of Amsterdam, raised antisemitism concerns and whether public funds were involved. The Minister declined to draw conclusions about a debate not yet held, said the UvA is not involved in organising or funding it, and saw no reason to consult the UvA.
No. The UvA has informed me that it is not involved in the organisation and financing of this symposium.
Nee. De UvA heeft mij te kennen gegeven niet betrokken te zijn bij de organisatie en financiering van dit symposium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Vermue en Bisschop over de veiligheid van binnen- en zeevaart op de Westerschelde

MPs asked whether shipping safety on the Westerschelde is adequate and whether a speed limit for sea-going vessels should be imposed after complaints from inland skippers about wash damage. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes existing separation measures and evaluation mechanisms, argues a speed limit would not solve the problem and could worsen safety, and says the issue will be discussed in the existing nautical platform.
Imposing a speed limit may actually adversely affect safety on the Westerschelde.
Het opleggen van een snelheidsbeperking kan de veiligheid op de Westerschelde juist nadelig beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Gedoe over onderzoek naar schoolkeuze ouders’

An SGP MP asked the education state secretary about a study of parental school choice motives, arguing the research should focus on satisfaction with the existing school offer rather than hypothetical scenarios. The state secretary explained the study uses vignettes to compare school characteristics and relates preferences to actual choices, and promised the results after the summer.

As stated in my letter to your House of 27 June 2016, the study into parental school choice motives in primary and secondary education is currently being carried out and the House will receive the research results after the summer.

Zoals vermeld in mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 27 juni 2016, wordt het onderzoek naar schoolkeuzemotieven van ouders in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs momenteel uitgevoerd en ontvangt de Kamer de onderzoeksresultaten na de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het vermelden van de naam van een levenloos geboren kind op het verlof tot begraven

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the name of a stillborn child may be explicitly shown on the burial permit, and whether the model form and the announced review of regulation for stillborn children will allow this. The minister expressed understanding for the parents but only committed to examining, within the announced review, whether and how registration of stillborn children under the Burial Act needs changing.
I will also consider in the review announced in the letter of 26 April 2016 whether and how the registration of stillborn children under the Burial Act needs to be changed.

Ik zal bij het in de brief van 26 april 2016 aangekondigde onderzoek tevens betrekken of en op welke wijze de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen in het kader van de Wet op de lijkbezorging wijziging behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Bruins over de zienswijze en opstelling van de gemeente Rotterdam inzake leerplicht en kinderbescherming

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a Rotterdam municipal position, treating parents' use of the Leerplichtwet exemption as grounds for a Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigation, is acceptable and consistent with legal certainty. The minister answered that children need education under the IVRK, that municipalities may file a verzoek tot onderzoek when development is threatened, that parents have no legal remedy to stop such an investigation, and that the filing is not an administrative decision.
Parents have no legal remedies available to prevent an investigation by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming into whether a child's development is threatened.
Ouders staan geen rechtsmiddelen ter beschikking om een onderzoek door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming om te zien of de ontwikkeling van een kind wordt bedreigd af te wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van het Besluit huisvesting

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked why small extensions of traditional barns were not exempted from the new emission requirements in the final Besluit huisvesting, and whether the government will consult the sector on exempting them. The State Secretary confirmed the change from the draft was made after consultation, explained that traditional barns cannot use the alternative, and promised to check the reported problems with the sector and consider adjusting the technical requirements in the leaflets.
I will consult with the sector to see whether they have proposals for amending these leaflets
Ik zal in overleg met de sector na gaan of zij wijzigingsvoorstellen hebben voor deze leaflets
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Bisschop en Potters inzake vernomen onjuistheden in Nederlandse schoolboeken over Israël

MPs Voordewind, Bisschop and Potters asked the education state secretary about alleged factual errors and antisemitic wording in Dutch textbooks on Israel and the Middle East, and about schools avoiding Holocaust and Middle East lessons. The state secretary declined to intervene in individual textbook content, but reported forwarding a correction request to ThiemeMeulenhoff and committed to supporting teachers through School en Veiligheid.
It is not for me to pronounce on the content of individual teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om een uitspraak te doen over de inhoud van individuele lesmethodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het recente arrest van het Europese Hof van Justitie inzake de uitvoering van de Kaderrichtlijn Water

MP Bisschop asked the minister how a CJEU ruling on the Water Framework Directive affects Dutch water law, permitting and the programmatic approach in the Omgevingswet. The minister answered that the ruling supports the Dutch implementation, that it is assumed to have no consequences for permitting or the Omgevingswet, and that developments will be monitored, with no concrete new commitment beyond informing parliament if adjustment is needed.
Based on the interpretation given in answer 2, it is assumed that the conclusions of the ruling have no consequences for permit granting in Dutch practice.
Op grond van de interpretatie gegeven in antwoord 2, wordt aangenomen dat de conclusies van het arrest geen gevolgen hebben voor vergunningverlening in de Nederlandse praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichtgeving van de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) over de gewichtenregeling

The MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the State Secretary about DUO's communication on the weighting scheme for disadvantaged pupils, including whether the new mandatory parental form changed criteria, why ethnicity is not reintroduced, and the decline in weighted pupils. The State Secretary answered that only a formal requirement changed, that ethnicity was rejected as stigmatising, that the decline reflects demographics, rising parental education and errors, and that SBB judges foreign education levels.
Using the mandatory parental form has been a formal requirement for determining a weight since 1 January 2015.
Het gebruik van het verplichte ouderformulier is met ingang van 1 januari 2015 een formeel vereiste voor de vaststelling van een gewicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Pabo's lopen leeg, tekort basisschoolleraren dreigt'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education why mandatory entrance tests for teacher training colleges (pabo's) were introduced without prior notice to pupils, whether the entry quality truly rises, when students learn of admission, how funding will compensate for falling intake, and what measures prevent future drops. The minister defended the tests as raising entry quality, said the late admission timing was acceptable, stated she is in talks with the sector on temporary funding compensation, and declined further measures for now while awaiting intake figures in early 2016.
At this moment I am not considering any measures.
Op dit moment overweeg ik geen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het verhogen van de maximumsnelheid op de A20 bij Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel naar 130 kilometer per uur

An MP asked the minister why the speed limit on the A20 near Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel is being raised to 130 km/h despite accident and congestion concerns, and whether consultation with the Zuidplas municipality would be reopened. The minister confirmed a draft traffic decision has been published, said the road's accident risk is rated medium, and said objections will be assessed before a final decision.
The objections submitted by stakeholders are assessed by Rijkswaterstaat and taken into account in formulating a definitive traffic decision.
De ingebrachte zienswijzen van belanghebbenden worden door Rijkswaterstaat beoordeeld en meegenomen in de formulering van een definitief verkeersbesluit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Jasper van Dijk, Rog en Bisschop inzake de berekeningen van de VSNU dat het studievoorschot bij lange na geen 1 miljard euro oplevert en de komende tien jaar zelfs nauwelijks ext

MPs Schouten, Van Dijk, Rog and Bisschop asked the Minister of Education about VSNU calculations showing the student tuition-investment package yields far less than 1 billion euro and barely adds investment over ten years. The minister replied that up to 1 billion euro becomes available by 2026, that institutions will pre-invest 200 million euro yearly in 2015-2017, and that the investment will vary by institution, with details reported only at sector level.
I expect institutions to make the allocation of their pre-investments transparent and to discuss them well internally.
Ik verwacht van de instellingen dat zij de bestemming van de voorinvesteringen inzichtelijk maken en intern goed bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de oproep van de Turkse president Erdogan om Jeruzalem te veroveren

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns President Erdogan's call to conquer Jerusalem and whether this should halt Turkey's EU accession talks. The minister said the remarks are inappropriate and were already conveyed to Turkey, but refused to suspend accession negotiations, preferring a credible process that presses for press and expression freedom reforms.
No. The cabinet chooses a credible accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
Nee. Het kabinet kiest voor een geloofwaardig toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over leerlinggewichten

An MP asked how DUO's country education information is used to set student weights, whether foreign parents' education is fairly assessed, and whether tightened weight rules and controls are reliable and reduce weighted pupil numbers. The government answered that SBB benchmarks foreign systems against Dutch levels, that the weighting criteria were not tightened but error corrections reduce weights, and that the weight is only a correction factor in the youth care allocation model.
I point out that the scheme or the standards in the scheme have not been tightened.
Ik wijs erop dat de regeling of de normen in de regeling niet zijn aangescherpt.
