Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het Nederlandse EU-voorzitterschap in wil zetten op stedelijke ontwikkeling ten

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Minister of Interior intends to shift CAP funds toward urban development during the Dutch EU presidency, and questioned the claims about urban green areas and regulation. The minister denied any plan to move CAP budget, pointed to existing EU urban funds (EFRO, ESF) and a planned European Urban Agenda, and did not commit to reconsidering.
The intention is not to take decisions during the Dutch presidency on shifting CAP or other European fund budgets to urban development.
De inzet is niet om tijdens het Nederlands voorzitterschap besluiten te nemen over het verschuiven van budget van het GLB of andere Europese fondsen naar stedelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Bisschop inzake trage internetverbindingen in het onderwijs en de ambities op het gebied van digitale leermiddelen en kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs

MPs Voordewind and Bisschop asked about slow internet connections in schools, whether all schools can meet digital learning targets, and how to fund fast connections in rural areas. The State Secretary answered that most schools have adequate bandwidth via cable, that an 8 Mbps connection is too slow, and that a joint approach with school associations and the Ministry of Economic Affairs is being explored.
I want to examine together with the PO-Raad, the VO-raad and the Ministry of Economic Affairs whether a joint approach can be created that provides all schools with fast internet
Ik wil samen met de PO-Raad, de VO-raad en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken bekijken of er een gezamenlijke aanpak te creëren is die alle scholen van snel internet kan voorzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Wie mag er naar een witte school’

MP Bisschop asked whether restricting parent choice to the eight nearest schools in Amsterdam undermines freedom of education and whether schools truly participate voluntarily in the central allocation system. The Secretary of State replied that all programmes remain available, that oversubscription forces schools to select objectively, that schools are free to opt out, and that he trusts participation is voluntary.
I have every confidence that primary schools participate voluntarily.
Ik heb er het volste vertrouwen in dat de basisscholen vrijwillig deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'Rotterdam fnuikt thuisonderwijs'.

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether Rotterdam's approach to home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet complies with the law, whether parents are properly informed, and whether pressure on parents is being exerted. The State Secretary answered that Rotterdam acts within the law, that exemptions are ultimately decided by courts, that parents can complain to the municipal ombudsman, and that he intends to remove the exemption ground from the law but no amendment takes effect for 2015–2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het rapport ‘Tackling intolerance and discrimination in Europe with a special focus on Christians’

An SGP MP asked the government about a Council of Europe report on intolerance and discrimination against Christians and whether it accepts the report's findings and the concept of reasonable accommodation. The government rejects the picture of rising anti-Christian intolerance for the Netherlands, says it is committed to combating discrimination on any ground, and notes that reasonable accommodation is mainly used for disability rights.

The cabinet assumes that the national delegations to the Parliamentary Assembly of the other Council of Europe member states will themselves bring this report, and its conclusions and recommendations, to the attention of their governments.

Het kabinet gaat ervan uit dat de nationale delegaties naar de Parlementaire Assemblee van de overige lidstaten van de Raad van Europa dit rapport, en de conclusies en aanbevelingen daaruit, zelf onder de aandacht van hun regeringen zullen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van Toorenburg over het maken van pasfoto’s op gemeentehuizen

MPs Bisschop and Van Toorenburg asked whether municipalities offering passport photos at town halls, such as Amsterdam, conflicts with earlier assurances and the Knops motion, and whether this is a municipal task and unfair competition with the photo trade. Minister Plasterk answered that it is not prohibited, that municipalities are not making passport photos themselves but are responsible for photo quality via the fotomatrix, and that he sees no reason to discuss it with municipalities, though his ministry is examining how to improve photo quality.
I therefore see no reason to enter into discussion with municipalities about this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden hierover in gesprek met gemeenten te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de merkwaardige vorm van bestuurlijke samenwerking tussen ROC Amsterdam en ROC Flevoland, door middel van de juridische figuur van een koepelstichting

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the joint governance arrangement between ROC Amsterdam and ROC Flevoland via a umbrella foundation, questioning whether it complies with the WEB and the merger test. The Minister answered that the arrangement is in conflict with the law in practice, that the Inspectorate found no change and will not re-examine it, and that the institutions have been given two years to dismantle it, with the harmonisation bill expected around summer.
The cooperation is organised in such a way that there is de facto action in violation of article 9.1.4, second paragraph, last sentence of the Vocational Education Act (WEB).
De samenwerking is zo ingericht dat er de facto sprake is van handelen in strijd met artikel 9.1.4, tweede lid, laatste volzin van de Wet educatie beroepsonderwijs (WEB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Nederland financierde conferentie die Gezinssynode 2014 wilde beïnvloeden'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the government funded a conference aimed at influencing the 2014 family synod, and whether subsidising such church-related activity is acceptable. The minister replied that the subsidy supports a European umbrella of Christian LGBT groups as part of emancipation policy, that the government does not seek to influence church affairs, and that no subsidies go to Islamic countries.
There is no question of the government trying to exert influence on church affairs.
Er is geen sprake van dat de overheid invloed probeert uit te oefenen op kerkelijke aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de voortdurende reeks ongevallen op de A20 bij Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel en Moordrecht

An MP asked the minister about a recurring series of accidents and traffic jams on the A20 near Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel and Moordrecht, including why the new Moordrecht slip roads had not improved safety. The minister answered that earlier road works reduced queuing and accidents, that the monitoring period is too short for firm conclusions, and that the situation will be reviewed with the region if late lane-merging proves structural.
If traffic monitoring shows that this phenomenon is structural, it will be examined in consultation with the region whether additional measures are possible.
Als uit de verkeersmonitoring blijkt dat dit verschijnsel structureel is, zal in overleg met de regio onderzocht worden of aanvullende maatregelen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Wetenschapsselectie van de NWO is ontmoedigende farce’

An SGP MP asked the minister whether NWO's grant selection, where many proposals of similar quality are rejected, is wasteful and whether lottery or direct institutional funding should be considered. The state secretary rejected the premise, defended peer review as the international norm, opposed lottery selection, and said the Toekomstvisie Wetenschap will address interdisciplinary proposals and NWO governance.
I consider it important that a qualitative assessment takes place and that it is argued why a proposal is granted or rejected.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er een kwalitatieve beoordeling plaatsvindt en dat wordt beargumenteerd waarom een voorstel wordt gehonoreerd of afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de toegang van ge-moedsbezwaarden tot Nationale Hypotheek Garantie (NHG)

SGP MPs asked whether conscientious objectors recognised by a court, who refuse life-insurance coverage, can obtain a maximum NHG-guaranteed mortgage, and whether a 100% financing model backed by a buy-out amount, or separate case assessment, could be considered. The minister answered that NHG can be granted without life insurance if the bank demonstrably bears the mortgage-death risk, that this is the lender's choice, and that the fund's structure rules out a motor-insurance-style model or case-by-case assessment.
It is up to the lender to assess whether it is willing to do so in such cases.
Het is aan de geldverstrekker te beoordelen of zij hiertoe in voorkomende gevallen bereid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het verbieden van festivals waar niet krachtig tegen drugsgebruik wordt opgetreden

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked whether festivals with drug problems should keep receiving permits and what legal grounds exist to refuse or revoke them. The government answered that no national rules set permit conditions, that municipalities may refuse permits only where drug use would likely cause public order or health problems, and that some municipalities already attach anti-drug conditions.
The suspicion of drug use in itself is not a ground for refusal.
Het vermoeden van drugsgebruik op zich is geen weigeringsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Jan Vos over de dubbeltellingregeling voor betere biobrandstoffen

MPs Bisschop and Jan Vos asked the government about the Corbey Commission's advice to simplify the double-counting scheme for advanced biofuels, including abolishing partial double counting, and about the lack of a level playing field in the EU. The Secretary of State agreed to adopt the advice on removing partial double counting using a 70/30% threshold, to be implemented by the NEa by year-end, and offered affected parties a choice about existing decisions.
I adopt this part of the advice and will swiftly amend the regulations accordingly.
Ik neem dit gedeelte van het advies over en pas de regelgeving daarop snel aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het plan van het platform Bewust moslim om op de dag van dodenherdenking een symposium te houden over een zogenoemde schaduw Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would try to stop a planned symposium on a so-called 'shadow Holocaust' and what powers the municipality had to prevent it. The Minister replied that the municipality and mosque cancelled the event, that ministers do not intervene in municipal matters or judge organisers' views, and that mayors may act only on public order grounds, not on the content of the meeting.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in municipal affairs, nor is it for me to judge the views of people organising a meeting such as the questioners describe.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in gemeentelijke aangelegenheden te treden noch is het aan mij om de opvattingen te beoordelen van mensen die een bijeenkomst organiseren als door de vragenstellers bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Segers over de stijging van de grafrechten

Two MPs (Bisschop and Segers) asked the Interior Minister about sharp rises in municipal grave fees and price differences of up to 7,500 euro, and asked whether the state checks that fees do not exceed actual costs, whether it will require transparency and tariff moderation, and why grave costs were omitted from the COELO study. The minister answered that fee-setting is an autonomous municipal competence, that objections and appeal to the courts are the available remedy, that a 2010 handbook on fees is being updated, and declined to act on moderation or additional monitoring.
Setting municipal grave fees is an autonomous competence and responsibility of the municipal council.
Het vaststellen van de gemeentelijke grafrechten is een autonome bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het storten van staalslakken in de Oosterschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat should cover steel slag dumped in the Oosterschelde with rubble to protect the Oosterschelde lobster and benthic life, and whether it will do so. The minister acknowledged the species' value, said consultation with lobster fishers and a provincial permit are in place, and offered an ecological finish on a test section and a joint exploration for the next cluster, but did not commit to rubble cover.

Besides the test section with ecological finishing being dumped in the second cluster, I will explore with the parties involved and the market what options exist within the current financial frameworks

Naast het testvak met de ecologische afwerking dat in het tweede cluster wordt bestort, zal ik samen met de betrokken partijen en de markt verkennen welke mogelijkheden er binnen de huidige financiële kaders zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dik-Faber over opwaardering van de N57 en N59

MPs Bisschop and Dik-Faber asked the minister about road safety and accessibility on the N57 and N59 in Zeeland and Zuid-Holland, including whether fatality rates are five times the national average and what funding the Rijk could provide. The minister denied the fatality claim, stated that €18 million is reserved for bringing these roads to three-star EuroRAP level, and said no extra funding or accessibility problem exists, while noting the projects already count as MIRT projects.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Bisschop en Geurts over het bericht van een werkbezoek aan de gemeente Barneveld op 16 januari 2014

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether a rail terminal in Barneveld would reduce road freight and whether the ministry would help assess its feasibility, and about multimodal terminals generally. The state secretary answered that such initiatives are primarily a market responsibility, that ProRail will review any concrete proposal against existing policy, and that the national terminal network is considered sufficient until 2020, with selective strengthening on key corridors also under study.
For new market initiatives for rail terminals, ProRail will examine whether such projects meet the policy starting points set out in the policy framework.
Bij nieuwe marktinitiatieven voor railterminals zal ProRail bekijken of dergelijke projecten voldoen aan de beleidsuitgangspunten, zoals die verwoord staan in het beleidskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inzameling van Klein Gevaarlijk Afval (KGA) en huisvuil in de binnenvaart

An SGP MP asked the minister why the national scheme for collecting small hazardous waste and household waste from inland shipping lacks sector support and why collection points along the Maas and Twente canal were removed, and asked about subscriptions, cost-coverage, an international CDNI alternative and vessels that only sail on those waterways. The minister defended the polluter-pays principle, reported that collection points were reduced from about 95 to 25 with subscriptions at about 245, and said an international harmonised system is still being pursued, though fuel-levy financing would need a treaty change.
I am, however, open to suggestions for improving the system now introduced.
Ik sta wel open voor suggesties tot verbetering van het nu ingevoerde systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bisschop over het ontslag van de Gezaghebber op Bonaire

MPs Van Raak and Bisschop asked whether the resignation request of the Island Governor of Bonaire serves integrity, whether a no-confidence motion filed by a UPB faction leader suspected in a corruption case is appropriate, whether the governor should be supported, and whether dismissal will be granted or deferred until trial ends. The minister answered that the Island Council's no-confidence vote is primarily its own matter, reaffirmed integrity principles and the presumption of innocence without judging the motion, and noted the governor will resign on 1 March 2014 respecting the council's wishes.
The Island Council of Bonaire adopted a motion of no confidence against the Island Governor on Tuesday 26 November 2013.
De Eilandsraad van Bonaire heeft op dinsdag 26 november 2013 een motie van wantrouwen tegen de Gezaghebber aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ’Ambtenaar verdacht van lekken over moskee-internaten ontslagen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the dismissal of a whistleblowing civil servant in Rotterdam who had reported misconduct, including a BING report finding improper governance, and about provincial supervision and the whistleblower regime. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, pointing to the courts, noted the anti-detriment provision applies, and said the BING report will be considered by the prosecutor.
It does not befit me as minister to comment on the factual complex in this case.
Het past mij als minister niet om commentaar te geven op het feitencomplex in deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de noodklok van Rijkswaterstaat over de veiligheid van de Oosterscheldekering

An SGP MP asked the minister about press reports of an internal Rijkswaterstaat report claiming the Oosterscheldekering storm barrier had been neglected, and whether it met safety norms. The minister replied that the report does not say the barrier was neglected, that the barrier has always met and still meets the legal norm, and that management has been tightened and staffing adjusted.
I informed you in April 2013 about this and, in line with the report's conclusions, indicated that the landslides did not lead to problems for the Oosterscheldekering.
Ik heb u in april 2013 hierover geïnformeerd en in lijn met de conclusies van het rapport aangegeven dat de afschuivingen niet tot problemen voor de Oosterscheldekering hebben geleid.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop en Van Klaveren over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 11 mei 2013 inzake een klokkenluider

MPs Bisschop and Van Klaveren asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a whistleblower alleging safety and permit failures and clientelism in Rotterdam. The minister said fire safety was in order, the zoning and permit issue was resolved in April 2013, whistleblower channels exist via the municipal ombudsman and the Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, and he welcomed an independent Rotterdam culture investigation while declining to comment on an individual employee's employment situation.
No statements can be made about the employment situation of individual civil servants and the considerations involved.
Over de rechtspositionele situatie van individuele ambtenaren en de afwegingen daarbij kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (WOB)

An SGP MP asks the state secretary why she does not use the WOB exception in article 10(2)(g) to refuse disclosure of school test results, which she treats as a call for administrative disobedience, and whether the exception is hopeless. The state secretary answers that disclosure is the starting point, she is reconsidering her decision on objections from school boards, and she will not disclose without judicial intervention while affected parties wish to pursue it.
As long as affected parties wish for that for compelling reasons, disclosure will therefore not take place without judicial intervention.
Zolang belanghebbenden dat om moverende redenen wensen, zal dus niet zonder rechterlijke tussenkomst tot openbaarmaking worden overgegaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht betreffende het voornemen om binnenkort een WOB-verzoek van RTL Nieuws inzake eindtoetsgegevens in te willigen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether the ministry would grant an FOI request from RTL Nieuws for end-of-primary test data, why the ministry rather than the Inspectorate handles it, and about privacy, school protections and consultation. The State Secretary answered that individual pupil scores will not be released while school averages (raw and inspectorate-corrected where available) will be, with schools given two weeks to object, and that the Wob principle of open disclosure applies.
That is why I will not provide the score per pupil.
Daarom zal ik de score per leerling niet verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop over berichtgeving dat het gemeentebestuur Rotterdam jarenlang willens en wetens lakse moskee-internaten tolereerde

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether Rotterdam's municipal government knowingly tolerated unsafe mosque boarding schools, whether officials' warnings were ignored, and how oversight and whistleblowers are protected. The ministers answered that fire safety was adequate, no failed supervision or integrity breach by officials or administrators was found, and that the municipality has a whistleblower scheme and the burgemeester will speak with officials who felt political pressure.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop inzake beëindiging opleiding Hebreeuwse en Joodse studies

An SGP MP asked the education minister whether small programmes such as Hebrew and Jewish Studies at Leiden, which is discontinuing it, are being cut without proper weight given to their unique value, and what responsibility the government bears. The minister replied that the choice is the university's, that small programmes are not to be cut as such, and that Hebrew remains available as a minor at Leiden and as a programme at Amsterdam, so no gap requires talks with Leiden.
I therefore do not get the impression that, from a national perspective, undesirable white spots are arising in the programme offer.
Ik heb daarom niet de indruk dat, vanuit een landelijk perspectief bezien, ongewenste witte vlekken in het opleidingenaanbod ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het leerlingenvervoer

An SGP MP asked the state secretary of Education about Gaasterlân-Sleat's pupil transport costs, its tendering of transport, cost-cutting options and travel times for denominational pupils. The state secretary answered that the figures were provided by the municipality, described the legal options municipalities have to limit transport costs, and agreed to answer for the committee debate.
According to information from the municipality, the costs of pupil transport to the Eben-Haezerschool in Emmeloord, after deduction of parents' own contribution, amount to €38,712.
Volgens informatie van de gemeente bedragen de kosten van het leerlingenvervoer naar de Eben-Haezerschool te Emmeloord na aftrek van de eigen bijdrage van de ouders € 38.712.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de TV-serie Barbie’s Baby en het bericht ‘Holleeder-geknuffel moet stoppen’

MP Bisschop asked ministers whether broadcasting a TV series featuring a baby and a planned Holleeder interview were acceptable, and whether child labour rules and child protection were adequately applied. The minister answered that broadcasters are responsible for content and that the Labour Inspectorate issued a fine report because the producer had no exemption for child work, while stating that parents are primarily responsible and child protection intervention was not triggered.
The Labour Inspectorate has drawn up a fine report.
De Inspectie SZW heeft een boeterapport opgemaakt.

Shifts a sum of 600 thousand euro within the budget from the nominal and unforeseen reserve to earmark it for nature protection on the BES islands.
This amendment explicitly aims to establish that these funds benefit the drafting and implementation, in consultation with local nature organisations, of an integrated management plan
Dit amendement beoogt expliciet vast te leggen dat deze middelen ten goede komen aan het in overleg met lokale natuurorganisaties opstellen en uitvoeren van een integraal beheerplan
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over oneerlijke concurrentie

An MP asked the Minister of Defence about the ministry allegedly awarding itself a contract to transport two Fokker aircraft to Peru, in breach of the Market and Government Act, and the consequences for unfair competition. The minister answered that Defence disputed the ACM ruling, that the court rejected the appeal on 22 June 2017, that no damages claims were filed, and that a bill to tighten the Act is in consultation.
A bill tightening the Market and Government Act is currently going through an internet consultation round.
Momenteel doorloopt een wetsvoorstel dat de Wet Markt en Overheid op enkele punten aanscherpt een consultatieronde via internet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vervuiling van een drinkwaterbron in Zuid-Holland

MPs Koşer Kaya and Hachchi (D66) asked about pesticide pollution of a drinking water source in Zuid-Holland, including incident frequency, substances and health risks, and what support and enforcement measures exist against the polluter. The minister answered that pesticide norm exceedances cause near-annual intake stops at several Maas and Lekkanaal intake points, that the source lies in the Bommelerwaard under the Waterschap Rivierenland's responsibility, and that the waterschap has administrative enforcement tools, with Rijkswaterstaat offering help.
The Waterschap Rivierenland has administrative enforcement instruments available to address the discharge in the Bommelerwaard.
Het Waterschap Rivierenland heeft voor de aanpak van de lozing in de Bommelerwaard bestuurlijke handhavingsinstrumenten tot haar beschikking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Bommel over het gebruik van Nederlandse inlichtingen bij een drone-aanval met onschuldige burgerslachtoffers

MPs Hachchi and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch intelligence was used in a US drone strike causing civilian deaths, whether it was an illegal targeted killing, and whether sharing with partners should be reconsidered. The Minister of Defence said the government cannot confirm the strike was illegal, that the MIVD gathered the intelligence in NATO Operation Ocean Shield, that the government will reassess sharing if a partner is shown to carry out illegal targeted killings, and that CTIVD's review timing is for the CTIVD to announce.
As also stated in my reply to the questions of MPs Van Bommel, Van Dijk, Van Raak and Sjoerdsma of 10 April 2014, it is not known on the basis of what information such activities are carried out.

Zoals ook gemeld in mijn reactie op de vragen van leden Van Bommel, Van Dijk, Van Raak en Sjoerdsma van 10 april 2014 is niet bekend op basis van welke informatie dergelijke activiteiten worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de vergunning verleend aan Urenco voor de export van 1000 ton verarmd uranium naar Rusland

D66 MPs asked how the ANVS issued a transport permit for depleted uranium to Russia despite a text error, what risks, oversight and Russian end-use guarantees apply, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The government admits the error should not have been issued, says it was corrected by amendment, and defends the export licence as legally permissible with formal Russian guarantees, declining to withdraw it.
I regret the error made. The ANVS has in the meantime taken measures so that a strict application of the justification principle will apply from now on.
Ik betreur de gemaakte fout. Er zijn intussen door de ANVS maatregelen getroffen die er toe leiden dat voortaan sprake zal zijn van een strikte toepassing van het rechtvaardigingsbeginsel.
Antwoord op vraag 3 van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over leveringen van ‘dual use’ goederen

Two D66 MPs asked whether the minister had contacted Imtech about an internal investigation showing at least 51 shipments of dual-use goods to denied entities. The minister answers that the company applied for no export licences, that the ministry did contact RH Marine Group and reviewed the investigation, and that customs has been asked to investigate while licence applications are held.
After inspection, customs was asked to conduct an investigation.
Na inzage is de douane gevraagd een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over een aan Urenco verleende vergunning voor de levering van verarmd uranium aan Rusland

MPs from D66 asked whether a November 2015 transport permit for up to 1,000 tonnes of uranium hexafluoride to Russia, and the related export licence, were justified given the sanctions climate, Russian plutonium and weapons risks, storage conditions and Euratom rules. The government answered that the permit wrongly mentions depleted uranium (only natural UF6 is covered, with a textual error to be corrected), that the export is civil and subject to Russian formal guarantees and IAEA safeguards, and that transport risks are low; several questions were answered by restating the regulatory framework.
The textual error will be corrected as soon as possible and the transport permit will be amended.
De tekstuele fout zal zo snel mogelijk worden hersteld en de vervoersvergunning zal worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Swinkels over het artikel ‘Tientallen vliegtuigen bij Schiphol met laser beschenen’ en de uitzending van het programma opsporing verzocht

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of lasers aimed at landing aircraft at Schiphol and about a Opsporing verzocht broadcast on the matter, including police action, the difficulty of catching the perpetrator, and possible restrictions on laser pointer sales. The state secretary answered that police have acted, the suspect has not yet been caught because the beam is hard to trace, the government sees no need for new national measures or a campaign, and sales from foreign webshops are hard to supervise.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on the exact nature of the actions taken by the police.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen omtrent de exacte aard van de acties die door de politie zijn verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Hachchi over bijeenkomsten in het kader van het RIVM-onderzoek naar werken met chroom-VI

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Hachchi (D66) asked the Defence Minister about information meetings for former staff on the RIVM study into chromium-VI exposure, including frustration over criteria and attendance and the timeline. The minister defended the meetings and the study's independence and oversight, gave attendance figures, and promised fuller information in a late-January 2016 progress letter.
In the next progress letter, expected at the end of January 2016, I expect to be able to give you more substantive information about the study.
In de volgende standvanzakenbrief, die eind januari 2016 is voorzien, verwacht ik u meer inhoudelijke informatie over het onderzoek te kunnen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over berichten in de media omtrent de “massale vernietiging van bewijsmateriaal van buitenlandse verkeersovertreders”

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether evidence on foreign traffic offenders was massively destroyed, why, and how EU cooperation on collecting traffic fines works. The Minister answered that no fines were destroyed, that about 20% of fines are not collected, that cooperation generally works well, and that digital enforcement is being extended to foreign plates, though the reasons for deleting some data are only set out in a separate letter.
There is no question of destroyed fines.
Er is geen sprake van vernietigde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Veldman over het conflict tussen de gemeente Nijmegen en Rijkswaterstaat over het gebruik van de nevengeul van de Waal

MPs Hachchi and Veldman asked the minister about a dispute between Nijmegen municipality and Rijkswaterstaat over use of the Waal side channel and the Veur-Lent island, including whether Rijkswaterstaat is backtracking on earlier agreements. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat is working constructively with the municipality, will draw up a joint plan for the area, and indicated where a boathouse and seasonal catering may be located.
Rijkswaterstaat will, in consultation with the municipality, draw up a plan for how this area is to be used.
Rijkswaterstaat zal in afstemming met de gemeente een plan opstellen voor de invulling van dit gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over een niet-aanvalspact tussen Europa en China op het gebied van cyber

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether the Dutch cyber envoy is negotiating a digital non-aggression pact between Europe and China, and related questions on its purpose, mandate and participants. The government answered that no such negotiations took place; the envoy only joined an informal dialogue on cyber norms, and the government promised no further information on a pact.
There was no question of negotiations on a 'non-aggression treaty' during the meeting on 26 and 27 October.
Van onderhandelingen over een «niet-aanvalsverdrag» was geen sprake tijdens de bijeenkomst op 26 en 27 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi over de berichtgeving dat de MIVD nog steeds advocaten afluistert

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked whether the MIVD wiretaps lawyer-client conversations, how often this happens, and whether a court-ordered change to independent review of lawyer taps will be implemented before taps occur. The Minister said the MIVD taps only when necessary under the law with ministerial approval, declined to say how often or whether a specific person is tapped, and said the court ruling's implications, including independent review, are being studied with information to the House to follow as soon as possible.
As you know, I cannot publicly address whether someone is being wiretapped by the MIVD.
Zoals u weet kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de vraag of iemand door de MIVD wordt afgeluisterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi over de uitspraken dat een Nederlandse militair die is overgelopen naar ISIS beter ‘daar kan sneuvelen’

Two MPs asked the government whether the Minister-President's and Defence Minister's remarks that a Dutch soldier who defected to ISIS could better die there were government policy, and about related questions on citizenship loss, prosecution and punishment. The government answered that the remark was a reaction to a multiple-choice question, not cabinet policy, that the soldier will be arrested and questioned on return, that ongoing criminal investigation prevents further disclosure, and that a bill to expand citizenship revocation for terrorism is pending.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) has started an investigation into criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) is een onderzoek gestart naar strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Eijsink over kindermisbruik in Afghanistan

MPs Hachchi and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about reports that US soldiers were told to ignore child sexual abuse (bacha bazi) in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch troops were trained and guided on it. The minister acknowledged the practice conflicts with human rights, said Defence was unaware of it at the 2002 start and has no specific guidelines, relying on general ethics training, a pragmatic ban on minors at Dutch bases, and post-mission care.
Defence lacks the information needed to fully assess the American case.
Het ontbreekt Defensie aan informatie om de Amerikaanse casuïstiek volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over de berichten dat de Nederlandse Politie Sint Maarten te corrupt vindt

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked about reports that the Dutch police consider the Sint Maarten police too corrupt to cooperate with, and about the rules, powers and remedies around the Recherche Samenwerkingsteam. The government answered that the team's reinforcement is planned for 24 months, that an Integrity Chamber law was adopted in Sint Maarten, and that cooperation with the Sint Maarten police will be intensified under the 24 May 2015 protocol.
The Integrity Chamber Ordinance was adopted by the Estates of Sint Maarten on 18 August 2015.
De Landsverordening Integriteitkamer is op 18 augustus 2015 door de Staten van Sint Maarten vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht “Een jaar na MH17: nog steeds vliegen boven conflictgebieden”

An MP asked whether KLM and Air France fly over conflict zones such as Mali, South Sudan and the Sinai, whether the government could guarantee passenger safety and information, and whether conflict-zone overflight should be avoided altogether. The government answered that airlines are themselves responsible for risk assessment and route choice, that it does not actively monitor or steer their routes, and that it shares relevant threat information without intending to restrict routes.
Each airline is itself responsible for the safe execution of a flight.
Elke luchtvaartmaatschappij is zelf verantwoordelijk voor een veilige uitvoering van een vlucht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat het kabinet Sint Eustatius boycot voor verdere werkbezoeken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet agreed not to visit Sint Eustatius while it is under enhanced financial supervision, and what the purpose and precedent were. The minister confirmed a coordinated approach to visits, said the Governor and Ministry would continue dialogue with the island's board, and stated a meeting with the island's leadership was planned for mid-September.
The island executive council has sufficient opportunity to engage in dialogue with the Netherlands, in the person of the Governor.
Het bestuurscollege heeft voldoende gelegenheid om het gesprek met Nederland te voeren, in de persoon van de Rijksvertegenwoordiger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de arrestatie van Carvajal en dreigende inval van Venezuela op Aruba

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about the arrest of Venezuelan official Carvajal on Aruba, reports of Venezuelan warships approaching Aruba, and whether there was a military threat. The government answered that Carvajal enjoyed consular immunity under the Vienna Convention and was released, that the Venezuelan naval vessels were in Venezuelan territorial waters, that no military threats were made, and it answered most questions in substance while declining to comment on the exact words attributed to the Prime Minister.
The cabinet has taken note of the reports.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van de berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over onterecht afgegeven medische certificaten aan piloten

Members of parliament asked the state secretary how the aviation medical centre EAMC could issue 99 doubtful medical certificates to pilots, whether other certification bodies are affected, and why inspections of the remaining bodies would take the rest of 2015. The state secretary answered that the ILT has annulled 99 certificates, that criminal proceedings are ongoing, that extra inspections of all other bodies have been started and finished in November, and that no legislative change is currently needed.
On this basis, the ILT annulled 99 certificates and suspended 1 certificate.
Op basis hiervan heeft de ILT 99 certificaten nietig verklaard en 1 certificaat geschorst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over misstanden bij de verbetering van de veiligheid bij de luchtmacht

MPs Hachchi and Van Dijk asked whether the director of the Military Aviation Authority, who previously commanded Eindhoven air base where safety problems occurred, has a conflict of interest in overseeing air force safety, and whether disciplinary action or an independent specialist is warranted. The minister answered that the 2014 OVV report found no structural shortcomings, that the conflict concern was addressed by assigning certification of Eindhoven flight activities to the deputy director, and that no external specialist or disciplinary measures are planned.

Precisely to prevent the appearance of a conflict of interest, it was decided earlier this year to assign the certification assessment of flight activities at Eindhoven air base to the deputy director of the Military Aviation Authority (MLA).

Juist ter voorkoming van de schijn van belangenverstrengeling is eerder dit jaar besloten de beoordeling van de certificering van de vliegactiviteiten op vliegbasis Eindhoven op te dragen aan de plaatsvervangend directeur Militaire Luchtvaartautoriteit (MLA).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Hachchi over het bericht dat kwetsbaarheden in encryptiesoftware door Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten zijn gebruikt

Two D66 MPs asked whether a research article on Diffie-Hellman weaknesses, which suggests the NSA may have used them to read VPN, SSH and TLS traffic, is credible, whether other states or non-state actors have used such weaknesses, and whether the government wants access to encrypted data or a uniform policy on zero-day vulnerabilities. The government declined to say whether the researchers' hypothesis is correct because intelligence services do not disclose their collection methods, advised longer key lengths and stronger configuration, and said it supports encryption and responsible disclosure, referring to a forthcoming letter on encryption.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect their intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hachchi over de haven van Saba in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked the minister about reports that the Saba harbour's poor condition and mooring problems deter tourists, and what has been done since 2013. The minister said infrastructure repairs may be needed, a harbour expert was seconded and new rules adopted, and he will examine financial options for harbour improvements in the spring budget decision.
I have indicated to the Kingdom Representative that I will look into whether financial resources can be freed up in the short term to improve the harbour of Saba.
Ik heb aan de Rijksvertegenwoordiger aangegeven dat ik op korte termijn zal gaan bezien of er financiële middelen vrij gemaakt kunnen worden voor de verbetering van de haven van Saba.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Weesboten steeds groter probleem’

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the growing problem of abandoned 'ghost boats', including a report projecting up to 35,000 by 2030, and whether central government, a national fund, or a national registration system should act. The State Secretary answered that the central government has no responsibility for abandoned boats on non-state land or water, that responsibility lies with producers, importers, branch organisations and the authorities managing the waterways, and that a new national registration system would add administrative burden without clear effectiveness.
The central government has no responsibility for abandoned ghost ships on or in land or waters that do not belong to the central government.
Het Rijk heeft geen verantwoordelijkheid voor achtergelaten spookschepen op of in gronden of wateren die niet van het Rijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Hachchi en Bergkamp over de waarschuwing voor digitale dementie bij decentrale overheden

MPs Schouw, Hachchi and Bergkamp asked the ministers about warnings from local and regional officials that digital records risk being poorly preserved, and whether archive law and powers are sufficient. The government says existing archive law shows no gaps, points to a Ictu baseline study and to strategic information consultation (SIO) as the remedy, and declines to accelerate the AIDO project for lack of resources.
There are indeed no indications that the legal frameworks in archive regulations lead to shortcomings.
Er zijn inderdaad geen indicaties dat de wettelijke kaders in de Archiefregelgeving tot tekortkomingen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over problemen met de motor van de F-35

An MP (Hachchi, D66) asked the Minister of Defence about a US Inspector General report finding quality-management failures and 61 deviations at Pratt & Whitney, the F-35 engine maker, and what this means for Dutch contracts and costs. The minister answered that the findings concern process control rather than product quality, that the JPO is acting on them, and that the deviations have no direct consequences for product quality or costs.

There are no consequences. The Netherlands has legal arrangements with the US government, which concludes contracts with the manufacturers Lockheed Martin and Pratt & Whitney on behalf of the partners.
Er zijn geen gevolgen. Nederland heeft juridische afspraken met de Amerikaanse overheid die namens de partners contracten sluit met de fabrikanten Lockheed Martin en Pratt & Whitney.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht ‘Bluscapaciteit ontoereikend bij grote brand’

MPs Hachchi, Van Veldhoven and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether insufficient firefighting water capacity in the water mains poses a national risk to businesses, schools and hospitals, whether the government knew of it, and what should be done. The minister answered that he was not aware of such a problem, that the Veiligheidsberaad sees no national issue and deems water supply a matter for municipalities and safety regions, and that no extra action is needed.
The Veiligheidsberaad indicates that the availability of firefighting water is a matter for municipalities and safety regions; the fire service is part of the safety region.
Het Veiligheidsberaad geeft daarbij aan dat de beschikbaarheid van bluswater een zaak is van gemeenten en veiligheidsregio's; de brandweer maakt deel uit van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over de aanwijzing Extern optreden in relatie tot de vrijheid van meningsuiting

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the requirement that staff submit external publications in advance to the Communications directorate for advice infringes freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution. The minister answered that the advice is non-binding, serves to prevent operational and security harm and consequences afterwards, and that she does not consider the requirement a restriction on freedom of expression.
The advice of the Communications directorate is non-binding.
Het advies van de directie Communicatie is vrijblijvend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat Defensie laks zou zijn met geheimen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a report that Defence is lax with secrets, and about a Lloyd's audit and whether it should be sent to parliament. The minister rejects the press framing, says the audit is an internal tool that will not be sent to parliament, and states that existing security rules and supervision are adequate, pointing to awareness-raising measures.
It is not obvious to send this report to the House of Representatives.
Het ligt niet voor de hand om dit rapport naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de oorzaak en consequenties van het neerstorten van een ScanEagle

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about the cause of a 2013 ScanEagle drone crash, the adequacy of operator training, the Military Aviation Authority's review, why the investigation was not sent to parliament, and the use of the drone over populated areas and by police. The minister said a faulty sensor coating caused the crash, training has been adjusted, the report was withheld for confidentiality reasons, and the drone has not yet been deployed over the Netherlands for civil support.
Investigation reports on such incidents are as a rule not sent to the House of Representatives.
Onderzoeksrapporten van dergelijke incidenten worden in de regel niet naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over Nieuwe tegenslagen met de JSF

An MP asked the Defence Minister about new software delays in the F-35 programme, including effects on cost, operational capability, close air support and projected Dutch industry revenue based on 4,500 aircraft. The minister answered that the delays have no financial consequences, that the block 3F software will give full capabilities around 2017, and that the figures and cost-accounting concerns were already addressed earlier.
No, that is not correct. The first aircraft with the full operational capabilities of the block 3F software are expected in 2017.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De eerste toestellen met de volledige operationele capaciteiten van de block 3F software worden in 2017 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Defensie een zwarte lijst voor journalisten aanhoudt

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister whether Defence keeps a blacklist of journalists, as reported by EenVandaag, and what measures would prevent one. The Minister answered that no such list exists, that the report rested on a single internal email expressing a staff member's personal frustration, and that press freedom is an important good to be protected.
As I reported to your House in my letter of 17 April (Kamerstuk 29 692, no. 20) following EenVandaag's coverage, there is no blacklist or similar list for journalists at Defence.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 17 april jl. (Kamerstuk 29 692, nr. 20 ) naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving van EenVandaag aan uw Kamer heb gemeld, is er bij Defensie geen sprake van een zwarte of soortgelijke lijst voor journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het hacken van passagiersvliegtuigen van buitenaf

MP Hachchi (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about a US GAO report warning of rising hacking risk to passenger aircraft, whether this applies to Dutch airspace, what measures have been taken, and about a German call to make aircraft remotely controllable. The State Secretary replied that the vulnerability is an expected future possibility rather than a demonstrated one, that certification and EU-level cybersecurity steps are the relevant safeguards, and that remote control of aircraft raises many practical and legal objections requiring further study.
The vulnerability mentioned is currently not a demonstrated vulnerability, but an expected possibility in the future given developments in aviation.
De genoemde kwetsbaarheid betreft op dit moment geen aangetoonde kwetsbaarheid, maar een op termijn verwachte mogelijkheid gezien de ontwikkelingen binnen de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat Duitsland de veiligheid in de luchtvaart onderzoekt na de vliegramp bij Germanwings

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would set up a dedicated working group on aviation safety after the Germanwings crash, mirroring Germany, and whether the minister would review Dutch aviation safety, cockpit technology, and pilot medical testing. The minister declined a separate Dutch working group, pointing to ICAO, EASA and existing EU safety systems, and promised to press EASA to continue and schedule the work and to inform the German counterpart.
This makes it unnecessary for the Netherlands to set up its own working group.
Dit maakt het niet nodig om als Nederland een eigen werkgroep in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat de Navo België adviseert om fregatten van de hand te doen

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether NATO advised Belgium to divest its frigates and what the consequences would be for Dutch-Belgian defence cooperation, including naval cooperation (Benesam) and the NH-90 helicopter. The minister said intensive contacts exist, that no Belgian decision had been taken, that NATO contacts are confidential, and pointed to existing cooperation in helicopters and special forces.
I have not understood from my Belgian colleague that such a measure is under consideration.
Ik heb van mijn Belgische collega niet begrepen dat een dergelijke maatregel aan de orde zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht 'Sluis op losse schroeven'

An MP asked the minister why bidders for major lock renovation projects (Limmel, IJmuiden, Beatrix locks) appear reluctant, whether talks with the construction sector occurred, and whether projects would be delayed. The minister answered that interest is sufficient, consultation occurs via existing platforms, no delay is planned, and Rijkswaterstaat is exploring tender adjustments.
Rijkswaterstaat is examining the possibilities of making changes to the tendering process to limit tender costs and capacity and thereby promote market parties' interest.
Rijkswaterstaat beziet de mogelijkheden om wijzigingen aan te brengen in het aanbestedingsproces om tenderkosten en -capaciteit te beperken en daarmee de interesse van marktpartijen te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over containers met stenen uit Afghanistan

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister how stolen Dutch defence equipment from Afghanistan was replaced by containers of stones, the value of the loss, whether it can be recovered, and how the theft happened. The minister said the containers were transferred to a civilian carrier, the equipment cannot be traced or recovered, the carrier has been held liable, and the military police closed their investigation without finding how the theft occurred.
The military police investigated the circumstances of this incident and could not determine how the removal took place.
De KMAR heeft de toedracht van dit voorval onderzocht en daarbij niet kunnen achterhalen op welke wijze de ontvreemding is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat twee voormalig medewerkers van de MIVD worden doorbetaald tot hun pensioen en zijn bevorderd

An MP asked the Minister of Defence whether two former MIVD intelligence officers, placed on non-active duty in 2007, were promoted and paid until retirement without working, and about the costs and leak of the settlement. The minister answered by referring to earlier CTIVD and ministerial letters and said the settlement's contents remain confidential under the agreement with the parties.
In reaching the solution to the labour dispute through a settlement agreement, the parties agreed to keep its contents confidential.
Bij de totstandkoming van de oplossing voor het gerezen arbeidsconflict door middel van een vaststellingsovereenkomst zijn partijen over de inhoud daarvan geheimhouding overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het niet meenemen van alternatieven van bewoners voor onder andere dijkverzwaring

An MP asked the minister whether water boards must thoroughly examine and weigh residents' alternatives to dike reinforcement, give residents full early information on plans and costs, and allow more time for such research. The minister answered that all serious alternatives must be weighed under the participation code, that residents should be involved early, that preparation costs are reimbursed, and that the water board's decision is subject to provincial approval and appeal to the Council of State.
In decision-making on dike reinforcements, all serious alternatives, including those of residents, must be weighed.
In de besluitvorming over dijkverzwaringen dienen alle serieuze alternatieven, waaronder die van bewoners, te worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat er recentelijk nog onveilig is gewerkt met chroom-6

MPs Hachchi and Jasper van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about reports that personnel at Volkel and Eindhoven air bases worked with chromium-6 unsafely in 2012 and 2014, and why the Chamber was not informed proactively. The Minister replied that exposure was below the limit value, that about a few dozen specialised staff work with chromium paint, that measures were taken, and that the Armed Forces occupational health service will report on an ongoing review, expected in April.

As I previously reported to you (see among others Chamber letter 34 000 X, no. 72 of 2 February), the Defence occupational health service is conducting research at the ten defence locations where chromium-containing paint is still used.

Zoals ik u eerder heb gemeld (zie onder meer Kamerbrief 34 000 X, nr. 72 van 2 februari jl.), voert de arbodienst van Defensie onderzoek uit op de tien defensielocaties waar nu nog met chroomhoudende verf wordt gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het aan de grond houden van Duitse NH90 helikopters vanwege technische gebreken

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether German NH90 helicopter restrictions over sea and built-up areas apply to the Dutch NH90 and affect delivery and capacity. The minister answered that the German limits stem from a national airworthiness rule rather than a technical defect, that the Dutch NH90 is certified under US FAR standards and not affected, and that the Dutch military aviation authority confirmed this.
The Netherlands is itself responsible for the certification of military aircraft.
Nederland is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de certificering van militaire luchtvaartuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht ‘De vulkaan van Saba kan bezig zijn te ontwaken’

An MP asked the government about the risk of a volcanic eruption on Saba, the state of its seismograph monitoring, which ministry is responsible for safety there, and how evacuation and emergency response are organised. The Minister answered at length, explaining the monitoring setup, the legal responsibilities under the Veiligheidswet BES, the emergency protocols and exercises, and that new seismographs and GPS equipment will be installed.
Measures will be taken to increase the availability of the measurement data.
Maatregelen zullen genomen worden om de beschikbaarheid van de meetgegevens te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over de stijging van waterschapslasten ten gevolge van het hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked whether rising water board levies caused by shifting flood-protection costs to water boards breach the minister's earlier pledge that citizens would not bear these costs. The minister answered that the Water Governance Agreement targets efficiency gains offsetting cost increases, that monitoring shows the agreement on track, and that no individual-level commitments were made.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Jasper van Dijk over gebruik van chroomverf bij Defensie

MPs Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister why chromium paint was still used unsafely in 2008, whether safe working can be guaranteed, and how staff are informed. The minister said Defence aims to work chromium-free, that new incidents cannot be fully excluded, that protective measures were tightened since 2001 and staff are trained, and that work is halted when precautions are missing.
Despite the tightening of regulations and adjustments to working methods, new incidents remain possible.
Ondanks de aanscherpingen van de regelgeving en aanpassingen van de werkwijze blijven nieuwe voorvallen mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het dreigingsniveau in Mali

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Defence about the raised threat level around Dutch soldiers in Mali, including the MNLA demand for apology over an Apache strike, deaths during protests in Gao, a possible buffer zone and whether intelligence gathering and political reconciliation remain possible. The government answered that the threat level is significant, extra protective measures were taken, no investigation is needed into the Apache strike since MINUSMA acted in self-defence, and the Algiers talks have resumed.
In response to the raised threat level, additional measures have been taken.
Naar aanleiding van het verhoogde dreigingsniveau zijn aanvullende maatregelen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over bewerkte testresultaten van de F-35

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether improvements in F-35 test results stem mainly from a changed counting method, whether the minister was informed, and whether stealth problems exist. The minister answered that the DOT&E report shows reliability gains, that the report does not clarify how much is due to counting changes, that the partner countries were informed without content details, and that there are no stealth problems.
He points out that part of the improvement in this parameter can be attributed to the way the F-35 programme counts and processes failures.
Hij wijst erop dat een deel van de verbetering van deze parameter kan worden toegeschreven aan de manier waarop het F-35 programma storingen telt en verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over verstekelingen aan boord van de Karel Doorman

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister about stowaways found aboard the Karel Doorman Ebola relief ship, the security consequences, what happens to them on arrival, and whether they were infected. The minister confirmed awareness, said an internal investigation found remaining intrusion points being addressed, that the stowaways were refused entry and handed to the IND for asylum processing, and that they were not infected.
The internal investigation into the stowaways found aboard the Joint Support Ship (JSS) Karel Doorman has now been completed.
Het interne onderzoek over de verstekelingen die werden aangetroffen aan boord van het Joint Support Ship (JSS) Karel Doorman is inmiddels voltooid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de Isla raffinaderij in verhouding tot internationale milieuverdragen

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked how the government's position that the Isla refinery's pollution and CO2 emissions are a purely Curaçao matter fits with Kingdom-wide treaty obligations, why the refinery is absent from the biodiversity report, and why some environmental treaties apply to the whole Kingdom and others only to the European part. The government answered that each country within the Kingdom is responsible for implementing environmental policy and its treaty obligations, that the refinery was excluded from the CBD report because it concerns green environment and little data exists, and that treaty application depends on extension requests and implementing legislation.
However, within the Kingdom each country is itself responsible for implementing environmental policy.
Echter binnen het Koninkrijk is elk land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het milieubeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over achterblijvende resultaten om meer vrouwen te betrekken bij militaire vredesmissies

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked why women remain underrepresented in the Dutch armed forces and UN peacekeeping missions, and whether further research and a revised national action plan on UNSCR 1325 are planned. The ministers answered that quality is the main criterion, that gender is treated as operationally relevant, that further research is not opportune, and that a February 2015 conference and the 2015 UN review will inform the next action plan.
Further research is not considered opportune at this time.
Nader onderzoek achten wij nu niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het wapenembargo tegen Rusland, de Franse Mistraldeal en samenwerking tussen Europese wapenleveranciers en Russische strijdkrachten

Two MPs asked whether the Mistral helicopter carrier deal would be delivered to Russia despite the arms embargo, how Europe's arms makers could cooperate with Russian forces, and about the embargo's status and enforcement. The minister replied that France decides on delivery, that the government shares France's view that conditions are not right for delivery, that the embargo does not cover pre-August 2014 contracts, that it runs until 31 July 2015, and that the Netherlands will raise enforcement issues in Brussels.
The government has no insight into deliveries above 1 million euros from EU member states based on contracts concluded before 1 August 2014.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in leveringen van boven de 1 miljoen euro vanuit EU-lidstaten op basis van voor 1 augustus 2014 gesloten contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over postume rehabilitatie van drie KNIL-vliegers

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether three KNIL pilots convicted in Colombo in 1943 were given long sentences to set an example, and whether the government would reopen historical research and reconsider posthumous rehabilitation. The minister answered that the sentencing cannot now be traced to a deterrence motive, that the 1950 pardon already addressed their interests, that the earlier rehabilitation refusal stands, and that further historical research is unlikely given lost archival sources.
Obtaining further insight into this case is therefore unlikely.
Het verkrijgen van nadere inzichten in deze zaak is daardoor onwaarschijnlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over de Isla raffinaderij in relatie tot de EU-sancties

Two MPs asked whether processing Russian crude at the Venezuelan-run Isla refinery on Curaçao complies with EU sanctions against Russia, and how the Curaçao government is held to EU sanctions. The minister replied that the energy sanctions do not ban imports of Russian oil, that the refinery's dealings fall under Curaçao's autonomy, and that Curaçao's cooperation is being pressed via the Kingdom's Rijkssanctiewet.
The Cabinet has no information on economic cooperation between the Isla refinery on Curaçao and Russian companies.
Het Kabinet heeft geen informatie over economische samenwerkingsverbanden tussen de Isla raffinaderij op Curaçao en Russische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over het artikel ‘Gemalen kunnen veel energie besparen’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about press reports that pumping stations (gemalen) could save considerable energy, and whether this could help meet the 2020 efficiency target. The minister said the studies show savings potential but are too limited to confirm the 20% figure, committed to discussing bemaling with the Unie van Waterschappen, and noted that investments pay back in 7-10 years.
I am certainly willing to do that.
Ik ben daar zeker toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke fraude bij de productie van de motor van de F-35

MPs Hachchi and Sjoerdsma asked the Defence Minister about possible fraud involving titanium of uncertain origin, possibly from Russia, in the F-35 engine, and how Defence would prevent unsafe or illegally sourced materials. The minister replied that US authorities are investigating, affected parts are being replaced, Defence has raised the matter with the Joint Program Office, and she cannot rule out problems until the inquiry ends, but will inform the House of the outcome of the case against A&P Alloys.
I cannot make any statements on this at the moment because the American authorities are conducting an investigation.
Ik kan daarover op dit moment geen uitspraken doen omdat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten onderzoek doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Van Hijum en Hachchi over het bericht ‘Ziek personeelslid vliegbasis Twenthe kreeg 100.000 euro schadevergoeding’

MPs asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a media report that a sick former employee at Twenthe air base received 100,000 euro in damages after 14 years, allegedly on condition of dropping further legal steps, and whether such payouts had occurred before. The Minister confirmed the settlement after a long process delayed by medical uncertainty, denied any gag clause, reported fourteen related claims with five liability acknowledgements, and agreed to an independent broad investigation of all Defence staff exposed to chromium-6.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht «Nederland weigert eigen tolk asiel»

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about press reports that the Netherlands refused asylum to a former Dutch interpreter from Uruzgan, whose claim was rejected by Norway, and about the wider treatment of Afghan interpreters. The government answered that Norway is responsible under Dublin, that no individual circumstances justified taking over the claim, that individual talks and compensation payments to a group of 25 Afghan interpreters are under way, and that a referral route via the IND exists.
As the Chamber is aware, I am reticent about providing information on an individual case.
Als uw Kamer bekend, ben ik terughoudend met het verstrekken van informatie over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat F-35 toestellen aan de grond staan

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister how long the F-35 fleet would be grounded after a fire incident, and whether this affected delivery schedules, costs and confidence in the 37-aircraft budget. The Minister replied that flights resumed after a US investigation found a specific cause, that no direct delivery impact is seen (first Dutch aircraft in 2019), that financial consequences are not yet clear, and that incidents will be reported in progress reports.
I have promised to do so.
Ik heb toegezegd dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Knops en Eijsink over het voornemen van de marineleiding om tweedehands helikopters aan te schaffen

Three MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the naval leadership plans to buy second-hand helicopters amid a helicopter shortage linked to NH90 problems, and what the financing, risks and training implications would be. The minister answered that the headline was incorrect, that the statements came from the naval officers' association chair rather than naval leadership, that no purchase is planned, and that compensating measures focus on extending existing Cougar helicopters and using other countries' helicopters.
The headline above the report is not correct.
De kop boven het bericht is niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Hachchi over het bericht: ‘Aruba boos over trage benoeming Raad van State’

Two MPs asked why Aruba's seat on the Council of State remains unfilled, whether a nomination was pulled from the Council of Ministers agenda, and when Aruba will be represented. The minister confirmed the report, cited confidentiality of Council of Ministers deliberations on nominations, and explained that the nomination requires agreement with the Aruban government but not automatic approval, promising only to announce any appointment.
Under Article 26 of the Council of Ministers' Rules of Procedure, there is a duty of confidentiality regarding what is discussed or takes place at the meeting.
Krachtens artikel 26 van het Reglement van orde voor de Ministerraad bestaat ten aanzien van hetgeen ter vergadering wordt besproken of geschiedt, een geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht dat de beoogde Venezolaanse consul generaal voor Aruba, Hugo Carvajal, is vrijgelaten

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hugo Carvajal, designated Venezuelan consul-general for Aruba, was released, alleged Venezuelan naval threats, and the basis for granting him immunity and declaring him persona non grata. The minister answered that the Venezuelan navy sighting was routine transit with no threats, that immunity rested on Article 13 of the Vienna Convention given Venezuela's reasonable reliance on a non-diplomatic designation note, and that persona non grata status requires no reasons.
It concerns an autonomous decision of mine that was not coordinated with the US.
Het betreft een autonoom besluit van mij dat niet is afgestemd met de VS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over de onduidelijke antwoorden van de regering inzake de hongerstaking van minister-president van Aruba

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government how it prevented escalation with Aruba over the budget dispute, whether the College Financieel Toezicht was explicitly assigned the investigation, what solution it intends, whether a mediator should be appointed, and whether the Raad van State should rule on the lawfulness of the Rijksministerraad decision. The minister answered that the joint press statement clearly pointed to Cft staff, that a quick interim report and a final report within six weeks are expected, and that the royal decree was adopted lawfully, so no Raad van State ruling is sought.
With a view to the process of finding an acute solution, I do not consider it useful to make that communication public now.
Met het oog op het proces van het vinden van een acute oplossing, acht ik het niet dienstig die communicatie nu publiek te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Arubaanse premier Mike Eman in hongerstaking gaat

MPs from D66 and CDA asked whether Aruba's prime minister's hunger strike was caused by a Council of Ministers decision instructing the Governor not to sign Aruba's 2014 budget, and whether that decision was lawful. The minister replied that the Council acted lawfully, that the budget right remains with Aruba, and that the Governor's instruction is a temporary suspension pending an independent review.
The decisions of the Council of Ministers are taken carefully and lawfully.
De beslissingen van de Rijksministerraad komen zorgvuldig en rechtmatig tot stand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht van “EU-onderzoek naar fraude op Bonaire”

An MP asked why the OLAF report on possible fraud in Bonaire subsidies was confidential, whether it would be published, and how the Chamber would be informed about prosecution decisions. The minister answered that the report was given confidentially by the European Commission, that a preliminary criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is underway which publication could harm, and that no communication about such an investigation is normally given.
Publication of the report could harm this preliminary investigation.
Openbaarmaking van het rapport zou dit oriënterend onderzoek kunnen schaden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over de intrekking van de ondersteuning van de jaarlijkse reünie van Indië-veteranen

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether support for the annual reunion of the 7th Grenadiers battalion (1949–1951) veterans was being withdrawn, and what means were available to keep it. The minister replied that support is maintained but coordination moves to another army unit, and that there is no budget cut on veterans' reunions.
No, support for the annual reunion of the 7th Grenadiers battalion remains in place.
Nee, de steun aan de jaarlijkse reünie van het 7e Bataljon Grenadiers blijft gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over gezichtsherkenning door de Scan Eagle

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Scan Eagle drone, used to track seals, is designed for facial recognition and whether its use for justice purposes could include such recognition. The government answered that the Scan Eagle's Defence cameras cannot identify people at operational altitude, but it does not rule out future low-altitude flights or facial-recognition cameras, pointing to a WODC privacy study.

Because I cannot foresee all future purposes for which a Raven or Scan Eagle will be deployed, I do not wish to rule out in advance that they will ever fly at low altitude or ever be fitted with cameras enabling facial recognition.

Omdat ik niet alle toekomstige doeleinden waarvoor een Raven of Scan Eagle zal worden ingezet kan voorzien, wil ik niet bij voorbaat uitsluiten dat deze ooit op lage hoogte zullen vliegen of dat zij ooit zullen worden voorzien van camera's waarmee gezichtsherkenning mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Verhoeven en Hachchi over drones die huizen fotograferen

MPs from D66 asked whether the commercial drone firm Billionhomes may photograph homes from the air and publish them without owners' consent, and how privacy is protected under the Wbp and drone permit rules.
