The Minister answered that the Wbp applies only where data are traceable to persons, that the ILT has received no permit application from Billionhomes, that privacy is not part of the aviation-safety permit assessment, and that a WODC study on privacy and drones is under way.

I have recently informed your House about a study that the WODC is carrying out at the cabinet's request into various questions surrounding unmanned aircraft (UAS), with particular attention to the possible negative effects of their use on privacy and how that privacy can be safeguarded most effectively.

Ik heb uw Kamer recent geïnformeerd over een onderzoek dat het WODC op verzoek van het kabinet uitvoert naar diverse vragen rondom onbemande luchtvaartuigen (UAS), met daarbij bijzondere aandacht voor de mogelijk negatieve effecten van het gebruik van onbemande luchtvaartuigen op de privacy
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over de snelle slijtage van de nieuwe helikopters (NH-90)

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister whether the NH-90 helicopter is made by a sister company of the Fyra train manufacturer, whether this prompted a review of production and maintenance, what the financial consequences of rapid wear are, and what the operational consequences are for anti-piracy, Caribbean and future operations. The minister answered that the parent company Finmeccanica owns both Agusta Westland and AnsaldoBreda, that production and maintenance were not changed because of the Fyra, that a working group will report on financial and operational effects by end of April, and that 2014 operations proceed as planned.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform you further.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het verschuiven van de waterschapsbelasting van boeren naar burgers

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked about a TV report claiming water board levies shifted from farmers to citizens, and whether reserved seats on water boards misrepresent interests. The minister says the figures cover the whole 'Ongebouwd' category, not just farmland, are not directly comparable over time, and that the reserved seats are a deliberate balance of interests, with evaluation planned alongside the 2015 elections.

As I promised in debate with your House on the bill amending the water board elections, the system of reserved seats will be included in an evaluation of the upcoming provincial elections combined with the water board elections in 2015.

Antwoord 7 Zoals ik heb toegezegd in debat met uw Kamer over het wetsvoorstel Wet aanpassing waterschapsverkiezingen ( Tweede Kamer, 2013–2014, 33719 ), wordt het systeem met geborgde zetels betrokken in een evaluatie van de komende statenverkiezingen gecombineerd met waterschapsverkiezingen in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Hachchi over brandende vaten zwavelijzer bij de ISLA-raffinaderij

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a fire involving drums of iron sulphide at the ISLA refinery on Curaçao, the resulting sulphur dioxide peak, health risks, how the drums ended up on a waste heap, and whether the refinery should be closed. The minister confirmed the fire, said the SO2 peak was higher than earlier hourly averages, described health effects, and said the refinery and any investigation are the autonomous responsibility of the Curaçao government.
The ISLA refinery is an autonomous responsibility of the government of Curaçao.
De Isla raffinaderij is een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat slechts negen procent van de door Defensie goedgekeurde dronevluchten van te voren bekend gemaakt is

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked why only nine percent of approved Defence drone flights were announced in advance and whether this is proportionate and privacy-respecting. The minister denied the figure as framed, explained that the 2012 change in procedure means fewer flights are published in the Staatscourant, described retention rules for drone footage, and declined to commit to publishing all flights in advance, citing investigation confidentiality.
In view of the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights before their deployment.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk vluchten voor de inzet aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat zeemansgraven worden geschonden

D66 MPs asked whether the wreck of Dutch submarine O-16 in the South China Sea, possibly disturbed by a Cambodian salvage vessel, constitutes grave desecration, what happened to the crew's remains, whether international criminal prohibition should be pursued, and for an overview of sunk WWII Dutch ships. The government said the disturbance would be unlawful, that criminalisation exists via international legal assistance, that Cambodian authorities have not yet replied, and that it would not publish a wreck overview for fear of provoking further incidents.
Moreover, making such an overview public is not expedient, as it could precisely provoke more incidents.
Daarbij is het openbaar maken van een dergelijk overzicht niet opportuun, omdat daarmee juist meer incidenten zouden kunnen worden uitgelokt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Hachchi over de ongelijke behandeling van Defensie medewerkers die geen vakbondslid zijn bij het kandideren voor de Ondernemingsraad

Two D66 MPs asked why Defence staff who are not union members face a 30-signature requirement and a one-year employment threshold for works council candidacy, and whether this unequal treatment will be changed. The minister answered that the Defence co-determination decree mirrors the former WOR rules, that the minister will review the decree with unions after the WOR was amended, and that the SER will consider the one-year threshold.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht dat de minister “persoonlijk sorry” heeft gezegd tegen haar Indonesische collega

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether the defence minister apologised personally to her Indonesian counterpart over the handling of the Leopard tank deal, what that means versus formal apologies, whether the cabinet agreed to it, and whether it changes arms export policy. The minister said she personally regretted how the matter went, that formal apologies are not at issue, and that the statement does not change export policy, but declined to answer each question separately.
When asked, I said during the press meeting that I personally regret the course of events surrounding the planned delivery of tanks to Indonesia.
Ik heb desgevraagd tijdens de ontmoeting met de pers gezegd de gang van zaken rondom de voorgenomen levering van tanks aan Indonesië persoonlijk te betreuren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat onbestuurbare drones uit de lucht kunnen vallen bij regen of wind

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether Raven drones can fall from the sky in rain or wind and how many crashed, and who bears liability for damage. The Defence minister denied that nine Ravens crashed, described the Rijkerswoerdse Plassen emergency landing and other flights, and said the aircraft is not certified for icing or heavy rain, with operations stopped before limits are exceeded.
There is no question of nine Ravens having crashed.
Er is geen sprake van het neerstorten van negen Ravens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over het milieuprobleem veroorzaakt door oude boten in havens

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about abandoned sailing and motor yachts in Dutch harbours, including ownership tracing, a national registration system, a disposal levy and a clean-up fund. The state secretary answered that harbour managers are responsible for records, that existing registration suffices, that disposal levies and funds are for producers and industry, and that abandoned vessels are not currently a significant environmental problem.
I see no need for the central government to introduce a new system in addition to these two systems.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om als Rijksoverheid aanvullend aan deze twee systemen een nieuw systeem in te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Justitie “superdrones” mag lenen van Defensie

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Justice Ministry may borrow Defence's new ScanEagle drones, and about privacy, airspace safety, incident history and transparency. The ministers answered that the ScanEagle may in principle be deployed in support of civil authorities once personnel are qualified, that existing legal frameworks suffice, and that they will not ban flights or publish evaluations, citing ongoing investigations.
It is not standard procedure for the police to conclude every deployment of a Defence Raven with an evaluation.
Het is niet een standaardprocedure voor de politie om iedere inzet van een Raven van Defensie met een evaluatie af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over Nederlandstalige beleidsplannen die niet vertaald worden voor Bonaire, St. Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked why the Natuurbeleidsplan for Caribbean Netherlands was published only in Dutch, and whether policy plans for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are standardly translated into English or Papiamentu. The minister answered that an English version will appear in August, no Papiamentu version will be made, and there is no legal duty to translate policy plans, leaving that choice to each department.
There is therefore no legal obligation that policy plans applying to Caribbean Netherlands must be translated into English or Papiamentu.
Er bestaat dus geen wettelijke verplichting dat beleidsplannen die gelden voor Caribisch Nederland in het Engels of Papiaments moeten worden vertaald.
Antwoord vragen Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht “Afghaanse tolk vreest bijltjesdag”

D66 MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked whether Afghan interpreters working for the Dutch mission in Kunduz face danger after the withdrawal, how many are employed, whether asylum claims are expected, and whether a lighter regime or contact with Germany is planned. The ministers replied that the situation is unforeseeable, some safety measures and an inventory have been made, four monitors and sixteen interpreters are under German contracts, asylum claims are assessed individually without a special collective scheme, and contact with Germany exists.
We see no reason for a special (collective) arrangement.
We zien geen aanleiding voor een bijzondere (collectieve) regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over de inzet van onbemande vliegtuigjes (‘drones’) zonder toestemming van de gemeente door de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de politie in Soesterberg

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Royal Marechaussee and police used Raven drones for traffic checks in Soesterberg without informing the local authority, and how that fits with the military assistance procedure. The government admits the assistance procedure was not followed, that the local authority was not asked, that it has instructed all involved to follow the procedure in future, and that a police-wide drone policy is being developed.
Because the assistance procedure was not followed, the authority never got to the question of subsidiarity and proportionality.
Doordat de bijstandprocedure niet is gevolgd, is het gezag niet toegekomen aan de subsidiariteit- en proportionaliteitsvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over de aantasting van de beschermde status van het Mariene Park bij Bonaire

MPs Van Veldhoven and Hachchi asked the state secretary about reports that Bonaire's executive council would weaken the protected status of the Bonaire National Marine Park, the planned pier near Karel's Bar, and whether the national government had enough oversight of coastal development. The state secretary answered that Bonaire is responsible for permits under its own ordinances, that the national minister issued a conditional permit for the pier after assessment, and that a strategic environmental assessment of the coastal zone is being prepared.

The Openbaar lichaam Bonaire is responsible for the good management, conservation and protection of the marine park in accordance with the Bonaire Nature Management Ordinance and the spatial planning framework.

Het Openbaar lichaam Bonaire is verantwoordelijk voor een goed beheer, behoud en bescherming van het mariene park overeenkomstig de Verordening Natuurbeheer Bonaire en de kaders van de ruimtelijke ordening.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de opmerkingen van de president-directeur van KLM dat de problemen tussen KLM en Schiphol alleen maar op papier zijn opgelost, maar dat de echte problemen er nog liggen

An MP asked the state secretary how to interpret KLM's CEO saying the KLM-Schiphol problems were solved only on paper and that real problems remain. The state secretary declined to comment on media reports, said the Shared Vision Commission should finish its second part, and said the report would be sent to parliament in May.
It is my intention to send this report to the House in May.
Het is mijn intentie om dit rapport dan ook nog in mei aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over onderzoek giftig gas in vliegtuigen

An MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about reports of toxic fumes (TCP) in aircraft cabins and cockpits and whether EASA should be asked to study the issue. The state secretary said the evidence does not show a link to health effects, that airlines are responsible for cabin air quality and worker health, and that REACH-based research by RIVM will examine TCP properties, with no regulatory change planned for now.
I share EASA's view that, on the basis of objective data, it cannot be said that fume events lead to a direct dangerous situation.
Ik deel de mening van de EASA dat op basis van objectieve gegevens er niet kan worden gesteld dat fume-events leiden tot een directe gevaarlijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht ‘Kwaadwillende kan vliegtuig op afstand hacken’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how the computer security of the Dutch aviation sector stands after a report that a malicious actor could hack an aircraft remotely, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that aviation is part of critical infrastructure covered by existing regulation and inspection, that the tested vulnerability concerns a simulation setup rather than certified onboard systems, and that the NCSC has informed partners, without announcing a new concrete measure.
The research in question explicitly concerns a test setup and a theoretical vulnerability.
Bij voornoemd onderzoek betreft het nadrukkelijk een testopstelling en een theoretische kwetsbaarheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de Marine wederom ingeroepen moest worden om de watervoorziening op Saba te redden

MPs Hachchi and van Veldhoven asked about the Navy being called in again to supply water on Saba, the adequacy of the island's water supply, and the government's promised structural solution. The minister answered that a drinking water study was launched to produce a durable solution by summer 2013, that imported water is an emergency measure, and that the Caribbean Netherlands water law differs from the Drinkwaterwet.
The study will be ready around summer, after which it will be jointly determined with Saba which measures will be implemented.
Het onderzoek zal rond de zomer gereed zijn, waarna gezamenlijk met Saba zal worden bepaald welke maatregelen zullen worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hachchi over de stijging van de waterschapslasten in 2013 met meer dan 5%.

MP Hachchi (D66) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment why water board levies rose more than 5% in 2013 in some boards, including Vallei & Veluwe and Aa & Maas, and whether this is worrying. The minister answered that water boards set their own rates, attributed the increases to reserve depletion, merger effects and investment needs, and noted that most boards stayed below 5% and near expected inflation of 2.75%.
I want to emphasise that it is not up to me but to the boards of the water authorities themselves to set the rates and determine what is necessary and acceptable.
Ik wil hierbij benadrukken dat het niet aan mij, maar aan de besturen van de waterschappen zelf is om de tarieven vast te stellen en te bepalen wat nodig en aanvaardbaar is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hachchi over het ‘mislukken van Single European Sky’

An MP asked the state secretary about airline criticism that the Single European Sky compromise on performance and charging regulations undermines the goal of a single European airspace. The state secretary acknowledged the criticism, argued the revisions balance airline and state interests, and outlined Dutch and FABEC steps including a joint 2015-2019 performance plan.
The Netherlands will continue to focus on the implementation of FABEC.
Nederland zal zich blijven richten op de implementatie van FABEC.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over asbestsanering in de scholen van Bonaire

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked the state secretary whether asbestos removal from Bonaire schools would follow Dutch rules, where the material would go, who is responsible and pays, and whether BES law should be aligned with Dutch standards. The government answered that Dutch rules are used as the benchmark, that the material will likely be shipped to the Netherlands for processing with temporary storage on Bonaire, that the Rijksgebouwendienst is responsible for storage while the Bonaire public body and the education ministry bear the costs, and that full alignment of BES law is deferred to a 2015 evaluation.
Until then, in principle the principle of legislative calm is maintained.
Tot die tijd wordt in beginsel vastgehouden aan het uitgangspunt van legislatieve rust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en Hachchi over de situatie van ezels op Sint Eustatius

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reportedly poor conditions for dozens of donkeys on Sint Eustatius and whether local authorities had promised to end the situation. The State Secretary answered that the public body had rounded up most loose donkeys, that a drought-related food shortage has since been resolved, that an action list was agreed with Greenfound Foundation, and that the ministry would mediate if local authorities asked.
If the local authorities request it, I am willing to engage in mediation where possible.
Indien de plaatselijke autoriteiten daartoe verzoeken ben ik bereid om mij waar mogelijk in te zetten voor bemiddeling.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de kritiek van de Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) op het kennisniveau van de luchtvaartinspectie (ILT)

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about criticism from the US Federal Aviation Administration of the aviation inspectorate ILT's expertise and whether budget cuts caused it. The state secretary said the criticism concerns a difference in interpreting type-rating requirements, that ILT and EASA are addressing it, and that cuts were absorbed mainly through reorganisation while expertise is safeguarded.
Following the discussion, EASA is working on clarifying the European procedures.
Naar aanleiding van de discussie werkt EASA aan de verduidelijking van de Europese procedures.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de voortgang van het Single European Sky (SES)

An MP (Hachchi, D66) asked the state secretary about progress on the Single European Sky, the European Parliament resolution, Eurocontrol recommendations on Dutch oversight of airspace, and the FABEC functional airspace block. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing oversight arrangements, the FABEC ratification timeline, and commitments to pursue implementation.
The head of the NSA has an independent position as prescribed by European regulations.
Het hoofd van de NSA heeft een onafhankelijke positie zoals voorgeschreven in de Europese regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent en Hachchi over de verwoestende olievervuiling op de kusten van Curaçao

Two MPs asked whether PdVSA delayed acting on an oil leak at Bullenbaai, Curaçao, what the scale was, whether it was deliberate, and whether the Kingdom government should intervene given PdVSA's record. The minister answered that the government cannot judge the cause and that the Curaçao prime minister's investigation may clarify it, that the situation is an incident rather than irreversible, and that Curaçao as an autonomous country must lead the response and prevent recurrence.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom. It is therefore up to the government of Curaçao to lead the further containment of the pollution and the clean-up operations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk. Het is daarom aan de regering van Curaçao om leiding te geven aan verdere indamming van de vervuiling en de opruimwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hachchi over de ontwikkelingen in de stroomprijs op Bonaire

An MP asked the government how electricity prices on Bonaire have developed, whether the arbitration ruling between WEB and Ecopower will raise prices for residents, and what options exist for competition and decentralised renewable generation. The minister answered that tariffs have been frozen since 2010, that a new regulatory framework is being prepared with the Ministry of Infrastructure, and that the minister of EL&I holds political and legal responsibility for energy supply in the Caribbean Netherlands, with some powers delegated to the local government.
In the Electricity Concessions BES Act, part of the powers over energy supply has been delegated to the local government.
In de wet elektriciteitsconcessies BES is een deel van de bevoegdheden betreffende de energievoorziening gedelegeerd aan het lokale bestuur.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koolmees (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de gevolgen van nieuwe belastingregels op de economie van Saba

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about the effects of the new tax regime (ABB, flat tax, excise duties) on the economy of Saba and Sint Eustatius, including tax burden, prices, transport costs, Sint Maarten transit, and budget effects. The state secretary answered that the overall tax burden stayed roughly constant with a shift from direct to indirect taxes, that most households gained net income, and that no separate figures exist for several effects, while committing to talks with Sint Maarten on exemption of transit goods.
There are no figures known on the effect of the ABB on the government budget on Saba and Sint Eustatius.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het effect van de ABB op het overheidsbudget op Saba en Sint Eustatius.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over het bericht dat Nederland moet terughacken

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked the Justice minister about reports that the Netherlands should 'hack back' against foreign servers spreading viruses, including what actions the government takes and the risks and legal safeguards of such measures. The minister replied that cyber security is primarily the responsibility of individuals and providers, the government protects its own infrastructure and informs the public via NCSC, that hack-back is not an official government term and would be addressed in a forthcoming legislative proposal on cybercrime, and that an international treaty comparable to the law of the sea is interesting but premature.
However, I note that in the rapidly changing digital world, legislation and international agreements have fallen behind.
Wel constateer ik dat in de snel veranderende digitale wereld de wetgeving en internationale afspraken zijn achter gebleven.
Antwoord vragen Sterk en Hachchi over Nederlands-Pakistaanse vrouw die in huwelijkse gevangenschap in Pakistan verkeert

MPs Sterk and Hachchi asked about a Dutch-Pakistani woman held in a forced marriage in Pakistan, what the embassy had done, and whether the government would act on religious divorce and women's rights. The minister said he could not comment on the individual case for privacy reasons, that the embassy assists consular cases on request, and that he would raise the issue in EU settings.
To protect the identity of the person concerned, I cannot make a substantive statement about the case.
Ter bescherming van de identiteit van betrokkene, kan ik over de zaak geen inhoudelijke uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koser Kaya over de aanhoudende problemen met koopkracht en belastingdruk op de BES-eilanden

Two D66 MPs asked about the state of the interdepartmental studies on purchasing power, inflation, tax revenue and poverty in Caribbean Netherlands, and about a double-taxation problem with Sint Maarten. The government answered that the Ecorys purchasing-power study and the poverty exploration were completed and sent to parliament in June 2012, that a first revenue estimate was requested, and that talks with Sint Maarten on double indirect taxation were constructive.
Only in autumn 2012 will definitive clarity on the revenue of the new tax system be possible.
Pas in het najaar van 2012 zal definitieve duidelijkheid over de opbrengst van het nieuwe belastingstelsel kunnen worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Gent over aanhoudende ontevredenheid op de BES-eilanden

MPs Hachchi and Van Gent asked the minister about lasting dissatisfaction on the BES islands, including Bonaire, its causes, purchasing power research, constitutional anchoring of island status, and information gaps. The minister acknowledged pockets of discontent, denied riot threats, deferred to later policy notes, and argued the islands already have sufficient information channels, rejecting a liaison in The Hague.
I therefore do not believe that the island governments would be unable to have sufficient information.
Ik ben dan ook niet van mening dat de eilandbesturen niet in staat zouden zijn over voldoende informatie te beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de aanhoudende problemen met de postvoorziening op de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Hachchi asked about persistent postal failures on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including residents receiving reminders and fines for bills they never received, and whether postcodes, UPU country codes and enforcement would fix the problems. The state secretary admitted the service still falls short of concession terms, said enforcement via an instruction or fine is being considered, and noted liability for losses is a matter for the courts while a review of alternatives to the concessionaire is underway.
I have now commissioned an external agency to explore whether, and under what conditions, parties are willing to take on (parts of) the postal service for the Caribbean Netherlands.

Ik heb inmiddels een extern bureau opdracht gegeven om een verkenning uit te voeren of, en zo ja onder welke voorwaarden partijen bereid zijn om (delen van) de postvoorziening ten behoeve van Caribisch Nederland op zich te nemen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra en Hachchi over onveilige software in pacemakers

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about security vulnerabilities in SCADA software in pacemakers and insulin pumps, including whether manufacturers must report flaws and whether certification should be mandatory. The minister answered that no central registry exists, that manufacturers must validate software and carry out post-market surveillance, that reports go to notified bodies or the IGZ, and that tightening of the existing regime is planned.
In my letter dated 27 March 2012, I informed you of my plans to tighten the current legal regime.
In mijn brief d.d. 27 maart 2012, heb ik mijn voornemens voor aanscherpingen binnen het huidige wettelijke regime aan u kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vroege pensioenleeftijd van het overheidspersoneel

Two D66 MPs asked why the public sector has a low average retirement age, what early-retirement schemes and age-related measures exist for civil servants, and what effects this has on wages and the wider labour market. Minister Spies answered that the low average is driven mainly by police and defence, that the general public-sector retirement age has risen, that remaining early-exit schemes are being phased out, and that no spillover effects to other sectors are expected.
The cabinet's policy is aimed at encouraging people to keep working longer.
Het beleid van het kabinet is er op gericht om het langer doorwerken te stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen  Leden Eijsink, Hachchi en van Dijk over het bericht 'Defensie krijgt export-admiraal'

MPs Eijsink, Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister what mandate the new 'export admiral' would have, whether this blurs independence and integrity given the role's links to defence industry exports, and how it relates to EL&I export promotion and export control. The minister answered that the vice-admiral mainly coordinates property, materiel disposal and supports exports without representing companies, that EL&I remains responsible for export licences, and that existing EL&I export consultations continue.
PCDS Nagtegaal will not act as a representative of companies, so conflict of interest does not arise.
PCDS Nagtegaal zal niet optreden als vertegenwoordiger van bedrijven, dus belangenverstrengeling is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Hachi en Schouw over de risico’s van software voor het op afstand besturen van industriële processen

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about security risks of SCADA systems controlling industrial processes, including whether attacks require exceptionally advanced software, what security requirements and oversight apply, the risks of USB sticks and internet connections, and European activity. The minister answered that operators are themselves responsible, sectoral supervisors oversee SCADA safety, the NCSC advises, and that European initiatives exist.
Organisations within government and the commercial sector are themselves responsible for their SCADA systems.
Organisaties binnen de overheid en de commerciële sector zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun SCADA-systemen.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink, Hachchi, Jasper van Dijk en El Fassed over het bericht ‘JSF duurder door uitstel aankopen VS’

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether and how the government was informed of the US Pentagon's decision to delay 179 F-35 deliveries over five years, and how information flow through the JSF Program Office had improved. The minister answered that the US notified the Netherlands in January 2012, that the JPO was not responsible for the US order schedule, that he had raised timely information with the JPO director, and that financial effects would be reported to the Chamber by 1 June 2012.

The Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is responsible for the development and future further development of the F-35, contract signing, ongoing production of the F-35 aircraft and preparation of maintenance.

Het Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en toekomstige doorontwikkeling van de F-35, de contractsluiting, de lopende productie van de F-35 toestellen en de voorbereiding van de instandhouding.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel en Hachchi over Flintlock

MPs Van Bommel and Hachchi asked the defence minister about the Flintlock 2012 training exercise in Mali, including security risks, changed locations, and who decided to cancel it. The minister answered that AFRICOM cancelled the exercise in consultation with Malian authorities and the US ambassador, that Dutch planners were kept informed, and that no date for a future exercise has been set.
The commander of AFRICOM, in consultation with, among others, the commander of JSOTF-TS, the Malian minister of Defence and the US ambassador in Bamako, decided to cancel the exercise.
De commandant van AFRICOM heeft in overleg met onder meer de commandant van JSOTF-TS, de Malinese minister van Defensie en de Amerikaanse ambassadeur in Bamako besloten de oefening af te gelasten.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de verhoging van de pensioenpremie door het ABP

An MP asked the ministers whether the government had budgeted for the ABP pension premium increase costing the state over 300 million euros, how the costs would be absorbed and what it means for civil servants' pay, cuts and collective bargaining. The minister answered that the increase was partly foreseeable but not budgeted, that ministries must absorb it through personnel and material savings, that net pay falls about 0.4%, and that the pension agreement measures will be implemented in the ABP scheme.
The shortfall caused by the recovery surcharge on the pension premium does not come entirely unexpectedly.
De tegenvaller vanwege de herstelopslag op de pensioenpremie komt niet helemaal onverwacht.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold en Hachchi over uitspraken HRW over Nederlands mensenrechtenbeleid

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister to respond to Human Rights Watch criticism that the Netherlands has become inconsistent on human rights, including toward friendly countries such as Israel, and to explain the government's position on appointing an EU Special Representative for Human Rights. The minister rejected the criticism, said friendly countries are also addressed on rights issues (with examples to follow in the 2011 human rights report), and stated the government is in principle opposed to such an EU special representative, pending internal EU discussions.
As promised to the House, I will include examples of this in the 2011 human rights report.
Zoals toegezegd aan de Kamer zal ik in de mensenrechtenrapportage 2011 daarvan voorbeelden opnemen.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold, Hachchi, Schouw en Dijkstra over Kamervragen Oeganda anti-homoseksualiteitswet

D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest to Uganda over a renewed anti-homosexuality bill that proposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps would follow if it passed. The minister said the bill is unacceptable, that Nederland and the EU have raised objections with Uganda, that the Ugandan premier distanced himself from it, and that further steps are premature.
I do not consider the proposed private member's bill acceptable.
Ik acht het voorliggende initiatiefwetsvoorstel niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over het bericht dat Nederland zich niet houdt aan Europese aanbestedingsregels

An MP asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that the Netherlands is not complying with EU defence procurement rules, whether it can meet the Commission's two-month deadline, and when the directive will be transposed. The government confirms it received a reasoned opinion, explains the Commission could take the Netherlands to the Court of Justice, and says compliance will follow once the Aanbestedingswet on defence and security is passed by both chambers.
The Netherlands can comply with the Commission's request as soon as the bill is approved by your chamber and the Senate and the law enters into force.
Nederland kan voldoen aan het verzoek van de Commissie zo spoedig als het wetsvoorstel door uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer is goedgekeurd en de wet in werking treedt.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Israëlisch wetsvoorstel ten aanzien van inkomsten van organisaties die donaties ontvangen van buitenlandse statelijke e

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli bill restricting foreign state-funded NGOs, including whether the Netherlands pressed Israel and whether a 45% tax would cut donor funding. The minister said the government raised concerns about democratic rights, that the legislative process is complex and uncertain so details cannot be judged now, and that the Netherlands will await the final law before assessing its effect on Dutch subsidies.
The government follows the Israeli debate closely, but refrains from commenting on individual statements made in that context in Israel.
De regering volgt het Israëlische debat aandachtig, maar onthoudt zich van commentaar op individuele uitspraken die in dat kader in Israël worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de business case van de Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne (VBHKAZ) door de gemeente Doorn

MP Hachchi (D66) asked the defence minister about the Doorn municipality's business case for reusing the Van Braam Houckgeestkazerne, including why Defence did not supply cost data and whether the Zeeland marine barracks figures differ. The minister answered that Defence gave Utrechtse Heuvelrug all requested inputs, uses the same norm amounts for both locations, and will compare the business cases once the Zeeland working group reports.
In the consultation with the House I declared myself willing to provide the necessary information.
In het overleg met de Kamer heb ik me bereid verklaard de daartoe benodigde informatie te verschaffen.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA), Hachchi (D66) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Defensie over de uitspraken van admiraal Venlet over de Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

MPs Eijsink, Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister about admiral Venlet's statements that overlapping development, testing and production of the F-35 JSF was a miscalculation and that production must slow. The minister acknowledged the cost increases, shared the Pentagon's position, disclosed additional costs for the Dutch test aircraft, and said a Dutch decision on replacing the F-16 is left to a future cabinet.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de vermeende puinhoop van het personeelsbeleid bij Defensie

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister about union claims of a personnel policy mess at Defence, including vacancy bank problems, opaque selection, standardised rejection letters and advice to leave for training via EBD. The minister said processes are being corrected and vacancy bank adjustments made, rejections are standardised for efficiency with contact persons available, and no known cases of advising early resignation exist.
Employees interested in a particular position can indicate this via the vacancy bank.
Medewerkers die belangstelling hebben voor een bepaalde functie kunnen dit via de vacaturebank kenbaar maken.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi (beiden D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks), en Ormel en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bevordering van politieke vrouwenparticipatie in

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would back a gender quota for Libya's new constitution-making body, and how it funds women's political participation in the MENA region. The minister said the Netherlands supports women's participation, will remind the NTC of its commitments, has earmarked EUR 2 million for 2011 and 2012, and will take a lead role within the EU, but did not commit to requesting a quota.

I follow developments in Libya closely and where necessary I remind the NTC and the interim government of their commitments in the draft Constitutional Charter regarding the democratic transition, including women's rights.

Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Libië nauwgezet en waar nodig herinner ik de NTC en de interim-regering aan hun toezeggingen in the draft Constitutional Charter ten aanzien van de democratische transitie inclusief vrouwenrechten.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over het bericht dat het aantal onveilige abortussen wereldwijd is toegenomen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a report showing rising unsafe abortions worldwide, linked to stagnating contraceptive use, and what the Netherlands will do. The State Secretary called the figures shocking, backed prevention through contraception and sexual education over restrictive abortion laws, and said the Netherlands will intensify its contraception and family planning efforts, with more detailed policy plans promised for April 2012.
As already promised, I will inform you in more detail about my concrete policy intentions in April 2012.
Zoals reeds toegezegd zal ik u in april 2012 uitgebreider informeren over mijn concrete beleidsvoornemens.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een brief naar aanleiding van een noodoproep in verband met de dengue-epidemie op Bonaire (ingezonden 9 dece

MPs Dijkstra and Hachchi asked how much money is spent on strengthening public health care on Bonaire, the role of RIVM, GGD and CAREC in dengue control, how local prevention policy will be continued and evaluated, and the cost of prevention relative to incomes. The minister answers that the island authorities are responsible for public health, that the ministry supports them with funding of up to 0.7 million euro a year for RIVM work and about 1 million euro for the GGD project to mid-2013, and that local evaluation is the island government's responsibility.

The island executives of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba (the BES islands), like municipal governments in the Netherlands, are themselves responsible for public health care, including infectious disease control.

De bestuurscolleges van Bonaire, Sint Eustasius en Saba (de BES-eilanden) zijn net als gemeentebesturen in Nederland, zelf verantwoordelijk voor de publieke gezondheidszorg, waaronder infectieziektebestrijding.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink en Dijksma (beiden PvdA), Hachchi (D66) en Jasper Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Economische zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Defensie over het stopzetten van de ontwikkeling van de F13

MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Defence about the cancellation of the F136 engine development for the Joint Strike Fighter, including the financial commitments of Dutch firms, expected orders, contacts with industry and the US Congress. The government regrets the decision, says the US financed the engine alone, reports about 7 million euro invested by Dutch firms and a revised order estimate of about 750 million dollars, and says it is pursuing a larger role for Dutch industry on the F135 engine.
The answer to questions 13, 14 and 15 addresses the possibly larger role of Dutch industry in producing the remaining engine, the F135 from Pratt & Whitney.
In het antwoord op de vragen 13, 14 en 15 wordt ingegaan op de mogelijk grotere rol van de Nederlandse industrie bij de productie van de overgebleven motor, de F135 van Pratt & Whitney.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over het tekort aan soldaten en korporaals

An MP asks the Defence Minister about shortages of soldiers and corporals in the Dutch army, caused by budget cuts that block filling operational posts while surplus officers remain on payroll. The minister acknowledges the problem, says operational units will be fully staffed by 2013 and other units by 2014, and states that recruitment is being pursued and progress reported to parliament.
Once the staffing of an operational unit falls below seventy percent, that unit is no longer deployable.
Zodra de vulling van een operationele eenheid lager is dan zeventig procent is deze eenheid niet meer inzetbaar.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het talentbeleid bij de overheid (ingezonden 24 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about civil service talent retention, junior recruitment and trainee programmes, citing surveys showing weak attention to talent. The minister provides trainee and intake figures, describes the 'Beter Werken in het Openbaar Bestuur' programme, and says no quantitative targets are set by BZK, with departments and other tiers responsible for their own staffing.
The Ministry of BZK has no quantitative targets for the inflow and outflow of young talent within the central government sector.
Het ministerie van BZK heeft geen kwantitatieve doelstellingen wat betreft in- en uitstroom van jong talent binnen de sector Rijk.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dat de Nederlandse Officieren Vereniging deelname van militairen aan de Gay Pride afkeurt (i

Two D66 MPs asked the Defence and Education ministers whether the government would distance itself from the Dutch Officers' Association's criticism of military participation in the Gay Pride Canal Parade, and whether uniformed personnel could participate again next year. The Defence minister replied that uniformed participation has been permitted since 2009 and will continue, that the magazine article is the association's responsibility, and that existing diversity measures on sexual orientation are largely being maintained.
Defence bears no responsibility for this magazine and the article is therefore the responsibility of the editorial board.
Defensie draagt geen verantwoordelijkheid voor dit blad en het artikel komt dan ook voor rekening van de redactie.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Hachchi (D66) en El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse inzet tijdens de Review Conferentie van de

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands will act at the CCW Review Conference on cluster munitions, including whether a draft Protocol VI with a weaker standard than the CCM should be supported. The minister replied that the Netherlands will push for a protocol with the broadest scope, citing a total ban as the end goal, will promote universalisation of the CCM, and will consider a political declaration if no consensus is reached.
The Netherlands wants a Protocol VI with the broadest possible scope, explicitly including a total ban on cluster munitions as the final goal.
Nederland wil een Protocol VI met zo groot mogelijke reikwijdte, waarin een totaalverbod van clustermunitie expliciet als einddoel wordt opgenomen.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitwasse

MPs Hachchi and Koşer Kaya asked ministers about the use of payrolling to circumvent dismissal rules, the number and age profile of payroll workers in government, the future policy, and the severance pay of civil servants versus payroll workers. The minister replied that the government had asked the Labour Foundation for advice expected in December, would not anticipate it, and that civil servants have no statutory severance while payroll workers' entitlements depend on the sector collective agreement and ultimately the courts.

Vragen van het leden Eijsink (PvdA), Hachchi (D66), El Fassed (GL) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het massa-ontslag bij BAE systems als gevolg v

MPs asked the ministers about BAE Systems mass layoffs linked to delays and cost overruns in the JSF (F-35) programme and their effects on the Dutch aerospace industry. The government answered that production is ongoing, delays lower near-term output, and the business case will not be re-tendered until accounting checkpoints in 2020 and 2030, while promising no new information beyond existing reports.
I do not have information about the relationship mentioned in question 3, and I cannot make a comparison between the situation in the United Kingdom and that in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de in vraag 3 genoemde relatie en ik kan geen vergelijking maken van de situatie in het Verenigd Koninkrijk met die in Nederland.

Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over capaciteitsopbouw op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP from D66 asked ministers about capacity building on the BES islands and whether a foundation's proposal to encourage Caribbean Dutch students who studied in the Netherlands to return could be funded from the existing budget. The government agreed local capacity building is essential, pointed to a study-debt repayment scheme for Rijksdienst Caribisch Nederland staff and local solutions in education, and said any further return incentives are up to the public bodies and their budgets.
From the central government there is no specific scheme aimed at the return of students to Caribbean Netherlands other than described in answer 3.
Vanuit de Rijksoverheid bestaat geen specifieke regeling gericht op de terugkeer van studenten naar Caribisch Nederland anders dan beschreven bij antwoord 3.

Vragen van de leden Eijsink (PvdA) en Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht waarin een ex-topagent onthult hoe hij in het Midden-Oosten door MIVD werd geofferd (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

MPs Eijsink and Hachchi asked the Defence Minister, after a press report that an ex-agent was left exposed by the MIVD in the Middle East, about measures taken to protect the officer's safety, responsibility for the cover company's exposure, the MIVD's response to his warning letters, and compensation. The minister answered that he could not discuss operational matters publicly but would inform the Commission for the Intelligence and Security Services on request.
Regarding operational matters concerning the MIVD, I cannot make any public statements.
Over operationele zaken de MIVD betreffend, kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bestuurscollegewisseling op Bonaire (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

Dutch MP Hachchi asked the Minister of Interior about the turnover of the executive council (bestuurscollege) on Bonaire, whether the procedures were correctly followed, and how to respond to opposition calls against appointing a suspect in a corruption case. The Minister regretted the frequent changes, found no clear procedural breach in the appointments and the late acceptance of one appointment, and said the island council can set a policy but there is no formal bar to appointing candidates who meet legal requirements.
As long as candidates meet the formal requirements of the Wolbes, such as those laid down in article 39 in conjunction with article 11 of the Wolbes, there is no formal obstacle to appointment.
Zolang kandidaten voldoen aan de formele vereisten van de Wolbes zoals onder meer neergelegd in artikel 39 j°. 11 van de Wolbes is er geen formeel beletsel voor benoeming.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over Amerikaans beleid dat hulp bij veilige abortus onmogelijk maakt (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about US aid policy that blocks funding for safe abortion, including for rape victims in war zones, and whether the Netherlands will raise this with the US. The state secretary explains the US distinction between abortion as family planning (excluded) and cases of life endangerment, rape or incest (permitted), says there is no overview of affected organisations, and states that the Netherlands will continue to cooperate with the US and raise policy differences in contacts.
In contacts with the US, differences in policy also come up for discussion.
In contacten met de VS komen ook verschillen in beleid aan de orde.

Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over onveilige seks en extra bezuinigingen op seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten (SRGR) (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a Bayer-commissioned survey showing youth knowledge of contraception declining worldwide, and about a reported 40 million euro cut to sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRGR) funding. The government acknowledged the problem, described existing programmes, denied a targeted cut (citing a GDP-driven budget reduction while SRGR still receives 3 million euro more), and defended the merged budget lines as more transparent.
However, I was confronted at a very late stage of the budget preparation with a cut to the development cooperation budget as a result of a downward GDP adjustment.

Ik werd echter in een heel laat stadium van de voorbereiding van de begroting geconfronteerd met een korting op de begroting voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking als gevolg van een neerwaartse BNP bijstelling.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat ruim driehonderd geloofsgemeenschappen in Hongarije niet langer erkend dreigen te worden (ingezonde

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi asked the Dutch government about Hungary's new church law, which would deregister 348 of 362 religious communities from 2012 and may conflict with the ECHR, EU values and the EU Charter. The government answered that registration regimes are not inherently unlawful, shared concern about ECHR compatibility, raised the issue with Hungarian parliamentarians, and stated the EU Charter does not apply to this law.
I first note that a registration regime for religious communities as such is not unusual and does not necessarily conflict with any norm of international law.
Ik stel voorop dat een registratieregeling voor kerkgenootschappen als zodanig niet ongebruikelijk is en niet bij voorbaat strijdig hoeft te zijn met enige internationaalrechtelijke norm.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Hachchi (D66), Timmermans (PvdA), Peters (Groenlinks) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Israëlische antiboycotwet (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Israeli anti-boycott bill, which would make calling for boycotts a civil wrong and allow damages without proof of harm, conflicts with freedom of expression and whether it shields settlements. The minister said the law may conflict with freedom of expression, that the Israeli Supreme Court is reviewing it, that settlements are contrary to international law, and that the Dutch government opposes boycott calls in this context while noting Israel's democratic debate.
I am not anticipating the judgment of the Court.
Ik loop niet op het oordeel van het Hof vooruit.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers (PvdA) en Hachchi (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het opschorten van de investering in de Subsidiefaciliteit Burgerschap en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (SBOS) (ingezond

MPs Dikkers and Hachchi asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs why the SBOS subsidy facility was suspended until 2013, how much was saved, why the decision was not previewed in the Focus letter or debated in parliament, and whether the round could be reopened. The State Secretary answered that budget cuts forced choices, that the reduction was implemented via an amendment, that a further amount of 27 million euros in commitments remains, and that reopening the round is not possible due to lack of budget room.
There is not yet clarity about the amounts involved and I cannot inform you further at this time.
Over de hiermee gemoeide bedragen is er nog geen duidelijkheid en kan ik u nu niet nader informeren.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi en Koşer Kaya (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de kinderopvang op de BES eilanden (ingezonden 31 mei 201

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about the level and funding of childcare on the BES islands, including targets, budget adequacy and problems anticipated. The minister answered that island governments are responsible and set targets and budgets, that a reference framework and a special grant from 2013 are planned, and that he lacks data on several points.
The island governments set the objectives for childcare and decide what budget they wish to make available.
De eilandbesturen stellen de doelstellingen voor de kinderopvang vast en bepalen welk budget zij beschikbaar willen stellen.
Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de door het Israëlische parlement aangenomen «antiboycotwet» (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether he knows of the Israeli anti-boycott law, how he assesses it, and whether he shares the US view that it violates fundamental democratic rights, and whether he will press Israel on it. The minister answered that the law is debated in Israel, that it can be challenged before the Supreme Court, that he agrees free expression is a basic right, but that he sees no reason to act.
I see no reason to do so, see answers 2 and 3.
Ik zie hiertoe geen aanleiding, zie antwoorden 2 en 3.

Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks), Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mediasituatie in Arabische landen, en

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and PvdA asked the government about internet and media restrictions in Yemen and Bahrain during protests, including whether the Netherlands would condemn these as strongly as Libya, and what it would do to secure internet access. The government answered that it condemns the restrictions wherever they occur, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU, supports media projects, and declined to answer the questions before the scheduled debate.
This has unfortunately not proved possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat inwoners van Curaçao ziek zijn door vervuild water (ingezonden 16 juni 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that residents of Curaçao were ill from contaminated tap water, asking for the government's reaction, whether Curaçao's government responded adequately, and whether the Netherlands would offer analysis capacity. The Minister declined to comment on the press report, said judging Curaçao's response falls to its own Staten, and said assistance depends on a request from Curaçao's government.
It does not befit me to give a judgment on the response of the Curaçao government.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de reactie van de regering van Curaçao.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de website van DUO onveilig is (ingezond

D66 MPs asked the education and interior ministers how the DUO website could be hacked again despite an earlier audit, whether other government sites are similarly vulnerable, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister regrets the incident, says the flaw was repaired and sites checked, denies the system is unreliable, notes that incidents cannot be fully prevented, and points to the audit recommendations and a criminal complaint.
I regret that for the second time an incident has occurred on the DUO website.
Ik betreur dat er voor de tweede keer een incident op de website van DUO heeft plaatsgevonden.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Defensie over de hoofddirecteur personeel van Defensie die alarm slaat (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the head of Defence personnel's warning about mass departures from reorganisations is accurate, and requested exit and sick-leave figures. The minister denied a link to the April budget cuts, said outflow is normal and exit data were provided by month, and said sick-leave data were also provided, with the reorganisation lesson being central steering.
It is unclear to what extent the budget cut measure plays a decisive role.
Het is onduidelijk in hoeverre de bezuinigingsmaatregel een doorslaggevende rol speelt.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het wegjagen van jong talent bij de overheid. (Ingezonden 10 mei 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Interior Minister about a survey showing civil servants fear budget cuts will drive young talent away from government, and about succession planning and staffing. The government answered that continuity is not at risk, that young people's exit cannot yet be confirmed from figures, and that it will keep investing in youth intake and discuss retention with unions and local governments.
I am of the view that there is no reason for concern about continuity in operations.
Ik ben van mening dat er geen reden is tot zorg over de continuïteit in de bedrijfsvoering.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over genderbeleid in de Arabische Regio (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs Hachchi and Peters asked the foreign minister and state secretary what concrete consequences a joint US-Dutch statement on women in emerging democracies has for Dutch gender policy in the MENA region, which concrete joint actions are planned, how Dutch funding for women's organisations works, and whether gender and UNSCR 1325 will be raised with regional authorities. The government answered that joint follow-up is being arranged, outlined existing funding through the MDG3 fund and embassies (including new budget of 2 million euros for women's participation), and said 1325 will be included in the forthcoming National Action Plan.
Yes, the forthcoming National Action Plan 1325 for 2012-2015 will include the elaboration for the MENA region.
Ja, in het momenteel in voorbereiding zijnde Nationaal Actieplan 1325 voor de periode 2012 – 2015 zal de uitwerking voor de MENA regio worden meegenomen.

Vragen van de leden Hachchi, Van Veldhoven (beiden D66) en Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en Inf

Three MPs asked ministers about a benzene vapour leak and odour nuisance at the ISLA refinery on Curaçao that reportedly forced school evacuations, asking about causes, measurements, enforcement, alternatives and whether the Dutch central government should intervene. The minister said the information falls under Curaçao's autonomous environmental responsibility, declined to give details on the leak, stated the SEI refinery timetable is being met, and said enforcement of environmental norms is a Curaçao matter.
I cannot provide the requested information, and it does not fall under the information covered by Article 68 of the Constitution.
Ik kan de gevraagde informatie niet vertrekken en zij valt niet onder de informatie waarvoor artikel 68 van de Grondwet geldt.

Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de postvoorziening op de BES-eilanden (ingezonden 21

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs and the Interior minister about poor postal quality on the Caribbean Netherlands islands, including improvement timelines, sanctions, concession renewal criteria, routing via Curaçao and delayed tax mail. The government answered that the regulator Agentschap Telecom will measure quality and act, with a concrete improvement path by end 2011, administrative fines available, and a decision on concession renewal after a new quality measurement.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het personeelsbeleid op het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (ingezonden

MPs Pechtold and Hachchi (D66) asked about staff policy at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, including reassignment practices, retention of young staff, trainee prospects, age-neutral cuts and HDPO conflict of interest. Minister Rosenthal answered that the ministry disagrees with the critics, cites staff departure and promotion figures, and says the reassignment system is being reviewed with the works council and unions.
It is foreseen that proposals for adjustments will be the subject of consultation with the works council and the unions within a few months.
Voorzien is dat voorstellen voor aanpassingen over enkele maanden onderwerp van overleg met de Ondernemingsraad en de vakbonden zullen zijn.

Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de postbezorging op de BES eilanden in gebreke blijft d

An MP asked ministers about reports that postal delivery on the BES islands was failing because of unclear postcodes and addressing after the constitutional change of 2010. The government answered that a postcode system is the concession holder's responsibility, that talks with Nieuwe Post aim to raise service quality during 2011, and that it will ask the UPU to add the name Caribisch Nederland and inform postal operators of the change.
I will ask the UPU to add the name 'Caribisch Nederland/Dutch Caribbean' to this code system and to make this additional name known worldwide among postal operators.

Ik zal de UPU het verzoek doen in dit code systeem de benaming «Caribisch Nederland/Dutch Caribbean» toe te voegen en deze additionele benaming wereldwijd onder de postbezorgingbedrijven bekend te maken.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Defensie over de brugsimulator voor het Koninklijk Instituut voor de Marine (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Defence Minister whether the bridge simulator procurement for the Royal Netherlands Naval Institute was irreversible, why the tender exceeds IMO training requirements with 472 specifications, whether cheaper alternatives exist, and for an overview of public information on the tender. The minister replied that the procedure is nearly complete and the contract will be signed soon, that additional military requirements justify the specifications, and that the contract was not EU-tendered due to security measures and was awarded to the most economically advantageous bidder.
Because carrying out the project requires special security measures, the contract was not tendered under European procurement rules.
Omdat de uitvoering van het project bijzondere veiligheidsmaatregelen vereist, is de opdracht niet Europees aanbesteed.

Vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het kiesrecht voor de Eilandsraad van niet-Nederlanders (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the Minister of Interior about how the Caribbean islands were informed of the Santana court ruling extending active voting rights to non-Dutch residents for the Bonaire island council elections, how eligible voters are identified, the role of the IND, the short timeframe for candidacy, language of information, and differences in election organisation. The minister answered in detail, describing notifications, IND support, and that the Kieswet now applies integrally, with evaluation promised.
The Ministry of Interior, in light of the Court's ruling, arranged for three public bodies to receive an update to the PIVA elections module so they could correctly select eligible voters.

Het ministerie van BZK heeft, gelet op de uitspraak van het Hof, geregeld dat drie openbare lichamen de beschikking hebben gekregen over een update in de module verkiezingen van de PIVA om de juiste selectie van de kiesgerechtigden te kunnen maken.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat door fouten bij Dienst Uitvoering Onderw

Two MPs asked the ministers about a reported DUO web-portal fault that exposed students' personal and study data to other users. The minister acknowledged the incident, explained it was a capacity-overload bug in the 'Mijn DUO' application, reported it was fixed and an external audit ordered, and denied DigiD was the cause.
An external audit of the technical causes has now been commissioned.
Er is inmiddels opdracht gegeven om een externe audit uit te voeren naar de technische oorzaken.

Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de wervingscampagne van het Rijk terwijl er grootschalige bezuinigingen en inkrimpingen op het ambtenarenapparaat zijn a

An MP asks why the central government is running a recruitment and image campaign, with posters at train stations, while large cuts and staff reductions are announced and only 58 vacancies are listed. The minister replies that the campaign is mainly about positioning the government as an employer, that it has been scaled down, and that a new contract and labour-market strategy are being prepared.
Because the number of vacancies at the central government has fallen sharply, the campaign has been substantially scaled back.
Omdat het aantal vacatures bij de Rijksoverheid sterk is teruggelopen is de campagne sterk versoberd.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Defensie over een vermeende inspectie van Nederlandse militairen aan een ziekenhuis in Tarin Kowt (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch soldiers entered a provincial hospital and a nearby NGO office in Tarin Kowt in April 2009 in a raid-like manner, and whether this violated the Fourth Geneva Convention. The minister replied that soldiers entered after staff permission to search for wounded enemy fighters, that complaints were partly upheld and procedures tightened, and that no international law was breached.
Following these conclusions, several relevant procedures have been tightened.
Naar aanleiding van deze conclusies zijn enkele relevante procedures aangescherpt.
Vragen van het lid Hachchi (D66) aan de minister van Defensie over een afgelaste opleiding voor bijna 470 aspirant-militairen (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Defence Minister why about 467 trainee soldiers were told their training and posts were cancelled, when that became clear, and how Defence tracks its hiring room. The minister says rising applicant numbers, fewer dropouts and budget limits forced a postponement of the intake, notified in July, and that monthly and quarterly reporting monitors hiring capacity.
In this matter it is not so much a question of legal obstacles, but of the need to stay within the relevant budget.
Het gaat in deze kwestie niet zozeer om juridische belemmeringen, maar om de noodzaak binnen het desbetreffende budget te blijven.

a payroll criterion so that companies without sufficient wage costs to carry out real activities at least receive a sanction

requests the government to work out options by March 2017 to exempt housing corporations from transfer tax and corporate tax for their DAEB activities

Motie Omtzigt/Groot over uitbetalingen huurtoeslag door Belastingdienst
Asks the government, with housing corporations, to allow housing benefit to be paid directly to corporations rather than only to a single taxpayer account.
to make an exception to the rule that all Tax Administration payments go to one account number
een uitzondering op te nemen op de regel dat alle uitbetalingen van de Belastingdienst op één rekeningnummer geschieden
Motie Groot/Omtzigt over visie op woningcorporaties
Asks the government for a note on the social role of housing associations and the fitting tax treatment for them.
requests the government to give its vision in a note to the House on the social role of housing associations
verzoekt de regering in een nota aan de Tweede Kamer voor 1 april 2012 haar visie te geven op de maatschappelijke rol van woningcorporaties
Asks the government to review the substance requirements for letterbox companies and their enforcement, and to inform the House before the fiscal agenda committee meeting.
requests the government to review the substance requirements and their enforcement and to inform the House about this
verzoekt de regering de substance-eisen en de naleving van de substance-eisen tegen het licht te houden en de Tweede Kamer hierover te informeren
Amendement van het lid Groot het tot 1 januari 2013 uitstellen van de afschaffing van de zogenoemde kindertoeslag in box 3 – de verhoging van het heffingvrije vermogen per minderjarig kind
Postpones the abolition of the box 3 child allowance (higher tax-free allowance per minor child) to 1 January 2013.
Amendement van het lid Groot over het verlagen van de multiplier in de giftenaftrek in de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 naar 25%
Amendment lowers the tax deduction multiplier for charitable gifts in income tax from 50% to 25% and raises the corporate tax gift cap.

Amendement van het lid Groot rondom het regelen dat met ingang van 1 januari 2012 op auto’s die aantoonbaar voor ten minste 90% op groen gas rijden vanaf 1 januari 2012 een korting op de bijtelling me
Adds a conditional 18-percentage-point reduction in the car benefit for cars running on biogas upgraded to natural gas quality, with fixed periods of 60 months and ministerial rules on proof.
if it appears that the car runs wholly or almost wholly on gas that meets the definition of natural gas
indien blijkt dat de auto geheel of nagenoeg geheel op gas rijdt dat voldoet aan de omschrijving van aardgas
Amendement van het lid  Koolmees c.s. over het met drie jaar uitstellen van de verhoging van de accijns op CNG-brandstoffen
Postpones the excise increase on CNG fuels by three years, to 2015 and 2016, to give green gas more time to develop.
This amendment postpones the increase in excise duty on CNG fuels by three years.
Dit amendement stelt de verhoging van de accijns op CNG-brandstoffen uit met drie jaar.
Amendement van het lid Groot dat regelt dat ook woningcorporaties een beroep kunnen doen op de in artikel 12 van de Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969 op te nemen bestedingsreserve

Extends the corporate tax spending reserve exemption to housing associations approved under the Housing Act, with a 500 million euro revenue loss and entry into force subject to EU state aid approval.
Amendement van de leden Groot en Koolmees ter vervanging van nr. 25 over het herinvoeren van het lage BTW tarief voor de kunsten
Amends the VAT law to reinstate the low VAT rate for art, performing arts and live performances, with transitional rules.
This amendment brings the import and supply of art, admission to performing arts and performances by performing artists under the reduced VAT rate.
Met dit amendement wordt de invoer en levering van kunst, het verlenen van toegang tot podiumkunsten en het optreden door uitvoerende kunstenaars onder het verlaagde btw-tarief gebracht.
Amendement van het lid Groot over verlaging van het tarief voor de loon- en inkomstenbelasting van de eerste en de tweede tariefschijf met 0,06 procentpunt
Lowers the first two income tax and wage tax brackets by 0.06 percentage points, financed by a higher rate for incomes above EUR 150,000.
Amendement van het lid Groot over de introductie van een verzilverbare heffingskorting voor huishoudens met een gezamenlijk verzamelinkomen van niet meer dan € 20.000
Amendment introducing a refundable tax credit of €100 for households with combined income up to €20,000, costing about €260 million.
This amendment aims to introduce a refundable tax credit for households with combined income not above €20,000
Met dit amendement wordt beoogd een verzilverbare heffingskorting te introduceren voor huishoudens met een gezamenlijk verzamelinkomen dat niet hoger is dan € 20 000

Amendement van het lid Groot over de introductie van een wettelijke vrijstelling voor woningcorporaties indien zij uitsluitend of nagenoeg uitsluitend de huisvesting aan ouderen dan wel mensen met een
Introduces a statutory corporate tax exemption for housing associations whose housing serves only or mainly elderly or disabled people, with entry into force subject to EU state aid approval.
This amendment introduces a statutory exemption for housing associations
Dit amendement introduceert een wettelijke vrijstelling voor woningcorporaties
