Amendement van het lid Groot over het aanmerken als ANBI van woningcorporaties die als toegelaten instelling in de zin van de Woningwet een bijdrage leveren aan de volkshuisvesting
Extends the ANBI charity tax status to housing associations acting as licensed providers of social housing under the Housing Act.
social housing provided by an approved institution within the meaning of the Housing Act
volkshuisvesting door een toegelaten instelling in de zin van de Woningwet
Amendement van het lid Groot over het behouden van de frisdranken belasting
Amends the tax bill to keep the soft drinks tax and set the tobacco tax on snuff and chewing tobacco to zero.
the soft drinks tax is retained and the rate on chewing and snuff tobacco is set at zero
de frisdrankenbelasting behouden blijft en het tarief voor de belasting op pruim- en snuiftabak op nihil wordt gezet
Amendement van het lid Groot over de 30% regeling en promovendi
Amends the 30% ruling so that PhD candidates can qualify without the salary threshold, with a cap of €857,143 on the tax-free allowance to fund the cost.
This amendment aims to provide budget cover to reverse the announced salary limit of €26,605 (2011 figures) for young PhD candidates.
Dit amendement beoogt budgettaire dekking te realiseren om de aangekondigde salarisgrens van € 26 605 (cijfers 2011) voor jonge promovendi terug te draaien.
Amendement van het lid Groot over het invoeren van een 60% tarief voor inkomstenbelasting
Amends the income tax schedules to add a fifth bracket taxing income above 150,000 euros at 60 percent.
introduction of a fifth tax bracket is intended
invoering van een vijfde tariefschijf beoogd
Amendement van het lid Groot over het herinvoeren van het lage BTW tarief voor de kunsten
Proposes restoring the reduced VAT rate for art, performing arts and live performances, with transitional rules, at a revenue loss of about 90 million euros.
this amendment brings the import and supply of art, admission to performing arts and performances by performers under the reduced VAT rate
met dit amendement wordt de invoer en levering van kunst, het verlenen van toegang tot podiumkunsten en het optreden door uitvoerende kunstenaars onder het verlaagde btw-tarief gebracht
Amendement van het lid Groot over het behouden van de kindtoeslag
Amendment deleting a change to the income tax act so that the child-related tax-free allowance increase remains in place, costing 25 million euro.
Article I, part F, is deleted.
Amendement van het lid Groot over het ongedaan maken van de voorgestelde afschaffing van de grondwaterbelasting
Reverses the proposed abolition of the groundwater tax from 2012, keeping the levy in place.
With this amendment the proposed abolition of the groundwater tax from 1 January 2012 in the Tax Plan 2012 is reversed.
Met dit amendement wordt de in het Belastingplan 2012 voorgestelde afschaffing per 1 januari 2012 van de grondwaterbelasting ongedaan gemaakt.
Amendement van het lid Groot over het ongedaan maken van de voorgestelde afschaffing van de belasting op leidingwater
Amendment reversing the government's proposed abolition of the tap water tax from 2013.
With this amendment, the proposed abolition of the tap water tax from 1 January 2013, included in the Tax Plan 2012, is reversed.
Met dit amendement wordt de in het Belastingplan 2012 voorgestelde afschaffing per 1 januari 2013 van de belasting op leidingwater ongedaan gemaakt.
Amendement van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Groot dat regelt dat het deel van de rekenhuur boven de kwaliteitskortingsgrens en de aftoppingsgrens dat worden gesubsidieerd via de huurtoeslag vastgesteld
Keeps the subsidised share of rent above the quality discount and cap thresholds fixed in statute (percentages set at 65% and 40%) rather than delegating them to an AMvB.
that the part of the rent above the quality discount and cap thresholds subsidised through rent allowance remains set at the level of statute
dat het deel van de rekenhuur boven de kwaliteitskortingsgrens en de aftoppingsgrens dat worden gesubsidieerd via de huurtoeslag vastgesteld blijft worden op het niveau van wet
Motie Groot over de inkomensafhankelijke premie zorgverzekering
Asks the government to spread future increases in the income-dependent health insurance premium across all groups rather than burdening employers and employees disproportionately.
requests the government to spread future increases in the income-dependent health insurance premium evenly across all groups in society
verzoekt de regering om toekomstige verhogingen van de inkomensafhankelijke premie zorgverzekering evenwichtig te spreiden over alle groepen in de samenleving
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Omtzigt ter vervanging van nr. 21 over het beperken van de verlenging van de uitvraag van jaarloongegevens naar 1 jaar
Shortens the temporary extension of the employer payroll-data collection regime from three years to one year, ending the government's data-gathering earlier.
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het grotendeels ongedaan maken van het vervallen van de faciliteiten voor MKB-beleggingen
Amends the tax rules on MKB (SME) investment exemptions, largely reversing the abolition of the facilities for SME investments.
Article XXVI Other fiscal measures 2010 is amended as follows
Artikel XXVI Overige fiscale maatregelen 2010 wordt als volgt gewijzigd
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het laten vervallen van de verlenging van de uitvraag van jaarloongegevens
Deletes the extension of the temporary scheme for collecting annual salary data, ending a government information-gathering power.
This amendment provides that the temporary scheme for requesting annual salary data is not extended.
Dit amendement regelt dat de tijdelijke regeling uitvraag jaarloongegevens niet wordt verlengd.

Amendement van het lid Groot c.s. over de toepassing van de dwangsomregeling van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht op beschikkingen ingevolge de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen met betrekking

Makes the administrative law penalty-payment rule apply to income-dependent benefit decisions for calculation years from 2012 instead of 2014, so the tax authority faces penalties for late decisions sooner.
that the penalty-payment scheme of the General Administrative Law Act applies to decisions under the General Income-Dependent Schemes Act for calculation years from 2012

dat de dwangsomregeling van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht van toepassing wordt op beschikkingen ingevolge de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen met betrekking tot berekeningsjaren vanaf 2012
Amendement van het lid Braakhuis c.s. over het laten vervallen van de bepalingen inzake het afschaffen van de heffingskortingen
Removes a provision in a tax bill that reversed the abolition of tax credits for socially responsible and venture investments, undoing an earlier amendment.
With the present amendment the aim is to also undo the provisions in this bill that were connected with abolishing the said tax credits.
Met het onderhavige amendement wordt beoogd ook de bepalingen in het onderhavige wetsvoorstel ongedaan te maken die samenhingen met het afschaffen van de genoemde heffingskortingen.
Amendement van het lid Irrgang c.s. strekkende tot het ongedaan maken van de verwijdering van de bepalingen van het amendement Tang en Irrgang
Removes subsection a of article I.1 of the bill so that an earlier amendment on BV company law stays in the bill.
In article I.1, part A, subsection a is deleted.
In artikel I.1, onderdeel A, komt subonderdeel a te vervallen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over het bericht 'Cashen met valse scheiding populair'

MPs Omtzigt and Groot asked about reports that 'false divorces' to claim benefits are popular, and about the scale of address fraud and single-parent household trends. The State Secretary answered that address registration fraud combined with divorce is illegal and prosecutable, that married couples keep fiscal partner status unless formally divorced, gave income calculations, and described the Landelijke Aanpak Adreskwaliteit, which is continued until 2023.
If a couple does not actually separate but registers at two different addresses to obtain financial benefit, that is fraud and therefore punishable.
Als een stel niet daadwerkelijk uit elkaar gaat, maar zich op twee verschillende adressen inschrijft om financieel voordeel te genieten is dat fraude en dus strafbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over een regeling waarbij leenbijstand, die voor 1 januari 2017 omgezet is in een gift, niet langer leidt tot terugvordering van toeslagen en het (nog) niet uitvoeren van

Members Omtzigt and Groot asked why self-employed people whose loan assistance was converted into a grant, creating a phantom income that forced repayment of benefit allowances, still lack relief, and whether a scheme for existing cases could be proposed as the motion requested. The state secretary replies that retroactive or case-by-case compensation is unworkable, costly and unequal, that only a payment-plan route is offered, and that no problems with municipalities have been reported.
Although I understand the wish of your House, in view of the above I see no possibilities to arrive at a legally defensible and affordable tailor-made solution and to implement your motion.

Hoewel ik de wens van uw Kamer begrijp, zie ik gelet op het vorenstaande, dan ook geen mogelijkheden om tot een juridisch goed verdedigbare en tevens betaalbare maatwerkoplossing te komen en uw motie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over het bericht 'Om te winnen is elke truc toegestaan'

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about tax and money-laundering oversight of football finances revealed by Football Leaks, including Dutch company use, transfer-pricing of image rights, and a delayed DNB investigation. The government answered that the Tax Authority will check the leaked information and act where Dutch tax is evaded, describes existing supervision by the Tax Authority, FIOD, DNB and KNVB, and says DNB will publish its general conclusions soon.
The Tax Authority is collecting the information published in Football Leaks and will verify it, as it has done with earlier leaks.
De Belastingdienst verzamelt de informatie die wordt gepubliceerd in Football Leaks en zal deze natrekken, zoals ook bij eerdere leaks is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Groot over een datalek bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Oosenbrug and Groot asked about a data leak at the Tax Authority in which taxpayer data on CD-ROMs was sent to the wrong tax consultant, and whether affected taxpayers should have been informed. State Secretary Wiebes answered that the leak was reported to the Dutch DPA, that the risk was low so individual notification was not required, and that the Tax Authority tightened checks and is digitising the extension process.
The scope of the data leak is not exactly known.
De omvang van het datalek is niet exact bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over belastingschulden van amateur voetbalclubs

MPs Van Dekken and Groot asked the ministers about tax debts at amateur football clubs, how the KNVB and the Tax Authority share information on suspected fraud, and whether the KNVB licensing system and club accounts can help prevent it. The State Secretary answered that contact with the KNVB is regular, that the Tax Authority is bound by fiscal secrecy and cannot share fraud data with the KNVB, and that the KNVB will explore sporting sanctions while criminal investigations are not disclosed.
The Tax Authority has a general fiscal confidentiality obligation that also applies towards the KNVB licensing committee.
De Belastingdienst heeft een algemene fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht die ook werkt jegens de KNVB licentiecommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het bericht ‘Miljoenenroof Mozambique liep deels via Amsterdam’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch trust company TMF, which managed the Dutch shell company Ematum B.V. tied to a Mozambique bond, had fulfilled its gatekeeper duties and what supervisors can do to detect such fraud. The minister explained the trust-office gatekeeper obligations, the supervisory and enforcement tools of DNB and the Belastingdienst, and planned tightening of the Wet toezicht trustkantoren, while declining to judge TMF's conduct and citing legal secrecy on reports.
With this bill the aim is to make the regulatory framework for trust offices stricter.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt beoogd het regelgevend kader voor trustkantoren strenger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het bericht 'Luxemburg volhardt met geheime rulings'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Luxembourg is making oral tax rulings despite EU transparency rules, whether it should be held to account and whether Dutch rulings are ever oral. The State Secretary answered that Luxembourg's finance minister denied oral rulings, that oral rulings are undesirable under the new EU directive, and that in the Netherlands rulings are always recorded in writing.
If member states do not comply with the agreements in Directive 2015/2376/EU, I am of the view that these member states should be called to account by the other member states.
Indien lidstaten zich niet houden aan de afspraken in de Richtlijn 2015/2376/EU, ben ik van mening dat deze lidstaten hierop moeten worden aangesproken door de andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het bericht “Grote Nederlandse bedrijven houden miljarden in hun zak”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO report claiming large Dutch companies cost the Dutch tax authority about 1.5 billion euro a year through avoidance, and about the consistency with earlier corporate tax analyses. The State Secretary disputes the 1.5 billion figure, says the report cannot separate avoidance from tax incentives, maintains the earlier analysis, and states the government supports international agreements on profit taxation and transparency.
The conclusion of the study is in my view not that the Dutch tax authority loses 1.5 billion euro in tax through avoidance by large companies.
De conclusie van het onderzoek is naar mijn mening niet dat de Nederlandse fiscus 1,5 miljard euro aan belasting misloopt door belastingontwijking door grote bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Groot over de onrust bij zzp’ers in de media over de Wet DBA

MPs Mei Li Vos and Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Wet DBA, including whether intermediaries and payroll firms shift the risk of social premium back-payments onto contractors and whether the information campaign reaches clients. The State Secretary answered that the Act restores a balance of responsibilities, that the intermediary arrangement does not remove clients' risk, and that the Tax Authority runs a broad campaign aimed at both clients and contractors.
Yes, I am aware of the phenomenon described.
Ja, ik ben met het geschetste verschijnsel bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Nijboer en Groot over het bericht dat de heer Meerstadt per direct opstapt als commissaris bij ABN AMRO

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about the sudden resignation of ABN AMRO supervisory board member Meerstadt after Panama Papers reports, and whether undisclosed offshore interests should be disclosed and checked in suitability tests. The minister answered that the resignation was unplanned, Meerstadt denies involvement, disclosure rules apply, and tax authorities will use the Panama Papers information, but declined to assess whether further information can be provided.
The Tax Authority will use the information from the Panama Papers to detect possible tax fraud.
De Belastingdienst zal de informatie uit de Panama Papers gebruiken om eventuele belastingfraude op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Groot over de onrust bij zzp’ers in de media over de Wet DBA

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty among freelancers over the Wet DBA, including whether the Tax Authority's website guidance is clear enough and whether intermediaries become more attractive to clients. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority is simplifying its information and running a broad communication campaign, that model contracts are optional, and that the Act does not change the legal definition of employment versus entrepreneurship.
The Tax Authority endorses the importance of good information and recognises the concern that freelancers do not derive certainty from the text on the Tax Authority's website.
De Belastingdienst onderschrijft het belang van een goede voorlichting en herkent het geluid dat zzp'ers geen zekerheid ontlenen aan de tekst op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Groot over privacylekken bij de Belastingdienst

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Finance about privacy breaches and wrongly registered residence ('ghost occupancy') at the Tax Authority, which halt benefit payments, including whether there are system errors, whether the Authority will meet the Data Protection Authority's deadline, whether breaches of confidentiality should be corrected faster, and whether affected citizens will be compensated. The State Secretary answered that the root cause lies in the Personal Records Database, that the Tax Authority corrects its systems and calculations once a report is made, that a new fast-track protocol was introduced in 2015 with extra attention since early 2016, and that affected persons receive owed benefits with possible damages claimed through the complaints procedure.
Once this is known to the Tax Authority, it will be resolved.
Zodra dit bij de Belastingdienst wel bekend is, wordt dit opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het artikel ‘Toeristenbelasting is een melkkoe’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked about a report that municipal tourist tax is a cash cow, with hotels and bungalow parks charging guests more than the municipal rate, and whether this breaches advertising rules and is lawful. The minister confirms hoteliers may pass on the tax under article 224 Gemeentewet, says overcharging would be undue payment and misleading, and leaves enforcement to the consumer authority ACM and courts while declining to judge specific conduct.
It is not correct to withhold more tourist tax than the municipality in question charges.
Het is daarbij niet juist om meer in te houden aan toeristenbelasting dan dat door de desbetreffende gemeente in rekening wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het besluit van de Europese Commissie aangaande Starbucks

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the European Commission's decision that the Starbucks tax ruling constituted state aid, whether the full decision will be published, the government's cooperation with Starbucks, the BEPS implications for intangibles and hybrid mismatches, and the transfer pricing decree. The State Secretary answered that the confidential version was received, Dutch consultation on confidential data is ongoing with a reply to follow within weeks, and that BEPS changes are largely in line with existing Dutch policy, though the transfer pricing decree will be revised later.
I expect to be able to inform the House further within a few weeks about the government's response and view on the decision.
Ik verwacht Uw Kamer binnen enkele weken nader te kunnen informeren over de reactie en zienswijze van het kabinet op het besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Hoogland over de berichtgeving rondom de fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Infrastructure and Environment how Volkswagen manipulated emissions tests, whether other brands or EU countries are affected, how US and EU testing differ, and what should be done to check Dutch and EU effects. The government referred several answers to earlier answers, confirmed NOx emissions in practice are much higher than the EU norm, said the RDW cannot yet determine vehicle numbers, and described that the German type-approval authority KBA has set Volkswagen a deadline for a remedy.
As soon as the necessary data are available, the RDW will determine the numbers.
Zodra de noodzakelijke gegevens beschikbaar zijn zal de RDW de aantallen achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over het bericht ‘Havens verliezen hun belastingvrijstelling’

MPs Albert de Vries and Groot asked whether the European Commission has moved to a new phase and issued an ultimatum over the temporary corporate tax exemption for Dutch seaports, how the Commission treats indirect state aid to ports in other member states, and what alternatives exist. The Secretary of State declined to disclose the content or outcome of ongoing talks with the Commission and did not assess alternatives, referring instead to the earlier answers, while noting that talks aim to avoid forced recovery of the aid from 1 January 2016.
The talks between the cabinet and the European Commission are still ongoing.
Het gesprek tussen het kabinet en de Europese Commissie is nog steeds gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Recourt over de voortgang van het centraal aandeelhoudersregister voor besloten en (niet-beursgenoteerde) naamloze vennootschappen

MPs Groot and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about delays and a possible cost overrun in setting up the central shareholders register (CAHR), and whether the KNB's alternative based on the Central Digital Repertory could be pursued. The minister confirmed the importance of the register, said costs cannot yet be estimated, stated the Chamber of Commerce is designated manager, and indicated further decision-making is expected in autumn 2015.
My estimate is that further decision-making can take place this autumn.
Mijn inschatting is dat dit najaar nadere besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het bericht  ’Amsterdamse verhuurders in de fout met inkomensdata’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked the minister whether Amsterdam landlords wrongly requested income indications for tenants with liberalised leases, and whether such landlords should be denied portal access and rent increases reversed. The minister answered that such requests are unlawful, that the Tax Authority sanctions repeat or deliberate misuse by revoking portal access, and that in 2014 only warning letters were issued, with two landlords now warned.
Landlords who nonetheless include addresses with a liberalised lease in their request file violate both the law and the terms of use of the web portal.
Verhuurders die toch adressen met een geliberaliseerd huurcontract in hun opvraagbestand opnemen, overtreden de wet èn de gebruiksvoorwaarden van het webportaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Groot over Roemeense voetbalfraude

Two MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that Dutch letterbox firms facilitated Romanian football transfer fraud, and whether Dutch tax rules and treaties can prevent such structures. The minister said transfer fraud should be tackled, pointed to existing matchfixing platforms and a Niet-Melders project, said tax authorities already share information on football, and argued a source-tax on payments abroad would be disproportionately harmful.
I agree that (transfer) fraud in sport should be tackled.
Ik deel de mening dat (transfer)fraude in de sport aangepakt dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het artikel ‘HSBC hielp klanten bij belastingontduiking’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that HSBC helped clients evade tax, including how Dutch authorities obtained the data, how many Dutch tax evaders were found, whether foreign banks can be prosecuted, and how black savings via Switzerland and Dutch BVs are being curbed. The State Secretary answered that 130 Dutch holders were investigated, 48 were found non-compliant with about 2.3 million euro recovered, Switzerland cooperation and a new automatic exchange regime are being pursued, and no action was taken against HSBC itself.
Cooperation by a bank in tax evasion and avoidance is in my view undesirable.
Het meewerken van een bank aan belastingontduiking en -ontwijking is naar mijn mening onwenselijk.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over het terugvorderen van uitgekeerde toeslagen vanwege het samenwonen met een vreemdeling zonder rechtmatig verblijf

Two MPs asked the State Secretaries whether a Council of State ruling means people in special circumstances no longer automatically lose benefits when a partner without lawful residence lives with them, and what the ruling's scope and practical consequences are. The government answered that the ruling is limited to the specific facts of that individual case, that it changes no policy or practice at the Tax Authority, and that it is consistent with earlier rulings.
The scope of this ruling is limited to this individual case, because it is based on the specific facts and circumstances of the case, from which no general conclusion can be drawn.

De reikwijdte van deze uitspraak is beperkt tot dit individuele geval omdat die gebaseerd is op de specifieke feiten en omstandigheden van het geval waaraan geen algemene conclusie kan worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het effect van de Europese BTW regels voor elektronische diensten op kleine ondernemers, die per 1 januari 2015 van kracht zijn geworden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the effect of the 2015 EU VAT rules for electronic services on small businesses, including reports of firms ceasing cross-border activity, and whether a threshold or exemption could be introduced. The State Secretary said the rules are EU law leaving no national room for deviation, that no direct signals of closures had reached the tax service, and that he will consult business organisations on making information more accessible but sees no national scope for a threshold.
However, as noted above, these are rules laid down in the VAT Directive and a number of implementing and Commission regulations.
Zoals hiervoor is opgemerkt gaat het echter om regels die zijn vastgelegd in de BTW-richtlijn en een aantal uitvoerings- en commissieverordeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Oosenbrug over het doen van belastingaangifte door mensen met psychi(atri)sche, maatschappelijke en verslavingsproblemen

MPs Groot and Oosenbrug asked whether abolishing the electronic signature (pincode) for tax returns has made it harder for vulnerable citizens and the intermediary organisations helping them, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary says alternatives exist (commercial software, DigiD with proxy, Belastingdienst help) and that intermediaries have been advised, but commits to no new measures for this group.
For the group referred to in the question, in my judgement there are sufficient options to obtain (free) help with filing the tax return.
Voor de in de vraag bedoelde groep zijn er naar mijn oordeel voldoende mogelijkheden om (gratis) hulp te krijgen bij het doen van de belastingaangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over pensioenopbouw door IB-ondernemers bij een beroepspensioenregeling

Two MPs asked why self-employed income-tax payers in mandatory occupational pension schemes are assessed on profit from three years earlier, and what relief exists for someone who became partly disabled, so that their pension premium more than doubled. The government answered that a reference year (t-3) gives time to fix the maximum pensionable income, that special rules apply for illness, disability and starters, that it is always allowed to use a lower amount, and that pension funds and social partners decide on premium-free continuation and discretion.
It is always fiscally permitted to assume a lower amount than the maximum that may be taken into account as pensionable income.
Het is fiscaal altijd toegestaan om van een lager bedrag uit te gaan dan het bedrag dat ten hoogste als pensioengevend loon in aanmerking mag worden genomen.

Antwoord schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kerstens en Groot (Beiden PvdA) en het lid Pieter Heerma (CDA) over het convenant dat de uitzendsector heeft gesloten met de Belastingdienst waardoor oneerlijke concurrentie en

Three MPs (Kerstens, Groot of PvdA and Pieter Heerma of CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a covenant between the Tax Authority and the staffing sector that allegedly enables unfair competition and displacement through extraterritorial cost allocation, and asked about oversight, the estimated EUR 250 million revenue loss and whether the covenant should be terminated. The answer was not given in this text: it only states that the questions were answered by letter on a related request from another MP, so the substance of the answers is not present.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Groot over mogelijkheden de Wet Normering Topinkomens te omzeilen

MPs Kerstens and Groot asked whether topfunctionarissen could exceed the WNT pay norm by shifting pay into tax-free work expenses, and whether such schemes should be made unlawful. The minister replied that no gap exists, citing the gebruikelijkheidscriterium and a practical €2,400 threshold, and promised to examine tightening the criterion and clarifying the WNT framework.
The State Secretary of Finance has committed to examining whether the customary-practice criterion needs further tightening in this context.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën heeft toegezegd te onderzoeken of het gebruikelijkheidscriterium in dit kader nadere aanscherping behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Marcouch over coulance voor kerkgenootschappen ten aanzien van de publicatieplicht voor ANBI’s

Two MPs asked why church communities get until 1 January 2016 to meet the ANBI publication requirement while mosques and other faiths must comply from 2014, and whether that is fair. The State Secretary explained the transitional rule is for church bodies covered by group rulings that lack their own RSIN, applied in practice to all religious bodies including mosques, and that about 2,000 ANBIs (none religious) will lose status for not complying.
That means, for example, that mosques also have until 1 January 2016.
Dat betekent dat bijvoorbeeld ook moskeeën tot 1 januari 2016 de tijd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het alarmerende bericht dat de integriteit van trustkantoren in het geding is

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked the Finance Minister about DNB findings that trust offices take unacceptable risks with Dutch limited partnerships (cv-structures), lack separation of functions and source-of-funds checks. The minister agrees the findings are worrying, points to new integrity rules (RibWtt 2014) effective 2015, and says tax avoidance via these structures falls outside last year's measures and is being addressed internationally.
Soon I will publish the new Regulation on Integrity of Business Operations under the Trust Offices Supervision Act (RibWtt 2014).
Binnenkort zal ik de nieuwe Regeling Integere Bedrijfsvoering Wet toezicht trustkantoren (RibWtt 2014) publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groot over het dichten van het btw-lek

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the VAT gap caused by refunds on unpaid invoices of failed customers could be closed by introducing a cash-based VAT scheme, and asked about its administrative and financial effects. The State Secretary answered that no reliable estimate of the gap exists, that a mandatory cash scheme would have mixed effects on businesses and a one-off negative cash effect for the Treasury, and that the Netherlands had not argued for it in the EU Green Paper response.
The Tax Authority has no specific information on the amount of VAT deducted by bankrupt businesses on unpaid invoices, so no statement can be made on the size of this VAT gap.

Bij de Belastingdienst is over de omvang van door failliete bedrijven in aftrek gebrachte btw waarbij de factuur niet is betaald geen specifieke informatie aanwezig, zodat geen uitspraak kan worden gedaan over de omvang van dit btw-lek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over een gelijk Europees speelveld voor de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked whether the government would delay or drop corporate tax for Dutch port operators until an EU study on port competition is published and EU-level state aid rules are agreed. The minister answered that no general EU-wide tax comparison is possible, that talks with the Commission on modernising corporate tax liability for state enterprises are ongoing, and that a bill is aimed for Prinsjesdag 2014 with transitional arrangements considered.
We have no insight into the progress of processing the results and the analysis thereof.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de voortgang van de verwerking van de resultaten en de analyse daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Groot over de uitzending ‘Caribisch Nederland, Drie jaar later, Bonaire’

Two MPs asked the government about a broadcast on Bonaire's high prices, falling real incomes, electricity and produce costs, and competition, and whether the 2010 tax reform and the switch to the US dollar caused price rises. The minister answered at length, acknowledging strong price rises and partly attributing them to global factors and dollarisation, citing indexation, tax relief and planned electricity and price regulation, while admitting gaps in data.
The Statistics Netherlands has started a study into, among other things, income developments on the islands.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek is een onderzoek gestart naar, onder andere, (bewegingen in) de inkomenssfeer op de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Groot over het bericht dat de Rabobank heeft aangekondigd de Liborboete in mindering te brengen op de nettowinst van de bank

MPs Nijboer and Groot asked whether Rabobank may deduct a Libor fine from its taxable profit, and how that squares with the rule that fines are non-deductible. The State Secretary declined to discuss an individual taxpayer, explained that foreign fines are in principle deductible unlike Dutch fines, and said he is considering proposing that foreign fines also be non-deductible in a letter to parliament.
I am therefore considering proposing that foreign fines also no longer be allowed as a deduction.
Ik overweeg daarom voor te stellen ook buitenlandse boetes niet langer in aftrek toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Recourt over belastingontduiking door misdaadondernemers

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether criminals can evade tax by deregistering from the municipal population register (GBA), why conservatory assessments on emigration are limited, whether immediate settlement on emigration could replace them, and why a RIEC study on this fraud has not yielded an effective approach. The State Secretary answered that residence for tax purposes is assessed on all circumstances, that GBA deregistration alone does not end tax liability, that EU law makes immediate collection on emigration doubtful, and that an FIOD investigation into the phenomenon is underway with measures to follow depending on its outcome.
To gain further insight into the possible scale of this specific phenomenon, the FIOD is currently conducting an investigation.
Om nadere duiding over de mogelijke omvang van dit specifieke fenomeen te krijgen, voert de FIOD momenteel onderzoek uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch en Omtzigt over het mislukken van het overleg over directe huurtoeslagbetaling aan woningbouwcorporaties

MPs Groot, Monasch and Omtzigt asked why the motion-based arrangement for direct payment of rent allowance (huurtoeslag) to housing associations failed. The State Secretary answered that housing association umbrella body Aedes judged the partnership arrangement commercially unviable, and that no alternative route for direct payment is available within the legal framework.
I see no possibilities, within the statutory scheme and the conditions attached to it, to give direct payment of rent allowance to housing corporations an alternative form.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om binnen de wettelijke regeling en de daarbij geldende randvoorwaarden een directe betaling van huurtoeslag aan woningcorporaties op alternatieve wijze vorm te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Groot over tax rulings van de Nederlandse Belastingdienst

An MP asked whether a tax ruling let KPN deduct a €3.7bn book loss on selling E-Plus against future profits, costing the state about €900m, and whether this breaches the participation exemption. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual taxpayer under confidentiality rules, confirmed that losses on selling a participation fall under the exemption and cannot be deducted, and said the tax authority would not make such agreements.
Agreements on deducting losses from selling a participation conflict with the participation exemption. Therefore the tax authority will not make such agreements.

Afspraken over het aftrekken van verliezen geleden door verkoop van een deelneming staan op gespannen voet met de deelnemingsvrijstelling. Derhalve zal de Belastingdienst dergelijke afspraken niet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de gevolgen van het inflatiecijfer op de huurstijgingen

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the ministers whether the Woonbond's claim that the inflation figure inflates rent increases is valid, and whether the calculation method should be changed. The minister rejected the Woonbond's three arguments as consistent with international guidelines and declined to start a study of an alternative inflation measure.
I therefore see no reason to start a study into a different inflation figure as the basis for rent policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een onderzoek te starten naar een ander inflatiecijfer als basis voor het huurbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Groot over studiereizen met privékarakter op kosten van de belastingbetaler

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about tax deductions for training costs and study trips with a private character, including differences between income tax and corporate tax rules and whether abuse is controlled. The State Secretary explained the deduction rules, said the treatment of entrepreneurs and employees is sufficiently balanced, declined to give details of audit methods, and said improper use is undesirable without proposing new limits.
To prevent future abuse, no statements can be made about the audit method and audit coverage.
Om toekomstig misbruik te voorkomen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de werkwijze bij controle en over de controledichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot over de verkoop van vakantiedagen

MPs Hamer and Groot asked the ministers about a report that businesses hold about 16 billion euro in unused leave and whether a lower tax rate on buying out leave days would boost the economy. The government answered that the 16 billion figure rests on a small, uncertain survey, that only above-statutory leave can be bought out, and that a reduced tax rate is undesirable because of unequal treatment, revenue loss and tax arbitrage.
For tax purposes, the buyout of holiday days is treated as wages taxed at the rate applying to the employee who buys out.
Fiscaal wordt de afkoop van vakantiedagen beschouwd als loon dat belast wordt naar het tarief zoals dat geldt voor de werknemer die afkoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Groot over de ontwikkeling en de internationale concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse havens

MPs De Vries and Groot asked the ministers about the OECD study on Rotterdam and Amsterdam port competitiveness, corporate tax exemption for state port companies, and EU support for smaller ports. The government said the OECD study draws no competitiveness conclusions, that the consequences of ending the tax exemption are not yet clear, and that a level playing field is important to the Netherlands.
However, it is not yet clear at this moment how the revision of the corporate tax liability for state-owned enterprises will be shaped.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet duidelijk hoe de herziening van de vennootschapsbelastingplicht voor overheidsbedrijven wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Kerstens over zzp'ers die door de Bbz-regeling in de knel raken

MPs asked whether self-employed people on Bbz benefits are being pushed into financial trouble when a Bbz loan is converted into a non-repayable benefit, causing loss of allowances, and how the tax office and municipalities handle the annual statement and this conversion. The minister answered that the conversion is taxed in the year of definitive determination, that individual cases fall to municipalities and the tax secrecy duty, suggested adjusting income estimates for allowances, and said he will ask the state secretary to explore options and inform the House.
However, I have persuaded the state secretary of Finance to explore other options to mitigate or remove the described effects.
Wel heb ik de staatssecretaris van Financiën bereid gevonden andere mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de geschetste effecten te matigen dan wel weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over verlenging van de VUT-uitkering

Two PvdA MPs asked whether extending VUT early-retirement benefits to bridge the rise in the AOW pension age would trigger immediate taxation, and whether the Tax Authority's pension knowledge group's view was government policy. The state secretary answered that extension past age 65 would lose the transitional regime and trigger the VUT levy, that the knowledge group's advice is not policy, and that spreading existing entitlements over a longer period will be tolerated under conditions via a policy decision.
Policy in the formal sense is determined exclusively by me.
Beleid in formele zin wordt uitsluitend door mij vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over mogelijke fouten in loonstrookjes als gevolg van de samenloop WUL en AOW leeftijdsverhoging

Two MPs asked whether the 2013 AOW age increase combined with the new wage definition (WUL) caused errors in pensioners' payslips, whether the SVB communicated adequately, and whether taxpayers need to file returns. The government denied a systematic error, explained how tax credits are split between AOW and pension income, pointed to Belastingdienst information, and declined to extend the early WUL evaluation to pension-fund and SVB implementation.
At present, given the answers above, I see no reason to also include the implementation and communication by pension funds and the SVB in that evaluation.
Ik zie op dit moment – gezien de hierboven gegeven antwoorden – geen reden ook de uitvoering en communicatie door pensioenfondsen en SVB in die evaluatie te betrekken.
Antwoord vragen Groot over het opzeggen door Mongolië van het belastingverdrag met Nederland

Labour MP Groot asked the State Secretary of Finance about Mongolia's termination of its tax treaty with the Netherlands, including whether an IMF report calls the treaty problematic and why Mongolia terminated it. The State Secretary answered that the IMF report only flags the 0% dividend rate as problematic, that Mongolia terminated the treaty over lost revenue, and declined to propose new substance requirements for Dutch-based companies.
The fact that Mongolia has terminated the Treaty is not, for me, a reason to make proposals to amend Dutch statutory or regulatory provisions.
Het feit dat Mongolië het Verdrag heeft opgezegd, is voor mij geen aanleiding voorstellen te doen om Nederlandse wet- of regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Nijboer over het belastingvoordeel dat gepaard gaat met het aanbieden van hypotheken onder marktrentes

MPs Groot and Nijboer asked the state secretary of Finance whether employee mortgage discounts below market rate should be taxed at market value rather than the 3% norm rate, and about the revenue loss. The state secretary confirmed the tax treatment rules, said the norm rate is applied in practice, and stated there is no budgetary loss; the rule will be reviewed in light of planned mortgage interest deduction limits.
In light of the upcoming restrictions on mortgage interest deduction, as foreseen in the VVD/PvdA coalition agreement, this arrangement will still be reviewed.
In het licht van de aanstaande beperkingen van de hypotheekrenteaftrek, zoals voorzien in het Regeerakkoord VVD/PvdA, zal deze regeling nog worden bezien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether the government would improve information to carers about the inheritance tax exemption linked to the mantelzorgcompliment, and whether the exemption should rest on receiving that compliment. The state secretary replied that information has already been improved, including SVB letters, and that the compliment is not meant for the exemption, so the statutory condition cannot be waived through the hardship clause.
Since this is an explicit choice by the legislature, I have no room to deviate from it by applying the hardship clause.
Nu sprake is van een uitdrukkelijke keuze van de wetgever, heb ik geen ruimte om daarvan met toepassing van hardheidsclausule af te wijken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Groot over gebruik van financiële derivaten door zorginstellingen

Two MPs asked the health minister about rising use of financial derivatives by healthcare institutions, the risks, oversight by the NZa and the Waarborgfonds voor de Zorgsector, and whether legal limits apply. The minister answered that usage rose per KPMG data, that institutions' boards bear primary responsibility, that the WFZ requires prior approval for derivatives and bars margin calls, that no statutory limits exist, and that a WFZ survey will inform possible future regulation.
It is primarily the responsibility of an institution's Executive Board and then its Supervisory Board to oversee the prudent use of derivatives.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad van Bestuur en vervolgens van de Raad van Toezicht van een instelling om toezicht te houden op het verstandig gebruik van derivaten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Monasch over het verschil in belastingdruk tussen bouwrijpe en braakliggende grond

MPs Groot and Monasch asked why selling a demolished building plot with foundations left attracts only 2% transfer tax while removing the foundations triggers 19% VAT, and whether this discourages greening vacant land and harms neighbourhood liveability. The State Secretary of Finance answered that VAT applies only to a building plot as defined under the VAT Act, that removing foundations does not create a building plot merely to make a garden or lawn, and that no liveability signals are known; he declined to change the law pending a Court of Justice ruling.
I do not intend to take legislative measures for the time being pending that ruling.
Ik ben niet voornemens om in afwachting daarvan thans wettelijke maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot over de werkwijze van gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs Recourt and Groot asked whether bailiffs allocate collected payments first to costs, then interest, then principal, and whether this creates tax or legal issues, notably in ABN AMRO cases. The government answered that the Article 6:44 BW order applies, found no indications of tax avoidance or criminal conduct, and said the Bureau Financieel Toezicht is conducting an exploratory investigation into bailiffs' interest calculations, expected to conclude in October.
In January 2012 the Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) started an exploratory investigation into interest calculation by bailiffs.
In januari 2012 is het Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) gestart met een verkennend onderzoek naar renteberekening door gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Plasterk over het bericht dat het speculeren met derivatencontracten op de staatsschuld tot verliezen heeft geleid

MPs Groot and Plasterk asked the Finance Minister about a Parool report that derivative swaps on the national debt caused losses of around 100 million euro, and about the risk policy and controls. The minister said the state does not speculate, acknowledged about 11 billion euro of swaps taken early in 2011 with a market loss of about 100 million, explained the 7-year risk framework, called the 2.4 billion figure a misunderstanding, and said control procedures were tightened.
I would like to point out that the State does not speculate.
Ik hecht eraan erop te wijzen dat de Staat niet speculeert.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de aanpak van derivatengebruik bij woningcorporaties

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether a ban on speculative derivative positions should extend beyond formally approved housing associations to non-profit housing bodies, and how the planned AMvB listing permitted banks would be designed. The minister answered that the new rules apply only to toegelaten instellingen, that extension to other NWIs is not intended, and that the AMvB will be sent to parliament once drafted, with supervision and sound finance considered.
When the relevant AMvB (draft) is ready, I will send it to your House for discussion.
Als de betreffende AMvB (in concept) gereed is zal ik deze ter bespreking aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Groot en Wolbert over de verhoogde vrijstelling van de erfbelasting voor mantelzorgers

MPs Recourt, Groot and Wolbert asked whether carers can qualify for the raised inheritance tax exemption of 600,000 euro, what conditions apply, and whether citizens have been adequately informed. The state secretary confirmed the partner exemption conditions (including the carer allowance, cohabitation contract or five-year registration, and no other partner), said no specific agreements on information were made with parliament, and committed to working with Mezzo on improving information to carers.
The state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport will consult with Mezzo to examine whether information to carers on inheritance tax and the exemption could be further improved.
De staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zal in overleg met Mezzo bezien of zij de voorlichting aan mantelzorgers over erfbelasting en vrijstelling verder zouden kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij over "de onregelmatigheden binnen het pensioenfonds van het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)"

MPs Groot and Vermeij asked the minister whether supervision of the CBR pension fund failed given irregularities found by an Integis investigation, and what measures and remedies apply. The minister answered that the investigation concerned a separate toeslagfonds (supplementary fund) outside prudential pension supervision at the time, that current rules prohibit such standalone funds, and that correction of irregularities is for the employer and works council to resolve.
No conclusions can therefore be drawn from this investigation about supervision of the CBR pension fund.
Er kunnen aan dit onderzoek dan ook geen conclusies worden verbonden over het toezicht op het pensioenfonds van het CBR.
Antwoord vragen Plasterk en Groot over het bericht dat een Mexicaanse telecomgigant een bod doet op 28% van de aandelen in KPN

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister about América Móvil's partial bid for 28% of KPN shares, whether the 30% mandatory-bid threshold should be lowered, and whether the minister could change it by decree. The minister declined to judge the bid, said the 30% threshold was chosen deliberately and remains in line with other EU states, and stated that changing it would require a change in the law.
In view of the above, I currently see no reason to change the threshold for the mandatory bid.
Gezien bovenstaande zie ik momenteel geen reden om de drempelwaarde voor het verplichte bod te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de berichtgeving over een eventuele verhoging van de kilometervergoeding

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether he knew of reports on raising the mileage allowance from 19 to 24 cents per km, what the budget effect would be, and whether he would seriously consider the ANWB's smart travel budget alternative. The state secretary confirmed awareness, stated a 5-cent increase would cost about 500 million euro in forgone revenue, and said he was positive about B50 plans but that the budget agreement now puts the emphasis on fiscal consolidation.
A rise in the tax-free mileage allowance of 5 cents results in a budgetary loss of about 500 million.
Een stijging van de onbelaste kilometervergoeding met 5 cent heeft een budgettaire derving van circa 500 miljoen als gevolg.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de gevolgen van de woon-werkbelasting voor de huurtoeslag, zorgtoeslag en kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether taxing commuting allowances would reduce housing, healthcare and childcare benefits, and whether affected workers would be compensated. The minister confirmed the reduction effect depends on how employers apply the tax rules, and deferred any compensation discussion to the upcoming budget debate.
There is still sufficient opportunity to address this subject during the relevant legislative debate.
Bij de betreffende wetsbehandeling is er nog voldoende gelegenheid om dit onderwerp te behandelen.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Groot over het bericht in de Volkskrant over de vrije val van de huizenverkoop

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior and the State Secretary for Finance about a newspaper report of a sharp fall in home sales in February 2012 and why the Dutch housing market is weaker than neighbouring countries. The minister answered that the drop is partly overstated when compared with recent months, attributed the decline to market dynamics and the economic situation, and listed measures the cabinet has already taken to support the housing market.
This cabinet has taken various measures to give a targeted boost to confidence in the housing market and to remove obstacles to transactions.
Er zijn door dit kabinet verschillende maatregelen genomen om het vertrouwen op de woningmarkt een gerichte impuls te geven en belemmeringen voor transacties weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de belastingopbrengsten op de BES eilanden

MP Groot asks whether the Finance Ministry refused to give BES island representatives information on expected tax revenue and what revenues were in 2009-2011 and the target yield. The state secretary replies that 2011 figures are not yet available, estimates a 50-65 million USD range, and explains the tax differences between the islands.
The requested information on the 2011 yield of national taxes in the Caribbean Netherlands is not yet available.
De gevraagde informatie over de opbrengst over het jaar 2011 van de rijksbelastingen op Caribisch Nederland is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord vragen Groot over "de hoge inflatie in Caribisch Nederland"

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about high inflation on the Caribbean Netherlands islands and its effect on low-income residents, and whether support measures and the annual report would address poverty. The minister confirmed the inflation figures, said benefits and minimum wages were indexed per island, and promised a cabinet response on the purchasing-power study before summer 2012 plus an analysis of poverty by 1 July 2012.
In addition, at the initiative of the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior, a study has been started to gain more insight into price level movements and the income situation.
Daarnaast is op initiatief van de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van BZK een onderzoek gestart om meer inzicht te krijgen in de bewegingen in prijspeil en de inkomenssfeer.
Antwoord vragen Groot over " de koopkrachtondersteuning in het buitenland "

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether and how the government will comply with a Haarlem court ruling that the 33-euro purchasing-power allowance must also be paid to pensioners living abroad, and whether the scheme should be tested against EU social security rules. The minister said the SVB is considering appeal and would not anticipate that, noted the EU treaty has no procedure for courts to review laws, and explained that Caribbean Netherlands counts as abroad for this allowance and has no social security treaty with the Netherlands.
The Social Insurance Bank is studying whether to appeal the court's ruling.
De Sociale Verzekeringsbank bestudeert of zij hoger beroep instelt tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de alleenstaande ouderenkorting

An MP asked whether two fiscal partners living apart, both receiving the single-person AOW pension, are each entitled to the single elderly tax credit, including for part of the year and in the digital tax return. The state secretary confirmed entitlement in full, said the credit is granted automatically by the tax authority from SVB data, and that the 2012 return program will be adjusted.
They will automatically be granted the single elderly tax credit in their 2011 assessment.
Zij zullen de alleenstaande ouderenkorting in hun aanslag over 2011 automatisch toegekend krijgen.
Antwoord vragen Groot over de belastingheffing over de opbrengst van een appartementencomplex

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling that taxed rental income from an apartment complex in Box 3 rather than Box 1, and about its budgetary effects. The State Secretary replied that the ruling turned on its specific facts within existing Supreme Court criteria, is under appeal, has no budgetary consequences, and that no further measures are warranted.
Decisions like this one, which involve no changed assessment criteria and are strongly casuistic in nature, have no budgetary consequences.
Beslissingen als de onderhavige waarin geen veranderde beoordelingscriteria aan de orde zijn en die sterk casuïstisch getint zijn, hebben geen budgettaire gevolgen.

Antwoord vragen Arib en Groot over het bericht dat de fiscus belasting heft over smartengeld van slachtoffers uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog en mogelijk ook over vergoedingen voor slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik binnen de

MPs Arib and Groot asked whether tax is levied on compensation paid to Second World War victims and to victims of abuse in the Catholic Church, and how such payments affect benefit entitlements. The government answered that periodic Artikel 2 Fonds payments are taxable income, that lump-sum church compensation is not income for tax purposes but counts as assets, and that municipalities decide on benefit means-testing, with a planned exemption under review.
I have decided together with the relevant fellow ministers to take measures so that the one-off payments from the Roman Catholic Church at issue are included in this regulation.

Ik heb met de betrokken collega-bewindslieden besloten om maatregelen te treffen waardoor de hier aan de orde zijnde eenmalige uitkeringen van de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk in deze regeling worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Groot inzake de sleuteltabel 2012

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance for the budgetary yields and costs of many tax changes and asked for the Sleuteltabel 2012 to be sent to parliament early. The government sent the key table of indicative budgetary effects and referred the detailed questions 2 to 75 to that table.
Answer 1 Yes, see below the SLEUTEL TABEL 2012 level 2011 as of 2012
Antwoord 1 Ja, zie onderstaand SLEUTEL TABEL 2012 niveau 2011 per 2012
Antwoord vragen Groot over de behandeling van bezwaarschriften door de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about an internal Tax Administration proposal to approve objections unseen, the backlog of 61,000 income-tax objections, handling capacity and timeliness. The State Secretary confirmed the proposal existed but was not adopted, attributed the backlog to the Tijdige Aangifte campaign, ex officio assessments and stricter penalties, and said the peak should be cleared by 1 September, while stating cuts will not compromise rights enforcement.
This proposal has not been adopted.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de voortvarendheid waarmee de Belastingdienst huiseigenaren van dienst is bij het achterhalen van de hoogte van het inkomen van achteloze huurders

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether the Tax Authority's web tool letting landlords check whether a household's income exceeds 43,000 euro is lawful and privacy-compliant, and what safeguards and enforcement exist against misuse. The minister answered that a temporary exemption from tax secrecy covers the tool, that landlords can only query their own properties and must accept usage terms, and that misuse is unlawful and subject to civil, data-protection and criminal sanctions.
Landlords may only request the information for that purpose.
Verhuurders mogen de informatie alleen maar voor dat doel opvragen.
Vragen van de leden Groot, Monasch (beiden PvdA) en Koolmees (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Financien over de fiscale behandeling van transformatie van kantoorpanden (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Groot, Monasch and Koolmees asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax obstacles to converting office buildings into housing, including double VAT, the transfer-tax exemption period and WOZ valuation. The State Secretary rejected changes to VAT integration levy, transfer tax and other fiscal incentives, citing budgetary, EU and simplicity considerations, and gave no commitment to action.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht dat Nederland € 1 miljard aan inkomsten van Zwitserse bankrekeningen misloopt (ingezonden 7 december

Labour MPs Groot and Plasterk asked whether a Swiss deal like those with Germany and the UK could yield about €1 billion one-off, and whether the government will pursue one. The state secretary answered that the amount seems unrealistic, that such deals keep bank secrecy and conflict with automatic information exchange, and that the government is exploring the figures and conditions with Switzerland.
The Netherlands has therefore entered into consultation with Switzerland to explore which amounts could be involved and under which conditions an agreement could be concluded.
Nederland is daarom in overleg met Zwitserland getreden om te inventariseren over welke bedragen het zou kunnen gaan en onder welke condities een akkoord zou kunnen worden gesloten.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Financiën en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over problemen met het verrekenen van inkomsten uit werk bij mensen in de WWB en het ove

Two MPs asked the state secretaries of Finance and Social Affairs about problems with offsetting work income against WWB benefits and the Tax Authority rejecting corrected annual statements, causing later assessments for beneficiaries. The state secretary answered that offsetting is a regular, legally provided process, that no signals of frequent problems are known, and that guidance for municipalities was issued in 2010.
On this point too there are no signals that people often receive reassessments because the Tax Authority does not accept corrected annual statements.
Ook op dit punt zijn er geen signalen dat mensen vaak navorderingen krijgen doordat de Belastingdienst aangepaste jaaropgaven niet accepteert.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Groot (PvdA) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vermogenstoets in de huurtoeslag voor 2012 (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt, Groot and Braakhuis asked whether households with children who exceed the wealth test on 1 January 2012 could lose all their 2012 rent allowance, and why the lowered wealth test was not announced clearly. The state secretary answered that the lowered test applies by law, that the tax authority informed beneficiaries via a press release, a website notice and intermediaries, and that this was considered sufficient outreach.

Furthermore, intermediaries (e.g. housing corporations, social counsellors and municipalities) have been informed about the abolition of the child allowance in the box 3 tax-free allowance, so they can inform their clients.

Verder zijn de intermediairs (o.a. woningbouwcorporaties, sociale raadslieden en gemeenten) geïnformeerd over de afschaffen van de kindertoeslag van het heffingsvrije vermogen in box 3, zodat zij hun klanten hierover kunnen informeren.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de brief van bureau DUDOK aan de Eerste Kamer (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about a letter from a building-law firm to the Senate on the corporate tax exemption for care housing associations, including whether the tax liability can be postponed and whether the exemption's removal conflicts with a parliamentary motion. The state secretary replies that the exemption was never legally repealed but ended by policy under a 2009 decision, that a generous transition period was observed, that re-introduction would likely be illegal state aid, and that no further postponement will be granted, though a closing-balance agreement is offered.
I therefore see no reason, nor possibility, to give these corporations another year of respite.
Ik zie daarom geen reden, noch mogelijkheid, om deze corporaties nogmaals een jaar respijt te geven.

Vragen van de leden Verhoeven (D66) en Hachchi (D66) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over lastenverhogingen voor ondernemers als gevolg van Digin

MPs Verhoeven and Hachchi asked whether the Tax Authority's switch to a new certificate supplier after the DigiNotar breach raised costs for businesses and whether SMS authentication would be scrapped. The government answered that the new KPN/Getronics certificates cost the same as the old DigiNotar price, so there is no increase in costs, and that the SMS authentication question rests on a misunderstanding.
So there is no increase in costs or administrative burden.
Er is dus geen sprake van verhoging van kosten en administratieve lasten.

Vragen van de leden Smeets, Dikkers en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken en aan de staatssecretarissen van Economie Landbouw en Innovatie, en van F

MPs asked whether multinationals such as Shell should be obliged to disclose tax payments and royalties per country and project, and whether Dutch tax policy attracting extractive firms is problematic. The government answered that transparency is supported via international initiatives (EITI, EU and OECD country-by-country reporting work), that it will not address individual companies on their payments, and that Dutch tax treaties are public.
The Netherlands favours transparency and seeks international agreements that apply to all internationally operating companies.
Nederland is voorstander van transparantie en streeft naar internationale afspraken die gelden voor alle internationaal opererende bedrijven.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over de wenselijkheid van schatkistbankieren voor decentrale overheden (ingezonden 14 okt

MPs Heijnen and Groot asked whether provinces and municipalities investing surplus funds in a troubled financial institution shows unnecessary risk-taking, and whether mandatory integral treasury banking should be reconsidered. The minister answered that decentralised governments are autonomous within the statutory framework, only one province uses integral treasury banking, and he will consult local government bodies on barriers to participation.

Under the Regulation on investments and derivatives of decentralised governments (Ruddo), provinces and municipalities are not permitted to take out loans for the sole purpose of investing the borrowed funds at a higher return.

Op basis van de Regeling uitzettingen en derivaten decentrale overheden (Ruddo) is het niet toegestaan voor provincies en gemeenten om leningen aan te gaan met het enkele doel de aangetrokken gelden tegen een hoger rendement uit te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Monasch, Plasterk en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraken van de President van de Nederlandse Bank over noodzakelijke a

PvdA MPs asked the finance and interior ministers whether they agree with the DNB president that mortgage interest deduction must be adjusted given high Dutch mortgage debt, and whether they will pursue a national housing accord and legislation. The government answered that it keeps the mortgage interest deduction, points to existing measures such as the new mortgage code limiting interest-only loans, and sees no need for a housing accord or a debate on changing the deduction.
Vragen van de leden Groot en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de website zorgtoeslag.nl (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs Groot and Heijnen asked the State Secretary of Finance whether a commercial website charging fees for applying for healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag), which they say imitates the Tax Administration, should be tackled and whether a legal framework exists. The State Secretary replied that the site transparently discloses its paid services, that a legal framework exists where misleading, and that after legal analysis the site does not imitate the Tax Administration, while the operator agreed to make its commercial nature clearer on its homepage.
Moreover, JSKS has committed to adjust the homepage of their site so that it immediately becomes clear that it is a site of a commercial service provider.
Overigens is door JSKS toegezegd, dat zij de homepage van hun site zodanig zullen aanpassen dat al direct duidelijk wordt dat het om een site van een commerciële dienstverlener gaat.
Vragen het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de opbrengst van bijzondere financiële instellingen (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MP Groot asks the state secretary of Finance about the fiscal attractiveness of the Netherlands for multinationals, the reported drop in tax revenue from foreign special financial institutions since 2007, and whether a withholding tax on interest and royalties should be introduced. The state secretary answers that location choices involve many factors, that the revenue figure of 1.5 billion euro was a 2004 estimate of value added, that DNB will publish updated figures in 2012, and that a withholding tax on interest and royalties is not in the Netherlands' interest, so no new memo will be sent.
If updated data are not known, why is that the case and when can you supply that data?
Indien geactualiseerde gegevens niet bekend zijn, waarom is dat het geval en wanneer kunt u die gegevens dan wel leveren?

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over grootschalige fraude door middel van DigiD met kinderopvang-, huu

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Interior Minister about large-scale fraud with childcare, rent and care allowances via DigiD, including whether the Tax Authority deliberately did not check DigiD use, how victims would be compensated and how fraudsters would be pursued. The government answered that about 2,500 victims were involved in recent prosecutable cases, that measures blocking third-party applications and requiring written confirmation of account changes were introduced, that victims would be compensated, and that ongoing criminal investigations prevent discussing specific cases.
Victims receive a letter from the Tax Authority stating that they are victims of fraud.
Gedupeerden krijgen van de Belastingdienst een brief waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij slachtoffers zijn van een fraude.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de kwaliteit van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor zelfstandige ondernemers (ingezonden

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about the quality of disability insurance for self-employed workers after the AFM found weak budget products. The Minister of Social Affairs said the AFM found no structural misconduct, that Finance is preparing measures on product development and advice, and that he sees no need for further action on specific products.
The Minister of Finance is currently preparing a package of measures addressing the various identified shortcomings.
De minister van Financiën bereidt op dit moment een pakket maatregelen voor die verschillende onderdelen van de geconstateerde tekortkomingen adresseren.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de recente vastgoedfraude (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

MPs Recourt and Groot asked how the FIOD and Tax Authority uncovered large-scale real estate tax fraud, whether the Public Prosecution Service was involved, and whether prosecution capacity and the natural persons behind companies are pursued. The government answered that cases were handled through a tripartite consultation with a threshold for prosecution, that 8 cases went to criminal investigation involving 17 suspects, and that 9 of them are being prosecuted.
Between the participants in the tripartite consultation there is good and close cooperation.
Tussen de deelnemers aan het tripartiete overleg is sprake van een goede en nauwe samenwerking.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de zorgtoeslag (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

An MP asks whether the care allowance (zorgtoeslag) for a surviving partner is recalculated on an annualised income the deceased never actually earned, and whether this is unreasonable. The state secretary agrees the rule can yield unreasonable outcomes, affecting about 21,000 households, and commits to abolishing the annualisation and 10% rules in the 2012 tax plan and instructing the tax authority to stop annualising in the meantime.
In anticipation of this, I will instruct the Tax and Customs Administration/Allowances to refrain from annualising income upon death in situations where there is a surviving partner.

Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen opdracht geven om het herleiden van het inkomen bij overlijden voortaan achterwege te laten in situaties waarin sprake is van een achterblijvende partner.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belemmeringen bij de aanpak van zwartspaarders (ingezonden 20 april 2011).

An MP asks whether the Supreme Court's KB-Lux ruling makes it harder for the tax authority to fine non-cooperating shadow earners, and what can be done to still penalise those who refuse to disclose information. The State Secretary replies that non-cooperation still leads to a reversed burden of proof for tax assessment, but fines require proof of intent or gross negligence, and he points to civil kort geding with penalty payments and criminal sanctions for withholding information, plus a planned review of whether withholding information should also be fineable.
I intend to intensify this approach.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanpak te intensiveren.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over misbruik van «Britse BV’s» (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

MPs Recourt and Groot asked the Minister of Security and Justice about abuse of UK limited companies (ltd's) registered in the Netherlands, including registration trends, misuse, supervision, background checks on directors, other foreign legal forms and EU coordination. The minister answered that ltd numbers fluctuate and are low relative to BVs, that the new supervision on legal persons will cover foreign entities, that EU law (Centros, Überseering, Inspire Art) bars requiring background checks or applying Dutch rules to EU companies, and that the government will alert EU partners if abuse is disproportionate.

The renewed supervision of legal persons expected to start on 1 July of this year offers the possibility to monitor all legal persons active in the Netherlands in an equal way through partly automated supervision.

Het vernieuwde toezicht op rechtspersonen dat naar verwachting op 1 juli van dit jaar van start zal gaan, biedt de mogelijkheid om alle in Nederland actieve rechtspersonen op een gelijke manier te volgen door middel van een deels geautomatiseerd toezicht.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Vermeij (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over een onbedoeld effect van de wijzigingen in de Uitvoeringsregeling loonbelasting (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

MPs Groot and Vermeij asked the State Secretary of Finance about the 2011 article 12.2a of the wage tax implementing regulation, which affected early-retirement schemes insured with insurers since 2006, and whether it was introduced unexpectedly and hurt holders of stamrecht rights. The State Secretary answered that the article is being amended retroactively to 1 January 2011 so it applies only to abusive pre-financing aimed at avoiding the higher 52% VUT levy, and that it does not affect the rights holders described.

I have therefore decided to amend article 12.2a of the URLB 2011 with retroactive effect to 1 January 2011 so that it only applies in situations where the inspector can demonstrate unusual pre-financing linked to the increase of the VUT levy rate.

Ik heb daarom besloten artikel 12.2a van de URLB 2011 met terugwerkende kracht tot en met 1 januari 2011 zodanig aan te passen dat artikel 12.2a van de URLB 2011 slechts van toepassing is in situaties waarin de inspecteur kan aantonen dat er sprake is van een ongebruikelijke voorfinanciering
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat het old boys network nog volop bestaat (ingezonden 4 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the old boys network among supervisory board members persists, citing data on longer tenures and more board seats per person. The minister replied that average tenure is within the Code's maximum, that the 60% network-based appointment share rose only slightly, that no new regulation is planned, and that the pending bill with the Irrgang amendment on capping board seats is being prepared.
I see no reason for further regulation on this point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nadere regelgeving op dit punt.
