Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over accountantsdiensten bij gemeenten (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal audit costs are known and whether municipalities are breaking the mandatory tendering rules for accountants, with possible effects on control quality. The minister said he has no overview of total audit costs per municipality, sees no reason for a study, and referred the tendering questions to earlier answers without substantive new information.
I have no insight into the total costs per municipality, and inquiries with the VNG revealed that it also has no insight into these costs.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de totale kosten per gemeente en navraag bij de VNG leerde dat deze ook geen inzicht heeft in deze kosten.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over gedwongen ontslagen bij de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Finance Minister about reports that the Tax Administration director-general warned of forced dismissals, the size and cost of any social plan, and whether an independent body such as the Court of Audit should examine if tax collection can be maintained under the budget cuts. The state secretary confirmed the cuts of about EUR 400 million structural by 2015, said no decision on implementation had yet been taken and that an independent study was not appropriate, but promised to inform parliament once clearer.
An independent study into the consequences of the budget cuts for the Tax Administration's performance is therefore not appropriate.
Een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de consequenties van de taakstellingen voor de taakuitoefening van de Belastingdienst is dan ook niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Smeets en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Financiën over de problemen tussen de belastingdienst en ZZP-ers (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MPs Smeets and Groot asked ministers about conflicts between the Tax Authority and self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including alleged witch-hunts, how many VAR certificates are refused or revoked, and whether postal deliverers hold VARs. The state secretary denied any witch-hunt, stated that no data exist on zzp'ers with problems, gave VAR statistics for 2009, and declined to provide breakdowns by sector or by postal operator.
No, there is certainly no question of a witch-hunt by the tax authorities.
Nee, van een heksenjacht van de fiscus is zeker geen sprake.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over de aangekondigde bezuinigingsmaatregelen bij de Belastingdienst in Limburg (ingezonden 23 sept

MPs Smeets and Groot asked why 162.3 fte in Limburg's tax region were declared surplus, why motions on regional employment and the allocation of cuts were not followed, and how the works council was involved. The state secretary replied that 109 fte surplus in Limburg is handled through voluntary mobility like other regions, that regional employment is not the main criterion for office location, and that the works council was informed and approved the steps.
We will inform your House once there is clarity on this.
Wij zullen uw Kamer informeren als hierover duidelijkheid is.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de tijdelijke maatregelen voor de woningmarkt (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

Labour MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether the temporary VAT cut on renovation labour costs will be passed on to consumers, and about its effectiveness, architects' exclusion, woonboten/woonwagens exclusion, funding from the EIA underspend, the NHG increase and bank lending. The state secretary answered that government cannot guarantee pass-through but obtained commitments from industry bodies, explained the scope limits under EU VAT rules, and promised an EIB evaluation in 2011.
I am not in favour of that.
Ik ben daar geen voorstander van.
Vragen van het lid Groot (PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Financiën over het overstappen van verzekeraar (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

An MP asked ministers whether insurers obstruct customers who want to switch insurer and charge high fees for it. The minister said no studies show consumers face unnecessary difficulty, pointed to industry rules and the NMa's competition oversight, and stated insurers may not block switching or charge unreasonable fees.
I am of the view that consumers may not be made impossible or unnecessarily difficult to switch to another insurer.
Ik ben van mening dat het consumenten niet onmogelijk of onnodig moeilijk gemaakt mag worden om over te stappen naar een andere verzekeraar.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Leenders waarmee ten aanzien de jacht met eenvoudigere regels met minder potentiële regeldruk hetzelfde resultaat wordt bereikt en waarmee maatschap
Amendment to the hunting law removes the game-bag plan obligation, requires hunting unit boards to include civil society organisations, and makes unit data public, reducing regulatory burden.
The cull plan, which under the bill as submitted forms part of the game management plan, and the obligation for hunters to act in accordance with the cull plan are removed.

Het afschotplan – dat volgens het wetsvoorstel zoals dat is ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer onderdeel uitmaakt van het faunabeheerplan – en de verplichting voor jagers om bij de uitoefening van de jacht overeenkomstig het afschotplan te handelen vervallen.

Amends the hunting law to limit hunter data obligations, drop the culling plan and the duty to follow the management plan, require publication of data, and add civil society to unit boards.

Dit amendement regelt dat jagers alleen gegevens hoeven te verstrekken die zij nu al op vrijwillige basis aan faunabeheereenheden verstrekken.
Amendement van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Leenders waarmee de rol van provincies wordt verduidelijkt.
Changes the wording of the provinces' duty for species protection from jointly ensuring to taking the necessary measures, clarifying it as an obligation of means rather than result.
'jointly ensure' is replaced by: ensure that the necessary measures are taken for.
wordt «tezamen zorg voor» vervangen door: zorg voor het nemen van de nodige maatregelen voor.
Motie van het lid Leenders over een visie op voedsel
Asks the government to produce a food vision, drawing on the WRR report on food policy.
requests the government to come up with a food vision and to involve the WRR report Naar een voedselbeleid in it.
verzoekt de regering, te komen met een voedselvisie en daar het WRR- rapport Naar een voedselbeleid bij te betrekken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de verhoogde kans op longontsteking nabij pluimveebedrijven

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders asked about a study finding higher pneumonia rates near poultry farms and what the government will do about it. The state secretary cited the study's statistical association, pointed to forthcoming measures and an interim wet veedichte gebieden bill, and said emissions rose after the battery-cage ban.
Work is also underway on a proposal for an interim act on densely farmed areas.
Verder wordt gewerkt aan het voorstel voor een interim-wet veedichte gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over het bericht ‘Alleen noodfonds kan schaapskuddes nog redden’

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government responds to reports that only an emergency fund can save traditional shepherd flocks, and whether it will support them. The state secretary says the financial position of shepherds is a provincial responsibility under the Natuurpact, that he is working with provinces and organisations toward a structural solution, and that an emergency fund is unnecessary if a structural solution is provided.
I am of the view that when shepherds are offered a structural solution, an emergency fund is not needed.
Ik ben van mening dat wanneer herders een structurele oplossing geboden wordt, een noodfonds niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek, Leenders en Jacobi over de onkostenvergoeding voor de plaatsing van hoogspanningsmasten

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether compensation for high-voltage pylons on farmland differs by period, whether some owners were bought out permanently for small sums, and whether TenneT could harmonise payments nationally. The minister answered that full compensation applies everywhere, that older buy-outs were legally permissible and that the current TenneT system is already applied nationally.
This principle is always and everywhere applied, regardless of the period in which the compensation was agreed.
Dit principe wordt altijd en overal toegepast, onafhankelijk van de periode waarin de schadevergoeding is afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Leenders en Kuiken over balkons in Breda, die ook zonder belasting af zouden kunnen breken

MPs asked whether balconies of 160 flats in Breda could collapse without warning, the risks to residents, and whether mandatory inspections for gallery flats should extend to balconies. The minister said the defect was a too-deep reinforcement placement, the corporation acted promptly by closing balconies, the risk was judged small, and he sees no reason to extend the inspection duty, leaving enforcement to municipalities.
I therefore see no reason at this time to extend this inspection obligation.
Ik zie daarom thans geen aanleiding om deze onderzoeksplicht uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het Q-koorts kompas en het advies van Brabantadvies

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the Q-fever compass published by Q-support and a BrabantAdvies warning that Q-fever knowledge and experience may be lost, asking whether patients get adequate support and whether the advice will be adopted. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports but deferred substantive answers to a forthcoming letter covering all Q-fever advice.
In the letter of 21 February on the committee's request for a response to the BrabantAdvies advice, we indicated that we wish to inform the House comprehensively on all Q-fever advice.

In de brief van 21 februari jl naar aanleiding van de vraag van de vaste Kamercommissie om een reactie op het advies van BrabantAdvies is aangegeven dat wij de Kamer graag in samenhang willen berichten over alle adviezen over Q-koorts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over een voorstel voor aanpassingen van de Gecombineerde opgave

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the current Gecombineerde opgave creates a negative incentive against trees and hedges on farmland, and whether it could be changed as proposed by landscape designer Heebing. The State Secretary denied any such negative incentive, explained that landscape elements are not counted as agricultural land, and said the proposed approach conflicts with EU requirements, so it cannot be realised.
The working method proposed by Mr Heebing is not in line with the European requirements and therefore cannot be realised.
De door de heer Heebing voorgestelde werkwijze is niet in overeenstemming met de Europese vereisten en kan daarom niet gerealiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over SDE+ subsidie voor de gedupeerden van de hevige hagelstormen in Zuid-Oost Nederland afgelopen zomer

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked whether the government would guarantee SDE+ subsidy availability for hail-storm victims in south-east Netherlands, and whether it would consult the province, municipalities and sector. The minister answered that SDE+ is competitive and cannot give individual developers advance certainty, pointed to increased 2017 budgets and NIA support for Noord-Brabant, and referred back to his answer on question 2 for questions 3 and 4.
The SDE+ scheme offers no possibility to give individual project developers advance certainty about project applications.
De SDE+ regeling biedt geen mogelijkheid om individuele projectontwikkelaars vooraf zekerheid te bieden over projectaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de berichten ‘O’Leary: Ryanair-vliegtickets worden gratis’ en ‘Zwijg of je vliegt eruit’

PvdA MPs asked the government about reports that Ryanair's chief executive said the airline's low fares rest on paying pilots very little, and about pay-to-fly contracts, safety risks and possible sham employment arrangements. The government answered that it opposes poor pay and unfair competition, is working at EU level on pay-to-fly and fatigue rules, joins court cases and investigates cabin crew, but cannot comment on individual taxpayers.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents the Tax Authority from making statements about individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen belet het de Belastingdienst om uitspraken te doen over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over de toenemende drukte op Schiphol en de overlast die dat oplevert voor de omgeving

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked the State Secretary about Schiphol nearing its 500,000 flight-movement cap, rising noise complaints from Bussum, low-altitude climb practices, ultrafine particles, and whether surrounding municipalities outside the Omgevingsraad Schiphol are heard. The State Secretary answered that the 50/50 rule and any new caps require agreement with the community, that complaints come from a stable number of about 24 residents per year, that noise stays well within legal limits, and that research on ultrafine particles is ongoing.
The agreed volume ceilings are not sacred, provided new agreements are made in good consultation with the surroundings.
De afgesproken volumeplafonds zijn niet heilig, mits er in goed overleg met de omgeving nieuwe afspraken worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Cegerek en Leenders naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over de toename van fijn stof in Zuidoost Brabant

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about press reports that fine particulate matter in south-east Brabant would exceed norms in 2020, asking about health effects, prevention measures and causes. The state secretary acknowledged the forecast exceedance of the daily fine-dust norm in five Brabant municipalities near livestock farms, cited RIVM estimates of about nine months of life-years lost, and described an existing package of measures and an upcoming update on poultry-sector air quality.
You will be informed about this shortly.
U wordt hier binnenkort over geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Leenders over de sluiting van de Rotterdamse vestiging van het Wellant College

MPs Vermue and Leenders asked why the Rotterdam vmbo-groen department of Wellant College must close, leaving 180 pupils to find new schools, and how this affects pupils with extra support needs and local green-sector prospects. The state secretary replied that closure is a board decision, that nearby alternatives exist, and that the school has a duty of care for pupils with support needs, while leaving substantive regional planning to local partners.
Whether or not to close a branch is a decision primarily taken by the school board.
Het al dan niet sluiten van een vestiging is een beslissing die primair door het schoolbestuur wordt genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de Q-koortsepidemie

Two PvdA MPs asked the Health Minister about the Q-fever epidemic, including the division of lead between Health and Economic Affairs, the Van Dijk commission's recommendation, delayed reporting by farms, and compensation for victims. The minister answered that Health takes the lead in practice, that Q-fever victims received a 10 million euro foundation rather than compensation as the state accepts no liability, and that a screening advice was pending.
Given that the public health interest is paramount for both ministers, the Ministry of VWS takes the lead.
Vanuit het gegeven dat het belang van de volksgezondheid voor beide bewindslieden voorop staat, heeft het Ministerie van VWS daarbij de lead.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Leenders over het bericht ‘Merwedebrug op A27 nog weken dicht voor vrachtverkeer wegens slijtage’

MPs Hoogland and Leenders asked the minister about the closure of the Merwedebrug for heavy traffic, its effects on buses, schoolchildren and hospital visitors, inspection findings, and compensation. The minister answered that detours, emergency bus timetables, repair works and a compensation procedure are in place, and that an evaluation with provinces will follow, but declined to exempt buses from the closure for safety reasons.
I have also committed to evaluating the closure process with them.
Ook heb ik toegezegd het proces van de afsluiting met hen te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Hoogland over tunnels voor dassen en otters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about badger and otter tunnels, noting that 12 of 13 otter crossing problems ordered by a 2014 court ruling for 2015-2016 remain unresolved, and who is responsible for maintenance. The government answered that the problems are complex, responsibility for most tunnels lies with provinces and municipalities, one problem is solved and others are being investigated, with some targeted for 2017-2018.
The Court set phased deadlines within which measures, such as construction or repair of ledges, fences or culverts, must be implemented.
Het Hof stelde gefaseerde termijnen vast waarbinnen voorzieningen, zoals aanleg of herstel van looprichels, rasters of duikers, getroffen dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het nieuwe Europese steunpakket aan boeren

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU's new EUR 500 million farm support package, including how Dutch funds will be spent, whether pig farmers' exit is being delayed, and whether national top-ups risk unfair competition. The State Secretary answered that about EUR 23 million goes to the Netherlands via a national envelope, to be spent on sustainability, restructuring and market stabilisation measures agreed with the dairy and pig sectors, with a pig sector action plan to be finalised later.
Once I have determined the package of measures, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra ik het maatregelenpakket heb vastgesteld, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Leenders over berichten inzake de Zuid-West 380 kV Oost-hoogspanningsverbinding

MPs Cegerek and Leenders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that alternative routes for the ZW380 Oost high-voltage line were not taken seriously, that the route document was biased, and that TenneT ignored environmental guidelines and altered routes. The minister denied these claims, saying alternatives were incorporated through an interactive process, the route document follows the guidelines, and the environmental impact report will determine the preferred alternative with an independent monitoring commission.
I do not agree with this claim. The route document substantiates, based on the policy starting points of SEV III and the EIA principles, why the distinct realistic alternatives were considered.

Ik ben het niet met deze stelling eens. In het tracédocument is op basis van de beleidsuitgangspunten van SEV III- en m.e.r.-principes onderbouwd waarom de onderscheidende realistische alternatieven in beschouwing zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Leenders over verwijsproblemen van Brabantse huisartsen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that Brabant GPs struggle to refer MRSA patients, including hospitals refusing pig farmers and patients going to Belgium, and about isolation beds for stroke patients. The minister answered that the reports rest on suspicions without concrete cases, that one incident was resolved by referral to another hospital, that no formal reports were filed with the IGZ, and that no norms exist for isolation beds, which the IGZ oversees.
I have made inquiries in the region as to whether there is a question of major problems.
Ik heb in de regio navraag gedaan of er sprake is van grote problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vogels massaal uit de natuur geroofd’

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass illegal bird trapping and trade in the Netherlands, and whether NVWA enforcement capacity and bird markets are adequately supervised. The State Secretary could not confirm the figures but acknowledged such illegal practices occur, admitted no separate statistics are kept, judged NVWA's 20 inspectors sufficient, and saw no reason to tighten supervision of bird markets beyond asking NVWA to pay more attention to them.
I do not have such figures, because the registrations of police, justice and the NVWA do not record these poaching offences separately.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers, want in de registraties van politie, justitie en de NVWA worden deze stroperijdelicten niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over alarmerende bijensterfte in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that US beekeepers lost half their bees, whether this signals risk for the Netherlands and Europe, and its consequences for food security and biodiversity. The state secretary answered that the US situation is not representative because of large-scale commercial beekeeping, that Dutch winter losses were very low, and referred back to the answer on the consequences.
The report gives no cause for concern since the situation in the United States is not representative of the Dutch or European situation.
Het bericht geeft geen aanleiding voor bezorgdheid aangezien de situatie in de Verenigde Staten niet representatief is voor de Nederlandse of Europese situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de uitvoering van het programma Stroomlijn, deelgebied 1 en 2)

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about public opposition to the Stroomlijn flood-safety vegetation-clearing programme, the balance with nature protection, the role of residents and organisations, the beaver habitat, the mid-term evaluation and the lack of compensation for felled trees. The minister answered that the programme is proportionate, consulted stakeholders, that the mid-term evaluation was completed and found the goals achievable, and that compensation is limited because most protected nature is spared.
Yes, the mid-term evaluation of the Stroomlijn programme has now been carried out.
Ja, de tussenevaluatie van het programma Stroomlijn is inmiddels uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over kaalslag in broedgebied Keteleiland

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked whether clearing a ten-metre vegetation strip on Keteleiland during the bird breeding season was lawful under the Flora and Fauna Act, why it was done then, and what alternatives existed. The minister said the Act permits work if nesting birds are not disturbed, that a survey found insufficient distance from some nests but no significant loss of breeding success, that the clearing was necessary for bank stability, navigation safety and flood risk, and that a Ministry of Economic Affairs investigation is ongoing.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, as competent authority for the Flora and Fauna Act, is currently having further investigation carried out.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, als bevoegd gezag voor de Flora en Faunawet, laat momenteel nader onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jacobi over de bescherming van broedvogels in het waddengebied

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about declining breeding bird populations in the Wadden Sea, the consistency of cross-border monitoring figures, the need for stronger trilateral cooperation, and whether current protection policy should be revised. The State Secretary answered that the figures are consistent with national monitoring, pointed to the trilateral Action Plan for breeding birds and a national offensive under the 'Naar een Rijke Waddenzee' programme, and stated that multiple parties' involvement does not hinder effective policy.
My aim is that the managers and governments involved will, each within their own responsibility, make efforts to reverse this decline in breeding success.
Mijn inzet is dat de betrokken beheerders en overheden vanuit ieders verantwoordelijkheid zich zullen inspannen om deze achteruitgang van het broedsucces te keren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over het advies van de Raad van State op het ontwerpbesluit dat het Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden wijzigt en de reactie van de regering hierop

An MP asks why the government will not, on the basis of the Council of State's advice, adopt a ban on non-professional pesticide use on paved surfaces and instead allows it for now, and whether it will extend the ban to unpaved surfaces, as the Council's advice and a motion suggest. The state secretary answers that the Council found no legal basis for a private-use ban, so immediate entry into force was excluded, and that she will inform parliament before the summer recess on options and on extending the measures to unpaved areas.
The Council of State's view is that there is no legal basis for a ban on private use on paved surfaces.
Het oordeel van de Raad van State is dat er geen wettelijke grondslag is voor een verbod op het particulier gebruik op verhardingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over de jacht op zwanen

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about EenVandaag footage of swan hunting, provincial culling permits, enforcement and compensation paid for swan damage. The state secretary answered that provinces grant and supervise the permits, no violations were recorded, police are assessing the footage, and provinces remain responsible, so no permits will be withdrawn.
Under the Flora and Fauna Act it is the responsibility of the provinces to approve wildlife management plans and grant the permits based on them.
Het is ingevolge de Flora- en faunawet de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies om faunabeheerplannen goed te keuren en daarop gebaseerde ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over het hoge aantal gevallen van longkanker in Brabant en het effect hierop van de intensieve veeteelt

Two MPs asked whether the government will act on reports of high lung cancer rates in Brabant linked to intensive livestock farming, including research, registration and a moratorium on new permits pending study. The minister replied that the ongoing VGO study does not cover lung cancer, that the GGD has started an exploratory study with results expected end of April, and that the Health Council may be asked to revise its 2012 advice, but no permit moratorium is accepted since no scientific indications of risk are known.
Following the report, the GGD in the Brabant region is immediately starting an exploratory study into the relationship between lung cancer and livestock farming.
Naar aanleiding van het genoemde bericht start de GGD in de regio Brabant per direct een verkennend onderzoek naar de relatie longkanker en veehouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over de stand van de wilde eend

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether he knew of a sharp decline in wild duck numbers, whether hunting or damage control was ongoing, and whether the hunt should be suspended until a Sovon study is published, and whether he would urge provinces to do so. The State Secretary answered that hunting is closed until 15 August, that provinces may grant exemptions only in exceptional damage cases, that he will review the Sovon results before reopening the season, and that he sees no reason to urge provinces to refrain since the decision is a provincial competence.
On the basis of that, I will consider whether these give cause to open the hunting season for the wild duck after 15 August or not.
Op basis daarvan zal ik bezien of deze aanleiding geven om na 15 augustus het jachtseizoen met betrekking tot de wilde eend al dan niet te openen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Van Dekken en Recourt over wildstroperij

MPs Leenders, Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the safety of green BOA enforcement officers fighting poaching, their training, the lack of separate registration of poaching, equipment, and police capacity. The minister answered that deployment is the responsibility of private employers and local triangles, that poaching is not a separate offence so is not registered, that equipment can be granted on justified request, and that a provincial coordination platform is being set up.
Poaching is not a separately defined criminal offence in law, so separate registration is not possible.
Wildstroperij is geen afzonderlijk in de wet opgenomen strafbaar feit, waardoor aparte registratie niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het aanbieden van jachtarrangementen in Nederland

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked whether hunting arrangements allowing foreign hunters in the Netherlands can be banned under current or new nature law, and what this would require. The state secretary replied that a legal amendment to the Wet natuurbescherming is needed, provinces currently lack such powers, and that talks with provinces and the hunters' association are ongoing.
No, introducing a ban on hunting arrangements for foreign hunters requires an amendment to the Nature Conservation Act.
Nee, voor de invoering van een verbod op jachtarrangementen voor buitenlandse jagers is een wijziging van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over nieuwe technieken om genetisch gemodificeerde organismen (ggo’s) te ontwikkelen

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about new gene-editing techniques for GMOs, including whether they fall under GMO rules, whether labelling should apply, whether they will be linked to pesticides, and when a national framework for GMO cultivation will be available. The State Secretary answered that the techniques are currently treated as genetic modification pending a European Commission legal analysis, that labelling applies until the techniques are listed in Annex IB, that the techniques are not inherently tied to herbicide use, and that a Rathenau Institute consultation report will inform a national framework.
The Rathenau Institute is preparing a report on this consultation and on that basis I will inform you further about the framework for decision-making on GM cultivation.
Het Rathenau Instituut stelt een rapport op van deze consultatie en op basis daarvan zal ik u nader informeren over het afwegingskader voor besluitvorming over gg-teelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Van Dekken en Recourt over de berichten 'Nieuwe generatie jagers op komst'  en 'Aantal stropers is verdubbeld op de Veluwe'

MPs Leenders, Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about reports of 'new hunters' and a doubling of poaching on the Veluwe, including sentencing, enforcement and national trends. The minister said poaching is not a separate offence and prosecution can yield unconditional prison terms, described enforcement cooperation with private landowners' wardens, and said poaching is not registered separately so national trends and arrest figures cannot be provided without disproportionate manual review.
In police and justice registrations, poaching offences are not recorded separately.
In de registraties van politie en justitie worden stroperijdelicten niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het aanbieden van jachtarrangementen in Nederland

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about websites advertising goose hunting in the Netherlands for foreign hunters, and how the Nature Conservation Act and related rules allow, condition and control such visits. The government answered that foreign hunters may hunt under a time-limited guest permit only when accompanied by a Dutch licence holder and with landowner or wildlife-unit permission, and it said it will consult provinces and the hunters' association on ending commercial hunting trips.
I disapprove of organising commercial hunting trips and the associations this raises. I will therefore consult with the provinces and the Royal Hunters Association about ending such practices.

Het organiseren van commerciële jachtreizen en de associaties die dit oproept keur ik af. Ik zal daarom met provincies en de Koninklijke Jagersvereniging in overleg treden over de beëindiging van dergelijke praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jacobi over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat een omstreden onkruidverdelger in wil zetten langs de IJssel

MPs Leenders and Jacobi asked how Rijkswaterstaat's planned use of the contested herbicide glyphosate along the IJssel fits with the upcoming ban on glyphosate use and whether safety grounds justify an exception even when alternatives exist. The minister answers that current rules allow glyphosate on stumps, that Rijkswaterstaat applies a stricter-than-required policy, that an exception for safety-critical cases is planned in a ministerial regulation, and that water contamination risk is negligible.
Nevertheless, Rijkswaterstaat preferably does not use crop protection products in management and maintenance.
Desalniettemin gebruikt Rijkswaterstaat bij voorkeur geen gewasbeschermingsmiddelen bij beheer en onderhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over een vergunningsaanvraag voor een megastal in Dinkelland

MPs Van Dekken and Leenders ask the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a permit application for a large pig farm in Dinkelland, including whether the municipality can block it given its own land-use vision, grandfathering and salvage rules, the PAS nitrogen scheme, and what residents, the municipality, province or national government can still do. The government answers that the municipality and province are competent for land-use and the permit was handled under PAS transitional law, that the 2013 vision could not alone bar the farm under provincial rules, and that residents retain ordinary legal remedies while no national interest warrants a directive.
The Programme for Addressing Nitrogen (PAS) has no consequences for this case because the application for the Nature Conservation Act permit was submitted before 1 July 2015.
Het Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) heeft geen gevolgen voor deze casus omdat de aanvraag voor de Natuurbeschermingswetvergunning was ingediend vóór 1 juli 2015
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Dikkers over het bericht in ‘Groene Ruimte’ dat EFSA (European Food Safety Authority) wijst op mogelijke hormoonverstorende effecten van 15 stoffen

MPs Leenders and Dikkers asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the EFSA finding of possible endocrine-disrupting effects of 15 pesticide substances should lead to a temporary ban, and whether the precautionary principle permits a national use ban pending further EFSA research. The State Secretary answered that EFSA does no new research, that a possible endocrine-disrupting classification does not automatically mean risk, that the Ctgb tests authorised products against exposure limits, and that neither the Commission nor the Ctgb sees grounds to intervene in current authorisations.

The Ctgb informs that classifying an active substance as possibly endocrine-disrupting does not immediately mean there is also a risk when the substance is incorporated into a plant protection product.

Het Ctgb laat weten dat classificatie van een werkzame stof als mogelijk hormoonverstorend niet meteen betekent dat er ook sprake is van een risico als deze stof in een gewasbeschermingsmiddel wordt verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over het bericht «Gezondheid boeren bedreigd door pesticiden»

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked about a report that farmers' health is threatened by pesticides, including the Health Council's findings on nervous-system disorders in farmers and childhood leukaemia in their children, and whether the government would speed up follow-up research. The government answered that it is taking the Health Council advice seriously, that RIVM is preparing a multi-year exposure study with results expected in 2018, and that it will report on progress in June 2016.
The cabinet takes public health very seriously and the Health Council's advice prompted the cabinet to adopt the proposals in that advice.
Het kabinet neemt de gezondheid van de bevolking zeer serieus en het advies van de Gezondheidsraad vormde voor het kabinet aanleiding om de voorstellen in het advies van Gezondheidsraad over te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over het bericht dat low cost luchtvaartmaatschappijen vertraagde passagiers die om compensatie vragen afwimpelen

An MP asked the state secretary whether low-cost airlines rarely pay compensation to delayed passengers and whether the regulator has acted, including on jurisprudence and EU rules. The state secretary said the regulator (ILT) handles complaints, sees no verified sanctions needed because airlines pay when found due, provides complaint data, and notes EU rule revision is pending.
I am sending you, as annex 2 to these answers, the overview of the handling of complaints submitted to the ILT in 2014 and 2015.
Ik stuur u als bijlage 2 bij deze antwoorden het overzicht van de afhandeling van bij de ILT ingediende klachten in 2014 en 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Henk Leenders over de 380 kV-hoogspanningslijn tussen Doetinchem en Wesel

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a letter from the Bomenstichting Achterhoek, the number of trees to be felled for the 380 kV line between Doetinchem and Wesel, alternatives considered, and compensation and landscaping. The minister replied that no letter was sent, that the foundation accepts the plans with adequate compensation, that the route was based on the most environmentally friendly alternative in the MER, and that replanting obligations are legally binding in the landscape plan.
I am aware of the reported news item. That item contained incorrect information; no letter was sent.
Ik ken het aangehaalde bericht. Dit bericht bevatte onjuiste informatie, er is geen brief verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Jacobi en Van Dekken over mogelijke schade door zoutwinning aan de flora en fauna van werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she responds to a study by environmental groups showing the Wadden Sea seabed could subside from salt extraction, harming birds' feeding and the World Heritage site, and why it conflicts with the industry consultant's findings. The State Secretary declined to give a substantive response, citing the ongoing appeal before the Council of State's administrative law division, and promised to inform the House after that ruling.
In light of this, I do not wish to give a substantive response to the mentioned research report at this time.
In dit licht wil ik nu geen inhoudelijke reactie geven op het genoemde onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over mogelijke vakantievluchten vanaf vliegveld Seppe

An MP asked the state secretary whether commercial flights could move from Eindhoven Airport to Breda International Airport and whether Breda should become a national-interest or civil airport. The government answered that Breda is a regional airport under provincial competence, lacks the infrastructure for large commercial traffic, and that any change to its airport decree would be a provincial matter with no Rijk role.
Breda International Airport (Seppe) is an airport of regional significance, for which the province of North Brabant is the competent authority.
De luchthaven Breda International Airport (Seppe) is een luchthaven van regionale betekenis, waarvoor de provincie Noord-Brabant bevoegd gezag is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Recourt en Rebel over het bericht “Ambtenaren: geen 'bolletjesvluchten' vanaf Eindhoven Airport”

PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an internal memo proposed banning flights from Curaçao and Aruba to Eindhoven Airport due to drug-mule smuggling risks, and about controls and responsibilities. The minister answered that the consultation is ongoing and he will inform parliament later on the memo and risks, while noting that Curaçao and Aruba are responsible for their own controls and that inter-ministerial coordination took place.
I cannot yet answer these questions, as consultation with all those involved is still ongoing.
Ik kan op deze vragen nog geen antwoord geven, aangezien het overleg met alle betrokkenen nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Leenders over de oproep van de Vereniging van waterbedrijven in Nederland (Vewin) om de waterkwaliteit te verbeteren

MPs Jacobi and Leenders asked the minister about a list of 62 measures to improve water quality proposed by the drinking water association Vewin, including whether the government requested it and whether it will be included in the National Water Plan. The minister welcomed the list, said it was drawn up after a meeting with drinking water companies, and promised a further discussion with Vewin and a debate in parliament before the measures are finalised in the National Water Plan.
The definitive package of measures will be included in the National Water Plan and the river basin management plans for the Water Framework Directive that form part of it.
Het definitieve pakket maatregelen zal worden opgenomen in het Nationaal Waterplan en de stroomgebiedbeheerplannen voor de Kaderrichtlijn Water die daarvan onderdeel uitmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het gebruik van een nekbreekapparaat om ganzen te doden

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked whether a neck-breaking device used in Gelderland to kill geese is permitted under Dutch and EU rules, whether it was properly tested, and whether its use should be banned. The state secretary answered that the device is not on the approved list but provinces may deviate if no unnecessary suffering is caused, that testing is the province's responsibility, that the matter is under court appeal so no judgement will be given, and that the unit has voluntarily paused its use.
How this device was assessed and/or tested is the responsibility of the province.
Op welke wijze dit apparaat is beoordeeld en/of getest, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de rechtszaak van de Nederlandse Varkenshouders Vakbond (NVV) tegen de provincie Noord-Brabant

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the NVV pig farmers' union lawsuit against the province of Noord-Brabant over its livestock sustainability score, and about related policy such as the Brabant law and the stopper scheme. The state secretary said the NVV must make its own choices, that a sustainable pig sector transition is needed, and that the Crisis- en herstelwet experiment for Brabant gives the province a firmer legal basis; several answers point to ongoing talks and a future bill.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs asked the ministers why GPs in Reusel-De Mierden warn of rising resistant-bacteria infections in livestock farmers when RIVM data do not show it, whether data submission should be made mandatory, and whether the GGD study will be shared. The minister replied that RIVM data reflect local trends adequately, that laboratory participation is good and all relevant institutions will be connected by end 2015, that a letter on antibiotic resistance will follow before summer, and that the GGD will not publish a report.
The GGD Brabant-Zuidoost has indicated that it will not publish a report.
De GGD Brabant-Zuidoost heeft aangegeven dat zij geen rapport zullen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Mei Li Vos, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de situatie bij Air France-KLM

MPs from the PvdA and VVD asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the French state's increase of its stake in Air France-KLM, its double voting rights, possible break-up or sale of KLM, governance changes and Qatar landing rights. The minister replied that the French stake increase is not a fundamental shift, no agreement exists on joint share purchases, no break-up is on the agenda, and the reports of a 'plan B' sale are unsubstantiated speculation.
I have no indication whatsoever that such a plan B is on the agenda.
Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat een dergelijk plan B aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Visser en Leenders over de berichtgeving inzake Qatar Airways

MPs Visser and Leenders asked the Staatssecretaris whether he knew of the Qatar Airways CEO's threat to block Dutch firms' contracts in Qatar over landing rights, whether the CEO contacted him, what he would do, and whether he shares EVO's concern that the landing-rights freeze harms the Netherlands as a distribution country. The Staatssecretaris answered that he was not approached, that Dutch policy does not specifically target Gulf carriers, that Qatar was informed, and that talks with EVO and a Seabury study on air cargo are ongoing, without committing to new legal changes.
I have not been approached by Mr Al Baker.
Ik ben niet benaderd door de heer Al Baker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over het bericht dat de ingrijpende gevolgen van Q-koorts onderschat worden

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the health consequences of Q-fever, including chronic patients who may be overlooked, are being underestimated, and whether doctors' training, compensation and a general fund for future zoonosis outbreaks will be pursued. The Minister of Health answered that Q-fever remains serious, that Q-support and professional training will address recognition, rejected direct state compensation while promising to review arguments from patient groups, and saw no need for a general zoonosis fund.
I will of course carefully examine whether there are indeed more or different insights that could change the position.
Ik zal uiteraard zorgvuldig bezien of er inderdaad meer of andere inzichten zijn die het standpunt kunnen wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over vertraging bij de aanleg van een centraal beveiligingssysteem op Schiphol

MPs Mei Li Vos and Leenders asked about delays in building a central security system at Schiphol, whether the 3 June deadline will be met, whether costs and complexity were underestimated, whether the Algemene Rekenkamer should audit Schiphol's tendering, and how the state's shareholder powers over state holdings could be strengthened. The minister answers that the 3 June switchover is still planned, Schiphol faces no financial problems if it slips, the state exercises shareholder oversight through informal contact and statutes, declines to ask the Rekenkamer for an audit, and says the Rekenkamer's access to subsidiaries requires a legal change for which the Council of State previously saw no need.
These concern operational matters for which Schiphol's management board and supervisory board are responsible and accountable.
Het betreft operationele aangelegenheden, waarvoor de directie en raad van commissarissen van Schiphol verantwoordelijk en aanspreekbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de “maffiahandel in puppy’s”

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mafia-style trafficking of puppies from Eastern Europe, including health risks, protection of veterinarians, possible vet complicity, and steps to stop it. The government answered by referring largely to a separate letter on puppy trade, noting rabies vaccination exemption for puppies was ended, that vets involved can face criminal or disciplinary prosecution, and that threatened vets can report to police.
Where enforcement and supervision reveal that Dutch veterinarians are involved in illegal dog trade, they can be prosecuted under criminal or disciplinary law.
Daar waar bij handhaving en toezicht blijkt dat Nederlandse dierenartsen betrokken zijn bij illegale hondenhandel kunnen zij strafrechtelijk, dan wel tuchtrechtelijk worden vervolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de verkoop van B.V. Schiphol Airport Retail

MPs Mei Li Vos and Leenders asked whether the sale of 60% of Schiphol Airport Retail B.V. was a privatisation requiring parliamentary approval, and why it was done. The government answered that Schiphol Group, not the state, sold the stake, that the sale needed no shareholder consent under the articles, and that Schiphol keeps control through the shareholder agreement and concession role.
There is no partial privatisation here because the state itself does not dispose of any shares.
Er is hier geen sprake van een deelprivatisering omdat de staat zelf geen aandelen vervreemdt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers whether they share concern from Reusel-De Mierden GPs about rising multiresistant infections and requested an overview of infection trends in Noord-Brabant. The minister replied that Brabant infection rates are not higher than elsewhere in the Netherlands, no regional data for Reusel-De Mierden is available, and an integrated antibiotic resistance approach letter will follow before summer.
Separate data for Reusel-De Mierden are currently not available to us.
Aparte gegevens voor Reusel-De Mierden zijn bij ons op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over het bericht “Run boeren op vergunning uit vrees voor PAS”

MPs asked whether a surge of nature permit applications in Gelderland and Noord-Brabant, filed before the PAS nitrogen programme takes effect, would consume PAS nitrogen space and whether these applications could be granted without the PAS. The state secretary answered that granting them does not affect PAS space, that new developments need proof of no negative effects, and that transitional rules bar pre-PAS applications from receiving PAS development space, requiring new PAS applications instead.
Granting these permits has no consequences for the space that is created with the PAS.
Het verlenen van deze vergunningen heeft geen gevolgen voor de ruimte die met de PAS gecreëerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over misbruik van EU subsidie voor de kweek van meervallen

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about alleged misuse of EU subsidies for catfish farming, including whether the EU is reclaiming funds and whether subsidies will be recovered and controls strengthened. The State Secretary largely referred to separate letters to parliament, said she did not agree the subsidy was wrong as it was a court matter, and pointed to earlier correction overviews.
I refer you for the answer to the parliamentary letter on subsidy development in aquaculture that was sent to your House at the same time.
Ik verwijs u voor de beantwoording naar de Kamerbrief inzake subsidie ontwikkeling aquacultuur die gelijktijdig aan uw Kamer is verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Ypma over het bericht dat een school in Zwolle is gesloten vanwege de vondst van asbest

MPs Leenders and Ypma asked whether a Zwolle school closed over asbest exposed pupils and staff, and how many schools have completed asbestos inventories. The state secretary answered that no one was exposed, air and adhesive samples were clean, 64% of pre-1994 school buildings are inventoried for asbestos, and referred to an earlier letter for the action on other schools.
There has been no health risk for pupils or staff.
Er is geen gezondheidsrisico geweest voor leerlingen of het personeel.

m: Amendement van de leden Bevers en Joseph over Over middelen voor het mobiel medisch team voor de regio Oost en in Limburg
Shifts funds within the health budget to station a 24/7 mobile medical team helicopter and ground team in the East and Limburg regions.
The problem can be solved by stationing a 24/7 helicopter MMT at Teuge airfield and a 24/7 ground MMT in South Limburg (Maastricht UMC).
Het probleem kan worden opgelost door de stationering van een 24/7 Helikopter-MMT op vliegveld Teuge en een 24/7 grondgebonden-MMT in Zuid-Limburg (Maastricht UMC).
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over het terugdraaien van de bezuiniging op de instellingssubsidie Ge-Bu
Shifts 762,000 euro within the health budget from long-term care to curative care to reverse the planned cut to the Ge-Bu drug bulletin subsidy for 2026.
With this amendment it is proposed to add 762,000 euro to article 2 Curative Care
Met dit amendement wordt voorgesteld € 762.000 aan artikel 2 Curatieve Zorg toe te voegen
Motie van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bevers over het subsidiebeheer bij VWS uiterlijk in 2025 structureel op orde hebben
Asks the government to ensure VWS subsidy management is structurally in order by end 2025 and to inform the House by end 2025 with testable results, given Court of Audit concerns.
requests the government to ensure VWS subsidy management is structurally in order by 2025 and to inform the House by end 2025
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat het subsidiebeheer bij VWS uiterlijk in 2025 structureel op orde is, en de Kamer daarover uiterlijk eind 2025 te informeren
Motie van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bevers over uitspreken dat de Kamer uitvoerbaarheid van wetgeving nadrukkelijker meeweegt
States that the House will give more weight to implementability of legislation by requesting implementation tests in time, including on the whole set of amendments.
states that the House will give greater weight to the implementability of legislation by requesting implementation tests in time for bills, including on the whole set of amendments
spreekt uit dat de Kamer de uitvoerbaarheid van wetgeving nadrukkelijker meeweegt door, mede op basis van de inbreng tijdens de V-100, bij wetsvoorstellen tijdig uitvoeringstoetsen aan te vragen
Motie van de leden Bevers en Van den Hil over zorgen dat er meer behandel- en begeleidingscapaciteit beschikbaar komt door de hbo-psycholoog op de beroepenlijst van het zorgprestatiemodel te plaatsen
Asks the government to make the hbo-psychologist eligible for the care performance model's professions list so more treatment capacity is available for mental health waiting lists.
requests the government to promote placing the hbo or applied psychologist on the professions list
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat de hbo- of toegepaste psycholoog op de beroepenlijst geplaatst wordt
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over extra investeren in de vijf nationale herinneringscentra
Asks the government to invest extra money in the five national remembrance centres and bring a long-term plan with the spring memorandum, given a planned cut to article 7.
requests the government to invest extra in the five national remembrance centres
verzoekt de regering extra te investeren in de vijf nationale herinneringscentra
Motie van het lid Slagt-Tichelman c.s. over ouderenhuisvesting als integraal onderdeel van de plannen voor de ouderenzorg aan de Kamer voorleggen
Asks the cabinet to present housing for older people as an integral part of its elderly care plans to the Chamber, rather than developing them separately.
requests the government to present housing integrally, as a whole, in the elaboration of the elderly care plans to the Chamber
verzoekt de regering om huisvesting integraal – als een geheel – in de uitwerking van de plannen voor ouderenzorg aan de Kamer voor te leggen
Motie van het lid Van den Hil c.s. over onderzoeken hoe kinderopvangorganisaties gestimuleerd en ondersteund kunnen worden om gebruik te maken van de Friese taal
Asks the government to investigate how childcare organisations can be encouraged and supported to use the Frisian language.
requests the government to investigate how childcare organisations can be encouraged and supported to use the Frisian language
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe kinderopvangorganisaties gestimuleerd en ondersteund kunnen worden om gebruik te maken van de Friese taal
Motie van de leden Van der Molen en Bevers over helderheid verschaffen over de toepassing van het vijfde lid van artikel 16, Boek 1 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek, over het in de rechtbank voordragen van
Asks the government to clarify by 1 February 2023 how article 16(5) of Book 1 of the Civil Code applies to swearing the oath in Frisian in court.
requests the government by 1 February 2023 to provide clarity on the correct application of article 16(5) of Book 1 of the Civil Code
verzoekt de regering voor 1 februari 2023 helderheid te verschaffen over de correcte toepassing van het vijfde lid van artikel 16 van Boek 1 van het Burgerlijk Wetboek
Motie van de leden Van der Molen en Bevers over onderzoek starten naar het onderwijs in de Friese taal in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs
Asks the government to have the inspectorate report yearly on Frisian-language education and to commission a DINGtiid study of Frisian teaching in vocational education.
Motie van de leden Bevers en Van der Molen over bij de nieuwe bestuursafspraak Friese taal en cultuur onderzoeken of de instelling van een landelijke "commissie Frysk" mogelijk is
Asks the government to examine whether a national Frisian language committee with parliamentarians, ministers and others can be set up and meet regularly.
requests the government to examine, in the new BFTK, whether a national 'commissie Frysk' can be established
verzoekt de regering bij de nieuwe BFTK te onderzoeken of de instelling van een landelijke «commissie Frysk» mogelijk is
Motie van de leden Bevers en Van der Molen over borging van het duurzaam behoud van Tresoar en de bestaande financiële bijdrage
Asks the government to ensure sustainable preservation of Tresoar and its existing financial contribution through some form of administrative cooperation.
requests the government to ensure some form of administrative cooperation securing the lasting preservation of Tresoar and its existing financial contribution
verzoekt de regering zorg te dragen voor een vorm van bestuurlijke samenwerking waarbij het duurzaam behoud van Tresoar en de bestaande financiële bijdrage daaraan worden geborgd
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over het verder uitwerken van de wettelijke zorgplicht en verantwoordelijkheid voor de Friese taal en cultuur door een commissie
Asks the government to explore, with the new administrative agreement, how a legal shared duty of care for the Frisian language and culture could be elaborated through a commission.
requests the government to examine, with the new administrative agreement, how the legal duty of care for Frisian language and culture can be further elaborated by a commission
verzoekt de regering met de nieuwe bestuursafspraak te onderzoeken hoe de wettelijke zorgplicht en verantwoordelijkheid voor de Friese taal en cultuur verder uitgewerkt kan worden door een commissie
Amendement van het lid Van der Molen c.s. over middelen voor de Friese taal
Shifts budget within the education budget article to fund Frisian language teaching in primary and secondary education, with no change to executive checks.
In article 01 Primary education the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by € 200 (x € 1,000).
In artikel 01 Primair onderwijs worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 200 (x € 1.000).
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over zich ervoor inspannen dat hospices niet door een financiële ondergrens zakken terwijl nieuwe financieringsvormen worden verkend
Asks the government to work to keep hospices from falling below a financial floor while new funding forms are explored.
requests the government to make efforts so that hospices do not fall through a financial floor while new funding forms are explored
verzoekt de regering zich ervoor in te spannen dat hospices niet door een financiële ondergrens zakken terwijl nieuwe financieringsvormen worden verkend
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over een post "ondersteunen en bevorderen vrijwilligerswerk" opnemen in toekomstige VWS-begrotingen
Asks the government to include a separate budget item for supporting and promoting volunteer work in future health ministry budgets.
requests the government to include a item 'supporting and promoting volunteer work' in the coming VWS budgets
verzoekt de regering in de komende begrotingen van het Ministerie van VWS een post «ondersteunen en bevorderen vrijwilligerswerk» op te nemen
Motie van de leden Bevers en Bikker over initiatieven stimuleren om stellen waarvan één lijdt aan dementie dicht bij elkaar te kunnen laten wonen
Asks the government to stimulate initiatives giving priority in housing allocation so couples where one has dementia can live near each other.
stimulate such initiatives in light of the Housing, Support and Care for Older People programme
dergelijke initiatieven in het licht van het programma Wonen, Ondersteuning en Zorg voor Ouderen te stimuleren
Amendement van het lid Bikker c.s. over middelen voor een impuls aan het vrijwilligerswerk
Shifts 1 million euro per year within the budget to strengthen the organisational capacity for volunteer work.
With this amendment the submitters want to use 1 million euro annually in the period 2023 to 2027
De indieners willen met dit amendement in de periode 2023 t/m 2027 jaarlijks € 1 miljoen aanwenden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘VWS floot Zorginstituut terug bij programma Uitkomstgerichte zorg’ van Zorgvisie

An MP asks the minister why the Uitkomstgerichte zorg programme stalled after responsibility was placed with the sector, whether the Zorginstituut's enforcement powers were needed, and what lessons follow. The minister acknowledges delays and draagvlak tensions, notes the Zorginstituut retains its legal instruments, and commits to more government steering, extra AZWA agreements and a review of the Zorginstituut's quality tasks.
At the same time I see that more government steering is needed to speed up comparable programmes.
Tegelijkertijd zie ik dat meer regie vanuit de overheid nodig is om vaart te maken bij vergelijkbare programma's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Zorg Spoedeisende hulp loopt vast door ouderen, maar terug naar huis is vaak ook geen optie’

MPs Tielen and Bevers (VVD) asked the Health Minister and State Secretary about news that emergency departments are clogged by elderly patients who cannot safely return home, and how this relates to the Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) targets and the planned Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg. The ministers answered that they share the concern, cite measures such as strengthened primary care, care coordination, higher short-stay tariffs, a study on returning nursing homes, and monitoring of IZA goals, but could not give quantified effects.
After the first measurement of the monitor expected at the end of spring 2025, we can inform the House about the status of the monitor's outcomes.
Na de 1-meting van de monitor die einde voorjaar 2025 is voorzien, kunnen we uw Kamer informeren over de stand van zaken op de uitkomsten van de monitor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘Voor patiënten met gedragsproblemen en verstandelijke handicap is geen geld in de opvang’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that care providers refuse new clients with the highest-intensity care profile (VG7) because tariffs are not fully cost-covering, and about waiting lists. The state secretary acknowledged the signal, pointed to NZa cost research and a 2025 tariff increase, said 302 people with VG7 profiles abstain from care for unknown reasons, and referred to a letter for measures.
The data currently cannot show why these people abstain from care and therefore receive no care.
Uit de data is op dit moment niet te halen wat de reden is dat deze mensen afzien van zorg en dus geen zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Bevers over "initiatieven met software die gesproken taal real-time omzet naar geschreven tekst”

MPs De Kort and Bevers asked why speech-to-text software such as Speaksee is not reimbursed for hearing-impaired workers, and about savings, interpreter shortages and access to aids. The minister acknowledges an omission in the Reïntegratiebesluit and intends to amend it so UWV can provide such aids in the interim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het artikel ‘Steeds meer mensen overlijden na val, vooral ouderen slachtoffer’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the rising number of deaths from falls, mainly among older people, and what is being done about fall prevention, funding, the roles of insurers and innovation. The minister answered that the government supports a national fall-prevention approach, pointed to earmarked municipal funding and insurance-based resources, and described plans for coordination across care domains and technology support.
The cabinet endorses this ambition and is strongly committed to a national fall-prevention approach and associated funding.
Het kabinet onderschrijft deze ambitie en zet stevig in op een landelijke aanpak valpreventie en bijbehorende financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over de zorg en ondersteuning van ALS-patiënten

MPs Tielen and Bevers asked about difficulties ALS patients face obtaining Wmo care, aids and home adaptations, the use of an ALS protocol by municipalities, and access to specialised client support. Minister Helder acknowledged problems, said municipalities have discretion and VWS lacks oversight of protocol use, and promised to encourage dialogue with the VNG, while defending the existing GCO target groups and noting municipalities' statutory duty to provide client support.
I have no insight into the extent to which this protocol is actually used by municipalities.
Ik heb geen zicht op de mate waarin dit protocol daadwerkelijk door gemeenten wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht ‘Weer problemen met leerlingenvervoer in Schiedam: bussen komen soms wel twee uur te laat’

MPs Minhas and Bevers asked about late school transport buses for vulnerable pupils in Schiedam and what the government would do. The minister says responsibility lies with municipalities, that she has written to the VNG asking it to hold municipalities to account, and that she urges Schiedam to act quickly.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport, however, lies with municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt echter bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht 'Abortusklinieken zien vaker jonge vrouwen die anticonceptie wantrouwen'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that abortion clinics see more young women distrusting hormonal contraception, and whether this leads to unwanted pregnancies and how risks of natural methods are communicated. The minister said the trend is unquantified, that GPs have guidelines covering natural methods, that a ZonMw study on reasons for abortion will report in 2024, and listed existing youth information and education measures.
I am not unaware that there is much talk and writing about the (alleged) side effects of hormonal contraception.
Het is mij niet ontgaan dat er veel gesproken en geschreven wordt over de (vermeende) bijwerkingen van hormonale anticonceptie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat Terschelling het havengebied met 30 centimeter ophoogt, maar dat Rijkswaterstaat niet meedoet

Two VVD MPs asked why Terschelling municipality can raise its harbour terrain by 30 cm while Rijkswaterstaat will not raise its part, and whether a joint approach is possible. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat sees no current need to raise its land, that the municipality has not yet applied for a permit, and that the parties will keep talking and combine works where useful.
Rijkswaterstaat sees no possibility or necessity for a raising at this moment.
Rijkswaterstaat ziet voor een verhoging op dit moment geen mogelijkheid en noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘Wet verhindert stoppen onterechte zorguitkering’

MP Bevers asks whether court rulings that the CIZ can no longer withdraw long-term care entitlements when people are not eligible hamper fraud enforcement, and whether the law should be changed or the CIZ given investigative powers. Minister Helder replies that the CIZ can still withdraw indications for fraud and revise them when care needs change, that a legal clarification is being examined with the CIZ without a decision yet, and that the new cooperation bill only regulates data sharing, not CIZ enforcement powers.
Because of the CRvB rulings, I am in consultation with the CIZ to carefully examine what these rulings mean for the CIZ.
Vanwege de uitspraken van de CRvB ben ik met het CIZ in overleg om zorgvuldig te bekijken wat deze uitspraken betekenen voor het CIZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat de diepte van vaargeul Boontjes nog ter discussie staat

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the depth of the Boontjes fairway is still under discussion, and whether the new Kornwerderzand lock will cause ships to run aground and raise container volumes at Harlingen. The minister rejected the link between the lock and the Boontjes depth, said no decision on maintenance has been taken yet, and declined to commit to extending the main waterway network to Harlingen, citing existing routes and the NWP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘33 gemeenten verlagen tarieven voor pgb ondanks inflatie’

MP Bevers (VVD) asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports that 33 municipalities are lowering personal budget (pgb) rates despite inflation, including whether rates fall up to 50 percent and how the reductions are justified as 'reasonable rates'. The minister replied that municipalities set pgb rates themselves within legal requirements to provide adequate rates, that she lacks national insight into individual rates and cannot give percentages, and that she is developing a handreiking (guidance) with VNG and Per Saldo to help municipalities calculate adequate rates.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to set adequate rates.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om toereikende tarieven vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim nadert hoogst gemeten niveau ooit, vooral in de zorg’

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about rising sickness absence in care, its costs, the role of employer good practice, aggression, and the Veerkracht en Zeggenschap subsidy. The minister said costs data are not held, outlined the TAZ programme and employer-focused measures, and promised an update to Parliament before the summer recess.
I do not have figures on the costs of sickness absence.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over de kosten van het ziekteverzuim.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Tielen en Bevers over het bericht ‘Middel X vaker gebruikt na onthulling werkzame stof’

MPs Tielen and Bevers asked the Minister of Health about a report that use of Middel X rose after the active substance was publicised, and about the effectiveness of the industry code on restricting private sales. The Minister answered that a causal link cannot be established, that legal bans are ineffective and risky, that talks with stakeholders continue, and that the code will be evaluated at end 2023.
The Ministry of VWS continues to talk with field partners to explore whether, and if so which, additional options exist to prevent use of these substances for suicide.
Het Ministerie van VWS blijft wel in gesprek met veldpartijen om te verkennen of en zo ja, welke aanvullende mogelijkheden er zijn om het gebruik van deze stoffen voor suïcide te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bevers en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Acht diplomafraudeurs in zorg voor de rechter, aantal meldingen verdubbeld’

MPs Bevers and Van den Hil asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about reports of diploma fraud in care, the doubling of reports to the IGJ, and how to ensure employers check diplomas and VOGs. The minister answered that care providers bear final responsibility for checks, that the IGJ and DUO are raising awareness, that fraud is prosecuted criminally, and that making DUO extracts mandatory in hiring is not desirable.
It is not possible to find out how many care diplomas have been downloaded from DUO, because that specific information is not kept.
Het is niet mogelijk om te achterhalen hoeveel zorgdiploma's er gedownload zijn bij DUO, omdat die specifieke informatie niet wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het ‘Rapport Wmo-toezicht 2021’

An MP asked the state secretary about the IGJ report showing persistently low quality of municipal Wmo oversight and the Court of Audit's warnings, including why municipalities have not improved, unreported incidents, annual reports and timelines. The secretary acknowledged the problems, announced a joint policy framework with statutory reinforcement of municipal oversight (independence, mandatory oversight policy, public reports, possible duty to follow recommendations), and promised a letter by end of Q1 2023, while declining to quantify lost funds.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Bevers over het bericht dat er onrust is in de industriehaven van Harlingen omdat er miljoenen in de sluis Kornwerderzand worden geïnvesteerd maar dat vaargeul Boontjes mogelij

MPs Koerhuis and Bevers asked about reports that the Harlingen port fears the Boontjes fairway may silt up despite large investment in the Kornwerderzand lock, and about how the Boontjes was scored in the Integrale Mobiliteitsanalyse. The minister answered that the 3.8m NAP depth will be maintained until a decision in 2023 after evaluation with Fryslân and the Omgevingsberaad Wadden, that there is no direct link to the lock, and that the Boontjes is not a main waterway so was not analysed as a capacity bottleneck.
Until that decision has been taken, the depth of NAP-3.8m will in any case be maintained.
Tot dat dit besluit genomen is, zal in ieder geval de diepte van NAP-3,8m worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over de reportage ‘Euthanasie én orgaandonatie: deze artsen maken het mogelijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a broadcast on organ donation after euthanasia, including whether hospitals refuse cooperation, how it is funded, and whether information should be promoted more. The Minister said such donation is facilitated in many hospitals, explained past refusals, noted no separate NTS tariff but no evidence funding blocks procedures, and promised a guideline update and a handreiking for home-euthanasia donation in Q1 2023.
I think it is a fine thing that people in their last phase of life consider the possibility of helping other patients.
Ik vind het een mooi gegeven dat mensen in hun laatste levensfase oog hebben voor de mogelijkheid andere patiënten te helpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Strolenberg en Bevers over het artikel: ‘Rijk trekt zich steeds verder terug uit Friesland, diensten krimpen met tientallen ambtenaren’

MPs Strolenberg and Bevers asked the Minister of the Interior how the reported shrinkage of national government jobs in Friesland fits the goal of spreading public employment evenly across provinces, and what will be done about it. The minister answered that the drop is largely administrative (Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie staff reassigned across provinces), that a motion on fairer distribution is being worked out, and that a guideline will follow later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht 'Duizenden doden na valincidenten, Financiering valpreventie ouderen blijft lastig'

An MP asks the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about financing fall prevention for older people after a news report on deaths from falls, and about progress on the related amendment, alternative financing, and timely completion of the care chain approach. The minister confirms the policy priority, lists activities funded from amendment money, notes alternative financing via the Health Impact Bond and future funding from 2023-2024, and says governance and agreements with VNG and ZN are being developed.
I intend to make agreements with the VNG and ZN in the GALA.
Ik ben voornemens om afspraken te maken met de VNG en ZN in het GALA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bevers en Minhas over het bericht “Terschelling en Vlieland vragen Rijk om compensatie voor Doeksen. ‘Onze levensader kan niet alleen voor rijken zijn weggelegd’”

MPs Bevers and Minhas asked the State Secretary about Doeksen's request to raise Wadden ferry fares by 11.1% and whether residents could be shielded or compensated. The State Secretary answered that a temporary fuel surcharge was agreed at 4.5% for island residents and 16.5% for other passengers, that compensation would be discussed only if the Rijk makes funds available, and that greening the ferries is being studied.
