I agree with you that the residents of the Wadden Islands depend on the ferry connection for transport to the mainland.
Ik ben het met u eens dat de bewoners van de Waddeneilanden voor het vervoer naar het vasteland afhankelijk zijn van de veerverbinding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Bevers over het bericht 'Bereikbaarheid Ameland op het spel: boot te vaak te laat'

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that the Ameland ferry is often late, threatening reliability and accessibility before the storm season. The ministers answered that Rijkswaterstaat is studying long-term solutions for the period after 2030, with a decision expected in 2023, while acknowledging ferry delays caused largely by silting of the shipping channel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over Wervingscampagnes ten behoeve van donoren via social media

An MP asks the Health Minister whether sperm bank marketing on social media, advertising donor fees up to 560 euro per month, conflicts with Dutch rules allowing only cost reimbursement, and whether the Inspectorate can act. The Minister replies that no signs exist that the European Sperm Bank breaches Dutch law, that the 40 euro per donation fee is in line with the national standard, and that no grounds for IGJ action currently exist.
For now there are no indications that the ESB does not comply with Dutch laws and regulations, so there is currently no reason for the IGJ to intervene.
Vooralsnog zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de ESB zich niet houdt aan de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, zodat voor optreden door de IGJ op dit moment geen aanleiding bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bevers over het bericht 'Fraude met valse diploma’s in zorg neemt toe: cashen over de rug van kwetsbare patiënten'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the inspectorate has enough tools and capacity to combat fraud with fake care diplomas, what consequences and patient-safety effects have occurred, and what is being done about malicious staffing agencies, online sellers and the upcoming integrity law. The minister answered that the inspectorate's powers are limited for sole traders and agencies outside its supervision, that criminal enforcement depends on reports, and that a DUO diploma extract will be required in hiring, while the integrity bill does not cover this fraud.
The intervention options for the IGJ are limited in these cases.
De interventie-mogelijkheden voor de IGJ zijn in deze gevallen beperkt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over natuurlijke personen die zijn opgenomen in het curatele- en bewindsregister maar desondanks zonder toestemming van de bewindvoerder een bedrijf kunnen starten bij de Kamer van K

An MP asked the ministers whether it is undesirable that persons under guardianship or administration can start a business at the Chamber of Commerce without the administrator's approval, and whether the KvK should check the central register before registration. The minister agreed it is undesirable, and said the KvK and ministries will explore a systematic check by autumn, without committing to a concrete change.
It is not desirable that natural persons under guardianship or administration can carry out such acts without the required approval of their guardian or administrator.
Het is niet wenselijk dat natuurlijke personen die onder curatele of bewind staan dergelijke handelingen kunnen verrichten zonder de (vereiste) goedkeuring van hun curator of bewindvoerder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Bevers over het bericht 'Fryslân wil geen extra stikstofgevoelig Natura 2000-gebied'

MPs Van Campen and Bevers (VVD) asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about reports that Fryslân opposes additional nitrogen-sensitive Natura 2000 areas through the Wijzigingsbesluit Habitatrichtlijngebieden. The Minister answered that the amendment will be adopted after the recess, that the underlying data date from 2017, that no new nitrogen-sensitive areas are added, and that legal consequences for permit holders are still being investigated.
The draft amendment decision was developed in good consultation with the lead parties of the areas.
Het ontwerpwijzigingsbesluit is in goed overleg met de voortouwnemers van de gebieden tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht 'Erasmus Universiteit stopt met onderwijs voor ouderen: 'Schandalig, nalatig, waardeloos!''

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Erasmus University ending its HOVO senior education courses and related questions on lifelong learning, participation numbers, STAP eligibility and exclusion of older generations. The Minister answered that the courses ran at a loss, that HOVO is not publicly funded so must be cost-covering, that HOVO can be listed in STAP under certain conditions, and that the Erasmus Academy denies the framing of the journalist's quote.
HOVO does not fall under the statutory tasks of institutions and is not funded by the government.
HOVO valt niet onder de wettelijke taak van instellingen en wordt niet door de overheid bekostigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over “kleinschalig historisch medegebruik op Ameland”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about restrictions on small-scale historical use (recreational stake-net fishing, bait and shellfish gathering) on Ameland and other Wadden islands, including the 2016 Natura 2000 management plan exception. The minister answered that recreational stake-net fishing remains permitted under existing rules with prior municipal notification, that EU rules banning retention of bycaught sea bass cannot be exempted nationally, and that the Natura 2000 plan's wording still applies.
As regards the Natura 2000 management plan, no further restrictions have come into effect.
Wat betreft het Natura 2000-beheerplan zijn er niet meer beperkingen gaan gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bevers over berichten omtrent de ineffectieve besteding van coronagerelateerde opleidingssubsidies

MPs Van den Hil and Bevers asked why COVID-era retraining subsidies were allocated first-come-first-served or by lottery rather than by assessed need, why shortage sectors like care had limited access, and how future subsidies such as STAP will reach those most in need. Minister Van Gennip explained the crisis-speed rationale for the allocation method, argued the broad regulation was open to shortage sectors, reported that most completed short courses were at lower vocational levels, and pointed to the STAP budget, evaluation and broader labour-market measures.
No substantive assessment of the applications was chosen at the time, because experience shows this takes a lot of time.
Voor een inhoudelijke beoordeling van de aanvragen is destijds niet gekozen, omdat de ervaring leert dat dit veel tijd kost.

m: Amendement van het lid Flach c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over het doorschuiven van middelen voor de woningbouwimpuls
Amendment increasing the housing budget by 57 million euro so unspent Woningbouwimpuls funds remain available for housing construction in 2026.
This amendment ensures that the 57 million euro that threatens to lapse remains available for the WBI in 2026.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat de 57 miljoen euro die vrij dreigt te vallen, beschikbaar blijft te houden voor de WBI in 2026.
Amendement van de leden Flach en Grinwis over een nultarief voor het opnemen en storten van geld voor particulieren, kerkgenootschappen en stichtingen met ANBI-status
Amendment giving private account holders, churches and ANBI foundations a zero fee for withdrawing and depositing euro banknotes, set in the law itself rather than in lower regulation.
Notwithstanding the first paragraph, a bank shall not charge fees for withdrawing euro banknotes
In afwijking van het eerste lid brengt een bank geen kosten in rekening voor het opnemen van eurobankbiljetten
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Grinwis en Oosterhuis ter vervanging van nr. 53 over het verlengen van de bijtellingskorting voor elektrische auto's van de zaak
Amends the car benefit-in-kind rules so the electric car discount is phased in gradually, with changes to the youngtimer scheme as funding.
This amendment prevents electric cars from being de facto taxed more heavily in one go in 2026 in the benefit-in-kind
Dit amendement voorkomt dat elektrische auto’s (EV’s) in één klap de facto zwaarder worden belast in 2026 in de bijtelling
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies betreffende invoering van een pseudo-eindheffing voor fossiele leaseauto's
Asks the government to carry out an SME test and a regulatory burden advisory (ATR) opinion on the pseudo-excise tax for fossil lease cars, and to monitor and report to the Chamber regularly.
requests the government to still carry out an SME test and an ATR advice for this measure
verzoekt de regering alsnog een mkb-toets en een ATR-advies plaats te laten vinden bij deze maatregel
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over binnen de verdere implementatie van de Wmebv hoge prioriteit geven aan de digitale bezwaarfase
Asks the government to give high priority to enabling full digital objection procedures within the Wmebv implementation, and to report on progress in the Voorjaarsnota.
requests the government to give high priority to the digital objection phase within the further implementation of the Wmebv
verzoekt de regering om binnen de verdere implementatie van de Wmebv hoge prioriteit te geven aan de digitale bezwaarfase
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over een voorstel voor het inpassen van de structurele indexering van de schijfgrens binnen het budget van de Wbso
Asks the cabinet to propose, in the Belastingplan 2027, how the Wbso schijfgrens can be indexed every year within the existing Wbso budget.
requests the government to jointly from the ministries of EZK and Finance make a proposal in the Belastingplan 2027
verzoekt de regering om gezamenlijk vanuit de ministeries van EZK en Financiën bij het Belastingplan 2027 een voorstel te doen
Amendement van de leden Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over eenmalige indexatie van de schijfgrens van de WBSO
Proposes a one-off indexation of the WBSO wage-tax bracket limit for 2026, funded from a surplus, with a request to structure indexation in later budgets.
to index the bracket limit once in 2026 with the table correction factor of 2.9%.
om de schijfgrens in 2026 eenmalig te indexeren met de tabelcorrectiefactor van 2,9%
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over de Wet stroomlijning fiscaal inzagerecht verder uitwerken met de mogelijkheid tot aanvullende inzage in het fiscaal dossier
Asks the government to add a possibility for supplementary inspection of the tax file in the fiscal inspection law, with safeguards, to protect taxpayers' legal protection.
in the context of legal protection, taxpayers must retain the possibility to request supplementary inspection
in het kader van rechtsbescherming, belastingplichtigen de mogelijkheid moeten behouden aanvullende inzage te kunnen verzoeken
Motie van het lid Van Eijk  c.s. over een oplossing uitwerken voor de verzilveringsproblemen in de Wbso
Asks the government to work out a solution for Wbso innovation tax relief redemption problems for start-ups, such as a carry-forward option, and inform the Chamber.
requests the government to work out a solution for the redemption problems in the Wbso
verzoekt de regering een oplossing uit te werken voor de verzilveringsproblemen in de Wbso
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een nationale handling fee voor pakketjes van buiten de Europese Unie
Asks the government to introduce a national handling fee on low-value parcels from outside the EU together with neighbouring countries, while considering business concerns about feasibility.
requests the government to introduce, together with the relevant neighbouring countries, a national handling fee for parcels from outside the European Union
verzoekt de regering om tegelijk met de relevante buurlanden een nationale handling fee te introduceren voor pakketjes van buiten de Europese Unie
Motie van de leden Van Eijk  en Grinwis over het inzagerecht conform de Wet stroomlijning fiscaal inzagerecht in werking laten treden
Motion asking the government to bring the tax right of inspection into force as legislated and to report to the Chamber at least yearly on progress toward a workable system.
requests the government to bring the right of inspection into force in accordance with the law
verzoekt de regering het inzagerecht conform de wet in werking te laten treden
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over een onderzoek naar de bijdrage van de fiscaliteit aan meer reparatie van huishoudelijke apparaten en andere productgroepen
Asks the government to examine how taxation could encourage repair of household appliances and other products and report to the House before summer 2026.
to examine how taxation could effectively and feasibly contribute to more repair of household appliances
te onderzoeken op welke wijze de fiscaliteit effectief en goed uitvoerbaar zou kunnen bijdragen aan meer reparatie van huishoudelijke apparaten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het terugdraaien van de verhoging van de arbeidskorting en het schrappen van de verhoging van het tarief in de eerste schijf
Changes tax rates and labour tax credit amounts with later reductions in tax brackets and credits, a budget measure without bearing on executive checks.
In article I, part A, under 2, subpart a, '0.07 percentage point' is replaced by '0.12 percentage point'.
In artikel I, onderdeel A, onder 2, subonderdeel a, wordt «0,07%-punt» vervangen door «0,12%-punt».
Motie van het lid Stultiens c.s. over de budgettaire opgave bij de aanstaande voorjaarsbesluitvorming zo veel mogelijk invullen met alternatieve maatregelen

Asks the government to fill the budget shortfall in the spring decision-making with alternative measures, prioritising levies on fossil and linear consumption, and to give waste incinerators access to investment support.
requests the government to fill the budgetary task at the upcoming spring budget decision as far as possible with alternative measures
verzoekt de regering de budgettaire opgave bij de aanstaande voorjaarsbesluitvorming zo veel mogelijk in te vullen met alternatieve maatregelen
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over fiscale knelpunten in de samenwerking tussen melkveehouders en akkerbouwers wegnemen
Motion asks the government to remove tax obstacles to cooperation between dairy and arable farmers and to inform the House before summer 2026.
requests the government to remove tax bottlenecks in cooperation between dairy farmers and arable farmers
verzoekt de regering fiscale knelpunten in de samenwerking tussen melkveehouders en akkerbouwers weg te nemen
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Oosterhuis over het verlengen van de bijtellingskorting voor elektrische auto's van de zaak
Phases in the company car addition rate for electric cars more gradually from 2026 and extends the 15-year period for the reduced rate, funded by tightening the youngtimer scheme.
This amendment prevents electric cars (EVs) from being de facto taxed more heavily in one go in 2026 in the company car addition than petrol cars.
Dit amendement voorkomt dat elektrische auto’s (EV’s) in één klap de facto zwaarder worden belast in 2026 in de bijtelling dan benzineauto’s.
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Oosterhuis over het niet doorvoeren van  technische wijzigingen die zien op het afschaffen van de korting op de bijtelling
Reverses technical tax-bill changes so that the electric car benefit rate rises gradually (18% in 2026, 20% in 2027, 22% from 2028) and funds this by tightening the youngtimer scheme.
This amendment prevents electric cars from being effectively taxed more heavily in one go in 2026 in the benefit in kind than petrol cars.
Dit amendement voorkomt dat elektrische auto’s (EV’s) in één klap de facto zwaarder worden belast in 2026 in de bijtelling dan benzineauto’s.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 42 over het terugdraaien van de voorgestelde lastenverzwaringen in box 3
Reverses the proposed box 3 tax increases (forfait and lower tax-free allowance) and funds this by accelerating the phase-out of the Wet Hillen mortgage deduction.
This amendment provides that the cabinet's proposed increase of the box 3 forfait for other assets by 1.78% and the reduction of the box 3 tax-free allowance will not proceed.
Dit amendement regelt dat de door het kabinet voorgestelde verhoging van het forfait voor overige bezittingen in box 3 met 1,78%, en de verlaging van het heffingvrije vermogen in box 3 niet doorgaat.
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over het terugdraaien van de voorgestelde lastenverzwaringen in box 3
Reverses the cabinet's box 3 tax increases (higher forfait for other assets and lower tax-free allowance) and offsets the cost by speeding up the Wet Hillen phase-out.
This amendment provides that the cabinet's proposed increase of the box 3 forfait for other assets by 1.78%, and the reduction of the box 3 tax-free allowance, do not proceed.
Dit amendement regelt dat de door het kabinet voorgestelde verhoging van het forfait voor overige bezittingen in box 3 met 1,78%, en de verlaging van het heffingvrije vermogen in box 3 niet doorgaat.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis over het niet aanwenden van CBAM-inkomsten voor korting op de brandstofaccijns
Raises fuel excise rates so that CBAM revenues are not used for the 2026 fuel excise discount and instead support public transport.
With this amendment the fuel excise discount is therefore reduced by 448 million euros in 2026.
Met dit amendement wordt de brandstofaccijnskorting derhalve met 448 miljoen euro verlaagd in 2026.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis over middelen ten behoeve van het openbaar vervoer
Redirects CBAM revenues for 2026 and 2027 from a fuel excise cut to public transport funding in the transport budget to avoid service cuts and fare rises.
are used to prevent cuts in public transport in 2026 and 2027
worden aangewend om bezuinigingen op het openbaar vervoer in 2026 en 2027 te voorkomen
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Ceder over het lagere vliegbelastingtarief voor Suriname
Adds Suriname to the list of destinations eligible for the lower aviation tax rate in the environmental taxes bill.
This amendment aims to include Suriname on the list of countries for which the lower aviation tax rate applies.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe Suriname op te nemen op de lijst landen waarvoor het lagere vliegbelastingtarief geldt.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over bij onverhoopt toekomstige inhoudingen op de prijsbijstelling nadrukkelijk wegen of de begrotingsfondsen hiervan dienen te worden uitgezonderd
Asks the government, if future deductions from price indexation occur, to consider excluding the budget funds of the Mobility and Delta funds.
requests the government, in case of future deductions on price adjustment, to explicitly consider whether the budget funds should be excluded
verzoekt de regering bij onverhoopt toekomstige inhoudingen op de prijsbijstelling nadrukkelijk te wegen of de begrotingsfondsen hiervan dienen te worden uitgezonderd

Motie van het lid Vijlbrief c.s. over prioriteit geven aan het uitwerken van een aantal punten zodat een volgend kabinet vanaf de start in staat is snel en zorgvuldig de juiste investeringsbeslissinge

Motion asks government to prioritise preparing a list of necessary investments, a clearer split between consumption and investment spending, and design of a national investment bank for the next cabinet.
requests the government to give priority to elaborating the following points
verzoekt de regering om prioriteit te geven aan het uitwerken van de volgende punten
Motie van de leden Vijlbrief en Grinwis over de bezuinigingen op wetenschap en innovatie voor 2026 schrappen door het minder verlagen van het eigen risico
Motion asks the government to scrap the 2026 science and innovation cuts and to find funding by reducing the planned cut to the health insurance deductible.
requests the government to scrap the cuts to science and innovation for 2026 and to look for funding by lowering the deductible reduction less
verzoekt de regering om bezuinigingen op wetenschap en innovatie voor 2026 te schrappen en voor dekking te kijken naar het minder verlagen van het eigen risico
Motie van het lid Vijlbrief c.s. over onderzoeken hoe een wettelijk kader voor de prijsontwikkeling ingesteld kan worden voor vervolgonderwijs
Asks the government to investigate a statutory framework for price indexation in higher vocational and academic education.
requests the government to investigate how a statutory framework for price development can be set up for higher education
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe er een wettelijk kader voor de prijsontwikkeling ingesteld kan worden voor vervolgonderwijs
Motie van het lid Vijlbrief c.s. over de kostendelersnorm in de participatiewet afschaffen en dit betalen door vermogenden meer te laten betalen voor hun zorg
Asks the government to abolish the kostendelersnorm in the Participatiewet and finance this by making wealthy people pay more for care.
requests the government to abolish the cost-sharing norm in the Participation Act
verzoekt de regering om de kostendelersnorm in de Participatiewet af te schaffen
Amendement van het lid Grinwis over het terugdraaien van de verhoging van de arbeidskorting en het schrappen van de verhoging van het tarief in de eerste schijf
Reverses the increase in the labour tax credit and removes the first-bracket income tax rate increase.

Amendement van het lid Grinwis over een voorhangprocedure bij de nadeelcompensatie

Requires that a general administrative order on coal-ban compensation may only be submitted to the chamber after four weeks following submission of the draft to both houses, giving Parliament a pre-review period.
The submission of a general administrative order to be adopted under the fifth paragraph is not made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het vijfde lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder en Grinwis over de oproep voor effectievere ondersteuning van mensen met hoge energiekosten via het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

MPs Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder and Grinwis asked about the G4 call to support high-energy-cost households via the Temporary Emergency Energy Fund (TNE) and whether a publicprivate route can be revived this winter. The State Secretary answers that private co-financing fell short, so the route is not responsible; instead €30 million goes via the Municipal Fund to existing local services, with no direct income support, citing legal and state-aid risks.
It has been established that it is not feasible to realise a public-private construction this coming winter.
Er is geconstateerd dat het niet haalbaar is om aankomende winter een publiek-private constructie te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Grinwis over het artikel 'Doek valt voor Winst Uit je Woning, dat gemeenten helpt met isolatie van woningen'

MPs Welzijn and Grinwis asked the Minister of Housing about the bankruptcy of Winst Uit Je Woning, an intermediary used by municipalities for insulation under the national insulation programme, and its effects on delays, costs, monitoring and contract lessons. The Minister said the matter is mainly between municipalities and the firm, noted a doorstart, offered regional support funds, and largely declined to change municipal freedom, giving partial answers on costs, monitoring and energy poverty.
This is mainly a matter between the municipalities concerned as clients and Winst uit je Woning.
Dit is voornamelijk een zaak tussen de betreffende gemeenten als opdrachtgever en Winst uit je Woning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Podt, Bromet, Eerdmans, Grinwis, Beckerman, Graus en Dassen over ‘het door de Kamer geëiste verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij, dat de minister nog altijd niet hee

MPs from eight parties asked the minister why the ban on electric shock equipment in livestock farming, which parliament demanded, is still unsigned and may not take effect on 1 January 2026. The minister replied that the final decision steps are ready, that an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period may allow 1 January 2026, and that the aim remains entry into force on that date.
Within the cabinet policy on fixed change moments, I see room to use an exception to the standard two-month entry-into-force period, so that entry into force on 1 January 2026 remains possible.

Binnen het kabinetsbeleid over de vaste verandermomenten zie ik ruimte om gebruik te maken van een uitzonderingsgrond op de vaste invoeringstermijn van twee maanden, waardoor inwerkingtreding op 1 januari 2026 een mogelijkheid blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de toekenning van de extra middelen voor het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

An MP asked how the €50 million amendment for the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie would be implemented, how many of the 227,000 applications could now be honoured, what budget remains, and whether the amendment would be carried out in 2025 respecting parliament's budget right. The government replied that adding public money to the private-public fund is legally and financially risky, so it is exploring whether the €50 million can go to a planned public energy fund under the Social Climate Fund instead, and that nearly all of the €56.3 million has been paid out.
It is being explored whether the €50 million can be added to the available funds for the planned public energy fund supporting households with their energy bills.
Er wordt verkend of de € 50 miljoen kan worden toegevoegd aan de beschikbare middelen voor het te ontwikkelen publieke energiefonds voor de ondersteuning van huishoudens op de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Netversterking midden-Nederland jaren vertraagd'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Ministers of Climate and Green Growth and of Housing and Spatial Planning about the reported multi-year delay of grid reinforcement in central Netherlands, its effects on households and businesses, site selection, land acquisition, municipal planning and the grid check in spatial policy. The minister answers that the delay is disappointing, that several questions depend on forthcoming grid forecasts and studies, and that the government will take concrete steps such as a planned Nota Ruimte, an exploration of proactive spatial steering, and letters to Parliament on progress.
The cabinet is doing its utmost, together with all parties involved with TenneT and the province of Utrecht in the lead, to seize every opportunity to accelerate the realisation of this project.

Het kabinet spant zich tot het uiterste in om, samen met alle betrokken betrokken partijen, TenneT en de provincie Utrecht voorop, iedere mogelijkheid om de realisatie van dit project te versnellen aan te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Vijlbrief over het amendement Mooiman op de Wet versterking regie op de Volkshuisvesting

Two MPs (Grinwis and Vijlbrief) asked the minister to assess the consequences and feasibility of the adopted Mooiman amendment fully excluding urgent housing priority for status holders, to explain how it differs from her own bill, and to answer before the votes. The answer is that the questions were answered in a separate letter on the feasibility of adopted amendments, referred to by document number.

The written questions from MPs Grinwis and Vijlbrief on the Mooiman amendment to the Housing Market Steering Act (submitted 2 July 2025) have been answered in a letter on the feasibility of adopted amendments.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Grinwis en Vijlbrief over het amendement Mooiman op de Wet versterking regie op de Volkshuisvesting (ingezonden 2 juli 2025) zijn beantwoord middels een brief over Uitvoerbaarheid aangenomen amendementen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Grinwis over de invulling van de klimaatmaatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

MPs Flach and Grinwis asked the government about the impact of ETS-2 and the green gas blending obligation on greenhouse growers, whether the sector agreed to an opt-in, why an exemption for glasshouse horticulture is not feasible, and how compensation and the CO2 levy will be set. The minister answered that an opt-in with full cost compensation is unavoidable for enforceability reasons, that the blending obligation is reduced and delayed, that a new tariff study is pending, and that a compensation scheme and SDE++ adjustments are still being worked out.

The cabinet remains in discussion with the covenant partners, trusting that the sector's concerns about reasonable and timely compensation can be resolved on the basis of the compensation scheme being worked out.

Het kabinet blijft hierover in gesprek met de convenantspartijen in het vertrouwen dat de zorgen vanuit de sector over de redelijke en tijdige compensatie weg te nemen zijn op basis van de uitgewerkte compensatieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens, Dijk, Grinwis en Kouwenhoven over het belastinglek bij Duitse beleggingsfondsen

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a tax leak involving German real estate investment funds, including whether the state can still tax past gains and whether a step-up valuation loophole can be repaired. The State Secretary answered each of the 16 questions, stating that taxing past gains with retroactive effect is not justified and that the loophole will not be repaired.
In this case I currently see insufficient justification for measures to bring untaxed value increases from years before 2025 into the corporate tax base after all, that is, with retroactive effect.

Ik zie in het onderhavige geval vooralsnog onvoldoende rechtvaardiging om maatregelen te nemen die onbelaste waardestijgingen die zien op jaren vóór 2025 alsnog (dat wil zeggen met terugwerkende kracht) in de heffing van vennootschapsbelasting te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Grinwis en Flach over de voortgang van het besluitvormingstraject rondom de natuurcompensatie Voordelta

MPs Vedder, Grinwis and Flach asked the State Secretary about the progress of the alternative nature compensation process for the Voordelta, including conditions for a proposal, EC approval, compensation funds, and impacts on the sand eel fishery. The State Secretary answered that stakeholders are working toward a broadly supported proposal, that the European Commission will test it against the 2003 compensation plan, that some correspondence with Brussels is confidential, and that about 27 million euro is available for flanking measures, though no impact estimate is yet possible.
Communication with member states from the institutions of the European Union is confidential.
Communicatie met lidstaten vanuit de instellingen van de Europese Unie is vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op de leden Postma en Grinwis over het meerekenen van autonome vlootvernieuwing in de balanced approach-procedure

MPs Postma and Grinwis asked whether autonomous fleet renewal was counted in the reference situation and the noise target of the balanced approach procedure at Schiphol, and whether it was double-counted. The minister confirmed autonomous developments up to November 2024 are in the reference situation, said the 15% first-phase target sits on top of them, and announced a policy change for the remaining 5% so autonomous developments can contribute to it.
In the letter of 7 May to the House, the cabinet announced a policy change for the remaining percentage, so that autonomous developments can contribute to achieving the remainder of the noise target.

1 aan de Kamer heeft het kabinet voor het resterende percentage een beleidswijziging aangekondigd, waardoor de autonome ontwikkelingen wel kunnen bijdragen aan het behalen van het restant van het geluidsdoel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over stikstofdifferentiatie ten behoeve van suikerbieten, tarwe, gerst of aardappelen op kleigrond

An MP asked whether farmers on clay soil whose 2024 wet-weather yield losses push their three-year average below the threshold could be exempted from nitrogen differentiation, and whether the conditions could be loosened. The minister refused to disregard 2024 or use a three-year average, arguing the conditions protect water quality, and said she does not intend to loosen them.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daar ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Vijlbrief en Grinwis over de stijgende kosten voor huiseigenaren en bedrijven als gevolg van het ravijnjaar voor gemeenten

MPs asked the government about rising property tax (ozb) for homeowners and businesses caused by municipal deficits, and about whether this is reflected in purchasing-power, inflation and poverty forecasts. The minister answered that the government is in talks with local authorities, that ozb is excluded from forecasts with only small effects, and that setting local taxes is a matter for municipal councils.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, the level of services and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over het bericht 'Zonnestroom is in 2027 geen cent meer waard, dus paneelbezitters zijn de dupe'

MPs Erkens and Grinwis asked the minister about reports that feed-in compensation for solar power will fall sharply from 2027 and whether Greenchoice's terms comply with the legal 50% floor and fairness rules. The minister answered that Greenchoice meets the 50% minimum, that fairness and cost questions are for the ACM regulator to examine, and that the ACM is reviewing feed-in costs and will get extra tools from 2027.
The ACM already supervises this and can enforce where necessary.
De ACM houdt hier nu al toezicht op en kan daar zo nodig op handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht ‘‘Den Haag laat kinderen op straat slapen’, woede over beperken opvang van dakloze gezinnen’

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about The Hague's decision to restrict shelter for non-entitled homeless families, and whether it conflicts with children's rights and national homelessness ambitions. The State Secretary replied that municipalities are responsible for solutions, that the ambition of no children on the street is essential, and that the government is mapping homeless families and discussing regional housing measures.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to arrive at appropriate solutions for (threatened) homeless persons, including cases involving minor children.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te komen tot passende oplossingen voor (dreigend) dakloze personen, inclusief gevallen waar dat minderjarige kinderen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de beperkte investeringscapaciteit van woningcorporaties in Waddinxveen en Midden-Holland

An MP asked the minister about housing corporations in Waddinxveen and Midden-Holland lacking investment capacity to build social rental homes despite many available sites, and about adjusting project support, a collective instrument, to help. The minister acknowledged the regional shortfall, pointed to inter-corporation solidarity, planned changes to project support and a legislative proposal, but declined to commit to using collective project support in this case now.
I still stand by the principle that collective project support can be deployed if, after all efforts in the region, it proves additionally necessary.
Ik sta nog steeds achter het uitgangspunt dat collectieve projectsteun ingezet kan worden als dit na alle inspanningen van de regio aanvullend noodzakelijk blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Vandaag gestolen, morgen in Polen: ‘De hele polder wordt leeggeroofd'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked the ministers of Justice and Agriculture about a news report on mass theft of farm machinery in rural areas, asking about its scale, registration, cross-border organised crime, funding for rural trust persons and ANPR cameras. The minister answered that theft shows no rising trend in police figures, outlined existing prevention and cross-border cooperation measures, and said budget for trust persons is secured through brancheorganisaties while police capacity is under strain.
The police have no insight into the amounts of the stolen vehicles.
De politie heeft geen inzicht in de bedragen van de gestolen voertuigen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Grinwis over de scheve positie van de onvrijwillige schuldeiser ten opzichte van de vrijwillige schuldeiser naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘Insolventierecht is failliet bij

MPs Van Nispen and Grinwis asked whether the bankruptcy creditor ranking, which does not distinguish involuntary from voluntary creditors, unfairly leaves victims of environmental damage unpaid, and whether the Secretary of State will study reordering creditor priority. The Secretary of State disagrees with the article's conclusions, explains the existing ranking and the security-right rationale, notes the Omgevingsbesluit financial-security requirement for major risk firms, and declines to change the system after WODC research found too many drawbacks.
I am not convinced that reversing the order so that involuntary creditors take over the separatist position of security holders would ultimately lead to a better system.
Ik heb niet de overtuiging dat het omdraaien van de volgorde waarin «onvrijwillige» schuldeisers de separatistenpositie overnemen van zekerheidsgerechtigden uiteindelijk leidt tot een beter systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Grinwis over het bericht 'Steeds meer miljonairs verhuizen naar belastingparadijzen'

Two MPs (Dassen and Grinwis) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that wealthy people are moving to tax havens, and whether this undermines support for the tax system and warrants a trailing tax. The State Secretary answered that such fiscally motivated moves are undesirable, that research on emigration figures and the evaluation of residence determinations is ongoing with results promised for spring, and that Dutch efforts continue at OECD and EU level without committing to a national trailing tax yet.
A next step I want to take is to investigate whether reliable figures can be provided on how many people, and with what fiscal interest, emigrate to a country with no or low taxation.

Een volgende stap die ik daarom wil zetten, is onderzoeken of er betrouwbare cijfers zijn te geven over hoeveel personen en met welk fiscaal belang emigreren naar een land met geen of een lage belastingheffing.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Grinwis over de gevolgen van de aangekondigde grenscontroles voor het vrachtverkeer

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister how border checks with Germany and Belgium affect freight traffic, including waiting times, costs, parking capacity and fatal accidents linked to queues. The minister replied that checks are intelligence- and risk-driven with no fixed posts, that waiting times are very limited, that green lanes and exemptions are ruled out, and that cost-sharing talks are ongoing.
Because of the effectiveness of the controls, it is undesirable to publish where the controls will be carried out.
Het is vanwege de doelmatigheid van de controles onwenselijk te publiceren waar de controles worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Grinwis over internationale koolstofmarkten

MPs Bontenbal and Grinwis asked the minister what COP29 agreed on Article 6 carbon market standards, how these make climate action cheaper, when the PACM becomes operational, how companies and Dutch government could use PACM and ITMOs. The minister answered that standards for Article 6.4 credits were adopted, first credits expected mid-2025, companies can buy credits, and the Netherlands does not currently intend to use Article 6 credits for its own targets.
The cabinet is therefore currently not intending to use the options that Article 6 offers.
Het kabinet is daarom momenteel niet voornemens om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheden die artikel 6 biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Grinwis over het spoortraject Emmen-Rheine

MPs Vedder and Grinwis asked whether the government will ensure the cross-border Emmen-Rheine rail link can open by December 2026, given that German trains lack Dutch approval for the last 0.5 km into Coevorden and a simplified vehicle-authorisation procedure has not yet been confirmed. The Secretary of State says the ILT, an independent regulator, decides on authorisation, that the government is facilitating talks with ILT and EU bodies, and that it will keep the House informed, but declines to intervene in the regulator's decision.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) ultimately assesses and decides whether to grant a Dutch vehicle authorisation.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) beoordeelt en besluit uiteindelijk over het al dan niet toekennen van een Nederlandse voertuigvergunning.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over het bericht 'Evangelist op station Maastricht met machtsvertoon staande gehouden: 'Intimiderende en dreigende sfeer''

ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers whether police intervention against evangelists singing at a Maastricht station piano, and NS house rules restricting evangelising folders, are compatible with freedom of religion, and whether they will talk to NS about this. The government answered that police acted on a nuisance report under local responsibility, that no restrictions were imposed and the group left voluntarily, that house rules and WP2000 obligations justify NS enforcement, and that it sees no reason to talk to NS now.
The police's conduct was based on knowledge of the local situation and under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het optreden van de politie is op basis van de kennis van de lokale situatie en onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de gedragscode voor beheer en onderhoud door waterschappen

An MP asked whether the national code of conduct for water board maintenance (mowing, dredging) expires on 1 January 2025, whether it will be renewed, and how the mowing dispute with nature organisations can be resolved. The state secretary replied that the code cannot be extended under the repealed Nature Conservation Act, that a new code under the Environment and Planning Act is being negotiated, and that a session is planned to allow flail-mower use in non-safety situations, with the new code to take effect on 1 April 2025.
I am currently holding talks with the nature organisations concerned, the IPO, the Union of Water Boards and RVO to still reach a suitable solution.
Ik voer momenteel gesprekken met de betrokken soortenorganisaties, het IPO, de Unie van Waterschappen en RVO om alsnog tot een passende oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op van het lid Grinwis over het artikel ‘‘Fuck de regels’: hoe spotgoedkope Chinese fatbikes Nederland worden binnengesmokkeld’

MP Grinwis asked the ministers of Infrastructure, Finance and Justice about reports that illegal Chinese fatbikes with throttles and excessive motors are smuggled into the Netherlands, how customs and the ILT control them, and what enforcement measures will follow, including on online sellers and the Ouxi V8 model. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that customs controls are risk-based without separate capacity or success figures for fatbikes, that the ILT and police can seize or fine non-compliant vehicles, and that a consumer awareness campaign is running.
It cannot be said how much capacity Customs deploys on fatbike controls.
Het is daardoor niet te zeggen hoeveel capaciteit de Douane inzet op de controles van fatbikes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Inge van Dijk, Grinwis en Maatoug over ‘het uiterst kritische Raad van State advies over het nieuwe box 3 stelsel’

MPs from D66, CDA, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks-PvdA asked how the government views the Raad van State's critical advice on the new box 3 wealth tax system, including delay, budgetary shortfall, the Hoge Raad's view on the forfait, and wealth inequality. The Staatssecretaris answers that a one-year delay to 2028 is expected, a shortfall of about 2.4 billion euro in 2027 will be covered by raising the forfait on other assets and lowering the tax-free allowance, and that alternatives including a wealth tax are being studied, with a reply to the advice to follow.
In a further report on that advice the cabinet will provide a full response, and I cannot anticipate that now.
In een nader rapport op dat advies komt het kabinet met een uitgebreide reactie, daarop kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Erkens, Vermeer en Grinwis over de overstap van de industrie naar groene waterstof en de raffinageroute

Four MPs asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the proposed 0.4 correction factor for the refinery route for green hydrogen, which they feared would undermine hydrogen investment and rely on uncertain market assumptions. The minister defended the correction factor as a balance between CO2 reduction, pump prices and hydrogen stimulation, acknowledged investment risks and committed to a study under a parliamentary motion on the refinery route's impact.

After the parliamentary questions were asked, the House adopted the motion by MPs Bontenbal and Vermeer calling for a study into how the refinery route should be designed to contribute maximally to the industry's sustainability goals.

Na het stellen van Kamervragen heeft de Kamer de motie van de leden Bontenbal en Vermeer aangenomen over een onderzoek naar hoe de raffinageroute eruit moet zien om maximaal bij te dragen aan de verduurzamingsdoelstellingen van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bontenbal over het potentiële valmeerproject bij de Haringvlietmonding

MPs Grinwis and Bontenbal asked the government about the proposed Delta21 valmeer (storage reservoir) at the Haringvliet mouth, its energy value, flood safety, ecological impact, strategic autonomy, and whether it should be included in the grid security plan and a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answers that the project has potential value as large-scale electricity storage but faces large uncertainties and ecological drawbacks, and commits to a broader cost-benefit comparison of flexibility options and an update of the energy storage roadmap.

As promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (7 November 2024), the cabinet is willing to map the pros and cons of a valmeer project for the energy system, including a comparison with other flexibility applications.

Zoals is toegezegd tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (7 november 2024) is het kabinet bereid om in kaart te brengen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van een valmeerproject voor het energiesysteem, inclusief een vergelijking met andere flexibiliteitstoepassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Grinwis en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Kabinet krijgt tik op de vingers uit Brussel'

MPs Vijlbrief, Grinwis and Inge van Dijk asked Finance Minister Heinen how the cabinet will respond to a European Commission warning that debt and deficits rise beyond EU reference values over the longer term, and why it added 8 billion in spending despite low debt. The minister says the cabinet stays within EU reference values during its term apart from a one-off 2026 deficit overshoot, that further consolidation is for future cabinets, and gives no concrete additional cuts or measures.
The cabinet will not submit to the European Commission a different budgetary path than the frameworks set by the cabinet.
Het kabinet zal niet een ander budgettair pad aan de Europese Commissie voorleggen dan de door het kabinet vastgestelde kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over VvE’s die in de knel komen door de Gasketelwet

An MP asks the minister about housing associations (VvE's) facing high costs under the Gas Boiler Act, specifically replacing collective flue systems older than fifteen years, and about a feasible route forward. The minister responds that the CO-regime is important for safety, points to a new trade handling framework and a forthcoming NEN practice guideline, notes that flue inspection certificates are available, and promises further talks with the sector and consumer organisations.

In the coming period I would like to enter into discussion with the sector and consumer organisations about the bottlenecks with collective flue systems at VvE's identified in the evaluation and the letter from Vereniging Eigen Huis.

Ik ga komende tijd graag in gesprek met de sector en consumentenorganisaties over de in de evaluatie en de brief van Vereniging Eigen Huis geconstateerde knelpunten met collectieve rookgasafvoeren bij VvE's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht ‘Hoe een volhardende buurvrouw protesteert tegen een bouwproject op de Müllerpier en zich voor 400.000 euro laat afkopen’

An MP asks the housing minister how to respond to a report that a resident was paid 400,000 euros to withdraw objections to a Rotterdam housing project, and whether the buyout creates precedent and whether ministry officials' conduct is involved. The minister says objection and appeal rights must be preserved, contract freedom means she will not intervene in such settlements, the Wet versterking regie volkshuisvesting would accelerate appeals, and the official's conduct is a private matter.
However, I also consider it important that an interested party can lodge an objection or appeal when they suffer disadvantage or harm from a planned construction project.
Ik vind het echter ook van belang dat een belanghebbende bezwaar of beroep kan instellen wanneer deze nadeel of schade ondervindt van een voorgenomen bouwproject.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het waarderen van de zonnestroomboiler ofwel PV-zonneboiler in de NTA 8800

An MP asked whether PV-solar boilers (electric boilers fed by own solar power) are a proven technique, whether they help with grid congestion and self-consumption, and why they cannot be credited in the NTA 8800 energy performance calculation for new buildings, asking for a fix before a committee debate. The minister answers that such boilers suit some homes with panels but heat pumps are more efficient, that grid-congestion benefits are limited, and that NTA 8800 will be revised in the EPBD-IV implementation, where own storage valuation will be assessed.
In NTA 8800, the calculated annual yield of the PV panels is fully offset against the calculated total fossil energy use of the building-related installations.
In de NTA8800 wordt de berekende jaaropbrengst van de PV-panelen geheel verrekend met het berekende totale fossiele energiegebruik voor de gebouwgebonden installaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen, Grinwis en Bromet over het bericht dat de minister alle basisscholen in Nederland het boek “Wat zeg ik? Hondentaal voor kids”

MPs Van Campen, Grinwis and Bromet asked whether the ministry of agriculture was really sending the children's dog-behaviour book to all primary schools, why, and at what cost. The state secretary confirmed it, said it was meant to reduce dog bites among children aged 6-10 and cost about EUR 45,000, but that after consultation with the education ministry the mailing was cancelled and an alternative destination is being considered.
In consultation with the State Secretary of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW), it has now been decided not to send the books to primary schools anymore.
Inmiddels is in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) besloten de boeken niet meer te versturen aan basisscholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en De Hoop over het bericht dat ondanks het verbod op tijdelijke huurcontracten, er nog altijd honderden woningen met een tijdelijk contract aangeboden worden

MPs Grinwis and De Hoop asked the housing minister how the government enforces the ban on temporary rental contracts after reports that hundreds of such homes are still offered. The minister answered that the Wet vaste huurcontracten has no enforcement instruments, that wrongly offered temporary contracts automatically become indefinite, and that municipalities have no enforcement task, while promising information campaigns and openness to talks with landlord organisations.
The Wet vaste huurcontracten has no enforcement powers of its own.
De Wet vaste huurcontracten kent geen eigen handhavingsmogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Grinwis over het tariefsysteem voor de kosten van het elektriciteitsnet voor kleinverbruikers

MPs Bontenbal and Grinwis asked the minister about Flemish and Walloon time-based grid tariffs for small consumers and whether the Dutch flat-capacity tariff is fair. The minister said network operators will publish an alternative tariff study this autumn, that the ACM decides on tariffs, and that a proposal will be sent to parliament before the 28 November debate.

After Netbeheer Nederland publishes the study on an alternative grid tariff for small consumers, I will share my appreciation of it with your House ahead of the Electricity Grid, Energy Infrastructure & RES committee debate on 28 November.

Na publicatie door Netbeheer Nederland van het onderzoek naar een alternatief nettarief voor kleinverbruikers zal ik mijn appreciatie daarvan met uw Kamer delen, voorafgaand aan het Commissiedebat Elektriciteitsnet, Energie-infrastructuur & RES op 28 november a.s.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, De Hoop, Pierik, Postma, Stoffer en Vedder over de voortgang van de verruiming van het sluizencomplex bij Kornwerderzand

MPs asked about the delayed and costlier widening of the Kornwerderzand lock complex, including whether cost increases stem from tighter Rijk standards, the salinity problem, the bridges, and whether the Rijk should bear costs. The minister answered that the cost rise reflects a more realistic estimate rather than new norms, that the regional province must make a substantial contribution, and that talks with the region are being restarted, without firm commitments on financing.

In the consultation with the deputy it was indicated that if the region chooses to realise the project, IenW first expects a substantial contribution from the regional governments towards the identified cost increase.

In het overleg met de gedeputeerde is aangegeven dat als de regio ervoor kiest het project te willen realiseren, IenW eerst een substantiële bijdrage van de regionale overheden verwacht voor de geconstateerde kostenstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Eneco kijkt over de grens bij investeren in opslag en opwek'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about grid congestion, grid tariffs and incentives for large-scale battery storage in the Netherlands after Eneco's reported investments abroad. The Minister answered that batteries help with feed-in congestion but are not yet a reliable solution for consumption congestion, that tariff harmonisation is pursued at EU level, and that no new battery tariff or additional subsidy is currently planned.

I am in favour of a level playing field regarding network tariffs to prevent battery storage investments taking place in other countries when the most favourable storage locations are in the Netherlands.

Ik ben voorstander van een gelijk speelveld ten aanzien van netwerktarieven om te voorkomen dat investeringen in batterijopslag in andere landen plaatsvinden wanneer de meest gunstige opslaglocaties in Nederland bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Holland Casino maakt forse verliezen en dreigt met agressieve gokcampagnes'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked whether state-owned Holland Casino would pursue aggressive gambling advertising to offset losses, how this squares with public health responsibility, and whether closures or reduced hours were planned. The State Secretary of Finance replied that Holland Casino has no plans to significantly increase marketing, that aggressive campaigns are unacceptable, that the government expects a role model from the state-owned company, and that the advertising framework will be assessed in an evaluation due in October 2024.
Holland Casino has confirmed to the Ministry of Finance that it has no plans to significantly increase its marketing expenditure.
Holland Casino heeft richting het Ministerie van Financiën bevestigd dat het geen plannen heeft om zijn marketinguitgaven significant te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het onderzoek «De keuze voor warmtenetten of andere warmteoplossingen»

An MP asks the ministers how the government reacts to a Berenschot study finding district heating cheaper than heat pumps from a societal perspective, whether the cost-plus tariff method in the Wet collectieve warmte will raise consumer prices, how the WIS subsidy and tariff protection will help consumers and projects, and whether cost sharing and financing can be improved. The minister acknowledges the cost-distribution issue, expects cost-based tariffs to lower prices for roughly 45-64% of consumers with phased introduction and a possible tariff cap, and describes subsidy changes, a planned guarantee fund and forthcoming studies, mostly promising further letters and evaluations without firm commitments on the specific demands.
The cabinet is preparing a letter exploring complementary policy options (in addition to the Wcw) to safeguard the affordability of collective heat.
Het kabinet bereid een Kamerbrief voor waarin flankerende beleidsopties (in aanvulling op de Wcw) worden verkend om de betaalbaarheid van collectieve warmte te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Grinwis over de uitvoeringsaspecten van het nieuwe kinderopvangstelsel

The MPs Maatoug and Grinwis asked whether the current childcare allowance system, which leaves parents bearing repayment risk, should be replaced by direct financing, and what deadlines, choices and information the implementation requires. The State Secretary agrees the current system is fundamentally flawed, says a reform letter will come in autumn with a bill planned for 2025, and lists the information the implementing agency needs.
The childcare allowance will be replaced by a new financing system in which the payment is transferred directly to childcare organisations.
De kinderopvangtoeslag wordt vervangen door een nieuw financieringsstelsel waarbij de vergoeding direct wordt overgemaakt naar kinderopvangorganisaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 30 mei 2024: ‘Vrees voor onderhoudsproblemen van monumentale kerken door milieuzone: Niet te betalen’

An MP asked the ministers whether zero-emission zones threaten maintenance of historic churches and specialist craftsmen, given that exemptions are limited to 12 day-permits per year. The government answered that the exemption package, including longer-term permits, adequately addresses these concerns, that municipalities set exemption policy, and that it will evaluate the Central Desk and share results with parliament by year end.
Exemption policy falls under municipal responsibility, so it is up to municipalities to decide which exemptions they grant.
Het ontheffingenbeleid valt onder verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten, daarmee is het aan gemeenten om te bepalen welke ontheffingen zij verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht “Spaarders in box 3 mogen oordeel Hoge Raad niet afwachten”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether savers in box 3 who did not object to their 2023 tax assessments will benefit from a forthcoming Supreme Court ruling, given that their assessments may already be final, and what communication and objection procedures will apply. The State Secretary confirms that assessments for savers are being held back, that the Supreme Court rulings of 6 June apply to 2023 assessments dated early May, refuses to estimate the workload of individual objections, and says a return to the pre-2016 mass-objection procedure is rejected in favour of a new 'direct aanpassen' system.
Almost all 2023 income tax assessments of box 3 savers are dated early May 2024, so on 6 June, the date the Supreme Court rulings were issued, the assessments were not yet final.

Nagenoeg alle aanslagen inkomstenbelasting 2023 van de spaarders box 3 hebben een dagtekening van begin mei 2024, waardoor aanslagen op 6 juni, de datum dat de arresten van de Hoge Raad zijn gewezen, nog niet onherroepelijk vaststonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Beckerman en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Sterke stijging aantal zaken over servicekosten, bezwaar vaak succesvol’

MPs Beckerman and Grinwis asked the Minister of Interior about reports that tenants win most service-cost and defect disputes, especially against private landlords, and what is being done about landlords who push the limits of service charges. The Minister says the rules on service charges are being tightened through a bill (limited list of cost categories, lower thresholds for collective claims), that municipalities can now enforce against misuse under the Good Landlordship Act, and that the bill is expected after the summer; on several points, such as refusing optional services and the 6.4 billion euro repayment reports, the answer is limited or refers back to existing law.
The Huurcommissie currently does not track which defects occur most often.
Door de Huurcommissie wordt op dit moment niet bijgehouden welke gebreken het meest voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Grinwis en Bromet over het bericht ‘Kabinet versoepelde exclusief voor Schiphol de bestaande stikstofregels’

MPs Vedder, Grinwis and Bromet asked whether the minister relaxed nitrogen rules for Schiphol against advice from senior officials, and why PAS-melders are treated differently. The minister denies overriding advice, says the same extern salderen policy was applied to private parties, acknowledges the Raad van State ruling now requires additionality checks, and commits to broadening the PAS-melder legalisation approach.
No, that is not the case. I want to emphasise that no exception was made when issuing the definitive nature permit for Schiphol.
Nee, dat is niet het geval. Ik wil benadrukken geen enkele uitzondering te hebben gemaakt bij afgifte van de definitieve natuurvergunning voor Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Erkens over het vinden van een balans tussen drinkwater en geothermie in Limburg

MPs Grinwis and Erkens asked how their amendment protecting drinking water reserves in Limburg would be applied to geothermal drilling, including interpretation, EBN's plans, permitting speed, and double casing standards. The State Secretary answered that the amendment's scope depends on whether 'designated or reserved' covers only water-catchment areas or also supplementary protection zones, that a legal opinion is pending, and that double casing is already legally required for geothermal wells.
The advice is expected this summer and I will share it with your House.
Het advies wordt deze zomer verwacht en zal ik met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Mila woont met haar pasgeboren baby in een auto in Noord, urgentieverklaring afgewezen'

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked the ministers how they view Amsterdam refusing an urgency declaration for a mother and newborn living in a car, and whether they would act against such policy. The minister answered that municipalities hold discretion over urgency criteria, that Amsterdam says it tried to prevent the situation, and that he will not discuss the case specifically for privacy reasons.
It is up to the municipal council to set criteria for determining which housing seekers qualify for urgency.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om criteria vast te stellen aan de hand waarvan kan worden bepaald welke woningzoekenden in aanmerking komen voor urgentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de Dual Fuel tractoren van Blue Fuel Solutions

An MP asks why the RDW has not yet type-approved Blue Fuel Solutions' dual-fuel hydrogen tractors despite contact since 2021, why registrations were withdrawn, and what route (Article 35 procedure) and emissions testing are needed. The Staatssecretaris answers that an Article 35 procedure with emissions tests is required, that registrations were issued wrongly as diesel vehicles, that the EU-level route is preferred and that talks with the initiator and RDW continue.
I am still awaiting the results of these emissions tests.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van de resultaten van deze emissietesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over geblokkeerde bankrekeningen van Nederlandse burgers, onder wie veel jongeren

An MP asks the Finance and Justice ministers about bank accounts of citizens, many young people, being blocked, often under anti-money-laundering rules, and about whether legal protection and oversight are adequate. The minister acknowledges signals, says no figures are kept on blocked accounts, explains the grounds for blocking and the complaint routes (bank complaint procedure, Kifid, courts), and promises to ask the banks and Betaalvereniging to record blocking data better.
I do not have figures on the number of blocked accounts, the specific number of young people whose payment account has been (or was) blocked, and the reasons why these accounts were blocked.

Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal geblokkeerde rekeningen, het specifieke aantal jongeren waarvan de betaalrekening geblokkeerd is (geweest) en de redenen waarom deze rekeningen dan geblokkeerd zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Grinwis over de noodkreet van de gemeente Krimpenerwaard, Molenlanden en zestien andere Zuid-Hollandse gemeenten om te kunnen blijven 'bouwen voor behoefte'

Grinwis (ChristenUnie) asks Minister De Jonge whether he shares the call of Krimpenerwaard, Molenlanden and sixteen other South Holland municipalities to keep building for local need, and why he considers the province of South Holland to be 'not delivering' on housing, including its 3-hectare rule blocking new sites above 3 hectares. The minister shares the concern about the housing shortage and the rural municipalities' worries, says the blanket 3-hectare rule is undesirable, and states he has raised the matter with the province and informed the House of the meeting of 12 March.
A generic measure to allow no new location larger than 3 ha is, in this time of housing shortage, undesirable in my view.
Een generieke maatregel om geen enkele nieuwe locatie groter dan 3 ha toe te staan, vind ik in deze tijd van woningnood ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘NS verbiedt christelijke jongeren flyers uit te delen op Utrecht Centraal: ‘Dit is propaganda’’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether NS's ban on Christian youths handing out evangelism flyers at Utrecht Centraal, which NS called propaganda, restricts religious and expression freedom, and why pro-Palestine demonstrations there were not stopped. The minister replied that NS and ProRail may enforce station house rules requiring permission for distributing texts regardless of content, that the assessment belongs to NS and local authorities, and that he will not comment on their earlier decisions.
It is not for me to enter into the assessment that NS security and service staff made on site.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afweging die de veiligheid- en servicemedewerkers van NS ter plaatse hebben gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Bontenbal en Grinwis over het bericht ‘Zinkfabriek Nyrstar in Budel legt productie stil’

MPs Erkens, Bontenbal and Grinwis asked how the government views the shutdown of the Nyrstar zinc plant in Budel over high energy costs, lack of state aid and the investment climate, and whether this reflects a wider industrial trend, the effect of the tax changes and the ending of the IKC and volume compensation schemes, the link to grid congestion and balancing, and how the government will address negative sentiment around industry. The minister acknowledges the high energy costs and competitive disadvantage relative to neighbours, defends the Dutch climate-led industrial policy ('greener here than grey elsewhere'), explains the reasons for ending the IKC and the ACM's abolition of the VCR, and promises further studies on electricity costs and a report to parliament, but gives limited concrete answers on grid congestion and some questions are answered by reference to policy stance.
I expect that the cabinet will inform the House later this quarter about the findings.
Ik verwacht dat het kabinet de Kamer later dit kwartaal zal inlichten over de bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het opheffen van de directe treinverbinding tussen Enschede en Deventer en Schiphol

MPs Grinwis and Vedder asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the temporary removal of the direct Enschede/Deventer–Schiphol train, its duration, the decision process, and infrastructure bottlenecks at Deventer. The State Secretary answered that the change is temporary and tied to HSL speed restrictions and delayed ICNG deliveries, that NS and ProRail have been urged to restore the link quickly, and that a Deventer infrastructure solution is not yet realistic and awaits a new cabinet.
I have called on NS and ProRail to keep the change to the timetable between Enschede and Deventer and Schiphol as short as possible.
Ik heb NS en ProRail opgeroepen om de aanpassing in de dienstregeling tussen Enschede en Deventer en Schiphol van zo kort mogelijke duur te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het feit dat er sinds december 2023 minder intercity’s stoppen op station Schiedam Centrum

The ChristenUnie MP Grinwis asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure about fewer Intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum since December 2023, and whether this trade-off was made to keep Sprinter stops and how it weighs against PHS goals. The State Secretary answered that Intercity stops were reduced to four per hour to make the additional Sprinters affordable, that total stops remain equal, and that the reduction will be monitored and reversed depending on passenger demand, with NS responsible for the timetable.
My ministry ensures that NS complies with these agreements.
Mijn ministerie ziet erop toe dat NS deze afspraken naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over woningen met Energielabel A die desondanks niet goed geïsoleerd zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about homes with energy label A that are nonetheless poorly insulated, and how such labels are quality-controlled, including pre-2021 labels. The minister acknowledged the concern, described the private quality-assurance system and planned public oversight, reported that no label-A dwelling in the database is poorly insulated on all components, and pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and landlords.
I want this to be examined further, and I can inform you that Woonconcept has indicated that an independent qualified energy adviser will check the registered energy labels.
Ik wil dat dit nader onderzocht wordt en kan u melden dat Woonconcept heeft laten weten dat een onafhankelijke vakbekwame energieadviseur de geregistreerde energielabels gaat controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de Dag van de Vrachtwagenchauffeur

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the lack of truck driver vacancies, traffic congestion, rest-time rules, the shortage of truck parking, and falling truck driver training places. The minister answered that the sector and government take various measures, that no congestion charge is planned, and that rest rules are European and should not be deviated from.
It is undesirable to deviate from the rest and driving times; this endangers road safety.
Het is onwenselijk om af te wijken van de rust- en rijtijden; dit brengt de verkeersveiligheid in het geding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Vedder en Grinwis over het sluiten van de nautische verkeerspost Ouddorp en het niet langer inzetten van vuurtorenwachters op vuurtoren Westhoofd

Three MPs (SGP, CDA, ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the nautical traffic post at Ouddorp and the Westhoofd lighthouse watch were closed, raising safety concerns for the Slijkgat channel. The Minister answered that the area is not a VTS zone, that replacing the radar and systems was too costly, that information remains available through other public channels, and that the Slijkgat depth commitments continue, but gave no commitment to restore the post.
Discussions are ongoing with parties about users' information needs and how these can be better served.
Er wordt verder overlegd met partijen over de informatiebehoefte van de gebruikers en hoe daar nog beter in kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Garnalenvissers in Zuidwesten ten einde raad om dreigende sluiting visgebied'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why she has not implemented the adopted Van der Plas motion postponing a ban on bottom-disturbing fishing in the Voordelta, why she threatens closure of 24,550 hectares, and whether that counts as agreement or coercion. The minister answers that she will not enter the closure on 31 December 2023 and will take more time, that a binding compensation obligation under a court ruling requires action, and that the dialogue failed to produce full agreement.
I have not put the Access Restriction Decree (TbB) into effect on 5 October 2023.
Ik heb het Toegangsbeperkend Besluit (hierna: TbB) niet per 5 oktober 2023 inwerking laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de vaststelling van de voorlopige tarieven GLB 2023

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture why the provisional 2023 CAP tariffs for the basic income support and eco-scheme were set well below earlier communicated levels, how much budget is short, and whether 2023 eco-scheme funding can be topped up without drawing on 2024 budget. The Minister acknowledges poor communication, explains the lower tariffs stem from more applications than budgeted and a risk of clawbacks, commits to seeking additional eco-scheme funding without guaranteeing it, and says the 207 euro floor for basic income support is kept.
Once I have the definitive data, I can set the definitive tariffs.
Zodra ik de definitieve gegevens heb, kan ik de definitieve tarieven vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de 'Borselse voorwaarden voor een kerncentrale'

MP Grinwis asked the government how it views the 39 'Borsele conditions' for new nuclear plants, the process behind them, and whether it will meet them on landscape, cooling towers and underground cabling. The minister answered that the conditions are still being consolidated with the municipality and province, that substantive assessment is premature, and that the government will weigh them in the siting decision.
At this moment it is too early to respond substantively to the conditions.
Het is op dit moment te vroeg om inhoudelijk in te gaan op de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Plotseling tekort van 126 miljoen voor tolvrije tunnel: ‘We kunnen in 2030 toch niet weer poortjes neerzetten?'

MPs Grinwis and Van der Graaf asked about a reported 126 million euro shortfall for making the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free, linked to the controversial status of Betalen naar Gebruik. The minister said a toll-free tunnel from 2025 is agreed with Zeeland, that the Rijk has committed to funding 2030–2033, but declined to give firm guarantees about future tolling and deferred the matter to a new cabinet.
Declaring Betalen naar Gebruik controversial does not yet mean that BNG will not go ahead.
Het controversieel verklaren van Betalen naar Gebruik (BNG) betekent nog niet dat BNG niet doorgaat.
