Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Koerhuis, Van der Plas enWesterveld over dreigende huisuitzettingen van weeskinderen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew of threatened evictions of at least five orphaned young adults from social rental homes before the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act takes effect, and how to prevent them and hold housing corporations to the law's spirit. The minister agreed such evictions must be prevented, said corporations should already act in the spirit of the law and that she is in close contact with Aedes to find solutions, and targets entry into force on 1 January 2024.
I am in close contact with Aedes to ensure a suitable solution in the spirit of the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act in the situations mentioned.
Ik heb nauw contact met Aedes om in de genoemde situaties te zorgen voor een passende oplossing in de geest van de Wet huurbescherming weeskinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Romke de Jong (D66) over het bericht 'Afschaffing btw op groente en fruit dreigt te sneuvelen'

MPs Grinwis and Romke de Jong asked why the government doubts introducing a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables despite coalition support and the Prime Minister's remark that the tax service can implement it. The state secretaries answer that no decision has been taken, that the zero rate would invite endless legal challenges under the neutrality principle and cost 550-950 million euros, and that implementation on 1 January 2024 is not advisable.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Valstar, Bisschop en Grinwis ten aanzien van de garnalenvissers die per 1 oktober een nieuwe vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig hebben

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie, SGP and VVD asked about the shrimp fishing fleet needing new Wet natuurbescherming permits from 1 October, including catalyst subsidy uptake, the code of conduct, the nitrogen assessment model and a possible extension of the tolerance period. The minister answered that installation numbers are unknown, that a tolerance extension to permit issuance is planned, that a 15-month extension to 2025 is refused, and that talks with the sector on the model and permits are ongoing.
I intend to extend the existing tolerance period until the permit is issued and, within those permits, to give all permit applicants nitrogen space up to a specific date to be fixed.

Ik ben voornemens de bestaande gedoogperiode te verlengen tot de vergunning is afgegeven en binnen die vergunningen alle vergunningaanvragers tot een specifiek vast te leggen datum de stikstofruimte te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de massale vogelsterfte op broedeilanden door vogelgriep

An MP asked the minister about bird flu causing mass seabird deaths on breeding islands, the lack of support and funding for clearing carcasses, and the Audit Office findings on fragmented responsibility. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to a national platform, protocols and a planned exploration of bottlenecks, but said carcass removal is primarily the landowner's responsibility and that the poultry compensation convenant talks will not cover wild bird costs.
I expect to inform the House further about this exploration before the end of the year.
Ik verwacht de Kamer voor het einde van het jaar nader te informeren over deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Boswijk en Grinwis over het bericht in Trouw met als titel: “onenigheid Rijk en provincie fnuikt redding van de grutto”

MPs Bromet, Boswijk and Grinwis asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a Trouw report that Rijk-provincie disagreement stalls grutto protection and that funds remain unspent. The minister disputes that little money has been paid out (EUR 2.5 million of EUR 3 million allocated), says long-term contracts are legally possible and that provinces are responsible for the decision on long-term commitments, while promising shared intent to resolve the matter by next summer.
It is a competence of the provinces themselves whether or not to conclude long-term contracts at their own risk, without a financial guarantee for the period after 2027–2028.
Het is een bevoegdheid van de provincies zelf om al dan niet op eigen risico langjarige contracten af te sluiten zonder de financiële garantie voor de periode na 2027–2028.
Antwoord op van de leden Valstar, Van Campen, Bisschop, Grinwis en Boswijk over ‘bestaand gebruik’ in relatie tot de toetsing van de garnalenvisserij aan de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs from VVD, SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about the Landsadvocaat's advice on whether shrimp fishing licences under the Visserijwet can count as existing use (bestaand gebruik) for Wet natuurbescherming permits, and whether the 1994 licences should be investigated. The minister answered that the legal route is highly complex, that the sector must itself reconstruct licence and emission data via AIS and logbooks, and that the sector remains responsible for the nitrogen deposition calculations.
I share that observation and gladly give these fishers the opportunity and room to demonstrate this.
Ik deel die constatering en biedt deze vissers graag de kans en ruimte om dit aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de vragenlijst Wwft Sw voor beleggingsondernemingen van de AFM en de Vragenlijst integriteitsrisico van DNB

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether AFM and DNB questionnaires that list religious institutions, charities and churches as higher-risk sectors for money laundering, and that lead banks to apply enhanced due diligence, deter these organisations and conflict with GDPR and equal treatment rules. The minister replies that the questionnaires reflect sector-level risk assessments, that a sector risk must not be applied automatically to individual clients, that the FIU data cited are limited, and that regulators are not required to act on the requests for an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens investigation or for a judgement on discrimination.

I consider it important that institutions apply the individual approach required by law correctly. It is not intended that individual clients be refused by institutions on the basis of a sector-wide risk.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat de instellingen de door de wet gevraagde individuele benadering juist toepassen. Het is niet de bedoeling dat individuele klanten geweerd worden door instellingen op basis van een sectorbreed risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Krul en Grinwis over het bericht 'Ministerie betaalde al 15.000 euro aan actiegroep Lelystad Airport: ‘Dit is van de zotte’

Three MPs (Boswijk, Krul, Grinwis) asked why the government pays penalty payments rather than fulfilling a Woo freedom-of-information request from Stichting Laagvliegen, whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported under the NEC directive, what sanctions apply for incomplete reporting, and how that affects the nitrogen approach. The minister acknowledges delay and agrees phased publication, says the NEC reporting is not legally binding but commits to including above-3,000-foot emissions from 2024, and maintains that the nitrogen contribution of aviation is about 0.01%.
I regret that it took longer than the applicable statutory deadlines, as a result of which a penalty payment was imposed.
Ik betreur het dat het langer heeft geduurd dan de daarvoor geldende wettelijke termijnen, waardoor er een dwangsom is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het duurder worden van woningen als gevolg van de invoering van de Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen

An MP from ChristenUnie asks the Minister for Housing about fears that the Wet kwaliteitsborging voor het bouwen (Wkb) will raise housing prices, with too few inspectors and high supervision costs. The Minister responds that start-up concerns are recognised, that enough quality assurers are expected, that lower permit fees should offset costs, and that the Act will take effect on 1 January 2024 together with the Omgevingswet.
So I do not expect there to be a shortage of quality assurers.
Ik verwacht dus niet dat er sprake zal zijn van een tekort aan kwaliteitsborgers.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de herziening van de Capital Requirements Regulation (CRR) door de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the government about the EU revision of the CRR requiring banks to provide for non-performing loans even when fully guaranteed by the state, which affects NWB and BNG lending to housing corporations via the WSW guarantee fund, and whether a carve-out can be pursued in trilogue. The minister acknowledges the cost and financing risks for housing corporations, says the impact cannot be quantified because the data is confidential, and commits to pursuing a targeted exemption in the trilogue.
Information on expected NPLs that have been or could be on the balance sheets of the banks for more than seven years is not public, competitively sensitive information.
Informatie over de verwachte NPL's die langer dan zeven jaar op de balans van de betreffende banken staan of in de toekomst zou kunnen staan is niet publieke, concurrentiegevoelige informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de toepassing van de alleenstaande ouderenkorting bij belastingplichtigen met een partner in een verzorgingstehuis naar aanleiding van een bericht in de Geldgids van de Consume

An MP asked why the tax authority rejects claims for the single elderly person's tax reduction when a partner lives in a care home, even though entitled people should receive it, and how many are affected. The Staatssecretaris explains the Belastingdienst depends on the SVB indication, may grant the reduction if it was granted the prior year, otherwise sends a pre-announcement of adjustment, and gives figures for 2021 while committing to examine improved communication.
The Belastingdienst does not know in how many cases this involves a partner admitted to a care home.
Het is bij de Belastingdienst niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen hierbij sprake is van een partner die is opgenomen in een verzorgingstehuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Twee gasboringen voor drie verlaten stallen: hoe de stikstofhandel in een Drents dorp juist tot meer uitstoot leidt'

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether nitrogen-space trading via external netting (extern salderen) lets emissions rise, whether a stopped activity can be used as a credit, and how PAS-melders (farms with unlawful permits) can be legalised. The minister answered that conditions are in place (30% reduction, real capacity required), that stricter rules on dormant permits are being prepared with an evaluation expected around summer, and that legalisation is progressing through three measures and reported annually.

In the letter of 25 November 2022 the cabinet announced it would, together with the other competent authorities, further tighten the conditions for external netting, among others to prevent netting with so-called dormant permits.

In de Kamerbrief van 25 november 2022 heeft het kabinet aangekondigd om samen met de andere bevoegde gezagen de voorwaarden voor extern salderen verder aan te scherpen, o.a. om salderen met zogenaamde slapende vergunningen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Nijboer over het feit dat er nog altijd flitskredieten worden aangeboden in Nederland

MPs Grinwis and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether flash-credit providers such as saldodipje.nl, which impose penalties for missing guarantor documents that push costs above the legal maximum, are acceptable and whether the AFM can act against them. The minister said the 2020 flash-credit regulation caps such costs, a Rotterdam court ruling found insufficient evidence of a cap breach, and the government will review the rules when the revised EU consumer credit directive is transposed.
For that reason the Flash Credit Approach Regulation entered into force on 1 January 2020.
Daarom is op 1 januari 2020 de Regeling aanpak flitskrediet in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Boswijk over de opkoop van boerderijen ten behoeve van de verbreding van de A27 bij Utrecht

MPs Grinwis and Boswijk asked whether the national government's buyout of farms for the A27 widening near Amelisweerd, and its use of nitrogen space, undermines provincial area processes, PAS-melder legalisation and fair rules on extern salderen. The minister denies any breach of inter-governmental agreements, rejects claims that Rijk buys nitrogen space for Schiphol, and announces tighter rules, a first-purchase right, a possible pre-emption right, a register of nitrogen banks and an independent enforcement study.

To prevent governments surprising each other, the national government and provinces have inter-governmental agreements on extern salderen, under which the Rijk informs provinces in advance of planned transactions.

Om te voorkomen dat overheden elkaar verrassen, hebben Rijk en provincies interbestuurlijke afspraken over extern salderen, waarbij is afgesproken dat het Rijk de provincies vooraf informeert over voorgenomen transacties op basis van extern salderen.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Zwartspaarder spint garen bij schrappen vermogenstaks'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that abolishing the wealth tax lets tax evaders gain, asking for figures on black savers, penalty floors for hidden savings, and the treatment of cash. The State Secretary said the Tax Authority does not systematically track such cases, will examine alternatives to tying fines to the tax owed, and confirmed that cash currently falls under the low-yield bank-balance category.
The Tax Authority does not systematically record how often and how much is recovered from black savers.
De Belastingdienst houdt niet systematisch bij hoe vaak en hoeveel nagevorderd wordt bij zwartspaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Grinwis over het bericht 'Boer Arjan moet verplicht zijn veestapel drastisch verkleinen; "Ze maken je helemaal kapot"'

MPs Boswijk, Van Campen and Grinwis asked the minister why promised legalisation of PAS-melder farms has not been delivered, whether the state will pay enforcement penalties, and whether an emergency law or provincial relief is possible. The minister says the legalisation programme, a 250 million euro provincial grant and a damages desk are being pursued, but that withholding enforcement is legally very difficult and penalties cannot be paid by the state.
It is a statutory obligation to have the measures implemented in time.
Het is een wettelijke opgave om de maatregelen tijdig uitgevoerd te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens en Valstar over versnelling geothermie

MPs Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens and Valstar asked how to accelerate geothermal heat projects amid the gas crisis, including exceptions to SDE++ deadlines, a correction scheme for glasshouse horticulture, and simpler permitting and risk frameworks. The Staatssecretaris answered that retroactive SDE++ changes are unfair to other bidders, that a temporary correction scheme is being explored with a decision expected soon, and that permitting and risk rules will change in spring 2023 with a taskforce being set up.
An adjustment after the tender has closed, with retroactive effect, affects equal treatment of projects for two reasons and therefore also the government's reliability.
Een aanpassing na afloop van de tender – met terugwerkende kracht – raakt om twee redenen aan de gelijke behandeling van projecten en daarmee ook aan de betrouwbaarheid van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over ‘Het openstellen van de saneringsregeling voor de visserij’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the fishing vessel decommissioning scheme compensates by vessel size rather than fishing rights, whether this is unfair, and why the sector was misled about the quota management system. The minister defended the size-based design as necessary given the lack of reliable quota market values and EU state-aid rules, said quota management will be developed with the sector by 2025, and gave timelines for the liquidity and standstill schemes.
I can imagine certain conditions were not foreseen. However, to prevent trading on insider knowledge, I could not share all details of the scheme in advance.
Ik kan mij voorstellen dat bepaalde voorwaarden niet waren voorzien. Om handelen met voorkennis te voorkomen, kon ik echter niet alle details van de regeling vooraf delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het DNB-rapport ‘Van herstel naar balans' en signalen dat PEPs door Wwft-instellingen worden geweerd als klant

MP Grinwis asked the Finance Minister about DNB's report on a risk-based anti-money-laundering approach and about reports that Wwft institutions refuse or drop PEPs as clients without concrete risk. The minister largely agreed with a risk-based approach, promised a policy agenda, dialogue with the sector and guidance, and said refusing PEPs solely for their status is improper, though he provided no formal complaint mechanism.
I therefore believe that the application of the regulations to PEPs can be improved.
Ik vind dan ook dat de toepassing van de regelgeving op PEPs beter kan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis over uitvoering van de motie van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over onderzoek naar de opbrengst van Dynamic Tidal Power-energiedammen in zee (Kamerstuk 32813, nr. 793)

MPs Grinwis and Stoffer asked why motions on researching Dynamic Tidal Power dams and an energy-from-water innovation programme had not yet been carried out. Minister Jetten answers that further research on DTP is being commissioned and that a programme depends on its outcome, with DTP's costs and impacts judged high against other options.
The motion by MPs Grinwis and Stoffer on researching the yield of Dynamic Tidal Power energy dams at sea is being implemented.
Aan de motie van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over onderzoek naar de opbrengst van Dynamic Tidal Power-energiedammen in zee wordt uitvoering gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over 'Eneco schroeft vergoeding voor terugleveren zonnestroom flink terug'

Two MPs asked the minister about Eneco sharply cutting the feed-in compensation for solar power and whether this and other suppliers' practices require stronger consumer protection or ACM investigation. The minister confirmed Eneco will reverse the cut for fixed contracts, said ACM supervises reasonable compensation, and announced intent to set a legal minimum of 80 percent of the bare supply tariff from 2025, possibly earlier by decree.

My intention is, from the perspective of consumer protection, to set the statutory minimum of the reasonable compensation for fed-back electricity, from the phase-out of the netting scheme (2025), at 80 percent of the bare supply tariff.

Mijn voornemen is om, uit het oog van consumentenbescherming, het wettelijk minimum van de redelijke vergoeding voor teruggeleverde elektriciteit met ingang van de afbouw van de salderingsregeling (2025) vast te stellen op 80 procent van het kale leveringstarief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Boswijk over grote onduidelijkheid voor akkerbouwers rondom het 7e Actieprogramma (7e AP) en addendum met daarbij de aanvullende voorwaarden uit de derogatiebeschikking, het nie

MPs Grinwis and Boswijk asked the Minister of Agriculture about the uncertainty for arable farmers caused by the 7th Action Programme, the derogation conditions, the new CAP and the ANLb, including buffer strips, harvest and sowing timing, the eco-scheme and communication. The Minister acknowledged the timing problems, committed to working with RVO on implementation, a reduced entry requirement and a 2023 learning year, but declined to adjust the derogation-based buffer strip rules or to set a transition year for several measures.
Work is being done closely with RVO to enable timely elaboration of the necessary regulations and communication about them.
Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met RVO om tijdige uitwerking van de benodigde regelgeving en communicatie daarover mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gündoğan en Grinwis over de 10-jaarstermijn in de erf- en schenkbelasting

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch inheritance tax is avoided for Dutch nationals who have lived abroad for over ten years, including those with a pied-à-terre in the Netherlands, how other countries handle such limits, and whether the ten-year rule should be extended or abolished. The State Secretary answered that the ten-year fictional rule prevents tax flight, that a second home does not avoid liability, that the government sees no reason or plan to change the ten-year period, and that a rough estimate of revenue impact cannot be given.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the ten-year period. There is no intention to do so.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om de tienjaarstermijn aan te passen. Er is geen voornemen hiertoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en De Graaf over de opkoop van stikstofruimte uit boerderijen ten behoeve van het verbreden van de A27 bij Amelisweerd

MPs Grinwis and De Graaf asked why the government bought nitrogen emission rights from eight farms to enable widening the A27 at Amelisweerd, questioning the fairness, prices, procedure and consistency with other sectors and policy. The minister defended the approach as voluntary, lawful and conforming to inter-governmental agreements, withheld purchase prices as commercially sensitive, and said no policy change occurred.
The amounts stated in the agreement are sensitive information that affects the State's negotiating position.
De in de overeenkomst genoemde bedragen betreffen gevoelige informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat raakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over aangescherpte vereisten voor regelvermogen (aFRR) en effecten op de energierekening van huishoudens

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether tightened aFRR balancing-capacity requirements (activation within five minutes from 1 July 2022) reduce gas and coal plants' supply, raise TenneT's costs and household energy bills, and whether implementation should be postponed. The minister answered that the rules follow EU regulation, that supply has not significantly fallen, that prices rose sharply in July 2022, that detailed cost and pass-through figures are confidential or uncertain, and that the rules cannot be postponed nationally.
The compensation TenneT pays on average and per provider is competitively sensitive.
De vergoedingen die TenneT gemiddeld en per aanbieder betaalt zijn concurrentiegevoelig.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Erkens, Heinen, Tielen en Grinwis over het artikel 'Al 20 jaar geregeld tekort aan isotopen voor kankerbestraling: waarom het probleem maar niet wordt opgelost'

MPs from VVD and ChristenUnie asked about the status of the PALLAS isotope reactor in Petten after an EenVandaag report on chronic shortages of medical isotopes, and whether government pre-financing or a first-loss facility could fund such projects. The minister described reserved funds of 1.29 billion euro, remaining conditions, expected production around 2030, and said the final decision on the 330 million euro gap is expected in spring 2023, with the Growth Fund also considered.
The cabinet expects to make a definitive decision on the investment in the PALLAS project in spring 2023.
Het kabinet zal naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2023 een definitief besluit nemen over de investering in het PALLAS-project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over overlast door transformatorstation TenneT in Krimpen a/d IJssel

An ChristenUnie MP asked the ministers about noise nuisance from a TenneT transformer replacement at the Krimpen a/d IJssel substation and why the northern site was chosen. The minister answered that the permit is a municipal matter, that TenneT justified the northern location with noise reductions and lower costs, and that participation of residents is a condition for good spatial planning.
Assessing the permit application is a municipal matter.
De beoordeling van de vergunningaanvraag is een gemeentelijke kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de bouw van het Datacentrum Zeewolde

The MP Grinwis asked ministers about the planned Meta hyperscale data centre in Zeewolde, including the government's ability to stop it, the sustainability conditions for selling state land, and the use of farmland and grid capacity. The minister answered that a preparatory decision restricts new hyperscale data centres, that TNO found the plan does not yet meet the sustainability conditions so the state land cannot be sold yet, and that legal tools to block the already adopted zoning plan are currently unavailable.
I myself asked the State Advocate for advice on my legal options to still stop the hyperscale data centre in Zeewolde.
Zelf heb ik de Landsadvocaat om advies gevraagd over mijn juridische mogelijkheden om alsnog het hyperscale datacenter in Zeewolde tegen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de onacceptabele uithuiszetting van huurders in Capelle aan den IJssel

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the housing minister how to stop landlords from using temporary leases in Capelle aan den IJssel to evict tenants and re-let at higher starting rents, and whether such caps could apply to starting rents. The minister said permanent leases should remain the norm, promised to extend the points-based rent system and make it binding, and said municipalities may get tools to curb misuse of temporary leases, while rejecting a cap on starting rents for liberalised homes.
As stated in the coalition agreement, fixed-term rental contracts must remain the norm.
Zoals in het coalitieakkoord is opgenomen, moeten vaste huurcontracten de norm blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over de energieleveringszekerheid voor aankomende winter

MPs Erkens and Grinwis asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about gas supply security for the coming winter, covering gas prices, storage filling, North Sea production, long-term LNG contracts, the gas-reduction plan, coal plant limits, insulation and batteries. The minister answered by referring largely to earlier letters to parliament, stating that prices are set by the EU market, that a versnellingsplan for North Sea gas will follow by July 2022, and that there is no room to force large gas users to switch immediately.
I see no room to immediately switch multiple large gas users over to sustainable alternatives.
Ik zie geen ruimte om meerdere grootverbruikers van gas per direct over te laten schakelen op duurzame alternatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Grinwis over de technische correcties van de CO2-doelen voor de glastuinbouwsector

MPs Valstar and Grinwis asked about technical corrections to CO2 emission ceilings for the greenhouse horticulture sector for 2018 to 2020, including delays and financial consequences. The ministers confirmed a correction for 2018 in line with the covenant criteria, said 2019 and 2020 ceilings would also be corrected and published, and committed to a new individual system and covenant 2021–2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Grinwis en Boswijk over het bericht 'Hoge gasprijzen dwingen vier van de tien glastuinders definitief of tijdelijk te stoppen'

MPs Valstar, Grinwis and Boswijk asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Agriculture about reports that high gas prices may force many greenhouse growers to stop, and about job losses, timelines for switching to sustainable heat, and support. The ministers acknowledge the sector's serious concerns and possible bankruptcies, say sustainability transitions take time, but refuse to compensate high gas prices and promise a letter at the end of April.
We cannot rule out that companies will go bankrupt.
Tegelijk kunnen wij niet uitsluiten dat er bedrijven failliet zullen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het snel opschalen van het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma

An MP asks the ministers to scale up and programmatically reshape the National Insulation Programme, including targeting the worst-insulated homes, coordinating with municipalities, and adding a voucher scheme. The government answers by referring to a separate letter presenting the National Insulation Programme, without addressing the questions in substance.

The written questions from MP Grinwis (ChristenUnie) to the Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning on rapidly scaling up the National Insulation Programme have been answered by means of the letter 'Presentation of National Insulation Programme'.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Grinwis (ChristenUnie) aan de Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening over het snel opschalen van het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma ( 2022Z00970 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «Aanbieding Nationaal Isolatieprogramma» (Kamerstuk 30 196, nr. 787 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Grinwis en Ceder over het gebruik van eHerkenning

MPs Omtzigt, Grinwis and Ceder asked why the government keeps requiring eHerkenning for tax filing despite a Gelderland court ruling questioning its legal basis, and about refunds, penalties and a free public alternative. The State Secretary defends the legal basis, says the ruling does not affect other tax assessments, offers a limited compensation scheme, and refuses to provide a free public login or restore paper filing for now.
To clarify this, I will have an addendum published on the Tax Administration's website.
Om dit toe te lichten zal ik een naschrift laten publiceren op de website van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'PostNL laat het afweten: honderden Hagenaars krijgen al drie weken geen post meer'

MP Grinwis asked the minister about reports of prolonged, large-scale non-delivery of mail by PostNL in The Hague and other municipalities, including questions on monitoring, the 95% delivery norm, liability and redress, and a request for talks with PostNL. The minister answered that the ACM supervises delivery quality, that PostNL exceeded the norm only through force majeure claims rejected by the ACM for 2019, that liability is limited by law, and that she had contacted PostNL, which has taken back delivery in the affected area.
I do not have this information.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Tata vervuilender dan gedacht: een gat in de administratie'

An ChristenUnie MP asked whether RIVM measurements showing more metals and PAH near Tata Steel IJmuiden than the emissions register predicts should lead to a continuous deposition monitoring programme, direct enforcement of Tata's permit, and similar checks on other large emitters. The state secretary said the discrepancy is worrying, that the province will investigate the reporting gap and deposition studies will be commissioned for 2022, but declined to order direct enforcement and deferred judgement on other emitters pending that investigation.
I consider it important that the reporting of emissions from the Tata Steel site and the underlying system be examined as quickly as possible
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er zo snel mogelijk naar de rapportage van de emissies van het terrein van Tata Steel en de achterliggende systematiek wordt gekeken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over het bericht ‘Meer verkeersongelukken in 2021, politie maakt zich zorgen’

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked about police concern over rising traffic accidents in 2021, including risky behaviour, nitrous oxide use in traffic, and the road safety targets and funding for dangerous N-roads. The minister outlined prevention and enforcement measures, said the nitrous oxide ban cannot take effect by 1 July 2022 due to procedure, and committed to a road safety target and prioritisation of N-road investments.
The cabinet is committed to reducing traffic participation under the influence of all drugs, and specifically nitrous oxide.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om verkeersdeelname onder invloed van alle drugs, en ook specifiek van lachgas, terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Grinwis en Van der Plas over de mogelijkheid dat de nachttrein Brussel/Amsterdam-Berlijn/Dresden/Praag ook in Hengelo stopt

MPs asked why the new European Sleeper night train from Brussels/Amsterdam to Berlin/Dresden/Prague does not stop in Hengelo despite earlier investment in the Hengelo-Bad Bentheim link and overnight travel gaps. The State Secretary explained that the stop is commercially and timetable-constrained for European Sleeper, that a stop in 2022 is unlikely, and that the government will explore whether a 2023 stop is feasible and talk with the operator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over spanningen bij toepassing van de Wwft

MP Grinwis asks the Finance Minister about tensions between Wwft anti-money-laundering rules and Dutch coffeeshop toleration policy, civil-law duties of care that require banks to keep accounts, notaries' confidentiality conflicts, the absence of a hardship clause, and the proportionality of bank de-risking, including whether to apply the Toeslagenaffaire lessons. The Minister answers that the tensions are for national legislators to resolve, that Wwft obligations are preventive and separate from criminal enforcement, that banks must assess risk individually, and that a notaries' confidentiality analysis and evaluation of the implementing act are underway.
We will inform your House further when conclusions have been reached with the parties involved in this matter.
Wij zullen uw Kamer nader informeren wanneer met de betrokken partijen tot conclusies in deze kwestie is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de documenten behorend bij het besluit op het Wob-verzoek inzake Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS)-melding Lelystad Airport d.d. 16 juli 2021

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the nitrogen calculations for the Lelystad Airport PAS notification, which appeared to be wrong, still permit legalisation, whether the errors were culpable, and why the ministry pursued the notification despite unresolved questions. The Minister answered that the notification meets the legalisation criteria, that the competent authority presumes good faith, that verification is still ongoing so no conclusions can yet be drawn, and that the 'top priority' label was an internal civil-servant qualification.
It is not advisable to make statements in advance about the outcomes of the legalisation process.
Het is niet verstandig om vooruitlopend hierop uitspraken te doen over de uitkomsten van het legalisatieproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Ceder en Grinwis over de toename in arbeidsuitbuiting

Christian Union MPs asked the ministers about the sharp rise in reported labour exploitation, why few cases reach prosecution, the dismissal of a case involving Filipino truck drivers, and protection for victims. The Secretary of State answered that most reports lack sufficient evidence, explained the prosecution and inspection process, said the high evidentiary burden limits prosecution, and promised implementation of the Aanjaagteam recommendations and a later review of article 273f, while noting the cabinet is caretaker.
However, a fully functioning cabinet and financial resources are needed for the decision-making on revising article 273f of the Criminal Code.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële middelen nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Bontenbal, Erkens en Grinwis over de stijgende gasprijzen

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about rising gas and energy prices, including household exposure, the causes, the Hermans motion funds, and whether France-style price freezes or targeted support should be used. The government answered that most households face higher bills, outlined temporary energy tax reductions for 2022 and a 150 million euro scheme for vulnerable households via municipalities, and rejected price regulation as market-distorting.
This therefore requires an individual assessment of the situation of all households. That information is not available.
Dit vergt dus een individuele beoordeling van de situatie van alle huishoudens. Die informatie is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Aukje de Vries en Grinwis over het bericht op NOS.nl getiteld ‘Spoorbrug over Van Harinxmakanaal bij Leeuwarden nog wekenlang defect’

MPs Heerema, De Vries and Grinwis asked the minister about a defect that left the Leeuwarden railway bridge over the Van Harinxmakanaal unable to open for shipping for weeks, its causes, repair timeline, communication, inspection frequency, and whether a replacement study is needed. The minister and state secretary answered that the bridge was repaired and reopened in early October, that ProRail sees no need for early replacement or a quickscan, and that inspections and repair costs were addressed.
ProRail did its utmost to restore the functioning of the railway bridge as quickly as possible and was in constant contact with the ministry, the province and the municipality.
ProRail heeft haar uiterste best gedaan de werking van de spoorbrug zo spoedig mogelijk te herstellen en heeft daarbij voortdurend in contact gestaan met het ministerie, de provincie en de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Gezondheidslobby casht jackpot in gokbranche'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about reports that health-sector organisations such as MIND promoted state-run lotteries, the role of the Nederlandse Loterij, gambling reclame rules, and monitoring of gambling addiction. The government answered most questions substantively, committing to talks with MIND and asking the Kansspelautoriteit to act, while noting data gaps (LADIS not operational) and that some questions fall under other ministries or are commercially confidential.
Regarding the budgeted financial returns of any participation, we do not share information because it may concern commercially sensitive and competition-sensitive business information.
Over begrote financiële opbrengsten van welke deelneming dan ook, delen wij geen informatie omdat dit mogelijk bedrijfs-commerciële en concurrentiegevoelige informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Miljoenenstrop dreigt voor vier grote zenders bij verlenging FM-vergunning'

MPs Grinwis and Rajkowski asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why the proposed fee for the emergency three-year extension of four national commercial FM radio licences is many times the current price, and how this fits with motions on digitalisation and COVID relief. The State Secretary answered that SEO's market-conform valuation, based on opportunity costs and CPB growth projections, was adopted, that the fee is not meant to compensate losses, and that the extension serves sector stability while digitalisation continues.
I am willing to extend the commercial licences for the requested period of three years.
Ik ben bereid om de commerciële vergunningen te verlengen voor de gevraagde periode van drie jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het omzeilen van het provisieverbod door enkele aanbieders van financiële producten

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether a fee-withdrawal facility that lets advisers collect commissions from clients' investment accounts circumvents the commission ban and distorts advice, and whether lijfrente products are treated unequally. The minister answered that the ban allows such facilities under conditions, that the AFM will be consulted on their effects, and that lijfrente account and insurance costs are treated equally.
I will ask the AFM to keep monitoring whether negative side effects arise from investment firms' use of the facility.
Ik zal de AFM vragen om in de gaten te blijven houden of er negatieve bijeffecten optreden als gevolg van het gebruik van de faciliteit door belegginsondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht "NVDE: volgend jaar twee miljard euro extra voor klimaat, vooral voor duurzame warmte"

An MP asks the state secretary about a CE Delft report on under- and overspending of SDE++ renewable energy subsidy budgets, the growing budget reserve, and calls for funding for sustainable heat. The state secretary answers that the budget is set conservatively, that reserves will be emptied by a new cabinet, that she will carry out the motion on a heat carve-out after the autumn round and will consider transparency suggestions, but rejects a reserve cap mechanism and a penalty scheme.
I intend to use the most current insights on energy and CO2 prices, based on the most recent KEV, to determine the opening budget of the SDE++.
Ik ben voornemens om de meest actuele inzichten van de energie- en CO 2 -prijzen – op basis van de meest recente KEV – te gebruiken voor het bepalen van het openstellingsbudget van de SDE++.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bikker over de verplichte acceptatie van een coffeeshop door ABN AMRO als klant

MPs Grinwis and Bikker asked whether coffee shops buying cannabis in cash fall under the Dutch anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), how many unusual-transaction reports coffee shops filed, whether prosecutions followed, and why supervision differs from other traders. The minister says coffee shops may fall under the Wwft above EUR 10,000 but that Wwft supervision of their soft-drug purchases is not applied in line with the tolerance policy, no coffee shop reports appear in FIU data, and a regulated cannabis supply experiment is planned.
Wwft supervision of coffee shops is carried out in line with the tolerance policy.
Het Wwft-toezicht op coffeeshops wordt in lijn met het gedoogbeleid uitgeoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Stoffer over de gevolgen van het UBO-register voor ondernemers, kerken en goede doelen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about costs of the UBO register for entrepreneurs, churches and charities, the handling of ANBI board members, and privacy risks. The government answered in detail, describing registration costs, a planned explanatory note on ANBI board members, and measures against scraping and privacy leaks.
To implement the Bruins motion, consultation with SBF examined ways to clarify the position of ANBI (charity) board members.
Ter uitvoering van de motie-Bruins is in goed overleg met SBF bezien welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de positie van (bestuurders van) ANBI's te verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Huis maximaal verduurzaamd en toch nog een torenhoge energierekening. Hoe kan dit?'

An MP asked the minister about higher capacity-based grid tariffs for households that have sustainably upgraded homes, and whether these discourage electrification. The minister said the number of higher-capacity connections is limited, that grid costs are shared among users under cost-reflective rules set by the ACM, and that Netbeheer Nederland is studying a new tariff structure.
This is not possible, since the allocation keys are set by the ACM. I am not competent to intervene in this.
Dit is niet mogelijk, aangezien de verdeelsleutels door de ACM worden vastgesteld. Ik ben niet bevoegd om hierop in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de steeds meer voorkomende «nep-sociale huur» en over de verhoging van de maximaal toegestane verkoopprijs bij sociale koopwoningen

MPs Grinwis asked about municipalities programming temporarily affordable 'social rent' from commercial parties, its long-term effects, and raising the maximum price for social owner-occupied homes to the NHG limit. The minister answered that municipalities have discretion, that regulated rent from commercial landlords lacks corporation duties such as passend toewijzen, and that the price cap rise aims to help build affordable starter homes in tight markets.
Private landlords do not have this task.
Particuliere verhuurders hebben deze taak niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Grinwis over het bericht 'Actiegroep: ministerie zwichtte voor vrees claim gaswinner'

MPs Bromet and Grinwis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ministry extended Vermilion's expired gas exploration licence out of fear of damage claims, and why relevant documents were redacted under the Wob. The minister denied this, citing the Mijnbouwwet's grounds, said extension differs legally from a new licence, and that existing licences are extended while new oil and gas licences are not issued per the coalition agreement.
The Mijnbouwwet has specific grounds for assessing (an extension of) an exploration licence.
De Mijnbouwwet kent specifieke afwegingsgronden voor de beoordeling van (een verlenging van) een opsporingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Bouchallikh, Grinwis, Van Raan en De Hoop over de minicargovluchten die worden uitgevoerd tussen Luik en Maastricht

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about mini cargo flights between Liège and Maastricht, including how many occurred, whether the minister still opposes them for environmental reasons, and whether a ban like France's is legally possible. The minister confirmed seven repositioning flights since January (six by Astral Aviation), said the EU framework lacks room for national bans, and promised to monitor France's case and raise the issue in revising EU Regulation 1008/2008.

A concrete legal basis for temporarily banning such flights due to serious environmental problems is absent from Dutch legislation and, given their cross-border nature, could not be unilaterally established by the Netherlands.

Een concrete wettelijke grondslag voor het tijdelijk verbieden van dergelijke vluchten wegens ernstige milieuproblemen ontbreekt in de Nederlandse wetgeving en zou gelet op het grensoverschrijdend karakter niet eenzijdig door Nederland vastgesteld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de consultatie op het conceptwetsvoorstel Wet aanpassing fiscaal kwalificatiebeleid rechtsvormen, waarmee wordt beoogd hybride mismatches aan te pakken én de plannen van de Ame

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Dutch box 3 wealth tax should be widened to cover shareholdings and loans to companies, as in Biden's plans, and whether the draft tax-classification bill would lead entities to restructure to avoid box 3. The State Secretary rejected the claim of a box 2 loophole, defended existing rules, and said the government would study real-return taxation and submit the bill separately.
The research report will be sent to the House of Representatives in the short term.
Het onderzoeksrapport zal op korte termijn aan de Tweede Kamer worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Snels, Inge van Dijk en Grinwis over de noodzaak om zo snel als mogelijk financiële instellingen verplichten over klimaatrisico’s te rapporteren

MPs asked the Finance Minister about speeding up mandatory climate-risk reporting by financial institutions, including the TCFD framework, its alignment with the EU's proposed revision of the non-financial reporting directive, and the timing of EU and IFRS standards. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU-level harmonisation over a national patchwork, and that it will assess the Commission proposal via a BNC-fiche and pursue international convergence rather than launch national legislation now.
The cabinet wants to work towards a swift and prompt completion of the European process and its implementation in our national laws and regulations.
Het kabinet wil zich inzetten voor een voortvarende en spoedige afronding van het Europese traject en implementatie daarvan in onze nationale wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Ceder over vastlopende hersteloperatie toeslagenschandaal

MPs Grinwis and Ceder asked whether the childcare benefit scandal restitution operation is stalling, why rejection letters after the light check lack a objection clause, whether the Catshuisregeling compromises care, and about moratorium, dossier access, and compensation capacity. The State Secretary answered that the operation is not stalling despite high workload, that the letter was amended to include an objection reference, and that all parents get an integral assessment with the moratorium and dossier processes described.
As a result, the letter was amended and the full legal remedies reference was included.
Naar aanleiding hiervan is de brief aangepast en is de volledige rechtsmiddelverwijzing wel opgenomen.

m: Amendement van het lid Raijer over het expliciet borgen van de regionale uitvoering van de ondersteuning aan zieke leerlingen en studenten
Amends the regional support structure for sick pupils and students so that regional implementation is secured and the minister designates the regions on the foundation's proposal.
Our Minister designates, on the proposal of the legal person, the regions that together form a nationally covering regional support structure.
Onze Minister wijst, op voordracht van de rechtspersoon, de regio’s aan die gezamenlijk een landelijk dekkende, regionale ondersteuningsstructuur vormen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raijer over het afschaffen van het predicaat cum laude aan de Universiteit Twente.

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the government agrees with the University of Twente's decision to abolish the cum laude distinction for PhD defences, a move it justified by gender inequality in assessment. The Minister said universities set their own doctoral regulations, expressed concern that assessing theses is not objectifiable, supported finding another way to recognise excellence, and declined to intervene or to ask the university to reconsider.
No, universities themselves determine their doctoral regulations.
Nee, de universiteiten stellen zelf hun promotiereglement vast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raijer en Wilders over het artikel 'gemeente zet stappen tegen moslimdiscriminatie met nieuw actieplan: 'Genoeg is genoeg''

MPs Raijer and Wilders asked whether the state will ban a Den Haag action plan's teaching materials on Islamic heritage and mosque visits, investigate their funders including foreign ones, and close Islamic schools. The State Secretary refused all demands, citing constitutional education freedom under Article 23, said no signals of non-neutral teaching exist, and pointed to the Justice Ministry for foreign interference reporting.
No. Article 23 of the Constitution protects the right to educational freedom and, more specifically, the free choice of teaching materials.
Nee. Artikel 23 van de Grondwet beschermt het recht op onderwijsvrijheid en – meer specifiek – de vrije keuze der leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raijer en Bosma over het stopzetten van het Sinterklaasfeest op een Utrechtse basisschool

MPs Raijer and Bosma (PVV) asked the Minister of Education whether a Utrecht primary school dropping Sinterklaas celebrations sets a precedent and whether the government will pressure schools to keep Dutch traditions. The state secretary answered that schools are free under the freedom of education to shape their own celebrations, declined to intervene, and said Sinterklaas remains widely celebrated.
Within the framework of freedom of education, it is up to schools themselves how they shape their education and the activities and celebrations that form part of it.
In het kader van de vrijheid van onderwijs is het aan scholen zelf hoe zij invulling geven aan hun onderwijs en aan activiteiten en vieringen die daar onderdeel van uitmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Raijer over de bezetting van het Academiegebouw in Leiden door gemaskerde pro-Palestijnse activisten

MPs Boon and Raijer (PVV) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the occupation of the Leiden Academy Building by masked pro-Palestinian activists, whether universities should engage with occupiers, whether the university must file a criminal complaint, and whether the action should be qualified as antisemitic. The minister said university boards decide interventions locally, that the Leiden board filed a complaint and police cleared the building, and that qualifying antisemitism is for the prosecutor and courts, not the minister.
I want to note that as Minister I cannot intervene in the prosecution service's decisions nor have any involvement in the legal process.
Ik hecht eraan te benoemen dat ik als Minister niet kan treden in opvolging door het OM noch bemoeienis kan hebben met de rechtsgang.

Motie van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz c.s. over een voorhangprocedure voor de AMvB die de nieuwe (spoed)samenwerkingsverbanden aanwijst

Gives the Huis voor klokkenluiders' investigation department power to impose administrative sanctions and fines on employers who harm whistleblowers or mishandle internal reporting channels.
This amendment provides that the investigation department of the Whistleblowers Authority gets sanction powers.
Dit amendement regelt dat de afdeling onderzoek van het Huis voor klokkenluiders sanctiemogelijkheden krijgt.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 43 over sanctiemogelijkheden voor het Huis voor klokkenluiders
Gives the Huis voor klokkenluiders power to impose orders, administrative fines and sanctions on employers who mishandle internal reporting channels or retaliate against whistleblowers.
The House is authorised to impose an order under administrative coercion to enforce articles 2, 8(2), 17e or 17ea.
Het Huis is bevoegd tot oplegging van een last onder bestuursdwang ter handhaving van de artikelen 2, 8, tweede lid, 17e of 17ea.
Amendement van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van der Laan over het bieden van bescherming aan vrijwilligers bij sportverenigingen
Extends whistleblower protection to people reporting abuses met during volunteer work at sports and dance clubs, and adds the Centrum Veilige Sport to the list of reporting channels.
The submitters recognise that abuses occur not only in work-related activities but also in activities carried out as volunteer work at amateur associations.

De indieners zijn zich ervan bewust dat misstanden niet alleen plaatsvinden bij werkgerelateerde activiteiten maar ook bij activiteiten die worden verricht in het kader van vrijwilligerswerk bij amateurverenigen.
Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Inge van Dijk over onderzoeken hoe de bestuurlijke en/of strafrechtelijke sanctiemogelijkheden kunnen worden uitgebreid
Asks the government to investigate how administrative and criminal sanctions against organisations can be expanded and which administrative body is best placed to enforce them.
requests the government to investigate how the administrative and/or criminal sanction options can be expanded

requests the government, in anticipation of establishing a fund supporting whistleblowers, to work on and make proposals on financing
verzoekt de regering vooruitlopend op de instelling van een fonds ter ondersteuning van klokkenluiders en melders te werken aan en voorstellen te doen

Shortens the first mandatory ministerial report to parliament on the law's effectiveness from five years to three, and subsequent reports to every three years.
the Minister will send a report to the States General within five years of the law's entry into force and every five years thereafter
de Minister binnen vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding van de wet en vervolgens iedere vijf jaar een verslag zal sturen naar de Staten-Generaal

requests the government to come up with a statutory anchoring of the Code for Children's Rights
verzoekt de regering te komen met een wettelijke borging van de Code voor Kinderrechten
Motie van de leden Leijten en Dekker-Abdulaziz over onderzoeken in hoeverre de universele dienstverlening van telefoniediensten verbreed kan worden tot internetdiensten
Asks the government to investigate whether the universal service obligation for telephone services can be extended to internet services.
requests the government to carry out research into the extent to which universal service for telephone services can be broadened to internet services

Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Ceder over socialmediaplatformen dwingen om de algoritmes op hun platformen voor kinderen uit te zetten
Asks the government to require social media platforms, nationally and in Europe, to switch off or adapt recommendation algorithms for children.
requests the government to force social media platforms, nationally and at European level, to switch off the algorithms on their platforms for children
verzoekt de regering om op nationale en Europese schaal socialmediaplatformen te dwingen de algoritmes op hun platformen voor kinderen uit te zetten
Motie van het lid Rajkowski c.s. over een ministeriële regeling veiligheid en integriteit voor de volledige Nederlandse vitale infrastructuur
Asks the government to make a ministerial regulation on security and integrity for all vital Dutch infrastructure against digital threats.
requests the government to make a ministerial regulation on security and integrity for the full Dutch vital infrastructure
verzoekt de regering een ministeriële regeling veiligheid en integriteit te maken voor de volledige Nederlandse vitale infrastructuur
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over het terugdraaien van de opschalingskorting meenemen in de nieuwe financieringssystematiek
Asks the government to include reversing the scaling-up discount in the design of the new healthcare financing system from 2026.
requests the government to include reversing the scaling-up discount in the design of the new financing system from 2026
verzoekt de regering het terugdraaien van de opschalingskorting mee te nemen in de vormgeving van de nieuwe financieringssystematiek vanaf 2026

Asks the government to run a pilot with a democratic donation credit before the 2025 municipal elections so all citizens can donate equally to parties.
requests the government to carry out an experiment with the democratic donation credit before the 2025 municipal elections
verzoekt de regering om vóór de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 2025 een experiment uit te voeren met het democratische donatietegoed
Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Kat over overheidsinstanties eerst een kosteloze betalingsherinnering laten sturen
Asks the government to urge agencies to send a free payment reminder before issuing a demand with collection costs, and to investigate making this mandatory.
requests the government to call on government agencies to first send a free payment reminder to the citizen
verzoekt de regering om overheidsinstanties op te roepen om eerst een kosteloze betalingsherinnering te sturen naar de burger

Motion asks the government to quickly prepare options for a larger own tax base for subnational governments and to inform the House this year about the proposals.
to inform the House in any case this year about the intended proposals for the larger tax base
de Kamer in ieder geval dit jaar nog te informeren over de beoogde voorstellen voor het grotere belastinggebied
Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Romke de Jong over raadsleden en Statenleden betrekken bij opstelling van het nieuwe financieringssysteem
Asks the government to involve councillors and provincial state members in drafting the new financing system for decentralised governments and to inform the House about how this will be done.
requests the government to specifically involve councillors and provincial state members in drafting and developing the new financing system for decentralised governments
verzoekt de regering specifiek raadsleden en Statenleden te betrekken bij het opstellen en uitwerken van het nieuwe financieringssysteem voor decentrale overheden

Amendement van de leden Leijten en Dekker-Abdulaziz ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het niet verlenen van erkenning aan private aanbieders die gegevens gebruiken voor commerciële doeleinden anders dan a

revenue is obtained from the use, trade or provision of data on users or authentication of users
inkomsten worden verkregen uit het gebruik, verhandelen of verstrekken van gegevens over gebruikers of authenticatie van gebruikers
Motie van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over een "open source, tenzij"-principe opnemen in de Wet digitale overheid

requests the cabinet not to include open source as a minimum requirement in the Digital Government Act.
verzoekt het kabinet om open source niet als minimale vereiste op te nemen in de Wet digitale overheid
Amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz c.s. over een verbod op discriminatoire selectie op grond van nationaliteit, geboorteplaats of daarvan afgeleide gegevens
Prohibits the Minister of BZK from processing nationality or birthplace data, or derived data, in the address-quality approach where this leads to discriminatory selection.
Our Minister is not competent to process data on nationality, birthplace or derived data in performing the task, insofar as the processing results in discriminatory selection of persons

Onze Minister is niet bevoegd om in het kader van de uitoefening van de in het eerste lid bedoelde taak gegevens over nationaliteit, geboorteplaats of gegevens die daarvan zijn afgeleid te verwerken, voor zover die verwerking discriminatoire selectie van personen tot gevolg heeft
Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Ceder over een privacy impact assessment onderdeel maken van de evaluatie
Asks the government to make a privacy impact assessment part of the evaluation of the amended law and to inform the Kamer.
requests the government to make a privacy impact assessment part of the evaluation, and to inform the Kamer about it
verzoekt de regering om een privacy impact assessment onderdeel te laten maken van de evaluatie, en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz c.s. over een verbod op discriminatoire selectie op grond van nationaliteit, geboorteplaats of daarvan afgeleide gegevens
Prohibits the Minister of the Interior from processing nationality or birthplace data, or derived data, in the address-quality project where this leads to discriminatory selection of persons.

Our Minister is not competent, in carrying out the task referred to in the first paragraph, to process data on nationality, place of birth or data derived from them, insofar as that processing results in discriminatory selection of persons.

Onze Minister is niet bevoegd om in het kader van de uitoefening van de in het eerste lid bedoelde taak gegevens over nationaliteit, geboorteplaats of gegevens die daarvan zijn afgeleid te verwerken, voor zover die verwerking discriminatoire selectie van personen tot gevolg heeft.
Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Ceder over een convenant met signaalleveranciers afsluiten voordat de wet in werking treedt

Asks the government to have an independent body, such as the Data Protection Authority, review the full set of risk profiles including those of signal providers before the law takes effect, to agree a covenant first, and to send annual overviews to the House.

requests the government to have an overview of the risk profiles, including those of the signal providers, independently reviewed, for example by the Data Protection Authority, before the law takes effect

verzoekt de regering een totaaloverzicht van de risicoprofielen, inclusief die van de signaalleveranciers, onafhankelijk te laten toetsen, bijvoorbeeld door de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, voordat de wet in werking treedt
Motie van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Ceder over onderzoeken wat de uitvoeringslasten zijn van het actief informeren van burgers wanneer er onderzoek van adresgegevens heeft plaatsgevonden

Asks the government to consult municipalities and study the administrative cost for mayors and aldermen of actively informing citizens about an address-investigation signal and its legal basis, and to report to the House.
noting that the current bill does not explicitly lay down the citizen's right to information
constaterende dat in het huidige voorstel van de wetswijziging het informatierecht van de burger niet expliciet is vastgelegd
Amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz c.s. over een verbod op discriminatoire selectie op grond van nationaliteit, geboorteplaats of daarvan afgeleide gegevens
Prohibits the Minister of BZK from processing nationality, birthplace or derived data in the address-quality programme where this leads to discriminatory selection of persons.

The Minister is not authorised, in carrying out the task in the first paragraph, to process data on nationality, birthplace or derived data, insofar as this processing leads to discriminatory selection of persons

Onze Minister is niet bevoegd om in het kader van de uitoefening van de in het eerste lid bedoelde taak gegevens over nationaliteit, geboorteplaats of gegevens die daarvan zijn afgeleid te verwerken, voor zover die verwerking discriminatoire selectie van personen tot gevolg heeft
Amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het binnen een week openbaar maken van bijdragen van meer dan 30.000 euro
Lowers the threshold for publishing donations above 50,000 euro to 30,000 euro and shortens the publication deadline from two weeks to one week in the political party financing bill.
In the first paragraph '50,000' is replaced by '30,000' and 'as soon as possible' is deleted.
In het eerste lid wordt «50.000» vervangen door «30.000» en vervalt «zo snel mogelijk».
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over een regeling voor subsidiëring van decentrale politieke partijen
Asks the government to submit a bill on subsidising local political parties and on transparency of their other income.
requests the government to submit to the House in 2022 a bill on political parties
verzoekt de regering in 2022 een voorstel Wet op de politieke partijen bij de Kamer in te dienen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het waarborgen van menselijke tussenkomst bij de controle van risicoprofielen
Requires the minister to take measures guaranteeing human intervention when developing risk profiles used to check citizens.
Our Minister takes appropriate measures to guarantee human intervention in the control when developing profiles
Onze Minister treft passende maatregelen om bij de ontwikkeling van profielen controle door menselijke tussenkomst te waarborgen.
Amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over terugkoppeling aan de burger dat er onderzoek van adresgegevens heeft plaatsgevonden
Amendment requires the municipal college to inform a person whose address data were investigated of the grounds for the investigation and whether it led to changes in the basic registry.
the college informs the person whose address data have been examined of the grounds for the investigation
informeert het college de persoon van wie de gegevens betreffende het adres zijn onderzocht over de gronden voor het onderzoek
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Leijten c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het waarborgen van menselijke tussenkomst bij het opvolgen van signalen
Requires that the mayor and aldermen take measures protecting persons whose address data is investigated after a ministerial signal, including a right to prior human intervention.
whereby this person has at least the right to prior review through human intervention.
waarbij deze persoon ten minste het recht heeft op voorafgaande controle door menselijke tussenkomst.
Amendement van het lid Rajkowski c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over over het toevoegen van een voorhangbepaling aan de artikelen 2.37c en 2.37f

Replaces an earlier amendment by adding a four-week parliamentary pre-submission period (voorhang) for the general administrative measures (AMvB) on personal data processing and analysis methods in the new provisions.
is not made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General
wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd
Amendement van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het waarborgen van menselijke tussenkomst bij de controle van risicoprofielen
Requires the minister to ensure human intervention in checking risk profiles used in automated controls, with measures set by general administrative order.
The Minister shall take appropriate measures to ensure human intervention in the control when developing profiles.
Onze Minister treft passende maatregelen om bij de ontwikkeling van profielen controle door menselijke tussenkomst te waarborgen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht over het visumbeleid door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

The MP asks whether the ministry ran a statistical bias test on the visa risk algorithm (IOB/KVV) after the PMP report, and if not, why the answer claims compliance. The minister says an external bias test by SigmaRed found no undue discrimination except a Yemeni-nationality deviation explained by documented hits, plus an experiment finding labels did not affect decisions; the earlier RIG study was rejected and monitoring will be added.
Yes, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs had a statistical validation study (bias test) carried out.
Ja, het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een statistisch validatieonderzoek (bias-toets) laten uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Dekker-Abdulaziz over strijd tegen Islamofobie

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister about rising Islamophobia, protection of mosques and Muslim communities, support for victims, and demonstrations, referencing press reports. The minister answered that discrimination figures for 2023 will be published in April 2024, pointed to existing measures (antidiscrimination services, the national programme, a Regioplan/Utrecht study) and said protection decisions are local and based on threat information, without committing to new Islamophobia-specific instruments.
Decisions on the implementation of these security measures are never publicly disclosed.
Over de invulling van deze veiligheidsmaatregelen worden nooit uitspraken in het openbaar gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Kat en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat AI-sites teksten van nieuwsmedia gebruiken zonder daar bronvermelding aan toe tevoegen

MPs asked whether AI sites reusing news texts without attribution, and the scope of the copyright text-and-data-mining exception, breach copyright and should be curbed. The government answered that the exception may cover scraping even of paywalled articles if access was lawfully obtained and no reservation was made, that attribution is not a legal condition, and that the EU AI Act and copyright evaluation will be used to address the issue.
Attribution is therefore not a condition for lawfully making a reproduction within text and data mining.
Bronvermelding is dus geen voorwaarde voor het rechtmatig kunnen maken van een reproductie in het kader van tekst- en datamining.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Temmink, Van Raan en Van Baarle over het bericht 'Tien camera’s per vierkante kilometer in database politie: ‘Onbespied over straat kan bijna niet meer’' en de uitzending

MPs from D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that private cameras registered with the police (Camera in Beeld) are growing, whether footage from unregistered private cameras, doorbell cameras and cameras pointed at public roads is lawful and usable, and whether this amounts to a nationwide surveillance network. The Minister answered that police may demand footage under article 126nda Sv for offences carrying four years or more, that misaligned cameras are a concern, that a nationwide network is undesirable, and that courts decide whether unlawfully obtained footage is admissible.
I therefore consider it important that camera owners continue to be reminded that they must adjust their cameras in line with the rules of the General Data Protection Regulation.
Ik acht het derhalve van belang dat camera-eigenaren er blijvend op worden gewezen dat zij hun camera moeten afstellen volgens de regels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het voorspellend algoritme van de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police predictive algorithm RTI-G, its effectiveness, discrimination risks, lack of appeal for citizens and whether it would be suspended. The minister answered that the police have stopped using RTI-G, that it was not self-learning, that ethnicity was removed in 2017, and that individuals cannot generally contest police tools during investigations except in court.
Individuals cannot always resist or defend themselves against the police use of a specific instrument.
Personen kunnen zich niet altijd verzetten of verdedigen tegen de inzet van een specifiek middel door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam en Van Baarle over het illegaal verzamelen van gegevens van uitkeringsgerechtigden door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's unlawful collection of benefit recipients' data via cookies and IP addresses for a fraud risk scan, its ethics and human-rights checks, the discrimination risk, data deletion, costs and proportionality. The minister acknowledged the cookie-based IP data was collected unlawfully and proportionality was lacking, stopped the scan, reopened 460 cases, and promised a technical briefing and further information, while withholding operational details for inspection reasons.
In the interest of inspection, control and supervision I cannot make this public.
In het belang van inspectie, controle en toezicht kan ik dit niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Minister gooit satellietbedrijf Inmarsat van 5G-frequentie'

MPs Amhaouch and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked why Inmarsat cannot get a longer licence in Greece, whether its demand for ten years of certainty is proportionate, and about the 3.5 GHz auction timing. The minister replied that Greece can grant only 5-year licences with a renewal already provided for, that no compensation has been agreed, and that the auction will move to 2024 depending on a pending court case.
However, I do not control whether interested parties initiate legal proceedings against the decisions I take.
Ik heb daarbij echter niet in de hand dat belanghebbende partijen juridische procedures aanspannen tegen de besluiten die ik neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Van Baarle, Koekkoek, Den Haan en Mutluer over de illegale undercover onderzoeken bij moskeeën

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about covert undercover investigations of mosques by her ministry, including whether affected citizens should be personally informed as the Landsadvocaat and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens urged. The minister admitted the processing of personal data lacked a legal basis and said the ministry will now actively inform those whose reliable contact details it can obtain, while others may ask the ministry whether they are in its records.
