My ministry will therefore actively inform those people for whom reliable contact details are available.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom die mensen actief informeren, van wie betrouwbare contactgegevens voor handen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat Nederlanders de overheid steeds minder vertrouwen met persoonsgegevens

An MP asked the State Secretary about declining public trust in government handling of personal data, AI and algorithm oversight, and cookie consent practices. The government acknowledges AVG compliance problems, defers mandatory algorithm registration and impact assessments pending the EU AI Act, and says it is pursuing EU-level cookie reform rather than national legislation.
The cabinet recognises that the current practice is unpleasant.
Het kabinet herkent dat de huidige praktijk onprettig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Bromet over het artikel 'Nederlandse gemeenten overtreden massaal de wet door achterkamertjes in te duiken'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch municipalities unlawfully hold informal closed meetings to avoid public scrutiny, and how the Municipalities Act and the Open Government Act apply. The Minister replied that the law sets openness as the rule, that informal technical or information meetings without decision-making are not regulated by the Municipalities Act, that no unlawful closed meetings were established, and that a circular on committees is being prepared.
I do not have figures on the number of municipalities that use closed meetings within the meaning of the Municipalities Act and other types of meetings.
Ik beschik niet over cijfermateriaal over het aantal gemeenten dat gebruik maakt van besloten vergaderingen in de zin van de Gemeentewet en andere type bijeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over de noodmelding van NL-Alert in Noord-Holland op 5 juli 2023

An MP asked the Justice minister why the 5 July 2023 NL-Alert emergency message for Noord-Holland pointed to Twitter for updates, which not everyone can access, and whether info should not depend on one tech platform. The minister replied that mayors and safety regions are responsible for local alerts, the national government does not review them, and she will check with the safety regions whether the guidance framework needs changing.
In times of disasters or crisis, it is the mayor who is responsible for alerting and informing citizens.
In tijden van rampen of crisis is het de burgemeester die de verantwoordelijkheid heeft voor het alarmeren en informeren van burgers
Antwoord op vragen de leden Azarkan en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht over het algoritmeregister

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Azarkan asked about an NOS report that the government's algorithm register offers little insight into algorithms and decision rules, and whether it will be expanded or evaluated. The State Secretary answers that the register is still being developed, that 123 algorithms are registered with only some fields complete, that government bodies are encouraged to publish, and that the aim is full coverage of high-risk AI by 2025, with a link to the upcoming EU AI Act registration duty.
It is important for transparency that all relevant algorithms are published by government bodies.
Het is voor de transparantie van belang dat alle relevante algoritmen gepubliceerd worden door overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Grevink over het bericht 'Schiphol en Havenbedrijf Rotterdam klagen de staat aan over 5G-beleid'

MPs asked the minister about the 3.5 GHz spectrum allocation for local use, after Schiphol and the Port of Rotterdam sued the state over the 5G policy and its first-come-first-served allocation. The minister answered that local-use concerns were partly accommodated in the final band plan, that the mainports' wish for a formal coordinating role is for the government to weigh in the allocation conditions, and that the appeals may delay but do not necessarily stop the auction.

However, it remains the (statutory) task of the government, specifically the Radio Communications Agency (RDI), to assess licence applications, coordinate with other radio services, and grant licences to applicants.

Het is en blijft echter de (wettelijke) taak van de overheid, specifiek die van de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI), om vergunningaanvragen te toetsen, de coördinatie met andere radiodiensten te verzorgen, en vergunningen te verlenen aan de aanvragers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over “het bericht ongeveer 2,2 miljoen mensen vorig jaar getroffen door cybercriminaliteit”

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to reports of 2.2 million cybercrime victims, ransomware payments, data breaches in government, reporting rates, and the MiND discrimination reporting point. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to existing strategies, prevention and reporting measures, rejected a ransom fund and paying ransoms, and promised to improve the MiND point's visibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over desinformatie

An MP asked the State Secretary of the Interior about disinformation, including criminal law use, algorithms and echo chambers, platform obligations under the DSA, and the role of citizens and media. The government answered that the DSA will bind very large platforms, that the state stays restrained on factchecking, and that it will report on the national strategy by end 2023.
At the end of 2023 we will inform the House about the progress in implementing the national strategy.
Eind 2023 zullen we uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de Rijksbrede strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Wuite over stemregistratie voor de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen in de Caribische Landen van het Koninkrijk

D66 MPs asked how the government will make European Parliament elections as accessible in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom as in the Netherlands, how it will involve Caribbean citizens in EU engagement, and how the planned dialogues and events will reach them. The minister says a policy paper will set out options (more voting locations, abolishing the registration requirement) with consultation of the Caribbean countries, and that the dialogues and events will be digital and open to all, with extra effort for youth and hard-to-reach groups.
The policy paper will set out a number of routes to increase the accessibility of the EP elections in the countries and to facilitate voters as much as possible in casting their vote.

In de hoofdlijnennotitie wordt een aantal sporen uitgewerkt waarlangs de toegankelijkheid van de EP-verkiezingen in de landen kan worden vergroot en kiesgerechtigden zoveel mogelijk kunnen worden gefaciliteerd in het uitbrengen van hun stem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Podt over het bericht over het visumbeleid door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Podt (D66) asked about press reports that the Foreign Ministry's visa profiling algorithm (IOB) may discriminate, including objections from the data protection officer and questions on transparency, the algorithm register, the Dutch DPA's role and waiting times at VFS Global. The minister replied that the IOB uses rule-based profiles, that legal advice from external counsel found the use of nationality lawful and non-discriminatory, that the algorithm will be added to the register by 1 January 2024, and that a new data protection officer will focus on oversight of the IOB.
The algorithm is not yet included in the Algorithm Register. The ministry will ensure that the algorithm is included and explained in the register by the set deadline of 1 January 2024.

Het algoritme is op dit moment nog niet in het Algoritmeregister opgenomen. Het ministerie zal er zorg voor dragen dat het algoritme voor de hiervoor vastgestelde uiterlijke datum van 1 januari 2024 in het register is opgenomen en toegelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Ouders gooien privacy van hun kinderen te grabbel op sociale media'

An MP asked the government about parents posting children's photos on social media, the privacy and misuse risks, and whether parental consent age should be raised. The government acknowledges the risks, points to existing GDPR and DSA protections, awareness campaigns, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's enforcement powers, and a forthcoming policy letter, without answering all questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Storing Vodafone: telefoonproblemen bij onder meer ziekenhuizen en 112'

An MP asked why 112 emergency calls failed for some Vodafone customers for nearly a full day on 14 April 2023, how this squares with rules requiring automatic fallback to another provider, and about 2G/3G switch-off, emergency call standards and a reporting point. The minister attributed the outage to a technical fault during night maintenance, explained existing legal rules and ongoing standardisation work, said a reporting point is still being explored, and reported no known casualties.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van der Laan over berichten over schermtijd

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van der Laan asked the State Secretaries for Health and for the Interior about reports on rising screen time among babies and young children, its effects, and what government will do to inform parents and address tech companies' role. The government answered that screen time has both benefits and harms, outlined existing youth health-care guidance, a planned public campaign, reliance on the EU Digital Services Act and talks with platforms, and declined to adopt France's age-15 social media rule because Dutch GDPR implementation already protects children under 16.

At the commission of the Alliance for a Digital Society, the Trimbos Institute is surveying the extent to which existing research can show the relationship between mental, social and physical health and screen time.

Het Trimbos-instituut inventariseert in opdracht van de Alliantie Digitaal Samenleven in welke mate bestaande onderzoeken beeld kunnen geven van de relatie tussen mentale, sociale en fysieke gezondheid en schermtijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het weerbaar maken van onze democratie tegen heimelijke (politieke) beïnvloeding

MPs Sneller and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the ministers about dark money, transparency of advertising and campaign financing, foreign donations to Dutch NGOs, and possible foreign influence on elections. The ministers answered that transparency is being strengthened through the EU political advertising regulation, the Wtmo bill and the Wfpp, but that many issues are still under negotiation or fall under other levels of government.
The cabinet is committed to further increasing this transparency.
Het kabinet zet zich ervoor in om deze transparantie verder te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Dekker-Abulaziz over het bericht dat 'de politie meekeek in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, whether this method is common at demonstrations, how Amnesty's criticism is answered, and whether the measure is effective, proportionate and subject to ministerial notification. The minister confirmed the reports, said online monitoring is used where serious public order disruption or crimes are expected within legal limits, and stated that proportionality assessments and the decision rest with police and the competent authority (mayor or public prosecutor), with internal work instructions not public.
This assessment is not made by me, but by the police under the responsibility of the competent authority.
Deze afweging wordt niet door mij gemaakt, maar door de politie onder verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Partners Code voor Kinderrechten teleurgesteld in aanpak ministerie’

MPs Drost and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked the State Secretary for Interior about the ministry's small, fragmented tender approach to the Code for Children's Rights online, versus a larger integral programme, and whether it would be revised. The State Secretary says the approach is content-driven, cites broader online child-rights policy and a planned letter, and declines to revise the approach while staying in dialogue with the original partners.
You will shortly receive a letter with an overview of all policy on children's rights online and its current status.
U ontvangt binnenkort een brief met het overzicht van al het beleid met betrekking tot kinderrechten online en de stand van zaken daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat ‘de overheid de gegevens van vliegpassagiers verzamelt’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the government collects airline passenger data beyond what the CJEU and the Data Protection Authority consider necessary. The Minister acknowledges the CJEU ruling, describes the data collected and retention periods, and commits to reducing the general retention period from five to three years and adding independent review and filtering measures.

In addition to the existing privacy safeguards, this year I will still make a number of adjustments to the processing of passenger data, in line with the Court's ruling and the request of the Data Protection Authority.

Naast de bestaande privacy waarborgen zal ik dit jaar nog – in lijn met de uitspraak van het Hof en het verzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens – een aantal aanpassingen doen in de verwerking van passagiersgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over TikTok

An MP asked whether TikTok's data protection raises high security risks and whether civil servants should be barred from having TikTok on work devices, citing the US ban for public representatives. The state secretary said the Irish privacy regulator's investigation into TikTok's data transfers to China is expected in the first half of 2023, referred to a forthcoming letter on the government's policy, and advised parliament to decide on additional measures itself.
I therefore advise the Dutch parliament to take note of the letter and, respecting its own independent position, to decide on any additional security measures.
Ik adviseer het Nederlandse parlement dan ook om kennis te nemen van de brief, en met inachtneming van zijn eigen onafhankelijke positie, te besluiten over eventuele extra veiligheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

D66 MPs asked ministers whether the Utrecht court ruling that the mayor could not impose an online area ban (ruling it an impermissible restriction of free expression reserved to national legislation) should be accepted, and what alternatives exist to tackle online incitement. The government declined to comment on the pending case, outlined administrative measures and a framework for mayoral powers, and said it would consider alternatives without committing to a specific legislative proposal.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual and/or pending cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele en/of lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Mutluer over het bericht dat pasfoto’s van buitenlanders ten onrechte door de politie gebruikt worden

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police use passport photos of foreigners from the CATCH-Vreemdelingen database, questioning the legal basis under the Aliens Act and whether it meets EU requirements. The Minister explains that police biometric experts run facial comparisons on the database only under Article 107(6) conditions, that the database is held separately from criminal law systems, and that practice applies the stricter conditions even to facial images, but does not concede any legal problem.
For the purposes of investigating and prosecuting criminal offences, the police do not have free access to the BVV and CATCH-Vreemdelingen.
De politie heeft ten behoeve van de opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten geen vrije toegang tot de BVV en CATCH-Vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht ‘Provincie Utrecht gebruikt als eerste overheid in Nederland een eerlijke CO2-prijs’

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the national government factors the costs of climate change into policy, whether a national CO2 price should be used, and whether ministers should report climate costs. The minister answered that the IAK and MKBA guidance already include CO2 prices, that the planning bureaus' efficient CO2 prices differ from Utrecht's social-cost approach, that he is willing to work toward a national CO2 price, and that reporting and decision-note requirements are left to individual ministers.
I would prefer to leave this to the ministers themselves.
Dit laat ik graag aan de Ministers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Meenen over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about recent developments in artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT's effects on education, the labour market, business use and national AI policy. The government answered that the effects are not yet fully known, outlined existing support programmes and monitoring, and promised to keep following developments; it did not answer question 12 about the debate timing as substance.
We have tried to answer the questions for the committee debate, but unfortunately this has not succeeded.
Wij hebben geprobeerd de vragen te beantwoorden voor het commissiedebat, maar dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘VS verbieden producten Huawei en andere Chinese bedrijven: ‘Onacceptabel risico voor nationale veiligheid’

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked the minister whether the Netherlands would follow US bans on Huawei and restrict Huawei's access to Dutch banks, and how far Huawei remains in Dutch telecom networks. The minister said the government shares US security concerns, that Huawei is already excluded from the vital core network with implementation being checked, that detailed supplier information is confidential, and that the Netherlands will decide independently on any bank-access restriction.
Detailed information on who uses which supplier where, and which phase-out deadlines apply, is considered commercially confidential information.
Gedetailleerde informatie over wie waar welke leverancier gebruikt, en welke uitfaseringstermijnen gelden wordt gezien als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het artikel 'Nieuwe app Forum lek: privégegevens alle 92.000 (oud-)leden op straat'

An MP asked the government about a reported data leak from the Forum party app exposing personal data of 92,000 current and former members, and about party member data handling, retention, oversight and subsidy use. The minister answered that parties may process member data under the UAVG with safeguards, that the Data Protection Authority decides compliance and will not comment on individual cases, and that the Wfpp requires an accountant's check of member counts, while a Wet op de politieke partijen is in consultation.
When asked, the AP indicated it does not wish to make statements about individual reports and cases in the context of any investigation.
Desgevraagd heeft de AP laten weten dat zij geen uitspraken wenst te doen over individuele meldingen en zaken in het kader van eventueel onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

Two D66 MPs asked the government about Almelo's municipal bylaw banning online posts that could cause physical disruption of public order, including enforcement, constitutional free-speech concerns under Article 7 of the Constitution, and the lack of a promised legal framework for municipal online monitoring. The Justice Minister answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for their bylaws, that enforcement rests with the mayor, that the censorship ban limits municipalities, and that the promised guidance on social media monitoring is delayed to Q1 2023.
I have understanding for the search by municipalities for ways to maintain public order where the cause lies in online conduct.
Ik heb begrip voor de zoektocht van gemeenten naar manieren om de openbare orde te handhaven als de oorzaak is gelegen in online gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Elon Musk daalt op zijn Twitter steeds dieper af in het konijnenhol'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about reports that Elon Musk's Twitter had cut staff, that hate speech had risen, and whether the government should keep advertising there, and asked how much the government spends on social media advertising. The State Secretary said the advertising budget was about 13.5 million euro in 2022, that Twitter's service and ad reach were unchanged, that there is no government-wide social media policy but a review is underway, and that the EU Digital Services Act will require Twitter to assess and mitigate rights risks.
DPC is currently exploring with ministries whether additional rules on advertising on social media are desirable and how these could be shaped.
DPC voert momenteel een verkenning uit bij departementen of aanvullende regelgeving t.a.v. het adverteren op sociale media gewenst is en op welke wijze deze dan gestalte kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het artikel 'Hoe Thierry Baudet de winst opstrijkt van een uitgeverij die met overheidssubsidie is opgezet'

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior Minister whether Forum voor Democratie used party subsidy to set up the publisher Amsterdam Books, now run by party-linked figures, and whether the subsidy should be stopped or recovered. The minister answered that the Wfpp does not regulate party structure or the conduct of party-linked persons, that the subsidised activities do not cover the BV's founding, and that subsidy would be recovered only if the audited accounts show unlawful spending.
If the process above shows that a political party has spent subsidy unlawfully, this may lead to recovery of the subsidy.
Indien op basis van het hierboven genoemde proces blijkt dat een politieke partij subsidie op onrechtmatige wijze heeft besteed, dan kan dat leiden tot het terugvorderen van de subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Dekker-Abdulaziz over Nederlanders in het buitenland die mogen stemmen op het Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Dekker-Abdulaziz asked about low registration by Dutch citizens abroad for the Kiescollege niet-ingezetenen election and what outreach is planned. The minister reports 23,427 registrations as of 22 December, describes the information campaign and notes that reasons for non-registration will be examined in the evaluation later.
As part of the evaluation of the Kiescollege election, this will be done among voters in the permanent register who have not registered for the Kiescollege election.
In het kader van de evaluatie van de kiescollegeverkiezing zal dit wel worden gedaan onder kiezers in de permante registratie die zich niet voor de kiescollegeverkiezing hebben geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht 'Don’t download Qatar World Cup apps, EU data authorities warn´

An MP asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether she would warn against, and discuss with Google and Apple, two Qatar World Cup apps flagged by EU data authorities as privacy risks. The State Secretary answered that she would warn citizens, endorsing the Dutch Data Protection Authority's advice, but saw no reason for separate talks with Google and Apple given the World Cup had ended for the Netherlands.
I see no reason to enter into talks with Google and Apple as a cabinet in addition to the regulators' message.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op de boodschap van de toezichthouders als kabinet hierover in gesprek te gaan met Google en Apple.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over de toegezegde brief aan het lid Rajkowski (VVD) tijdens het Commissiedebat Telecomraad van 31 mei 2022 over de mogelijke gevaren rondom het uitschakelen van 2G en 3G i

An MP asks whether the shutdown of 2G and 3G in 2025 will leave only 4G/5G for calls, whether government can influence the timing, and how emergency 112 reachability and VoLTE reliability will be affected. The minister answers that providers decide shutdown timing under technology neutrality, that VoLTE calling is not yet as reliable as 2G/3G but is being worked on, and that she will send a supplementary letter, without guaranteeing provider-independent 112 access.
At this moment I cannot guarantee that. But I am committed to it.
Op dit moment kan ik dat niet garanderen. Maar ik zet ik mij daar wel voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘DPG Media lanceert Seamless ads’

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked whether DPG Media's 'seamless ads', which can look like news articles, undermine trust in journalism and whether media should be required to label them. The Secretary of State answered that existing rules under the Civil Code, the Dutch Advertising Code and oversight by ACM and the Advertising Code Committee already require ads to be recognisable, that no new regulation is currently needed, and that the Press Council has no role here, but that the Advertising Code Committee will be asked what it can do.
I will ask the Advertising Code Committee what it could possibly mean in relation to seamless ads.
Ik zal aan de Reclame Code Commissie vragen wat zij mogelijk kunnen betekenen in relatie tot seamless ads.

Antwoord op van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Bouchallikh, Kathmann, Azarkan, Ceder, Van Weerdenburg, Koekkoek, Bontenbal, Leijten, Rajkowski en Eerdmans over het bericht ‘Chinese TikTok-medewerkers krijgen toegang tot data

MPs from eleven parties asked the government about a report that Chinese TikTok staff can access data of European users, including children's data, and what steps it would take. The State Secretary answered that TikTok could not say which staff access which data, that the Irish DPC and the Dutch AP are investigating transfers to third countries, and that the government will raise the issue with TikTok but leaves enforcement to the independent regulator.
At this moment we do not know which TikTok employees have access to which data.
Op dit moment weten we niet welke medewerkers van TikTok toegang hebben tot welke gegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Sjoerdsma over de Europese Parlementsverkiezingen van 2024 naar aanleiding van het kabinetsstandpunt over het initiatiefvoorstel van het Europees Parlement over de verk

The MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Sjoerdsma asked how many non-Dutch EU residents registered to vote in the 2019 European Parliament elections, how they were informed, whether turnout was evaluated, and about the timeline and direction of the European Electoral Act reform. The Minister answered that 56,637 registered in 2019, that municipalities are legally obliged to inform them, and that the Netherlands does not track their actual turnout, while promising further outreach and noting Council negotiations on the Electoral Act have only just begun.
The Netherlands does not keep track of how many of these persons actually went to vote.
Nederland houdt niet bij hoeveel van deze personen daadwerkelijk zijn gaan stemmen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dekker-Abdulaziz over het vervallen van de Tijdelijke wet digitale beraadslaging en besluitvorming provincies, gemeenten, waterschappen en openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked why the temporary law allowing digital deliberation and decision-making by local and provincial councils lapsed on 1 July 2022 despite rising COVID cases, and what problems local councils face. The minister answered that the law was not extended after parliamentary committee advice, that no major problems have been reported, that councils have fallback options within the current law, and that a new temporary law or permanent regulation will be introduced if needed.
If the health situation requires it, a new Temporary Act will be initiated so that decentralised representative bodies can meet digitally in a safe manner.
Indien de gezondheidssituatie daarom vraagt, zal een nieuwe Tijdelijke wet in procedure worden gebracht, zodat decentrale volksvertegenwoordigingen op een veilige wijze digitaal kunnen vergaderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Sjoerdsma en Dassen over de gele kaart procedure met betrekking tot de Europese kiesakte.

MPs asked whether the eight-week yellow card deadline for the European electoral act started from the Commission's publication date (3 May 2022), which would have expired before the 5 July vote on the motion. The minister answered that the period runs from the date the proposal was transmitted to national parliaments, which was 19 May 2022, so the deadline runs until 14 July and has not expired.
This means that the period within which each of the Chambers could issue a yellow card will expire on 14 July 2022 and therefore has not already expired on 28 June.
Dit betekent dat de termijn waarbinnen elk van de Kamers een gele kaart zou kunnen trekken op 14 juli 2022 zal verlopen en dus niet reeds op 28 juni is verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Ginneken over het gebruik van omstreden Chinese bewakingscamera’s door de Nederlandse overheid en politie

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Van Ginneken asked the ministers whether the Dutch government and police use Chinese surveillance cameras (Hikvision, Dahua), what security risks this poses, and what will be done. The government confirmed use of Chinese cameras, stated that national security is weighed in procurement case by case, announced a study into camera risks within central government, but said the police will keep using Dahua cameras and no central overview exists.
For this reason there is no central overview available of Chinese cameras in use by the government, the risks associated with them, or the considerations behind their purchase.

Daarom is er geen centraal overzicht beschikbaar van Chinese camera’s in gebruik bij de overheid en eventuele risico’s die daarmee verbonden zijn en ook niet van de afwegingen die ten grondslag lagen bij de aankoop.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Dekker-Abdulaziz en Rajkowski over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen inzake de vacature 'Senior beleidsmedewerker interceptie en digitale opsporing' bij het Minist

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about a senior policy vacancy on interception and digital investigation, and whether intelligence services could intercept encrypted OTT communications, and how quantum threats to encryption should be handled. The minister said intelligence services fall under other ministers, that an inventory of lawful access to encrypted evidence is underway with EU work pending, that OTT providers are currently not subject to decryption obligations, and that quantum effects on encryption fall outside the inventory's scope.
I cannot speak for the intelligence and security services (IenV services), as these services fall under the portfolios of the Ministers of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Defence.

Ik kan niet voor de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (IenV-diensten) spreken, deze diensten vallen onder de portefeuille van de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie.

m: Motie van de leden Klink en Kuik over e-procurement en e-tendering bij ngo's die financiering ontvangen
Asks the government, in dialogue with NGOs receiving funding, to allow e-procurement and e-tendering to improve transparency and reduce fraud in aid spending.
requests the government, in dialogue with NGOs receiving funding, to allow e-procurement and e-tendering
verzoekt de regering om in de dialoog met ngo's die financiering ontvangen e-procurement en e-tendering toe te laten passen
Motie van de leden Klink en Van der Graaf over de "Farmer Managed Natural Regeneration"-methode als vaste component in door Nederland gefinancierde activiteiten
Asks the government to examine how Farmer Managed Natural Regeneration can become a standard component of Dutch-funded activities on food security, climate, biodiversity and migration.
requests the government to examine how the Farmer Managed Natural Regeneration method can be integrated as a fixed component
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe de «Farmer Managed Natural Regeneration»-methode (FMNR) kan worden geïntegreerd als vaste component
Motie van de leden Amhaouch en Klink over aanvullende instrumenten voor risicodeling
Asks the minister to explore instruments within existing funds to provide first-loss capacity and risk sharing for companies investing in combination countries and Ukraine.
requests the minister to investigate and facilitate, within existing funds and instruments, a facility providing first-loss capacity and risk sharing
verzoekt de Minister binnen bestaande middelen te onderzoeken en te faciliteren om binnen de bestaande financiële middelen en instrumentarium een faciliteit te maken
Motie van het lid Klink c.s. over een gelijk speelveld met de omringende landen bij nieuwe imvo-wetgeving
Asks the government to set achievable goals for new due diligence (IMVO) legislation and ensure a level playing field with neighbouring countries, after broad consultation.
requests the government to ensure, through broad consultation with businesses, achievable goals for new due diligence legislation
verzoekt de regering te borgen, door onder andere via brede consultaties met ondernemers, het mkb en grote Nederlandse bedrijven haalbare doelen te stellen
Motie van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over een diversificatie- en onafhankelijkheidstrategie
Asks the cabinet to develop, with business and civil society, a strategy to diversify trade and reduce dependence on unstable countries.
requests the cabinet to work with business and civil society representatives toward a diversification and independence strategy
verzoekt het kabinet om samen met vertegenwoordigers van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven en het maatschappelijk middenveld te komen tot een diversificatie- en onafhankelijkheidsstrategie
Motie van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over het standaard ondersteunen van seksuele-gezondheidszorg en abortuszorg daar waar met Nederlandse middelen noodhulp wordt verschaft
Asks the government to routinely support sexual health and abortion care wherever Dutch-funded emergency aid is provided in conflict areas.
requests the government to try, wherever Dutch funds provide emergency aid, to always also standardly support sexual health care and abortion care
verzoekt de regering om te trachten, daar waar met Nederlandse middelen noodhulp wordt verschaft, ook altijd standaard seksuelegezondheidszorg en abortuszorg te ondersteunen
Motie van het lid Klink over een koppeling tussen landen waar irreguliere migratiestromen vandaan komen en de besteding van ontwikkelingssamenwerkingsgelden
Asks the government to carry out extensive research into the possibilities and effects of directly linking aid spending to countries of irregular migration.
requests the government to conduct extensive research into the possibilities and effects of a direct link
verzoekt de regering om uitgebreid onderzoek te doen naar de mogelijkheden en effecten van een directe koppeling
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over extra ondersteuning van LHBTIQ+-organisaties in de regio Oost-, Centraal Europa en de Kaukasus
Shifts 2.4 million euro within the foreign aid budget to support LGBTQI+ organisations in Eastern and Central Europe and the Caucasus.
Coverage is found in the non-legally mandatory expenditures of article 3.4
Dekking wordt gevonden in de niet-juridisch verplichte uitgaven van artikel 3.4
Motie van het lid Klink c.s. over de transitie van fossiel naar niet-fossiel
Asks the government to deliver by Q2 2022 a clear definition, timetable and support package for phasing out export credit insurance for fossil projects.
requests the government to have a clear delimitation, timetable and firm package ready by Q2 2022
verzoekt de regering om uiterlijk in het tweede kwartaal van 2022 een heldere afbakening, tijdpad en een stevig pakket voor behoud van kennis en banen gereed te hebben
Motie van het lid Klink c.s. over een verbinding van het Nederlandse innovatie- en handelsbeleid met een interdepartementale aanpak
Asks the government to link Dutch innovation and trade policy explicitly to an integrated interdepartmental approach for internationally operating business.
requests the government to make an explicit link between Dutch innovation and trade policy for internationally operating business
verzoekt de regering om voor het internationaal opererend bedrijfsleven een expliciete verbinding van het Nederlandse innovatie- en handelsbeleid te maken
Motie van het lid Klink c.s. over invest International als enig loket voor financiering van internationaal ondernemen
Asks the government to make Invest International the sole counter for financing international entrepreneurship.
requests the government to make Invest International the only counter for financing international entrepreneurship
verzoekt de regering om van Invest International het enige loket voor financiering van internationaal ondernemen te maken
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over de ROM's blijvend extra ondersteunen in de facilitering van de internationalisering van het mkb
Asks the Minister to continue extra support for regional development companies in helping SMEs internationalise.
requests the Minister to continue to extra support the ROMs in facilitating SME internationalisation
verzoekt de Minister de ROM's blijvend extra te ondersteunen in de facilitering van de internationalisering van het mkb
Motie van het lid Klink c.s. over internationaal actieve mkb'ers ook gebruik laten maken van fondsen
Asks the government to let internationally active SMEs also use funds such as Invest International, not only bank-linked financing.
requests the government to also let internationally active SMEs make use of funds such as Invest International
verzoekt de regering om internationaal actieve mkb'ers ook gebruik te laten maken van fondsen als Invest International
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over de ondersteuning van de huidige IMVO-convenanten continueren
Asks the government to continue its support for and involvement in existing IMVO covenants for the agreed term and to finish a new sectoral cooperation instrument.
requests the government to continue its support for and involvement in the current IMVO covenants for the agreed term
verzoekt de regering de ondersteuning van en betrokkenheid bij de huidige IMVO-convenanten voor de afgesproken looptijd te continueren
Motie van het lid Klink over het alleen op basis van wederkerigheid toegankelijk zijn van Nederlandse en Europese ODA-middelen
Asks the government to work within untied aid rules so that Dutch and EU ODA funds are accessible only on a reciprocity basis to companies from countries that do not respect international agreements.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Staaij, Peters, De Roon, Klink, Eppink en Omtzigt over de bescherming van mensen die met de dood bedreigd worden door wetten tegen geloofsafvalligheid en godslastering

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands is doing to press states that retain the death penalty for apostasy and blasphemy, including via UN resolutions, UPR reviews, and an international campaign, and how it protects people threatened in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and in UN fora, made statements and visits, supports a moratorium in principle, and cited Dutch criminal law and support for ex-believers, but gave no concrete new commitments.
The Netherlands is against the death penalty in all cases and under all circumstances and therefore gives extensive attention to these resolutions and parliamentary motions.
Nederland is tegen de doodstraf in alle gevallen en onder alle omstandigheden en geeft daarom uitgebreid aandacht aan deze resoluties en Kamermoties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over ‘Meer haat tegen lhbti'ers in sommige Afrikaanse landen, hoe komt dat?’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising hostility toward LGBTI people in some African countries, including Ghana's proposed anti-LGBTI bill, and asked about aid, diplomatic pressure and whether aid should be used as leverage. The minister answered that the Ghana bill conflicts with Dutch values, that the Netherlands has raised concerns through diplomatic channels and multilateral fora, and that aid suspension must be weighed carefully against side effects, with support for LGBTI organisations to continue.
The Netherlands has no programmes relating to law enforcement in Ghana.
Nederland heeft geen programma’s die betrekking hebben op de rechtshandhaving in Ghana.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het bericht 'Eindhovense toeleverancier van Philips en ASML opent vestiging in China'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a Dutch chip-supplier opening a plant in China could evade US restrictions, whether export controls, EU Chips Act goals, IP protection and screening of outward investment were adequate, and what sanctions were possible. The government answered that production abroad is not bound by Dutch law, that dual-use exports remain licensable, that outward-investment screening is awaiting an EU Commission analysis, and that no concrete measures against the firm were planned.
The cabinet has taken note of the European Commission's intention to examine the risks that may arise from outbound investments.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het voornemen van de Europese Commissie om de risico’s die mogelijk voortkomen uit uitgaande investeringen te gaan onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over berichten ‘VN-top over steun voor Hoorn van Afrika levert veel minder op dan gehoopt’ en ‘Italy looks to ‘strategic’ Horn of Africa for continental stability’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports on weak UN pledges for the Horn of Africa and Italy's strategic interest there, asking about Dutch humanitarian aid, aid priorities, cooperation with Italy and Dutch agri-business. The minister answered in detail on aid amounts, priorities, EU coordination and migration policy, committing to continued EU-level engagement but not to a specific bilateral talk with Italy.
The Netherlands therefore actively pursues a joint approach through the EU (and together with some member states), the World Bank and IFAD on various themes including food security.

Nederland zet daarom actief in op een gezamenlijke aanpak via de EU (en samen met sommige lidstaten), de Wereldbank en het International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) op verschillende thema’s waaronder voedselzekerheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het begrip huwelijkse gevangenschap

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about forced marriage detention (huwelijkse gevangenschap), its relation to SDG and CEDAW commitments, consular support, and international action. The Minister answered that the government opposes it, supports women's rights organisations through the SDG5 Fund, provides limited consular assistance, and raises the issue in EU and UN forums.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat de Oegandese regering het mensenrechtenkantoor van de Verenigde Naties niet zal verlengen

An MP asked the government about Uganda's decision not to renew the UN human rights office mandate, UN torture-committee criticism of torture and unauthorised detention ('safe houses'), and the implications. The minister answered that the government regrets the non-renewal, condemns the practices, will raise them bilaterally and in EU settings, and will monitor the situation.
The Netherlands will raise these practices with the Ugandan authorities bilaterally, either alone or within the EU.
Nederland zal de Oegandese autoriteiten over deze praktijken bilateraal, al dan niet in EU verband, aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht ‘Oeganda scherpt anti-homowetten nog verder aan, jezelf LHBTI+ noemen al strafbaar’

An MP asked the ministers whether the government knows of Uganda's new anti-LGBTI law, what it will do to protect LGBTI rights there, and whether aid to Uganda should be halted. The ministers condemned the law, described diplomatic démarches through the embassy, EU and Equal Rights Coalition, and said aid cannot be fully stopped though the law's consequences for rule-of-law support are being considered.
Dutch support for law enforcement programmes in Uganda will also be reconsidered.
Ook zal de Nederlandse steun aan rechtshandhavingsprogramma's in Oeganda worden heroverwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Van der Graaf, Van der Lee, Klink, Jasper van Dijk en Thijssen over de situatie in Turkije en Syrië na de aardbevingen van 5/6 februari jl.

Members of parliament asked about access for international aid to Syria after the February 2023 earthquakes, the role of civil society in opposition areas, EU reconstruction funding, psychosocial and care needs, and aid worker safety. The minister answered that aid access to northwest Syria remains dependent on Turkey-based UN deliveries, that the EU is coordinating mid- to long-term support through existing channels, and that psychosocial support is integrated into programmes.

As promised during the committee debate on humanitarian aid after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria of 22 February, I asked the European Commission on behalf of the cabinet, ahead of the EU donor conference, to prepare a proposal for medium- and long-term aid and to coordinate its implementation.

Zoals toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat Humanitaire Hulp na de aardbeving in Turkije en Syrië van 22 februari jl. heb ik voorafgaand aan de EU-donorconferentie namens het kabinet de Europese Commissie verzocht een voorstel te maken voor het leveren van middellange- en lange-termijnhulp en de implementatie hiervan te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht ‘Ik wil dat Wim wordt uitgeleverd aan Nederland. Zedenzaken tegen reformatorische hulpverlener stagneren’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about stalled sexual-abuse cases against a Reformed aid worker abroad, and about orphanage tourism. The minister said the government cannot prevent such crimes abroad, outlined steps taken since 2022 (screening via VOG, travel advice, awareness campaigns, a working group) but declined to reopen the 2020 Ecorys recommendations or rule out orphanage-tourism measures.
There is no reason for new research.
Er is geen aanleiding voor nieuw onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over Nederland betaalde verdachte stichting in corruptieschandaal Europees Parlement

An MP asked the minister whether the Dutch government funded No Peace Without Justice, a foundation suspected in the European Parliament corruption scandal, and about the grants, conditions, evaluation and termination of that funding. The minister answered that the ministry gave small grants in 2013, 2018 and 2022 (including EUR 500,000 for Afghanistan activities with conditions and reporting), no evaluation was done after 2022 media reports, and funding was not renewed pending the Belgian investigation.
The ministry will closely follow developments surrounding this dossier.
Het ministerie zal de ontwikkelingen rondom dit dossier nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer, Klink en Inge van Dijk over exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Stoffer, Klink and Inge van Dijk asked how the government accepts higher risks in green export credit insurance, what room Atradius DSB has, and how green export can be stimulated alongside phasing out fossil-related insurance. The government answered by listing measures such as lower financial requirements for small green transactions, longer loan terms, a green cover product, and OECD negotiations to modernise the Arrangement, noting 48 green transactions were insured in 2022.
The cabinet provides the maximum room within the set national and international frameworks, such as the EU state aid frameworks and the OECD Arrangement.
Het kabinet biedt de maximale ruimte binnen de vastgestelde nationale en internationale kaders zoals de EU-staatssteunkaders en de OESO Arrangement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat de VN nog 38 miljoen dollar tekort komt voor de berging van FSO Safer.

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a reported USD 38 million shortfall for salvaging the FSO Safer tanker, the role of Yemen's government, and the timing and feasibility of the operation. The minister answered that enough funds exist for the first phase, that Nederland is pressing the UN for speed, and that the Dutch firm Smit Salvage is negotiating the operation with the UN.
I recently also clearly conveyed the urgency of the situation and my great concerns about the progress to the head of UNDP.
Ik heb onlangs de urgentie van de situatie en mijn grote zorgen over de voortgang ook helder kenbaar gemaakt bij het hoofd van UNDP
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de mensenrechtensituatie in Oeganda

An MP asked about the human rights situation in Uganda, Dutch aid oversight, the withheld JLOS payment of €850,000 over unaccountable police violence, and the effectiveness of JLOS and private sector programmes. The minister said the government remains concerned, describes monitoring of aid projects, defends the withholding as a signal, and commits to conditional responses but declines any change to the aid relationship.
Currently there are no indications that development aid funds in Uganda are being used for activities other than those intended.
Momenteel zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat er OS-gelden in Oeganda worden ingezet voor andere activiteiten dan bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat Nederlands plan om Jakarta te redden van de zee hapert door «stroperig Indonesisch bestuur»

An MP asked why the Dutch-Korean Jakarta coastal protection plan (NCICD) stalls, whether it is a long-term solution, its costs and Dutch company involvement, and whether the minister will engage Indonesian counterparts. The minister replied that Indonesia decides on the measures and timing, that Dutch funding of about EUR 9 million ended in 2020, and offered to discuss cooperation if Indonesia requests it.
It is up to the Indonesian government to decide whether it wants to implement the proposed measures, how it wants to do so and when.
Het is aan de Indonesische overheid te besluiten of ze de voorgestelde maatregelen willen uitvoeren, hoe ze dat willen doen en wanneer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat Rusland voorlopig niet akkoord gaat met verlenging van de graandeal

An MP asked the minister whether Russia's refusal to extend the Black Sea grain deal and its claims about unmet export commitments were accurate, how sanctions relate to the deal, and how Dutch support is shaped. The minister replied that the deal was extended by four months, that the UN and UNCTAD manage sanctions exemptions for food and fertiliser, and that the Netherlands funds UNCTAD, CHD and WFP initiatives in support of the deal.
On 17 November it became known that, thanks to the efforts of the UN and Turkey, the grain deal has been extended by 4 months.
Op 17 november jl. werd bekend dat met dank aan de inzet van de VN en Turkije, de graandeal is verlengd met 4 maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat Nederlandse halfgeleiderproducenten op het boodschappenlijstje van Rusland staan ter bevoorrading van het rakettekort

Klink (VVD) asked the minister about reports that Dutch semiconductor producers appear on Russia's shopping list for its missile shortage, including possible Chinese ownership, export controls, sanctions evasion via intermediaries, and government subsidies. The minister answered that the components are universal and widely traded, that no evidence shows direct Dutch supply to Russian weapons makers, that the goods were added to EU sanctions in the eighth package, and that details of enforcement cannot be disclosed publicly.
On the Dutch information position regarding circumvention of trade bans, and the conduct of supervision, I make no statements in public.
Over de Nederlandse informatiepositie omtrent omzeiling van handelsverboden, en uitvoering van het toezicht, doe ik in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Klink over het bericht dat de Europese Unie voornemens is een waterstofbank in het leven te roepen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the EU plans a hydrogen bank with three billion euros and whether it could be located in the Netherlands. The minister answered that little is known yet, that the Commission is still developing the concept, that the government will monitor it and may align with Germany's H2Global, and that a full assessment must await more concrete information.
Little is yet known about the planned hydrogen bank.
Er is nog weinig bekend over de voorgenomen waterstofbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het charmeoffensief van Rusland in Afrikaanse landen

An MP asked the foreign trade and development minister about Russia's charm offensive in African countries, Lavrov's July 2022 visits, the African states that abstained or voted against the UN resolution on aggression against Ukraine, and Dutch aid funds flowing to their governments. The minister replied that the visits had limited impact, that Dutch aid to governments is mostly channelled through other actors with some exceptions, and that aid to Ethiopia, Mali and Burkina Faso is being reviewed for security and rule-of-law projects.

For this reason, a review is currently being carried out of the Dutch development cooperation projects in the field of security and rule of law, so that funding does not go through the central governments of Ethiopia, Mali and Burkina Faso.

Om deze reden wordt er thans een herziening uitgevoerd van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingssamenwerkingsprojecten op het gebied van veiligheid en rechtsorde, opdat financiering niet via de centrale overheden van Ethiopië, Mali, en Burkina Faso loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink en Kamminga over het bericht dat de Britten een wetsvoorstel hebben ingediend om Brexit-afspraken Noord-Ierland eenzijdig te wijzigen

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about a UK bill that would allow unilateral changes to Brexit Northern Ireland Protocol arrangements, including its impact on trade, Ireland, Dutch-UK relations and the role of the EU Court of Justice. The Minister answered that the government shares EU concerns, supports Commission dialogue and pressure measures, and urges the UK to honour its international obligations, while the bill's final content and implications remain uncertain.
The cabinet has, in the EU and in contacts with the UK, expressed its concerns about any form of unilateral action.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen periode in de EU en in de contacten met het VK zijn zorgen uitgesproken over iedere vorm van unilaterale actie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de uitzonderingen op Europese mededingingsregels van containerrederijen en prijsafspraken

An MP asked whether the EU competition exemption for container shipping consortia lets large carriers control capacity and prices, and what can be done about price transparency and the exemption's expiry in 2024. The State Secretary answered that the Commission found no evidence of anticompetitive conduct, attributed high prices mainly to supply-chain disruption, said transparency is the Commission's task, and said the Netherlands will await the Commission's review before acting.
Because oversight of this lies primarily with the European Commission, I would like to await its findings.
Omdat het toezicht hierop primair bij de Europese Commissie ligt, zou ik haar bevindingen willen afwachten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink en Ceder over de berichten 'Steun projecten die kinderen een thuis bieden, geen tehuis: 'Het is tijd voor een nieuwe stap'' en 'Een kindertehuis is geen goed systeem – maar de situat

MPs Klink (VVD) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the government addresses orphanage tourism risks, including follow-up to the Ecorys study, possible ANBI status changes, regulation of volunteer trips, campaigns, dialogue with providers, and mandatory VOG checks for volunteers. The minister responded that the government discourages such trips through travel advice, is studying regulation and will inform parliament before the summer recess, leaves ANBI questions to the finance state secretary, and points to sector-led campaigns and dialogue.
The aim is to inform the House before the summer recess.
Inzet is om de Kamer voor het zomerreces te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de handelsmissie van NABC naar Kameroen tussen 21 en 25 maart

MP Klink (VVD) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an NABC trade mission to Cameroon, including whether the travel advice was outdated, which sectors were safe for Dutch businesses, EPA and Global Gateway opportunities, food security, and the absence of a Dutch embassy in Cameroon. The Minister acknowledged the travel advice had been updated after COVID-related delays, pointed to trade opportunities in agriculture and other sectors, and explained that embassy support is provided via Benin and an honorary consul, while committing to no concrete new step.
The travel advice is updated periodically.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink, Kamminga en Van Campen over de nadelige gevolgen van het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië met betrekking tot de invoer van aardappelpootgoed uit de EU

MPs asked whether Brexit trade barriers harming the Dutch seed potato sector, including SMEs, would be eased by a derogation or by Brexit Adjustment Reserve support. The minister acknowledged the sector's difficulties, rejected a special derogation for seed potatoes, said export options to the UK are being explored but are complex, and pointed to an internationalisation programme and individual support.
However, this is extremely complex and time-consuming.
Dit is echter uiterst complex en tijdrovend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het persbericht van het Duitse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken inzake gesprekken in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a German Foreign Ministry press release on talks in Afghanistan, including whether Dutch funding of teacher and health-worker salaries via international organisations amounts to disguised budget support to the Taliban and whether humanitarian aid carries hard conditions. The ministers answered that funding of basic services is only considered under strict conditions (no Taliban involvement, equal access for women and girls, delivery via multilateral bodies or NGOs), that humanitarian aid is subject to softer conditions monitored by the UN and EU, and that the EU has earmarked funds for basic services.

Support must only be provided via multilateral organisations or NGOs, not (directly or indirectly) via the Taliban; there may be no substantive interference by the Taliban regarding policy, implementation and management

Zo dient steun alleen via multilaterale organisaties of ngo’s te worden verstrekt, niet (direct of indirect) via de Taliban; mag er geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis van de Taliban plaatsvinden m.b.t. beleid, uitvoering en management
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en Klink over het bericht 'Shell verhuist hoofdkantoor naar Engeland en wordt op papier volledig Brits'

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Foreign Trade ministers about Shell and Unilever moving their headquarters abroad, and the consequences for investment climate, employment, and Dutch international standing. Minister Blok answered that the government regrets Shell's plan, which moves about ten top jobs to London, is in talks with the company, and that Dutch investment climate remains good, citing confidentiality on the content of talks.
Given commercial confidentiality, it is not for me to go into detail about the content of these conversations.
Het is gezien de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet aan mij om in detail te treden over de inhoud van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de antwoorden op de vragen over aandacht voor het buitenland bij Pride Amsterdam

Rep. Klink (VVD) asked which of the 71 countries where homosexuality is criminalised receive Dutch ODA, how much, how much goes to civil society and LHBTI work, and for how long. The minister lists 45 such countries receiving ODA, says per-country figures are only available for delegated embassy budgets, and describes long-standing LHBTI support and decriminalisation efforts without committing to new action.
Although a large part of the 71 Zero Flags Project countries receive ODA funds, only expenditure from delegated budgets for 2020 can be reported.
Hoewel een groot deel van de 71 genoemde Zero Flags Project landen ODA-gelden ontvangt, zijn alleen de uitgaven op gedelegeerde budgetten voor 2020 weer te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Klink, Amhaouch en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Kabinet maakt reuzendraai: stopt toch met financieren fossiele brandstofprojecten in het buitenland'

MPs from VVD and CDA asked the government about the impact of signing the COP26 pledge to end international public support for unabated fossil energy by end 2022, including effects on firms, jobs, existing export credit insurance, transition support and funding. The minister answered that roughly a quarter of the export credit portfolio is fossil-linked, that 39 countries and institutions have signed, that new policy will be implemented by end 2022, and that existing policies and contracts are unaffected.
In 2022 the cabinet will work on new policy to end international public support for the fossil energy sector, particularly regarding the export credit insurance (ekv).
Het kabinet zal in 2022 werken aan nieuw beleid voor het beëindigen van internationale overheidssteun aan de fossiele energie sector, in het bijzonder voor wat betreft de ekv.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bestempelen van zes Palestijnse ngo’s als terreurorganisaties door Israël

An MP asked the government whether six Palestinian NGOs designated as terrorist by Israel are linked to the PFLP, their funding, OLAF investigations and the UAWC inquiry. The government answered that the evidence behind the listings has not been shared, that Nederland has requested it from Israel, and that the UAWC external investigation and the OLAF review are still pending.
The information underlying the six listings is not public.
De informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan de zes listings is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië voor de invoer van pootgoed uit de Europese Unie

An MP asked whether the UK's closure of its border to EU seed potatoes, and the resulting harm to Dutch growers, traders and cooperatives, would be addressed, including damage estimates, mitigation, use of the Brexit Adjustment Reserve and keeping Parliament informed. The minister agreed the closure is harmful, said the solution must come from EU-UK talks, gave only rough trade estimates, pointed to existing export support and Brexit Adjustment Reserve funding still being worked out, and considered the questions answered.
With the answers to the questions above, I trust I have informed you sufficiently.
Met de antwoorden op de vragen hierboven vertrouw ik erop u voldoende te hebben geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over aandacht voor het buitenland bij Pride Amsterdam

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about Pride Amsterdam's attention to LGBTI rights abroad, including how many countries criminalise homosexuality, whether Dutch aid goes to such countries, and what the government does to improve LGBTI people's position. The Minister confirmed that homosexuality is criminal in 71 countries, said Dutch aid still funds civil society there because rights work is needed most in such places, and listed diplomatic and funding instruments for LGBTI rights.
The human rights situation in a country is no reason not to finance activities there.
De mensenrechtensituatie in een land is geen reden om daar geen activiteiten te financieren.

m: Asks the government to coordinate and expand expertise at diplomatic posts on food and water as strategic development priorities.
requests the government to strategically coordinate existing expertise at the posts in the field of food and water
verzoekt de regering de bestaande deskundigheid bij de posten op het gebied van voedsel en water strategisch te coördineren
Asks the government to deliver by 1 March 2011 a plan to restructure the diplomatic post network along the lines of an earlier motion.
requests the government to come up with an elaboration as requested in that motion
verzoekt de regering met een uitwerking te komen zoals verzocht in die motie
Motion asks the government for a note by summer 2011 on Dutch policy on raw material security, especially rare earth metals.
requests the government to come up with a note before summer 2011 on integral Dutch policy
verzoekt de regering voor de zomer van 2011 te komen met een notitie aangaande het integrale Nederlandse beleid
Motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over de situatie in Papoea
Asks the government to seek open dialogue with Indonesia in international fora to stop human rights violations in Papua and report back.
requests the government to take initiatives in international fora leading to open and constructive dialogue with Indonesia on the situation in Papua
verzoekt de regering in internationaal verband initiatieven te ondernemen die moeten leiden tot een open en constructief overleg met Indonesië over de situatie in Papoea
Motie van het lid Nicolaï c.s. over beveiliging diplomatiek verkeer
Asks the government to review the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and inform the House before summer 2011.
requests the government to consider the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and to inform the House about it before summer 2011
verzoekt de regering zich te beraden op de technische beveiliging en classificatie van het Nederlandse diplomatieke verkeer en daarover de Kamer voor de zomer van 2011 te informeren
Asks the government to work in the UN on research into monitoring and compliance mechanisms for freedom of expression and news gathering online.
requests the government to work within the UN to research review and compliance mechanisms for the right to freedom of expression and news gathering
verzoekt de regering zich in te zetten om in VN-verband onderzoek te doen naar toetsings- en nalevingsmechanismen voor het recht op vrije meningsuiting en nieuwsgaring
Motie-Ormel c.s. over berechten van piraten
Asks the government to stop prosecuting pirates in the Netherlands where no clear Dutch interest is at stake.
requests the government no longer to prosecute pirates in the Netherlands in cases where no demonstrable Dutch interest is at stake
verzoekt de regering geen piraten meer in Nederland te berechten in die gevallen waarbij geen aantoonbaar Nederlands belang in het geding is
Amendement van de leden Ormel en Nicolaï ter vervanging van nr. 64 over het oormerken van een bedrag van 2 miljoen euro voor de opbouw van het justitiële apparaat op de Westelijke Jordaanoever
Earmarks 2 million euro in the foreign aid budget for building the justice apparatus in the West Bank.
to earmark an amount of 2 million euro for building the justice apparatus on the West Bank
een bedrag van 2 miljoen euro te oormerken voor opbouw van het justitiële apparaat op de Westelijke Jordaanoever
Motie Peters c.s. over side event voor Chinese kunstenaars tijdens de wereldexpo
Asks the government to work for its own side event with critical Chinese artists at the Shanghai World Expo.
requests the government to work for its own side event with critical Chinese artists
verzoekt de regering zich in te zetten voor een eigen side event met kritische Chinese kunstenaars
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over niet steunen van de toetreding van Iran tot de IMO
Asks the government not to support Iran's accession to the IMO Council in the election of council members.
requests the government, as a member of the IMO assembly, not to support Iran's accession to the council in the election
verzoekt de regering als lid van de IMO-vergadering, bij de verkiezing van de raad toetreding van Iran hiertoe niet te steunen
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over plaatsing van het Iraanse Revolutionaire Gardekorps op de lijst van terroristische organisaties
Asks the government to work toward the EU listing the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps as a terrorist organisation.
requests the government to promote that the European Union also place the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps on the European list of terrorist organisations
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat ook de Europese Unie het Iraanse Revolutionaire Gardekorps op de Europese lijst van terroristische organisaties plaatst
Motie Nicolaï c.s. over een selectiever en effectiever postennetwerk
Asks the government to propose a more selective and effective embassy network, including which posts to close, shrink, open or upgrade.
requests the government to come by 1 April 2010 with a proposal based on the Dutch interest for a more selective and effective embassy network
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk 1 april 2010 te komen met een voorstel uitgaande van het Nederlands belang voor een selectiever en effectiever postennetwerk
Amendement van de leden Van der Ham en Nicolaï over het niet generiek toekennen van de ontheffing van de sollicitatieplicht
Shortens the maximum period of exemption from the job-search obligation for benefit recipients from twelve to six years in three benefit acts.
In the fourth paragraph of article 9, '12 years' is replaced by: six years.
In het vierde lid van artikel 9 wordt «12 jaar» vervangen door: zes jaar.
Amendement van het lid Van der Ham c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het niet generiek toekennen van de ontheffing van de sollicitatieplicht

Replaces the articles of the bill so the maximum exemption period from the job-search obligation for single parents with a child under five is cut from twelve to six years rather than granted generically.
In the fourth paragraph of article 9, '12 years' is replaced by six years.
In het vierde lid van artikel 9 wordt «12 jaar» vervangen door: zes jaar.
qa: Vragen van de leden Nicolaï en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aantasting van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in Libanon (ingezonden 25 mei 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the restriction of freedom of expression in Lebanon after a World Press Photo exhibition was closed following removal of photos by an Israeli photographer. The minister agreed this was a serious infringement, said the embassy supported WPP's decision, and stated that freedom of expression is not well anchored in Lebanon.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï en Schaart (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een wapentransport onderweg van Turkije naar Jemen (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

MPs Nicolaï and Schaart asked the Foreign Minister about a seized arms shipment from Turkey to Yemen, whether it could destabilise Yemen, who was behind it, whether Turkey was aware, and Dutch arms-export criteria for Yemen. The minister said the UAE authorities are investigating and may later share details, that Turkish authorities were not aware and had not licensed it, and that all Dutch export applications for Yemen are on hold.
The authorities in the UAE are conducting the investigation into this incident and may in due course be able to provide information on the client, carrier and final destination of the transport.

De autoriteiten in de VAE verrichten het onderzoek omtrent dit incident en zullen te zijner tijd wellicht in staat zijn om informatie te verschaffen over opdrachtgever, vervoerder en einddoel van het transport.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï, Van der Steur en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie over publicaties van Wikileaks (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

Three VVD MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about WikiLeaks publications, including who can access SIPRNET, how allies store and control access to sensitive information, whether passenger data access is limited, and whether the government will seek clarification and safeguards. The minister answered that details of US systems are not disclosed, that NATO inspections and bilateral responsibility govern information security, that the Netherlands was pre-informed of publications, and that the need for additional measures is under study.
Regarding how the system is managed and who has access to it, no statements are made given the classification of the system.
Over de vragen hoe het systeem wordt beheerd en wie daartoe toegang heeft worden gezien de classificatie van het systeem geen mededelingen gedaan.

Vragen van de leden Schaart en Nicolaï (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de door China aangekondigde verlaging van de export van zeldzame aardmetale

MPs Schaart and Nicolaï asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about China's reduced export quotas for rare earth metals, its effect on Dutch raw material security, and how the government will safeguard that security. The government answered that there is no acute supply problem yet, pointed to a CBS/TNO study of critical raw materials, and described EU and WTO efforts against Chinese export restrictions, including a WTO dispute panel expected to rule in early 2011.
I will inform the House about this.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ormel (CDA) en Nicolaï (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het weigeren van een delegatie burgemeesters uit Israël (ingezonden 21 septemb

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch embassy advised the VNG against receiving Israeli mayors from West Bank settlements, on what international-law grounds, and what the government would do about the diplomatic fallout. The minister denied the embassy issued a formal negative advice, said the government avoids legitimising settlements but does not prevent others from contacting them, and described the VNG as an autonomous body free to decide.
The VNG is free to decide independently with whom it wishes to have contacts.
Het staat de VNG vrij zelfstandig te beslissen met wie het contacten wil aangaan.
Vragen van de leden Nicolaï en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over vervolging van homo’s in Malawi (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

MPs Nicolaï and Ten Broeke asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of gay men in Malawi, including a reported 14-year sentence for a male couple, and whether the government and EU had condemned it and whether it affects aid relations. The minister referred to earlier answers, said the Netherlands has no bilateral aid relationship with Malawi, noted that the EU ambassadors and the High Representative publicly condemned the case while the Commission's aid is unaffected for now, and described NGO work on HIV/AIDS prevention among vulnerable groups including homosexuals.
The conviction of the homosexual couple has so far had no consequences for the European Commission's aid to Malawi.
De veroordeling van het homostel heeft vooralsnog geen consequenties voor de hulp van de Europese Commissie aan Malawi.
Vragen van het lid Nicolaï (VVD) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Syrië aan Hezbollah Scudraketten verstrekt (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

MP Nicolaï asked the foreign minister about reports that Syria supplies Scud missiles to Hezbollah and what the consequences would be for the region, the peace process and relations with Syria and the EU. The minister answered that the reports were not verifiable, that such supplies would breach UN resolutions 1559 and 1701, and that the matter would be raised in the UN Security Council and EU if confirmed, without committing to concrete steps.
So far these reports have not been objectively verifiable.
Vooralsnog zijn deze berichten niet objectief verifieerbaar gebleken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Pechtold (D66), Nicolaï (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Iraanse toetreding tot de Mensenrechtenraad van de VN (in

MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would oppose Iran's candidacy for the UN Human Rights Council given its human rights record, and what that would mean for the Council's credibility. The minister replied that Iran withdrew its candidacy and that the Netherlands had actively lobbied against it, and that it will continue to keep notorious rights violators out of the Council.
In the future too, the Netherlands will continue to work unabatedly to keep notorious human rights violators out of the Council.
Ook in de toekomst zal Nederland zich onverminderd blijven inzetten om notoire mensenrechtenschenders buiten de Raad te houden.

m: Motie van de leden Ram en Hirsch over de Kamer beter informeren over de ontwikkelingen en besluitvorming rond revolverende fondsen
Asks the government, together with the rapporteurs, to explore how the Chamber can be better informed about revolving funds so it can exercise its budget right.
requests the government, together with the rapporteurs, to explore how the Chamber can be better informed about developments and decision-making on the revolving funds
verzoekt de regering om samen met de rapporteurs in overleg te verkennen hoe de Kamer beter geïnformeerd kan worden over de ontwikkelingen en besluitvorming rond de revolverende fondsen
Motie van het lid Ram over een heldere exitstrategie voor de twaalf revolverende fondsen
Asks the government to draw up a clear exit strategy with end dates and agreements with the Kamer for all twelve revolving funds, citing the Kamer's budget right.
the absence of agreements affects the Kamer's budget right
ontbreken van afspraken het budgetrecht van de Kamer raakt
