Motie van het lid Ram over ontbindende voorwaarden stellen aan ngo's, waaronder het erkennen van de staat Israël en het bestrijden van antisemitisme
Asks the government to attach termination conditions to NGO funding, including recognition of the state of Israel and combating antisemitism.
requests the government to attach termination conditions to NGOs
verzoekt de regering om ontbindende voorwaarden te stellen aan ngo's
Motie van het lid Ram over het openbaar maken van financiële jaarverslagen en jaarrekeningen expliciet opnemen in subsidievoorwaarden en contracten met ngo's
Asks the government to require NGOs receiving subsidies to publish their annual financial reports in subsidy conditions and contracts.
requests the government to explicitly include public disclosure of financial annual reports in the subsidy conditions
verzoekt de regering om het openbaar maken van de financiële jaarverslagen en jaarrekeningen expliciet op te nemen in de subsidievoorwaarden
Amendement van het lid Ram over het schrappen van de bijdrage aan UNRWA
Moves 19 million euro from the UNRWA contribution in the foreign affairs budget to a general article, permanently ending the payments to UNRWA.
With this amendment the submitter aims to structurally end the spending on UNRWA of 19 million euros
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener structureel de uitgaven aan UNRWA van 19 miljoen euro
Motie van het lid Ram over exportvergunningen voor levering en onderhoud van defensieproducten verstrekken voor de gehele contractduur
Asks the government to issue export licences for defence products for the full contract duration, with an opt-out clause if a country's human rights situation changes.
to issue export licences for the supply and maintenance of defence products for the full intended contract duration
exportvergunningen voor de levering en het onderhoud van defensieproducten voor de gehele voorgenomen contractduur te verstrekken
Motie van het lid Ram over stoppen met het beleid van SDG 5-doel gendergelijkheid in combinatie- en ontwikkelingslanden
Asks the government to stop its policy of enforcing SDG 5 gender equality in combination and developing countries.
requests the government to stop the policy of SDG 5 gender equality in combination and developing countries
verzoekt de regering te stoppen met het beleid van het SDG 5-doel gendergelijkheid in combinatie- en ontwikkelingslanden
Motie van het lid Ram c.s. over een pas op de plaats maken bij langjarige financiële verplichtingen voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Asks the demissionary government to pause entering new long-term financial commitments for development cooperation, or implementing them.
requests the government to pause, during the caretaker period, the entering into new long-term financial commitments for development cooperation

verzoekt de regering om in de demissionaire periode een pas op de plaats te maken waar het gaat om het aangaan van nieuwe langjarige financiële verplichtingen op het gebied van ontwikkelingssamenwerking
Motie van de leden Ram en Kamminga over het opbouwen van een gelijkwaardige handelsrelatie tussen Nederland en India
Asks the government to work with India to build a reciprocal, equal trade relationship aimed at strengthening both economies and expanding bilateral trade.
Requests the government to explore with India how an equal trade relationship can be built with the Netherlands.
verzoekt de regering om samen met India te onderzoeken hoe met Nederland een gelijkwaardige handelsrelatie kan worden opgebouwd
Motie van het lid Ram over de soevereiniteit en energiemix van landen respecteren en stoppen met klimaatbeleid in combinatie- en ontwikkelingslanden
Asks the government to respect other countries' sovereignty and energy mix and stop climate policy in combination and developing countries.
requests the government to respect countries' sovereignty and energy mix and stop climate policy in combination and developing countries
verzoekt de regering de soevereiniteit en energiemix van landen te respecteren en te stoppen met klimaatbeleid in combinatie- en ontwikkelingslanden
Motie van het lid Ram over overleg met het bedrijfsleven en alle regio's over het bevorderen van de buitenlandse handel
Asks the government to consult all business sectors and regions on plans to promote foreign trade.
requests the government to consult with all business sectors and all regions to make plans to promote foreign trade
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met alle sectoren van het bedrijfsleven en met alle regio's om plannen te maken om de buitenlandse handel te bevorderen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over de onduidelijkheid rondom Nederlands belastinggeld bij USAID

An MP from the PVV asked the minister why EUR 18.5 million in Dutch aid funds sent to USAID since 2014 remains unclear regarding its use and possible repayment, and whether payments via USAID should stop. The minister answered that monitoring and reporting exist, that USAID's overdue report prevents assessment of whether funds were used as intended and whether repayment is due, and that no new contributions via USAID are currently planned.
Only on the basis of the report can I assess whether the amount was used for the intended goals, and whether (part of) the money must be repaid.
Op basis van de rapportage kan ik pas beoordelen of het bedrag is ingezet voor de beoogde doelen, en of (een deel van) het geld moet worden teruggestort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over het langlopende conflict tussen Multraship en de Roemeense overheid

An MP asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development whether the government would press Romania to pay Terneuzen salvage firm Multraship an arbitration award unpaid for about 20 years, and what steps it would take. The minister answered that Romanian courts refused enforcement over procedural faults by Multraship, that the Netherlands is facilitating dialogue, and that the matter will be raised with the Romanian counterpart once a new government is in place.
Once a new cabinet has taken office I will raise this matter with my Romanian counterpart.
Zodra een nieuw kabinet is aangetreden zal ik deze zaak opnemen met mijn Roemeense counterpart.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over het bericht dat UNRWA toch 68 miljoen euro krijgt vanuit de EU

An MP asked the minister whether the EU's decision to pay UNRWA despite allegations that staff were involved in the 7 October attacks was acceptable, and whether the Netherlands would press to reverse it and cut ties. The minister answered that the Commission decided independently, that UN investigations are ongoing, and referred to an earlier letter for the Dutch position without committing to new action.
The decision whether or not to fund UNRWA is an independent decision of each donor separately.
Het besluit om UNRWA al-dan-niet te financieren is een eigenstandig besluit van elke donor afzonderlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over het bericht ’Paniek bij UNRWA om stopzetten financiering was allemaal theater’

An MP from the PVV asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about a report that UNRWA's alarm over suspended funding was staged, and about the government's view of UN Watch's criticism, the independence of two investigations into UNRWA, and international initiatives to end UNRWA. The minister disagreed with the characterisation, described UNRWA's dependence on voluntary donor funding, defended the independence of the OIOS and Colonna-led reviews, and said no international initiative to end UNRWA is currently pursued.
The cabinet has no reason to doubt the independence or professionalism of the conduct of these investigations.
Het kabinet heeft geen reden te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid of professionaliteit van het verloop van deze onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over het vervangen en vervolgen van UNRWA

An MP (PVV) asked whether UNRWA staff in Gaza were linked to Hamas, whether UNRWA should lose all Dutch support, whether it can be sued or banned, and whether COGAT and WFP could take over its work. The minister acknowledged the reports, declined to cut support or pursue legal action citing UN immunity, and argued there is no alternative to UNRWA in Gaza at this stage.
Only the UN can lift this immunity or suspend operations.
Alleen de VN kan deze immuniteit opheffen of werkzaamheden opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel ‘Amsterdamse extremisten maken gebruik van El Tawheed moskee’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the El Tawheed mosque should be closed because a group that supports armed jihad uses it. The government declined to comment on the concrete case, said criminal investigation is possible if offences are indicated, and explained that courts can ban an organisation on Public Prosecution Service request and that closing a building for safety violations is a local authority matter.
In addition, a building as such can be closed if there is, among other things, non-compliance with fire and safety regulations.
Daarnaast kan een gebouw als zodanig gesloten worden indien er, onder andere, sprake is van niet-naleving van brand- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat drugsafval het riool overspoelt

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Environment ministers about drug waste dumped into sewers and on land, including incident counts, lab takedowns, enforcement capacity, prevention, BOA safety and who pays the cleanup costs. The government answered that no national dumping figures are kept, cited 24 lab takedowns and doubled LFO capacity, said the polluter should bear costs, and pointed to a one-million-euro amendment-funded contribution and a Brabant cleanup protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Segers over het bericht ‘Gezamenlijke ketenactie tegen arbeidsuitbuiting en mensenhandel’

MPs Van Laar and Segers asked about a joint enforcement action against labour exploitation and trafficking on Bonaire, including how few addresses were checked, why action came only now, victim shelter, and prostitution policy. The minister reported no arrests and no finding of underpayment or exploitation, promised recurring joint checks at least four times a year, and said a revised MoU is expected in June 2015.
Agreements have been made to act jointly at least four times a year, with prostitution being one of the sectors that will regularly be checked.
Er zijn afspraken gemaakt om ten minste vier keer per jaar gezamenlijk op te treden waarbij prostitutie een van de sectoren is die regelmatig zullen worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht ‘Bank weigert rekening aan sekswerkersclub’

MP Rebel asked the Finance and Justice ministers whether a bank refusing a business account to a sex workers' advocacy club was justified and how government will improve sex workers' access to financial services and tax deductions. The minister answered that banks set their own acceptance policies, that individual cases are not reviewed, and that the NVB will issue an information leaflet while casework is referred to it.
I do not intervene in a bank's assessment of individual cases.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling door een bank van individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over radicalisering in de Somalische gemeenschap

An MP asked the ministers about radicalisation in the Somali community, including returns to Somalia and whether Dutch Somalis radicalise there. The minister said no return figures or reasons are systematically recorded, radicalisation abroad cannot be ruled out, and prevention work such as the POLRAD project is ongoing.
The reasons for their return are not recorded by the government, because there is no ground or reason to do so.
De redenen voor hun terugkeer worden niet door de overheid geregistreerd, omdat hier geen grond of aanleiding voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de televisieuitzending over de ‘portemonneetest’

Rep. Krol asked the Interior and Justice ministers how the government views a TV test in which wallets handed in to police or municipal offices went missing, with 640 euros gone from five of them. The minister said the government expects careful conduct, reports that a municipal employee was dismissed and a police investigation is ongoing, but declined to commission nationwide research, saying municipalities are responsible for their own operations.
It is therefore up to the council to judge how the task is carried out in its own municipality.
Het is derhalve aan de raad om een oordeel te vellen over de wijze waarop in de eigen gemeente uitvoering wordt gegeven aan deze taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Siderius over de financiële en sociale gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de kinderalimentatie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Social Affairs and Finance about the financial and social effects of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen on child maintenance, including whether recipients lose out and whether the scheme leads to conflicts and a flood of maintenance cases. The minister answers that most recipients gain, that effects depend on individual cases, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects some extra change requests, and that no compensation is planned.
The exact consequences for child maintenance depend heavily on the facts and circumstances of a specific case.
De exacte gevolgen voor kinderalimentatie zijn sterk afhankelijk van de feiten en omstandigheden in een specifiek geval.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt (over het wetsvoorstel „Hervorming Kindregelingen” waarin het woord alimentatie in de memorie van toelichting slechts een keer voorkwam en wel in de artikelsgewijz

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked the government about the Hervorming Kindregelingen bill, its limited treatment of child maintenance (alimentatie), the promised standard calculation rule and advice from the judiciary, and the effects on divorced parents' incomes. The minister replied that the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice is attached, that existing alimentatienormen serve as the basis, that parents can seek advice from the Juridisch Loket, mediators or lawyers, and that a further analysis of the bill's consequences was being prepared, without providing a new calculation tool.
I asked the Council for the Judiciary to advise on the House's request to develop a standard calculation rule for child maintenance.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak gevraagd advies uit te brengen over het verzoek van de Tweede Kamer om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel inzake de berekening van kinderalimentatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over het niet respecteren van de rechten van vakbonden

MPs Van Nispen and Ulenbelt asked whether the European Patent Organisation in The Hague violates union rights, and why Dutch bailiffs were ordered not to enforce a court ruling against it because of its immunity. The minister said he cannot confirm the alleged conflict, that immunity rules mean the court ruling cannot be enforced in the Netherlands, that internal appeal routes exist, and that the Netherlands will raise the matter with the organisation and its governing council.
The cabinet cannot make substantive statements about court rulings.
Het kabinet kan inhoudelijk geen uitspraken doen over gerechtelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de illegale handel in puppy’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about illegal cross-border puppy trade, document fraud, online sales, veterinary complicity, police and NVWA enforcement, and a lifetime animal-keeping ban. The government answered that it has taken measures, pointed to separate letters, said veterinarians cannot be prosecuted without proven intent, rejected mandatory parent-dog presence, and promised an evaluation of the keeping ban before the summer recess.
At the request of the House, the Minister of Justice will also examine in the evaluation the possibilities of imposing the keeping ban as a standalone measure or penalty.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer laat de Minister van V&J in de evaluatie ook kijken naar de mogelijkheden het houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel of straf op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht ‘Wegpiraat ontloopt zijn straf’

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether the number of fines for serious traffic offences had fallen sharply, what explains the drop in stops since 2007, and how the government will respond. The Minister answered that criminal traffic stops have been stable (around 84,000 a year), attributed the earlier decline mainly to lower traffic volume and the abolition of ticket quotas, said the actual detection probability cannot be determined, and noted an early start to a new repeat-offender approach from 1 January 2015.
The number of stops for criminal traffic offences has been stable in recent years.
Het aantal staandehoudingen voor strafrechtelijke verkeersovertredingen is de laatste jaren stabiel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over verkeershufters die minder vaak worden gepakt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why traffic offenders are caught less often, and whether this undermines the effectiveness of the beginner-driver and repeat-offender measures and road safety. The minister attributes the decline mainly to reduced traffic during the economic crisis and the abolition of ticket quotas, states that stopping offenders remains important but that no effectiveness-of-stop research exists, and reports on the status of enforcement experiments and speed camera systems, promising to monitor the experiments.
After that period, all final results will be mapped out and decisions will be taken on any further steps to be taken.
Na afloop van die periode zullen alle eindresultaten in kaart worden gebracht en beslissingen worden genomen over eventuele te zetten verdere stappen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Oskam over de taak van gemeenten in relatie tot radicalisering en uitreizende jihadisten

MPs Heerma and Oskam asked how municipalities are supported by central government in tackling radicalisation and jihadist departures, including the expert unit and the claim that municipalities lack clarity. The minister replied that the expert unit became operational in February 2015 and is being built up, that a range of support tools exist, and that a 10-point plan was drawn up for municipalities.
Central government assists municipalities in preventing radicalisation and managing social tensions.
Het Rijk staat gemeenten bij in de preventie van radicalisering en de beheersing van maatschappelijke spanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over de brandveiligheid van windmolens

Two PvdA MPs asked about fire safety of wind turbines after a fire at Ooltgensplaat, and whether investigations were still pending. The government answered that forensic, fire brigade and labour inspectorate investigations are ongoing, with results expected around summer 2015, and that the Chamber will be informed of outcomes.
Publication of the reports will follow as soon as possible, insofar as the Public Prosecution Service does not object because of criminal law aspects.
Publicatie van de rapportages volgt zo spoedig mogelijk, voor zover het Openbaar Ministerie dit niet bezwaarlijk acht vanwege de strafrechtelijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gouds bestuur lost vrouwenkwestie op’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a planned wall separating women from view of Muslims in a Gouda redevelopment amounts to sharia-based apartheid, and whether the government will ban mosque construction and the planned Gouda mega-mosque. The minister answered that the wall is a site-entrance separation requested by a special school and a child day-care centre, and that the mosque has offered to reduce its size, with an independent facilitator starting a new consultation; he reiterated that Muslims may build mosques within zoning rules and the law.
The mosque board of the new mosque planned in Gouda recently (mid-March) offered to substantially reduce the size of the mosque.
Het moskeebestuur van de nieuw te bouwen moskee in Gouda heeft recent (half maart) het aanbod gedaan om de moskee qua omvang substantieel te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

An SP MP asked ministers about foreign financing, the role of imam Tarik ibn Ali, possible salafist involvement, and the mosque's gender separation and segregation effects in Gouda. The government answered that the municipality commissioned a PWC audit finding 0.05% of funds from two other Schengen countries, that the Bibob advice is pending, and that the mosque's size and related decisions are a local responsibility.
I cannot make statements about individual ongoing investigations.
Over individuele (lopende) onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de gevolgen van in Nederland begane verkeersovertredingen met auto’s met een buitenlands kenteken

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement of traffic fines against foreign-plated vehicles, including data exchange under the Cross Border Enforcement directive, collection rates, and a 2013 Wob request by RTL. The minister answered that the new directive was adopted in March 2015, that enforcement of French plates began in December 2014 and Polish plates was still being prepared, that collection rates are partial, and that the RTL request was partly granted after court proceedings, with some information unavailable.
RTL did not receive data overviews because there were no overviews or other documents within my ministry containing such data.
RTL heeft geen data-overzichten ontvangen, omdat er zich geen overzichten of andere documenten binnen mijn ministerie bevonden waarin dergelijke data zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over voetbalgeweld door zichzelf Feyenoord-supporters noemende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked about Dutch Feyenoord supporters rioting in Rome, Dutch mayors' powers to impose restrictions for conduct abroad, EU options to deport or ban convicted hooligans, Italian fine enforcement, and Engeland's travel bans. The government answered that mayors may consider foreign conduct under art. 172a Gemeentewet, that EU deportation is limited to genuine threats to public order, that Italy may seek Dutch help on fines after judgments become final, and that it will raise an international stadium ban in EU and Council of Europe fora.
I will ask the European Union and the Council of Europe to pay attention to establishing an international stadium ban and to explore other options to prevent hooligans from causing problems abroad.

Ik vraag binnen de Europese Unie en de Raad van Europa aandacht voor het tot stand brengen van een internationaal stadionverbod en voor het onderzoeken van andere mogelijkheden om te voorkomen dat hooligans in het buitenland voor problemen zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Voordewind over het bericht 'Rotterdam fnuikt thuisonderwijs'.

MPs Bisschop and Voordewind asked whether Rotterdam's approach to home-schooling exemptions under the Leerplichtwet complies with the law, whether parents are properly informed, and whether pressure on parents is being exerted. The State Secretary answered that Rotterdam acts within the law, that exemptions are ultimately decided by courts, that parents can complain to the municipal ombudsman, and that he intends to remove the exemption ground from the law but no amendment takes effect for 2015–2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS ziet immigrant als wapen’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that IS sees migrants as a weapon, and possible jihadist infiltration via the Libya-Italy route, mean a security emergency at the borders, and whether the government can guarantee no terrorists will arrive. The government answered that it is alert to signals of misuse of the refugee flow, describes existing reporting structures, awareness efforts and coordination bodies, but does not guarantee that no terrorists will arrive.
The Netherlands and the EU, including the implementing organisations, are alert to signals that ISIS or other jihadist organisations are misusing the refugee flow to reach the Netherlands or Europe.
Nederland en de EU, inclusief de uitvoeringsorganisaties, zijn alert op signalen van misbruik van de vluchtelingenstroom door ISIS of andere jihadistische organisaties naar Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de afschaffing van de opbrengsten van de proces verbaal-vergoeding voor gemeenten

CDA MPs asked whether the WODC study on abolishing the proces-verbaal fee for municipalities will examine effects on neighbourhood liveability, police workload, BOA dismissals, municipal budgets and use of administrative fines. The minister answered that the study focuses on registration and spending of the fees rather than direct effects, that no signals of BOA dismissals or budget cuts have been found, and that no VNG inventory is needed for now.
The short time elapsed since the abolition of the fee scheme, as well as the period made available for the study, currently make it impossible to map the effects of the abolition.

De korte tijd die is verstreken sinds de afschaffing van de vergoedingsregeling, alsmede de voor het onderzoek beschikbaar gestelde periode, maken het op dit moment niet mogelijk de effecten van de afschaffing in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het Aeronautical Fixed Telecommunication Network (AFTN) van 3 maart 2015

An MP asked which Dutch parties connect to the AFTN network, whether ICAO and Dutch bodies received special alert messages about eastern Ukraine before the MH17 crash, and about the OVV investigation into route choice. The government answered that ICAO does not send messages over AFTN, that no such special alerts were known to the Dutch government, and that the OVV independently decides what it investigates.
The OVV is independent and itself determines which incidents it investigates.
De OVV is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf welke voorvallen hij onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over foto's van Shabir Burhani waarop hij met wapens poseert

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers how the state acts against radicalised people photographed with weapons, including Shabir Burhani, and whether training with the Taliban and a statement endorsing the Charlie Hebdo attack constitute a threat. The Justice Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to general criminal provisions and the Integrated Jihadism Action Programme, and said whether the statement is a threat is for the courts to decide.
As stated, I cannot make any statements about investigations into individual cases.
Zoals gemeld kan ik over onderzoek naar individuele zaken geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het veilen en opvangen van dieren na een inbeslagname

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked why a severely neglected pony was auctioned after a bankruptcy and whether curators may auction animals and pressure debtors with seizure threats. The government answered that auctions are permitted under the Bankruptcy Act, that criminal complaints were filed, that curators must follow the Animal Welfare Act and may be complained about to the rechter-commissaris, and that no additional national policy is considered necessary.
This of course does not prevent those involved from complaining about the curator's conduct to the rechter-commissaris, who supervises the proper handling of the bankruptcy.
Dit laat uiteraard onverlet dat betrokkenen zich over het gedrag van de curator kunnen beklagen bij de rechter-commissaris, die toeziet op de correcte afwikkeling van het faillissement.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de aanwezigheid van voormalig secretaris-generaal en van een zedenmisdrijf verdachte Joris Demmink bij de nieuwjaarsborrel van de Commandant Koninklijke Marechaussee

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Defence about the presence of former secretary-general Joris Demmink, a suspect in a sex offence case, at the Marechaussee commander's New Year reception, including whether the minister had contact with him and whether the commander would be called to account. The minister answered that all guests were received the same way and that Demmink is presumed innocent until proven otherwise in court.
All guests at the New Year reception of the Governor of the Residence were received in the same way.
Alle genodigden voor de nieuwjaarsreceptie van de gouverneur der Residentie zijn op dezelfde manier ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Recourt over het bericht «Bonnenregen onterecht»

MPs Hoogland and Recourt asked whether many motorists were wrongly fined on the N261 near Tilburg due to roadworks and unclear speed limits, and what would be done about it. The Minister of Justice replied that the public prosecutor found no evidence the fines were wrong, that individual appeals remain possible, that no separate count of wrongful fines is kept, and that no new measures are planned beyond the earlier answer.
I cannot provide such an overview. No separate registration is kept of this.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan ik niet geven. Hiervan wordt geen aparte registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en De Boer over cyberaanvallen op reisinformatiedienst 9292

Two VVD MPs asked whether the NCSC would assist travel information service 9292 against cyberattacks, arguing it has a statutory duty to inform travellers. The Minister replied that travel information providers are not a vital sector, so NCSC direct support is not provided, that 9292 has no statutory information duty, and that NCSC will consult 9292 on making its public knowledge available.
Incidentally, 9292 has no statutory duty to provide information to the traveller.
9292 heeft overigens geen wettelijke plicht tot informatievoorziening aan de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Haatimams naar Utrecht’

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about a planned Utrecht event featuring a controversial preacher, his radical views, and whether visa refusal or withdrawal and organiser responsibility could be used. The government answered that the preacher did not appear, there was no public order risk, and it outlined visa powers under the Schengen framework, local mayoral powers, and that the CMO will inform mosque organisations.
The event in Utrecht took place on Sunday 1 March last.
Het evenement in Utrecht heeft op zondag 1 maart jongstleden plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van reisinformatiediensten

An MP asked the government whether the national cyber security centre should actively help public transport travel-information provider 9292 against DDoS attacks, whether it has designated a travel-information operator, and how to make vehicle data resilient and open. The minister answered that travel-information providers are not a vital sector so NCSC gives only online guidance, that no designation under the Passenger Transport Act is needed, and that data delivery and open-data work will be discussed in the national public transport consultation without firm dates.
Providers of travel information are not part of the established list of vital sectors.
Aanbieders van reisinformatie zijn geen onderdeel van de vastgestelde lijst van vitale sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat extremistische sjeiks welkom zijn in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Utrecht event featuring the Saudi preacher Al-Hakeem, whose statements they called incitement to violence, would go ahead, and what the government would do about his visa and the organisers. The ministers answered that he was not known to have attended, that his statements would be unacceptable in the Netherlands, that visa refusal for hate preachers is policy, and that no criminal ground existed to ban the event.
This consideration was not at issue.
Deze afweging was niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over een voor het bezit van kinderporno veroordeelde psychiater die werkt met misbruikte patiënten

MPs asked whether a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography continued to treat patients with histories of sexual abuse, and whether the Public Prosecution Service informs the Health Inspectorate about such convictions. The minister confirmed the psychiatrist treated such a patient, that the Inspectorate now refers such cases to the disciplinary judge, and that a revised cooperation protocol with the Public Prosecution Service is being prepared, with a promise to finish it within months.
Following the tightened position, the IGZ and the OM are working intensively on renewing the cooperation protocol.
Naar aanleiding van het aangescherpte standpunt werken de IGZ en het OM intensief aan het vernieuwen van het samenwerkingsprotocol.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over de rol van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bij een psychiater die veroordeeld is voor het bezit van kinderporno en nog

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked how the health inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) handled a psychiatrist convicted of possessing child pornography who kept practising, and whether the employer should have been informed. The ministers answered that the IGZ was informed in 2012, opened an investigation and a supervision plan, took a disciplinary case in 2014, and that the OM-IGZ cooperation protocol is being revised to allow sharing of such information.

From the standpoint of patient safety, my view is that possessing, distributing or viewing child pornography by healthcare professionals is so transgressive that it poses a risk to patient safety, and that the convicted psychiatrist should have informed his employer of his conviction.

Vanuit oogpunt van de patiëntveiligheid is mijn standpunt dat het, verspreiden of bekijken van kinderporno door zorgprofessionals dermate grensoverschrijdend is dat het een risico vormt voor de veiligheid van patiënten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over het bericht ‘Schrik na drie steekpartijen op school in week’

MPs Tellegen and Straus asked the state secretary and justice minister about school stabbings and rising reported weapon possession among pupils, including its causes, the types of weapons, and measures to curb it. The government answered that it is addressing weapon possession through school safety policy, checklists and the Convenant Veilige School, but that the monitor cannot confirm an objective rise in weapon possession, which may reflect stricter reporting and zero-tolerance policy.
I will also have the checklist for introducing weapon possession controls at schools updated.
Ook laat ik de «checklist invoering controle op wapenbezit scholen» actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam over het intrekken van de visa van predikers

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked why the NCTV letter on withdrawing visas for preachers bears a 23 February creation date and a 3 March date, and about its reference number, timing, inter-communication, Schengen coordination and a database of banned preachers. The government explained the letter was written and sent on 17 February, copied on 23 February with only the official's name removed, that the reference number reflects creation date, that other Schengen states can be asked to revoke visas, and that a usable alert list will be delivered by 1 April.
The NCTV letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was written, signed and sent on 17 February.
De brief van de NCTV aan het Ministerie van BZ is op 17 februari geschreven, ondertekend en verstuurd naar het Ministerie van BZ.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de berichten ‘Amateurclub OFC naar de top dankzij dubieuze geldschieter’ en ‘De bad boys van Young Boys’

An MP asked whether amateur football clubs are protected against criminal influence, match-fixing and money laundering, and whether investigations into OFC's sponsor and into other clubs would be opened. The minister answered that preventive measures and new legislation on doping and gambling are in preparation, that clubs can make their own rules, and that no comment can be made on ongoing criminal investigations.
No statements can be made about the preliminary investigation or about concrete ongoing criminal investigations that are in the investigation phase.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over het voorbereidend onderzoek dan wel over concrete (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken die zich in de opsporingsfase bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht “Oefenwedstrijden Nederlandse teams in Spanje mogelijk gefixt”

An MP asked whether Dutch sports teams' friendly matches abroad may have been fixed and about the status of the justice investigation into match-fixing. The Minister replied that the OM continuously reviews signals, cannot disclose ongoing investigations, that five suspects were recently arrested, and that measures against match-fixing are being implemented with the sports sector.
No statements can be made about the preliminary investigation or about concrete ongoing criminal investigations that are in the investigation phase.
Er kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over het voorbereidend onderzoek dan wel over concrete (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken die zich in de opsporingsfase bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Aanhoudingen na dumpen afvalstoffen in brandstof’

An SP member asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about arrests after illegal mixing of hazardous waste into heating oil, whether this reflects structural enforcement, how long the practice persisted, and which company is involved. The Minister answered that a criminal investigation led to arrests of four managers of a West-Brabant waste firm, that the company name and details cannot be disclosed for investigative reasons, and that a blacklist of substances for heating oil and a related motion are being implemented.
I cannot make any statements about the name of the suspected company.
Over de naam van het verdachte bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Politie toont weer beelden schokkend uitgaansgeweld”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a police publication of images of violent nightlife assaults, whether violence is rising, what measures will be taken, and whether publishing footage and privacy concerns should reduce sentences. The minister answered that recorded violence has been falling since 2010, that violence is tackled with all criminal law means and preventive measures, that publishing recognisable footage can be effective but needs care, and that sentencing is for the judge.
Determining the sentence, and whether to take into account the publication of footage of the criminal offence, is a matter for the judge.
Het bepalen van de strafmaat en het eventueel rekening houden met het publiceren van beelden van het strafbare feit, is aan de rechter.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht “Luchtalarmsirenes gaan verdwijnen”, en het bericht “7 redenen waarom NL-alert de sirenes niet kan vervangen”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether NL-Alert can replace the air-raid sirens, given outages during disasters, phone ownership and night-time reach, and the vulnerability of elderly and dementia patients. The minister answers that all crisis communication channels can fail, that NL-Alert is supplemental and reaches people entering an affected area, and that the WAS siren system becomes redundant, while promising further development of the crisis communication package.
In the mentioned further development of the crisis communication package, I will in the coming years pay attention to how vulnerable groups can best be reached for all incident types.

In de genoemde doorontwikkeling van het pakket crisiscommunicatiemiddelen besteed ik de komende jaren aandacht aan de wijze waarop kwetsbare groepen het beste bereikt kunnen worden bij alle incidenttypen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de vervolging van politieagenten na een schietincident

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers who shot people should always be investigated by the Rijksrecherche, whether they can be prosecuted for disproportionate force, and whether the legal status of officers using firearms should be changed. The minister confirmed mandatory Rijksrecherche investigation and prosecution possibilities, argued officers face a fundamentally different situation from civilians, and announced a broader review of the legal position of officers who use force, with a letter to parliament before the Christmas recess.
In investigating and assessing force applied by the state, any appearance of partiality must be avoided.
Bij het onderzoek naar en het toetsen van het van overheidswege toegepaste geweld moet elke schijn van partijdigheid worden vermeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'Schietende agent moet niet berecht worden als burger'

MP Tellegen (VVD) asked whether an officer who uses firearms in an emergency is treated as a suspect when casualties result, and what safeguards exist against officers being treated as criminals in court. The Minister explains that prosecution decisions are taken by the chief prosecutor, subject to review by the Adviescommissie politieel vuurwapengebruik, that courts first assess whether the offence is met and then whether the Ambtsinstructie was followed, and describes support available to officers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof van Den Haag over het Europese Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the Justice Minister about the Hague Court of Appeal ruling on labour conditions at the European Patent Office and whether the government would enforce it. The minister answered that the EPO's immunity from execution is absolute under its protocol, so the government has issued a notice barring bailiffs from enforcing the ruling, and that it will raise the matter with the EPO's Administrative Council and the Dutch-hosted EPO without ruling out further steps.
The Minister of Security and Justice can then notify the bailiff that enforcement of the judgment would violate the Kingdom's international legal obligations.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie kan vervolgens de gerechtsdeurwaarder aanzeggen dat tenuitvoerlegging van het vonnis in strijd is met volkenrechtelijke verplichtingen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het opvragen van beelden de politie tonnen kost

An MP asked whether the police and prosecution must pay banks for camera footage under an NVB arrangement, costing millions, and whether banks should provide it free. The minister replied that a statutory compensation basis (art. 592 Sv) and forfaitaire agreements exist, that the aim is not to deter requests, and that he sees no reason to change the rules.
I see no reason to amend this statutory arrangement.
Ik zie geen reden om deze wettelijke regeling aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het aanpakken van overlastgevers met een koopwoning

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the rules for evicting nuisance-causing owner-occupiers should match those for tenants, as Amsterdam's mayor wished. The minister said nuisance cases are handled the same regardless of ownership, acknowledged Amsterdam's call for more instruments, and offered talks while noting strict human-rights limits on eviction.
I am willing to discuss this with the municipality of Amsterdam and other municipalities.
Ik ben graag bereid daar met de gemeente Amsterdam en andere gemeenten over te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat processen-verbaal het verdachtenverhoor niet goed weergeven

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister how to address research showing police interview reports (processen-verbaal) do not accurately reflect suspect interrogations, and whether judges and prosecutors are aware of these limits and can review recordings. The minister answered that legislation is being prepared to regulate interview reports, police and prosecution are improving report quality, audiovisual recordings remain a supplementary tool that judges can order played at trial, and the Inspectorate's ongoing study will determine whether further research is needed.
Audiovisual recording of interrogations cannot fully replace the written report and remains a tool that makes subsequent checking possible.
Audiovisuele vastlegging van verhoren kan daarvoor niet volledig in de plaats komen en blijft een hulpmiddel, waardoor controle achteraf mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de bezetting van een moskee in Leiden

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the occupation of a mosque in Leiden by Identitair Verzet, the consequences of such actions for Muslim organisations, and the threat of right-wing extremism. The minister answered that the occupation led to a penalty order for unlawful entry on a construction site, that vandalism near the mosque site cannot be linked to its construction, and that the government condemns the action and is in contact with the mosque and partners.
The cabinet strongly condemns the action and understands the unrest that has arisen.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de actie sterk en heeft begrip voor de onrust die is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de rellende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Dutch fans rioting in Rome before the AS Roma-Feyenoord match, whether preventive measures and information exchange were sufficient, and whether fans with stadium bans could be prevented from travelling. The minister answered that European information channels were used, Dutch police spotters were present, the investigation is ongoing, and the pending bill on area bans is considered sufficient without additional measures.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover geen verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de terreuraanslag in Kopenhagen tijdens een debat over de vrijheid van meningsuiting

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Justice Minister about the Copenhagen terror attack, whether the government will invest more in security services, whether the attack links to Islam, and how to protect Islam-critical voices. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to a EUR 128.8 million security package, acknowledged a link between jihadism and Islam while calling jihadist violence a perverted religion, and said the state protects citizens' freedom of expression without committing to new measures.
As reported in the letter, this concerns a package of EUR 128.8 million in total, structural, realised in a rising series.
Zoals gemeld in de brief gaat het om een pakket van in totaal 128,8 mln. euro structureel, dat in een oplopende reeks wordt gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de strafbaarheid van verhuurders van panden waarin wiet wordt geteeld

MP Rebel asked the Justice Minister whether landlords face a duty to investigate cannabis cultivation in rented property, and whether the MeldpuntVerdacht website's claims about landlord liability and registration are accurate. The minister answered that no general investigation duty exists, that the website's claim that landlords are presumed guilty until proven innocent is plainly wrong, and that registration on the site does not avoid liability, while declining to comment on the website operator's interests.
The sentence on the website stating that a landlord is guilty until proven innocent is therefore plainly incorrect.
De zin op de website waarin staat dat een verhuurder schuldig is totdat deze zijn onschuld bewijst, is dan ook pertinent onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sluiten van politiebureaus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about closing police stations, including the number of new locations by type, maps, response times, mayors' views and opening hours. The minister answered that about 200 physical locations will no longer be needed by 2025, that changes will be gradual and agreed with local authorities, and that response times are not expected to be affected, though exact closure dates and opening hours are not yet fixed.
This situation will be worked towards gradually over the next ten years.
Naar deze situatie wordt de komende tien jaar geleidelijk toegewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de data van agenten niet goed beveiligd zijn

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the police handles reports that officers' personal data was insufficiently secured, including whether online login to systems holding such data was possible and why HR systems were outsourced to an external company. The minister replied that a second risk analysis led to two-factor authentication, that the system meets Wbp security requirements though no absolute guarantee exists, that no unauthorised access occurred, and that outsourcing does not change the korpschef's responsibility for data security.
It is in fact not correct that one could log in without security.
Het klopt overigens niet dat onbeveiligd kan worden ingelogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de politie in 215 gemeenten vaak te laat komt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police arrive late in 215 municipalities, whether the 90% within-15-minutes norm for 2015 will be met, and what measures will ensure it. The minister confirmed the figures, attributed lateness mainly to rural geography and unforeseen peaks, said the 90% target is a self-imposed police goal with no statutory basis, and listed existing measures without guaranteeing the target per municipality.
This target was set by the police itself and is not a legally established norm.
Deze streefnorm heeft de politie zichzelf opgelegd en is geen wettelijk vastgestelde norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de inzetbare operationele sterkte bij de Nationale Politie

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice for yearly figures on national police funding, personnel costs, operational and non-operational strength, headcount and operational deployability (including and excluding trainees) for 2013 to 2021. The Minister answered with budget and annual-report figures for 2013 to 2019, noting that the police multi-year budget runs only to 2019, and gave the deployability percentages (trainees assumed 40% deployable).
Therefore, no data can currently be provided for the period after 2019.
Derhalve zijn er op dit moment nog geen gegevens te verstrekken voor de periode na 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Jacobi over de aanwezigheid van de politie in Friesland

MPs Marcouch and Jacobi asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police response times and presence in Friesland, including missed 15-minute targets in the North Netherlands unit and whether police posts had closed. The minister confirmed the target was missed in 2014 but improving since 2012, listed measures taken, said no posts in Friesland had closed since 2012, and stated that cell facilities on the Wadden islands exist for the first six hours with transfer to the mainland beyond that.
Yes, the police target standard was not met in North Netherlands in 2014.
Ja, de streefnorm van de politie is in Noord-Nederland in 2014 niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de reflectoren op politieuniformen niet werken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police uniform reflectors fail, whether officers must wear hi-vis vests in dangerous situations, and whether the uniform will be improved. The minister said the new uniform meets all design requirements, that the yellow stripes were never meant to be reflective, and that extra hi-vis gear is supplied for specific situations, so no change is planned.
The new uniform meets all the requirements set for the design.
Het nieuwe uniform voldoet aan alle bij het ontwerp gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat justitiebanen wegvloeien uit Leeuwarden

MP Segers asked whether justice jobs are draining from Leeuwarden and whether new justice services are being steered away from less central cities, and how the Schouten motion on Northern Netherlands employment was applied. The minister denied recognising that pattern, said employment effects were considered in past location choices and that the Rechtspraak decides on scan facilities, and stated no jobs were lost in Northern Netherlands after court map reform apart from some back-office functions moved to Groningen.
Any change to the court sitting locations must be submitted to parliament for prior consultation.
Een eventuele wijziging van de zittingsplaatsen moet bij het parlement worden voorgehangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitlatingen van Guy Verhofstadt over een Europese CIA

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Guy Verhofstadt's call for a European CIA and whether the government would rule out transferring sovereignty on intelligence. The minister confirmed the remarks were made in Verhofstadt's capacity as an MEP, stated the government will not transfer sovereignty since internal security remains a national matter, and said those holding such views are free to express them.
The cabinet considers it important that this remains so and therefore has no intention whatsoever of transferring sovereignty to a 'Euro-CIA'.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat dit zo blijft en is dus geenszins voornemens om soevereiniteit aan een «Euro-CIA» over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de manier waarop de politie omgaat met vermeend valse aangiftes van seksueel geweld

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how police handle suspected false reports of sexual violence, including whether the informal intake conversation deters reporting and whether indicators like delayed or inconsistent statements are treated as signs of false testimony. The minister answered that the police and prosecution aim to reduce unnecessary barriers, that falsity is assessed against investigation results rather than a checklist, that the balance in the prosecution guideline is adequate, and that no further study is planned.
Preventing false reports must not lead to treating a victim in a way that presumes from the outset that the report is false.
Het voorkomen van valse aangiften mag niet leiden tot een bejegening van het slachtoffer waarbij er op voorhand vanuit wordt gegaan dat de aangifte vals is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over problemen met aangiftes met betrekking tot zedendelicten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether prosecution of sexual offences against intellectually disabled victims is hampered by difficulties obtaining usable testimony, and what police can do about it. The Minister answered that specialised police interviewers and psychologists are used, that a police working group will report on guidelines before summer, and that the OM and IGZ are informing care institutions about the scope of criminal law.
As previously promised by the former State Secretary of Security and Justice, your House will be informed of the results of a working group set up by the police.
Zoals eerder toegezegd door de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie 2 zal uw Kamer geïnformeerd worden over de resultaten van een door de politie ingestelde werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgen over de kwaliteitsontwikkeling van de forensische geneeskunde

An MP from the SP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about concerns raised by the Dutch Register of Forensic Experts over forensic medicine quality, including training adequacy for forensic doctors in criminal investigations and a proposed commission on future quality assurance. The minister replies that quality is primarily the profession's responsibility, that the tender requirements aligned with professional registration, and that no changes to the tender or a commission are currently planned.
Determining the requirements a forensic doctor must meet in light of the state of science is primarily a task for the profession of forensic doctors.
Het bepalen van de eisen waaraan een forensische arts gezien de stand van de wetenschap moet voldoen is bij uitstek een taak voor de beroepsgroep van forensische artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de aanwas van gespecialiseerde agenten stokt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that recruitment of specialist police officers (sex crime investigators, marksmen, riot police, financial and cyber investigators) has stalled, and whether reducing operational strength is responsible. The minister answered that recruitment is deliberately restrained during the reorganisation to match the agreed formation, gave training numbers for 2011-2014, said no shortages were reported except in financial and cybercrime, and promised a progress report with a reorganisation completion date and a later update on postinitial training enrolment.
I will inform your House in the next progress report about the date on which the personnel reorganisation is expected to be completed.
Ik zal uw Kamer in de eerstkomende voortgangsrapportage informeren over de datum waarop de personele reorganisatie naar verwachting afgerond zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat een man die is veroordeeld voor het doodrijden van een meisje een opgelegd rijverbod negeert

An MP asked the Justice Minister how a man convicted of fatally drunk-driving a teenage girl could repeatedly be stopped driving despite a driving ban, and what enforcement tools exist. The minister answered that the conviction is not yet final, that police cannot physically prevent banned drivers from driving, that vehicle seizure was tried but cars were registered to others, and that prosecution has been instituted and victim support maintained.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service cannot prevent a person from driving despite a driving ban or a withheld licence.
Politie en OM kunnen een persoon niet beletten om, ondanks een rij-ontzegging of een ingehouden rijbewijs, toch te gaan rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over gewelddadige intimidatie van kandidaat-politici

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about violent intimidation of provincial election candidates, including a stone through a PVV candidate's window and vandalism of his home and cars. The minister condemned the acts, said police found no suspect so far, and said protection of candidates lies with the Public Prosecution Service, with ministry monitoring and possible measures in consultation with it.
For security reasons I will not comment on the nature of this extra attention or the protective measures.
Om veiligheidsredenen doe ik geen uitspraken over de aard van deze extra aandacht of beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Spoorloos verdwenen na jaren van gedwongen isolement’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a report of a woman who disappeared after years of forced isolation, asking about prior warning signs, a 'cover-up culture', non-cooperation, and the welfare of her children. The minister declined to give details on prior signals and the criminal investigation, described the wider collectivist-culture risks in general terms, and stated that no information about child protection measures could be given.
I cannot provide information on this because of the interests of investigation and prosecution connected to the criminal investigation into this case mentioned in my answer to question 4.
Hierover kan ik geen mededelingen doen vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging die verbonden zijn aan het in mijn antwoord op vraag 4 genoemde strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over nepwapens

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether removing the ban on toy guns resembling real firearms (due to the EU Toy Safety Directive) allows such toys to be sold and carried in the Netherlands, and whether safety should prevent their sale. The minister answered that such toys may be sold and carried unless they are classed as weapons by intent, that there is no national data on incidents with replica guns, and that the EU directive cannot be reopened.
A European directive is binding on all member states.
Een Europese richtlijn is bindend voor alle lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over agenten die hun eigen DNA niet willen afstaan

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why around 300 police officers, including forensic detectives, have not given their DNA to the forensic elimination database, and what is being done about it. The minister answered that participation is voluntary under Article 11 of the Constitution, that a new uniform privacy regulation has been adopted, and that supervisors will approach the remaining officers, without planning further measures.
From the right to bodily integrity, laid down in Article 11 of the Constitution, it follows that DNA material may only be taken with the explicit consent of the employee.

Uit het recht op onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam, neergelegd in artikel 11 van de Grondwet, wordt afgeleid dat de afname van DNA-materiaal slechts met uitdrukkelijke toestemming van de medewerker mag plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over bange agenten die terreurverdachten met een meldplicht weren uit politiebureaus uit angst voor aanslagen

An MP from the PVV asked whether police fear for their safety and bar terror suspects under a reporting obligation from police stations, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The Minister replied that the arrangement concerned a single person at one station, that there is no general policy of categorising such persons, and that he saw no reason to revise his predecessor's position on administrative detention.
As far as could be verified, such an arrangement to report via the intercom was made at only one police station, for one person with a reporting obligation.
Voor zover kon worden nagegaan is een dergelijke afspraak, om zich via de intercom te melden, slechts op één politiebureau gemaakt ten aanzien van één persoon met een meldplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht “Meld Misdaad Anoniem vaker getipt over drugslabs”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Meld Misdaad Anoniem's hotline is not reachable from abroad, whether many internationally relevant crimes can be reported anonymously, and how access could be improved quickly. The minister confirmed that foreign access depends on local providers, pointed to the international Crime Stoppers channel and planned online reporting, and said a separate number via KPN is being explored at extra cost.
Meld Misdaad Anoniem is currently working on enabling anonymous online reporting as well.
Bovendien werkt Meld Misdaad Anoniem op dit moment aan het realiseren van de mogelijkheid om ook online anoniem te kunnen melden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Marcouch over het bericht dat allochtone daders een grotere kans op een zware straf hebben

MPs Recourt and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about research showing foreign-origin offenders face a higher chance of prison sentences, and whether judges may be discriminating. Minister Opstelten answered that the differences largely disappear after controlling for factors such as prior record and employment, so no conclusion of judicial bias can be drawn, while the Judiciary Council has commissioned further research including talks with judges.
It cannot be concluded from this that judges, consciously or unconsciously, take the ethnic background of the suspect into account.
Hieruit kan niet afgeleid worden dat rechters, bewust of onbewust, rekening houden met de etnische achtergrond van de verdachte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over allochtone daders die een grotere kans op een zware straf hebben

Kuzu asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that non-Western-looking or minority-origin defendants receive harsher sentences, and whether this breaches equal treatment and ECHR principles. The Minister said the Raad voor de rechtspraak takes the signals seriously, that differences largely disappear after controlling for criminal record and employment, and that a follow-up study is being carried out by the judiciary itself.
Impartiality is one of the core values of the judiciary.
Onpartijdigheid is één van de kernwaarden van de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de samenwerking tussen de Haagse politie en een salafistische moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the Hague police again cooperated with the salafist As-Soennah mosque in the New Year's Eve neighbourhood project, and whether this partnership should be ended given the mosque's views. The minister answered that participants, including mosques, act under police supervision within legal limits with no more powers than ordinary citizens, and that the local authority sees no reason to end the cooperation.
The participants do so under police supervision and within the framework of the law, and have no more powers than any other citizen.
De deelnemers doen dat onder toezicht van de politie en binnen de kaders van de wet en hebben niet meer bevoegdheden dan iedere andere burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Rijksoverheid.nl was dupe van DDoS-aanval’

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked whether the government websites rijksoverheid.nl and others were taken offline by a DDoS attack, its motives, whether such sites are critical infrastructure, and how citizens were informed. The minister confirmed the attack, said motives are unknown and a report was filed, said the sites are not critical infrastructure but important for citizens, and described the backup, a planned improvement plan, and information channels used.
A backup facility exists for the affected sites, but it also turned out to be affected.
Voor de getroffen sites bestaat een back-upvoorziening, die echter ook getroffen bleek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de website van de Rijksoverheid plat lag door een DDoS-aanval

An MP from D66 asked about a DDoS attack that took the central government website offline, the status of 2013 counter-measures, attacker identity, a cybersecurity conference agenda and the lack of an emergency website. The minister confirmed awareness, reported progress on the 2013 measures, said attackers are unknown, a criminal complaint was filed, and promised a supplier improvement plan and a further legislative proposal in 2015.
The Ministry of General Affairs has filed a criminal complaint.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft aangifte gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanslag bij een synagoge in Kopenhagen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Copenhagen attacks, including whether they were linked, whether the threat to Jewish institutions was recognised, and whether protection would be maximised. The minister confirmed the same suspect was reported for both attacks, stated Jewish objects are targets, and said additional security measures are being taken while declining to give details.
As usual, we do not make statements about the security measures.
Over de beveiligingsmaatregelen doen wij zoals gebruikelijk geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat de aanpak van zware misdaad in Noord-Nederland hapert

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the fight against serious crime in Northern Netherlands is stalling, including a backlog in criminal investigations and the effects of police reorganisation. The Minister denied a backlog in investigations, attributing the drop in complex cases to a focus on processing times, and announced measures to increase cases referred to the multi-judge chamber and to bring anti-organised-crime units up to strength.
In Northern Netherlands there is no backlog in the number of criminal investigations.
In Noord-Nederland is geen sprake van een achterstand in het aantal recherche-onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de nauwe banden op Curaçao tussen het bestuur en de (illegale) gokindustrie

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers about the scale of legal and illegal gambling on Curaçao, alleged money laundering, weak oversight by the Gaming Control Board and the lottery foundation, possible party financing from the gambling industry, and whether the Kingdom will investigate party financing. The minister answered that gambling oversight and law enforcement are autonomous matters of Curaçao, that the Curaçao Public Prosecution Service handles money laundering suspicions, and that the Duradero project with Curaçao strengthens enforcement capacity.
Supervision of casinos and lotteries is an autonomous matter of the Country of Curaçao.
Toezicht op casino's en loterijen is een autonome aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een islamitische geweldsprediker naar Rijswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Salafist preacher, Muhammad Hassan, invited to a Rijswijk fundraiser, has links to the Muslim Brotherhood, poses a public-safety threat, and whether preachers calling for violence should be barred and mosques calling for violence closed. The minister answered that Hassan is a Salafist with an ambiguous link to the Brotherhood, that visas of three speakers were withdrawn on public-order grounds, that the foundation cancelled the event in its original form, and that closing a mosque is only possible for building-safety or drug violations or if a legal entity's aims breach public order.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn with a view to public order, against the background of social unrest.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over zijn uitspraken dat binnen het Openbaar Ministerie extra officieren van Justitie zijn aangesteld

An MP asked the Justice Minister what was meant by claiming extra prosecutors had been appointed at the Public Prosecution Service, how many, and whether a 5 million euro intensification offsets an 80 million euro cut. The minister answered that seven experienced prosecutors were appointed above establishment for counter-terrorism and radicalisation, that the extra funding is not a correction to the cabinet's cuts, and that vacancies are being filled with new staff.

Since these are additional tasks for which extra staff are appointed, these additionally provided funds should not be seen as a correction to the earlier government-wide budget cut target of this cabinet.

Aangezien het hier extra taken betreft waarvoor extra personeel wordt aangesteld, dienen deze additioneel beschikbaar gestelde middelen niet te worden gezien als een correctie op de eerder genoemde rijksbrede taakstelling van dit kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Benefiet ter discussie'?

An MP from the VVD asks the Justice Minister about a planned charity gala in Rijswijk featuring foreign salafist preachers, including whether the government can refuse visas or act against them and what responsibility organisers and venue owners bear. The government answers that visas of three speakers were withdrawn for public order reasons, that Schengen rules allow refusal on threat grounds, that Dutch authorities can ask other member states to revoke visas, and that free speech is limited where hatred or threats to public order arise.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn in the interest of public order, against the background of social unrest, as set out in a letter from the NCTV.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust, zoals verwoord in een brief van de NCTV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Imams hebben visum voor benefiet in Rijswijk al binnen’

An SGP MP asked whether imams invited to a Rijswijk event had already received visas, whether visas could be refused or withdrawn for radical preachers, and whether criteria should be tightened and EU-level action taken. The government confirmed three visas were withdrawn on public order grounds, said current Schengen criteria suffice, and saw no reason to tighten them or raise the issue in the EU.
I see no reason to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over maatregelen na de falende visumaanpak inzake extremistische imams

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government how extremist imams obtained visas that were later revoked, whether individual visa checks and a blacklist will be strengthened, what steps follow against the organiser of a jihadist gala, and whether other ANBI-status organisations facilitating such preachers should lose that status. The Minister answered that the visa procedure was correctly followed, that risk profiles are being enriched and visas can be revoked on new information, that the event was not prohibited but was changed after visas were withdrawn, and that the Tax Authority can investigate ANBI status where there are signals.
In the visa granting to the three imams, nothing went wrong in the procedure.
Bij de visumverlening aan de drie imams is in de procedure niets fout gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de miljoenen van Bruinsma op een Zwitserse bankrekening

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Public Prosecution Service had failed to respond to Swiss mutual legal assistance requests about Klaas Bruinsma's money in a Swiss bank account, and whether a secret deal with Engelsma, Geerts and Cok explained this. The minister answered that Dutch authorities did provide information to Switzerland in 1998, 2005 and 2006, that no evidence of any such deal was found, and that the Public Prosecution Service's contacts on related matters cannot be disclosed.

No indication has been found of the existence of an agreement that money in a Swiss bank account would go to the persons named in question 3, that the Netherlands would not assist the Swiss prosecutor, or any agreement of similar content.

Van het bestaan van een overeenkomst, dat geld op een Zwitserse bankrekening aan de in vraag 3 genoemde personen toe zou komen en Nederland de Zwitserse officier van justitie niet zou helpen met zijn strafrechtelijke onderzoek, of een afspraak van soortgelijke strekking, is geen aanwijzing aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de opname van aangiftes naar aanleiding van de twee incidenten afgelopen weken tegen vrouwen met een moslimachtergrond

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police recorded complaints about two attacks on Muslim women in Almere thoroughly, including the discriminatory background, and what is done to instruct officers and prevent discrimination cases going unprosecuted.
