The minister replied that the complaints were recorded as assault with discriminatory remarks noted in one case, described police training and a discrimination network, and announced a study of discrimination cases in the criminal justice chain due end 2015.
The account of the complainant is leading when taking the complaint and its write-up in the official report.
Het verhaal van de aangever/aangeefster is leidend bij het opnemen van de aangifte en de uitwerking in het proces verbaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over het bericht “Bomalarm op station Leiden door misverstand”

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked about a bomb alarm at Leiden Central station caused by a camera rig hung there by a media agency's technician for ad-viewing measurement. The government described the sequence of events, said NS had been aware of the test but failed to communicate it internally, rejected that anyone acted knowingly, and found no criminal offence.
The incident must therefore be regarded as an unwise action combined with poor communication.
Het gebeurde moet dan ook beschouwd worden als een onverstandige actie in combinatie met gebrekkige communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voortgaande anti-homogeweld in Amsterdam

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Security and Justice about rising anti-gay violence in Amsterdam, including the share of non-Western suspects and whether funds should go to prosecution instead of dialogue projects. The government answered that reporting and reduced tolerance explain the figures, that every incident is unacceptable, and that it pursues criminal enforcement alongside prevention, education and awareness campaigns.

For the cabinet, every violent incident is one too many, and the message is clear that aggressive behaviour towards LGBT people is unacceptable and will be firmly addressed, regardless of the perpetrator's background.

Voor het kabinet is ieder geweldsincident er één te veel, en is de boodschap duidelijk dat agressief gedrag jegens LHBT's onacceptabel is en hard wordt aangepakt – los van de achtergrond van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een mega-moskee in Gouda

CDA MPs asked the government about the financing of a planned large mosque in Gouda, its links to salafist fundraising, and the sale of the former Prins Willem Alexander barracks with a nuclear bunker. The minister answered that the sale and onward sale are a local matter, that PWC found no obstacles and a Bibob advice is pending, that the bunker will be demolished, and that national security is not a criterion for such sales.
The proposed decision on the onward sale to El Wahda may be changed by the mayor and aldermen after receipt of the Landelijk Bureau Bibob advice.
Het voorgenomen besluit over de doorverkoop aan El Wahda kan door het college van burgemeester en wethouders eventueel worden gewijzigd na ontvangst van het advies van het Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Moskee in Gouda mag er komen van college’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a mosque in Gouda may be built, and whether the origin of its funding and the municipality's investigation into it were adequate. The minister answered that the funding origin is known (0.05% from outside the Netherlands, from two Schengen countries), that PwC investigated the funds, and that the Bibob bureau advised the municipality, so no further assistance is needed.
The municipality of Gouda commissioned forensic accountant PwC to investigate the origin of the financial resources for building the new mosque.
De gemeente Gouda heeft forensisch accountant PWC onderzoek uit laten voeren naar de herkomst van de financiële middelen voor de bouw van de nieuwe moskee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat met software criminaliteit kan worden voorspeld

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam predictive policing software CAS reduces crime, whether it should be rolled out nationally, and about burglary figures and local innovation. The minister said predictive policing is promising, that pilots will be studied, and gave burglary counts for 2010-2014 while declining to answer the questions in time for the scheduled debate.
I therefore consider it worthwhile to examine whether predictive policing can have the same effect in the Netherlands and which preconditions apply.
Ik vind het daarom zinvol om te bezien of predictive policing in Nederland eenzelfde effect kan hebben en welke randvoorwaarden hierbij gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over de opkomst van Apple en Google in het betalingsverkeer

MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether the uneven playing field between banks and tech firms like Apple and Google in payments, data-use rules and payment data protection should be closed. The government answered that all parties must comply with the same privacy law, that the voluntary banking code is only a further interpretation of it, and that the new EU directives and privacy regulation will add registration and risk-based duties.
All the parties mentioned, both financial institutions and other companies, must comply with the same privacy legislation.
Alle genoemde partijen, dus zowel financiële instellingen als andere bedrijven, moeten voldoen aan dezelfde privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Staaij over de fouten die zijn gemaakt in de zaak Van U.

MPs Recourt and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Justice and Security about errors in the Van U case, including whether civil-law measures and broader psychiatric-detention options were considered, and whether dangerous suspects are being released pending appeal. The minister replied that an independent commission has been set up by the College of Procurators-General to investigate the DNA sampling, enforcement of pre-trial detention and BOPZ detention, and that it will answer these questions in its outcome, expected before the summer recess.
The College of Procurators-General asked the commission to establish the facts and circumstances surrounding the DNA sampling of the suspect after his conviction(s) in 2012.
Het College van Procureurs-generaal heeft de commissie gevraagd de feiten en omstandigheden te achterhalen rond de afname van het DNA van verdachte na zijn veroordeling(en) in 2012
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de affaire Demmink

Bontes asks about the status of the criminal investigation into former secretary-general Demmink, Turkey's non-cooperation with mutual legal assistance requests, the handling of intelligence reports and the Rolodex inquiry, the civil case against AD, and legal aid costs. Minister Opstelten answers that the investigation is ongoing with requests to Turkey still pending, declines comment on the witness statements because of the parallel investigation, reports legal aid costs of about 16,343 euro, and notes that no appeal is expected.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie grootschalig data van vliegtuigpassagiers wil opslaan

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that the European Commission wants to store passenger (PNR) data broadly, raising privacy and proportionality concerns under EU case law. The minister replied that no new Commission proposal has been adopted yet, that the Commission intends to add data protection safeguards, that the Netherlands welcomes stronger fundamental-rights protection, and that the Chamber will be kept informed before any step is taken.
As agreed with the Chamber, we are awaiting the process and will not take any step without informing the Chamber.
Zoals afgesproken met de Kamer wachten wij het proces af en zetten geen stap zonder de Kamer te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Geheimen mee in het graf’ dat oproept onder omstandigheden DNA-onderzoek te doen na een niet natuurlijke dood en omtrent een landelijk protoco

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether DNA of deceased persons who died unnaturally should be compared with the police DNA database and whether a national autopsy protocol is needed. The minister said such DNA sampling is not generally justified, that sampling from a deceased suspect is limited by article 69 Sr, and that the legal basis will be addressed in the Criminal Procedure Code modernisation, plus a working group on a national protocol.

In setting the rules for taking cell material for DNA research from a deceased suspect or victim, the fundamental right to bodily integrity is currently insufficiently taken into account, and an intrusion on that right must be provided for by or under law.

Bij de normering voor het afnemen van celmateriaal voor DNA-onderzoek bij een overleden verdachte of slachtoffer van een strafbaar feit is op dit moment onvoldoende verdisconteerd dat het grondrecht op de onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam daarbij een rol speelt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat Nederland totaal niet voorbereid is op een terreuraanval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands is unprepared for a commando-style terrorist attack, whether the police, defence and intelligence services should be heavily funded, whether the Marechaussee should guard sensitive sites, and whether administrative detention, a public jihad register and a ban on return for departed jihadists should be adopted. The Minister rejected the claim of unpreparedness, pointed to extra funding, Marechaussee redeployment and planned exit-ban and citizenship-revocation measures, but declined administrative detention and a public register as unnecessary or incompatible with the rule of law.
The Cabinet is of the view that a public list is not in line with the principles of our rule of law.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat een openbare lijst niet in overeenstemming is met de beginselen van onze rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat Nederland in het vizier is van terreurcellen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Netherlands is a target of terror cells, including whether jihad is linked to Islam, whether jihadists' names and photos should be published, and why administrative detention and border interception of returnees are not introduced. The minister acknowledged the reports, described jihad as an Islamic concept with contested meanings, refused public listing of names, stated that the threat level is substantial and that further measures are underway, and rejected administrative detention while pointing to expanded administrative tools and nationality revocation proposals.
Creating an additional power of administrative detention for counterterrorism purposes is, as previously stated, not necessary in my view.
Het creëren van een aanvullende bevoegdheid tot administratieve detentie ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding acht ik zoals gemeld niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de golf van incidenten jegens moskeeën

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a wave of incidents against mosques, including threats, vandalism and arson, and about police registration of anti-Muslim discrimination, protection of mosques and prosecution. Minister Opstelten answered that the government condemns such attacks, will improve registration of Muslim discrimination and report on it separately, will take protective measures where threat warrants, and will apply prosecution policy with aggravated sentencing for discriminatory offences.
No public statement is made about information received from the intelligence and security services.
Over ontvangen informatie van inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraak gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitlatingen van Snowden over Nederland en de NSA

An MP asked why Snowden's asylum request was not processed, how the government views claims that Dutch intelligence services are subordinate to US services, why promised new cooperation criteria with the US have not appeared, and whether intelligence services should cooperate on equal terms. The government answered that asylum cannot be applied for abroad under the Vreemdelingenwet, that the Wiv 2002 and CTIVD oversight govern cooperation, that new criteria are being addressed in a planned Wiv amendment, and that it agrees services should not be a proxy for foreign services.
On the content of those talks we can only inform the House through the appropriate channels.
Over de inhoud van die gesprekken kunnen wij de Tweede Kamer alleen via de daartoe geëigende kanalen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat de voorzitter van de politievakbond zijn vriendin via het ministerie van V&J aan een baan hielp

MP Marcouch asked Minister Opstelten whether the head of the police union ACP secured a job for his girlfriend on the Cultuurmonitor research team, whether this conflict of interest was overlooked, and related questions on the monitor's origins, procurement, and publication. The minister answered that the partner was added by the independent researcher, that procurement rules were followed at EUR 87,500, and that the instrument was not used after the steering group rejected it, with a new approach commissioned under WODC.
In the present case the latter procedure was properly followed.
In het onderhavige geval is de laatstgenoemde procedure ordentelijk gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat agenten onveilig zijn vanwege een gebrek aan training

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers feel unsafe due to insufficient training, citing a police union survey on shortages, cancelled lessons, sick leave and tests replacing real training. Minister Opstelten answered that officers receive sufficient training (raised to about 45 hours a year), that training is being developed from testing to practical preparation, that officers share responsibility for their own training, and that training is assessed in appraisal interviews.
No, I do not know it. It is up to the ACP to share this with me, possibly in regular contacts.
Ik ken deze niet. Het is aan de ACP om dit eventueel met mij in de reguliere contacten te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over reclame voor zware luchtdrukwapens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about heavy air-pressure weapons being advertised, whether advertising should be discouraged, whether these weapons should move to a licensed category, and why they should not be banned in the meantime. The minister replied there is no specific advertising policy for such weapons, that a study of their classification and power limits is underway and will be reported to parliament, but that no ban is possible without changing the law first.
On 16 December 2014 I committed to conduct a study of (heavy) air-pressure weapons as soon as possible.
Op 16 december 2014 heb ik toegezegd zo snel mogelijk een onderzoek te zullen doen naar (zware) luchtdrukwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse informatiepositie in aanloop naar de MH-17 ramp

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Foreign Affairs and Defence about the Dutch government's information position before the MH-17 downing, including what was known about downed aircraft, Ukrainian airspace warnings, the July 2014 Ukraine briefing and the role of the OVV and CTIVD. The government answered most questions by pointing to the ongoing OVV and prosecution investigations, stating it had no validated list of downed aircraft and that Ukraine gave no warnings beyond NOTAMs, while committing to share the briefing report and correspondence with the OVV.
We consider it of the utmost importance that the Public Prosecution Service can continue its investigation unhindered.
Wij achten het van het grootste belang dat het OM het onderzoek ongehinderd kan blijven verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de toegepaste strafmaat in een zaak waarbij een meisje van zestien om het leven is gekomen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Justice about the light sentence (a community service order) given for fatally speeding into a sixteen-year-old girl, and about the defendant's absence from the verdict and the case for mandatory minimum sentences. The Minister answered that sentencing is for the independent judge, that the case turned on establishing the facts, and that minimum sentences are not desirable in general.
The prosecution of criminal offences in our democratic constitutional state is entrusted to the independent judge.
De berechting van strafbare feiten is in onze democratische rechtsstaat opgedragen aan de onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over extra maatregelen tegen terreur

The MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (D66) asked the ministers about France's terrorism funding, Dutch security measures after the Paris attacks, intelligence staffing at the AIVD, and cooperation with neighbouring countries. The government answered by referring to its letter to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288) on additional counter-terrorism measures, rather than answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (both D66), question number 2015Z01185, have been answered by letter 'additional counter-terrorism measures and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Parliamentary paper 29 754, no. 288).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2015Z01185 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een steekpartij in het Asielzoekerscentrum in Dronten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government about a stabbing at an asylum centre in Dronten, whether it shares outrage at repeated violent incidents, what measures will stop them, how violent asylum seekers can be detained and denied residence, and whether regional reception should replace reception in the Netherlands. State Secretary Teeven answered that safety is a priority with COA house rules, supervision, police involvement and consequences for asylum procedures, and that reception in the region and Dutch international obligations remain the government's starting points, without capping numbers.
Safety and liveability inside and outside the asylum centre have the highest priority.
Veiligheid en leefbaarheid binnen en buiten het asielzoekerscentrum geniet hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over Etnisch profileren in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about ethnic profiling by police, including the handling of a complaint about alleged mistreatment and an unlawful stop in The Hague's Schilderswijk, and the findings of a Leiden University study. The Minister answered that the complaint procedures were carefully conducted, that the Leiden study found no structural ethnic profiling, and that the police use of identity checks is legally bounded, while withholding some detail on disciplinary cases citing anonymised data.
Mr Sealiti can avail himself of various legal remedies if he believes this outcome does him an injustice.
De heer Sealiti kan zich van verschillende rechtsmiddelen bedienen indien hij meent dat met deze uitkomst hem onrecht wordt aangedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hoogland over voortdurende agressie tegen NS-personeel

Two MPs asked the government about persistent aggression against NS rail staff, including survey figures, prosecution rates and measures taken. The minister acknowledged the problem, gave differing incident figures, said police and prosecutors do not register NS-specific cases, and listed existing and planned measures.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS-personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Sabotage Belgische kerncentrale Doel mogelijk terreurdaad’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether the reported sabotage of the Belgian Doel nuclear plant was a possible terrorist act, how it assesses security near the Dutch border, whether it has contacted Belgian counterparts, and whether Dutch nuclear plants need a security review. The minister answered that cooperation with Belgium is intensive and that Dutch nuclear installations meet existing rules, declined to disclose intelligence-level information, and saw no need for a new review.
I do not make public statements about the knowledge level of the Dutch security services.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over het kennisniveau van de Nederlandse veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de recherche zo goed als stilligt door een stuwmeer aan overuren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether criminal investigations were being postponed to next year because detectives had to take leave hours, and whether budgets for overtime had run out. The minister replied that prioritisation is a continuous task of the prosecution service, that leave is granted subject to operational needs, that no unit had exhausted its overtime budget, and that the agreed police strength of 49,500 FTE is maintained, so no extra funds are needed.
Per unit a budget is available for overtime.
Per eenheid is er een budget beschikbaar voor overuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘OM biedt jeugd in Veen 600 euro’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Security and Justice why the Public Prosecution Service proposed a higher compensation of 200 euro per day to 88 youths detained after New Year's riots in Veen, how the amount was calculated, and whether it sends a wrong signal given the tougher stance on disorder. The Minister defends the extra compensation by pointing to harsh detention conditions and long uncertainty, rejects claims of arbitrary haggling, and states that the cases were dismissed for lack of legally convincing evidence.
In its advice on calculating the amount of compensation, the Public Prosecution Service took into account the criteria of article 89 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the case law based on it.
Het OM heeft in zijn advies bij de berekening van de hoogte van een schadevergoeding rekening gehouden met de criteria van artikel 89 Sv en de daarop gebaseerde jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de plicht voor politiemedewerkers om rittenboekjes te gaan invullen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police officers must now fill in logbooks for unmarked vehicles from 1 January 2015 and whether this bureaucracy should be scrapped. The minister answered that the registration is a tax-law requirement to prove private use is excluded, is now uniform and low-burden, and that it will not be scrapped.
No, the trip registration of the police's use of unmarked service vehicles remains necessary for the reasons mentioned above.
Nee, de rittenregistratie van het gebruik van niet-herkenbare dienstvoertuigen van de politie blijft noodzakelijk om de hiervoor genoemde redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het massale vandalisme in Utrecht tijdens de jaarwisseling

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about mass vandalism in Utrecht during New Year's Eve, including whether the city's 'fairly quiet night' framing was wrong, how many suspects were arrested, whether damages can be recovered, whether minimum sentences should be introduced, and whether police and prosecution need more investment. The minister said he is not yet satisfied but sees a slight decline in incidents, that the OM cannot guarantee damage recovery though victims can join criminal proceedings, that minimum sentences are not desirable under the coalition agreement, and that no extra investment is warranted as performance is on track.
I see no reason for that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over criminele netwerken en hennepteelt in Zuid Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about municipalities stopping recovery of costs for clearing cannabis plantations, police and prosecution capacity for organised crime, financial investigators, and whether cannabis should be regulated. The minister answered that municipalities set their own policy, that cost recovery is a local matter, that cannabis regulation would not solve the problem, and that investigations and capacity are being strengthened, while stating that some data is not held centrally.
I am not aware whether, and if so how many municipalities for what reason have since 2012 stopped the administrative clearance of cannabis plantations and recovery of costs from the offender.
Het is mij niet bekend of, en zo ja hoeveel gemeenten om welke reden sinds 2012 zouden zijn gestopt met het bestuurlijk ruimen van hennepplantages en het verhalen van gemaakte kosten op de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer bezorgd is om veiligheid bij uitrukken in duo’s

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to union and volunteer-association criticism that the 'Uitruk op maat' framework for variable fire-brigade deployments endangers firefighter safety, and what he will do to secure workfloor support. The minister answered by referring to a letter sent to the House, noting the Security Council provided the framework for information, that he will discuss the safety concerns with the parties, and that he asked the Council to keep consulting them to build support.
Given the criticism from the unions and the VBV of the national framework regarding the safety aspect, I will enter into discussions with the parties concerned about this jointly.
Gezien de kritiek van de vakbonden en de VBV op het landelijk kader met betrekking tot het veiligheidsaspect, zal ik met de betrokken partijen hierover gezamenlijk in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een jihadistische dreiging voor de NAVO-basis in Brunssum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reported jihadist threats to the NATO base in Brunssum, the link to a nearby mosque, possible closure of that mosque, and security measures. The minister declined to discuss specific threats or measures publicly, said responsibility is shared between defence, local authorities and NATO, and referred to the general threat assessment.
For security reasons I do not make public statements about threats and risks concerning specific objects and services.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over dreigingen en risico’s ten aanzien van specifieke objecten en diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het NAVO-hoofdkwartier in Brunssum een mogelijk jihad-doelwit is

An MP asked whether the NAVO headquarters in Brunssum is a jihadist target, whether surveillance of NATO staff by mosque visitors was ignored, and whether the threat level should be raised. The minister declined to comment publicly on threat assessments for specific objects, said NATO reports no specific local threat, and said existing services act where needed.
For security reasons I do not make public statements about threats and risks concerning specific objects and services.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraken over dreiging en risico ten aanzien van specifieke objecten en diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the Demmink affair, including a Turkish document on entry records, the handling of security reports, costs of legal aid for former secretary-general Demmink, and contacts between officials and MPs. The minister answered that the Turkish document was passed to the Public Prosecution Service and a letter rogatory was sent, declined to comment on the content of documents in an ongoing criminal investigation, provided cost tables, and said security dossiers are kept by the AIVD and that the department does not keep records of MP contacts.
I do not comment on the content of documents that form part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik doe geen mededeling over de inhoud van documenten die onderdeel zijn van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice to comment on testimony that former SG Demmink was under investigation in the Rolodex case, contrary to earlier denials, and on a former detective's statement that he was tasked to follow Demmink. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service found no information confirming the testimony, and that the statements are being considered in a separate prosecutorial investigation, so he declined to comment further.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak van de rechter die het AD in het gelijk heeft gesteld in de zaak Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Justice Ministry would pay the legal costs of former secretary-general Demmink after a court ruled the AD's publications lawful, and whether the ministry would further investigate the allegations. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating other allegations, that he will not judge any investigation, and that he would reconsider reimbursement if Demmink appealed and sought costs.
Against that background, I will therefore refrain from giving a substantive judgement on any investigation into the former secretary-general of my ministry.
Tegen die achtergrond zal ik mij dan ook onthouden van het geven van een inhoudelijk oordeel ten aanzien van enig onderzoek naar de voormalige secretaris-generaal van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht “Rechter geeft AD gelijk in zaak topambtenaar Demmink”

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Rotterdam court ruling that AD's 2012 reporting on former secretary-general Demmink was lawful changes the minister's earlier view, whether investigations were flawed, and whether a new inquiry will be ordered. The minister acknowledged the ruling, declined to judge any investigation given parallel Public Prosecution Service work, and said he would consider recovery of costs if the allegations were proven.
Against that background I will therefore refrain from giving a substantive judgment on any investigation into the former secretary-general of my ministry.
Tegen die achtergrond zal ik mij dan ook onthouden van het geven van een inhoudelijk oordeel ten aanzien van enig onderzoek naar de voormalige secretaris-generaal van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens wil dat Facebook de nieuwe privacy voorwaarden uitstelt

An MP asked the minister whether he agrees with the Data Protection Authority's (CBP) request that Facebook postpone its new privacy policy pending investigation, how the CBP will enforce it, and whether results will be sent to parliament. The state secretary declined to comment on the CBP's independent enforcement decision, noted Facebook postponed the policy to 30 January 2015, and said the CBP will publish its findings itself, after which he will assess whether a response is needed.
The CBP is independent. It is therefore not appropriate for me to comment on a decision of the CBP in an individual enforcement case.
Het CBP is onafhankelijk. Het past mij daarom niet commentaar te leveren op een beslissing van het CBP in een individuele handhavingszaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat België radicale moslimgevangenen spreidt

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Belgium's dispersal of radical Muslim prisoners is correct, whether isolation and deportation after sentence would be better, and what the extent of radicalisation in Dutch prisons is. The state secretary said he cannot judge Belgian policy, described the Dutch terrorist-ward placement rules and ongoing review, stated that deportation of illegal prisoners is standard policy, and said no specific investigation into radicalisation in prisons is needed at this time.
Given the picture of the extent and manner in which radicalisation occurs in Dutch penal institutions, I do not consider specific further investigation necessary at this time.
Gelet op het beeld van de mate en de wijze waarop radicalisering zich voordoet in de Nederlandse penitentiaire inrichtingen acht ik een specifiek nader onderzoek op dit moment nog niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Omtzigt en Knops over de vestiging van een moskee/islamitisch centrum in Gouda

MPs Oskam, Omtzigt and Knops asked ministers about a planned mega-mosque and Islamic centre in former Gouda barracks, including sale arrangements, financing from abroad, links of preachers to jihadism and counter-radicalisation measures. The government answered most questions, declining to comment on individual cases and noting that the municipality is responsible for land use and the financing investigation is ongoing.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik in het openbaar geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over afbetalingsregelingen door het CJIB

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about payment arrangements at the CJIB after a television broadcast showed citizens financially ruined by unpaid traffic fines and their escalation. The state secretary acknowledged the need for instalment payments, announced a generic instalment option for Wahv fines of 225 euro and above to be implemented in 2015 via a pending bill, and described an interim CJIB facility for hardship cases with criteria.
For that reason, it is being made possible to pay Wahv decisions of 225 euro and higher in instalments.
Om die reden wordt het mogelijk gemaakt om Wahv-beschikkingen van 225 euro en hoger in termijnen te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het verwijt van de burgemeester van Maastricht dat er onvoldoende steun uit Den Haag komt in de strijd tegen criminaliteit

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether drug policy explains rising high-impact crime in Maastricht and why the government does not respond to the mayor's call to regulate cannabis cultivation. The minister answered that no causal link can be shown, that he maintains contact with mayors, and that the response lies in an integrated enforcement approach, citing additional police capacity in southern provinces.
I regard local government as a very important partner in the joint approach to crime and nuisance.
Ik beschouw het lokaal bestuur als een zeer belangrijke partner in de gezamenlijke aanpak van criminaliteit en overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Tegengehouden jihadisten extra dreiging’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether blocking jihadists from leaving the country is wise given warnings that they become a threat, and whether the government will stop its deradicalisation approach and revoke citizenship of those who fight abroad. The minister answered that the risks are known, that blocking departure is deliberate policy to prevent foreign fighters from being trained and radicalised, and pointed to two legislative routes to strip Dutch nationality from terrorism suspects.
Blocking radicalised persons remains and will remain deliberate policy.
Het tegenhouden van geradicaliseerde personen is en blijft weloverwogen beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het bericht “Koper breekijzer in regio Ede krijgt aandacht politie”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in the Ede region monitor camera footage and sales records at hardware stores to track buyers of tools that could be used for burglaries, and on what legal basis and with what proportionality. The minister replied that stores voluntarily report suspicious purchases, police assess these tips under their general preventive task, privacy is not violated, and effectiveness will be evaluated over time.
So the police do not request footage or data.
Het is dus niet zo dat de politie beelden of gegevens vordert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Meisje gebeten door pitbull, baasje loopt door'

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police declined to pursue the owner of a pitbull that bit a girl, and whether the police and prosecutors give priority to Article 425 of the Criminal Code on dangerous animals. The minister answered that an investigation is underway, the dog and owner are being sought, and prosecution and municipal measures will be considered once identified; 100 to 200 such cases per year are handled.

Once the dog and its owner are found and the breed is established, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the mayor of Tilburg, will consider whether criminal and/or administrative measures (such as a muzzle order) apply in this case.

Zodra deze gevonden zijn en is vastgesteld wat voor hond het betreft, zal het Openbaar Ministerie in overleg met de burgemeester van Tilburg bezien of strafrechtelijke en/of bestuurlijke maatregelen (zoals een muilkorfgebod) voor dit geval aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de zin en onzin van aangifte doen

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police handling of online crime reports is slow, incomplete and inconsistent across units, and what is being done about it. The minister answered that the online form is secure, improvements such as DigiD identification are due in Q2 2015, and that the police handle about one million reports a year with no capacity problem, while promising to inform parliament further in February 2015.
In February 2015 I will inform the House in more detail about progress in implementing these measures.
In februari 2015 zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang bij de uitvoering van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de plannen de beveiliging van Joodse instellingen per februari te verminderen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether security measures at Jewish institutions would be scaled back from February 2015 and whether they would be increased and extended given the threat. The minister replied that no reduction is planned, measures stay in place while threat and risk warrant them, and structural long-term protection is being discussed with the Jewish community and local authorities.
There is no question of scaling back measures.
Er is geen sprake van afbouw van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Reorganisatie politie kost honderden miljoenen extra’

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked whether the police reorganisation would cost hundreds of millions more than budgeted, how extra costs would be covered, and whether the Court of Audit should check the costs. Minister Opstelten answered that the 230 million euro friction-cost budget is considered sufficient, that extra costs must fit within the budget, that the accounts are audited externally, and that he sees no reason for a separate Court of Audit review.
I see no reason to ask the Court of Audit, on top of the external accountant's audit, to look again specifically at the spending within the friction-cost budget.
Ik zie geen reden om bovenop de accountantscontrole de Algemene Rekenkamer te vragen nog eens extra specifiek naar de uitgaven binnen het frictiekostenbudget te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Sjoerdsma over de vervolging van een Nederlandse coffeeshopeigenaar in Thailand

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service informed Thai authorities about a Dutch coffeeshop owner's case, and why, given the Dutch gedoogbeleid and recent court rulings on back-door supply. The Minister confirmed a Dutch investigation into four Noord-Brabant coffeeshops, said the information sharing aimed to speed up a mutual legal assistance request, and stated that the case goes beyond back-door issues and that the suspect's nationality is not decisive.

The purpose of informing the Thai authorities was therefore to promote and expedite the execution of the legal assistance request in view of the progress of the criminal investigation in the Netherlands.

Het doel van het informeren van de Thaise autoriteiten was dan ook de uitvoering van het rechtshulpverzoek te bevorderen en te bespoedigen met het oog op de voortgang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Religies in gesprek in Ridderzaal’

Two PVV MPs asked why Islamic representatives were invited to a government dialogue in the Ridderzaal, a symbol of freedom, given their view of Islam as a totalitarian ideology. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected by freedom of religion, that the dialogue aimed to bridge differences in a pluralistic society, and that such conversations should continue.
Islam is a religion. Like other religions, this religion falls under freedom of religion and is subject to the same rules.
De Islam is een godsdienst. Deze godsdienst valt net als andere religies onder de vrijheid van godsdienst en is met dezelfde regels omgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mei Li Vos over het artikel ‘Tegenslag in strijd tegen matchfixing’

MPs Van Dekken and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that UEFA and online betting firms (ESSA) no longer share information on match-fixing and that betting firms may not pass on suspicious patterns. The Minister said he was unaware of the sharing breakdown, declined to judge UEFA's claims, and said the forthcoming remote gambling bill would require betting operators to share information on suspicious patterns, with the Gaming Authority supervising compliance.
In the lower regulations for remote gambling, licence conditions will also be included on sharing information necessary to strengthen the fight against match-fixing.

In de lagere regelgeving voor kansspelen op afstand zullen daarnaast vergunningsvoorwaarden worden opgenomen over het delen van informatie die noodzakelijk is voor versterking van de strijd tegen matchfixing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van ’t Wout over het bericht dat ouderen vaker slachtoffer zijn van geweld

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Health about a CBS report showing a rise in violence against elderly people, its causes, and whether additional measures to protect older people are planned. The government said the causes are unclear, pointed to ongoing action plans, prevention campaigns and a care-sector warning register, and said police and prosecutors do not record elder abuse specifically so no sentencing figures can be given.
The police and the public prosecution service do not record specifically on elder abuse.
Politie en het openbaar ministerie registreren niet specifiek op ouderenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat scholieren in Amsterdam zijn mishandeld, afgeperst en met de dood bedreigd

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about reports that pupils in Amsterdam were extorted, assaulted and threatened, and whether this is widespread in schools. The government answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate monitors the situation and has found limited signals at three schools, and that it will keep watching and support schools via the School and Safety centre.
The inspectorate remains alert to the situation and will explicitly hold schools to account for adequately safeguarding pupils' safety where necessary.
De inspectie blijft alert op de situatie en spreekt scholen zo nodig nadrukkelijk aan op adequate borging van de veiligheid van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat een Nederlandse columnist met de dood bedreigt wordt

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about reports that a Dutch columnist was threatened with death and what protective measures and knowledge of the threatener existed. Minister Opstelten said he is deeply concerned and had contacted journalists and columnists after the Paris attack, but declined to disclose protective measures or whether the threatener is known to police, citing ongoing investigation.
While the investigation is ongoing, I will not make any statements on this.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik hier geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een imam tientallen religieuze huwelijken sloot zonder voorafgaand burgerlijk huwelijk

An MP asked whether an imam who conducted dozens of religious marriages without prior civil marriage, and the mosque board's knowledge of it, would be investigated, and what the government would do about such marriages and the women affected. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service investigated, found five provable cases, and imposed conditional fines, that the government has no overview of how many such marriages occur, and that it will inform parliament on a possible study before the end of 2014 and is strengthening support and awareness measures.
The cabinet has no insight into the scale on which Islamic marriages without a prior civil marriage are concluded.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de schaal waarop islamitische huwelijken, waarbij geen sprake is van een voorafgaand burgerlijk huwelijk, worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de reconstructie van gebeurtenissen na de aanslag op de MH17 in het politievakblad Blauw

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about a Blauw police magazine reconstruction of the Dutch forensic team's work after MH17, including contacts with separatist leader Borodai, a request to Van Vliet to approach separatists, and surprise at Malaysian investigators on the train. The government answered that no direct negotiations took place, that contacts ran via the OSCE, that the SGBO asked Van Vliet to arrange access via the OSCE, and that the Malaysian presence was on Malaysia's own initiative with no concrete cooperation agreements yet.
On 21 July there was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Er was op 21 juli geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over het aantal neergeschoten helikopters en vliegtuigen boven Oost-Oekraïne voorafgaand aan de ramp van 17 juli 2014

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the government how many aircraft and helicopters were shot down over eastern Ukraine before the MH17 disaster, what the cabinet knew on 17 July 2014, and related questions about Dutch monitoring, a 14 July briefing, and prosecution timing. The government answered that the numbers were unverified and no validated list could be provided, that no specific airspace consultations took place, and that prosecution options cannot yet be disclosed because the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Both the number and the causes are unclear and not validated.
Zowel het aantal als ook de oorzaken zijn onduidelijk en niet gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht: “Verdachte vrij om DNA-drukte rond zaak MH17”

Member Helder (PVV) asked whether a suspect in a robbery was released from pre-trial detention because the NFI's DNA analysis was delayed by the MH17 workload, and whether budget should be increased. Minister Opstelten answered that the media report was incorrect: the DNA report was ready on 6 October 2014 but not passed to the prosecutor or detective, and the court released the suspect on conditions for personal reasons, so no budget increase is warranted.
No, the media reporting is incorrect and has since been corrected by the AD.
Nee, de berichtgeving in de media is onjuist en ondertussen gerectificeerd door het AD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een verdachte zou zijn vrijgelaten vanwege het niet tijdig onderzoeken van een DNA-spoor

The MP asks about reports that a suspect was released because the NFI did not get to a DNA trace in time, whether forensic work is delayed, and how outsourcing to private forensic institutes and the LTC approval process works. The minister confirms the case, says the NFI is not systematically late, reports that the outsourcing budget is largely spent, rejects that the LTC blocks outsourcing, and commits to simplifying the LTC procedure.
I committed to you during the committee meeting of 19 February 2014 to examine whether the LTC's working method can be simplified.
Ik heb u tijdens het AO van 19 februari 2014 toegezegd te bezien of de werkwijze van de LTC vereenvoudigd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het strafbaar stellen van “wraakporno”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about legal options against non-consensual distribution of sexual images ('revenge porn') and whether Dutch law has gaps, including civil, copyright and criminal routes. The minister gave a detailed overview of criminal, civil and copyright remedies, acknowledged a gap on copying confidential data, and announced new offences in the upcoming Computercriminaliteit III bill.
For that reason I intend to introduce new criminal offences in the Computer Crime III bill, expected to be submitted to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2015.

Om die reden ben ik voornemens om in het wetsvoorstel Computercriminaliteit III, dat naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2015 bij de Tweede Kamer wordt ingediend, nieuwe strafbaarstellingen te introduceren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de transactie met militairen, verdacht van verduistering

PVV MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers why a settlement offer over alleged embezzlement by soldiers in Kunduz was made on embezzlement in a group rather than in a service relationship, and whether the suspects were Marechaussee members subject to dismissal. The Defence minister answered that the settlement was based on the suspicion of embezzlement committed in association, that the suspects were not Marechaussee members, and gave no further explanation of the omitted aggravating element.
Answer 2 See the answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Zie het antwoord op vraag 1.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marcouch over misbruik van de introducéregeling bij schietsportverenigingen

MPs Kooiman and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of the introducé rule at shooting clubs after a TV broadcast showed clubs still ignoring tightened rules, and about inspections, sanctions, certification and a national registration system. The Minister said he was disappointed, outlined sanctions (certificate withdrawal, police permit revocation), argued that additional inspections are unnecessary given the limited scale, and said a national registry lacks added value per the KNSA.
Given the limited scale of the problem and the measures already introduced, in my view there is no reason to deploy more quantitative supervision by the police and inspection visits by the KNSA.

Gelet op de beperkte omvang van de problematiek en de reeds ingevoerde maatregelen, is er naar mijn mening geen aanleiding méér kwantitatief toezicht door de politie en controlebezoeken door de KNSA in te zetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het onderzoek naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the composition of the Joint Investigation Team on MH17, Malaysia's role, Ukraine's veto and non-disclosure arrangements, and who is examining the flight route decisions. The government answered that Malaysia is already formally involved and will join as a member, that the JIT agreement is confidential because it contains operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation, and that the Dutch Safety Board is examining route decisions without addressing liability.
We therefore cannot make the agreement regarding the JIT public.
De overeenkomst met betrekking tot het JIT kunnen wij daarom niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over de stand van zaken rondom de rampplek MH17

An MP from the VVD asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice whether wreckage and personal belongings remain at the MH17 crash site after the recovery mission, and about the security situation there. The government answered that some wreckage and possible remains remain at burn sites and north of Petropavlivka, that recovery will resume after winter if security allows, and that the frontline is a few kilometres north of the site.
After winter, and if the security situation allows, the repatriation mission will resume its work at the crash site.
Na de winter, en indien de veiligheidssituatie dit toelaat, zal de repatriëringsmissie haar werkzaamheden op de rampplek hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over ‘Niet méér, maar slimmer blauw op straat’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a PhD study claiming intelligence-led policing has not taken off, and about whether local priorities like public order risk being lost to numerical targets. The minister disputes that intelligence-led policing has failed, points to planned real-time intelligence centres and the 2015-2018 security agenda, and says numerical targets are set with local authorities.
The information discipline of the police will be strengthened in the coming years.
De informatiediscipline van de politie zal de komende jaren versterkt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat partijen een sharia-schikking hebben bereikt bij de Rechtbank Den Haag

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a Hague court settlement, in which parties agreed to submit their dispute to an imam and swear on the Koran, was acceptable and whether the government would stop such sharia settlements. The Minister answered that the settlement was reached under Dutch law, not sharia, that courts may record settlements unless contrary to law or public morals, and that he does not judge the independent court's assessment.
I do not intervene in this assessment by the independent judge.
Ik treed niet in deze beoordeling door de onafhankelijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over de dood van de 17-jarige Juliette uit Geldrop

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the death of a 17-year-old girl who had filed a threat report shortly before her death, and about police capacity and handling of threat reports. The minister confirmed a suspect was arrested and given a conduct order, but declined further details citing the criminal investigation, and pointed to ongoing police and prosecution improvements and a local pilot.
Because of the interests of investigation and prosecution, no further details can be given about this investigation.
Vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kunnen geen nadere mededelingen over dit onderzoek worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat een relatief groot deel van de homo’s zich onveilig voelt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a quarter of gay men feel unsafe in their neighbourhood, including whether discrimination-related crimes against LHBT people are underpunished and how cooperation between security partners and the 'Roze in Blauw' approach are being handled. The minister acknowledged the higher insecurity among gay and lesbian respondents, pointed to a forthcoming discrimination progress letter and the Veiligheidsagenda 2015–2018, and largely described existing cooperation and policy without new binding commitments.

In the progress letter on Discrimination, to be sent to your House later this calendar year, I will report the most recent figures from the police and the Public Prosecution Service on discrimination.
In de voortgangsbrief Discriminatie, die nog in dit kalenderjaar aan uw Kamer zal worden gezonden, maak ik melding van de meest recente cijfers van de politie en het OM inzake discriminatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over uitlevering van personen aan landen met de doodstraf

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked whether extradition to Texas, a death-penalty state, was approved for a murder suspect and how extradition to death-penalty countries is handled. The government answered that Texas gave a guarantee via the US federal Justice Department that the death penalty would not be imposed, that the suspect was examined in person by a forensic psychiatrist, that Dutch law requires an unambiguous guarantee against the death penalty, and that it sees no conflict with ECHR Article 3.
Extradition to the United States is permitted after the authorities of the state of Texas guaranteed that the death penalty will not be imposed in this case.
De uitlevering aan de Verenigde Staten (VS) is toegestaan nadat de autoriteiten van de staat Texas hebben gegarandeerd dat het opleggen van de doodstraf in deze zaak niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Visser over benzinedieven

MPs Tellegen and Visser asked whether police fail to catch fuel thieves because paper reports are not entered in the national digital system, and what measures are being taken. The Minister of Security and Justice said paper reports are not automatically recorded, that pomphouders are encouraged to use the digital reporting facility, that camera footage upload will be possible by year-end, and that the database contains repeat offenders.
Therefore, before the end of this year, the digital reporting facility will offer the option to upload images that support the report and may help with the investigation.

Daarom wordt nog voor het einde van dit jaar binnen de digitale aangiftefaciliteit de mogelijkheid geboden om beelden te uploaden die de aangifte ondersteunen en die behulpzaam kunnen zijn bij de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de grote brand op het industrieterrein in Maastricht

The MP asked whether toxic substances and asbestos were released in a large fire at a Maastricht industrial estate, why residents did not receive a NL-Alert, and about permits, inspections and fire safety. The Minister answered that no harmful concentrations were found, the NL-Alert was mistakenly replaced by Burgernet, inspections found the companies in order, and the distances to housing were adequate.
It is not known at which company the fire started.
Niet bekend is bij welk bedrijf de brand is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht '2600 rechtszaken om functies bij Nationale Politie'

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about 2,600 lawsuits were filed over job classifications in the National Police, and how many disputes remain before the courts and whether the reorganisation timelines are at risk. The minister confirmed about 9,872 objections, around 2,652 appeals, 16 rulings so far (confirming the employer acted correctly), and stated the appeals are separate from the reorganisation and do not affect its progress.
Of the 2,587 appeal cases actually submitted to the court, a ruling has so far been issued in 16 cases.
Van de 2.587 beroepszaken die daadwerkelijk aan de rechter zijn voorgelegd is inmiddels in 16 zaken een uitspraak gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het supersnelrecht rond oud en nieuw faalt

MPs Van Nispen and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about reports that super-fast-track justice (supersnelrecht) fails around New Year's Eve, including sentencing gaps and appeal rates. Minister Opstelten rejected the claim of failure, defended the measure as a signal against public-space violence, and said the procedure is carefully applied under the prosecution menu, with appeal rates not notably different from other cases.
I do not share the claim that the use of super-fast-track justice around New Year's fails.
De stelling dat de inzet van supersnelrecht rond oud en nieuw faalt deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over patiënten die fors voor een donornier betalen

An MP asked the ministers whether paid illegal organ trade occurs in the Netherlands, how doctors should handle suspected commercial donors, how medical confidentiality relates to reporting suspicions, and whether a reporting point or donor premium exemption should be introduced. The minister answered that the Netherlands lacks clear evidence of such trade, that existing law and possible criminal reporting already suffice without new guidelines or a reporting point, and that financial incentives are ineffective and legally constrained.
I see no reason at this time to set up a reporting point for healthcare providers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op dit moment over te gaan tot het instellen van een meldpunt voor zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het misbruik van patiënten door een veroordeelde zedendelinquent

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Health about sexual abuse of patients by care workers, including whether courts impose professional bans on sex offenders and how often the inspectorate receives reports. The government answered that the inspectorate received 133 reports of sexual boundary violations in 2013, that a professional ban by a criminal court has effect beyond the tuchtrecht route, and it committed to a broader disciplinary ban and mandatory certificates of conduct for new staff in some care sectors.
The Minister of Health intends to make a change that would allow a broader ban to be imposed within disciplinary law than the removal of registration for the BIG profession.
De Minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport (VWS) is voornemens een wijziging door te voeren waardoor het mogelijk wordt om binnen het tuchtrecht een breder verbod op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Britse voornemen om vertrokken jihadisten te denaturaliseren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands would follow the UK in revoking passports of departing jihadists, and about the government's stance on radicalisation and extremism in schools, universities and prisons. The minister replied that passport flagging and refusal procedures already apply, that policy combines several measures, and that a national reporting point and expert support for schools exist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Dekken over doorverkoop van toegangsbewijzen voor concerten

MPs Monasch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about resellers selling concert tickets before official sales start, unusable tickets, and whether this amounts to internet fraud. The government answered that such resale is not per se unlawful but must be clearly disclosed, that consumers and the ACM have remedies, and that a bill criminalising professional internet non-performance is expected in 2015.
We have no insight into the nature and extent of the risk buyers face when purchasing resold entrance tickets.
Wij hebben geen inzicht in de aard en omvang van het risico dat kopers lopen bij de aankoop van doorverkochte toegangskaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een demonstratie van Moslimbroeders in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a Muslim Brotherhood demonstration in Amsterdam, including alleged links to Islamic Relief, the use of the Rabia sign, and whether the group is extremist. The minister answered that individuals linked to Islamic Relief may have attended but the organisation itself is not officially linked, the Rabia sign is used more broadly by opponents of the 2013 Egyptian military takeover, and AIVD found no radical or violent course for the Brotherhood in the Netherlands, with no indications of change.
In the view of the AIVD, the Muslim Brotherhood at that time did not pose a threat to national security or the democratic legal order.
Het Moslimbroederschap vormde naar het oordeel van de AIVD toen geen bedreiging voor de nationale veiligheid of de democratische rechtsorde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Berndsen-Jansen over de ontnemingsschikking met Cees H. en het bericht Teeven weer in opspraak

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about a settlement with Cees H. (EUR 750,000 agreed), the unclear actual payment flows via Luxembourg, the exclusion of the tax authority, and a prosecutor's side agreement on a pardon. The minister replied that the actual financial settlement cannot be verified further, that the agreed amount stands, that no further investigation into the pardon matter is warranted, and that the Staatssecretaris was questioned by the investigator and by the minister.
After this investigation I informed the House by letter of 3 June 2014 that I unfortunately could not inform it further about the actual financial settlement of the agreement.
Ik heb uw Kamer na dit onderzoek bij brief van 3 juni 2014 laten weten dat ik uw Kamer helaas niet verder kon informeren over de feitelijke financiële afwikkeling van de schikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Iedereen bij moskee wist van shariahuwelijken’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Justice Minister about reports that a mosque community knew of sharia marriages, whether such marriages are tolerated, and whether imams performing them should be expelled or stripped of nationality. The minister said no national overview of sharia marriages exists, confirmed that religious marriages without a prior civil marriage are prohibited and punishable, and stated that stripping Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible under current law or planned.
No national overview of this is available.
Hier is geen (landelijk) overzicht van beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over de uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens in twee zaken die Somalische piraten hadden aangespannen tegen Frankrijk

MP Knops asked about two ECHR rulings against France involving Somali pirates, including compensation, whether France acted under UN mandate, and whether the Netherlands could intervene in a Grand Chamber referral. The minister answered that the rulings concern detention without prompt judicial appearance, that the Netherlands handles such cases differently, that Dutch navy operations are unaffected, and that Dutch intervention would depend on a referral and offer legal added value.
The Netherlands has so far organised this procedure differently.
Nederland heeft deze procedure tot dusver op andere wijze vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een anti-Zwarte Piet-demonstrant

An MP asked whether a woman was assaulted over an anti-Zwarte Piet demonstration and whether the perpetrator was arrested, and how the government would prevent violence over this debate. The minister said no complaint was filed, the parties reconciled, no criminal investigation followed, condemned violence, and said local authorities are responsible for the peaceful conduct of the festival.
Although this is the responsibility of local authorities, I can imagine that extra efforts will be made in the coming period to ensure the peaceful course of the Sinterklaas festival.
Hoewel dit aan de lokale autoriteiten is, kan ik mij voorstellen dat er de komende tijd extra inspanningen worden verricht om het vredige verloop van het Sinterklaasfeest te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een mogelijke moordaanslag in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported car collision and shooting in Almere, including whether suspects were identified, whether the shot men were arrested, a possible link to a murdered criminal, and how underworld violence spreading to neighbouring municipalities is handled. The minister confirmed the incident, declined to comment on suspects or links for investigative reasons, and explained that police coordinate across regions and that the case remains under investigation.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, no statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kunnen hier geen uitspraken over worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de geheime malware die aangetroffen is binnen de systemen van de Europese Unie en bedrijven in Europese lidstaten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the ministers whether the government knew of the Regin malware reportedly found in EU and Belgian systems, whether Dutch systems are safe and whether the US or UK were involved. Minister Plasterk said the AIVD found no direct Dutch targeting in 2013, gave no guarantees against foreign malware, declined to confirm details publicly, and pointed to general cyber security initiatives and EU cooperation.
No public statements can be made about that.
Daarover kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de vuurwerkopslag in Heerde

Three MPs (Oskam, Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij) asked whether a fireworks storage facility in Heerde close to a care centre and supermarket is safe, and whether other veiligheidsregio's should inventory similar risks. The state secretary replied that the Vuurwerkbesluit's construction requirements, sprinklers and fire resistance keep the effects of any calamity within the storage facility, declined to order a nationwide inventory, and described the uniform incident-response approach.
As I indicated in the answer to question 1, the consequences of any calamity are limited to the storage facility itself.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 1 heb aangegeven, beperken de gevolgen van een eventuele calamiteit zich tot de bewaarplaats zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van rapid responders en brambulances

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked about the rising use of rapid responders in ambulance dispatch and about a 'brambulance' pilot in Rotterdam-Rijnmond, including liability and effectiveness. The Minister defends rapid responders as speeding patient care, rejects further research and the claim that they are used merely to meet response times, and promises an evaluation of the pilot by early 2015.
Once the evaluation is ready, the safety region will make it public so that interested parties can take note of it.
Zodra de evaluatie gereed is, zal deze door de veiligheidsregio openbaar worden gemaakt zodat geïnteresseerden hier kennis van kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Marcouch over zijn aanpak om het aantal winkeldiefstallen te verminderen en de derving voor de retailers terug te dringen

MPs Oskam and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he will reduce shoplifting and the losses retailers suffer, and about the rules for sharing camera images of suspected shoplifters between shops and chains. The minister answered that no concrete reduction target can be set from the barometer, that sharing suspect data outside a corporate group requires prior review by the CBP, and that a draft bill and a sector protocol are in preparation.
Sharing images of (suspects of) shoplifting between entrepreneurs from different legal entities and groups is part of that.
Het uitwisselen van beelden van (verdachten van) winkeldiefstal tussen ondernemers uit verschillende rechtspersonen en groepen is daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over discriminerende opmerkingen op internet over Nederlandse profvoetballers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked ministers whether they would act on racist online comments about Dutch professional footballers and whether the victims had filed reports. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has opened a preliminary fact-finding inquiry, that MiND has forwarded five reports, and that he sees no need to direct the players or the KNVB to file complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service is opening a preliminary fact-finding inquiry to assess whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een oriënterend feitenonderzoek in om te beoordelen of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over criminaliteit veroorzaakt door “spookburgers”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the ministers about crime by 'ghost citizens' (unregistered residents) in Amsterdam and elsewhere, and about how to tackle it. The government answered that such crime exists in other municipalities, that the number of ghost citizens is at most 100,000 without indicating criminal involvement, that landlords have no duty to check registration, and that a RIEC Amsterdam project is being evaluated.
No (overview) information on this can be obtained from the existing registration systems.
Hierover is geen (overzichts-)informatie uit de bestaande registratiesystemen te halen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Rutte over het wetenschappelijk onderzoek waaruit onder meer blijkt dat het gebruik van cannabis schadelijk is voor de gezondheid, leidt tot een lagere intelligentie en bi

MPs Van der Steur and Rutte asked the government about research linking cannabis use to health harm, lower intelligence and early school leaving, including the Addiction article, cannabis-driving risk, schizophrenia, IQ and school dropout figures. The state secretary answered each question, noting evidence is mixed on causality, that Dutch dropout has fallen, and that cannabis use before 18 should be discouraged.
The original article that Elsevier refers to, published in the journal Addiction, has been added as an annex.
Het oorspronkelijke artikel waaraan Elsevier refereert en dat verschenen is in het blad Addiction is als bijlage toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Jihadgemeenten eisen staatshulp’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about municipal demands for state support in tackling jihadism and returning fighters, including the Hague's call for coordination with central government, screening, and the placement of dangerous returnees in a detention facility for habitual offenders. The minister said the government consults mayors every six weeks, supports municipalities with expertise, and is still examining whether elements of the ISD programme could apply to returnees, without committing to a specific new measure.
At present I am examining whether it is possible to apply elements of the programme offered by the Inrichting Stelselmatige Daders (ISD measure) that address behavioural change to returnees
Momenteel bezie ik of het mogelijk is om elementen uit het programma-aanbod van de «Inrichting Stelselmatige Daders (ISD-maatregel)», die zien op gedragsverandering, toe te passen op terugkeerders
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat de georganiseerde misdaad 25% van de wereldwijde beroepsmatige sportbeoefening in handen heeft

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether the minister knew the WADA director general's claim that organised crime controls about 25% of professional sport, and asked about Interpol information, a possible global anti-matchfixing agency, and links with doping. The minister said the claim could not be traced to Interpol information, that it was not verifiable, that no link with doping was found, and that Dutch support for the Council of Europe matchfixing convention is the chosen route.
As I already indicated during the Sport Legislative Consultation of 27 October 2014, you cannot expect me to forward all third-party information to your House.
Zoals ik al aangaf tijdens het Wetgevingsoverleg Sport van 27 oktober 2014 kunt u van mij niet verwachten dat ik alle informatie van derden aan uw Kamer doorstuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over conflicten over kinderalimentatie als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the abolition of the child-maintenance tax deduction (LOK) from 2015 would cause disputes over alimony and what parents should do. The minister says the reform may affect existing alimony, points parents to advice channels and to courts, and notes the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will advise on a calculation rule early next year.
The request in the motion to develop a standard calculation rule for changing child maintenance amounts due to the child benefits reform has been placed with the Council for the Judiciary.
