Het verzoek in de motie om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel voor wijziging van het kinderalimentatiebedrag als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen is neergelegd bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het buigen van de kunstwereld voor islamitische radicalen

MPs asked whether the government shares concern that an artist's work was not exhibited out of fear of Muslim radicals, and what measures will protect freedom of expression. The minister answered that artistic choices belong to museum professionals, that concrete threats can be reported to police, that he sees no concrete evidence of extremists undermining artistic expression, and that current law adequately guarantees freedom of expression.
In our current legislation and regulations, freedom of expression is already sufficiently guaranteed.
In onze huidige wet- en regelgeving wordt de vrijheid van meningsuiting reeds voldoende gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Straffen bankfraude-zaak fors lager door traag OM’

SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether lower sentences in a large bank fraud case resulted from the Public Prosecution Service leaving the case idle for two and a half years, and what caused any delay. The minister denied a two-and-a-half-year delay, said the case was reopened in late 2012 and scheduled for trial, that the prosecution applied a sentence reduction for the excessive length, has appealed the verdict, and that there is no lack of fraud-fighting expertise or capacity.
This transfer period, however, did not last two and a half years as the cited report claims.
Deze overdrachtsperiode heeft echter geen twee en een half jaar geduurd zoals in het aangehaalde bericht wordt beweerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over te weinig capaciteit bij politie en Openbaar Ministerie om mensenhandel aan te pakken

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and the Public Prosecution Service have enough capacity to tackle human trafficking, including forced prostitution, and whether planned budget cuts will affect specialist staff. The minister replied that the approach is working, that specialist human trafficking officers and teams exist, and that budget cuts will not undermine the ability to prosecute trafficking cases.
As a result, it is not possible to indicate how much capacity is deployed specifically for human trafficking.
Hierdoor is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel capaciteit specifiek alleen voor mensenhandel wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens tussen Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en justitie

An MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers how personal data exchange between the Tax Administration, AIVD, police and prosecution works under the convenant and article 43c of the tax implementing regulation, including transparency, oversight by the CBP, and ANPR data. The ministers answered that exchanges rest on statutory bases, are limited to necessary purposes and published in working agreements, while acknowledging that the number of prosecution requests is not aggregated.
A request is always made under the Code of Criminal Procedure and must at all times meet the requirements set out in it.
Vordering vindt altijd plaats op grond van het Wetboek van Strafvordering, en moet te allen tijde voldoen aan de daarin opgenomen vereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het na geruime tijd alsnog seponeren van een dagvaarding kort voor de terechtzitting

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how a minor charge against a party member over a 2012 demonstration could take over two and a half years and then be dropped shortly before trial, and whether this was linked to earlier procedural errors and to the prosecutor's earlier claim of a principled issue. The minister explained that the prosecution was abandoned because renewed prosecution after the court's ruling was not considered opportune given case law, denied any link to ICT problems, and called the case an exception while pointing to ongoing justice-system improvement efforts.
In this case there is an exception.
In deze zaak is sprake van een uitzondering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Oosenbrug over de uitwisseling van persoonsgegevens van miljoenen Nederlanders door de Belastingdienst, AIVD, politie en Justitie

MPs Schouw and Oosenbrug asked why the Tax Administration's data exchange with AIVD, police and prosecution was only disclosed after a convenant was concluded, and questioned the shared ANPR camera use and retention periods. The ministers answered that a legal basis in art. 67 AWR and the Uitvoeringsregeling applies, that the Tax Administration keeps only fiscally relevant plate data, and pointed to existing privacy supervision and legal remedies, without committing to new measures.
There was therefore no reason to send these convenants to your House.
Er bestond dus geen aanleiding deze convenanten aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat een agentenmepper een lagere straf heeft gekregen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a lower sentence for an officer-assaulting man because of his debts was acceptable and whether sentencing law should be changed to exclude such circumstances. The minister answered that judges independently weigh all circumstances, that sentencing is tailored case by case, and that he would not change the law or comment on specific sentences.
The judge is independent in this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) zeventig banen moet schrappen om de bezuinigingen te halen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asks the Justice Minister how the Netherlands Forensic Institute can cut 70 jobs to meet budget cuts, given recent capacity shortages and DNA mix-up errors, and whether outsourcing to private labs will rise. The minister answers that the core production will be kept, efficiencies and outsourcing safeguards are in place, the DNA error relates to a protocol changed in 2009, and compensation for errors over five years totals about 5,871 euro.
I do not agree that fewer staff will lead to more cases being outsourced.
Ik onderschrijf niet dat minder personeel ertoe zal leiden dat meer zaken zullen worden uitbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Segers over draagmoederschap

Two MPs asked the government about surrogacy, including unregulated online matching, risks to children, enforcement under the Criminal Code, and the status of existing policy. The Secretary of State answered that the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming investigates only when it learns of a possible surrogacy arrangement, that reporting and a new reporting structure are not needed, that enforcement is limited and largely left to the Public Prosecution Service, and that policy will await the Staatscommissie Herijking Ouderschap, expected in 2016.
It is not inconceivable that single men also make contact with potential surrogate mothers.
Het is niet ondenkbaar dat ook alleenstaande mannen contact leggen met potentiële draagmoeders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een illegale Marokkaan die een terreuraanslag wilde plegen

An MP asked the ministers whether the suspect in a planned terror attack acted alone, whether family members are being screened, what measures prevent his release, whether he will be expelled, and how intelligence services track illegal residents. The ministers declined to give details on the investigation, pointed to the prosecutor and judge on detention, described the rules for expelling criminal foreigners, and said illegal residence alone does not trigger AIVD investigation.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and the judge to determine whether there is reason to extend the pre-trial detention of suspects or not.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en aan de rechter te bepalen of aanleiding bestaat de voorlopige hechtenis van verdachten al dan niet te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Man in Amsterdam opgepakt voor voorbereiden aanslag op agenten’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported arrest in Amsterdam for planning an attack on police officers, including why border controls were not reintroduced, how the suspect entered the Netherlands, whether borders should be closed to immigration from Islamic countries, and whether police should stop wearing uniforms in public. The Minister answered that border controls would be a last resort and not proportionate, declined to discuss individual cases, rejected closing borders, and said there are no concrete indications of an attack and no reason to deploy the military at stations.
No statements are made about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over extra maatregelen tegen autodiefstal

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked about a news report on car theft, rising theft numbers, police priority, a ban on sale of key duplicators and car-theft electronics, ANPR camera privacy rules, and online sale of moped tuning kits. The minister denied a rise in thefts, said a sales ban is legally hard to justify under proportionality and EU law, noted a pending bill allowing 28-day retention of ANPR passage data, and offered to consult the trade on other options.
A sales ban is very difficult if it cannot be shown that these systems have no other use than carrying out criminal activities.
Een verkoopverbod is erg lastig als niet kan worden aangetoond dat er geen enkel ander nut is voor dit soort systemen dan het uitoefenen van criminele activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘ISIS-vlag in beslag genomen’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether three men who waved an ISIS-type flag should be stripped of Dutch nationality and have their passports revoked. The minister replied that a prosecution decision is still pending after advice from the anti-discrimination expertise centre, so such measures are not yet on the table, and no further details can be given for reasons of investigation and prosecution.
Because of investigation and prosecution interests, no further information can be provided.
Vanwege belangen van opsporing en vervolging kunnen geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over het bericht dat de rechtspraak een commercial court wil

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the judiciary's proposal for a commercial court for large international trade disputes, including its effects on the business climate, comparisons with other countries, expected speed, and costs. The minister replied that he awaits the Council for the judiciary's exploratory study, cites the UK Commercial Court and existing specialised commercial jurisdiction, and declines to anticipate the outcome or give cost and speed estimates.
I await the outcomes of that exploration and do not consider it desirable to anticipate those outcomes.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van die verkenning af en acht het niet wenselijk op de uitkomsten daarvan vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘‘extra geld voor controleurs natuurgebieden’’

An MP asked the ministers about a reported 100,000 euro in extra funding for training of nature-area enforcement officers (groene boa's), including its cost coverage, cost control, the content of training and whether bureaucracy will be reduced. The government answered that the funds are a structural contribution to employer costs, will be covered within the Economic Affairs budget, that an evaluation of training is under way due by year-end, and that cooperation arrangements with employers were agreed, though several questions were answered with references to future evaluation.
Based on this research, a decision will follow on whether and, if so, which adjustments should be made within the overall training system in domain II.
Op basis van dit onderzoek zal een beslissing volgen of en zo ja welke aanpassingen er binnen de gehele systematiek van opleiden binnen domein II dienen plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het verzwegen leed van afstandsmoeders

An MP asked the State Secretary about the concealed suffering of unmarried mothers forced to give up their children for adoption, including the scale of the practice, church involvement, state oversight of adoption procedures, the case for further research and apology, and support for birth parents searching for family. The State Secretary acknowledged the suffering and estimated about 20,000 adoptions since 1956, but said the church's role cannot be quantified, that the state's knowledge of illegal adoptions is unknown, and that further research is not obviously a government task while pointing to existing reports and subsidised search support.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat de rechtbank Utrecht niet goed beveiligd is

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked about reports that fake weapons were smuggled into the Utrecht court through a back door and whether court security was tightened. The Minister answered that the incident at the Midden-Nederland court exposed a pass registration and authorisation problem, outlined the Rijkspas security framework, and listed measures such as replacing all passes and checking deactivation of departed staff's passes.
I find this a worrying incident to which the Midden-Nederland court responded adequately.
Ik vind dit een zorgwekkend incident waar de rechtbank Midden-Nederland adequaat op heeft gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar jihadi-training in Ardennen’

Written questions from PVV MPs asked whether jihadi training facilities exist in or are used from the Netherlands, how many of the 41 passport-confiscated jihadists were trained in the EU, and whether jihadists can be denaturalised and expelled. The minister replied that no evidence of training camps in the Netherlands exists, that 48 passports are flagged, and that a bill to strip nationality from dual nationals convicted of terrorism is being prepared.
I have no indications that jihadist training camps are located in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat zich in Nederland jihadistische trainingskampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ronselpraktijken op een luchtmachtbasis

An MP asks the Defence and Justice ministers about alleged jihadist recruitment at the Volkel air base, including whether the radicalised ex-soldier has been located, what measures exist against radicalised ex-military personnel, and how many ex-staff are involved in jihadist activity. The government answers that recruitment is criminal under the Penal Code, that the integrated jihadism approach also covers Defence staff, that the MIVD investigates radicalisation when warranted, and declines to give numbers or operational details.
I cannot make any statements about the numbers of radicalised former Defence employees involved in jihadist activities.
Over aantallen geradicaliseerde ex-medewerkers van Defensie die betrokken zijn bij jihadistische activiteiten kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het verhalen van de kosten van het opruimen van drugsafval op de daders

An MP asked whether drug-dumping offenders are rarely traced, whether landowners such as the municipality of Landerd are kept informed of prosecutions, and whether victims should be compensated for cleanup costs. The ministers replied that dumping is not separately registered, landowners can join criminal proceedings as injured parties, and the government opposed a compensation scheme, referring to a parliamentary amendment.
Dumping of drug waste is as such not registered in the operational process systems of the public prosecution service (OM).
Het dumpen van drugsafval wordt als zodanig niet geregistreerd in de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het openbaar ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie dit jaar veel meer uitgeeft aan extern personeel dan begroot

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the National Police spends far more on external hired staff than budgeted, and whether a cap like the 'Roemernorm' should apply. The minister answered that external hiring is 4-5% of personnel costs, within the government norm, that hires are for a complex reorganisation and business continuity rather than replacing permanent staff, and that a diensthoofd HRM's arrangement does not circumvent the pay norm.
The total costs for external hiring by the police lie between 4 and 5% of total personnel costs and thus fall well within the government norm for external hiring.
De totale kosten voor externe inhuur van de politie liggen tussen de 4 en 5% van de totale personele lasten en vallen daarmee ruim binnen de Rijksoverheidsnorm voor externe inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de politie veel meer personeel inhuurt

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is true that police spend far more on hiring external staff, and whether this should be halted given terrorism threats and the cost compared with hiring frontline officers. The minister confirms external hiring costs of about 186 million against a budgeted 155 million, defends the spending as needed for the police reorganisation and continuity, and declines to halt it, while saying the force will keep scrutinising costs.
The police's most recent forecast assumes realised external hiring for 2014 of about 186 million.
De meest recente prognose van de politie gaat uit van een realisatie externe inhuur over 2014 van circa 186 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat de helft van de jonge verdachten allochtoon is

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the WODC's claims that relatively more second-generation Moroccan and Turkish youths have higher crime rates, and that allochtone youths are presumably less involved in cybercrime, are scientifically grounded, and whether a research bureau should refrain from unsubstantiated statements. The Minister confirmed the statements, cited a 2012 CBS-based publication for the first claim, treated the cybercrime remark as a hypothesis warranting further research, and defended the WODC's role in formulating testable assumptions.
Part of scientific research is also formulating assumptions in order to test them empirically afterwards.
Onderdeel van wetenschappelijk onderzoek is ook het formuleren van veronderstellingen om die daarna empirisch te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn, Moors en Van Oosten over het bericht “Tweetal steelt AOW via DigiD-fraude”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about a report that two people stole old-age pensions via DigiD phishing fraud, and how victims were compensated and future fraud prevented. The state secretary answered that a criminal investigation found about 5,000 possibly misused DigiD accounts and total losses of about 50,000 euro, that victims were fully compensated, and that the government will try to recover the money and promote safer DigiD use, with a promised overview of further measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Nederland kan IS alleen verbieden op initiatief van het OM”

MPs Helder and Wilders asked whether IS can be banned in the Netherlands only on the initiative of the public prosecutor, and why Germany could ban it while the Netherlands could not. The minister answered that IS is already banned in the Netherlands via the EU sanctions list combined with the Civil Code and the Criminal Code, that no civil dissolution procedure is available because IS cannot acquire legal personality here, and that he will act if new measures prove necessary.
If necessary I will act immediately and ensure targeted strengthening of the legal instruments.
Indien noodzakelijk zal ik direct optreden en zorgen voor gerichte versterking van het wettelijk instrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Of slapen er terroristen in Zwolle’

MPs De Graaf, Fritsma and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of possible jihadist terrorists among asylum seekers, whether border closures and subsidy cuts were warranted. The minister answered that there are no concrete indications of planned abuse, that reintroducing internal border controls would be disproportionate, and that he will not close borders or cut subsidies, while pointing to a letter on measures and promising continued vigilance.
For operational reasons, I cannot make specific statements about any possible indications in this regard.
Vanwege operationele belangen kan ik geen specifieke mededelingen doen over eventuele aanwijzingen hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het gebruik van de Quick Connect-koppeling

An MP asked whether the minister's letter wrongly implied that Quick Connect couplings had been replaced everywhere by screw couplings, whether reinforced variants can still fail, and which safety regions still use them, and whether the government will stop their use until proven safe. The minister answered that the weak combination was replaced everywhere by a robust one, that the reinforced-variant test lacked scientific basis, that no problems have been reported, and that the Veiligheidsberaad confirmed no further issues.
The letter of 7 October reported that the weak coupling combination has been replaced everywhere by a robust one.
In de brief van 7 oktober is gemeld dat de zwakke koppelingscombinatie overal is vervangen door een robuuste.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de betrokkenheid van jihadisten  bij onderwijsorganisaties

Two MPs asked ministers about jihadist involvement in a private Arabic-language and Islamic education foundation, including oversight, funding and whether such bodies can be shut down. The government said it finds extremist messaging unacceptable, that the foundation falls outside inspection as non-recognised education, and that it will act if laws are broken, while declining to give details on specific persons or organisations.
No public statements will be made about investigative information on specific persons or organisations.
Over onderzoeksgegevens over specifieke personen of organisaties worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een anti-joodse mishandeling in Arnhem

Two MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about an anti-Jewish assault in Arnhem and whether they would act on an anti-antisemitism action plan. The minister said a criminal complaint was filed and under investigation, that the government is convening dialogue and educational initiatives, but sees no added value in the proposed action plan beyond existing policy.
Because of the interests of investigation and prosecution, I cannot provide any information on that.
Vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik daar geen mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Van Nispen, Van Tongeren and Bruins Slot asked the ministers about reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and about the Health Council's findings on forensic medicine training and funding. The minister replied that existing registers and quality guidelines suffice for now, declined to fund the forensic physician training or a chair, and promised a further update in mid-2015.
Recent signals from the field and from your House are grounds to examine whether the quality of the body inspection should be tightened.
Recente signalen vanuit het veld en uw Kamer zijn aanleiding om na te gaan of de kwaliteit van de lijkschouw dient te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de politie geen betrouwbare cijfers heeft over hennepacties waarbij geen kwekerij wordt aangetroffen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police lack reliable figures on home entries where no cannabis grow is found, and about aftercare and damage compensation for residents. The minister agreed that reliable figures are important, noted that BVH was adjusted in September 2014 to generate such data, supported personal explanation to residents and prompt damage settlement, and said a national damage procedure is being developed.

In early September 2014 the police made an adjustment in the Basic Enforcement Facility (BVH) so that from that date figures can be generated on entries into premises where no cannabis grow was found.

Begin september 2014 heeft de politie een aanpassing gemaakt in de Basisvoorziening Handhaving (BVH), zodat met ingang van die datum cijfers kunnen worden gegenereerd over het binnentreden van plaatsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de zorgen van de Nationale ombudsman over onterechte invallen in woningen bij het opsporen van hennepkwekerijen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the National Ombudsman's concerns over wrongful home raids while searching for cannabis cultivation sites, including how often raids occurred, their impact on residents, police capacity and costs. The minister answered that wrongful raids were not previously registered, that the police added a registration option in September 2014, and that capacity and compensation costs are not separately recorded.
Entries into premises as such are not registered.
Binnentredingen als zodanig worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het gebrek aan betrouwbare gegevens over ‘hennepacties’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the lack of reliable data on police raids on suspected cannabis grow sites, following an Ombudsman report. The minister answered that there is no reason to believe entry warrants are granted too easily, that 6 of 36 complaints about such entries were formally upheld in 2012–2013, and that the police began recording entries where no cannabis grow was found from September 2014.
However, it is good to gain better insight into the number of – viewed afterwards – wrongful cannabis raids.
Wel is het goed om beter inzicht te krijgen in het aantal – achteraf beschouwde – onterechte hennepinvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over jihadverdachten die op verzoek van het OM zijn vrijgelaten

An MP asked why the Public Prosecution Service, after seeking pre-trial detention of two jihad suspects, later accepted their release under strict conditions and whether ankle monitors and reclassering oversight are adequate. The Minister declined to comment on the court's individual decision, denied a long waiting list for electronic monitoring, and defended the conditions as monitored, while acknowledging contact between suspects cannot be fully excluded.
I do not intervene in the judgment of the independent judge in an individual criminal case.
Ik treed niet in het oordeel van de onafhankelijke rechter in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de gewelddadige en  antisemitische bedreigingen door een pro-ISIS scholier

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about threats by a pro-ISIS pupil against Jews, the safety of pupils and staff, the rise of antisemitism among Muslim pupils since the AIVD warned in 2004, and whether anti-terrorism laws such as administrative detention will be introduced. The Minister said the OM will assess prosecution for the statements, declined to discuss security arrangements in public, pointed to schools' duties and existing support, and held that new administrative measures are not necessary because the OM has sufficient criminal tools.
I cannot make public statements about the security situation of persons or organisations.
Over de veiligheidssituatie van personen of organisaties kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kantonrechter stomverbaasd over onkunde justitie’

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a court report of three innocent people wrongly fined and summoned because of a data-matching error, and whether this relates to budget cuts. The Minister acknowledged the errors, attributed them to human mistakes in linking personal data, said internal research found the regular checks were skipped after an objection, and denied a link to budget cuts.
In these cases, as the district judge established, errors were made.
In deze zaken zijn, zoals de kantonrechter heeft geconstateerd, fouten gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht ‘Wie belasting betaald, wordt uitgelachen’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice, on behalf of the State Secretary of Finance, about reports that prostitutes in Amsterdam commit tax fraud, the investment in their social position, the opting-in regime and its evaluation, administrative support for self-employed sex workers, bank account access, and rent levels. The government denies the described tax fraud phenomenon apart from one malicious bookkeeper, says the sector's position is being improved, promises an evaluation of the opting-in regime soon, and mostly points to market forces and existing initiatives.
There was indeed a dishonest bookkeeper active in Amsterdam who victimised prostitutes.
Wel is er in Amsterdam een malafide boekhouder actief geweest, waar prostituees het slachtoffer van zijn geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het aftuigen van een tiener door dertig man

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a teenager beaten by a group of about thirty people, including whether the suspects were mainly of Turkish origin and whether multicultural tensions are growing. The Minister replied that the police investigation is ongoing, one minor suspect was arrested and released pending further inquiry, the group members had varied ethnic backgrounds, and that existing local tools would be used if threats to public order arise.
Because of conflicting witness statements, it is among other things still not clear what the circumstances were and who was all involved.
Door tegenstrijdige getuigenverklaringen is onder meer nog niet duidelijk wat de toedracht was en wie allemaal betrokken waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Een grote groep, voornamelijk Turkse jongeren, die een jongen afgetuigd hebben’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report of a group, mostly Turkish youths aged 13 to 17, who assaulted a boy, and called for harsher youth crime measures, an ISD for juveniles from age 12, and group liability. The Minister referred to earlier answers on the group's composition, defended the existing juvenile criminal law and combined approach, refused the ISD extension, and said participants proven to have joined the assault can be held liable under the existing group-violence provision.
No, I am not willing to do that. Juvenile criminal law offers sufficient possibilities to address youth crime.
Nee, ik ben daartoe niet bereid. Het jeugdstrafrecht biedt voldoende mogelijkheden om jeugdcriminaliteit aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanval op een student in defensie-uniform

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether an alleged knife threat and car incident against students in defence uniform were linked to jihadist danger, and what measures would be taken. The minister replied that police found the threat report was false and the car incident was not deliberate, that no other such incidents are known, and that Defence takes staff safety seriously but will not disclose its measures.
So as not to undermine the intended effect, no statements are made about measures taken or still to be taken.
Om het beoogde effect hiervan niet te ondergraven, worden over genomen of nog te nemen maatregelen geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Rebel over de omstandigheden waaronder politiemensen drugslaboratoria en -afval moeten opsporen en opruimen

MPs Marcouch and Rebel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about the working conditions of police and inspectors who detect and clean up drug labs and dumped drug waste, citing a union letter on unsafe conditions, the LFO team's capacity and falling numbers of green BOAs. The minister said the Inspectie SZW will investigate working conditions with no timeline, that LFO capacity has been doubled with new staff expected by 1 January 2015, and that green BOA numbers fluctuate without a structural downward trend.
The Inspectie SZW has since confirmed that it will carry out this investigation.
De Inspectie SZW heeft inmiddels bevestigd dat zij dit onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over beschermingsbewind en het toezicht daarop door de kantonrechter

An SP MP asked the government about the rising number of protective administration orders (beschermingsbewind), the strain on court supervision of professional administrators, the lack of a blacklist, bank account problems, and the funding of inspections. The Secretary of State answered that cases rose steadily, that the new quality rules are too recent to judge, that supervision workload is high but remains with the judge, and that no blacklist is planned for now while banks and sector bodies talk about account opening.
I see no reason to consider a black or white list.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een zwarte of witte lijst te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht moslims delen flyers uit voor protest

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that Muslims were handing out flyers for a protest, and whether the Hizb ut Tahrir caliphate aim undermines the democratic rule of law and whether members with Dutch passports should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister confirmed awareness, described HuT as an anti-democratic radical movement that does not call for violence but warrants vigilance, said measures follow only if criminal offences are committed, and rejected denaturalisation and expulsion as unnecessary.
If HuT were to commit criminal offences, measures would be taken.
Als de HuT zich schuldig zou (gaan) maken aan strafbare feiten dan worden er maatregelen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat er onderzoek gedaan wordt naar een tweet

MP Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the NCTV is investigating a jihadist tweet about three Dutch jihadists killed in Syria, on what legal basis, and whether a notice-and-take-down procedure was considered. The Minister confirmed the NCTV is assessing the tweet's content as a threat analysis, not a criminal investigation, that no take-down was considered, and that analyses draw on intelligence and police input under each service's legal framework.
It does not concern a criminal investigation or an investigation of the kind carried out by the intelligence and security services, but only an interpretation of the content of the tweet.
Het betreft geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek of onderzoek zoals de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten dat uitvoeren, maar slechts de duiding van de inhoud van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over potentiële jihadisten op luchthavens

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists working at airports had been arrested in the Netherlands, whether Dutch and Belgian intelligence services were in contact, and whether airport staff should be screened like in Belgium. The minister answered that no such cases were known to the Public Prosecution Service, declined to comment on international intelligence cooperation, and explained that airport positions with national security risk are designated as trust positions requiring a security clearance from the AIVD.
No public statements can be made about international cooperation between intelligence and security services.
Over de internationale samenwerking tussen inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over diverse ontwikkelingen en reorganisaties in de strafrechtketen en de gevolgen hiervan voor de bestrijding van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about reorganisations in the criminal justice chain, including dissolving the interregional detective units in Brabant and Zeeland in favour of new undermining teams, reduced prosecutor availability, the practice of listing only a few offences on summons, and police detective attractiveness. The minister answered that the redistribution is deliberate, prosecutors' capacity will be increased, asset seizure remains a priority, and the ad informandum practice has long-standing procedural grounds.
There is no reorganisation. It concerns a deliberate redistribution of capacity.
Er is geen sprake van reorganisatie. Het betreft een weloverwogen herverdeling van capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over inzake het integriteitsbeleid bij het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responded to a report finding the ministry's integrity policy was not in order, why the review was commissioned, which recommendations were accepted or rejected, and why no separate integrity unit was created. The minister rejected the negative picture, said several units manage integrity well, adopted two of three recommendations, and declined a separate integrity department because integrity should remain a line responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over het bestraffen van chauffeurs met te hoog beladen vrachtwagens

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked why drivers of overheight trucks at the Velsertunnel are rarely fined, how often fines are issued nationally, and whether road inspectors could be given enforcement powers. The minister explained the notification procedure, reported low fine counts due to police attendance and the planned 2016 renovation, and said talks on a Rotterdam inspector pilot are ongoing.
I refer further to my answer to question 2 for an explanation of the number of height signals compared to the number of fines.
Ik verwijs verder naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 voor een toelichting op het aantal hoogtesignaleringen ten opzichte van het aantal boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over de wijkagent als spilfunctie in het verbeteren van de veiligheid in wijken en buurten

Two CDA MPs asked whether the neighbourhood police officer (wijkagent) is truly a central figure in improving safety, whether the 1-per-5,000-inhabitants norm is met, where it is not, and how specialised support and police posts are secured. The minister affirmed the role, stated the norm is met nationally as a regional average with vacancies being filled, pointed to the other answers for regional figures, and described district-level flex teams and recherche support.
For an overview of the average norm per regional unit, I refer you to the answers to questions 1, 2 and 3 that MP Van Raak (SP) asked on 11 August 2014.
Voor een overzicht van de gemiddelde norm per regionale eenheid verwijs ik u naar het antwoord op de vragen 1, 2 en 3 die het lid Van Raak (SP) op 11 augustus 2014 stelde.
Antwoord op vragen de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Superblunder: Franse jihadisten op vrije voeten'

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that French jihadists were free in Turkey, whether Dutch-passport jihadists were held or extradited, whether they could be kept out, and whether border and passport controls should be tightened or borders closed. The minister said no Dutch-passport jihadists are currently known to be held in Turkey and none extradited, refused to end automated passport checks at Schiphol or to close borders, citing EU free movement and proportionality rules.
Such a decision is, as far as I am concerned, not on the agenda.
Een dergelijk besluit is wat mij betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het groeiende aantal jihadgezinnen

MPs asked about the growing number of jihadist families, reported departures from several municipalities, information sharing with mayors, and passport and nationality measures against departing jihadists. The Minister declined to give municipality-level details, described AIVD and municipal information sharing, outlined the passport and citizenship-revocation options, and described counter-radicalisation communication efforts.
I cannot go into individual cases in public.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het toenemende aantal drugslabs in seniorenflats

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising numbers of drug labs and cannabis grow sites in senior flats, the expected increase in production, health and fire risks, and fire casualty figures. The minister answered that the forecast is not clearly based, that enforcement intensification is underway, that no national shift to senior flats is known, and that cost and fire-cause data are incomplete or unavailable.
There is no complete picture of the extent of (drug) crime, and these higher registration figures may also result from prioritising the fight against drug crime.
Er bestaat geen volledig beeld van de omvang van (drugs)criminaliteit en deze hogere registratiecijfers kunnen ook het gevolg zijn van de prioritering van de bestrijding van drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de uitzending van Brandpunt over lijkschouwers

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked about a Brandpunt broadcast claiming forensic doctors miss crimes, and about standard protocols for death inspections (lijkschouw) including blood and urine testing. The minister replied that forensic doctors must be registered, that a national guideline exists requiring blood and urine sampling, that deviations are permitted if documented, and that no data on deviations is available.
There is no information available on whether, and if so how often, the guideline is deviated from.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over de vraag of, en zo ja, hoe vaak wordt afgeweken van de richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de inzet van de politie bij het aanbieden van gestolen spullen op internet

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police should intervene to help a victim recover a stolen bicycle offered for sale online, and how this fits police guidance on handling. The minister answers that police followed up after tracing the seller, leading to an arrest and return of the bike, that local police policy governs such cases with no national line, and that victims cannot be guaranteed recovery of stolen goods.
There is no general, national policy line in this area.
Er is geen algemene, landelijke beleidslijn op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een ICT-bedrijf fraudeerde met overheidsaanbestedingen

An SP MP asked ministers whether ICT firm Ordina committed procurement fraud with government tenders, how investigations would be followed, how such leaks of confidential information could be prevented, and whether an overarching anti-fraud authority is needed. The government answered that investigations are ongoing and information is limited for investigative reasons, outlined existing safeguards and planned conflict-of-interest rules, and deferred the anti-fraud authority question to a later letter.

Insofar as informing your House does not conflict with the investigative interests, you will be informed by the relevant ministers about the outcomes of ongoing investigations and measures, where there is cause to do so.

Voor zover het inlichten van uw Kamer het opsporings- en onderzoeksbelang niet in de weg staat zal u – indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat – over de uitkomsten van de lopende onderzoeken en maatregelen worden geïnformeerd door de desbetreffende Ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Gelderlander dat de gemeente Neder-Betuwe dumping van drugsafval hard gaat aanpakken

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked how many drug waste dumpings occur, how much police and inspection capacity is devoted to them, and who pays for clean-up. The government answered that no national figures exist, that Brabant recorded about 150 dumpings in 2013, and that dedicated police capacity and cost recovery from offenders are being pursued.
As I set out in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, I do not have national figures on drug waste dumpings.
Antwoord 1, 2 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 2 uiteen heb gezet beschik ik niet over landelijke cijfers over dumpingen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de berichten dat personeel bij de rechtbanken in Leeuwarden en Assen weggehaald wordt

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked whether the Noord-Nederland court's plan to move office staff from Leeuwarden and Assen to Groningen was known to the minister, how it fits the judicial map revision and regional employment commitments. Minister Opstelten said the plan has been withdrawn, that court sittings in Leeuwarden and Assen are unaffected, and that office organisation is a matter for the judiciary itself, with the Raad voor de rechtspraak to report back.
The judgement whether a sitting location must also have an office function is primarily for the Judiciary itself.
Het oordeel of een zittingsplaats ook een kantoorfunctie moet hebben is primair aan de Rechtspraak zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over bericht ‘Personeel rechtbank weg uit Leeuwarden’

MPs Oskam and De Rouwe (CDA) asked whether all office staff of the Leeuwarden court and clerk's office staff of the Assen court will move to Groningen, and how this fits with promises to keep Leeuwarden a full justice city and to protect employment in Fryslân. The Minister answered that Leeuwarden and Assen remain hearing locations with clerk's offices, that the Public Prosecution Service will keep 30 workplaces in Leeuwarden until 2016, and that the Council for the Judiciary will consult court boards on the office function.
Leeuwarden remains a full justice city.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over de plannen om rechtbanken in Noord-Nederland te sluiten waardoor de provincie Friesland zonder rechtspraak komt te zitten

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice Minister about plans to merge the Leeuwarden and Assen courts into a super court in Groningen, which could leave Friesland without local court sittings, and about whether this conflicts with the judicial map and access principles. The Minister answered that no decision to centralise the court's office function has been taken, that court sittings will remain in all 32 designated locations including Assen and Leeuwarden, and that the Council for the Judiciary has been informed and will monitor access, with evaluations promised later.

There is no question that justice will continue to be administered in the 32 sitting locations designated by general administrative order with a statutory pre-consultation procedure, including Assen and Leeuwarden.

Niet ter discussie staat dat er blijvend recht zal worden gesproken in de 32 bij algemene maatregel van bestuur met wettelijke voorhangprocedure aangewezen zittingsplaatsen, waaronder ook in Assen en Leeuwarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een nevenfunctie bij het comité van aanbeveling van het Gergiev Festival

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he sits on the honorary committee of the Gergiev Festival, why this was not on his ministerial CV, and how he views the conductor's support for Russia's annexation of Crimea and anti-gay laws. The minister admitted the membership was an oversight that he has since ended, said he has held no active side functions as minister, and stated that Gergiev's views contradict government positions.
When I took office as a member of the government, I ended my side functions and side activities.
Bij mijn aantreden als bewindspersoon heb ik mijn nevenfuncties en nevenactiviteiten beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over verijdelde islamitische terreuraanslagen in België

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about foiled jihadist attacks in Belgium, whether Dutch threat levels will rise, links to Dutch jihadists, attack counts, and whether administrative detention and loss of nationality for recruiters will be introduced. The minister said the threat level stays at Substantieel, declined to discuss individual cases or attack numbers, and rejected administrative detention for now while noting other measures, including possible reporting duties and contact bans, are being considered.
Recruiting for jihad is a criminal offence. The public prosecution service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over ‘Tanken zonder te betalen’

The MP Dijkhoff asked whether fuel theft ('tanken zonder te betalen') is left unaddressed by police and prosecutors for first and second offenders, and how many reported cases with usable footage led to prosecution. The minister replied that the approach is effective: industry agreements, a dedicated online reporting facility, civil recovery via bailiffs, and a focus on recidivists, while referring to earlier answers for case figures and stating that more specific data is not available.
More specific figures on fuel theft without payment and on the subsequent criminal prosecution are not available.
Meer specifieke cijfers over tanken zonder te betalen en over het strafrechtelijke vervolg zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Verhoeven over het hacken van servers door de politie terwijl de zogenaamde ‘hackwet’ nog niet door de Kamer is behandeld

Members Berndsen-Jansen and Verhoeven asked whether police hacking of servers in the Blackshades investigation has a legal basis while the 'hackwet' bill is pending. The Minister answered that the police acted under article 125i of the Criminal Procedure Code with prior authorisation from an examining judge, in only two exceptional cases, and that the Computercriminaliteit III bill will be submitted early next year.
Under certain circumstances it is possible, on the basis of article 125i of the Code of Criminal Procedure with authorisation from the examining judge, to enter a computer system remotely.
Het is onder bepaalde omstandigheden op basis van artikel 125i van het Wetboek van Strafvordering met een machtiging van de rechter-commissaris mogelijk om op afstand een computersysteem te betreden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het bericht dat het harde drugsbeleid op festivals zowel advocaten als verslavingszorginstellingen te ver gaat

D66 MPs asked whether festival-goers are adequately informed that accepting an on-the-spot fine gives them a criminal record, whether they can consult a lawyer on site, and whether strict drug enforcement at festivals helps health and safety. The Minister of Justice answered that the public prosecutor informs suspects on request, that a suspect can ask for a lawyer and the case is then postponed, and that the effects of enforcement are limited and no harder data exist.
There is no question of a specific strict drug policy at festivals.
Er is geen sprake van een specifiek streng drugsbeleid op festivals.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Rebel over de afdoening van strafbare feiten bij festivals

MPs Recourt and Rebel asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the handling of drug possession cases at the Lowlands festival, including criminal records, VOG consequences and the absence of lawyers on site. The Minister answered that 119 drug cases were settled mostly by OM penalty orders, that registration in JDS is legally required with VOG assessed case by case, and that no permanent lawyer presence was deemed necessary since suspects are informed of rights and can call a lawyer.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that 122 cases were settled at the Lowlands festival this year, 119 of them for drug possession.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij meegedeeld dat tijdens het festival Lowlands dit jaar in totaal 122 zaken zijn afgedaan, waarvan 119 zaken wegens drugsbezit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat een fraude-aanklager verdacht wordt van fraude

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an advocate-general at the Amsterdam appeals court is being prosecuted for fiscal fraud, whether his appointment was properly screened, and whether other cases show non-transparent appointments of VVD affiliates. The minister confirmed a criminal investigation into the advocate-general for private-sphere tax fraud, stated that the regular selection procedure was followed with no contra-indications found, and said no other such cases are known.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements are being made at this time.
In het belang van het onderzoek worden op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het op vrije voeten stellen van jihadgangers

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of jihadist fighters after pre-trial detention was not extended for three of four suspects, and whether administrative detention would help prevent such outcomes. The minister explained the court process (appeal, detention reinstated then suspended with passports seized) and said existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, so administrative detention is not necessary, though temporary measures are being considered.
I do not currently consider it necessary to create administrative detention possibilities.
Ik acht het creëren van administratieve detentiemogelijkheden op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Ontslag fraudeaanklager wegens mogelijke fraude’

MP Helder (PVV) asks whether the dismissal of a fraud prosecutor suspected of fraud could have been prevented by better screening at appointment, and whether a politically connected appointment is normal. Minister Opstelten answers that the advocate-general was appointed through the normal selection procedure, refers to earlier answers to Oskam's questions, and says a prosecutor must have unblemished conduct and that fraud is a high priority, with a letter on the state of affairs promised before year end.
No. The advocate-general in question was therefore appointed after going through the normal selection procedure.
Nee. De betreffende advocaat-generaal is dan ook benoemd na het doorlopen van de normale selectieprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Helder over de terreuraanpak en het dreigingsniveau in Nederland

PVV MPs Wilders and Helder asked why the terrorism threat level was not raised from substantial to critical after a jihadist's call for attacks in the Netherlands, and how much more concrete a threat must be. Minister Opstelten answered that individual threats do not currently warrant a higher level, that the threat remains within the substantial band, and that services are doing everything to prevent attacks, and noted the Chamber was briefed on 29 September.
The threats expressed by individuals do not currently constitute grounds for raising the threat level.
De bedreigingen die door individuen zijn geuit vormen op dit moment geen reden het dreigingsniveau te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over online drugswinkels

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about online drug shops, their turnover, scale, buyers, and whether they break coffeeshop rules and should be prosecuted more than coffeeshops. The minister said the scale is unknown and hard to measure, that online dealers are not covered by the tolerance policy and will be prosecuted criminally, and pointed to investments in digital investigation and international cooperation.
The precise scale of (the turnover from) drug sales on the internet is in fact not known.
De precieze omvang van de (omzet uit de) verkoop van drugs op internet is namelijk niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een student is beschoten met een luchtdrukwapen

The SP MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a student shot with an air-pressure weapon in Zeist, whether such incidents are tracked, whether buyers are warned, and whether stronger air weapons should require licensing and be reclassified under the Weapons and Ammunition Act. The Minister called the incident worrying, said there is no national registry for air-weapon incidents, described voluntary buyer information by dealers and clubs, and announced research into the firing power of air, spring and gas-pressure weapons.
I intend to commission research next year into the firing power of air, spring and gas-pressure weapons.
Ik ben voornemens komend jaar onderzoek te laten doen naar de schotkracht van lucht-, veer- en gasdrukwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onderzoeken naar de aanslag op de MH17

An MP asked when a progress report on the MH17 investigations would be sent, whether Ukraine would be asked to make the investigation agreement with the Dutch Safety Board public, and about the status, signing, and secrecy of the joint investigation team (JIT) agreement, including whether it contains vetoes or prosecution provisions. The ministers answered that the Safety Board's final report is expected in July 2015, that the JIT agreement is binding and signed with government knowledge but will not be published because it contains operational working arrangements, and that it is limited to the investigation phase with no prosecution arrangements.
This agreement is not public, as it concerns a document containing operational working arrangements in an ongoing criminal investigation.
Deze overeenkomst is niet openbaar, aangezien het hier een document betreft met operationele werkafspraken in een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het wegsturen van een agent in de Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a police officer was removed from the Schilderswijk after firm action, under foreign pressure, and whether officers should receive special tension training. The minister denied that the officer was dismissed or disciplined, saying his posting change was planned for training reasons before the incident, and declined to return him.
No, that is not correct. The police officer was not sent away.
Nee dat klopt niet. De politiemedewerker is niet weggestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Den Haag dat het Openbaar Ministerie iemand die een alcoholslot opgelegd heeft gekregen niet ook nog eens strafrechtelijk mag vervol

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a Hague appeals court ruling that the prosecutor may not also prosecute a driver already subject to a mandatory alcohol-lock programme, and about reports of faults in alcohol locks. The government answered that the ruling does not affect the administrative alcohol-lock measure, that the matter is still before the courts, that the CBR imposes the programme uniformly without individual balancing (with an investigation into possible change), and that it is studying mouth-alcohol false readings with a Wageningen University study.
When the alcohol-lock programme was introduced, the legislature deliberately chose to impose it mandatorily and uniformly, without room for individual balancing of interests.
Bij de introductie van het alcoholslotprogramma is door de wetgever bewust gekozen om het programma dwingend en uniform op te leggen zonder ruimte voor individuele belangenafweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam,Omtzigt en Segers over de radicale prediker ‘Tarik ibn Ali’ uit België die naar Gouda

Three MPs asked the ministers whether a Belgian imam with radical messages, invited by a Gouda mosque board, would be barred and whether criminal action was underway. The minister answered that no hateful content is currently expected, the local authority has agreed no incitement will occur, criminal action would follow if it did, and no Belgian investigation is known.
At this moment we have no indications that this person is coming to the Netherlands to proclaim a hateful or inciting message.
Op dit moment hebben wij geen aanwijzingen dat deze persoon naar Nederland komt om een haatzaaiende of opruiende boodschap te verkondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat hackers boos zijn vanwege criminalisering door het Openbaar Ministerie(OM)

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about hacker groups' complaints that the Public Prosecution Service (OM) criminalises hacking through its public consultation and wording, and about the definition of hacking. The minister answered that the OM uses broad consultation for penalty guidelines, that the term hacker has a dual meaning, and that the OM engages with the hacker community while still treating unauthorised intrusion under article 138ab as criminal.
On the OM website a disclaimer will still explicitly indicate that hacking in this sense is meant.
Op de OM-site zal door middel van een disclaimer nog uitdrukkelijk worden aangegeven dat hacken in deze betekenis wordt bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het reisregisterplan dat onlangs door de Kamer is afgewezen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the travel data register plan rejected by parliament, whether it is abandoned, what existing data will be used, the legal basis for prosecutors' access, and the EU funding. The minister confirmed the plan is no longer on the agenda, described a technical facility giving prosecutors automated, targeted access to existing KMar and Customs travel data, and said parliament will be informed of implementation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het gebruik van omstreden spionagesoftware door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police use FinFisher spyware, which software functions it has, what it is used for, and how privacy is protected. The minister said police use software installed on suspects' computers only to intercept confidential communication under art. 126l Sv, remote search only under art. 125i with examining judge authorisation, and declined to give details on specific software for security reasons.
Providing information on which specific software the police investigative services possess, test and use entails major risks for the usability of those means.

Het verstrekken van informatie over welke specifieke software de opsporingsdiensten van de politie beschikken, testen en gebruiken brengt grote risico's met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Conflict Almere over parketwacht”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that criminal and family hearings at the Almere court were suspended from 1 September 2014 due to insufficient police capacity for courtroom security. The minister confirmed the suspension, said hearings would resume in Almere on 17 November 2014 after agreements with the police, and said the police and the court had agreed on a service agreement for 2014–2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Geen politie: geen strafzaken in Almere’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether criminal and family cases at the Almere court would stop because the National Police would no longer assign parquet police there, and about the police capacity problems and the planned meeting with the judiciary. The Minister answered that the police still had enough capacity for parquet tasks, that the court management could move hearings for safety reasons, and that no other courts would lose parquet police.
The National Police has sufficient capacity available for carrying out parquet tasks.
De Nationale Politie heeft voldoende capaciteit beschikbaar voor de uitvoering van parkettaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme geweldsdruk op gevangenisbewakers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about rising violence against prison guards and whether planned job cuts in prison staffing are wise. The State Secretary reported falling incident numbers, said staff safety is a condition of DJI's budget cuts, and gave no new commitments beyond continued monitoring.
The development in the number of violent incidents is closely monitored by the Custodial Institutions Agency.
De ontwikkeling van het aantal geweldsincidenten wordt door de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen nauwlettend gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de voortvluchtige vrouwenhandelaar Saban B.

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked whether fugitive trafficker Saban B. is seen in Facebook photos in Turkey, the status of the investigation, and whether Turkey agreed to enforce his sentence. The minister confirmed authorities know he is in Turkey, that Turkey has been formally asked to take over enforcement since 2013, and that talks continue, but gave no further details citing the interest of the case.
I cannot make further statements at this time in the interest of the case.
Ik kan in het belang van de zaak op dit moment geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Kooiman over het bericht “Tienduizenden zonder 112”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Kooiman asked whether tens of thousands of people cannot reach emergency number 112 by mobile phone, and what is being done about coverage gaps and cross-border cooperation. The minister replied that TNO and Agentschap Telecom are mapping outdoor mobile coverage for 112 (map due in December), that cost and technical options are excluded from that study, and that cross-border arrangements with Belgium and Germany already route emergency calls to the correct Dutch centre.
I am currently having research carried out into outdoor mobile coverage in relation to the accessibility of the emergency number 1-1-2.
Ik laat momenteel onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mobiele dekking buitenshuis in relatie tot de bereikbaarheid van het alarmnummer 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over salmonella en gezondheidsrisico’s bij de firma Foppen naar aanleiding van WOB stukken NVWA van Omroep Gelderland

An SP MP asked the government about NVWA enforcement at salmonella- and listeria-linked fish firm Foppen, including why warnings rather than fines or recalls were used, the traceability failures in the 2012 outbreak, and prosecution. The State Secretary and Minister replied that NVWA intervention follows a predetermined risk-based scale, that fines were imposed for recall and traceability failures, and that the Public Prosecution Service found insufficient grounds for criminal prosecution.
The inspection report can only be made public after an extensive procedure in which the company Foppen is asked for its views.
Het inspectierapport is alleen openbaar te maken na een uitvoerige procedure, waarbij het bedrijf Foppen om een zienswijze wordt gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Samenleving elk jaar voor 30 miljard getild’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a press report claiming fraud costs society 30 billion euros a year is accurate, and whether fraud should be tackled harder and detection raised. The minister said the 30 billion figure cannot be confirmed given wide uncertainty in fraud estimates, reaffirmed the government's anti-fraud action plan and a progress report before year end, and argued cost-benefit logic cannot decide fraud policy.
The cabinet will send the House a progress report on the nationwide approach to fraud before the end of this year.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer voor het einde van dit jaar een voortgangsrapportage sturen over de rijksbrede aanpak van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht Kogel voor een allochtone familie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report on threats against a migrant family, including a bullet delivered to their home, and how the family's safety is guaranteed. The minister confirmed awareness, said an investigation is ongoing and declined to give details on the status of the investigation or on any protective measures.
I cannot give you any information about the status of this criminal investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van dit opsporingsonderzoek kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en de Albert de Vries over berichten met betrekking tot  de kerncentrale in Doel

MPs Wolbert and Albert de Vries asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports on incidents at the Doel nuclear plant in Belgium and their implications for Dutch safety, cross-border cooperation, and information for border residents. The minister answered that the plant is safely shut down, Dutch and Belgian authorities cooperate and exchange information, and no additional measures or resident information beyond the FANC website are currently considered necessary.
Further information beyond what is available on the FANC website is therefore currently not necessary.
Nadere informatieverstrekking dan die te verkrijgen is op de website van het FANC is op dit moment dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een brandweerman tijdens het bestrijden van een brand door een defecte ademluchtfles met Quick Connect-koppeling in acute ademnood kwam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that a firefighter fell into acute breathing distress from a defective breathing apparatus with a Quick Connect coupling, asking how many incidents occurred, whether testing is adequate, and whether use should stop everywhere. The minister reported five incidents across regions, a national inventory showing which regions still use the coupling, that the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, and that the choice of equipment is the employer's responsibility, promising no immediate nationwide halt.
This concerns an employer responsibility – in this case of the safety regions – to provide personnel with sound equipment
Het betreft een werkgeversverantwoordelijkheid – in casu van de veiligheidsregio’s – om personeel te voorzien van deugdelijke middelen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht van Brandweer Haaglanden, dat alle eerstelijns ademluchttoestellen met een snelsluiting (‘quick connect-aansluiting’) vervangen worden door exemplaren met schroefdraa

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Brandweer Haaglanden's replacement of quick-connect breathing apparatus couplings after three incidents, and about the investigation timelines and safety measures. The minister confirmed the incidents and the pending manufacturer and regional investigations, but said equipment choice and safety are the employers' (veiligheidsregio's) responsibility and that the Social Affairs ministry is examining the product under the Warenwet.
This concerns an employer's responsibility – in this case of the safety regions – to provide personnel with sound equipment enabling them to carry out tasks safely and effectively.
Het betreft een werkgeversverantwoordelijkheid – in casu van de veiligheidsregio's – om personeel te voorzien van deugdelijke middelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er achterstanden bij het NFI zouden zijn vanwege de werkzaamheden in het kader van MH17

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported delays in forensic work for criminal cases at the NFI caused by MH17 identification work, how large the problem is, how the backlog will be cleared without harming quality, and why extra funds are not used to engage private forensic institutes. The Minister says delays are at most four weeks, that intake restrictions are lifted and overflow work will be outsourced to accredited private institutes, and that the extra funds are reserved for specific cases.
I want to stress that, as far as can be foreseen now, the delay effect on NFI delivery times for the relevant areas of expertise is at most four weeks.
Ik wil hierbij benadrukken dat, voor zover nu valt te voorzien, het vertragingseffect op de levertijden van het NFI voor de betreffende deskundigheidsgebieden maximaal vier weken bedraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Politie omzeilt regels met miljoenenorders: Dure apparatuur op dubieuze wijze besteld'

An MP asked whether the police bypassed procurement rules by ordering 10,000 walkie-talkies and 800 mobile radios, whether the minister knew of this, and what steps will prevent non-compliant purchases. The minister said urgent safety needs justified buying outside the regular tender rules, that he was informed in outline, acknowledged non-compliant contracts in the past, and said these are being re-tendered.
I was informed that due to operational necessity the radio equipment had to be purchased outside the regular procurement rules.
Ik ben op de hoogte gebracht van het feit dat uit operationele noodzaak de randapparatuur buiten de reguliere aanbestedingsregels moest worden aangeschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de islamitische bedreiging van een christen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reports of a Christian man being spat on and threatened by Muslims, whether the perpetrators were arrested, whether Yezidis are also threatened, and what measures will prevent escalating violence linked to returning jihadists. The minister answered that a complaint was filed, no arrests yet, no indications of threats to Yezidis, and pointed to the integrated jihadism action programme for measures.
The criminal investigation has not yet led to arrest(s).
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft nog niet tot aanhouding(en) geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Kooiman en Van Gerven over de publicatie ‘Verstand op veilig’

MPs Smaling, Kooiman and Van Gerven asked whether the government shares concerns from a Rathenau Instituut report that marketisation has strained the core tasks of national-security knowledge institutes, and whether it will convene stakeholders, examine horizontal cooperation and review inspectorates' reliance on these institutes. The minister denied that marketisation is a problem, cited existing funding and statutory safeguards, and declined new round-tables, new horizontal structures or a review, saying existing forums suffice.
The cabinet sees no reason in the report to sit down with the institutions concerned and other relevant parties outside existing forums where this already happens.
Het kabinet ziet in het rapport geen aanleiding om met de betrokken instellingen en andere relevante partijen om tafel te zitten buiten verbanden waarin dat al gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Wolbert over schendingen van de privacy bij het bellen van het alarmnummer

MPs Bouwmeester and Wolbert asked whether the privacy of people is breached when online pages show that ambulance, police or fire services were at a given address, why the issue has not yet been resolved nationally, why some regions shield addresses and others do not, and when it will be fixed. The minister agrees it is undesirable, says a Northern Netherlands approach withholding location in most calls is being evaluated for national use, that encryption of paging messages is being examined, and that the Kamer will be informed later this year.
I find it undesirable from a privacy standpoint that information from paging messages of the emergency services remains visible on internet sites for a long time.
Ik vind het vanuit privacy-oogpunt onwenselijk dat informatie uit pagingberichten van de hulpdiensten langdurig zichtbaar is op internetsites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hachchi over het bericht «Nederland weigert eigen tolk asiel»

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hachchi asked about press reports that the Netherlands refused asylum to a former Dutch interpreter from Uruzgan, whose claim was rejected by Norway, and about the wider treatment of Afghan interpreters. The government answered that Norway is responsible under Dublin, that no individual circumstances justified taking over the claim, that individual talks and compensation payments to a group of 25 Afghan interpreters are under way, and that a referral route via the IND exists.
As the Chamber is aware, I am reticent about providing information on an individual case.
Als uw Kamer bekend, ben ik terughoudend met het verstrekken van informatie over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de gang van zaken bij het faillissement van Estro

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about bonuses paid to Estro's executives shortly before its bankruptcy, whether creditors could reclaim them, and what safeguards exist against abuse of quick bankruptcies. The minister answered that the curator and courts must assess the specific case, outlined the possible recovery routes (undue payment, director liability, bankruptcy pauliana), and pointed to planned reforms such as civil director bans and modernised bankruptcy offences.
It is up to him to investigate whether bonuses were indeed paid shortly before the bankruptcy and to assess whether this was done on improper grounds.
Het is aan hem om te onderzoeken of er inderdaad kort voor het faillissement bonussen zijn uitgekeerd en te beoordelen of dit al dan niet op oneigenlijke gronden is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Telegraaf ‘Extra bezuinigingen bij Justitie door tegenvallers’

An MP asks whether the Justice Ministry faces additional cuts after shortfalls, whether EU criminal law implementation could be dropped to save money, and whether the reclassering waiting list and merging the three reclassering organisations should be addressed. The minister rejects further cuts being ruled out, says EU directives must still be implemented, defends community sentences as effective, and says alternatives for reclassering are being explored with information to follow before the budget debate.
I will inform the House on this in more detail before the budget debate.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer hier vóór de begrotingsbehandeling nader over informeren.
