Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht

An MP asked ministers whether the ECHR ruling on inheritance tax exemptions for businesses versus individuals closed the door on claims by the Stichting Meldpunt Collectief Onrecht, and whether such foundations using false expectations for financial gain are permissible, and what ACM and the Reclame Code Commissie can do without consumer complaints. The Minister answered that the ECHR ruling is final and inadmissible, that the civil courts and ACM would judge the foundation's conduct, that no new complaints have reached ACM, and that ACM and the RCC have enforcement tools, with the RCC cautious about acting ex officio.
The Court answers the question put to it in the negative and declares the applicants inadmissible.
Het Hof beantwoordt de voorgelegde vraag ontkennend, en verklaart de verzoekers niet-ontvankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het mogelijk plegen van genocide en andere misdrijven door de zogenoemde Islamitische staat

Omtzigt asked whether internal legal advice on possible genocide by ISIS in Iraq and Syria would be shared, and when external international-law advice was sought and what it asked. Minister Timmermans declined to release internal advice to protect policy formation, shared the external advice (received 3 September) with the House on 5 September, and explained that the ICJ Bosnia obligation to prevent genocide applies only to states able to influence the perpetrators, which the government considers not to apply to the Netherlands while still committing to prevention and aid.
The internal legal advice on this must remain confidential to allow unhindered internal policy formation.
De interne juridische adviezen hierover dienen vertrouwelijk te blijven voor een onbelemmerde interne beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme geweldsterreur door Marokkaanse criminelen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of hundreds of Moroccan-Dutch youths involved in shootings and robberies, and about tougher sentencing, deportation of criminal immigrants and more police funding. The minister declined to give numbers citing ongoing investigations, said existing sentencing law suffices, rejected deportation-by-default and extra police funding, and gave no new commitments.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that concrete numbers of persons involved cannot be linked to this.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat concrete aantallen van betrokken personen hieraan echter niet kunnen worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het tekort aan wijkagenten

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether there is a serious shortage of neighbourhood police officers across most of the Netherlands, how many exist versus the statutory norm of one per 5,000 residents, and when the norm will be met nationally. The Minister denied a serious nationwide shortage, stated 3,444 officers are employed against 3,413 in the implementation plan, and said the norm is met nationally while some units fall short and vacancies are being filled under agreed personnel rules.
Nationally, the police meet the statutory norm set in the Police Act 2012: on average there is at least one neighbourhood officer per 5,000 residents.
Landelijk gezien voldoet de politie aan de wettelijke norm zoals deze is opgenomen in de Politiewet 2012: gemiddeld is er ten minste één wijkagent werkzaam per 5.000 inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het tekort aan wijkagenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether there is a shortage of neighbourhood police officers (wijkagenten) in many Dutch cities, and for regional figures. The minister denied a widespread shortage, gave regional numbers (3,444 active against 3,413 planned), and said filling open vacancies is subject to agreed personnel-reorganisation rules.
No, it is not correct that there are too few neighbourhood police officers in many cities in the Netherlands.
Nee, het klopt niet dat er in veel steden in Nederland te weinig wijkagenten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bosma over stappen van het Openbaar Ministerie tegen GeenStijl

MPs Helder and Bosma asked whether criminal investigations into GeenStijl photos reflect unequal treatment compared with the 'Dood aan de Joden' case, and whether free speech is safe under this cabinet. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service assesses each case on its merits, that both were examined, and that free speech was not breached criminally.
Each case is assessed by the Public Prosecution Service on its own merits.
Iedere zaak wordt door het Openbaar Ministerie op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de berichten ‘Nederlandse Marokkanen nu ook in Marokko berecht’ en ‘Luxe auto’s en appartementen: daar gaat het geld naartoe’

PVV MPs asked about reports that Dutch-Moroccan dual nationals are detained and prosecuted in Morocco, how many dual nationals are detained and still receive benefits, and whether citizenship, assets, and benefits should be withdrawn or repatriation encouraged. The minister confirmed about 150 dual nationals detained in each country, explained benefit termination via data exchange, rejected the claim of hundreds involved in killings, noted existing asset-seizure and Moroccan benefit-check powers, and declined denaturalisation and benefit restrictions based on work history.
If a person is in detention and receives a benefit from the Dutch state, this benefit is terminated.
Indien een persoon in detentie verblijft en een uitkering van de Nederlandse staat ontvangt, wordt deze uitkering beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het tekort aan politierechercheurs door liquidatiegolf

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the shortage of detectives caused by the rise in liquidations is acceptable, whether assaults go unpursued because of police capacity problems, how the many violent offences will be reduced, and whether one billion euros extra should be invested in the police. Minister Opstelten answered that police detective capacity has grown to about 14,000 FTE, that cases are prioritised by seriousness, that a violence-reduction approach is being pursued, and that he is not willing to invest an extra billion.
There is sufficient capacity available at the national police.
Er is voldoende capaciteit bij de nationale politie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Ouders top-25 geven niet thuis’ en ‘Aanpak top-24 zaak van lange adem’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will strip Moroccan criminals and their families of Dutch nationality and deport them, arguing that the soft approach to crime yields nothing and that parents should bear responsibility. The Minister rejects shifting responsibility to parents, explains that deprivation of nationality is only possible for state-undermining offences with sentences of 8+ years, and refuses to move neighbourhood officers to Morocco.
Revoking Dutch nationality and deportation following a conviction for ordinary offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en uitzetting wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over grote geldproblemen bij de recherche

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that overtime budgets for detectives were running out and that surveillance and arrest teams might withdraw their labour. The Minister replied that overtime is compensated first by time off and otherwise by money within budgets, that Amsterdam has already used much of its 2014 overtime budget, and that police capacity is adequate and must be prioritised, rejecting the call for an extra billion euros.
I expect that management and staff will jointly arrive at solutions.
Ik ga ervan uit dat leiding en medewerkers in deze gezamenlijk tot oplossingen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over de zorgen van de gemeente Raalte over de beperkte dekking van het C2000 netwerk

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about coverage gaps in the C2000 emergency radio network near Heeten, raised by the municipality of Raalte, including consequences for emergency services, the number of white spots and plans for full coverage. The minister confirmed the gap, said 24 coverage problems are open with eight being addressed yearly, explained that emergency services can fall back on direct radio and mobile phones, and said the Heeten problem may be solved in 2015 with a decision in January 2015.
I share the concern of the municipality of Raalte.
Ik deel de zorg van de gemeente Raalte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de angst van joodse burgers in de Haagse Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about fear among Jewish residents of The Hague's Schilderswijk after recent antisemitic incidents, including whether extra protection and an investigation into those planning to leave were warranted. Minister Opstelten answered that additional protective measures are being taken at Jewish institutions, that no separate investigation will be carried out, and that the government will raise the issue at a roundtable on antisemitism.
We do not intend to carry out an investigation as suggested in the question.
Wij zijn niet voornemens tevens een onderzoek zoals in de vraag wordt gesuggereerd te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van drugsafval

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked whether a fund could be created, financed from Plukze proceeds, to compensate landowners for clearing dumped drug waste, and what clean-up costs were in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that no legal barriers exist but the cabinet is reluctant to create budget funds, that costs should fall on the perpetrator, and estimated Noord-Brabant clean-up costs at about 1.5 million euro in 2012 and 3 million euro in 2013.
The costs that landowners face for clearing dumped drug waste should primarily be borne by the perpetrator.
De kosten waarmee grondeigenaren worden geconfronteerd om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen dienen primair ten laste te komen van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Nu al even veel drugsafval gedumpt als in heel 2013’

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the Justice Minister about the rise in synthetic drug waste dumping in Noord-Brabant, its cleanup costs, enforcement capacity, and why prosecutors did not appeal an acquittal in a cannabis-grow case. The minister gave figures on dumpings and costs, described intensified enforcement and funding decisions, and declined to provide some registration data citing administrative burden.
The College of Procurators-General has informed me that it does not have an overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste.
Het College van procureurs-generaal heeft mij gemeld dat het niet beschikt over een overzicht van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld ter zake van het dumpen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de onbeheersbare georganiseerde criminaliteit in Noord-Brabant en Limburg

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about organised crime in Noord-Brabant and Limburg, including drug production, criminal earnings, corruption of officials and threats to mayors, and whether a national coordinator for organised crime should be appointed. The Minister declined to confirm or give figures on many allegations, noted the Public Prosecution Service does not comment on threats or rumours about individuals, and said intensified regional police capacity and existing structures make a national coordinator unnecessary.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it does not make statements about possible threats against public officials.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Rebel en Fokke over de toenemende georganiseerde criminaliteit in Zuid-Nederland

MPs Recourt, Rebel and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising organised crime in southern Netherlands, including threats against mayors, drug-related crime, police funding and coordination. The minister answered that threats are handled under the prosecution service's protection directive, that police capacity in the south will be intensified within existing staffing from 1 October 2014 via regional structures, and that no national crime coordinator is needed.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it makes no statements about possible threats against public administrators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over het bericht dat er geen extra capaciteit ter beschikking wordt gesteld ten behoeve van de aanpak van zware criminaliteit in Zuid-Nederland

MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked whether the minister refuses extra capacity for fighting serious crime in South Netherlands, despite mayors' requests and police warnings about crime moving to the border regions. The minister answered that the authorities decided to deploy more police capacity from 1 October 2014 within existing strength, referring to a separate letter, and described the existing capacity and the earlier TaskForce B5 without giving new numbers on the extra deployment.
The competent authority in South Netherlands has therefore decided to deploy more police capacity to tackle undermining and organised crime from 1 October 2014, within existing strength.

Het bevoegd gezag in Zuid-Nederland heeft dan ook besloten om per 1 oktober 2014, binnen de bestaande sterkte, meer politiecapaciteit in te gaan zetten op de aanpak van ondermijnende en georganiseerde criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Oskam over de doorstart van het kinderdagverblijf Estro

Two CDA MPs asked whether investment firm HIG, a part-owner of bankrupt childcare company Estro, arranged a pre-packaged sale and re-start in which it effectively negotiated with itself, and whether directors or HIG should be held liable. The Minister answered that the curator's report describes a lawful pre-pack process, that HIG was the highest bidder after other bids were sought, that liability is for the curator and courts, and that creditors generally benefit from pre-packs.
It is for him to assess whether there are indications that the directors were guilty of mismanagement in the run-up to the bankruptcy.
Het is aan hem om te beoordelen of er aanwijzingen zijn dat de bestuurders zich in de aanloop naar het faillissement schuldig hebben gemaakt aan wanbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat Curaçao kennelijk stopt met het arresteren van bolletjesslikkers

MP Van der Steur asked whether Curaçao was ceasing arrests of drug swallowers and what the Netherlands would do about rising cases. The Minister denied Curaçao had decided to stop arrests, said a temporary emergency facility was being set up and structural facilities planned, and reported that drug courier cases have declined.
Curaçao has not decided to stop arresting drug swallowers.
Curaçao heeft niet besloten te stoppen met het arresteren van bolletjesslikkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘Nederlands geld voor terreurorganisaties’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of money flowing from the Netherlands to terrorist organisations, including the number of FIU reports, amounts, and arrests, and whether anyone sending money should be treated as a member and prosecuted. The Minister confirmed 108 terrorism files were reported to the FIU in 2013, said suspicious transactions do not themselves prove a crime, declined to disclose report contents, and stated that terrorist financing is punishable and that a planned extension of nationality revocation is coming.
I cannot make any statements about the content of the reports.
Ik kan over de inhoud van de meldingen geen mededelingen doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de "mogelijke genocide in Irak en de maatregelen die Nederland verplicht is te nemen, zoals het onmiddellijk stoppen van alle jihad reizen van Nederlanders en het voornemen tot

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice whether the government's suspicion of IS genocide in Iraq obliges the Netherlands under the Genocide Convention to stop Dutch jihadist travel and criminalise it, and sought legal advice. Minister Timmermans answered that the Convention binds the Netherlands regardless of the government's qualification, that efforts to block departures are ongoing, that a bill on losing dual nationality is coming, and that external legal advice has been requested.
The cabinet refers in this regard to the answers to parliamentary questions on IS and the situation in Iraq of 11 August 2014
Het kabinet verwijst in dat verband naar de beantwoording van de Kamervragen over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak van 11 augustus 2014
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat hackers 1,2 miljard inloggegevens en 500 miljoen e-mailadressen hebben gestolen

MPs Verhoeven and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hackers stole 1.2 billion login credentials and 500 million email addresses, and whether Dutch organisations were affected and how this relates to the data breach notification bill. The minister could neither confirm nor deny the claim, said the NCSC had alerted its government and critical-sector audience and is seeking information from Hold Security, and explained that breaches like this would generally need to be reported under the proposed duty.
This claim I can neither confirm nor deny.
Deze claim kan ik bevestigen noch ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de  'radicaliseringsaanpak' van dit kabinet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the government's approach to radicalisation, including meeting hate imams with mayors, the failure of the earlier 2007-2011 programme, the link between jihadism and Islam, and closing mosques or expelling imams and returning Syria fighters. The ministers answered that hate preachers are denied visas and can be handled administratively, that prior programme lessons are kept in a knowledge bank, that violent jihadism conflicts with the rule of law, and that nationality revocation for terrorist offences is being prepared.
Preachers or imams from visa-required countries who are known to call for hatred and violence are refused a visa.
Aan predikers of imams uit visumplichtige landen en van wie bekend is dat zij oproepen tot haat en geweld, wordt een visum geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht dat haatimams moeten worden aangepakt

Two D66 MPs asked how the government intends to stop hate preachers (haatimams), whether criminal law or a conversation with mayors is the right tool, how often such cases occurred and whether visas or residence permits were refused, and why the focus is on imams rather than other radicalising channels. The ministers answered that visa refusal, administrative measures and criminal law (art. 137d) apply, that no imam-related residence permits were refused on national security grounds in 2012-2014, and that a broader multi-year programme with mosques and local government on radicalisation is planned.
Criminal law applies (article 137d of the Criminal Code) to public statements that incite hatred against people because of their race, religion or belief.
Het strafrecht is van toepassing (artikel 137d Wetboek van Strafrecht) op openbare uitspraken die aanzetten tot haat tegen mensen wegens hun ras, godsdienst of levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Frankrijk wil verbod op uitreizen jihadstrijders’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a French bill to ban departures of jihadist fighters, whether it was discussed at EU level, and whether it includes sanctions on return. The minister declined to comment on the French bill as it is pending in the French parliament, and said existing criminal law suffices while a temporary administrative-law act is needed to reduce risks from returnees.
Since this proposal is still under consideration, I do not consider it appropriate to go into the substance of the French bill.
Aangezien dit voorstel nog in behandeling is acht ik het niet gepast om inhoudelijk in te gaan op het Franse wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Nu al even veel drugsafval gedumpt als in heel 2014’

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many Brabant and Limburg mayors had requested extra capacity against drug crime, whether organised drug crime is shifting to the south, and what he learned on a recent visit to Brabant. The minister acknowledged serious concern in the south, said police capacity will be redirected within existing strength from 1 October 2014 (detailed in a separate letter), and reported that mayors raised worries about smaller municipalities; he did not give a count of mayors' requests.

The competent authority in the south of the Netherlands has therefore decided that from 1 October 2014, within existing strength, more police capacity will be deployed against undermining and organised crime.

Het bevoegd gezag in Zuid-Nederland heeft dan ook besloten om per 1 oktober 2014, binnen de bestaande sterkte, meer politiecapaciteit in te gaan zetten op de aanpak van ondermijnende en georganiseerde criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het opheffen van het locatieverbod en enkelband voor Volkert van der Graaf

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the minister finds it outrageous that a court lifted the location ban and electronic tag for Volkert van der Graaf, the murderer of Pim Fortuyn, and what steps would be taken against it. State Secretary Teeven replied that it is not for him to judge court rulings, noted the decision was an interim measure, and said the Public Prosecution Service has appealed and he awaits the higher court's ruling.
It is not for me to judge rulings of a judge.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over uitspraken van een rechter.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de afhandeling van overtredingen van de Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg door de NZa totdat het nieuwe samenwerkingsprotocol met het OM in werking is getreden

MPs Leijten (SP) asked how the NZa will handle Wmg violations involving possible overlap with criminal conduct until the new cooperation protocol with the Public Prosecution Service takes effect, including whether the 'grown practice' of referring only deliberate cases to the OM is appropriate, and how the VUmc children's ward fraud case will be handled. The ministers answered that the NZa applies its enforcement policy, that the CSO Zorg practice is a non-binding agreement among partners, that an updated protocol is expected before 1 October 2014, and declined to comment on the individual ongoing VUmc case.
The protocol is an agreement between the participating partners among themselves; it is up to the partners themselves to hold each other to the working arrangements.
Het protocol is een afspraak van de deelnemende partners onderling, het is aan de partners zelf om elkaar op werkafspraken aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het besluit van de NZa om het onderzoeksrapport inzake de boeteoplegging aan het Sint Antonius Ziekenhuis  niet openbaar te maken

An MP asked why the NZa refused to publish its investigation report on the fine imposed on the Sint Antonius hospital, questioning the Wob basis, whether secrecy still applies after the case closed, and whether an anonymised version could be released so parliament can exercise oversight. The minister replied that the report is a separate document from the fining decision, that the report of findings has now been attached to a letter to parliament, and that the fining decision itself was already published.

The report of findings of the supervisory authority has now been attached as an annex to the letter 'Submission of the Borstlap committee report, evaluation of the Wmg and other assessment of NZa administrative costs'.
Het rapport van bevindingen van de toezichthouder is inmiddels als bijlage bij de brief «Aanbieding rapport commissie Borstlap, evaluatie Wmg en andere beoordeling bestuurskosten NZa» bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de stelselmatige terreur tegen joden in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked how the government will respond to reported systematic intimidation and threats against Jewish people in the Netherlands, including antisemitism linked to anti-Israel demonstrations, and who pays for security costs. The minister condemns antisemitism, outlines dialogue and an interfaith meeting, explains the limits of the mayor's powers over demonstrations, and says the state covers security measures it imposes while individuals are first responsible for their own protection.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after consultation with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all relevant parties to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over de berichten ‘Crimineel bedreigt Joden’, ‘Joodse vrouw zwaar mishandeld om Israëlische vlag’ en ‘Hamas-vlag aan de Admiraal de Ruijterweg’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of a criminal threatening Jews online, the assault on a Jewish woman over an Israeli flag, and a Hamas flag displayed in Amsterdam, asking whether the threats were investigated, how Jewish safety is protected, and whether local authorities can ban terrorist symbols. The minister answered that the OM examined the threats as incitement and the suspect was brought before the investigating judge, that the OM now treats public display of IS and Hamas flags as punishable, and that security for Jewish institutions is being reviewed with the NCTV and local authorities.
The OM determined in mid-August its national position on the punishability of symbols, flags and other forms of expression.
Het OM heeft medio augustus het landelijk standpunt ten aanzien van de strafbaarheid van symbolen, vlaggen en andere uitingsvormen nader bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een anti-Israëlische ambtenaar op het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant at the ministry who publicly claimed ISIS was a Zionist plot, and whether such a person could pose a state security risk given access to sensitive information. The minister distanced the government from the statements, explained the official was in a support role outside the NCSC's operational work, and reported her secondment was ended and she was suspended pending possible employment consequences.
At this stage the person concerned has been informed of the intended employment-law consequences.
In dit stadium is betrokkene geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen rechtspositionele gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over het bericht “PvdAer: ISIS is complot”

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked whether a Ministry of Security and Justice employee whose Twitter posts they called racist and radical should be dismissed. Minister Opstelten distanced himself from the posts, said her secondment to the NCTV was ended immediately, and said she is suspended pending an investigation and a decision on employment measures.
To ensure a careful decision-making process, the outcome cannot be anticipated.
Omwille van een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces kan niet vooruit worden gelopen op de uitkomsten daarvan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops over de tweet waarin een ambtenaar van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie stelt dat ‘Islamitische Staat (IS) een vooropgezet plan van zionisten is die bewust de Isl

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant's tweet claiming IS is a Zionist plot, and whether IS is monitored online and what policy applies to civil servants who support or excuse IS. The minister distanced the government from the tweet, explained that the NCSC monitors digital security rather than all online expressions, and set out the limits on civil servants' freedom of expression under the Ambtenarenwet, with disciplinary sanctions possible after advice from an advisory committee.
I completely distance myself from the content of the tweet.
Ik neem volledig afstand van de inhoud van de tweet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over antisemitische incidenten in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers about the rise in antisemitic incidents in 2013 (147 vs 114 in 2012), measures against online antisemitism, and whether the government would investigate perceptions of Israel. The minister called the figures worrying, outlined round-table and education initiatives, said research on perceptions of Israel would not be commissioned, and committed to further meetings and reviews.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de nog steeds niet uitgevoerde motie over het uitwisselen van informatie over in het buitenland veroordeelde zedendelinquenten, zodat ze niet in Neder

CDA MPs asked why a motion to exchange information on foreign-convicted sex offenders, so they cannot obtain a VOG and work in childcare, remains unimplemented, and whether Dutch children are adequately protected. The Minister confirmed the motion, said information exchange with non-EU countries happens only case by case, and promised an Interpol-related study and a progress report before the end of 2014, while acknowledging the VOG cannot fully exclude misuse.
in contrast to the arrangements within the EU, criminal information is not exchanged structurally with countries outside the EU
wordt in tegenstelling tot de afspraken die gelden binnen EU-verband, niet op structurele wijze strafrechtelijke informatie uitgewisseld met landen buiten de EU
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groei van het anti-homogeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a reported rise in violence against gay people in Amsterdam, whether it is structural, the ethnic background of suspects, and whether repressive measures should replace prevention. The minister acknowledged a modest rise in registered incidents (176 to 189), declined to record suspects' ethnicity, and restated a combined prevention and repression approach included in the Veiligheidsagenda 2015-2018.
The national police does not record the ethnic background of suspects or perpetrators.
De Nationale politie registreert niet op de etnische achtergrond van verdachten of daders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de artikelen 'Nederlandse Joden huren bewaking in', 'Angst onder Rotterdamse joden na bedreiging op straat', 'Gesprek moet helpen' en 'Antisemitisme: 'Zo doen wij

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about press reports on Jewish security, antisemitism, a housing association's letters ordering removal of an Israeli flag, Muslim discrimination, and revoking Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers. The minister answered that the housing association regretted its letters and no action is planned, an antisemitism study is due in early 2015, and nationality can only be revoked after a terrorism conviction under limited conditions.
A study into possible breeding grounds and triggering factors for antisemitism ... will be delivered in early 2015.
Een onderzoek naar mogelijke voedingsbodems en triggerfactoren voor antisemitisme ... zal begin 2015 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat steeds meer agenten kampen met schulden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that more police officers are in debt, including whether debts are underreported, whether officers are dismissed after a second wage garnishment, and whether police pay should rise. The minister said such debts are undesirable, that no historical overview exists (about 600 wage garnishments), that a new debt-assistance framework applies, denied dismissals as a routine practice, and maintained that current pay is adequate.
Such an overview cannot be provided as these figures are not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan ik niet verstrekken aangezien deze cijfers niet beschikbaar zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat tijdens de brand op het Shellcomplex aan de Chemieweg in Moerdijk d.d. 3 juni 2014 tegen de afspraken in de drinkwaterbedrijven niet zijn geïnformeerd

An MP asked whether drinking water companies Brabant Water and Evides were not properly informed during the June 2014 Shell Moerdijk fire, and what this means for water quality, cooperation with safety regions and convenant implementation. The minister answered that Midden- en West-Brabant did not alert the water companies because no risk was seen, that Zuid-Holland Zuid did inform Evides, that water quality was not endangered, and that implementation of the covenants is being monitored and pushed, with a fuller plan to follow.
The Dutch Safety Board is conducting further investigation into, among other things, crisis management including communication.
De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid verricht nader onderzoek naar o.a. de crisisbeheersing inclusief de communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over hakenkruizen bij een anti-Israëldemonstratie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about swastika flags shown at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, whether anyone had been arrested, what measures would be taken, and about rising antisemitism. The minister answered that the mayor had acted within the Municipal Act after the organiser was warned, that no arrests had been made, that a criminal complaint is being examined by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government is addressing antisemitism with stakeholders.
With regard to the statements made during the demonstration of 12 July 2014 in The Hague, a criminal complaint has been filed.
Ten aanzien van de uitingen die zijn gedaan tijdens de demonstratie van 12 juli 2014 in Den Haag, is aangifte gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Helder over de anti-Israëldemonstratie

PVV MPs asked whether police failed to act against Nazi and terror symbols and a Hitler salute at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and whether the mayor failed and suspects should be arrested, stripped of Dutch nationality and expelled. The minister refers to earlier answers, says criminal punishment is for the judge, and explains that Dutch nationality can only be revoked for terrorism convictions after 1 October 2010 and that residence can be ended only after a final conviction.
If someone has committed a criminal offence, it is for the judge to assess what punishment is appropriate, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien iemand een strafbaar feit heeft begaan, is het aan de rechter om te beoordelen welke straf passend is, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over de berichten ‘GeenStijl bedreigd op ISIS-demo, politie doet niks’ en ‘Van Aartsen, het Kalifaat heerst in uw Schilderswijk’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a GeenStijl journalist was told to stop filming at an ISIS-related demonstration, about threatening calls at the demonstration, and about police equipment and the protection of Jewish institutions. The Minister mostly referred to earlier answers to parallel questions, said police and the mayor had adequate resources, and said prosecution decisions rest with the public prosecutor and local authorities.
If criminal limits are exceeded, the public prosecution service decides whether criminal action is taken against it.
Indien strafrechtelijke grenzen worden overschreden, bepaalt het OM of hiertegen strafrechtelijk wordt opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de antisemitische demonstratie in Den Haag

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an antisemitic demonstration in The Hague, including Hitler salutes, threats to journalists and calls to kill Jews, and why no arrests were made. The minister condemned antisemitism, attributed the rise in incidents to tensions linked to the Middle East conflict, referred to answers given to parallel questions, and said the mayor is accountable to the municipal council, with no commitment to new action.
The assessment of the mayor's conduct is therefore primarily reserved for the municipal council.
De beoordeling van de handelwijze van de burgemeester is dan ook primair voorbehouden aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de antisemitische demonstratie door moslims in Den Haag

Three PVV MPs asked why police and the mayor did not act against alleged criminal speech (calls to violence, a Hitler salute) at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and why a journalist was removed rather than her harassers arrested. The minister answered that two people were arrested and will be prosecuted, no Hitler salute was found, the mayor lacks legal power to ban a demonstration for its content, and the journalist's treatment aimed to prevent escalation.
The mayor also has no power to act against a demonstration solely to prevent or end criminal offences.
De burgemeester heeft ook geen bevoegdheid tegen een demonstratie op te treden enkel ter voorkoming of beëindiging van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de demonstratie van ISIS-aanhangers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports of an ISIS-supporter demonstration in The Hague, including alleged Hitler salutes, racist chants, and a threatened journalist. Minister Opstelten answered that police observed no hate-inciting or offensive texts, that investigations found no Hitler salute, and that prosecution decisions rest with the public prosecutor.
It is for the public prosecutor to judge whether criminal limits were exceeded in this case.
Het is aan het OM om te oordelen of er in dit geval strafrechtelijke grenzen zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de Gaza-demonstratie van 24 juli 2014 in Den Haag

Three MPs asked the ministers about the Gaza demonstration in The Hague on 24 July 2014, including whether it was properly notified, whether police and prosecutors acted on antisemitic chants, threats to journalists, and display of ISIS flags. The government answered that the demonstration was notified as required with 50 expected participants, referred to answers given to related questions, and stated the prosecution's position that displaying IS and Hamas flags is punishable under the Penal Code.

The position is that IS (formerly ISIS/ISIL) and Hamas, banned as terrorist organisations by the EU and UN aiming at violence against certain population groups, public display of their flags constitutes a criminal offence in the prosecution's view under Articles 137d and 137c of the Penal Code.

Het standpunt houdt in dat nu IS (voorheen ISIS/ISIL) en Hamas (door de EU en de VN) verboden, terroristische organisaties zijn die tot doel hebben geweld te plegen tegen bepaalde bevolkingsgroepen, het in het openbaar tonen van deze vlaggen van deze organisaties naar het oordeel van het Openbaar Ministerie strafbaarheid oplevert
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de anti-Israëldemonstratie in Den Haag op 24 juli 2014

Mrs Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about anti-Jewish chants at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, the speed of the no-crime finding, police risk assessment, press arrangements and press safety. Minister Opstelten mostly referred to answers given to earlier parliamentary questions on the same demonstration, and stated that neither the Public Prosecution Service nor the mayor had signalled a threat to journalists in advance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de anti-Israëldemonstratie die zaterdag 12 juli 2014 in Den Haag is gehouden

MPs Voordewind and Segers asked the Justice Minister whether he regretted Nazi and ISIS symbols shown at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, how they would be countered, and whether mayors should get more powers. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service now treats displaying IS and Hamas flags as punishable, noted that free expression and demonstration can be restricted under ECHR and criminal law, and said existing mayoral powers appear sufficient.
At present there is no reason to assume that those powers fall short.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding te veronderstellen dat die bevoegdheden tekortschieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een demonstratie in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked the ministers about a demonstration in the Schilderswijk in The Hague, including why police rerouted an anti-ISIS march, how many people were arrested, whether such neighbourhoods undermine state authority, and whether a billion euros should be invested in the police. The government answered that six people were arrested, referred to earlier answers on the policing and order questions, rejected the call for an extra billion euros for the police, and said the police have sufficient resources.
During the demonstration of 10 August, six persons were arrested.
Tijdens de demonstratie van 10 augustus jl. zijn er 6 personen aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de onrust tijdens de IS-betoging in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked whether a counter-demonstration disrupting an anti-IS march in The Hague, allegedly by sympathisers with IS, is worrying, how many arrests were made, and what the government will do to prevent further incidents. The minister condemned IS and stressed fundamental rights, explained that mayors under the Public Manifestations Act cannot ban demonstrations for their content, and said the Public Prosecution Service had not been informed of other incidents.
The Public Prosecution Service has not been informed of incidents other than those in The Hague during demonstrations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is niet op de hoogte gesteld van incidenten – anders dan die in Den Haag – tijdens demonstraties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een aanhouding bij de Nederlandse Veteranendag

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether a spectator carrying the Morgenstervlag was arrested at the Veteranendag parade, whether the flag played a role, and whether the arrest was proportionate. The government answered that the person was arrested for climbing a fence into a closed security zone, not for the flag, that the Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag banned non-regimental flags at the parade by agreement with veterans' associations, and that the case is a standalone matter for local authorities and the Openbaar Ministerie.
In the first instance it is up to the local authorities to judge what happened.
Het is in eerste instantie aan het lokale gezag om een oordeel te geven over hetgeen er is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het kwijtraken van geld na een pseudokoop van drugs

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about undercover money going missing after a drug pseudo-purchase, including how it was lost, measures to prevent recurrence, and how responsibilities were divided with foreign partners. The Minister said the loss stemmed from an unforeseeable chain of events, the money may still be found, and declined further detail citing the ongoing investigation while stating that Dutch law was followed.

In the interest of the ongoing investigation I can make no statements on this other than that the loss of sight of the so-called show money was preceded by an unfortunate combination of circumstances that could not have been foreseen.

In het belang van het lopende onderzoek kan ik hierover geen mededelingen doen anders dan dat aan het uit het zicht raken van het zogenaamde toongeld een ongelukkige samenloop van omstandigheden vooraf ging die niet was te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Ruim baan voor verkeershufters’ en ‘Oom agent is onzichtbaar’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the number of traffic stops had halved, whether traffic offenders are getting free rein, and about the effectiveness of speed cameras and section control. The minister replied that traffic enforcement remains a police priority, that stops rose by over 50,000 in 2013, that the planned 2015 harder approach to repeat traffic offenders is in preparation, and that automated enforcement changes behaviour, while rejecting the claim of free rein.
I will inform you shortly in more detail about the preparations for this new approach to repeat offenders.
Ik zal u op korte termijn nader informeren over de voorbereidingen voor deze nieuwe veelplegeraanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over de ontruiming van een gedeelte van het centrum van Amsterdam naar aanleiding van de bommelding op 25 juni 2014

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked about the evacuation of central Amsterdam after a bomb threat, including whether Hotel Krasnapolsky should have been evacuated and whether disabled people face delays in evacuations. The minister said the hotel was not ordered evacuated, that police only advised, and that no evidence shows disabled evacuations are delayed, while declining to collect data on building accessibility and pointing to planned rule changes.
I do not have that data and I do not consider it necessary to collect that data after all.
Ik beschik niet over die gegevens en vind het ook niet nodig om die gegevens alsnog te verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat cybercrime Nederland jaarlijks 8,8 miljard euro kost

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that cybercrime costs the Netherlands 8.8 billion euro a year, whether the government should play a bigger role, who coordinates cyber security, and whether companies are reluctant to report crimes. The minister disputes the cost estimates as hard to verify, says the government is strengthening its role in cyber security and enforcement, describes coordination between ministries and private partners, but leaves the NaWas anti-DDoS project to private initiative and declines to give companies anonymous reporting beyond exceptional cases.
The economic damage caused by cybercrime is difficult to quantify.
De economische schade als gevolg van cybercrime is lastig te becijferen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Oskam over het bericht dat Franse hardrijders vrijuit gaan omdat met het uitwisselen van gegevens over verkeersboetes tussen Frankrijk en Nederland zaken niet goed geregeld zij

MPs De Rouwe and Oskam asked why French and Polish drivers committing traffic offences in the Netherlands escape fines while Dutch drivers are fined in France, and whether Dutch data sharing with France would be suspended. The minister answered that the Netherlands complied with the EU obligation to open its vehicle register, that enforcement adjustments for French and Polish plates are being phased in with completion targeted this year, and that the revenue loss cannot be quantified.
I aim to have the adjustments for processing offences by French plate holders completed this year, and afterwards those for Polish plate holders.
Ik streef ernaar de aanpassingen voor het verwerken van de overtredingen van Franse kentekenhouders dit jaar gereed te hebben en daarna die voor de Poolse kentekenhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over fraude bij schadeherstel van auto’s

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about widespread fraud in car bodywork repair, reported by the insurers' association, and whether the government would act if the sector fails to fix it. Minister Opstelten said he supports industry measures within legal and proportionality limits, pointed to a convenant and a shared-data approach with RDW and VbV, and described existing police and prosecution arrangements, without announcing new government intervention.
I think it is good that the Association of Insurers has investigated irregularities and fraud in the repair of bodywork damage to passenger cars.
Ik vind het goed dat het Verbond van Verzekeraars onderzoek heeft gedaan naar onregelmatigheden en fraude bij de reparatie van blikschade aan personenauto's
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over straatcoaches

The MPs asked whether street coaches, subsidised by municipalities, conceal crimes from police, whether police agreements with them obstruct information flow, and what the government will do given a Movisie study finding them ineffective. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such arrangements, that no national agreements exist, and that he will discuss the Movisie findings with the VNG and report to the House.
It is the responsibility of the local authority to make agreements on the deployment of street coaches and cooperation with the police.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal bestuur om afspraken te maken over de inzet van straatcoaches en de samenwerking met de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht “VS willen meer veiligheid luchthavens Europa”

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the US is pressing for tighter security at European airports with direct flights to the US, whether Dutch airports are affected, and whether explosives without metal are a threat to Schiphol. The government confirmed that only Schiphol is affected, that the threat of non-metal explosives is known and monitored with the US and partners, and that additional security measures for US-bound flights took effect on 8 July.
Schiphol is the only Dutch airport to which this applies.
Schiphol is de enige Nederlandse luchthaven waarop dit van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf , Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Gevaarlijke jihadist vaak buiten beeld’

PVV MPs asked whether the government will reintroduce border controls, detain and expel returning jihadists and impose an immigration stop from Islamic countries after a report that foreign jihadists move freely in Europe unknown to the services. The Staatssecretaris answered that European intelligence cooperation is intensified, rejected the listed measures as incompatible with the constitution and treaties, and pointed to a national action programme on travel-data collection for later this autumn.
Concrete public statements cannot be made about the nature of cooperation between intelligence services.
Over de aard van de samenwerking tussen inlichtingendiensten, kunnen in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over gevaarlijke jihadisten die buiten beeld zijn

An MP asked why European intelligence services exchange few jihadist names, whether open borders enable jihadists to move unnoticed, when border controls will be reintroduced, and what steps will improve data sharing. The Staatssecretaris answered that cooperation is improving, that reintroducing border controls is not proportionate now and is a last resort, that a national action programme will follow, and referred to earlier answers for data sharing.
At this moment, deploying these extreme measures is not proportionate to their effectiveness.
Op dit moment staat het inzetten van deze uiterste maatregelen niet in verhouding tot de effectiviteit daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een antisemitische oproep tot geweld tijdens de Haagse pro-ISIS-demonstratie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he knew of a reported antisemitic call to violence (invoking Khaybar and 'Joden, herinner je Khaybar') at a pro-ISIS demonstration in The Hague, and what measures would follow. The State Secretary said he had noted the report, that discriminatory statements are punishable, and that the Public Prosecution Service is gathering complaints and will assess whether the statements were criminal.
Following these complaints and the Omroep West broadcast, the Public Prosecution Service will assess whether there are criminal statements.
Naar aanleiding van deze aangiften en de uitzending van Omroep West zal het Openbaar Ministerie beoordelen of er sprake is van strafbare uitlatingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Health, and Interior about the planned tendering of forensic medical care and examination by the National Police, including quality, fragmentation, and ministerial responsibility. The government answered that the tender is in its preparatory phase under the light regime of the Aanbestedingswet, that existing providers may bid, and that it rejects a single-ministry responsibility, while declining to disclose some preparatory information.
For the second part of your first question, answering it would release information that may not be disclosed during the preparation of this tender.
Voor het tweede deel van uw eerste vraag geldt dat antwoord geven op deze vraag leidt tot het vrijgeven van informatie die tijdens de voorbereiding van deze aanbesteding niet vrijgegeven mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het versneld afdoen van zaken door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) op gespannen voet staat met een eerlijk proces

MPs Van Nispen asked whether the OM's fast-track ZSM approach to criminal cases undermines a fair trial, including access to counsel, information for lawyers, and judicial review. Minister Teeven answered that ZSM respects defendants' rights (Salduz consultation, legal aid, right to object to a penalty order and go to court), that information is documented in writing, and that a separate government reply on the human rights report would follow.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de houding van geprivilegieerden t.a.v. betaling van boetes

An MP asks whether diplomats who ignore serious traffic fines should be sanctioned more effectively, including via a blacklist and fuel-card measures like those used in the United States. The minister answers that roughly half of the fines in 2012-2013 went unpaid, that Netherlands lacks jurisdiction over absolute-immunity diplomats, and that announced measures aim to encourage payment, while the US-style approach is deemed unsuitable.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has examined in detail the options for holding privileged persons to account for unacceptable conduct, without undermining the treaty obligations the Netherlands has.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft uitvoerig gekeken naar mogelijkheden om geprivilegieerden aan te spreken op onacceptabel gedrag, zonder dat daarmee afbreuk wordt gedaan aan de verdragsrechtelijke verplichtingen die Nederland heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het misbruik van een faillissement

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack practice) are used to cheaply dismiss staff and disadvantage creditors. The Minister defended the pre-pack practice as beneficial for creditors and employment, said abuse would be refused by courts, and pointed to a forthcoming bill and a civil director ban and shareholder register.

Moreover, when the power to file for bankruptcy is used for a purpose other than the one it is meant for – for example to reduce staff quickly and 'cheaply' – this constitutes abuse of rights according to settled case law.

Daarnaast geldt dat wanneer de bevoegdheid tot het doen van een faillissementsaanvraag wordt gebruikt met een ander doel dan waarvoor zij is bedoeld – bijvoorbeeld om het personeelsbestand snel en « goedkoop » te kunnen terugbrengen – dit volgens vaste jurisprudentie misbruik van recht oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs asked the government how it responds to reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and whether training should be publicly funded to prevent a shortage and quality problem. The minister said employers are responsible for staffing, a professional register safeguards quality, and no short-term measures or public funding are currently warranted.
I saw and see no reason to take measures in the short term.
Ik zag en zie daarin geen aanleiding om op korte termijn maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Recourt over lijkschouwers die nog steeds misdrijven missen door gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Wolbert and Recourt asked whether forensic doctors with a short 30-day course get the same powers as those with a four-year profile training, and whether national figures on missed unnatural deaths exist. The minister answered that no such figures are kept, that the professional body's register is considered sufficient guarantee of quality, and that the supply of forensic doctors is not seen as requiring short-term measures.
I do not have figures on the number of times it later became apparent that a natural cause of death had been wrongly assumed.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal keren dat in een later stadium is gebleken dat aanvankelijk onterecht is uitgegaan van een natuurlijke doodsoorzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over politie en Openbaar Ministerie die niets doen tegen ladingdiefstal door spookbedrijf

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police and the Public Prosecution Service were doing nothing about cargo theft by a fake company, including why the victim company was no longer contacted and why an investigation was apparently halted. The minister answered that the case was transferred to the national police infrastructure unit, that contacts with the victim continue, that the appointment-based complaint procedure is explained by limits on internet reporting, and that police and prosecution were unaware of the Haaglanden investigation mentioned in the press.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Van der Steur over het bericht dat smartshops levensgevaarlijke drugs verspreiden

MPs Rebel and Van der Steur asked whether illegal narcotics sold as vitamin pills in smartshops were known, how the NVWA and IGZ supervise smartshops, whether national rules should replace local ordinances, and how drug-testing services and the police fit in. The state secretary answered that the four Amsterdam and Utrecht shops are under examination, that supervision is joint (NVWA, IGZ, police) and mostly complaint-based, and that no additional national rules are considered necessary.
Currently it is being examined further how action can be taken against the four smartshops in Amsterdam and Utrecht.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzocht op welke wijze kan worden opgetreden tegen de vier smartshops in Amsterdam en Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het 112 alarmnummer slecht bereikbaar is voor doven en slechthorenden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the 112 emergency number is hard to reach for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, including whether calls are often disrupted, whether location data can be detected, and whether harm has occurred. The minister said several channels exist (text phone, intermediary services, the Signcall app), that no police incidents of harm are recorded, and that a fix for disrupted conversations and location transmission is expected within months.
The solution is expected to be realised within a few months.
Naar verwachting is deze oplossing binnen enkele maanden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een veroordeelde pedofiel

MPs asked how a convicted sex offender was able to obtain housing above a childcare centre in Amersfoort and whether such offenders could be barred from child-rich areas. The State Secretary said the municipality did not allocate the home, the offender arranged it himself and the mayor was informed only after the move, and that barring offenders from all child-rich areas is not practically feasible, while pointing to a bill on longer supervision.
The mayor of Amersfoort informed me that there was no allocation of a home by the municipality.
De burgemeester van Amersfoort heeft mij gemeld dat er geen sprake was van toewijzing van een woning door de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de kwetsbaarheid van iTunes

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether iTunes has a vulnerability letting hackers intercept passwords, how many Dutch users are affected, whether the flaw might be deliberate and whether action will be taken. The Minister answered that the flaw is likely an implementation error by Apple, that no active abuse is known in the Netherlands, and that no specific steps will be taken beyond the general cyber security strategy.
No, I will not take specific steps.
Nee, ik ga geen specifieke stappen ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt over het bericht dat ontbreken GSM dekking levens kan kosten

MPs from the CDA asked the government about a reported death in Lattrop where AED alerts did not arrive, whether mobile coverage gaps endanger lives, and whether providers meet licence coverage obligations. The Minister replied that the network functioned properly, that 100% coverage is not achievable, that alternative emergency routes are advised, and that no coverage requirements exist in current frequency licences, with a ministry study on mobile coverage and 112 announced.
I do not have such information available.
Dergelijke informatie heb ik niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over een door terrorisme-experts verwachte aanslag

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about expert warnings of a terrorist attack and whether all returned Syria fighters are actually monitored, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The minister responded that the AIVD gives highest priority to these returnees and additional capacity has been freed, but declined to introduce administrative detention because existing criminal and administrative instruments are considered sufficient.
Research into these jihadist returnees therefore has the highest priority at the AIVD.
Het onderzoek naar deze jihadgangers heeft bij de AIVD dan ook de hoogste prioriteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de aangenomen motie Omtzigt (Kamerstuk 33 750 V, nr. 30) over informatie over veroordelingen van Nederlanders voor zedendelicten in het buitenland

MPs Omtzigt, Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked about information exchange on Dutch nationals convicted of sex offences abroad, which can allow them to obtain a VOG and work with children. The government explains that EU exchange works under treaties and ECRIS, while information exchange with non-EU countries occurs only case by case, with Thailand approached and an Interpol-based approach being explored.
It is not separately recorded in how many cases a VOG was refused to a person with a Dutch passport for a sex offence conviction abroad.
Er wordt niet apart geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen de VOG is geweigerd aan iemand met een Nederlands paspoort voor een veroordeling voor een zedendelict in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een islamitische geweldsprediker

An MP asked the ministers whether preacher Al-Haddad's activities in Almere, a municipality labelled a jihad town, are monitored and whether such preaching harms integration. The minister stated that hateful or violence-inciting statements are unacceptable, that individual monitoring cannot be disclosed, and that the mayor had publicly distanced herself from the preacher and reminded the inviting group of its responsibilities.
I cannot make public statements about the application of measures on an individual basis.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de toepassing van maatregelen op individuele basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over online drugs kopen

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about rising online drug purchases, risks to users, and enforcement against online drug marketplaces such as Silk Road. The government answered that monitoring and police digital expertise are being expanded, cited recent convictions, and declined to add the topic separately to an EU Justice Council agenda.
In the context of the investigative interest, it is not desirable to make statements about this.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang is het niet wenselijk hierover mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de uitzending “Undercover in Nederland” over hulp bij zelfdoding

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about a TV programme showing a De Einder counsellor advising on assisted suicide, and about the scale of such advice and referral practices. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and that suicidal people often do not reach care, but gave no figures on De Einder's advice or its link to suicides and declined to discuss the ongoing OM investigation.
Regarding ongoing investigations by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot make any statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over lopende onderzoeken van het OM kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een opgepakte jihadist

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a returned jihadist held in pre-trial detention for preparing a terrorist offence and weapons possession, including his contacts, the destination of the proceeds of a planned robbery, and whether other returnees finance jihad. The minister confirmed the detention extension, declined to comment on concrete cases or ongoing investigations, and described general financial-monitoring arrangements and criminal liability for financing terrorism.
As you know, I do not make statements about concrete cases or ongoing investigations.
Zoals u weet, doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete gevallen of lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de relatie tussen de bekostiging van de jihad en de georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists who went to Syria had prior police or prosecution contact, whether criminal money funds jihad, how counterterrorism policy addresses links with organised crime, and whether all returning jihadists should be placed in administrative detention. The minister answered that criminal backgrounds are weighed in threat assessments, that financial flows are mapped but criminal funding is often unclear, that existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, and that additional administrative detention is not considered necessary.
In line with earlier correspondence with your House on this subject, the Cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to create additional administrative detention powers for counterterrorism.

Conform eerder correspondentie met uw Kamer over dit onderwerp, acht het Kabinet het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding, op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Helder over de ronselfilm ‘Fighting Journalists, Oh Oh Aleppo “De spookstad”

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they knew of a jihadist recruitment film targeting Dutch youth, whether it aimed at recruiting for jihad, how they view the fact that the people involved are third-generation Dutch-born, and whether they would prosecute the makers and strip citizenship from dual nationals. The minister confirmed knowledge of the film, said it intends to radicalise and recruit youth, stated that recruitment for jihad is a crime with prosecution decided case by case by the Public Prosecution Service, and noted citizenship can be revoked after a final terrorism conviction where dual nationality exists.
Recruiting for jihad is a crime. The Public Prosecution Service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Keijzer over de berichten waaruit blijkt dat een consulent van Stichting De Einder adviezen over zelfdoding geeft

MPs Van der Staaij and Keijzer asked whether a counsellor of Stichting De Einder giving concrete suicide advice and a supplier address to a young woman was acceptable, and whether it was criminal, asking the government to act against the foundation and the Chinese supplier. The minister confirmed the reports, said the Openbaar Ministerie has opened an investigation and declined to comment on it, noted that article 294 Sr is not met since no suicide followed, and pointed to existing medicines-law and economic-offence powers against the supplier.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) is launching an investigation following the reports mentioned.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een onderzoek in naar aanleiding van voornoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het onderzoek naar het verband tussen medicijngebruik en agressie

MPs Van Nispen and Van Gerven asked whether the government will do more research into a possible link between certain medicines, such as antidepressants, and aggression, including taking blood samples from suspects after violent offences. Minister Opstelten answers that the existing drug safety system (CBG, Lareb) already monitors side effects, that the evidence on aggression is mixed and hard to establish in individual cases, that no registration of medicine-linked violence exists, and that there is no legal basis for blood testing of suspects for prescribed medication, which he considers undesirable.
I also do not consider it desirable to create such a legal basis.
Ik acht het ook niet wenselijk om een dergelijke grondslag te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over de mishandeling van spoorwegpersoneel

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked the government about the assault on rail staff, prevention measures, operator practices and court sentencing. The state secretary answered that the case is under investigation, outlined a Veilige Publieke Taak programme and existing measures, and said regional operators' cost and measure details would follow later.

I have asked the relevant subnational governments and PT authorities, as responsible concession grantors toward the regional rail operators, to provide insight into measures and costs regarding social safety.

Ik heb aan de betreffende decentrale overheden en OV- autoriteiten als verantwoordelijk concessieverlener richting de regionale spoorvervoerders (Arriva, Connexxion, Syntus en Veolia) gevraagd om inzicht te geven in maatregelen en kosten op het gebied van sociale veiligheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Helder over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa)  het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft gepasseerd bij het fraudeonderzoek in het St. Antonius Ziekenhuis te Nieuwegei

MPs Klever and Helder asked whether the NZa bypassed the Public Prosecution Service (OM) by imposing only an administrative fine in the St. Antonius hospital fraud case, and whether the tripartite protocol was followed. The ministers answered that the NZa independently concluded there was no intent, so the case did not qualify as a criminal offence under the ne bis in idem rules, that the hospital repaid improper claims, and that fraud must be fought through an integrated approach.

The NZa independently concluded, on the basis of the available investigative material, that no intent had been shown in this case and that the conduct therefore did not also constitute a criminal offence.

De NZa heeft zelfstandig, op basis van het beschikbare onderzoeksmateriaal, de conclusie getrokken dat er in het onderhavige geval van opzet niet is gebleken en de gedraging derhalve niet tevens een strafbaar feit opleverde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Oskam over de uitspraken en antwoorden op vragen over een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude

MPs from SP and CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether earlier answers on the compensation claim of identity-fraud victim Mr Kowsoleea were accurate, why the case remains unresolved despite earlier assurances, and whether the minister will personally arrange talks. The minister confirmed the earlier answers, said the state requested a further substantiation of the claim, and said he would like to see the case resolved soon without committing to a specific step.
Therefore the person concerned has been asked for a (further) substantiation of the alleged unlawfulness and of the causal link between the conduct attributed to the State and the claimed damage.
Daarom is betrokkene gevraagd om een (nadere) onderbouwing van de gestelde onrechtmatigheid en het causaal verband tussen het aan de Staat verweten handelen en de geclaimde schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het gedogen van de verkoop van wiet via internet

An MP asked whether coffeeshops may sell cannabis via internet coupons delivered to homes, and how this can be controlled for age, quantities and advertising. The minister answered that such online sales violate the tolerance policy, cannot be supervised, and that existing criteria and the Opium Act give enough means to act.
In the context of the investigative interest, it is not desirable to make statements about this.
In het kader van het opsporingsbelang is het niet wenselijk hierover mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het binnenvallen van drugspanden door de politie op basis van onvoldoende (geverifieerde) anonieme informatie

MP Oskam asked the Justice Minister whether it is acceptable that a Arnhem court acquitted a suspect of a cannabis grow after police entered a premises on an insufficiently verified anonymous tip, and how such tips are checked, and whether prosecutors should review use of powers. The minister said police did check energy use and the business registration before entry, that the court found no unambiguous consent, that the prosecution chose not to appeal, that no data exists on similar cases, and that the judiciary does not generally see powers as stretched.
No data on these aspects can be extracted from the registration systems of the Public Prosecution Service and the Council for the Judiciary.
Over deze aspecten zijn uit de registratiesystemen van het OM en de Raad voor de Rechtspraak geen gegevens te destilleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de stand van zaken in Irak en de opmars van ISIS

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about returned Syria jihadists, recruiters, terror financing, mosque closures and denaturalisation/detention of returnees. The government answered that about thirty returnees are known, that operational details and locations are not disclosed, that prosecutors and services monitor them, and that mosque closure and nationality revocation are possible under specific legal conditions.
Operational matters and specific cases cannot be disclosed publicly.
Over operationele aangelegenheden en concrete gevallen kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over het bericht dat miljardenwinst door dwangarbeid en seks behaald wordt

MPs Segers and Schouten asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Security and Justice how the government responds to an ILO report on forced labour profits, its size in the EU and the Netherlands, migrant share, enforcement capacity, and international cooperation. Minister Asscher answered that the government is doing all it can, cites rising human trafficking prosecutions, says reliable victim estimates are lacking, and states support for the new ILO forced labour protocol.
It is my intention to ratify the new instrument as soon as possible, after going through the usual procedure.
Het is mijn intentie om het nieuwe instrument, na daartoe de gebruikelijke procedure te hebben doorlopen, zo spoedig mogelijk te ratificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Recourt over ‘Drugslabs steeds gevaarlijker’

MPs Rebel and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that drug labs are growing larger, more professional and more dangerous, and whether police and justice have enough capacity to tackle them. The Minister confirmed the trend, said the LFO's protective equipment is top-level, declined to earmark police capacity for drugs, and said the LFO's specialist capacity has doubled in recent months.
The starting point is that we do not specifically earmark police capacity.
Het uitgangspunt is dat we politiecapaciteit niet specifiek oormerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de strijd tegen hennep en het dumpen van illegaal afval in Noord-Brabant
