An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the fight against cannabis and synthetic drug crime and illegal drug-waste dumping in North Brabant, including police capacity, cross-border cooperation, legal frameworks and a proposed guarantee fund. The minister answered that enforcement capacity is sufficient and is being strengthened, that legalising cannabis cultivation is not a solution, that a joint approach and cross-border action programme are in preparation, and that Pluk Ze funds cannot be earmarked for victims of dumping.
Police and the Public Prosecution Service are on track to meet the target I set when I took office in 2010.
Politie en OM liggen op koers bij de realisatie van de doelstelling die ik bij mijn aantreden in 2010 heb gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat politie en justitie de strijd tegen de georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit niet aan kunnen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecutors can cope with organised drug crime, what measures and evidence of effectiveness exist, whether they have warned of capacity limits, and whether budget cuts should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the fight is a top priority, that the target of doubling the number of criminal groups tackled is on track, that no hard figures on organised drug crime exist, and that no extra funds are available to reverse cuts.
I do not recognise the picture that police and the Public Prosecution Service would not be equal to organised crime.
Het beeld dat politie en OM niet zouden zijn opgewassen tegen de georganiseerde criminaliteit herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Dieselbendes roven tanks leeg’

MPs Visser and Dijkhoff asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of gangs stealing diesel from truck tanks, including the scale of the thefts, whether the gangs come from former Eastern Bloc countries, whether night-time checks on vans are warranted, whether licence-plate and camera tools are used, and whether police have sufficient legal powers. The Minister answered that diesel theft is rising, that police lack enough information to confirm organised Eastern Bloc involvement, that incidents mostly occur at night and suggest targeting checks, that plate recognition is not yet used for this, and that existing legal powers are sufficient.
There are sufficient (legal) possibilities for the police to successfully combat mobile banditry.
Er zijn voldoende (juridische) mogelijkheden voor de politie om met succes mobiel banditisme te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over onderzoek naar de regulering van cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a European research report on cannabis regulation, including whether strict laws reduce use, whether international drug treaties need changing, and whether Dutch tolerance policy complies with them. The minister agreed no clear link exists between strict laws and use, said the regulation model is untested, rejected the need to amend the treaties, and defended the Dutch reservation to the UN Single Convention as covering existing tolerance policy.
The Dutch tolerance policy on the sale and possession of cannabis is based on the reservation the Netherlands made to the UN Single Convention on drugs.
Het Nederlandse gedoogbeleid ten aanzien van de verkoop en het aanwezig hebben van cannabis is gebaseerd op het voorbehoud dat Nederland heeft gemaakt bij het VN Sluikhandel Verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Eijsink over berichten met betrekking tot de beëindiging van de treinkaping bij De Punt

MPs Recourt and Eijsink asked whether reports that the FBI assumed the Moluccans would be liquidated during the 1977 De Punt train hijacking, and that the FBI persuaded the marines, are known and whether the review underway includes these archival materials. The minister confirmed knowledge of the reports, said they are part of the ongoing review, and stated the working group found the information known to it insofar as relevant, with three external experts assessing completeness.
As I informed your House by letter of 1 April 2014, I asked three external experts to assess the working group's work for care and completeness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb laten weten bij brief van 1 april 2014 2 heb ik drie externe deskundigen verzocht het werk van de werkgroep te beoordelen op zorgvuldigheid en volledigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Montana Beheer en de toezichthouders

An SP MP asked the ministers of Finance and Justice about the Montana Beheer investment fraud, complaints made to the AFM from 2010, and why the regulator and the FIOD took so long to act, and whether delays generally harm victims. The minister answered that the AFM and FIOD acted within normal deadlines and due care, described the steps taken, and saw no reason for additional measures, while promising to review if delays are signalled in future.
The AFM and the FIOD acted within the regular time limits and due care standards in this case.
De AFM en de FIOD hebben in deze zaak gehandeld binnen de reguliere termijnen en zorgvuldigheidsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek van KWR Watercycle Research Institute naar drugsresten in rioolwater

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the government about a KWR study measuring drug residues in sewage, including whether it reliably reflects Dutch drug use and whether more monitoring is needed. The State Secretary answered that sewage measurements give only a limited indication, cannot distinguish dumped from consumed drugs for most substances, and that no new study will be commissioned.
Given the very limited added value of this type of research for prevention and enforcement, I see no reason to commission research into drug residues in sewage water.
Gezien de heel beperkte toegevoegde waarde van dit type onderzoek voor voorlichting, preventie en bestrijding zie ik geen reden opdracht te geven tot onderzoek naar drugsresten in rioolwater.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de werving, de rechtspositie en de bevoegdheden van politievrijwilligers

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about recruitment, legal status, powers and armament of police volunteers, including the lack of in- and outflow data, the staff ratio, allowance taxation and the basis for weapons decisions. The minister largely answers that targets and figures will follow later, defends the allowance and weapons arrangements, and agrees that individual weapons decisions should not be published.
From this year I will send your House annually the National Police management plan that I have adopted.
Ik zend uw Kamer vanaf dit jaar wel jaarlijks het door mij vastgestelde Beheersplan Nationale Politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik Faber over fraude met het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to investigate suspected PGB fraud in Houten (about 1.6 million euros not spent on care), and reportedly about 200 unprocessed fraud complaints at the national office, was acceptable given the stated lack of priority and capacity. The government replied that fraud is a high priority, that the prosecution service selects cases by modus operandi and motivated its decision, that it could not confirm the 200 figure and referred to earlier letters, and that a package of measures to tighten PGB access is being implemented.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it cannot confirm the stated number of 200 PGB fraud complaints.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld het genoemde aantal van 200 aangiften van pgb-fraude niet te kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over studiefinanciering voor jihadstrijders

MP Van Klaveren asked whether jihadist fighters receive student finance, how many and how much, whether all such benefits should be stopped permanently, and whether students in proliferation-sensitive fields could pose a risk. The minister confirmed that some departed Dutch jihadists received student finance, that it has been stopped for all known cases, that social benefits were stopped in some dozens of cases, and described the export-control style ministerial exemption procedure for proliferation-sensitive studies, but gave no numbers or amounts.
In the interest of the effectiveness of the approach, I do not provide information on specific cases.
In het belang van de effectiviteit van de aanpak doe ik geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over het houdverbod als zelfstandige straf

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a motion calling for an animal-keeping ban as a standalone sanction had not yet been implemented and whether a bill would be sent before summer 2014. The minister replied that the ban as a special condition was extended in 2012, that the evaluation will be brought forward to 2015 and a framework for a standalone measure is being sought, while stating that OM data on such bans cannot be generated and that seizure of new animals is only possible if they were also mistreated.
I am willing to bring forward the planned evaluation of the aforementioned law of 30 August 2012 to 2015.
Ik ben bereid de voorgenomen evaluatie van de eerder genoemde wet van 30 augustus 2012 ... te vervroegen naar 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik door politie en justitie van kentekengegevens die vastgelegd zijn door een particulier bedrijf

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecutors use licence-plate data collected by a private company (ARS Traffic & Transport Technology) along motorways, and about the legal basis, retention, privacy safeguards and Dutch ANPR practice. The minister confirmed such data can be requested by a public prosecutor under article 126nd Sv, explained the WBP basis and retention periods, and said the planned ANPR legislation will clarify the rules, with the bill pending at the Council of State.
These licence plates can be requested in criminal investigations by the public prosecutor under article 126nd of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Deze kentekens kunnen in strafrechtelijke onderzoeken worden gevorderd door de officier van justitie op grond van artikel 126nd van het Wetboek van Strafvordering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het rapport ‘Geef integriteit in rechtspraak meer systematisch aandacht’ van de Universiteit Leiden in opdracht van de Raad voor de rechtspraak en het bericht ‘financiële belang

An MP asked the Minister about a Leiden University report on integrity in the judiciary, including public registration of judges' financial interests and secondary positions, and combining judgeship with political roles. The Minister said an advisory working group is studying financial-interest disclosure and will report, that secondary positions must be registered and disciplinary measures are possible, and that the integrity system is already considered sound.
Once the advice is completed, the Council for the Judiciary will come with a position.
Zodra het advies is afgerond zal de Raad voor de rechtspraak met een standpunt komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onafhankelijkheid, onpartijdigheid en integriteit van de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the government responds to a Leiden University study recommending disclosure of judges' financial interests, the regulation of ancillary positions, and other integrity safeguards in the judiciary. The minister replied that existing rules on ancillary positions and a public register are in place, that a working group is advising on financial interests, and that some recommendations on complaint handling are being taken up by the courts themselves.
It is important to continuously pay attention to integrity.
Het is van belang voortdurend aandacht te besteden aan integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Marcouch over het bekladden van een huis in Almere

MPs Yücel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a house in Almere smeared with swastikas, whether neighbours had been targeted before, whether a complaint was filed, and whether this signals wider intimidation of ethnic minorities, plus election results in Duindorp and Almere Poort. The minister confirmed a police complaint for vandalism, discrimination and insult, found no prior signals in the street, condemned the incident as isolated, and promised to publish a 2013 police registration report on discrimination in August 2014.
For the results of the local elections I refer you to the websites of both municipalities.
Voor de uitslagen van de lokale verkiezingen verwijs ik u naar de websites van beide gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de internationale jacht op drugs gehinderd wordt door de  Nederlandse bezuinigingen op de vaste liaisons in Europa

An MP asked whether Dutch cutbacks to permanent police liaison posts in Europe, notably at the MAOC-N drug interdiction centre in Lisbon, hamper international drug interdiction, and whether the Minister's plans were unclear and criticised from Lisbon. The Minister answered that Nederland remains an active partner, that a flexible liaison (FILO) has been in place at MAOC-N since September 2013, that a permanent liaison in Lisbon is being reconsidered within a new deployment plan due end 2014, and that the Rome liaison stays until mid-2015.
At the end of 2014 I will, as promised, inform your House about the new deployment plan.
Eind 2014 zal ik uw Kamer – conform toezegging – informeren over het nieuwe plaatsingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat ‘de marechaussee niet wilde dat Brenno de Winter over NSS-top schreef’

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that military police wanted to stop journalist Brenno de Winter from writing about the NSS summit, including why journalists are observed and registered in public space and whether this restricts press freedom. The minister denied any policy of observing or registering journalists, said registration rests on the Politiewet 2012 and Wet Politiegegevens, and said no measures were taken to restrict investigative journalism.
It is therefore not police policy to observe and register journalists in public space.
Het is dan ook geen beleid bij de politie om journalisten in de publieke ruimte te observeren en te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over schikkingen in fraudezaken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether large fraud cases settled by high-value transactions create an appearance of class justice, whether the OM's guidelines have adequate criteria, whether press releases explain settlements, whether settlements stall legal development, and whether judicial review of transactions should be introduced. The Minister answered that high transactions are rare, used only when most appropriate, that the guidelines are sufficient, that the OM will consider more detail in press releases, that the accused keep recourse by refusing a transaction, and that no comparative plea-bargaining study is planned.
The defence always has the option of not accepting the transaction proposal, after which the OM will summon the suspect and the case will be brought before the judge.
De verdediging heeft echter altijd de mogelijkheid niet op het transactievoorstel in te gaan, waarna het OM tot dagvaarding zal overgaan en de zaak aan de rechter wordt voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Politiebond: Opstelten pakt geweld tegen agenten niet aan’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism from a police union that the national police were insufficiently implementing the protocol on violence against police officers, including caseworker capacity, training hours, compensation funds, anonymous reporting and registration of threats in the private sphere. The Minister answered that the protocol applies organisation-wide, that only 12 FTE of caseworkers are available nationally within a 29 FTE HRM structure, that existing instruments are adequate for recovering damages, and that further measures will be reported to Parliament in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform your House, as promised in my letter of 11 April, about the further approach.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer conform toezegging in mijn brief d.d. 11 april jl. informeren over de verdere aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Per dag 4 keer grof geweld tegen politie’

The MP Helder asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a news report of four serious violent attacks on police per day, the accuracy of the figures, further measures, and why such crimes receive community service sentences. The Minister confirms the police registered 5,520 incidents and 4,332 reports of aggression and violence against police officers in 2013, a decline from 2012, says violence in all forms is unacceptable, refers to a letter on further measures to follow in autumn, and notes that sentencing in serious violence cases is a matter for the prosecution and judiciary.
I will answer you before the date of 18 June.
Ik zal u antwoorden voor de datum van 18 juni aanstaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over Turkse rellen in Rotterdam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why only one person was arrested after riots by Turkish football supporters in Rotterdam, how costs would be recovered, and whether the riots reflect failed integration. The minister said the response focused on restoring public order, camera footage would be used to investigate offenders, damage recovery would be pursued through criminal and civil routes if damage is identified, and the incidents were treated as isolated.
Based on camera footage, further investigation will be carried out into persons who committed criminal offences.
Op basis van camerabeelden zal nader onderzoek worden gedaan naar personen die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over aparte berechting voor Veteranen

MP Eijsink (PvdA) asked the Ministers of Defence and of Security and Justice whether veterans with service-related trauma should be tried in a separate court, and about statistics, sentencing options, detention care, and reclassering supervision for veterans. The government answered that no statistics are held, that a 2011 study found veterans less often involved in criminal incidents, that ordinary courts already consider psychological conditions and can impose treatment conditions, that detention offers screening and forensic care, and that no special court or special reclassering regime is needed.
I consider the alignment of reclassering supervision with the perpetrator's personal circumstances sufficient and see no reason for improvement or adjustment of reclassering supervision.
Ik acht de afstemming van het reclasseringstoezicht op de persoon van de dader voldoende en zie geen aanleiding tot verbetering of aanpassing van het reclasseringstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de verdubbeling van geweld tegen homo's

An MP asked the ministers whether the reported doubling of violence against gay people (based on police-registered incidents rising from 623 to 1,143) is accurate, whether police will make combating anti-gay violence a top priority, and whether the rise is linked to the growing influence of Islam. The government answered that the figures cover all registered discrimination incidents based on sexual orientation, not only violence, that police anti-violence work remains a top priority and will be pursued in the 2015-2018 security agenda, and it rejected the link to Islam.
Yes, tackling violence is and remains a top priority of the police.
Ja, de aanpak van geweld is en blijft een topprioriteit van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de toenemende verwaarlozing van landbouwdieren

An MP asked the government about rising neglect of farm animals and the NVWA finding that 60 farmers are notorious offenders, including whether a permanent ban on keeping animals could be imposed as a standalone measure. The state secretary described an integrated prevention and support approach, reported the violations and animals taken into custody, and deferred the question on a standalone ban to answers from the Minister of Justice and Security.

For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to the questions from members Van Gerven (SP) and Schouw (D66) to the Minister of Security and Justice on the ban on keeping animals as a standalone penalty

Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Van Gerven (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het houdverbod als zelfstandige straf
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het zoveelste anti-joodse incident

An MP asked the ministers about an antisemitic defacement of an Anne Frank poster, the causes of rising antisemitism, and whether the perpetrators have been caught. The government condemned the act, pointed to a planned follow-up study on triggers of antisemitism among youth due early 2015, and reported that police investigated but no suspect has been arrested.
To be able to combat antisemitism better, I previously promised a follow-up study examining the trigger factors that contribute to the emergence of antisemitism.
Om antisemitisme beter te kunnen bestrijden heb ik eerder een vervolgonderzoek toegezegd, waarin de triggerfactoren, die bijdragen aan het ontstaan van antisemitisme, worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over kermisgeweld door allochtone jongeren

An MP asked the ministers about youths harassing fairground visitors and shoppers in IJmuiden, whether the offenders would be arrested, and how to prevent them escaping with community service. The state secretary answered that police investigation is ongoing, that the local authority decides on measures, and that sentencing is for the judge, who may impose community service alone only in limited circumstances.
The police investigation into this incident has not yet been concluded.
Het politieonderzoek naar dit incident is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Segers over de waarborgen voor voldoende landelijke specialistische opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Segers asked whether specialist national shelter for trafficking victims, especially minors, will survive decentralisation of youth and women's care, and how regional inequality and funding gaps will be prevented. The State Secretary replied that from 2015 municipalities will jointly procure this shelter nationally, that a VNG transition arrangement reserves funds, and that continuity of care is guaranteed, but gave few concrete figures or time limits.
The VNG will set aside funds for shelter for this category of victims and procure this form of women's shelter centrally.
De VNG gaat middelen voor de opvang van deze categorie slachtoffers apart zetten en deze vorm van vrouwenopvang centraal inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over de aanslag op bezoekers van het Joodse Museum in Brussel

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked the Justice Minister about the Brussels Jewish Museum attack: its effect on threat levels, whether the state should bear extra security costs for Jewish institutions, and renewed consultation with local authorities on funding. The minister said no acute threat was identified for Jewish institutions in the Netherlands, that security costs are primarily the responsibility of citizens and organisations with state support where needed, and that consultations with local authorities including Amsterdam have taken place.
Security measures are taken equally for every citizen, cultural, religious or educational institution, based on threat and risk.
Voor iedere burger, culturele, religieuze of onderwijsinstelling worden op gelijke wijze beveiligingsmaatregelen genomen op basis van dreiging en risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over mogelijk honderd nieuwe Syriëgangers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about a hundred potential jihadists were being monitored in nine municipalities and whether administrative detention should be introduced for counter-terrorism. The minister confirmed over a hundred travellers to Syria, described case-by-case threat assessments and local multidisciplinary interventions, and said the government does not consider new administrative detention powers necessary because existing criminal and administrative instruments suffice.
As I have previously informed your House, the Cabinet considers creating additional administrative detention powers for counter-terrorism purposes unnecessary.
Zoals ik eerder uw Kamer heb bericht, acht het Kabinet het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding, niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over digitaal solliciteren bij de politie

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police online application windows for hoofdagent and politiekundige posts were open only briefly, causing server overload and missed applications, and asked for a second chance. The minister confirmed the overload, said the police capped applicants to manage selection, promised new procedures and said affected applicants can still take part, but gave no date for new training places.
After evaluating this system, it has since been decided to develop new instruments to select the most suitable candidate efficiently and effectively among a large number of interested applicants.

Na evaluatie van dit systeem is er inmiddels voor gekozen om nieuwe instrumenten te ontwikkelen om bij een groot aantal belangstellenden op een doelmatig en slagvaardige manier tot de selectie van de meest geschikte kandidaat te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het pleidooi voor een fonds om justitiële dwalingen te voorkomen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether wrongfully convicted people wait too long for compensation and whether a permanent fund for investigating judicial errors should be created. The minister acknowledged that past procedures were sometimes slow and that the 2012 Wet herziening ten voordele addresses the gap, but declined to create a permanent fund, citing existing state-funded investigation and legal aid mechanisms.
Against this background, I am of the view that there is no need to establish a permanent fund to prevent judicial errors.
Tegen deze achtergrond ben ik van mening dat de noodzaak ontbreekt om te komen tot een permanent fonds om justitiële dwalingen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een ‘Nederlandse’ terreurstudent

Van Klaveren asked whether a Saudi terror suspect studying in the Netherlands, allegedly linked to Al-Shabaab, was known to the intelligence services and should be denied entry, have his studies ended and his student finance reclaimed. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, but explained that IND can refuse or withdraw residence permits on the basis of an AIVD report without a criminal conviction, and that non-EEA students receive no Dutch student finance.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over bendeleden die naar Marokko zijn gevlucht

PVV MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether gang members fled to Morocco to evade police, whether they are suspects, and why Morocco would refuse legal assistance requests. The minister answered that all suspects in the investigation have been arrested, no suspects are hiding in Morocco, no legal assistance requests were made, and the investigation is ongoing so no further statements can be made.
Because the criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make any statements on this point.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt kan ik op dit punt geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Lubbers wilde strafzaak voorkomen”

MP Helder asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecutor had been aware of former PM Lubbers' statements about nuclear weapons at Volkel and why no prosecution followed, and whether this amounts to class justice. The minister answered that the OM knew of the public statements, found no grounds for a criminal investigation after establishing whether they were factually accurate, and denied that Lubbers' former office played any role.
In connection with this, the OM stated in its press release that there were no grounds for conducting a criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft in verband daarmee in het betreffende persbericht gemeld dat er geen aanknopingspunten waren voor het verrichten van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het monitoren en beïnvloeden van internetdiscussies over het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the Prime Minister whether ministry staff monitor and try to influence online discussions about the ministry's policy, and whether this is acceptable given citizens' freedom of expression. The minister replied that no staff are recruited to influence opinion, that monitoring media is a way to pick up signals from society, that staff must identify themselves as civil servants online, and that influencing discussions is outside the communication guidelines.
Ministers do not recruit staff to monitor and influence citizens' opinions about their policy and functioning.
Bewindslieden werven geen medewerkers om de meningsvorming van burgers over hun beleid en functioneren te volgen en te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about Dutch nationals who became suicide bombers abroad, the victims, their dual nationality, whether AIVD budget cuts should be reversed, and whether the threat level will be raised. The minister confirmed two Dutch suicide attacks, declined to give victim or nationality details for operational reasons, said jihadist investigations were prioritised through internal reprioritisation, and stated the threat level remains substantial with no direct change.
For operational reasons I cannot publicly address matters that could reveal the identity of the two Dutch suicide bombers.
Ik kan om operationele redenen niet in het openbaar ingaan op zaken die de identiteit van de twee Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen kunnen prijsgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Nederlandse zelfmoordjihadisten in martelarenvideo's

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch suicide jihadists are glorified in martyrdom videos, whether distributing such videos is punishable, whether intelligence services' budget cuts are wise, whether administrative detention and deprivation of nationality for returning jihadists are warranted. The government answered that such videos are not punishable per se, that NCTV asks providers to act under their own terms, that the AIVD reprioritised internally, that existing criminal tools suffice instead of administrative detention, and that deprivation of nationality is possible only for dual nationals after a final terrorism conviction.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht het bericht ‘onderzoek naar monsterzege’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about football match-fixing concerns, including the KNVB's referral of the FC Oss–Emmen match to the Public Prosecution Service and the claim that a German prosecutor's reported suspect matches were 'fiction'. The minister answered that the referral led to no further steps, that the KNVB's integrity unit has not triggered any prosecutor-requested investigations, and that information-sharing about the German matter was not authorised.
The report did not lead to any follow-up steps.
De melding heeft niet tot vervolgstappen geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Marcouch over stelselmatige discriminatie van bewoners in de Haagse wijk Duindorp

MPs Yücel and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about alleged systematic harassment of migrant-background residents in The Hague's Duindorp district, whether the minister would visit, what measures were taken, and whether similar problems exist elsewhere. The minister answered that the mayor reports no systematic driving-out of residents, that local police, the housing corporation and municipal partners are handling incidents through an integrated approach, and that anti-discrimination policy is a local responsibility with no national overview.
The cabinet does not have a national overview at the level of cities or neighbourhoods of cases of driving out neighbourhood residents on grounds of racial discrimination.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een landelijk overzicht op het niveau van steden of wijken van gevallen van het (weg)pesten van buurtbewoners op grond van rassendiscriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een gehandicapte bejaarde

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a reported assault and robbery of a disabled elderly man, including the suspects' background, whether arrests were made, and whether criminal foreigners should be expelled for violent crimes. The minister says the Public Prosecution Service found the report to be a false complaint and explains the existing rules for expelling foreign offenders.
Research by the Public Prosecution Service shows that there was a false complaint.
Uit onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie blijkt dat er sprake is van een valse aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over misbruik van camerabeelden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of security camera footage, including the legal limits on repurposing such footage, staff training, criminal liability for covert filming and posting images to shame people, and how victims are encouraged to file complaints and how social media platforms handle removal. The minister answered that repurposing footage to publicize intimate scenes breaches the Wbp and that disciplinary rules exist, cited criminal provisions, declined to give details of the ongoing police investigation, and said the Facebook page had been removed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en van Oosten over een trust framework en eID

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about trust frameworks and personal data stores that give citizens control over their data, and about the government's role in e-identity initiatives. The minister answered that the government follows and partly supports such initiatives, that supervision is still being studied, and that legislation may be needed depending on the framework.
The cabinet set out in its e-privacy letter of 24 May 2013 several conditions for protecting personal data in the customer-business relationship.
Het kabinet heeft in haar e-privacybrief van 24 mei 2013 4 een aantal randvoorwaarden gesteld voor de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de relatie klant-bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Toorenburg over de onrust onder het gevangenispersoneel

MPs Kooiman and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about unrest among prison staff, including staffing shortages, intimidation, budget cuts and the pension gap for staff in substantially burdensome posts. The State Secretary disputed the staffing-shortage and intimidation claims, cited falling violent incidents, and deferred detailed answers on cuts and the Masterplan to a later letter.

In line with my earlier commitments during the General Consultation on the DJI Masterplan of 29 January and the General Consultation on prisons of 27 March, I will inform the House before the summer recess about progress on implementing the DJI Masterplan and the additional financial problems.

Conform mijn eerdere toezeggingen tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Masterplan DJI van 29 januari jl. en het Algemeen Overleg over het gevangeniswezen op 27 maart jl. zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van het Masterplan DJI en de aanvullende financiële problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de oproep dat strikte waarborgen voor gebruik drones in Europa

An MP asked the ministers whether they share the European Commission's call for strict safeguards on civil drones, given fragmented national rules and privacy concerns. The state secretary answered that safeguards exist in Dutch law, a WODC study is under way, and no restriction on drone use is warranted for now.
There is therefore no reason to restrict the deployment of such drones now.
Er bestaat dan ook geen aanleiding om nu het inzetten van dergelijke drones aan banden te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van der Steur over verschillende torenhoge boetes die het afgelopen jaar geïnd zijn

MPs Visser and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about very large unpaid fines collected in the past year, asking how many people are involved, why arrears grew so high, whether police enforcement and ANPR are used effectively, and whether gijzeling is adequate. The Minister answered that the cases involve confiscation orders, that 178 persons have open debts of 300,000 euro or more, that police enforcement and ANPR are used successfully and will expand, and that the approach to collecting financial sanctions will be reviewed with a letter to parliament in June 2014.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I have previously indicated that we are examining how the collection of financial sanctions, including the use of coercive measures, can be improved.

De Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik hebben eerder aangegeven dat bekeken wordt op welke wijze de inning van financiële sancties, inclusief de inzet van dwangmiddelen, verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het gebruik van camera's door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police use of smart cameras and a planned national sensor network, including whether new legislation is needed to protect privacy. The Minister answered that no police smart cameras are in use yet, that existing legal frameworks suffice for current sensing, and that the sensing policy vision is still in development.

For the forms of sensing currently applied, existing laws and regulations already provide sufficient frameworks and safeguards in terms of proportionality, subsidiarity and lawfulness, including protection of private life.

Voor de vormen van sensing zoals nu toegepast, bestaan binnen bestaande wet- en regelgeving op dit moment voldoende kaders en waarborgen in termen van proportionaliteit, subsidiariteit en rechtmatigheid, inclusief bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het proefschrift van dr. Peggy van der Pol ‘The Dynamics of Cannabis Use and Dependence’

An MP asks how the government views a dissertation finding that about 40% of initially non-dependent heavy cannabis users became dependent over three years, and whether it will take measures against cannabis use and dependence. The state secretary says the study shows other factors matter as much as potency, that prevention and treatment should be updated, and that the findings give no reason for further measures.
The findings of this study give me no reason for further measures.
De uitkomsten van dit onderzoek geven mij geen aanleiding tot nadere maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Buurtvader Gestel: “Ik ga derde overvaller Deurne niet aangeven”

PVV MPs asked why no action was taken against a neighbourhood father who said he would not name the third robber of a Deurne jeweller, and whether he should be arrested and whether Moroccans distrusting the Dutch should give up benefits and leave. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation and rejected the claim of a failed integration and parallel society, and rejected the benefit-surrender idea by restating that everyone has equal rights and duties.
The investigation into the robbery in Deurne – and therefore also the investigation into all possible suspects – has not yet been concluded.
Het onderzoek naar de overval in Deurne – en daarmee ook het onderzoek naar alle mogelijke verdachten – is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de verdubbeling van het aantal brandslachtoffers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that fire deaths had doubled, its causes, prevention for elderly residents, and whether crew size and workload are linked to casualties. The minister said the figures are preliminary and unanalysed, pointed to existing prevention projects and a pending smoke-detector study, and said no link to crew size or workload is known.
Because an analysis has not yet taken place, no information on the causes of the fires is available.
Doordat een analyse nog niet heeft plaatsgevonden, is er geen informatie over de oorzaken van de branden beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de zware en zinloze mishandeling van een voorbijganger

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a severe group assault on a passer-by in Gulpen and whether suspects had been arrested and whether perpetrators should always face prison rather than community service. The minister condemned the violence, said an investigation is ongoing with several suspects arrested, declined further comment for investigative reasons, and noted that the law requires a custodial element when serious assault is prosecuted.
In view of the interests of investigation and prosecution, I cannot make further statements about this incident.
In verband met de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Omtzigt Justitie over gsm-ontvangst in Nederland

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about poor mobile coverage in border municipalities and whether 112 emergency calls could fail, including how many complaints and cases occurred and what action was taken. The minister answered that 100% mobile coverage is not achievable, that no registration of failed emergency calls exists, that EZ is studying coverage reach, and that citizens are advised to use a landline in emergencies.
It is not registered in how many cases an acute emergency call was not possible because no mobile coverage was available.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd in hoeveel gevallen een acute noodoproep niet mogelijk was, omdat er geen mobiele dekking voorhanden was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de mobiele bereikbaarheid van 112 in het grensgebied

Two PvdA MPs asked whether mobile 112 emergency calls work reliably in border regions and whether full mobile coverage is required. The Minister acknowledges coverage complaints, says the extent is unknown and under study, explains that 112 calls are routed across networks, and rejects coverage requirements in licences while advising residents to use landlines and promising ongoing communication.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs is researching the scope of mobile coverage.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken doet onderzoek naar de reikwijdte van de mobiele dekking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat transportbedrijven zwarte lijsten hanteren voor parkeerplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether they know transport firms keep blacklists of unsafe lorry parking places, whether the government will act on the rise in cargo theft, and for statistics and an action plan. The minister confirms ongoing talks with the sector, says the government lacks those blacklists, outlines public-private prevention efforts and cargo theft figures, and promises to inform parliament before summer.
I expect to be able to inform the House about this this summer.
Ik verwacht Uw Kamer hierover deze zomer te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over jihadsteden in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported 'jihad cities' in the Netherlands, whether passport revocation is useful given dual nationality, the nationalities of jihadist sympathisers, and whether deportation or denaturalisation should be a structural solution. The minister declined to name the cities, said case-by-case measures are chosen, noted most persons hold a second nationality, and rejected deportation as a structural solution.
Since it is up to the municipalities concerned whether or not to communicate about this matter, I make no statements about it.
Aangezien het aan de betrokken gemeenten zelf is om wel of niet te communiceren over deze kwestie, doe ik hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de mogelijke fraude bij de nieuwbouw van het hoofdkantoor

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about alleged tax-return fraud by a KPMG-linked joint venture building KPMG's headquarters, and whether accountancy fraud is structural and calls for stricter rules. The minister declined to give details while the criminal investigation is ongoing, pointed to AFM supervision and recent reforms, and said the sector must change its culture.
Given that the criminal investigation is still ongoing, no further information can be provided on this matter.
Gelet op het feit dat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog gaande is, kunnen daarover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over misdrijven plegende Afghaanse diplomaat en de uitzending van PowNews d.d. 17 april 2014

Parliamentarians Helder and De Roon asked why an Afghan diplomat who assaulted and damaged property was only reprimanded, not expelled, waived immunity or prosecuted, and what was done about his parking abuse and diplomatic plates. The government answered that the diplomat's conduct was unacceptable but did not warrant expulsion, that Nederland cannot waive or prosecute under absolute immunity, and that a New York-style plate revocation was studied and rejected for legal and practical reasons.
In this case the diplomat's conduct was indeed completely unacceptable, but it did not qualify for such a visible and politically charged sanction.
In dit geval was het gedrag van de betreffende diplomaat weliswaar volstrekt onacceptabel, maar kwalificeerde het niet voor het treffen van een dergelijke zichtbare en politiek beladen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de groei van het aantal eerwraakmoorden

An MP asks the ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs about the reported growth in honour killings, whether this is linked to immigration from Islamic countries, what measures will be taken, and whether perpetrators should be deported after serving their sentences. The minister confirms awareness of the reported figures and refers the MP to earlier answers to parallel questions, without substantive answers in this document.
I refer to my answers to the written questions from members De Graaf and Wilders of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat Utrechtse raamexploitanten niet ingrepen ondanks berichten over mensenhandel

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many Utrecht window-prostitution exploiters were flagged for trafficking, poor supervision and disorder, what victim support was offered after the closures, and why closures did not produce more complaints. The Minister said six permits of five operators were revoked based on police reports and court rulings, that the municipality and police informed sex workers and offered care, but withheld details of the confidential reports and gave no complete victim or investigation figures.
Because of the confidential nature of the administrative reports, I cannot however provide further details on this.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van de bestuurlijke rapportages kan ik hier echter geen verdere details over verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de verplaatsing van cocaïneroutes naar Rotterdam

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a large share of cocaine entering Western and Central Europe passes through Rotterdam, and about seizure figures and inter-agency cooperation. The Minister answered that the flow via Rotterdam is long-known and not shown to be increasing, that higher 2013 seizures reflect better cooperation and detection, and that the total volume is unknown, giving seizure figures and describing the Integere Haven and HARC-team cooperation.
No good estimate can be made of this, since nothing is known about the total volume of cocaine smuggling to Rotterdam and no indicators for it exist.
Hiervan is geen goede schatting te maken, aangezien over de totale omvang van de cocaïnesmokkel naar Rotterdam niets bekend is en daar ook geen indicatoren voor te geven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het gebruik van de stille sms door de politie ten behoeve van de opsporing

Four MPs asked the minister about police use of silent SMS (stealth SMS) to locate phones in criminal investigations, including whether repeated use amounts to systematic observation, what procedural tightening was announced, and whether frequency of use is registered and disclosed. The minister answered that privacy impact depends on the case and is judged by the public prosecutor, that procedure now requires recording duration and frequency in the case file, but that the number of uses will not be publicly disclosed to protect investigations and because the criminal judge reviews lawfulness.
For that reason I do not intend to make this information public.
Om die reden ben ik niet voornemens deze informatie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over  afspraken over bezoeken van buitenlandse delegaties

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Chinese security screens that blocked protesters from view during Xi Jinping's Amsterdam visit, and whether foreign security details may hold special powers or immunity in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Dutch state is responsible for security, foreign security staff have no powers, foreign official missions enjoy immunity under customary law, and that permitting demonstrations is primarily a local matter.
The Dutch State is responsible for the security of foreign delegations and takes all necessary measures to this end.
Antwoord 4 en 5 De Nederlandse Staat is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van buitenlandse delegaties en treft hiertoe alle benodigde maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van de Rechten van de Mens in de zaal Moor e.a. tegen Zwitserland EHRM (069) 2014

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the ECHR ruling in Moor v. Switzerland, which found a limitation period barring asbestos-victim claims breached access to justice, affects Dutch asbestos victims, and whether the law or retroactive measures should change. The Minister answered that the Dutch 30-year absolute limitation period, the Van Hese/De Schelde exception and the IAS/TAS compensation schemes make the ruling without consequence for Dutch practice, that the law was already amended in 2003, and that retroactive legislation is undesirable.
I believe that the Dutch system for asbestos-related claims for exposures before 1 February 2004 complies with Article 6 ECHR and its interpretation by the ECtHR in the Moor case.

Ik meen dat het Nederlandse stelsel voor asbest-gerelateerde vorderingen voor blootstellingen vóór 1 februari 2004 in overeenstemming is met artikel 6 EVRM en de uitleg daarvan door het EHRM in de zaak Moor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over gewelddadig tuig in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a violent home invasion by youths in Rotterdam, whether suspects had been arrested and their nationalities, and whether penalties should be raised. The minister said the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that local authorities choose the measures, and that statutory maxima are adequate.
I cannot make further statements about this investigation because of the interests of investigation and prosecution.
Over dit onderzoek kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de beveiliging van een bedreigde eigenaar van een schoonmaakbedrijf

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about state protection for a threatened owner of a cleaning company, and how responsibility is divided between the person, the employer and the government. The minister answered that citizens and employers have primary responsibility for safety, that the government steps in when threats exceed their own capacity, and that a police report is not strictly required for protection.
The general principle of the protection system is that citizens are themselves primarily responsible for their own safety.
Algemeen uitgangspunt van het stelsel bewaken en beveiligen is dat de burger zelf in eerste instantie verantwoordelijk is voor de eigen veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Albert de Vries over het verdwijnen van het Openbaar Ministerie uit Vlissingen

MPs Recourt and Albert de Vries asked the Justice Minister about the disappearance of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) from Vlissingen, including when the hearing room closed and how Zeeland suspects can account for traffic offences. The minister denied the hearing room was closed, said CVOM hearings remain in Vlissingen for now, and promised telehearing at one location in Zeeland by around June 2014.
The aim is an introduction date for this location in the course of June 2014.
Het streven is naar een invoeringsdatum voor deze locatie in de loop van juni 2014.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over het persbericht ‘pooier vrij, slachtoffer duikt onder’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of a suspected trafficker after a court acquittal, whether the victims were protected and informed, and whether the sentencing guidance and immediate enforcement bill would have changed the outcome. The minister answered that the court's acquittal removed the basis for detention, victims were informed in time, sentencing guidelines await sufficient case law, and the immediate-enforcement bill would likely not have changed the result.
Regarding any security measures that may have been taken, I will not make any statements in the interest of the victims.
Over eventueel genomen veiligheidsmaatregelen doe ik in het belang van de slachtoffers geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over thuisprostitutie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement against home prostitution, its scale, and worker health and safety oversight. The minister said illegal home prostitution is already targeted through national action days and facilitator investigations, that the scale is unknown pending a WODC baseline study, and that municipalities and the Arbo inspectorate oversee licensed and self-employed workers.
The total nature and scale of the prostitution sector in the Netherlands is not known to me.
De totale aard en omvang van de prostitutiesector in Nederland is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten dat de overheid op Brenno de Winter jaagde

An MP asked whether a police alert flagging activist Brenno de Winter was still active after a correction letter, and why a prior request was ignored. The minister answered that the alert was removed on 10 March 2014, all police units were told to delete any such flags, and a national protocol on disclosure of data is being developed.
Within the force, all police units were instructed, as a precaution, to remove and destroy any alerts concerning him.
Binnen het korps is volledigheidshalve aan alle politie-eenheden opgedragen om eventuele aandachtsvestigingen hem aangaande te verwijderen en te vernietigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over het bericht dat de Interpol database van gestolen en/of vermiste paspoorten nauwelijks wordt gecheckt

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether Interpol's database of stolen and lost passports, which they said is rarely checked by governments, is adequately used at Dutch airports. The state secretary answered that the Koninklijke Marechaussee and national police have access to the database and consult it when needed, that the Schengen border check is secure, and that the Netherlands works with EU partners on passenger data.
I am currently examining the possibilities to better use this database to flag illegal immigration, serious crime and terrorism in passenger flows.
Ik onderzoek momenteel de mogelijkheden om deze databank beter te benutten bij het in passagiersstromen signaleren van illegale immigratie, zware criminaliteit en terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over wifi- en bluetooth tracking

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about wifi and bluetooth tracking of shoppers and passers-by under the Dutch data protection act, including how the legitimate-interest balancing test works, whether data subjects are informed, and whether iOS users are told when bluetooth is re-enabled. The state secretary answered that the controller must balance its interests against privacy, that the data protection regulator (CBP) holds that public-space tracking weighs more heavily toward individuals, that no legal duty exists to notify iOS users, and that device privacy settings are primarily the user's responsibility.
The College states that in the case of wifi tracking on the public road, article 8 of the Personal Data Protection Act applies, in particular subsections a and f.
Het College geeft aan dat in het geval van wifi-tracking op de openbare weg, artikel 8 van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens van toepassing is, in het bijzonder onderdeel a en f.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over mensenhandel en thuisprostitutie

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about trafficking in home-based prostitution, including the extent of the problem, police capacity, prosecution of homeowners who rent houses as brothels, and whether neighbours are deterred from reporting. The Minister answers that trafficking is not present in all illegal home prostitution, cites figures, notes a WODC baseline study is underway, says facilitators can be prosecuted but no cases are known, and denies neighbours fear reporting.
The WODC is currently carrying out a baseline study under the Wrp.
Het WODC voert momenteel een nulmeting uit in het kader van de Wrp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over afgekeurde veiligheidsvesten bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers in Limburg were working with rejected tactical safety vests, and how often this occurred. The minister denied that rejected vests are in use, said rejected vests are destroyed, and promised new vests for the Limburg unit by June 2014.
No, this is not correct. The national police naturally do not work with rejected tactical safety vests.
Nee, dit klopt niet. De nationale politie werkt vanzelfsprekend niet met afgekeurde tactische veiligheidsvesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het aanleggen van een database met reisgegevens

MP Schouw (D66) asked the Justice Minister why a letter promised before Christmas 2013 on a passenger travel-data database (PIU) had not arrived, whether Nederland accepted EU funding for it, what EU obligations exist, and what data would be collected, retained and accessed. The minister apologised for the delay, said Nederland accepted about 5.7 million euro in EU funds conditional on parliamentary approval, that no binding obligation yet exists, that no construction has started, and that details (data subjects, retention, rights, access, EDPS advice) would follow in a forthcoming letter.
Once this has been met, I will send the letter to your House.
Zodra hieraan is voldaan zal ik de brief naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de kwaliteit van Buitengewone Opsporingsambtenaren (boa’s)

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the quality, training and retraining requirements for buitengewone opsporingsambtenaren (boa's) are too low, and whether detachment firms risk creating disposable boa's and whether a quality mark is needed. The minister answered that the existing requirements are adequate, recently tightened in 2012/2013, and that detached boa's face the same rules, so no quality mark is necessary.
No, I consider the current requirements for quality, training and retraining, which apply to all boa's, appropriate.
Nee, de huidige eisen ten aanzien van kwaliteit, opleiding en bijscholing, die gelden voor alle boa's, acht ik passend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Nederlandse websites massaal privacywetgeving schenden door het ongevraagd plaatsen van tracking cookies

MP Gesthuizen asked whether enforcement of privacy law is failing given reports that many Dutch websites place tracking cookies before consent, and how enforcement will be improved. The government answered that the ACM and CBP are pursuing lasting behaviour change rather than fines (none imposed yet), that market transparency is recognised as a problem, and that existing law is adequate, with no tightening planned.
For enforcement it is important that the supervisory authorities act in such a way that lasting behavioural change occurs among companies to which the law applies.
Voor de handhaving is belangrijk dat de toezichthouders zo optreden dat het komt tot een blijvende gedragsverandering bij bedrijven waarop de wet van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat een coffeeshop plotseling vervolgd wordt wegens te grote voorraden

The MP asks whether a coffeeshop can operate without stocking more than 500 grams and whether the back-door supply gap undermines enforcement of coffeeshop policy. The minister replies that the 500-gram limit is a condition of the tolerance policy, that the operator is responsible for compliance, and that the tension with the ban on cultivation and sale outside coffeeshops has long been recognised.
The tolerance policy covers, apart from so-called user spaces, only the sale of small quantities of cannabis by coffeeshops under strict conditions.
Het gedoogbeleid omvat, naast de zogeheten gebruikersruimten, alleen het onder strikte voorwaarden verkopen van kleine hoeveelheden cannabis door coffeeshops.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over de toekomst van het Openbaar Ministerie en de landsrecherche op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about Dutch responsibility for the Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten, the temporary reinforcement of the Landsrecherche, mediation with the Rijksrecherche, the Aruba/Curaçao cooperation convenant, and whether prosecution capacity is sufficient. The government answered that law enforcement is an autonomous competence of the countries, that the temporary capacity boost has ended, that Sint Maarten's request for extra capacity is under review, and that capacity is considered adequate.
The Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten falls under the consensus national ordinance on the public prosecution services of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Sint Maarten valt onder de consensus-Rijkswet «Rijkswet openbare Ministeries van Curaçao, van Sint Maarten en van Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over zwanendrifter in de fout

An MP asked the ministers whether a swan drifter caught with 18 swans, some bloodied, was fined or prosecuted for animal cruelty and Flora- and Faunawet violations, and whether his exemption could be revoked. The government answered that no fine or animal-cruelty report was issued, that the police findings are recorded and the violations are still being assessed, that revocation is possible if violations are established, and that the NVWA carried out no inspections in 2013 but plans to do so this year.
At this moment it is being examined whether there has been a violation of the laws and regulations and if so which.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken óf er sprake is geweest van een overtreding van de wet- en regelgeving en zo ja welke.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Nederland niet goed is voorbereid op een ramp

MP Kooiman asked whether Dutch safety regions and vital sectors have concrete agreements, whether mandatory system exercises are held, and whether the NL-Alert cooperation has stalled. Minister Opstelten answered that preparedness is improving, that convenants are being concretised, that 22 of 25 regions held a system exercise in 2013 while the rest were pressed to comply, and that a national uniform-agreement duty for the Veiligheidsberaad was rejected in line with the Hoekstra commission.
I will continue to press the safety regions to hold exercises on the main structure and with vital partners.
Ik blijf er bij de veiligheidsregio’s op aandringen oefeningen op de hoofdstructuur en met de vitale partners te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het idee om agenten vrij te maken die zich alleen bezig moeten houden met criminaliteitsbestrijding onder Tilburgers van Marokkaanse en Antilliaanse afkomst

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether the government endorses a Tilburg VVD proposal to assign police specifically to crime-fighting among residents of Moroccan and Antillean descent, and whether there is a police capacity problem in Tilburg. The minister says targeted youth policy was used in the past and is now part of regular policy, stresses effectiveness and warns against unjustified ethnic distinction, and says he has no signals of a capacity problem in Tilburg, with the mayor able to request more capacity.
We must of course guard against a targeted approach toward these groups leading to unjustified distinction.
We moeten er uiteraard voor waken dat een gerichte aanpak op deze groepen zou leiden tot het maken van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanpak van vacaturefraude

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Social Affairs about vacancy fraud (money mule schemes), its scale, the measures taken against it, and whether victims who became unwitting money launderers could receive leniency. The Minister described the scheme, reported complaint and report figures, the UWV's screening and registration measures, and said leniency must be judged case by case by the prosecutor and courts.
No figures are available on the number of criminal cases concerning this specific form of fraud.
Er zijn geen cijfers over het aantal strafzaken aangaande deze specifieke verschijningsvorm van fraude beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het staken van de opsporing en vervolging van corruptiezaken in Zuid-Limburg

MP De Wit asked whether investigations into 10 to 15 corruption suspects in South Limburg in the early 1990s were halted on orders from third parties, as former FIOD investigators claimed in a documentary. The Minister answered that prosecutors found no evidence of a categorical decision to halt corruption investigations, though cases were assessed individually and several led to convictions.
There are no indications that a decision was taken to categorically halt corruption investigations.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat een beslissing is genomen tot het categoraal staken van corruptieonderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het stijgend aantal ladingdiefstallen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the 42 percent rise in cargo thefts in 2013, its causes, and the claim that police and prosecutors had reduced attention to transport crime. The minister denied reduced attention, said the cause of the rise is not directly explained, described continuing public-private cooperation and the NPC priority, and promised continued monitoring without committing to a specific new measure.
I do not share the view that there would be reduced attention to transport crime.
Ik deel de opvatting dat sprake zou zijn van verminderde aandacht voor transportcriminaliteit niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ING adverteerders inzicht wil bieden in klantgedrag

SP MPs Merkies and Gesthuizen asked the Finance Minister how he reacts to ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customer behaviour, and whether the pilot breaches privacy law, the sector code, consent rules and customer data ownership. The minister says he and the AFM and DNB are critical, that consent under the Wbp would be required for commercial use, that the Cbp is responsible for enforcement and may investigate, and that no further legal change seems necessary for now.
It is not for me nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice to pronounce on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de uitvoering van de motie over flitsen op trajecten waar staat aangegeven dat er trajectcontrole is

An MP asked whether police flash-speed checks on the A4 near Hoofddorp on 4 March 2014 breached the earlier motion-Bashir commitment not to conduct spot checks where a trajectory-control sign is displayed. The minister answered that the radar check there was not in line with that commitment, so no fines were issued and police were reminded to follow the instruction.
The radar check at that point was not in line with the commitment made to your House referred to in question 1.
De radarcontrole was op dat punt niet in overeenstemming met de in vraag 1 aangehaalde toezegging aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over de onduidelijkheden die zijn blijven bestaan na het debat over het sluiten van deals met criminelen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about unresolved questions after a debate on settlements with criminals, including the amount returned to Cees H., the use of the OM bank account, the approval chain, secrecy towards the tax authority and possible tax evasion. The Minister answered that the frozen assets were about 2 million guilders, that the OM followed existing law, that the bank records could not yet be found and would be followed up, and that no tax evasion occurred for the settlement amount.
As to what was actually transferred, I did not discuss it with your House.
Over wat feitelijk is overgemaakt, heb ik met uw Kamer niet gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanpak van broodfok en malafide hondenhandel

The MP asks the State Secretary and Minister how the government will tackle puppy-farming and dishonest dog trade, including inspection numbers, prosecution, licensing of vets, and identification and registration of dogs. The government answers with inspection and recheck figures, enforcement capacity, prosecution limits, a rejection of a standalone kennel ban and of an extra identification requirement, and a commitment to a review in about eighteen months.
This information cannot be generated from the systems of the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Deze informatie kan niet uit de systemen van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ‘jihadbruiden’

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about female jihadist travellers to Syria, including passport measures, administrative detention and stripping dual nationals of Dutch citizenship. The minister answered that case-by-case criminal and administrative measures apply, that administrative detention is not considered necessary, and that citizenship can be revoked only after a final terrorism conviction for dual nationals.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to create additional administrative detention powers for counterterrorism.
Ik acht daarom het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Dutch telecom and data-protection rules, including the opt-in cookie provision, apply to data Samsung collects from smart TVs, and whether new rules are needed. The government answered that existing law is adequate, that opt-in consent already applies, that compliance is for the independent regulators ACM and CBP to assess, and that it will bring the case to their attention.
Whether Samsung complies with this provision is not for me to assess, but for the two independent regulators, the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the Data Protection Authority (CBP).

Of Samsung deze bepaling naleeft staat niet ter beoordeling aan mij, maar aan beide onafhankelijke toezichthouders, Autoriteit consument en markt (ACM) en het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een jihadist uit Almere die poseert met 5 afgehakte hoofden

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a jihadist from Almere photographed with five severed heads, asking about his punishment, expulsion and the government's approach to jihadists leaving the Netherlands. The minister confirmed awareness of the photo, said the man's residence right had ended with a 20-year entry ban, and described measures such as stopping benefits, freezing assets and local-triangle interventions, while declining to disclose individual-level details.
However, I cannot make further public statements about the application of the aforementioned measures on an individual basis.
Ik kan echter in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over toepassing van voornoemde maatregelen op individuele basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over een arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie over het hyperlinken en embedden van reeds openbaar gemaakt materiaal

An MP asked whether the CJEU Svensson ruling on hyperlinking and embedding should lead Buma/Stemra to stop its embedding levy and the public broadcaster to drop its restrictions. The government answered that the Court ruled embedding of freely available material is not a communication to the public and that member states may not grant broader protection, noting Buma has voluntarily stopped requiring licences for such links and the NPO has been asked via the media regulator to consult on consequences.
The Minister of Education, Culture and Science has asked the Commissariat for the Media to consult with the NPO on the consequences of the ruling.
De Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap heeft het Commissariaat voor de Media verzocht met de NPO in overleg te treden over de consequenties van het arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat politiechefs zinloze cursussen en trainingen volgen

MP Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police chiefs' training courses (such as cow-hugging and horse mirroring) are a waste of police capacity and money, and what will be done about it. Minister Opstelten rejected the broadcast's portrayal as not reflecting the quality of police leadership education, noting that recent evaluations found some alignment problems and that a new, practice-oriented leadership programme will be piloted from summer 2014.
Recent evaluations (June 2013: 'Schoolmaken in de praktijk' and November 2013: 'Tussen hei en hoofdbureau') of all leadership training courses showed that this was the case in some parts.
Uit recente evaluaties (juni 2013: «Schoolmaken in de praktijk» en november 2013:»Tussen hei en hoofdbureau») van alle leiderschapsopleidingen bleek dat dit op onderdelen het geval was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Van Ark over het bericht ‘Buurt maakt jacht op Amersfoortse homo: ik moest kruipend naar huis’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to respond to reports of a neighbourhood hounding a gay man in Amersfoort, and whether existing legal tools are adequate and how many similar cases occur. The minister condemned such intimidation, pointed to local authorities and the local triangle as primarily responsible, cited police figures on anti-gay violence, and said existing tools suffice while promising support and a national awareness campaign.
It is therefore the task of local authorities to solve these problems in the municipality.
Het is dus de taak van lokale autoriteiten om deze problemen in de gemeente op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ypma over de uitzending ‘Dit is de dag – onderzoek’ en de berichten in de Telegraaf over daders van kindermishandeling

MPs Bergkamp and Ypma asked why child abuse complaints rarely lead to prosecution, how effective the policy is, and whether pleaders receive follow-up support. Minister Opstelten answered with registration figures, outlined existing protocols, a planned OM directive on forensic expertise, and promised a progress report and midterm review.
I will inform you of the outcomes in the next progress report.
Ik bericht u over de uitkomsten in de eerstvolgende voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over gezichtsherkenning door de Scan Eagle
