MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Scan Eagle drone, used to track seals, is designed for facial recognition and whether its use for justice purposes could include such recognition. The government answered that the Scan Eagle's Defence cameras cannot identify people at operational altitude, but it does not rule out future low-altitude flights or facial-recognition cameras, pointing to a WODC privacy study.

Because I cannot foresee all future purposes for which a Raven or Scan Eagle will be deployed, I do not wish to rule out in advance that they will ever fly at low altitude or ever be fitted with cameras enabling facial recognition.

Omdat ik niet alle toekomstige doeleinden waarvoor een Raven of Scan Eagle zal worden ingezet kan voorzien, wil ik niet bij voorbaat uitsluiten dat deze ooit op lage hoogte zullen vliegen of dat zij ooit zullen worden voorzien van camera's waarmee gezichtsherkenning mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en van Toorenburg over de GSM-ontvangst enquête van het CDA Zaltbommel

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about poor mobile reception in the municipality of Zaltbommel, including whether residents can miss emergency alerts, whether 112 and AED access are endangered, whether emergency services are hindered, and whether the minister will meet the parties involved. The minister answered that alerts can be received through other channels, that 112 calls are adequately handled, that AED alternatives exist, and that a meeting is unnecessary because 4G rollout is expected to improve coverage, with an update promised later in the year.
I do not consider a meeting necessary.
Ik acht een gesprek niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw inzake wildlife crime

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about EU-level action against wildlife crime, including enforcement rules, penalties and prosecutorial capacity. The government said it will send a written reply to the Commission, that existing EU rules suffice and enforcement is national, and that maximum penalties are rarely imposed though courts have handed down substantial sentences.
In the BNC fiche sent to your House on 14 March, it is announced that a written response will be sent to the Commission regarding the Communication.
In het BNC fiche dat op 14 maart jl. aan uw Kamer is gezonden, wordt aangekondigd dat een schriftelijke reactie aan de Commissie zal worden verstuurd naar aanleiding van de Mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de oproep een Marokkaanse dame 50 zweepslagen te geven

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about calls for a Moroccan businesswoman to receive 50 lashes after she opened a wine shop, including death threats she received. Minister Opstelten called the call for lashes unacceptable, left the criminal qualification to the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to disclose investigative or protection measures, and said nationality revocation and expulsion for common crimes are not possible.

It is not in the interest of the investigation or of the person concerned to make public statements about whether, and if so which, investigative actions in this case have been or are being carried out.
Het is niet in het belang van de opsporing en van betrokkene om publiekelijk mededelingen te doen over de vraag of, en zo ja welke, opsporingshandelingen in deze zaak zijn of worden verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het vrijlaten van Syrië-gangers

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he is aware of a court releasing Syria-travellers pending trial, whether they should be detained rather than released, and whether administrative detention and denaturalisation should be used against returnees. The minister answered that courts weigh flight and recidivism risk, that reclassering supervision intensity follows a risk instrument, that the AIVD assesses returnees, and that administrative detention is unnecessary since criminal and administrative tools already exist.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation of the persons concerned.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de specifieke situatie van betreffende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een islamitische terrorist die poseert met afgehakt hoofd

An MP asked why a jihadist shown posing with a severed head was not detained despite revoked residence rights, and whether administrative detention is needed against terrorism. The government said he was arrested in 2011, released for lack of serious suspicion, left for Syria with a 20-year entry ban, that prosecution was dropped for lack of national interest, and that it sees no need for new administrative detention powers.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to create additional detention possibilities for the purpose of counterterrorism.
Ik acht het creëren van een aanvullende detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘aangifte tegen hoofdaannemer centrale RWE/Essent’

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service would act on FNV's report that a main contractor at the Eemshaven RWE/Essent plant systematically underpaid subcontractors, and whether other subcontractors should be heard. The minister said a police report and criminal complaint were filed and are being assessed by the prosecutor, and described enforcement measures, a planned liability-for-wages bill and a pending cao-enforcement advisory request.
This complaint is being assessed by the Public Prosecution Service and its outcome cannot be anticipated.
Deze aangifte wordt beoordeeld door het openbaar ministerie en op de uitkomsten daarvan kan niet vooruit worden gelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over Vodafone die in verschillende landen openheid wil geven over aantallen taps en verstrekkingen van verkeersgegevens

The MP asks whether Vodafone's request for greater openness about wiretap and traffic data demands also applies to the Dutch government, and whether the government will act on it. The Minister answers that Vodafone's letter is not a request to publish more, that aggregated disclosure could harm investigations, and that the annual report to parliament already provides sufficient transparency.
I report annually to your House on the number of wiretaps, broken down by telephony and internet, and on data demands
Ik rapporteer jaarlijks aan uw Kamer over het aantal taps, uitgesplitst naar telefonie en internet, en de vorderingen van gegevens
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de vermeende steunbetuiging op Facebook van een PvdA-raadskandidaat aan islamitische terreurorganisaties

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a PvdA council candidate who 'liked' jihadist Facebook pages, including ISIS and Al-Nusra-linked ones, found this objectionable and whether it incited violence. The minister confirmed awareness of the 'likes', noted the candidate's statements that she follows groups she does not support, and called such online jihadist expressions worrying without committing to any concrete action.
I have taken note of the fact that a PvdA council candidate clicked the so-called 'like' button on various Facebook pages with a jihadist profile.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van het feit dat een PvdA-raadskandidaat bij diverse Facebook-pagina's met een jihadistisch profiel de zogenaamde « like » knop heeft aangeklikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat slechts tien procent van de gedownloade boeken middels de legale weg wordt verkregen

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Economic Affairs about reports that only ten percent of downloaded e-books are obtained legally, and about copyright compensation, the 21% VAT rate on e-books and market reform. The state secretary answered that downloading for private use falls under the private-copy exception with levies pending a CJEU ruling, supported an awareness campaign, pointed to the author contracts bill, and said VAT harmonisation is under EU review while market actors should develop business models.

Downloading (reproducing) e-books for one's own practice, study or use, on the other hand, falls under the private-copy exception of Article 16c of the Copyright Act, so the rightholder's consent is not required.

Het downloaden (reproduceren) van e-boeken voor eigen oefening, studie of gebruik, daarentegen, valt onder de thuiskopie-exceptie van artikel 16c van de Auteurswet zodat toestemming van de rechthebbende niet is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over chemische drugslaboratoria d.d. 18 februari 2014

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on chemical drug labs, including whether criminals exploit substances not yet listed under the Opium Act and whether a generic ban on new drugs should be introduced. The minister acknowledged the problem, rejected a generic ban citing a 2012 RIVM assessment and existing legal tools, and stated that lab dismantling by police with LFO expertise minimises risks to residents.
The cabinet concluded that the benefits of introducing a generic system would be extremely limited and certainly would not outweigh the disadvantages.
Het kabinet concludeerde dat de voordelen van de invoering van een generiek stelsel uiterst beperkt zouden zijn en zeker niet opwegen tegen de nadelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de groeiende groep terugkerende jihadisten

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice where returned jihadists are located, why they are not arrested on return, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The minister declined to disclose locations, said the AIVD assesses threats, the OM examines criminal investigation per case, and rejected administrative detention as unnecessary given existing criminal and administrative tools.
I do not make public statements about concrete cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht ‘Pas bij een arrestatie begreep ik de waarde van een bodycam’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about body-worn cameras for police, following a news report and foreign experiences, and whether a new pilot could be run. The minister replied that a 2009 pilot did not lead to national introduction, that existing cameras are used for supervision and events, and that new pilots (a Eastern Netherlands real-time imaging pilot and a helmet-camera pilot with the NCTV) are underway with evaluation due December 2014.
Further research abroad is not necessary.
Nader onderzoek in het buitenland is niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Zembla uitzending “Woede in de winkelstraat”

An MP asked the ministers whether franchisees need stronger legal protection after a Zembla broadcast on abuses in franchising, such as forced purchasing and wrong sales forecasts, and whether a new statutory franchise contract is needed. The minister answered that franchisees should negotiate more critically, that information for aspirant franchisees will be improved, and that new legislation is unnecessary because existing rules and criminal law suffice.
As previously indicated, I intend to improve the information for aspiring franchisees on Ondernemersplein.nl.
Zoals eerder aangeven, ben ik voornemens de voorlichting aan aspirant-franchisenemers op Ondernemersplein.nl te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over trainingen voor de jihad in thuislanden van westerse Syrië-gangers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Western jihadists are trained in Syria for attacks at home, how this is reflected in policy, how many have returned, and whether administrative detention and citizenship revocation should be used. The minister answered that the terrorism threat level was raised, that policy covers intelligence, criminal and administrative tools, roughly twenty jihadists have returned, administrative detention is deemed unnecessary, and dual nationals can lose Dutch citizenship after a final terrorism conviction.
No statements are made about concrete cases.
Over concrete gevallen worden geen mededeling gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Haagse loyaliteit aan Al-Qaida

An MP asked whether the government recognises the violent character of a jihadist pledge made in The Hague, what links exist to Al-Qaida, and whether recruiting for jihad should be punished by denaturalisation and deportation. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, cited the existing criminal provision on recruitment and the limited grounds for revoking nationality, and said the government rejects such conduct while treating Islam as a religion and jihadist radicalisation as a security and integration issue.
I do not make concrete public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een jihadistische radiozender

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the jihadist radio station Radio Ghurabaa, whether other Islamic stations call for violence, why it is not taken off air and prosecuted, and whether the government recognises a violent character of Islam. The minister confirmed the station is jihadist propaganda, said no other Islamic stations concretely call for violence, explained that the NCTV only alerts internet providers who must assess content under their own terms and that prosecution is for the OM, and denied that Islam is inherently violent.
The decision on possible prosecution rests with the Public Prosecution Service.
De beslissing tot eventuele vervolging ligt bij het OM.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Helder en Oskam over zijn uitspraak dat er goede gesprekken zijn met de advocaat van een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude en zijn toezegging de Kamer hierover te informeren

MPs Gesthuizen, Helder and Oskam asked why the minister said in parliament that talks with the lawyer of an identity-fraud victim were going well, and whether the Chamber had been properly informed. The minister replied that talks took place, the last on 16 April 2013, that the state asked for substantiation of the claimed damages, and that the lawyer was still considering a response; he said the earlier statement was accurate and that individual cases are not usually discussed substantively in the Chamber.
It is not customary to discuss an ongoing individual case in substance in the Chamber.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om in uw Kamer inhoudelijk in te gaan op een lopende individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over diefstallen uit stallen, schuren en weilanden

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising thefts of machinery and goods from farm barns, stables and fields, the role of Eastern European mobile criminal gangs, and cross-border cooperation. The minister said police do not register these thefts separately so no national trend can be confirmed, described regional measures and a 2013 project in Limburg, and referred to earlier letters and debates for the rest.
Thefts at agricultural businesses are not separately recorded in the police registration systems.
Diefstallen bij agrarische bedrijven worden niet apart geregistreerd in de registratiesystemen van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Slachtoffer overval zelf de cel in’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a crime victim who detained a robbery suspect and was now being investigated as a suspect should be treated as a helpful citizen, and whether this conflicts with the 2010 guideline on self-defence. The minister replied that the victim was never treated as a suspect for the robbery, but is suspected of threatening the suspect's girlfriend afterwards, so the self-defence guideline does not apply, and no help or letter to parliament is planned.
At present I see no need to provide assistance to the citizen concerned.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak om hulp te verlenen aan de betreffende burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het artikel “Angst heerst achter de voordeur bij veel ouderen”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of fear among elderly people over home burglaries, including whether police record victims' age, what policy exists, whether elderly people are informed on prevention, and whether aging-in-place policy will increase such crimes. The minister answered that over-55 victims are recorded, burglaries on this group fell 12% in 2013, prevention is pursued with seniors' organisations and CCV, and no increase is expected.
Yes, the police record whether the victim of a robbery is older than 55.
Ja, de politie registreert of het slachtoffer van een overval ouder is dan 55 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de aanhoudende Marokkaanse straatterreur in Helmond

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked about youth street crime in Helmond, its harsh enforcement, the over-representation of Moroccan-Dutch youths in crime statistics, and why criminal non-citizens and dual nationals are not deported or stripped of nationality. The minister replied that policing has been intensified with a zero-tolerance approach, that the approach does not distinguish by ethnicity, that sentencing is for the prosecution service, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The share of suspects among Moroccan-Dutch boys under 23 is indeed much higher than the share of suspects among native Dutch youths.
Het aandeel verdachten onder Marokkaans-Nederlandse jongens tot 23 jaar is inderdaad veel hoger dan het aandeel verdachten onder autochtone jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het in gevaar komen van opsporing en vervolging in Limburg bij het doorvoeren van de voorgenomen reorganisatie binnen het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a planned reorganisation of the Limburg public prosecution service would endanger prosecution, and whether seven parket secretaries would move to the police. The minister denied any reorganisation of the Limburg parket, said the concern about endangered public safety is not shared, and offered more clarity later but rejected reconsidering the process.
There is no question of a reorganisation of the Limburg district prosecutor's office.
Er is geen sprake van een reorganisatie van het arrondissementsparket Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Reorganisatie Openbaar Ministerie (OM) ‘gevaarlijk’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the planned reorganisation of the Openbaar Ministerie (public prosecution service) endangers criminal prosecution, whether budget cuts rather than court mergers cause problems, and whether the Chamber will be kept informed. The minister replied that the report is known, referred to earlier answers to similar questions, and said the Chamber is informed twice a year via the Versterking Prestaties Strafrechtketen programme, with the next report before the summer recess.
I inform the Chamber twice a year about the state of affairs of the Versterking Prestaties Strafrechtketen programme.
Ik informeer uw Kamer twee keer per jaar over de stand van zaken van het programma Versterking Prestaties Strafrechtketen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de behandeling van een diabetespatiënte door particuliere beveiligers en de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the treatment of a diabetic woman detained by private security and police after urinating in a HEMA fitting room, including alleged remarks by officers and whether an apology was due. The minister answered that police acted lawfully and professionally, found no basis for excuses, and noted the public prosecutor had dismissed the case.
Together with the competent authority, however, I am of the opinion that the police acted lawfully and professionally in this situation.
Samen met het bevoegd gezag ben ik echter van mening dat de politie in deze situatie rechtmatig en professioneel heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over jonge criminelen die hulpverleners uitlachen

PVV MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked the Justice Minister about young criminals mocking youth-care and police workers, doubting the effectiveness of the youth gang approach, judges' acquittals, expanding ISD measures to 12-year-olds, and parental liability. The minister rejected the claim that the approach fails, pointed to judicial independence, said ISD is being tested for 16-23 year olds and youths 12+ already have sanctions, and noted parents can be prosecuted or held liable for damages up to age 14 or 15 in civil law.
On 12 November 2013 I informed the House of Representatives about this.
Op 12 november 2013 heb ik de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over “islamitische geweldsprediking”

An MP asks whether mosques calling for violence should be closed immediately and whether Islam is inherently violent, and urges action against 'Islamisation'. The ministers answer that incitement to violence is prohibited and the Public Prosecution Service can ask a court to close an institution acting against public order, but they reject judging a religion by a violent minority and do not commit to new measures.
Calling for hatred or inciting violence is explicitly not permitted.
Het oproepen tot haat of het aanzetten tot geweld is nadrukkelijk niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een schietincident in Irak

MP Van Bommel asked why witness statements from Iraqi ICDC soldiers in the 2004 Ar Rumaythah shooting case were not treated as relevant by the prosecutor and only sent to the European Court now, and whether the prosecution withheld them. The minister answers that the statements' brief content was in the KMAR file and seen by counsel in 2007, that the full statements were only sent to the court in 2012 at the state's initiative, and rejects claims of deliberate concealment and perjury.
The suggestion that these statements were deliberately withheld by the prosecution for years is firmly rejected.
Met kracht wordt de suggestie verworpen dat deze verklaringen jarenlang «opzettelijk door het OM zijn achtergehouden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Ziengs over de flexibilisering van huurcontracten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the fixed terms of commercial lease contracts make shop premises inflexible and whether Dutch lease law allows short leases. The minister replied that the Civil Code balances landlord and tenant interests, that 5-year terms can be shortened to 2 years or less, and that a stakeholder platform (Winkeltop) is working on the vacancy problem.
All in all, a considerable degree of flexibility is provided.
Er wordt al met al de nodige flexibiliteit gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Hijum over de berichten dat online met aanschaf van bitcoins een semi-automatisch wapen is aangeschaft en een tiener zichzelf gedood heeft met een omgebouwd pistool

MPs Oskam and Van Hijum asked about reports that an illegal semi-automatic weapon was bought online with bitcoins and a teenager died from a converted pistol, including what has been done to tighten firearms law, border controls, international cooperation and online arms trade. The minister answered that prior measures concerned legal gun ownership, that border scanning is overwhelmed by volume but being strengthened, that existing enforcement is adequate, and that existing laws and an upcoming bill address online weapon trade, while declining to ban bitcoin.

Yes, the Computer Crime III bill, which I expect to be able to send to the Council of State within a reasonable time, provides among other things for creating an explicit statutory power for the police to enter a computer remotely.

Ja, het wetsvoorstel Computercriminaliteit III, dat ik binnen afzienbare termijn naar de Raad van State verwacht te kunnen sturen, voorziet onder andere in het creëren van een expliciete wettelijke bevoegdheid voor de politie om op afstand een computer te betreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over het bericht dat “verdachten profiteren in kinderpornozaken van een te vage tenlastelegging”

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that suspects in child pornography cases benefit from vague charging documents, and about a legal disagreement between the Public Prosecution Service and the Hague court on how possession charges must be drafted. The Minister confirmed a legal disagreement limited to a few court chambers, said several dozen cases were delayed and four summons declared void with only occasional sentence effects, and stated there are no formal OM-judiciary agreements, with the OM pressing for a uniform court position and a new test case expected to clarify matters.
The OM Den Haag will soon bring another case using the new method of charging.
Het OM Den Haag zal binnenkort weer een zaak aanbrengen met de nieuwe wijze van tenlastelegging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over knelpunten voor franchisenemers

An MP asked the Economics and Justice ministers about problems franchisees face, including the NFV's organisation, representation of franchisees, the VAKcentrum's identified knelpunten and calls for new legislation, an updated EIM study, and better information on the Ondernemersplein portal. The minister answered that franchising mostly works, that stakeholder talks are ongoing, that extra legislation is unlikely to solve the problems, that an EIM update is not needed, and that the Ondernemersplein information will be expanded.
However, it is not plausible that additional legislation will be able to solve the outlined problems.
Het is evenwel niet aannemelijk dat extra wetgeving de geschetste problemen zal kunnen oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodschieten van een verweesd jong damhert bij Marum

An MP asked whether police shot a young orphaned fallow deer in a pasture near Marum, whether less lethal alternatives were tried, and whether protocols were followed. The minister said an internal police investigation is ongoing and cannot be anticipated, and that the duty of care under the Flora- and faunawet applies, but whether it was met cannot be said while the investigation runs.
An internal police investigation into the precise events in this case is under way. I cannot anticipate the results of this investigation.
Er loopt een intern politieonderzoek naar de precieze gebeurtenissen in deze zaak. Ik kan niet op de resultaten van dit onderzoek vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Scores politie onbetrouwbaar’

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police registration of solved crimes is unreliable and how Parliament can supervise crime-fighting performance and High Impact Crime statistics. The Minister answers that the inspectorate's findings concern mainly the former regional systems, that police statistics are not unreliable overall, and that measures to fix registration are underway.
I do not share the view that the police figures are unreliable.
Ik deel de opvatting dat de politiecijfers onbetrouwbaar zijn niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het EenVandaag onderzoek naar zogenaamde babbeltrucs

MP Baay-Timmerman asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Finance about the EenVandaag findings on babbeltrucs targeting the elderly, including low reporting rates, the lack of a national approach, and whether banks should share one easy card-blocking number. The minister replied that no own figures on prevalence exist, pointed to reporting-improvement measures and prevention, rejected a national coordinated approach as unnecessary, and said the Finance minister saw no reason to negotiate a single blocking number with banks.
As I answered in earlier parliamentary questions on this subject, I do not have my own figures on the scale of this phenomenon.
Zoals ik heb geantwoord op eerdere Kamervragen over dit onderwerp beschik ik niet over eigen cijfers over de omvang van dit fenomeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de inzet van politiestudenten tijdens de jaarwisseling 2013-2014

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about deploying police trainees (aspirant-agenten) during New Year's Eve 2013-2014, including whether agreements with police unions on voluntariness, coaching, pay and course completion were kept. The minister confirmed deployment, said the agreements were made and largely followed, acknowledged one incident each of no coach present and one trainee deployed before completing the course, and promised clearer communication of agreements before future deployments.
For every special deployment, the agreements will be clearly communicated and repeated shortly before a deployment.
Bij iedere bijzondere inzet zullen de afspraken duidelijk worden gecommuniceerd en vlak voor een inzet worden herhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over een 77-jarige vrouw uit Valkenswaard die tienduizenden euro’s moet betalen omdat vaten gif op haar terrein zijn gestort door criminelen

An MP asked the government about a 77-year-old woman in Valkenswaard who must pay tens of thousands of euros to clear barrels of toxic drug waste dumped on her land by criminals, questioning the municipality's assessment of her conduct and whether the law should include a hardship clause or fund. The State Secretary replied that the municipality is responsible for the case and the legal framework is sufficient, declined to judge the municipal assessment, and pointed to a provincial working group and a possible guarantee fund instead of legislative change.
I therefore cannot give an opinion on assessments the municipal official made regarding the specific case in Valkenswaard.
Ik kan daarom geen mening geven omtrent inschattingen die de betreffende gemeenteambtenaar heeft gemaakt met betrekking tot de specifieke casus in Valkenswaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Rebel over handhaving dumping drugsafval in de natuur

MPs Jacobi and Rebel asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about enforcement against dumping of drug waste in nature, including whether existing law is adequate, who pays cleanup costs, enforcement numbers and capacity, and expertise. The minister replied that existing Environmental Management Act provisions suffice, that no new rules are planned, that the polluter should pay with waterproofing funds being explored, and that specialist police expertise (LFO) is available.

Further data on the number of drug waste dumpings and the resulting prosecutions, sentences, and collected fines cannot be generated from the business process systems of the Public Prosecution Service and investigative agencies.

Nadere gegevens over aantallen drugsafvaldumpingen en de daarop volgende strafvervolging/strafoplegging en geïnde geldboetes en/of gevangenisstraffen kunnen niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het OM en de opsporingsinstanties worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het omzeilen van telefoontaps door verdachten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether suspects can disable police phone taps by hiding behind a lawyer's number, and what the consequences are for lawyer-client confidentiality and ongoing cases. The minister replied that the aspects of spoofing are being inventoried and that the results, including these questions, will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform your House by letter before the summer recess about the results of the inventory.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het zomerreces per brief informeren over de resultaten van de inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over wifi-tracking door winkels

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked whether shops may collect device identifiers via wifi or bluetooth from people inside and passing by their stores, and whether shops must disclose this and whether the data protection authority will be asked to investigate. The state secretary answered that tracking inside a shop may be justified as a legitimate interest under the Dutch data protection act if limited to visitor counts and movement, but collecting data from passers-by on the public road requires consent, and the minister will discuss the issue with the data protection authority.
The Minister of Economic Affairs indicated at the general consultation with your House on 12 February that he would discuss this issue with the Data Protection Authority (CBP).
De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft tijdens het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 12 februari j.l. aangegeven dit vraagstuk te zullen bespreken met het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de rechtsbescherming van erfpachters

An SP MP asks the ministers whether they will change the law so leaseholders (erfpachters) can compel a reluctant ground lessor to amend contracts marked 'code rood', rather than having to sue, and whether they will act on NVB suggestions such as statutory protection, court review and AFM supervision. The minister maintains that the leaseholder must go to court, but says consultation with stakeholders on the evaluation of the banking guideline and possible steps will take place shortly.

This does not alter the fact that, as also indicated in the earlier answer of 7 February 2014, consultation with relevant parties will take place shortly to jointly consider which steps are conceivable based on the experiences gained.

Dit laat onverlet dat, zoals ook aangegeven in eerdergenoemde beantwoording van 7 februari 2014, op korte termijn overleg zal plaatsvinden met betrokken partijen om aan de hand van de opgedane ervaringen met elkaar te bezien welke stappen denkbaar zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over vermeende privacyschendingen door Samsung

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Samsung smart TVs may track viewing behaviour under accepted terms, whether consent is explicit, and whether the TVs' terms of use are lawful, citing a CBP ruling. The State Secretary answered that consent or contract grounds under the Wbp could justify collection, that the Cbp is the independent supervisor and the government will not judge Samsung's lawfulness itself.
Supervision of compliance with the Wbp rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (Cbp).
Het toezicht op de naleving van de Wbp berust bij het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (Cbp).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over een toename in de diefstal van Canta’s (voertuigen voor invaliden)

A GroenLinks MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising theft of Canta mobility vehicles, whether national figures exist, whether a licence plate requirement should be introduced, and what other measures are planned. The minister answered that police records misclassify Cantas, that an analysis shows about 74% of thefts occur in the Amsterdam region, that a plate requirement would not outweigh administrative costs for theft prevention alone, and that prevention is mainly the owner's responsibility, with tracking systems recommended.
The actual number of stolen Cantas therefore cannot be reliably traced from BVH.
Het werkelijke aantal gestolen Canta's is derhalve niet goed herleidbaar uit BVH.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Puinhopen bij justitie Limburg”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of serious problems at the Limburg public prosecution service and whether the government will act, inform parliament and accept that problems stem from court mergers and digitisation. The minister rejects the 'puinhopen' characterisation, points to earlier letters and measures taken by the Limburg parquet, and attributes some issues to the reorganisation while promising regional fixes.
Where (temporary) coordination problems arise, the district prosecution office takes measures to address them.
Daar waar zich (tijdelijke) problemen in de afstemming voordoen treft het arrondissementsparket daarvoor maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over de berichten “Rijbewijs gewoon te koop in Litouwen” en “Litauiske forekort kjopes for 80 Euro”

Two PVV MPs asked the transport minister whether Lithuanian driving licences bought for 80 euros should no longer be accepted in the Netherlands and whether Lithuanian vehicles should be barred from Dutch roads. The minister answered that no fraud has been established, that EU rules require mutual recognition of licences and free movement precludes banning Lithuanian vehicles, and that roadside checks continue.
This could be the case if fraud had been demonstrated. However, this is not the case.
Dit zou het geval kunnen zijn als fraude zou zijn aangetoond. Dit is echter niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over discriminatie van allochtone politieagenten binnen de politieorganisatie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about discrimination against ethnic-minority police officers, their departure rates, and how discrimination complaints are handled. The minister answered that no targets are set, that the last published ethnic minority share was 7% in 2011, that no current data on entries and exits exists, and that a staff satisfaction survey in 2014 will cover the issue and results will be shared with parliament.
After 2011, the number of ethnic minority employees was no longer actively tracked by the police organisation.
Na 2011 is het aantal allochtone medewerkers door de politieorganisatie niet meer actief bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de benoeming van de Venezolaanse Consul in Aruba

Two PVV MPs asked whether Venezuela appointed a consul in Aruba who is suspected of drug trafficking linked to a terrorist organisation, whether he is on US watch lists, whether an international arrest request applies, and whether this was raised during a Dutch delegation visit. The minister answered that no request for a new Venezuelan consul-general in Aruba has been received, that the person is publicly listed on the US Treasury SDN list since 2008, that the Justice Minister will not comment on non-public lists or arrest requests, and that the delegation visit did not raise the appointment.
The Minister of Security and Justice does not comment on non-public lists of the United States or on international arrest and detention requests.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie doet geen uitspraken over niet-openbare lijsten van de Verenigde Staten of internationale opsporings- en aanhoudingsverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wolbert over de enquête onder brandweerpersoneel

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an EenVandaag survey in which 80% of fire service staff said reorganisation reduced public safety, and about organisational problems such as bureaucracy and poor communication. The minister disputed the survey's picture, pointed to the Hoekstra commission's finding that safety improved, and said Brandweer Nederland will run a follow-up staff survey and keep consulting unions and works councils.
I take the signals from the survey seriously and am in contact with the employers, the safety regions, about them.
Ik neem de signalen uit de enquête serieus en ben daarover in contact met de werkgevers, de veiligheidsregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de voorwaardelijke invrijheidsstelling van een in het buitenland recidiverende pedoseksueel

An MP asked the minister about a Dutch national with prior child-abuse convictions, reportedly arrested in Bulgaria with orphan children, including whether he was still on probation and whether his suspended Dutch sentence should be enforced. The state secretary confirmed the facts, said the probation condition covers offences abroad, and explained that enforcement depends on the individual case and that Bulgaria is not obliged to transfer sentences to the Netherlands.
When general and/or special conditions are breached, however, whether the Public Prosecution Service seeks enforcement of a conditional sanction depends on the circumstances of the individual case.

Bij overtreding van de algemene en/of bijzondere voorwaarden hangt het echter van de omstandigheden van een individuele zaak af of het Openbaar Ministerie de tenuitvoerlegging van een voorwaardelijke sanctie vordert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de beoordeling van euthanasie door de Regionale Toetsingscommissies Euthanasie

MPs Dik-Faber and Van der Staaij asked whether euthanasia review committees should follow professional guidelines, whether there should be an independent dispute body for KNMG's complaints, and whether a meeting with KNMG had taken place. Minister Schippers answered that committees are not bound by guidelines but use them as a reference, that transparency will be improved via the website, that a separate dispute body is not desirable, and that a meeting with KNMG has been arranged.
We do not consider it desirable that in other situations objection to an Rte judgement be possible.
Wij achten het niet wenselijk dat in andere situaties bezwaar tegen een Rte-oordeel openstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over de dreigende uitlevering van een Vietnamese student aan de Verenigde Staten

The SP MP De Wit asked the Justice Minister about the imminent extradition of a Vietnamese student, Lee Vu, to the United States, questioning its hardship and whether it could be postponed until he finishes his studies. Minister Opstelten refused to postpone, citing US prosecutorial concerns about evidence quality and victims' claims, and stated that his studies do not constitute grounds for delay.
I therefore see no ground in this case to postpone an extradition obligation and allow a foreign criminal case to be further delayed.
Ik zie in deze zaak daarom geen grond om een uitleveringsverplichting uit te stellen en een buitenlandse strafzaak verdere vertraging te laten oplopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat verboden wapens gemakkelijk in buurlanden verkrijgbaar zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how prohibited alarm and gas pistols can be bought easily in Germany and Belgium, how cross-border sales and imports are controlled, and whether the government will take extra measures or raise the issue with neighbouring countries and in Brussels. The minister said the difference in laws is a fact, that Dutch import controls by customs and police work well, that the investigation into the specific weapon is not finished, and that no additional measures are warranted.
No, I see no reason in this incident to take or undertake additional measures or actions.
Nee, ik zie in dit incident geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen of acties te (onder)nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht over een extra controle op het nieuwe dienstwapen van de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the extra inspection of the new police service pistol, after a missing trigger-bar catch notch was found, including when all weapons would be checked, whether any were affected, the risks to officers, the manufacturer's liability and the costs. The minister answered that 13,000 weapons were checked so far with completion due 15 February 2014, that only one weapon was found missing the part and repaired, that the manufacturer bears all extra costs of about 1,200 man-hours, and that more defects cannot be ruled out but sampling was increased.
On 15 February 2014 the inspection of all service weapons will have been completed.
Op 15 Februari 2014 zal de controle op alle dienstwapens zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over een grote criminele jeugdgroep in Den Haag

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Hague youth gang whose members fled police, including reported help from family and others, and what would be done to dismantle the group. The Minister said such fleeing does not mean escaping view, that helping offenders would be punishable if true, and that a multi-track approach with the municipality and prosecutors is underway.
Police and justice have these boys closely in their sights.
Politie en justitie hebben deze jongens scherp in het vizier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries (over het bericht tienduizenden huizen nog altijd onverkoopbaar door erfpacht

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about reports that tens of thousands of homes on leasehold land remain unsaleable because banks refuse financing. The minister defends the banking guideline agreed between the notaries and the banks as self-regulation, says he will consult stakeholders shortly, and rules out bringing leasehold contracts under financial supervision or declaring the guideline generally binding.
I will shortly consult with the parties involved about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met betrokken partijen over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het op Nederlands grondgebied verrichten van opsporingsactiviteiten door Amerikaanse diensten en het naar aanleiding daarvan uitleveren van een Nederlander

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether US agents conducted undercover drug-purchase operations on Dutch soil leading to the extradition of a Dutchman, and how such activity is authorised and prevented. The minister answered that no US investigative acts took place in the Netherlands, that the courts found no breach of Dutch rules, and that extradition was approved.
I do not regard such a course of events as undercover actions on Dutch territory for which Netherlands would have had to be asked permission through a mutual legal assistance request.
Een dergelijke gang van zaken merk ik niet aan als undercoveracties op Nederlands grondgebied waarvoor door middel van een rechtshulpverzoek Nederland om toestemming had moeten worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de beantwoording van vragen over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP asked why fire-response plans specific to wind turbines are absent, how high brigades can reach, how quickly specialist rescue teams arrive, and how offshore turbines are regulated. The Minister answered that generic procedures apply, that municipal safety regions are responsible for instructions, and that offshore permits require certification and emergency plans reviewed by Rijkswaterstaat.
Drawing up instructions, deployment procedures and attack plans is a responsibility of the safety regions.
Het opstellen van instructies, inzetprocedures en aanvalsplannen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Merkies over een schikking van het Openbaar Ministerie met KPMG

MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Merkies (SP) asked why the Minister approved a Public Prosecution Service settlement with KPMG over its role in the Ballast Nedam fraud, and whether it should be reversed. The Minister answered that he approved it after weighing all interests, that the settlement with its fine and publicity serves punishment goals, and that reversal is not possible.
With this settlement the investigation into the responsible natural persons has not ended; that investigation continues.
Met deze transactie is het onderzoek naar verantwoordelijke natuurlijke personen niet beëindigd; dat onderzoek wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen, en Merkies over de door het openbaar ministerie getroffen schikking met KPMG in een fraudezaak van Ballast Nedam

MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Merkies asked whether KPMG's top has known about the Ballast Nedam bribery affair for ten years, whether this was kept from the prosecution, whether the OM is investigating KPMG leadership, and whether the minister will reconsider the settlement with KPMG. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, declined to answer the specific questions because the investigation into three accountants is ongoing, and stood by the settlement.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over falend toezicht op jihadisten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that supervision of jihadists had failed, how many supervised jihadists had left for abroad, whether returnees should be arrested and denaturalised, and when jihad as such would be criminalised. The minister answered that one supervised person probably went to Syria, outlined the existing tools (AIVD risk assessments, prosecution, passport revocation, citizenship withdrawal) and noted that participation in jihadist fighting is already punishable under article 134a of the Criminal Code.
At present there is one departee who was under supervision of the probation service.
Op dit moment is sprake van één uitreiziger die onder toezicht van de reclassering stond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over inzet door Justitie van de nieuwe Defensie drone

An MP asked whether the Justice Ministry plans to use Defence's Scan Eagle drone, whether it will test its suitability and whether it should be grounded pending a motion on drone privacy. The minister answered that there are no concrete plans for Justice to request Scan Eagle support, that existing legal frameworks (proportionality and subsidiarity tests via the MLA and ILT) can cover its use, and that a study of privacy frameworks for drone cameras will be carried out in 2014.
Because the UAVs and the cameras mounted on them are still under development, the cabinet announced in its note on freedom and security in the digital society that a study will be carried out in 2014

Omdat de UAV’s en daarop gemonteerde camera’s nog steeds in ontwikkeling zijn, heeft het kabinet in de notitie Vrijheid en veiligheid in de digitale samenleving aangekondigd dat in 2014 een onderzoek zal worden uitgevoerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Recourt over KPMG en de steekpenningenaffaire van Ballast Nedam

MPs Nijboer and Recourt asked the Ministers of Finance and Justice about KPMG's role in the Ballast Nedam bribery affair, the AFM's handling of it, and accountant oversight. The minister answered that the AFM helped arrange a gradual handover of the 2012 audit, that the criminal investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed in detail, and that existing rules already cover integrity and fraud signalling, with a response to a pending motion promised.
To avoid harming this ongoing investigation, I cannot answer the specific questions you ask at this time.
Om dit nog lopende onderzoek niet te schaden kan ik de specifieke vragen die u stelt nu niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leegte en Van Oosten over het artikel waarin de International Chamber of Commerce, ICC, wijst op de risico’s van corruptie voor bedrijven

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Justice about an ICC warning that corruption risks for companies are underestimated, including the effects of US and UK anti-bribery law on Dutch SMEs and support for firms acting in good faith. The government rejected the ICC's picture, pointed to outreach measures, the 2012 OECD evaluation and planned integrated policy response, but gave no new commitments beyond ongoing talks with the ICC.
The cabinet does not recognise the picture that the ICC paints.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in het beeld dat de ICC schetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat slechts negen procent van de door Defensie goedgekeurde dronevluchten van te voren bekend gemaakt is

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked why only nine percent of approved Defence drone flights were announced in advance and whether this is proportionate and privacy-respecting. The minister denied the figure as framed, explained that the 2012 change in procedure means fewer flights are published in the Staatscourant, described retention rules for drone footage, and declined to commit to publishing all flights in advance, citing investigation confidentiality.
In view of the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights before their deployment.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk vluchten voor de inzet aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Tieners roven impulsief en voor de kick’ en ‘Stoere straatrover in de cel vaak een grienend jochie’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether juvenile street robbers under 16 should be punished harder, whether 14- and 15-year-olds should be tried under adult criminal law, and whether the adolescent criminal law should be reversed. The minister said the existing integrated approach and juvenile law suffice, that adult law for 14- and 15-year-olds would conflict with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, and that the adolescent criminal law will be kept.
I see no reason, given the age of the street robbers as described in the newspaper article, to further strengthen the approach described in answer 2.
Ik zie in de leeftijd van de straatrovers -zoals bedoeld in het krantenartikel- geen aanleiding de in antwoord 2 beschreven aanpak verder te verstevigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over rondslingerende munitie in de natuur

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether lead ammunition should be banned for hunting and pest control in the Netherlands, following reports of hunters losing ammunition in nature. The minister answered that such data are unavailable, noted that 14 EU states ban lead shot, and declined to extend the ban to lead bullets, citing insufficient grounds from the single incident.
The incident mentioned in the cited media report gives me insufficient reason to extend the existing ban on lead shot to a ban on lead cartridges for hunting and pest control.

Het incident, genoemd in het aangehaalde mediabericht, geeft mij onvoldoende aanleiding om het geldende verbod op het gebruik van loodhoudende hagel uit te breiden met een verbod op het gebruik van loodhoudende kogelpatronen voor jacht en schadebestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de inrichting van de specialistische blauwe diensten bij de Landelijke Eenheid van de nationale politie

An MP asked why railway, traffic and water police specialisms were merged into the Infrastructure service of the national police's Landelijke Eenheid, whether reporting points at stations had closed, and whether specialist expertise and public safety would be preserved. The Minister answered that the reporting facilities are not materially worse, that the merger is a flexible integrated approach, and that he holds to the adopted organisation plan while monitoring specialist quality.
I adhere to what is described in the National Police Organisation Plan.
Ik houd vast aan hetgeen in het Inrichtingsplan Nationale Politie is beschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Bommel over de smeergeldaffaire in verband met bouwprojecten van Ballast Nedam in Saudi-Arabië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the ministry interfered with the criminal investigation into the Ballast-Nedam bribery affair in Saudi Arabia and whether political interference is lawful, and asked about the UK precedent with BAE. The minister denies any involvement by the ministry, says the Public Prosecution Service's post-publication response was correct, and states that the only lawful ministerial intervention is a formal instruction under the Judiciary Organisation Act, subject to parliamentary control.
There has been no involvement, interest or obstruction from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Er is geen sprake geweest van bemoeienis, betrokkenheid of hindering van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Matchfixing nog steeds geen prioriteit in Nederland’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about reports that matchfixing is not a priority in the Netherlands and about organised crime's role, and whether the government would push for a European approach. The minister replied that matchfixing takes several forms, that the OM is examining signals of fraud in football within a preliminary investigation, and that the Netherlands is actively negotiating a Council of Europe convention against matchfixing, with adoption targeted for autumn 2014.
The Netherlands actively participates in the negotiations in the Council of Europe to reach a convention to combat matchfixing.
Nederland neemt pro-actief deel aan de onderhandelingen in de Raad van Europa, om tot een verdrag te komen ter bestrijding van matchfixing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over opgepakte jihadisten in Turkije

The MP asked whether Turkey had arrested jihadists with Dutch nationality, what happened to those returned to the Netherlands, and why the government does not apply harsher repression and deportation. The minister replied that no information is available from the OM or police on such cases, that AIVD assesses each returnee and OM considers prosecution case by case, and that no further public statements on concrete cases will be made.
About any information provided by the Turkish intelligence and security services to the AIVD, I make no further public statements.
Over eventuele informatie verstrekt door de Turkse inlichtingen-en veiligheidsdiensten aan de AIVD doe ik in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Voordewind, Van der Steur en Van der Staaij over het gebruik van xtc onder jongeren

MPs asked the government about the high ecstasy use among young party-goers, rising XTC-related hospital and first-aid incidents, how easily XTC is obtained, controls at events, and the role of parents and municipalities in prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new Trimbos VGHE prevention programme, noted increased incidents and drug strength, and said event organisers bear primary responsibility for security while enforcement focuses on production and trade.
For this reason I have instructed the Trimbos Institute to start the Safe and Healthy Hospitality and Events (VGHE) programme in 2014, as announced in the National Prevention Programme (NPP).

Mede om die reden heb ik het Trimbos-instituut opdracht gegeven om, zoals ook is aangekondigd in het Nationaal Programma Preventie (NPP), in 2014 te starten met het programma Veilige en Gezonde Horeca en Evenementen (VGHE).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Klever over het bericht van de Nationale ombudsman “fraude valt mee”

Two PVV MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about the National Ombudsman's statement that fraud is less serious than assumed, and whether they agree that all fraud must be tackled and that such statements insult taxpayers. The Minister replied that all fraud is unacceptable, pointed to the Rijksbrede aanpak Fraude and the zorgfraude plan of action, and said he does not share the view that the Ombudsman's statement is an insult, as the Ombudsman's task is to oversee government.
No, I do not share that view. The National Ombudsman's task is to oversee the government and make statements about it.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. De Nationale Ombudsman heeft tot taak om toe te zien op de overheid en daarover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het tegengaan van internationale voetbalhooliganisme

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about a new generation of Ajax hooligans shifting violence to international away matches and how to prevent it, including cross-border cooperation. The Minister said football violence abroad is not new, cited existing stadium bans and possible reporting obligations, and promised to raise a travel-ban-style reporting obligation in European fora, but gave no contact with Ajax or Italian authorities.

As I answered in previous written questions, I will shortly raise attention at European level for the possibilities of including a travel ban in the form of a reporting obligation in national regulations.

Antwoord 5 Zoals ik u heb geantwoord op eerdere schriftelijke vragen 2 zal ik op korte termijn in Europees verband aandacht vragen voor de mogelijkheden om in nationale regelgeving een uitreisverbod in de vorm van een meldplicht op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Moors over de vergoeding van advocaatkosten van een oud-ambtenaar

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reimbursement of legal costs for a former secretary-general after a court ordered prosecution to proceed, and whether reimbursement should continue after retirement. The minister answered that legal costs for the criminal defence will be terminated, civil proceedings and the earlier article 12 procedure remain reimbursed, no decision has been taken on the pre-trial witness hearing, and reclaiming paid costs is intended but depends on the eventual outcome.
If not, why not? Answer 4 Yes.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4 Ja.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over het onderbreken van een project voor jonge werkzoekenden bij de politie Assen

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked why a Assen police project offering work experience to young jobseekers was halted and whether a national rollout would be pursued. The minister answers that the original training project ended this year, a national working group is examining options, and 5 to 10 placements will be set up at two police units with an ambition of 100.
Last January, in implementation of the Marcouch motion, I indicated that I would research national possibilities for the national police to offer work experience places to unemployed young people.

Afgelopen januari heb ik ter uitvoering van de motie Marcouch aangegeven onderzoek te gaan doen naar landelijke mogelijkheden voor de nationale politie om werkervaringsplaatsen aan te bieden aan werkloze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Roon over de jihadcoalitie

MPs Van Klaveren and De Roon asked about a reported jihadist coalition in Syria, the number of Dutch jihadists involved, and whether participation should be criminalised with citizenship revocation and expulsion. The minister answered that the coalition groups are not designated terrorist groups and are distinct from ISIL and JaN, that about a hundred Dutch nationals are fighting there, and that participation is already punishable under article 134a Sr with citizenship revocation possible under conditions.
Participating in jihadist fighting or following training abroad is punishable under article 134a of the Dutch Criminal Code.
Het deelnemen aan de jihadistische strijd of training volgen in het buitenland is strafbaar op grond van artikel 134a Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van geweldsimam Al Haddad

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister knew of reports that Islamist preacher Al-Haddad called for stoning adulterers and death for apostates, whether he posed a public-order threat, and whether he should be expelled. The minister said such statements would be reprehensible but prosecution is for prosecutors and courts, that Al-Haddad may voice his views, and that under EU rules a British citizen can only be refused entry for a genuine, serious threat to public order, which was not established; the event was reported cancelled.
The assessment of criminal liability must in an individual case first be made by the public prosecutor and ultimately by the criminal court.
De beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het openbaar ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over de Taskforce hennep

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a waterbed effect in cannabis crime moving from big cities to rural Brabant, and about the expansion of the Taskforce hennep to all of Brabant and Zeeland. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the expansion reflects a general need for resilience rather than a direct response, and said there is no hard evidence yet of displacement to Belgium, while noting that cooperation with Belgian authorities is being structured.
It is correct that the TaskForce B5 will expand to all of Brabant and Zeeland.
Het klopt dat de TaskForce B5 gaat uitbreiden naar heel Brabant en Zeeland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het rapport ‘Metamonitor veilige publieke taak 2013’ inzake geweld en agressie tegen hulpverleners

Member Bontes asked the ministers about a 2013 report showing high rates of violence and aggression against public-sector workers in police, care and education, and whether the government would act. The minister states the government finds this unacceptable, points to a zero-tolerance policy and improved reporting, and says existing measures and municipal-led efforts will continue with six-monthly progress reports to parliament.
From the programme and the Safe Public Task expertise centre (VPT), all employers and employees involved are encouraged and supported to implement the eight VPT measures down to the shop-floor level.

Vanuit het programma en het expertisecentrum Veilige Publieke Taak (VPT) worden alle betrokken werkgevers en werknemers gestimuleerd en ondersteund om de acht VPT-maatregelen 3 tot op het niveau van de werkvloer te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over de toename van agressie tegen treinpersoneel

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked the ministers about rising aggression against rail staff, the measures taken with NS, the role of passengers and bystanders, use of Burgernet, and the arrest rate and sentences for offenders. The minister answered that NS takes measures such as cameras, security teams, training and a 24-hour control centre, that bystander e-learning and a publicity campaign are planned, that Burgernet is unsuitable, and that offender statistics are not registered separately and referred to an earlier study on sentencing.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen in die systemen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de resultaten van de aanpak van fraude bij toeslagen (o.a. de `Bulgarenfraude`)

MP Omtzigt asked about the Bulgarian benefit-fraud case, collection of fines, the fraud coordinator's work, household registration and the Kavelaars criticism of unimplemented advice. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures and described measures taken, but withheld the dates of benefit payments citing the investigation and did not commit to new steps beyond existing measures.
Because of the investigation's interests, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang kunnen hierover geen mededelingen gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het rapport van Amnesty International over etnisch profileren door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Amnesty International's report on ethnic profiling by police, including complaint numbers, complaint reporting, and whether proactive policing can avoid discrimination. The minister states that the report is taken seriously, that stelselmatig discriminatory profiling has not been demonstrated, and points to ongoing Leiden research and planned follow-up letters, while listing existing anti-discrimination training and complaint statistics.

I will consult the local triangles of Amsterdam and The Hague and will include the research results and the measures taken in a follow-up letter on ethnic profiling that I will send to the House in the spring to inform it further.

Ik treed in overleg met de lokale driehoeken van Amsterdam en Den Haag en zal de onderzoeksresultaten alsmede de (genomen) maatregelen betrekken in een vervolgbrief over etnisch profileren die ik in het voorjaar zend om de Kamer nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het stilliggen van een succesvol werklozenproject bij de politie te Assen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a successful youth employment project at the Assen police was halted, and whether work-experience places at the National Police would be created as the Marcouch motion requested. The minister answered that the Drenthe training project has ended, a working group is studying national options, several units are offering places, and the ambition is 100 places with 5 to 10 realised this autumn.
Last January, in implementation of the Marcouch motion, I indicated that I would investigate national possibilities for the National Police to offer work-experience places to unemployed young people.

Afgelopen januari heb ik ter uitvoering van de motie Marcouch aangegeven onderzoek te gaan doen naar landelijke mogelijkheden voor de nationale politie om werkervaringsplaatsen aan te bieden aan werkloze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over Nederlands geld voor de jihad in Jemen

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether money from the Netherlands funds jihad in Yemen, how much, and what will be done to stop it and prosecute donors. The minister confirmed informal, mostly small-scale flows may reach fighters, said the police and AIVD monitor such flows, and that prosecution under Article 421 of the Criminal Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide case by case.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to decide case by case whether to proceed with prosecution.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om per geval te besluiten of tot vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over de samenloop van een herzieningsverzoek met de tenuitvoerlegging van een strafvonnis

The MP asks whether pending, promising review requests (herzieningsverzoeken) can lead to imprisonment for unpaid damages orders, and whether the law should suspend enforcement via the CJIB while such requests are pending. The Minister answers that legal thresholds already filter hopeless requests, that the public prosecution service can postpone enforcement in evidently promising cases, and that a statutory suspension rule is not necessary or desirable.
I share the view that it is undesirable if, in evidently promising cases, enforcement would proceed after a review request or request for further investigation has been filed.

Ik deel de mening dat het ongewenst is wanneer in evident kansrijke gevallen na indiening van een herzieningsaanvraag of een verzoek tot nader onderzoek met de tenuitvoerlegging zou worden voortgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Dikkers over het zeer trage betaalgedrag van een aantal grootbedrijven ten koste van het MKB

MPs Mei Li Vos and Dikkers asked whether large firms such as DE Master Blenders lengthening payment terms to 180-200 days complies with the 60-day statutory limit, and whether enforcement should be strengthened, including by the ACM. The minister replied that civil contracts are not subject to government enforcement, that public supervision is undesirable due to administrative burden, and that suppliers can go to civil court, collective action, or the ACM.
Civil-law contracts are not a subject of government enforcement.
Civielrechtelijke overeenkomsten zijn geen onderwerp van handhaving van overheidswege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de VN geen inzage krijgt in misbruikdossiers van Vaticaan

Two D66 MPs asked why the Holy See refuses to give the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child detailed information on child abuse cases by clergy, and whether it should do so under the Convention. The Foreign Minister answered that the Convention requires cooperation but not detailed case information, that the Holy See does assist foreign mutual legal assistance requests, and that Nederland will not press the Holy See on the matter.
Given the answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, however, it is not reasonable for the Netherlands to confront the Holy See on this.
Gezien het antwoord op de vragen 1, 2 en 3 ligt het echter niet in de rede dat Nederland de Heilige Stoel hierop aanspreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over de realisatie van de doelstelling om te komen tot 5000 politievrijwilligers in 2015

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about reaching the target of 5,000 police volunteers by 2015, including recruitment, retention, displacement of paid work, unemployment-benefit rules, allowances, and volunteers' powers. The minister answered that recruitment is on track through planned campaigns, that the government will align volunteer status and powers with policy, and that displacement of paid labour must be avoided.
The deployment of police volunteers must not lead to displacement of paid labour.
Het inzetten van politievrijwilligers mag niet leiden tot verdringing van arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Marcouch over het bericht dat de Politie de groei van xtc-labs niet kan bijbenen

MPs Rebel and Marcouch asked whether police can keep pace with the rapid growth of ecstasy labs, including staffing of the four specialists, overtime, health risks and the APAAN precursor ban. Minister Opstelten answered that lab numbers rose but growth is unclear, that only four specialists handle dismantling with measures planned to ease workload, and that APAAN will become a registered category 1 substance once the EU regulation takes effect.

Due to the specific nature of dismantling laboratories and the required specialist knowledge level, this work is always and exclusively carried out by the specialists of the National Facility for Dismantling Support (LFO) of the national police unit.

Door de specifieke aard van de werkzaamheden bij het ontmantelen van laboratoria en het vereiste specialistische kennisniveau worden deze werkzaamheden altijd en alleen verricht door de specialisten van de Landelijke Faciliteit ondersteuning Ontmantelen (LFO) van de landelijke eenheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een app waarmee personen die staande worden gehouden hun rechten kunnen beschermen

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether citizens stopped by police should know their rights and whether a 'Stop and Search' app could help raise awareness among citizens and officers. The minister agrees citizens should know their rights and that respectful treatment matters, but declines to pursue a similar app, pointing to existing channels and planned website improvements.
In view of the above answers, I will not now make efforts to develop such an app.
Gelet op bovenstaande antwoorden zal ik me nu niet inspannen voor de ontwikkeling van een dergelijke app.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over de richtlijn bekendmaking niet-financiële informatie

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would oppose Lithuanian Council presidency compromise text narrowing non-financial reporting duties to risks material to the company itself and allowing firms to withhold information harmful to them. The minister answered that the government supports the directive in principle, will treat its BNC-fiche position as the starting point, and cannot discuss specific confidential compromise proposals.
Because of the confidentiality of the compromise proposals, I cannot go into specific proposals that may be made therein.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de compromisvoorstellen kan ik niet ingaan op specifieke voorstellen die daarin mogelijk worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports country-by-country tax reporting for multinationals, as proposed by the European Parliament development committee, and whether it will push for mandatory per-country tax disclosure in annual reports. The government replied that it supports transparency initiatives on tax payments but stresses coordination with existing rules, the economic risks of public disclosure, and the need for clear EU proposals with assessed effects.
The Netherlands has consistently indicated that alignment with existing transparency obligations, such as the obligation already included in the capital requirements directive, is important.
Nederland heeft steeds aangegeven dat afstemming met bestaande transparantieverplichtingen, zoals de verplichting die reeds is opgenomen in de richtlijn voor kapitaalvereisten, van belang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over uiteindelijke-belanghebbendenregisters in relatie tot de herziening van de derde anti-witwasrichtlijn

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about beneficial-ownership registers in the EU anti-money-laundering directive, including whether such a register should be public. The minister answered that the Netherlands prefers a central shareholder register accessible only to authorised public bodies and notaries, not the public, and that the UBO content is still under discussion in the Council.
The Netherlands sees more in a central shareholder register.
Nederland ziet meer in een centraal aandeelhoudersregister.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het tegengaan van internationale voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to curb foreign football hooligans, including entry and exit bans, EU cooperation, and dissolving supporter associations. The minister answered that proposed local measures are ineffective against one-off foreign visitors, that Dutch courts cannot impose exit or entry bans on non-residents, that such matters are for member states and possibly EU-level discussion, and that associations can only be dissolved if their own activities breach public order.
I will raise this at European level.
Ik zal hiervoor in Europees verband aandacht vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de 21-jarige Nederlander die al bijna drie jaar in een Turkse cel wacht op uitlevering naar Nederland
