Sjoerdsma (D66) asked why a 21-year-old Dutch national had been held for nearly three years in Turkey awaiting extradition, and whether the government had withdrawn the request. Minister Opstelten answered that the extradition request was withdrawn effective 1 December 2013 because proceedings had taken so long that detention would exceed the likely Dutch sentence, and that the man was released that day after consular assistance.
At the last contact Turkey was asked that, if the extradition request was still under consideration on 1 December 2013, the extradition procedure be terminated as of that date.

Bij het laatste contact is aan Turkije verzocht om, wanneer het uitleveringsverzoek op 1 december 2013 nog steeds in behandeling zou zijn, de uitleveringsprocedure met ingang van die datum te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over tekort wijkagenten

An MP asked whether Overijssel (Oost unit) falls short of the one-neighbourhood-officer-per-5,000-residents norm, why the shortfall persists nine months after the National Police was formed, and whether labour-union disagreement over the new job classification explains the delay. The minister confirmed Oost has 415 officers against a target of 629 after reorganisation, that the national total meets the norm, and that the norm should be reached by end 2014, with the union talks to be reported to parliament shortly.
Naturally, work must be done towards the statutory norm as quickly as possible.
Uiteraard dient zo snel mogelijk toegewerkt te worden naar de norm uit de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat een computervirus kinderpornografie verspreidt

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a ransomware 'police virus' that displays child pornography deters victims from reporting, how police distinguish planted from downloaded material, and whether voucher sellers bear responsibility. The minister acknowledged under-reporting is possible, said police can distinguish cases, noted voucher sellers are not assumed involved, and advised antivirus use and online guidance.
For that reason I cannot rule out that the number of people who reported the crime is lower than the number actually affected by this virus.
Ik kan mede daarom niet uitsluiten dat het aantal mensen dat aangifte heeft gedaan lager is dan het aantal mensen dat daadwerkelijk door dit virus getroffen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Duizenden agenten aan sufmakende pillen”

Labour MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether about a thousand police officers working under the influence of drowsiness-inducing medication poses a safety problem. The minister answered that the underlying study shows the press report misrepresents its findings, that medication use poses no known safety problem, and that medical confidentiality prevents tracking whether medication use is work-related.
The medication use of every individual Dutch citizen falls under medical professional confidentiality.
Het medicijngebruik van iedere individuele Nederlander valt onder het medisch beroepsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over medicijngebruik bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police officers taking sedatives and anti-depressants during work, and about PTSD in the force. The minister disputed the reported figures, said medication use falls under medical confidentiality, and described existing PTSD support and the PTSD complaints committee.
The medication use of every individual Dutch citizen falls under medical professional confidentiality.
Het medicijngebruik van iedere individuele Nederlander valt onder het medisch beroepsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een invalide man die al voor de vijfde keer is overvallen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a disabled man robbed for the fifth time, asking whether the police will catch the perpetrators quickly and punish them harshly. The minister condemned the robberies, said police are investigating and taking prevention measures, and declined to give publicly the progress of the investigation.
It is not conducive to the chances of success of this investigation if I make public statements about its progress.
Het is voor de succeskansen van dit onderzoek niet dienstig als ik over de voortgang publiekelijk mededelingen doe.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur naar aanleiding van diens brief over ‘tapgesprekken in de zaak Van Rey’, een reconstructie van de NOS, en het bericht dat de uitleg over de tapgesprekken onwaarschijnlijk is

Opposition MP Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about claims that a power outage did not explain why wiretaps of a call involving Van Rey and the State Secretary were not recorded, and why the backup system failed. The Minister answered that the 50-minute outage on 20 September 2012 was a fault in the storage component's power supply, not an external grid failure, detected by monitoring, and that measures were taken to prevent recurrence.
On 20 September 2012 from 13:14 to 14:04 a fault occurred in the power supply of the storage component, as a result of which the electronics did not function correctly.
Op 20 september 2012 van 13.14 uur tot 14.04 uur deed zich een storing in de voeding van de opslagcomponent voor, waardoor de elektronica niet correct heeft gefunctioneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de niet opgenomen telefoongesprekken met de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie in de strafzaak tegen de heer Van Rey

Green Left MP Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a 50-minute outage in the police wiretap system on 20 September 2012 caused unrecorded calls in the Van Rey criminal case, how often such failures occur, whether a risk analysis and backups exist, and why the public prosecutor was not informed. The Minister explains the outage was a power-supply fault in the storage component, that about 2,000 active taps were affected, that the audit and information-security measures are being reviewed, and that the prosecution was belatedly informed.

However, it was neglected to inform the users of the wiretap system and the Public Prosecution Service that a malfunction had occurred, and that as a result there was a chance that conversations had not been recorded.

Er is echter verzuimd om de gebruikers van het tapsysteem en het OM op de hoogte te stellen van het feit dat zich een storing had voorgedaan, en dat daardoor de kans aanwezig was dat gesprekken niet waren opgenomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen naar aanleiding van diens brief over ‘tapgesprekken in de zaak Van Rey’, een reconstructie van de NOS, en het bericht dat de uitleg over de tapgesprekken onwaarsch

MPs Oskam and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about recurring wiretap system outages, a September 2012 power failure that lost roughly 2,000 taps in the Van Rey case, and missing incident records. The minister answered that the outage was an internal power-supply fault rather than a utility failure, that storage and logging procedures are being tightened, and that expert review and a technical backup are being considered.
In the concrete case of the outage on 20 September 2012, it was regrettably neglected to immediately inform the users of the wiretap system that an outage had occurred.
In het concrete geval van de storing op 20 september 2012 is helaas verzuimd om direct de gebruikers van het tapsysteem op de hoogte te stellen van het feit dat zich een storing had voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de financiële ondersteuning van verboden wietclubs door de gemeente Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he would hold the municipality of Utrecht to account for paying setup costs and legal advice for two cannabis clubs whose cultivation experiment was not permitted under the Opium Act. The minister answered that no violation of the Opium Act appears to have occurred, that a foundation's exemption request is pending, and that municipal spending is a matter for Utrecht's own council and executive.
Furthermore, the spending of municipal funds is a matter for the municipal executive and council of Utrecht.
Verder is de besteding van gemeentemiddelen een zaak voor het gemeentebestuur en de gemeenteraad van Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Pia Dijkstra over politie-inzet bij voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Dijkstra (D66) asked whether the 281,552 police hours spent on football matches in 2012–2013 were high compared with other events, whether this fits local priorities, and what preventive measures would reduce it. Minister Opstelten answered that football-related police deployment has fallen by 5% year-on-year and 15% over three seasons, that local authorities decide the balance of police deployment, and that cooperation with clubs and the KNVB is the preventive route.
That weighing is made at local level by the local authority, which has control over police deployment.
Die afweging wordt op lokaal niveau gemaakt door het lokaal gezag, dat zeggenschap heeft over de inzet van politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over misstanden in franchiseland en de mogelijke aanpassing van de franchiseovereenkomst

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether franchise abuses are increasing, whether the franchise agreement should be made a named contract in the Civil Code, and whether franchisees can get legal aid for business disputes. The minister denied clear signs of a sharp rise, said no new research is planned, did not prioritise codifying franchise agreements, and explained that legal aid for business disputes is generally excluded with narrow exceptions.
At this moment I see no reason to commission new research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nieuw onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State over de rol van KNSA

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the consequences of a Council of State ruling that the mandatory KNSA membership requirement for shooting clubs and individual firearm leave violates Article 11 ECHR. The Minister confirmed the ruling affects KNSA's de facto central role and said he is examining what regulatory changes are needed quickly.
Currently I am examining which amendment of the regulations is needed to bring the granting of firearm leave in line with the Council of State's ruling in the short term.
Momenteel bezie ik welke aanpassing van de regelgeving nodig is om de verlening van wapenverloven op korte termijn in overeenstemming te brengen met de uitspraak van de Raad van State.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Klaveren over een jihadistische ex-militair

Two MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers whether a former Dutch soldier who served in 2009-2010 is now fighting as a jihadist in Syria, whether others have done so, and whether participating in jihad should mean loss of Dutch nationality. The minister confirmed the report is likely accurate, said two other ex-soldiers are possibly fighting, and explained that nationality can be revoked only after a final conviction for a terrorist offence, only if the person holds another nationality, and only for offences committed after 1 October 2010.
For every person returning from Syria, it is examined whether criminal action is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de verplichte verklaring omtrent gedrag voor mensen die met kinderen werken

An MP asked the minister whether people can work in VOG-required jobs before their certificate is issued and what sanctions organisations face for doing so. The state secretary answered that some workers may start without a VOG, that the employer is responsible for checking, that inspectorates enforce the requirement with sanctions such as funding suspension, and that enforcement is for the supervisors.
It happens that people work (temporarily) without a VOG in a role or profession for which a VOG is required.
Het komt voor dat personen (tijdelijk) zonder VOG werkzaam zijn in een functie of beroep waarvoor een VOG verplicht is gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Recourt over malafide incassobureaus

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about allegedly fraudulent debt collection agencies, including over-charging of consumers and a possible fraud case, and whether a legal quality mark is needed. The State Secretary answered that the sector's voluntary membership suffices for now, that a dialogue with the sector and a letter on enforcement of the Wet incassokosten would follow before Christmas, that legal aid is available only where gedupeerden fall under the Wet op de rechtsbijstand, and that no specific government body supervises compliance, with the Autoriteit Consument en Markt possibly acting in some cases.
No government body is specifically charged with supervising compliance with this law.
Er is geen overheidsinstantie specifiek met het toezicht op de naleving van deze wet belast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat de douane meer designerdrugs en grondstoffen onderschept

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that customs intercepts more designer drugs and precursor chemicals, including how much APAAN was seized in 2011 and 2012 and whether it can be banned. The minister replied that 1,150 kg (2011) and 5,551 kg (2012) of APAAN were seized, that APAAN is not produced or exported from the Netherlands, and that it cannot be placed on the Opium Act list but will fall under chemical-precursor controls once EU regulations take effect.
We are waiting for the relevant EU Regulations to take effect.
Het wachten is op de inwerkingtreding van de betreffende EU Verordeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over angst bij de Rabobank om gegevens te delen met het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum

An MP asked the Minister whether fear of Wob disclosure is deterring banks such as Rabobank from sharing cyber incident information with the NCSC, and whether a test case should be facilitated. The Minister acknowledged the signals, said information sharing already occurs, promised a letter before year-end clarifying how Wob exceptions apply to NCSC-shared information, and saw no need for a test case or an alternative legal structure.
With the aforementioned letter to your House I will provide clarity on how the Wob exception grounds, including those in article 10(1)(b) and (c), will be applied to information shared with the NCSC.

Met bovengenoemde brief aan uw Kamer zal ik duidelijkheid verschaffen over de toepassing die inzake de met het NCSC gedeelde informatie aan bepaalde uitzonderingsgronden in de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur, waaronder die in artikel 10, eerste lid, onder b en c, zal worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Onderzoek nepaccount VU-studente loopt dood in Amerika’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the stalled investigation into a fake Twitter account impersonating a VU student, which US authorities declined to act on for lack of dual criminality. The minister explained the mutual legal assistance request, US provider policies, and that the amended Dijkhoff proposal on identity misuse may enable future prosecution.
To be able to act under criminal law, it was necessary to identify the person behind the Twitter account used in the name of the person concerned.
Om strafrechtelijk te kunnen optreden was het nodig de identiteit achter het op naam van betrokkene gebruikte Twitteraccount te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether Dutch law can reach directors of foreign legal entities in cases of pauline acts or bankruptcy fraud, whether the cross-border director-liability rules and the civil director ban are effective, and what was done after a 2011 Supreme Court ruling. The minister answered that cross-border cases are inherently complex, that the Netherlands raised the issue in the EU insolvency regulation review, that foreign director liability is governed by the law of the company's home state, and that the director-ban bill is still pending at the Council of State.
Precisely because of the inherent cross-border aspects, we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level.
Juist vanwege de inherente grensoverschrijdende aspecten achten wij het overigens van belang om over dit vraagstuk op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over de bevoegdheden van burgemeesters voor het opleggen van maatregelen aan (ex-)justitiabelen

VVD MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a court annulment of a mayor's area ban on an ex-offender undermines mayors' exclusive powers, whether mayors have enough expertise under Article 172 of the Municipalities Act, and whether an advisory role for mayors is desirable. Minister Opstelten answered that the court's independent review is legitimate, that a formal advisory function is not desirable, and that a knowledge platform (handelingskader BIJ) has been launched to support mayors.
I do not share the view that a mayor can hardly exercise his independent power when a judge delivers his independent judgment on it.
Ik deel niet de mening dat een burgemeester nauwelijks zijn zelfstandige bevoegdheid kan uitoefenen wanneer een rechter zijn onafhankelijke oordeel daarover velt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Veldhoven over de inzet van het alcoholslot

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Van Veldhoven asked about the high number of drivers refusing the alcohol lock programme (ASP), its relation to criminal sentencing, cost hardship, the CBR's automatic imposition without regard to personal circumstances, and measurement errors. The minister answered that refusal reasons are varied, the administrative and criminal tracks run largely separately, the CBR cannot consider personal circumstances while administrative judges can (rarely do), and that the lock is calibrated to near-zero error though it cannot distinguish mouth from blood alcohol; an interim report is promised alongside the letter.
The administrative judge does have room to take the offender's situation into account.
De bestuursrechter heeft wel ruimte om rekening te houden met de situatie van de overtreder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over berichten over matchfixing in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about media reports of match-fixing in Dutch professional football, including whether Dutch authorities took German signals seriously and whether crimes could still be proven. The minister declined to say whether the prosecutor investigated the specific cases, citing investigative and privacy interests, rejected the claim that Dutch authorities were slow, and rejected the claim that Dutch matches were proven fixed.
As I have previously indicated to your House, the public prosecution service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating any particular matter.
Antwoord 2 Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven richting uw Kamer 2 kan het openbaar ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Moslimextremist bedreigt Elsevier-blogger Afshin Ellian’

An MP asked the ministers whether a call by a blogger against columnist Afshin Ellian constitutes a threat, whether Ellian filed a complaint, whether the university should act, and whether existing tools to counter such threats suffice. The government answered that the courts decide what counts as a threat, that no complaint had been filed, that police protective measures were taken, and that existing criminal and administrative instruments are sufficient, so the proposed national security bill is not needed.

I have concluded that the Public Prosecution Service has sufficient legal instruments to act criminally, together with the police and in coordination with the AIVD, where possible, against threats and calls to violence.

Ik ben tot het oordeel gekomen dat het OM over voldoende wettelijk instrumentarium beschikt om samen met de politie en in afstemming met de AIVD, daar waar mogelijk, strafrechtelijk op te treden tegen bedreigingen en oproepen tot geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over drankrijders die toch hun rijbewijs mochten behouden

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked whether some police regions failed for years to report drunk and asocial drivers to the CBR, endangering road safety. The minister denies police negligence, attributes the rise in reports in 2012 to improved automation and information, and says no structural problems remain.
In my view there has been no negligence on the part of the police.
Er is naar mijn mening geen sprake geweest van verzuim door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over de notarisservice van de HEMA

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether HEMA's online notary service, which lets consumers draft cohabitation contracts and wills before a notary signs, risks inadequate advice and capacity checks. The state secretary saw no reason for measures, leaving the matter to the notarial profession and its professional body, which is reviewing it.
I consider it first and foremost up to the professionals themselves, and the public-law professional body, to set the professional standard.
Ik vind het in eerste instantie iets van de beroepsgenoten zelf – en van de publiekrechtelijke beroepsorganisatie – om de professionele standaard te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Nederland blind is voor matchfixing

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands is blind to matchfixing, whether there were signals of foul play in the Netherlands-Hungary World Cup qualifier, whether that match was monitored, and when the ongoing judicial preliminary investigation would conclude. The minister referred to earlier answers for the first questions and said the public prosecutor's preliminary inquiry into football fraud has no fixed end date.
The public prosecution service has informed me that examining signals within the preliminary investigation is not linked to an end date.
Het OM heeft mij meegedeeld dat het bekijken van signalen in het kader van het voorbereidend onderzoek niet is gekoppeld aan een einddatum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over berichten dat Nederland blind zou zijn voor matchfixing

An MP asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about press reports that the Netherlands is blind to match-fixing, including whether a criminal investigation is underway and whether there were signals of fixing in a World Cup qualifier. The minister declined to say whether the prosecution service is investigating specific reports, while stating the research found match-fixing exists in the Netherlands but no large-scale manipulation, and that the prosecution service's preliminary inquiry is ongoing.
As I have previously indicated to your House, the public prosecution service (OM) cannot make statements about whether or not it is investigating particular matters.
Antwoord 2 Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven richting uw Kamer 2 kan het openbaar ministerie (OM) geen mededelingen doen over waar het wel of geen onderzoek naar doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over banen en opleidingen voor jihadisten

Two MPs asked whether returning jihadists are being helped with jobs, training and neighbourhood activities instead of being prosecuted, and what measures will stop this. The minister answered that each returnee gets a threat assessment, criminal prosecution is examined case by case, a local tailored approach may be used to reduce threat, and the prosecution service is examining criminal investigation options for returnees.
For every person returning from Syria a threat assessment is made and it is examined whether criminal prosecution is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt een dreigingsinschatting gemaakt en wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat geadviseerd wordt overvallers ruim baan te geven

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police advice to let home robbers take their loot and stay passive, from a study funded by the Commissie Politie & Wetenschap, was damaging and made citizens easy targets. The minister defended the RAAK principle as protecting victim safety and improving solving rates, and said the study was funded by an independent commission at a subsidy level of 1.815 million euro.
A victim of a home robbery may always defend himself and his belongings.
Een slachtoffer van een woningoverval mag zichzelf en zijn spullen altijd verdedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de voortdurende onduidelijkheid over de snelheidslimieten op de snelwegen

MP Bashir asked the ministers about persistent confusion among motorists over speed limits on Dutch motorways, including unclear signage, varying speeds, and navigation data. Minister Schultz van Haegen-Maas Geesteranus answered that Rijkswaterstaat is pursuing harmonised speeds, reviewing signage, improving navigation data and communication, but gave no firm new commitments beyond ongoing work.
Rijkswaterstaat is currently working on a proposal to adapt roadside signage so that it meets the road user's wish to be informed more frequently about the maximum speed.

Rijkswaterstaat werkt momenteel een voorstel uit om de bebording langs de weg zodanig aan te passen dat deze voldoet aan de wens van de weggebruiker om frequenter geïnformeerd te worden over de maximumsnelheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about three Council of State rulings on imposing the alcohol-interlock programme on truck drivers, the status of the exploration of interlocks in lorries, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister confirms the rulings were noted, says the exploration is completed, and promises to inform the Chamber before the 30 January 2014 committee meeting.
I intend to inform you as soon as possible, and at the latest before the scheduled committee meeting of 30 January 2014.
Ik ben voornemens u zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren, doch uiterlijk voor het geplande AO van 30 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Recourt over het bericht “Via virtueel Filipijns meisje 1000 kindermisbruikers getraceerd”

MPs Rebel and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Terre des Hommes data on Dutch people linked to child abuse, traced via a virtual Filipino girl, can be used as evidence, whether virtual minors are protected under Dutch law, and whether police can use decoys. The Minister answered that Europol will analyse the data and pass Dutch cases to police, that virtual minors are not covered by the corruption offence but virtual child pornography is, and that a law change and a Groningen review of the sex offences title are underway.
With the law of 29 November 2009, implementing the Lanzarote Convention, the so-called corruption of minors was made punishable (article 248d Sr).
Met de wet van 29 november 2009 is, ter uitvoering van het Verdrag van Lanzarote, het zogenaamde corrumperen van minderjarigen strafbaar gesteld (artikel 248d Sr).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over het opleggen van maatregelen aan (ex-)justitiabelen

Two MPs (Van der Steur and Dijkhoff, VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how to read a court ruling that municipalities cannot impose additional measures on ex-offenders, and whether mayors have sufficient powers over ex-offenders. The minister replied that such measures belong to the criminal judge, that mayors keep powers under public order law, and that no statutory expansion of their role is needed, though a supervision bill is forthcoming.
That does not alter the fact that the mayor has his own responsibility for maintaining public order and safety.
Dit neemt niet weg dat de burgemeester een eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft als het gaat om de handhaving van de openbare orde en veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanpak van horizontale fraude en het collectief verhalen van schade

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government accepts that victims of horizontal fraud are left unassisted and whether collective civil claims should be broadened, and whether the state should fund legal costs. The minister replied that victims receive support via the Fraudehelpdesk, asset recovery, new conservatory seizure and voorschotregeling, that enforcement is not prioritised toward vertical fraud, that art. 3:305a BW is being amended to allow collective damages claims, and that funding legal costs through the Wrb is rejected.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de mogelijkheid van legalisatie van cannabis

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the possibility of legalising cannabis, including the tension between banning cannabis purchase by coffeeshops while tolerating their sales, and the Uruguayan legalisation model. The minister acknowledged the tension in the tolerance policy, said he would report on foreign developments including Uruguay, and stated that drug policy should balance public health with the fight against nuisance and crime.
I will fulfil this commitment shortly and can confirm that, given recent developments, I will also address the situation in Uruguay.
Ik zal op korte termijn deze toezegging gestand doen en kan bevestigen dat ik hierbij, gezien de recente ontwikkelingen, ook zal ingegaan op de situatie in Uruguay.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de brandveiligheid van windmolens in Nederland

An MP from the Labour party asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the fire safety of wind turbines in the Netherlands and whether training, permitting and sector measures should change. The minister replied that Inspectie SZW, the forensic institute, police and the Rotterdam fire service are investigating, that improvements will be considered after those findings, and that the findings will be sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat grote gemeenten de wietteelt willen reguleren

An MP asked the Justice minister whether a large majority of big municipalities supporting regulated cannabis cultivation would change policy, and which municipalities have concrete plans. The minister says an inventory will be sent before 1 January 2014, that meetings with coffeeshop-municipality mayors were held, and that regulated cultivation is rejected as it is in conflict with international treaties and the Opiumwet.
I have committed to sending your House an inventory of municipal plans and intentions regarding cannabis cultivation before 1 January 2014.
Ik heb toegezegd uw Kamer voor 1 januari 2014 een inventarisatie te sturen van de gemeentelijke plannen en voornemens op het gebied van wietteelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het Dijkhoff over een apparaat dat een naderende politieauto, ambulance of brandweerwagen aankondigt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a device marketed as an early-warning system for approaching emergency vehicles that may be used to evade police, whether this is a traffic-safety claim, and whether it can be banned. The minister said he does not know who buys or sells the system, that it is less suitable for traffic safety since it cannot distinguish priority vehicles, and that he has received no police signals of misuse so would only explore a ban if such signals arise.
Should I receive such signals at a later point, I will then explore the possibilities and desirability of a ban.
Mocht ik dergelijke signalen op een later moment alsnog krijgen dan zal ik op dat moment de mogelijkheden en wenselijkheid van een verbod verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over trajectcontroles

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about average-speed (trajectory) checks, including boete counts on the Utrecht-Amsterdam route, revenue, and accident effects on the A2. The minister answered that the 2012 comparison cannot be made reliably, reported roughly 43.6 million euro in sanctions from May to August 2013, said revenue goes to the state treasury, and deferred the accident question until 2014 data is available.
The requested comparison cannot be made properly.
De gevraagde vergelijking is niet goed te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het tekort aan cyberspecialisten bij het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Public Prosecution Service lacks cybercrime specialists, what staffing was planned and realised for 2012-2014, and what measures would be taken. Minister Opstelten answered that existing specialist teams are sufficient, that no additional measures are planned, and that the High Tech Crime unit's results are not lagging its targets.
Since these staff also handle other types of crime to a greater or lesser extent, I cannot give concrete FTE numbers in this context.
Aangezien deze medewerkers zich naast cybercrime ook in meer of mindere mate bezighouden met de aanpak van andere soorten strafbare feiten, kan ik in dit verband geen concrete aantallen fte's noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about reports that a drink-driver escaped punishment through the alcohol-lock programme, the Judiciary's use of sentencing guidelines, technical reliability of alcohol locks, and whether the programme evaluation could be brought forward. The government said the judiciary, not the Council for the Judiciary, sets the guidelines, that no case data are kept, that technical faults are rare, and that the evaluation runs to end 2014 with the full period to 2022, and it did not meet the deadline for answering before the budget debate.
Unfortunately, this deadline was not met.
Deze termijn is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over berichten dat de politie een verkrachtingszaak een jaar laat liggen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police left a rape case untouched for a year, and whether mistakes by police and prosecutors should be recorded. The minister confirmed the reports, agreed that measuring is knowing in principle, but said registering errors is impractical and that 'error' is hard to define, so no registration is planned.
Beyond the considerable administrative burden this would impose on police and the Public Prosecution Service, the main obstacle is that the concept of 'error' cannot be defined unambiguously.
Naast de aanzienlijke administratieve last die dit voor politie en Openbaar Ministerie met zich mee zou brengen staat daaraan vooral in de weg dat het begrip «fout» niet eenduidig te definiëren is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar uitspraken over Volkel”

PVV MPs asked whether criminal investigation of former ministers Lubbers and Van Agt over their statements on nuclear weapons at Volkel is blocked by the government withholding information, and whether the state secrecy and official secrecy provisions have become empty. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the Public Prosecution Service cannot assess a state secret breach without government statements, NATO agreements exclude discussing nuclear weapon numbers and locations, and the provisions are still used in practice.
Within NATO it has been agreed that agreements relating to the numbers and locations of nuclear weapons present on allied territory are not discussed.
In NAVO-verband is overeengekomen dat niet wordt ingegaan op afspraken die verband houden met aantallen en locaties van op bondgenootschappelijk grondgebied aanwezige kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de beveiliging van joodse instellingen

An MP asked the ministers whether they would act against the roughly 800,000 euro yearly security costs borne by Jewish institutions and about research on antisemitism among Muslim youth. The minister replied that security is risk-based and applied equally to all institutions, that no new measures are currently warranted, and that antisemitism is addressed as a priority and a Dutch study is planned.
For every citizen, cultural, religious or educational institution, security measures are taken in the same way on the basis of threat and risk.
Voor iedere burger, culturele, religieuze of onderwijsinstelling worden op gelijke wijze beveiligingsmaatregelen genomen op basis van dreiging en risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over een politie-inval naar aanleiding van een WhatsApp-bericht

MP Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police raided a home after a misread WhatsApp message, and how WhatsApp interception and its authorisation and accountability work. The minister confirmed awareness, said the police acted on an anonymous tip about a possible bomb, and explained that internet taps require prior authorisation by the investigating judge and are accounted for via official records and notification duties.
Recording of communications takes place solely on the order of the public prosecutor with prior authorisation from the investigating judge.
Het opnemen van communicatie gebeurt uitsluitend op bevel van de officier van justitie met een voorafgaande machtiging van de rechter-commissaris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de mogelijkheid anoniem aangifte te doen bij zedenmisdrijven

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Justice Minister how anonymous reporting of sexual offences such as grooming works, whether this would lower the threshold for reporting, and why the Public Prosecution Service first said anonymity was not possible. The minister answered that anonymous reporting is possible in some cases but must be weighed against the defendant's right to test statements, that the Openbaar Ministerie policy is set out in an updated handbook, and that the earlier unclear communication reflects the need for careful weighing.
However, a careful weighing will always have to be made between the protection of victims and witnesses on the one hand and the procedural interests of suspects on the other.
Er zal echter steeds een zorgvuldige afweging moeten worden gemaakt tussen de bescherming van slachtoffers en getuigen enerzijds en de procesbelangen van verdachten anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de bouw van een moskee in Groningen

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of plans for a new mosque in Groningen, how it is financed and by which foreign actors, and whether they will stop its construction given alleged antisemitic and misogynistic content. The minister answered that the mosque is financed by its own foundation and congregation, that the municipality contributes nothing, and that building new mosques is permitted under the constitution unless laws are broken, refusing to halt construction.
The construction of new mosques is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Dijkhoff over drugsmokkel op Schiphol

MPs Van der Steur and Dijkhoff asked whether employees arrested for drug smuggling at Schiphol held security-screened positions, whether screening is backlogged, and what measures are needed to prevent insiders from exploiting their positions. The minister answered that eight of fifteen arrested workers held screened positions, that there is no screening backlog, and that screening is one link in a broader security chain, with the overall safety of Schiphol judged good.
There is no backlog in carrying out security investigations.
Er is geen achterstand met betrekking tot het uitvoeren van veiligheidsonderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over jonge criminelen die zich tot zware criminelen ontwikkelen

An MP asks the Justice Minister about research showing youth gang members developing into serious criminals, whether the 89 gangs targeted by current policy show escalation, and what is being done about criminal role models and the 'Dalton effect'. The minister answers that the studied gangs are different from the 89, that the integrated multi-track approach is being strengthened, and that criminal proceeds are being confiscated.
The approach to criminal youth groups, both old and new, will continue unabated.
De aanpak van criminele jeugdgroepen, zowel oude als nieuwe, wordt onverminderd voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht ‘Geheime dienst wijst legerliefjes af’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Defence personnel may only have relationships with partners from countries with which the MIVD or AIVD cooperates, how security clearance criteria work, and whether the policy breaches the right to family life under article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that partners are checked in security investigations, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens found an objective justification for the policy, and that in September 2010 to December 2012 five clearances were withdrawn and 25 refused due to insufficient data from time abroad.
If the security investigation yields insufficient data on the (partner of the) (prospective) position-of-trust holder, an assessment is not possible.
Indien het veiligheidsonderzoek onvoldoende gegevens oplevert over de (partner van) de (aspirant)vertrouwensfunctionaris, is een beoordeling niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht ‘Polenprijsje voor niet handsfree bellen: 50 euro’

Two PVV MPs asked whether foreign truck drivers are favoured in traffic fines, citing a Polish driver fined 50 euros instead of 220 for phone use, and whether the government will stop this and re-sanction affected drivers. The minister answered that foreign drivers are not favoured, that the reduced amount was an exceptional prosecutorial decision given perishable cargo, that data on foreign fines is limited, and that a settled sanction cannot be increased.
Foreign drivers are not favoured when imposing traffic fines.
Buitenlandse chauffeurs worden niet bevoordeeld bij het opleggen van verkeersboetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een bezoek van klokkenluider Snowden aan de Tweede Kamer

An SP MP asked whether the government would enable a visit by whistleblower Snowden to the Tweede Kamer, and whether it would guarantee his safety from extradition. The minister answered that the Kamer may speak with Snowden without him travelling to the Netherlands, that his passport was revoked so he cannot enter, and that an extradition treaty with the US prevents ruling out extradition requests, so no assurance letter is appropriate.
The Kamer is of course free to speak with Mr Snowden.
Het staat de Kamer uiteraard vrij om met de heer Snowden te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de door het Openbaar Ministerie gepubliceerde dodenlijsten uit Afghanistan

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why no further investigation was carried out into Afghan death lists published by the Public Prosecution Service, whether Afghanistan was consulted before publication, whether the lists are original and complete, and why a partial list was published. The minister answered that the criminal investigation ended in 2012 with the suspect's death, that the Afghan foreign ministry had no objection to publication, that the prosecution holds only copies it is confident are authentic, and that it tried but failed to locate fuller lists.
The Public Prosecution Service does not have the original lists but only copies obtained through a witness from Germany.
Het Openbaar Ministerie beschikt niet over de originele lijsten maar slechts over kopieën die via een getuige uit Duitsland zijn verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Dijkhoff over de aanslag van Al Shabaab in Nairobi

Two VVD MPs asked why Al Shabaab is not on the Dutch, EU and UN terrorist lists, whether it should be listed, and about Dutch jihadists and the progress of motions on citizenship revocation and travel visas. The minister replied that Al Shabaab is covered by UN and EU Somalia sanctions (asset freeze, travel bans, arms embargo) but not by the terrorism lists, that no dossier suitable for EU listing exists, and that the Justice minister will inform parliament by letter on the motions.
The House will shortly be informed by the Minister of Security and Justice, by letter, about the commitments made and motions adopted.
De Kamer wordt binnenkort door de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie door middel van een brief geïnformeerd over de gedane toezeggingen en moties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht ‘Nederlander onder daders Nairobi’

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers whether a perpetrator of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national, how the AIVD missed him, whether Al-Shabaab should be put on the terror list, and whether he should be denaturalised. The government answered that it has no information showing any perpetrator is Dutch, that the AIVD annual report notes support activities for Al Shabaab in the Netherlands, and that denaturalisation is therefore not applicable.
The cabinet has no information showing that one of the perpetrators of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat een van de daders van de aanslag in Nairobi een Nederlander is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het Nederlands verzet tegen country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch government is opposing an EU-wide country-by-country reporting obligation for multinationals and whether its position remains consistent with earlier commitments. The government answered that it supports transparency initiatives through tax reporting in general, while stressing possible negative economic effects of public disclosure, the need for coordination with existing rules, and clear, well-assessed EU proposals.
The Netherlands will also in future take a position along the lines outlined above.
Nederland zal ook in de toekomst een positie langs de hiervoor geschetste lijnen innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Knops over een strakker regime van certificering van schietverenigingen

MPs Oskam and Knops asked whether the stricter certification regime for shooting clubs from 2015 is in place, and about the model self-declaration for new members, its privacy compliance, objections from clubs, whether board members can judge applicants, verification of answers, and whether shooting guilds are exempt. The minister confirmed the regime, said the KNSA model was tested under privacy law and discussed with the ministry, that boards are trained to assess risks, and that no exemption is planned since guilds were already consulted.
There is no certainty that the questions have been answered truthfully.
Er bestaat geen zekerheid of de vragen naar waarheid zijn ingevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over agenten met een trauma

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police officers with PTSD still do not receive adequate care, whether the ministry's stated policy is being followed by managers, and what will happen to 25 dossiers at the PTSD complaints point. The minister regretted the media reports, said care is provided regardless of whether the problem is work-related, noted the HRM and care structure is still being set up, and said 7 of the 25 dossiers have been transferred to the complaints point with the rest not yet transferred.
Of course I will keep you informed about the progress of the work and results in this important dossier.
Vanzelfsprekend zal ik u op de hoogte houden over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden en resultaten in dit belangrijke dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over een voorstel van de politiebond om niet te bezuinigen op de politie en het OM, maar om te investeren in de fraudeaanpak

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government would respond to a police union proposal to invest in fraud enforcement instead of cutting police and prosecution budgets, and whether it would collect fraud statistics like Britain. The minister answered that fraud is a top priority, a cross-departmental action plan will be presented by year-end without pre-empting its measures, and that reliable fraud-size estimates are very difficult, so statistics are not an end in themselves.
As I announced in my letter of 3 July, the cabinet will present an action plan before the end of this year.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 3 juli jl. heb aangekondigd, zal het kabinet voor het einde van dit jaar een actieplan presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Segers over de rechtsgronden voor bewapening

Segers (ChristenUnie) asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the legal basis for arming police volunteers with batons, pistols and stun weapons, and whether other government personnel lack a legal basis for weapons. The minister answers that volunteers may be armed on the chief's request and his permission, that the lapse has been fixed, and that a stun-weapon pilot is planned for 2014 without a decision on its start.
The request from the police chief to grant the long baton to volunteer police officers, after proven competence, has now been duly received and permission has been granted.
Het verzoek van de korpschef tot toekenning van de lange wapenstok aan vrijwillige politieambtenaren, na gebleken bekwaamheid, heb ik inmiddels in goede orde ontvangen en de toestemming is verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat slachtoffers van mensenhandel te weinig vergoed krijgen

An MP asked the minister about reports that victims of human trafficking receive too little compensation in criminal cases, and why few claims are filed or granted. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, cited procedural and emotional barriers, and committed to simplifying compensation procedures, a best-practice guide for judges, specialised trafficking courts, and a national referral mechanism.

I take the recommendations in the report to heart and will incorporate them into the already started improvement process on victim compensation and the national referral mechanism project for victims of human trafficking.

Ik neem de aanbevelingen uit het rapport ter harte en zal deze meenemen in het reeds gestarte verbetertraject rond compensatie van slachtoffers en het project nationaal verwijzingsmechanisme slachtoffers mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht dat in de Europese Unie honderdduizenden mensen leven als slaven

MP Rebel asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hundreds of thousands of people in the EU live as slaves, the reliability of trafficking estimates, whether open EU borders and EU citizens' access to prostitution work should be regulated, and whether a long-term awareness campaign will be run. The Minister answered that no reliable estimates of victims exist, that Eurostat's registered figures are the most reliable available, that regulation of prostitution and cooperation with Eastern European states and EMPACT are the chosen route, and that several awareness campaigns are already underway.
Reliable estimates of the number of victims of human trafficking do not exist.
Betrouwbare schattingen van het aantal slachtoffers van mensenhandel bestaan niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht “Haagse politie gebruikt buitensporig geweld tegen buitenlanders”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Hague police use excessive force against foreigners, whether there is intimidation and racism around De Heemstraat station, and whether an investigation and talks with Schilderswijk residents will follow. The minister replied that this is primarily a local matter for the mayor, that the mayor sees no indication of misconduct, that 2012 force data show 19 unlawful uses out of 663 incidents, and that he knows of no racist climate, while declining to order an investigation or host talks, deferring to the mayor.
This is primarily a matter for local authority.
Dit is primair een kwestie van het lokaal gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de jihad vlag op een Haags veld

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how to interpret a jihad flag displayed on a The Hague football pitch, what the danger of jihadist ideology is, and whether sharia exists in The Hague. The minister called the incident an expression of support for jihadist ideas, described jihadism as the core of the terrorist threat, and said there is no separate sharia-based legal system competing with the democratic legal order in The Hague.
There is no separate legal system in The Hague competing with the democratic legal order.
Er is in Den Haag geen sprake van een aparte, met de democratische rechtsorde concurrerend rechtssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat de politie op grote schaal misbruik maakt van internet- en telefoongegevens

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police misuse telecom and internet data via the CIOT system, including unlawful requests, shared access codes, repeated audit findings and the number of requests. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate's 2012 recommendations are being implemented on schedule, that the request volume reflects multiple queries per investigation, and that no services have been cut off from CIOT access so far.
I hereby inform you about the status of the various measures I have taken to give effect to these recommendations.
Bij deze informeer ik u over de stand van zaken van de verschillende maatregelen die ik heb getroffen om hieraan gestalte te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Brazilië gebruikersdata binnen de grenzen wil houden

Two SP MPs asked whether Brazil's plan to force foreign tech firms to store user data domestically would protect Dutch citizens' data, and whether Dutch law can bind foreign companies. The minister replied that US jurisdiction over Google means server location is not decisive, saw no reason to contact Brazil, and explained that the Wbp applies to firms with a Dutch establishment or that process data using Dutch-located means.
This follows from the fact that the United States claims very broad jurisdiction, which leads to extraterritorial effects.
Dit vloeit voort uit het feit dat de Verenigde Staten zichzelf een zeer ruime rechtsmacht aanmeten die tot extraterritoriale effecten leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van de productie van GHB en de verkoop van grondstoffen hiervoor

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers how to tackle GHB production and the sale of its precursor GBL, including scheduling GBL, a ban on high-purity GBL, a licensing system, and denaturation. The government answered that the CAM quick scan is not yet finished, that a ban would likely be ineffective, that voluntary reporting and warnings to online sellers are in place, and that EU-level measures lacked support.
We expect such a ban would not or hardly be effective, because GBL with less than 80% purity can also be used in producing GHB.
Wij verwachten dat een dergelijk verbod niet of nauwelijks effectief zal zijn, omdat ook GBL met minder dan 80% zuiverheid kan worden toegepast bij de productie van GHB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Raak over het boek ‘naar één nationale politie’

MPs Kooiman and Van Raak asked whether the minister knew of a book on the creation of the national police, whether it was commissioned, what the police contributed and whether every officer received a copy at what cost. The minister confirmed knowledge of the book, said it was an initiative of the publisher and author, described the police's contribution as interviews and photo material, and stated the book was given to all permanent staff at a total cost of EUR 415,000.
This book is an initiative and publication of publisher Kerckebosch and author Louis Cornelisse.
Dit boek is een initiatief en uitgave van Uitgeverij Kerckebosch en auteur Louis Cornelisse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en van Raak over de dreigende sluiting van de brandweerpost Diever

MPs Kooiman and Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the planned closure of the Diever fire station, its effects on response times, and whether the Drenthe safety region complies with the law and the Kooiman motion. The minister answered that responsibility lies with the municipality and then the safety region, that the regional coverage plan does not yet meet legal requirements, and that he has asked the region to fix it by end 2013.
I have asked the safety region to improve the coverage plan as quickly as possible so that it meets the legal requirements.
Ik heb de veiligheidsregio verzocht op zo kort mogelijke termijn het dekkingsplan zodanig te verbeteren dat het voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de Marokkaanse groepsmishandeling van een vrouw

MPs from the PVV asked about a reported group assault on a woman by Moroccan men, whether the perpetrators had been arrested, whether the government would acknowledge a 'Moroccan problem' and expel convicted offenders, and whether group liability should be extended. The minister replied that police found the woman admitted to fabricating the account, a false-report procedure was started, and that group participation in violence is already punishable under article 141 of the Criminal Code, referring to earlier answers for the rest.
Following this confession, the police drew up an official report against her for filing a false complaint.
Naar aanleiding van deze bekentenis heeft de politie proces-verbaal tegen haar opgemaakt wegens het doen van een valse aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Recourt over belastingontduiking door misdaadondernemers

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether criminals can evade tax by deregistering from the municipal population register (GBA), why conservatory assessments on emigration are limited, whether immediate settlement on emigration could replace them, and why a RIEC study on this fraud has not yielded an effective approach. The State Secretary answered that residence for tax purposes is assessed on all circumstances, that GBA deregistration alone does not end tax liability, that EU law makes immediate collection on emigration doubtful, and that an FIOD investigation into the phenomenon is underway with measures to follow depending on its outcome.
To gain further insight into the possible scale of this specific phenomenon, the FIOD is currently conducting an investigation.
Om nadere duiding over de mogelijke omvang van dit specifieke fenomeen te krijgen, voert de FIOD momenteel onderzoek uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de civiele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat der Nederlanden bij militaire uitzendingen

Three VVD MPs asked whether the Supreme Court's 6 September 2013 rulings on State civil liability for the Srebrenica deployment affect future military deployments, local staff, command structures, the Bakker commission framework, and whether such liability can be excluded. The government answered that the rulings rest on Srebrenica-specific facts, do not change current practice, command or the assessment framework, and that excluding liability is not possible.

In future military deployments other facts and circumstances will be at issue. It is therefore not possible to make statements in advance about the possible liability of the State in future deployments.

Bij toekomstige militaire uitzendingen zullen andere feiten en omstandigheden aan de orde zijn. Het is dan ook niet mogelijk op voorhand uitspraken te doen over de eventuele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat bij toekomstige uitzendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Aankoop EU voor niets”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reported spending on a building for a planned European Public Prosecutor's Office was wasteful given the office's uncertain status, and whether Netherlands should host so many international organisations in times of crisis. The Minister said no Rijksgebouwendienst purchase for the EPPO exists and referred to earlier answers on a Den Haag building, while defending the government's policy of attracting international organisations to the Netherlands.
The Rijksgebouwendienst has not purchased any location for a European Public Prosecutor's Office.
De Rijksgebouwendienst heeft geen locatie aangekocht ten behoeve van een Europees Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver inzake het bericht Dubieuze stellingnames en rekenfout in SEO-rapport over belastingparadijs Nederland

MP Klaver asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a Quotenet report criticising a SEO study on the Netherlands as a tax haven, covering supervision costs, prosecution of letterbox companies, trust office reporting, and the SEO dividend tax estimate. Minister Opstelten answered that supervision claims are unclear, costs of extra enforcement and prosecution are uncertain, DNB supervises trust offices and has taken enforcement measures, and the SEO revenue figures will be addressed in a separate government response.
Tightening the control of trust offices, by contrast, is a constant concern.
Aanscherping van de controle op trustkantoren daarentegen is voortdurend aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het bericht “Meer dan 3.500 postbusfirma's in Nederland overtreden de wet”

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether the government was aware that many postbox firms and foreign cooperatives fail to file annual accounts on time, and what sanctions and oversight are in place. The minister answers that enforcement is multilayered (Chamber of Commerce monitoring, creditor claims, criminal fines, Tax Authority investigation), that sanctions need no tightening, and that a central shareholder register is planned.
I therefore see no reason to tighten the sanctions.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de sancties aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Van Oosten over de aanbevelingen in de dissertatie van mr.dr. R.P. Wijne

Two VVD MPs asked the health and justice ministers about recommendations in a dissertation by R.P. Wijne on easing patients' civil claims for avoidable harm, including reversing the burden of proof and presuming consent violations. The minister replied that the pending Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg already offers a low-threshold compensation route and incident-disclosure duty, and that the government will first assess its effects before considering further changes to the patient's evidentiary position.

We first want to see what the effects of the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg bill are, before considering whether, and if so which, further improvement of the patient's evidentiary position is necessary.

Wij willen eerst bezien wat de effecten zijn van het wetsvoorstel Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, alvorens te beschouwen of – en zo ja welke – verdere verbetering van de bewijspositie van de patiënt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over heling van door Oost-Europese bendes gestolen goederen in Nederland

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch markets openly sell goods stolen by Eastern European gangs, and what the government will do about fencing and police capacity. The minister answered that the claims are not recognised locally, that existing oversight and prosecutions apply, and that a digital purchasers' register and integrated approach to mobile gangs are being rolled out.
The parties involved in Rotterdam indicate that they do not recognise the signals about the Afrikaanderplein in that form and extent.
De betrokken partijen in Rotterdam geven aan de signalen over het Afrikaanderplein niet in die vorm en mate te herkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het bericht dat e-Court voor rechtbank speelt

MP De Wit asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the unclear legal status of e-Court's rulings, whether party consent is adequately safeguarded, and how defendants are informed about arbitration and the appointment of arbiters. The Minister replied that he had written to e-Court asking for clear communication on the legal status of procedures, and explained the statutory consumer protections (one-month right to choose the ordinary court) and the court review available for arbitral awards.
In this letter e-Court is asked to be completely clear, both on its website and with clients, about what out-of-court dispute resolution by e-Court entails.

In deze brief wordt e-Court verzocht in de communicatie, zowel via de website van e-Court alsmede met cliënten volstrekte duidelijkheid te betrachten over wat buitengerechtelijke geschilbeslechting door e-Court inhoudt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de dood van een 19-jarig meisje

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a 19-year-old woman was killed despite a prior threat complaint lying in a police pile, and whether police capacity is too thin for serious cases. The minister regretted the death, described the prioritisation procedure, and said there is sufficient capacity and that improvements such as earlier case screening are underway.
Complaints of robbery with serious violence and grievous assault are always taken up by the police.
Aangiftes van overvallen met fors geweld en zware mishandelingen worden door de politie altijd opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Doodgestoken Zweedse deed aangifte van bedreiging’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Den Bosch failed to handle with due priority a report of threats filed in August 2013 by a Swedish student later killed, and whether police lacked capacity. The minister answered that the report was assessed and marked for pickup, that police in Den Bosch can handle such reports with priority, and that case screening and intervention improvements are being implemented.
Reports of threats must be taken up with priority and adequately.
Aangiftes van bedreiging dienen met prioriteit en adequaat opgepakt te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het bericht inzake een wetenschappelijk experiment met het telen van wiet in Utrecht

The MP Rebel asked the Ministers of Justice and Health about a Utrecht cannabis club and a proposed scientific cannabis-growing experiment, and whether an Opium Act exemption would shield the club from prosecution. The government answered that an application for an exemption from the Social Cannabis Club Domstad is pending, no experiment application has yet been filed, and that an exemption only removes prosecution for the covered conduct while the holder remains liable for conduct outside it.
An exemption means that the acts and conduct covered by the exemption are not prohibited under the Opium Act.
Een ontheffing strekt ertoe dat de handelingen en gedragingen waarop de ontheffing ziet niet verboden zijn op grond van de Opiumwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Oskam over het bericht dat het Bureau Medicinale Cannabis van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport wiet gaat leveren voor een Utrechts experiment met hasjver

MPs Bruins Slot and Oskam asked whether a Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychiatric patients could receive an Opium Act exemption and whether the government would block it. The government answered that no exemption application has been filed, so no cannabis will be supplied, and that the Public Prosecution Service would act against any unlicensed experiment.
No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment
Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over experimenten met cannabisverstrekking

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a proposed Utrecht experiment supplying cannabis to psychosis-vulnerable patients, including whether the Bureau Medicinale Cannabis should supply it and whether it is approved and tested against treaties. The State Secretary answered that no exemption request has been filed yet so questions on that experiment cannot be answered, that any request will be assessed against criteria consistent with international treaties, and that the Social Cannabis Club Domstad request is under review.

No application for an Opium Act exemption has yet been submitted for an experiment (of a treatment) supplying cannabis to patients with vulnerability to psychotic disorders and severe cannabis addiction.

Er is nog geen aanvraag voor een Opiumwetontheffing ingediend voor een experiment (van een behandeling) waarbij cannabis wordt verstrekt aan patiënten met een kwetsbaarheid voor psychotische stoornissen en een ernstige cannabisverslaving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het kopiëren van identiteitsbewijzen door telecombedrijven

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister whether telecom companies copy customers' identity documents when signing up, whether this breaches the CBP privacy guidelines, and whether the government will act. The minister answered that partly masked scans are standard practice to prevent fraud, that enforcement is for the independent privacy regulator CBP, and that the government will not itself pressure telecom providers.
It is not for me to call telecom providers to account for the way they implement privacy legislation.
Het is niet aan mij om de telecomaanbieders aan te spreken op de manier waarop uitvoering wordt gegeven aan de privacywetgeving.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over privacyschendingen door middel van de bonuskaart van Albert Heijn

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked whether Albert Heijn's loyalty card exposes customers' purchase histories to privacy risks, whether such data counts as personal data under the Wbp, and whether other retailers face similar risks. The state secretary answered that purchase data is personal only when traceable to a person, that the card number gives access only to purchase history without identifying details, that the first five digits are no longer printed on receipts, and that he lacks an overview of other retailers' safeguards, leaving the final legal judgement to the Data Protection Authority.

The final judgement on whether consumers' purchase data must be regarded as personal data and whether shops such as Albert Heijn must protect it accordingly rests with the College bescherming persoonsgegevens.

Het finale oordeel over de vraag of aankoopgegevens van consumenten als persoonsgegevens moeten worden beschouwd en of winkels als Albert Heijn deze dienovereenkomstig moeten beschermen is aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat financiële data-analyse nauwelijks terreur voorkomt

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice minister about a report that financial data analysis rarely prevents terrorism, covering SWIFT data, AML/CFT rules, bank costs, retention and possible suspension of the EU-US TFTP agreement. The minister partly agreed with the report, said results are hard to quantify and often confidential, gave no case counts or false-positive figures, and saw no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement or change the EU AML directive position.
Given the highly confidential nature of this type of matter, I cannot rule out that the results will also have to remain partly confidential.
Gezien de zeer vertrouwelijke aard van dit type zaken, kan ik overigens niet uitsluiten dat de resultaten eveneens deels vertrouwelijk zullen moeten blijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat onbestuurbare drones uit de lucht kunnen vallen bij regen of wind

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether Raven drones can fall from the sky in rain or wind and how many crashed, and who bears liability for damage. The Defence minister denied that nine Ravens crashed, described the Rijkerswoerdse Plassen emergency landing and other flights, and said the aircraft is not certified for icing or heavy rain, with operations stopped before limits are exceeded.
There is no question of nine Ravens having crashed.
Er is geen sprake van het neerstorten van negen Ravens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat de servers van de Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) mogelijk zijn afgetapt door de NSA

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked ministers whether the NSA tapped SWIFT servers, including any server in the Netherlands, and what the government would do about it, including the EU-US TFTP programme. The government said it cannot confirm the report, SWIFT found no evidence of unauthorised access, the Commission has asked US authorities for clarification, and it sees no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement for now.
However, I cannot confirm the accuracy of that report.
Ik kan de juistheid van dat bericht echter niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een mogelijke uitbreiding van de AMS-IX naar de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the ministers whether AMS-IX's planned US expansion risks exposing exchanged data to US surveillance laws (Patriot Act, FISA), whether it threatens data protection, and whether AMS-IX should be treated as vital infrastructure and advised on its structure. The government answered that US law applies to activities on US soil, that the EU-US expert group is discussing surveillance, that Dutch data-transfer rules apply, that AMS-IX is not classified as vital infrastructure but a review is underway, and that it will not advise the company on its structure.
Under this US legislation the provider can, after intervention by a US judge, be obliged to cooperate with requests from US authorities.
Op basis van deze Amerikaanse wetgeving kan de aanbieder, na tussenkomst van een Amerikaanse rechter, verplicht worden mee te werken aan verzoeken van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over het ondermijnen van bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether foreign-company directors of Dutch companies can escape joint liability under Dutch law, and whether EU legislation is needed to change this. The minister replied that liability depends on the foreign law of the company's seat, that the Netherlands will raise harmonisation in the Commission's consultation, and that the upcoming civil director-ban bill will address misuse of foreign legal entities.
Because we consider it important to exchange views on this issue at European level as well, we will raise this in the consultation the European Commission is currently holding.

Omdat wij het van belang achten om over dit vraagstuk ook op Europees niveau van gedachten te wisselen, zullen wij dit opbrengen in het kader van de consultatie die de Europese Commissie momenteel houdt
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bontes over het ontkennen van het Marokkanenprobleem door de politie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Assen tolerated serious disorder by Marokkaans youths in nightlife, whether the police spokesperson's denial of a 'Moroccan problem' is acceptable, and whether the police will take Moroccan street violence seriously. The minister answered that police were not present during the incident, that a report was taken and an investigation started afterward, and that local authorities determine police deployment and accountability, referring to earlier answers on crime figures.
Local authorities determine the deployment of police action.
Door het lokale gezag wordt de inzet van het politieoptreden bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Kooiman over uitbetaling van overuren bij de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether some police units had stopped paying overtime in cash from mid-2013, switching to time-off, and questioned the effects on workload, night-shift scheduling and uniform working conditions. The minister confirmed that units with exhausted overtime budgets now compensate in time-off, denied that workload or cost cutting was the motive, and stated that working conditions are uniform nationally.
The same working conditions apply to every police employee.
Voor iedere politiemedewerker gelden dezelfde arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat een hoge politiefunctionaris buiten functie is gesteld wegens het lekken van informatie

A PVV MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a senior police official was removed from office for leaking information, whether it is acceptable that he received top posts, and what will be done about leaking or corrupt police managers. The minister confirmed awareness, said a disciplinary investigation is ongoing and withheld further details for privacy and procedural reasons, and stated general commitment to integrity without concrete new measures.
In the context of the investigation and the importance of the privacy of the employees involved in this ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information.
