In het kader van het onderzoek en het belang van de privacy van de bij dit lopende onderzoek betrokken medewerkers, kan ik geen verdere informatie verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA) via telecomaanbieders het internationaal telefoonverkeer afluistert

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the government about reports that the US NSA was intercepting international telephone traffic via Belgian provider Belgacom, and whether Dutch telecom providers had been similarly breached or approached. The minister said there is no indication of a comparable breach in the Netherlands, that providers are responsible for their own security under the Telecommunicatiewet, that the government does not know whether foreign services approached Dutch providers, and that EU-US expert group work and the JBZ-Raad addressed the issue.
No public statements are made about contacts between the Dutch intelligence and security services and foreign services.
Over contacten tussen de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en buitenlandse diensten worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Bommel over wanbetalende diplomaten

MPs Kooiman and Van Bommel asked whether diplomats unpaid traffic fines can be compelled to pay, given Article 41 of the Vienna Convention, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replies that quarterly reminders and talks with embassies have largely worked, some embassies have agreed to pay, and other coercive measures like withholding plates or parking permits are ruled out by the Vienna Convention.
The Netherlands is bound by the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations and must therefore act within the limits of that convention.
Nederland is gehouden aan het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer en heeft daardoor te handelen binnen de grenzen van dit verdrag
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een angstcultuur bij de Nationale Politie

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an atmosphere of fear exists in the National Police, where officers who speak out about abuses are targeted, and how reporting of misconduct is safeguarded. The minister rejects the unions' picture, points to internal channels, the national reporting point and the Dutch whistleblower decree (Besluit melden vermoeden van misstand), and says the korps chief's reminder about sharing confidential material is endorsed; he commits only to talk with those raising signals.
I do not recognise the picture painted by the union chairs.
Ik herken het geschetste beeld van de voorzitters van de vakbonden niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over de vermeende angstcultuur binnen de Nationale Politie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether disciplinary investigations within the National Police have increased, whether police staff are told not to contact unions about problems, and whether the minister will consult unions and the chief constable about an alleged climate of fear. The minister answered that internal investigations in 2013 are within the range of recent years, that channels for reporting problems exist, and that signals of an unsafe workplace will be taken seriously and discussed with those raising them.

It is important to me that the police offers a safe environment for all employees. If there are signals that this is not the case, I take them seriously and will engage in discussion with those raising the signals.

Voor mij is belangrijk dat de politie een veilige omgeving biedt voor alle medewerkers. Als er signalen zijn dat dit niet het geval is, dan neem ik die serieus en ga ik in gesprek met de aandragers van die signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over angstcultuur bij de politie

MP Kooiman asked the minister whether he shares police union concerns about a culture of fear, disciplinary action and gagging of officers, and what he will do about it. The minister denies recognising that picture, points to internal complaint channels, the whistleblower procedure and union freedom, and says cultural change is being pursued through the new national police.
I do not recognise the picture painted by the union chairs.
Ik herken het geschetste beeld van de voorzitters van de vakbonden niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het artikel ‘Politiebonden: ‘Werkgever, ga aan de slag met een veilige werkplek’

An MP asks whether police staff are being told they may not raise workplace problems with unions or works councils, and whether misconduct can be raised through normal dialogue with the employer. The minister denies the picture, points to internal complaint channels, the Onderzoeksraad Integriteit Overheid and a whistleblower procedure, and says culture change is underway with an inspectorate monitor.
Employees are otherwise free to join a trade union and carry out the activities that belong to it.
Het staat medewerkers verder vrij om zich te verenigen in een vakbond en de activiteiten die daarbij horen te verrichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de brandweer zorgen heeft over de borging van brandveiligheid in het omgevingsrecht

An MP asks the government whether fire-safety responsibilities of municipalities and safety regions will be safeguarded under the planned Omgevingswet and private quality assurance in construction, given fire service concerns. The minister replies that municipal fire-service responsibility is unchanged, private quality assurance will keep the Bouwbesluit 2012 as the test framework, and further details will follow in a letter this autumn.

The Omgevingswet proposal, however, contains no such changes and does not alter the principle that the tasks and powers for the physical living environment that government must address lie primarily with the municipalities.

Het voorstel Omgevingswet bevat dergelijke wijzigingen echter niet en brengt geen wijzigingen aan in het beginsel dat de taken en bevoegdheden voor de fysieke leefomgeving die de overheid moet behartigen in de eerste plaats bij de gemeenten liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de Big Brother Awards

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the Big Brother Awards, including the Tax Authority's expert prize and the Justice Minister's public prize for privacy-infringing policy. The minister answered that no jury report exists, defended the Tax Authority's use of police camera data and bulk requests to parking authorities as proportionate, rejected the suggestion that he ignores privacy, and promised a general letter on privacy and security later that autumn.
The State Secretary for Security and Justice and I will send your House a more general letter on the balance between privacy and security later this autumn.
De staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en ik zullen uw Kamer nog dit najaar een meer algemene brief sturen over de balans tussen privacy en veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rebel en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

MPs Rebel and Fokke asked the minister of Security and Justice about enforcing the residency criterion for coffeeshops in Maastricht, including whether the mayor may waive it in daily enforcement. The minister replied that the criterion is part of the national Opium Act guideline, that the local triangle sets enforcement priorities but cannot differentiate buyers by residency, and that he sent the mayor a letter of 30 August 2013.

As I indicated in my letter to the mayor of Maastricht of 30 August 2013, differentiation within the municipality regarding sales to residents, non-residents or certain non-residents does not fit the national framework and the objectives of the coffeeshop policy.

Zoals ik in mijn brief aan de burgemeester van Maastricht van 30 augustus 2013 heb aangegeven past differentiatie binnen de gemeente met betrekking tot de verkoop aan ingezetenen, niet-ingezetenen of bepaalde niet-ingezetenen niet in het landelijk kader en de doelstellingen van het coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen over het aantal dodelijke slachtoffers als gevolg van vervuilde xtc pillen

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen asked about deaths linked to contaminated ecstasy, the number of drug-related deaths over 20 years, and whether on-site drug testing at festivals should be reinstated. The government answered that cause of death is uncertain, that a full testing system is impossible and on-site testing gives false security, and that it sees no reason to revise drug policy, though it asked Trimbos to address the issue with professionals.
I see no reason to reconsider the current drug policy.
Ik zie geen reden het huidige drugsbeleid te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de politieverklikker

An SP MP asks the Justice and Security minister how he reacts to reports that criminals use the Target Blu Eye alert device to evade police, whether it is legally sold, whether it is easily converted for misuse, whether sale should be made punishable, and whether the Flister system is a better alternative, with its results. The state secretary only sends a holding notice saying the answers cannot be given within the usual period because information is still outstanding.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Kooiman (SP) to the Minister of Security and Justice about the police informer (submitted 16 September 2013) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) van uw Kamer aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de politieverklikker (ingezonden 16 september 2013) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Fokke over jurisprudentie ten aanzien van de handhaving van het ingezetenencriterium voor coffeeshops

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about case law on enforcing the residency criterion for coffeeshops, following a Maastricht ruling declaring the prosecution inadmissible. The minister summarised criminal, civil and administrative rulings (mostly upholding the criterion, with some appeals pending) and said the case law is consistent enough that no legislation is needed.
Case law so far shows that the residency criterion passes scrutiny before the criminal, civil and administrative courts alike.
Uit de jurisprudentie tot nu toe blijkt dat het ingezetenencriterium zowel bij de strafrechter als de civiele rechter als de bestuursrechter de toets der kritiek doorstaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Berndsen-Jansen over duizenden onterechte boetes op de A13

MPs Oskam and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of thousands of wrongly issued speeding fines on the A13 after a missing speed sign near hectometre post 11.0. The minister replied that the speed limit is sufficiently clear, that no investigation or refunds are needed, and that Rijkswaterstaat checks reported signage problems.
There is indeed no sign in the central reservation.
Er staat inderdaad geen bord in de middenberm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de oververtegenwoordiging van Nederland bij de hosting van pornosites

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Netherlands hosts a disproportionate share of the world's pornographic websites and what measures will be taken, including stricter age verification. The minister answered that hosting of legal adult content is a consequence of the country's digital infrastructure, that the government will act only on criminal content such as child pornography, and that age verification cannot be mandated for legal content.
I also do not believe that the Netherlands contributes to keeping inhumane conditions alive.
Ik ben ook niet van mening dat Nederland meewerkt aan het in leven houden van mensonwaardige omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat webwinkeliers zich verplichten om klantinformatie door te geven aan stichting BREIN

MP Oosenbrug asked whether webshops joining the eBoekhuis distribution platform can be forced to pass customer data to Stichting BREIN, how that fits privacy law, the legality of e-book resale, and whether the market is free given the Centraal Boekhuis position. The state secretary answered that consent under the Wbp is the main basis for such data sharing, that retention and cooperation are matters for businesses and the ACM, that resale of e-books is for the courts and the CJEU to settle, and that the NMa/ACM monitors non-discriminatory access to the platform.
Giving an authoritative interpretation on this is reserved for the judiciary and ultimately the Court of Justice of the European Union.
Het geven van een authentieke interpretatie dienaangaande is aan de rechtsprekende macht en daarbij uiteindelijk het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie voorbehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het weren van diplomaten die hun boetes niet betalen

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch policy allows withdrawal of agrément from diplomats who repeatedly commit traffic offences and do not pay fines, and why the agrément procedure is not more publicly visible. The minister answered that agrément is never withdrawn, that persona non grata is a last-resort instrument with risk to bilateral relations, and that the ministry sends quarterly letters to embassies about unpaid fines.
Agrément is granted but not withdrawn.
Agrément wordt verleend maar niet ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de artikelen ‘de grote voetbalroof’ en ‘onderzoek gewenst naar mensenhandel’

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about press reports on investment funds in football, UEFA's Financial Fair Play, possible match-fixing and human trafficking, and whether an investigation or a ban on such funds should follow. The minister answered that there is no evidence of coercion in these cases, that the sector's own rules (KNVB and UEFA) cover independence, and that no investigation or ban is planned, while a pending prosecution inquiry prevents disclosure on match-fixing.

Because of the possible investigative interest – the preliminary inquiry could lead to a criminal investigation, which is not served by premature disclosure of research data – I cannot make substantive statements on this at this time.

Vanwege het mogelijke opsporingsbelang – het voorbereidend onderzoek kan immers leiden tot een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat niet gediend is bij voortijdige openbaarmaking van onderzoeksgegevens – kan ik daarover op dit moment geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vernieling van proefvelden met aardappelen in Valthermond en de gemeente Eemsmond

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and justice minister about vandalised potato trial fields of Wageningen University in Valthermond and Eemsmond, including effects on blight-resistance research, prevention, penalties and recovery of damage, and group involvement and prosecution statistics. The government condemned the vandalism, said the research has not been significantly delayed, described cameras and resilience measures, outlined the maximum penalty and civil recovery routes, and stated that perpetrators have not been identified and protest groups are not registered.
Despite police efforts on this case, because the vandals acted extremely covertly, it has so far not been possible to trace those responsible for these incidents.
Ondanks de inzet van de politie op dit dossier is het vanwege het uiterst heimelijke optreden door de vernielers vooralsnog niet gelukt in verband met deze gevallen verantwoordelijken op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over recidive na educatieve verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen

An MP asked the ministers whether a quarter of motorists who must follow a traffic behaviour course re-offend within two years, and what recidivism rate is acceptable, and asked about the WODC evaluation, the longer-term recidivism and other offence types. The minister states the government aims for the lowest possible recidivism, notes the WODC figures (about 13% and 14% same-type reoffending, nearly 25% combined), says the EMG has been revised, and that longer-term data will come in 2016 and 2021 with ongoing optimisation of the measures.
I strive for recidivism percentages that are as low as possible.
Ik streef naar zo laag mogelijke recidivepercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de uitkomst van de consultaties over de 15% THC-norm voor cannabis

MP Van Tongeren asked the ministers why the consultation results on the 15% THC norm for cannabis were not sent with the impact analysis, and asked what weight was given to the arguments. The minister replied that the consultation advice was internal, now sent to the Chamber as an annex with formal reactions (municipal advice summarized), and that the Garretsen recommendation prompted the impact analysis, while article 3b(2) Opiumwet is not directly linked.
Nevertheless I am happy to comply with your request to send these to your House afterwards, as an annex to these answers.
Ik voldoe evenwel graag aan uw verzoek om deze alsnog aan uw Kamer te verzenden, als bijlage bij deze antwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht “13 duizend euro voor cursus ‘Digitaal leiderschap’”

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked whether a 13,000-euro social media course for civil servants, taught partly by a member of the 'Project X Haren' commission, is a fitting follow-up to that commission's recommendations and how the government will build social media skills without relying on this course. The minister answered that the commission has finished and its knowledge may be spread further, that civil servants are not obliged to take such a course, and that social media training is part of the regular education offer.
It is up to the government and the civil servants concerned themselves to decide which courses should be followed and by whom.
Het is aan de overheid en betrokken ambtenaren zelf om de afweging te maken welke cursussen gevolgd (dienen) te worden en door wie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en De Wit over de megaschikking met een oliehandelaar en het afkopen van strafvervolging

MPs Gesthuizen and De Wit asked the Justice Minister about the settlement with oil trader John Deuss's bank, FCIB, under which pending criminal proceedings and appeal were withdrawn in exchange for 34.5 million euros in confiscation and a 500,000 euro transaction. The minister defended the settlement as proportionate given the verdicts already reached, the limited prospects of a higher outcome due to imminent statute of limitations, and said the transaction was approved on 21 June 2013 after review limited to reasonableness.
My review is limited to that assessment.
Mijn toetsing beperkt zich tot die beoordeling.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bontes over de politiechef van de regionale eenheid Amsterdam, die niet Roemeense zakkenrollers, maar smartphones het probleem vindt

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam police chief was wrong to blame smartphone theft rather than Romanian pickpockets for the thefts during Gay Pride, and what will be done about Romanian criminals and labour migration. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to phone-blocking measures with providers, pickpocket teams, EU information sharing, possible unwelcome declarations by the IND, and says EU labour market restrictions on Romania and Bulgaria end on 1 January 2014 while the Social Affairs minister tackles abuse.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over 30 km zones

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether speed enforcement in 30 km zones is deprioritised by the police due to capacity shortages, and whether municipal enforcement officers (BOA's) should be empowered to enforce speed limits there. The minister replied that local authorities set enforcement priorities, that 30 km zones should be self-enforcing through road design, and that extending BOA powers to traffic enforcement is not desirable given lack of support from the VNG, police and prosecution.
Extending the powers of municipal BOA's in the context of traffic enforcement is therefore not something I consider desirable.
Uitbreiding van de bevoegdheid van gemeentelijke boa's in het kader van de verkeershandhaving vind ik dan ook niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het bericht dat de politie ongeoorloofd stealth sms’jes naar mobiele telefoons stuurt om verdachten te kunnen volgen

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Justice about reports that police covertly send 'silent SMS' to track suspects without proper authorisation, and about court criticism of this method. The minister confirmed the method is used, defended its legality and said police and prosecutors will tighten procedures, but declined to disclose how often it is used or how often it contributed to convictions.
Police and the Public Prosecution Service have informed me that they will take these critical points to heart and tighten the procedure for the use of the silent SMS.
Politie en OM hebben mij laten weten deze kritische punten ter harte te nemen en de procedure voor de inzet van de stille sms te zullen aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het handelen van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg bij een arts met een alcoholprobleem

MP Van Gerven asks how the Inspectorate for Health Care handled reports about a solo GP with an alcohol problem, whether the doctor should continue practising, whether colleagues raised alarms, and how the Inspectorate treats reports of addiction among healthcare workers. The minister answers that the Inspectorate received two reports in 2012, found no patient-safety risk while the doctor was sober, has reopened an investigation after new complaints, and will develop norms and an enforcement framework for alcohol and drug misuse, including a power to suspend practitioners provisionally.
The Inspectorate's policy is always to act when a practitioner's conduct, as a result of alcohol or drug misuse, leads to demonstrable patient safety risks.
Het beleid van de IGZ is om altijd op te treden wanneer het handelen van een beroepsbeoefenaar als gevolg van drank- of drugsmisbruik tot aantoonbare patiëntonveiligheid leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het betalen van zorgverzekeringspremie voor Nederlandse gedetineerden in het buitenland

An MP asked why Dutch citizens detained abroad must keep paying health insurance premiums without access to care, and whether suspension was possible, noting debt risks and parents paying for detained children. The minister acknowledged the problem and said a proposed amendment to Article 24 of the Zvw allows suspension of rights and obligations on notification, so exemption from the nominal premium is not needed.
With the proposed amendment to Article 24 of the Zvw, the problem identified has in my view been adequately resolved.
Met het voorstel tot wijziging van artikel 24 van de Zvw is het gesignaleerde probleem naar mijn mening afdoende opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Berndsen-Jansen over de kosten van het softdrugsbeleid van de financiële effecten van het reguleren van softdrugs

MPs Koolmees and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about enforcement costs of soft drug policy, the Taskforce B5 results and costs, coffeeshop turnover and tax revenue, and the financial effects of regulating soft drugs. The government answered that enforcement capacity is not earmarked, the Taskforce B5 cost about 1.99 million euro, and that tax data on coffeeshops are not available per branch, while stating that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs.
Whereas the current cabinet is doing everything it can to turn the tide and tackle crime, nuisance and drug tourism hard.
Dit terwijl het huidige kabinet er juist alles aan doet om het tij te keren en criminaliteit, overlast en drugstoerisme hard aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het dumpen van hondjes

An MP asks the State Secretary whether dumping puppies in water (Voorburg, with a witness seeing the man walk away, and a nursing dog left at a supermarket) should lead to a ban on keeping animals, and what will be done to prevent such cases. The government declines to comment on the individual cases pending prosecution, but says dumping animals will be explicitly classed as animal cruelty in the draft Besluit houders van dieren, allowing a keeping ban of up to 10 years as a condition of a suspended sentence.
In general, abandoning an animal (dumping) will be explicitly classified as animal cruelty in the draft Besluit houders van dieren.
Ten algemene, wordt het zich ontdoen van een dier (dumpen) in het concept-Besluit houders van dieren expliciet aangemerkt als dierenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het overlijden van een verstandelijk beperkte vrouw

An SP MP asked the state secretary and the justice minister about the death of a woman with an intellectual disability, including the NOVO care institution's kort geding to block broadcast of security camera footage, whether the IGZ had seen the footage, whether the footage was part of the criminal investigation, and the delay in answering. The government answered that the court, not the minister, decides on such privacy objections and did not ban broadcast, that the IGZ had viewed the footage at the police station, that the footage was included in the criminal investigation, and that more time was needed to answer.
It is not for me, but for the judge, to assess whether such an objection – in this case based on privacy considerations – is well-founded or not.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter om te beoordelen of een dergelijk verzet – in deze kwestie ingegeven uit overwegingen van privacy – gegrond is of niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering bezwaar heeft aangetekend tegen de herintreding van Bolivia in het Enkelvoudig Verdrag inzake verdovende middelen uit 196

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands objected to Bolivia's re-accession to the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs with a reservation on traditional coca leaf chewing, and why it did not object to Bolivia's earlier amendment proposal. The minister confirmed the objection, said it concerns the procedure of withdrawal and re-accession with a reservation rather than coca use itself, and refused to withdraw it.
The objection lodged by the Dutch government was prompted by concerns about the integrity of the treaty and the proper application of treaty law in general.
Het door de Nederlandse regering aangetekende bezwaar is ingegeven door zorgen omtrent de integriteit van het verdrag en de juiste toepassing van het verdragenrecht in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de recordopbrengst aan boetes en onduidelijkheid rond 130 km/u-wegen

Two SP MPs asked why the ministry ran an information campaign after confusion about the 130 km/u limit on the A2, whether speeding fines show confusion, which road sections account for most tickets, and whether matrix signs should show limits. The minister said fines data cannot show the cause of speeding, that road signs are clear and flyers were distributed, that the CJIB has no data by road section, and that a Rijkswaterstaat user survey covering signage is due in September 2013 with fixed signs kept for permanent limits.
The CJIB has informed me that its registration system does not distinguish by road section.
Het CJIB heeft mij meegedeeld dat het in zijn registratiesysteem geen onderscheid maakt naar wegvakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Gesthuizen over de dreigende uitlevering van de heer K. aan Turkije

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the extradition of Mr K. to Turkey, given his serious health condition, was responsible, what medical-care guarantees Turkey had given, and whether the decision would be reconsidered. The minister replied that the extradition procedure was complete and approved, that he sees no reason to reconsider, that actual surrender will not proceed until he is satisfied the health consequences are not especially harsh, and that he has consulted the prison medical adviser and entered into consultation with Turkish authorities on the manner of surrender and care.

I can make no statements about the content of that advice, except that I saw reason to enter into consultation with the Turkish authorities about how any extradition will take place and about the care Turkey will then provide.

Ik kan over de inhoud daarvan geen mededelingen doen, behalve dat ik er aanleiding in heb gezien om in overleg te treden met de Turkse autoriteiten over de wijze waarop een eventuele uitlevering zal plaatsvinden en over de zorg die dan door Turkije zal worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Meenen en Berendsen inzake het profielwerkstuk “De Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag”

MPs from D66 asked the state secretaries of Education and Justice about young people's awareness of the Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and whether education could deter crime, citing a student survey. The government acknowledges the low awareness, notes that only 650 youth applications were refused in 2012 and that the lookback period for adolescents was shortened, and commits to an information newsletter, awareness work with the CSV, and further outreach.
We endorse the importance of tailored information for young people about the existence of the VOG and the consequences a refusal may have for future study, internship or employment.
Wij onderschrijven het belang van voorlichting op maat aan de jongeren over het bestaan van de VOG en de gevolgen die een weigering hiervan kan hebben voor een toekomstige studie, stage of baan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het bericht dat Justitie “superdrones” mag lenen van Defensie

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Justice Ministry may borrow Defence's new ScanEagle drones, and about privacy, airspace safety, incident history and transparency. The ministers answered that the ScanEagle may in principle be deployed in support of civil authorities once personnel are qualified, that existing legal frameworks suffice, and that they will not ban flights or publish evaluations, citing ongoing investigations.
It is not standard procedure for the police to conclude every deployment of a Defence Raven with an evaluation.
Het is niet een standaardprocedure voor de politie om iedere inzet van een Raven van Defensie met een evaluatie af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat online zoeken naar gezondheidsgerelateerde informatie privacyrisico’s met zich meebrengt

An SP MP asked the ministers about reports that online searches for health information, such as herpes, create privacy risks through tracking cookies and data leaks to third parties. The minister answered that Dutch law (Wbp, Telecommunicatiewet cookie rules) protects such data, that the CBP and ACM are investigating tracking cookies and can enforce, but gave no specific new action beyond pointing to existing supervision and public information.
The CBP cannot make further statements about these ongoing investigations.
Over deze lopende onderzoeken kan het CBP geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het laffe Marokkaanse geweld tegen twee zusjes

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about a violent incident against two sisters by Moroccan youths, the over-representation of Moroccan Dutch in violent crime statistics, the government's seriousness on the issue, and whether offenders should be prosecuted, denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that the SCP explains only part of the gap, that the approach targets risk behaviour without ethnic distinction, that local authorities handle public order, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Boer over de aanpak van illegale taxi’s en aanbieders van illegale taxidiensten op internet

Two MPs asked how the government tackles illegal taxi services offered online, including via Facebook, and how many such operators were contacted, warned or sanctioned. The state secretary agreed these services should be tackled, said the size of the illegal market cannot be measured, and described ILT warning letters (about 60 in 2013) and proceedings, but gave no figures on sanctions or seized cars.
Seizure of cars is generally carried out by the police. The number of cars of unlicensed drivers seized on the order of the Public Prosecutor is not separately registered.
In beslagname van auto’s gebeurt in de regel door de politie. Het aantal op last van de Officier van Justitie in beslag genomen auto’s van snorders wordt niet apart geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked about child abuse at a Tilburg Koran school, why the complaint did not lead to prosecution, how many complaints against Islamic institutions led to cases, and whether schools promoting hatred should be closed. The minister said the prosecutor found too few leads for further investigation, data cannot be split by institution type, and closure is possible only where needed for public order or building-safety violations.
The Public Prosecution Service assessed the complaint and concluded it offered too few leads for further criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft de aangifte beoordeeld en is tot de conclusie gekomen dat deze te weinig aanknopingspunten biedt voor een nader strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Nederland paradijs voor buitenlandse inbreker”

An MP from the PVV asks whether the Netherlands is attractive to foreign burglars because of low sentences, low detection and clearance rates, and a small chance of imprisonment, and asks about minimum sentences, stacking of sentences, deportation and border closure. The state secretary acknowledges concern about burglary and low clearance rates, rejects minimum sentences and says the government will review sentence stacking and German measures, while promising to raise detection rates and the integrated approach.
My ambitions for tackling home burglary are therefore considerable.
Mijn ambities voor de aanpak van woninginbraken zijn dan ook fors.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat ook in Nederland door justitie veel gegevens worden verzameld

Opposition MP Gesthuizen asked whether Dutch investigative services can freely query collected telecom and internet data without independent oversight, and whether foreign agencies can access it directly or bypass mutual legal assistance. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on the CIOT system, stated that queries (2.758.435 in 2012) are subject to judicial control and audits, and denied that foreign agencies have direct access, saying foreign requests always go through mutual legal assistance.

These documents describe the basis and working method of CIOT queries, the number of authorisations and the number of queries (2,758,435 queries in 2012), and the (judicial) control and supervision of the queries.

In deze stukken worden de grondslag en de werkwijze van CIOT-bevragingen beschreven, het aantal autorisaties en het aantal bevragingen (2.758.435 bevragingen in 2012) en de (rechterlijke) controle en het toezicht op de bevragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht 'Meer over schiettoets nieuw dienstwapen'

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report on the shooting test for the new service weapon, including whether officers surrender their old weapon at the start of the test and whether those who fail lose the right to use the old weapon. State Secretary Teeven confirmed officers hand in the old weapon, explained that failing officers keep the old weapon in storage at the force leadership's initiative, and said officers without a firearm are restricted to lighter means and must retake a test within a week.
The new weapon is issued if the employee has passed the test.
Het nieuwe wapen wordt meegegeven als de medewerker geslaagd is voor de toets.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het voorgestelde decryptiebevel en het terughackvoorstel

An SP MP asked whether the proposed decryption order and hacking-back proposal violate human rights and whether the Council for the Judiciary's advice warrants a legality study and prior judicial authorisation. The minister replied that a TILT study on the decryption order was already done and sent to parliament, that the Council's advice is taken on board (including the Chambaz case), and that the draft bill already provides prior review by an investigating judge.
The draft bill put to consultation provides for prior review of the proposed investigative powers by the investigating judge.
Het conceptwetsvoorstel dat in consultatie is gegeven voorziet in de voorafgaande toetsing van de voorgestelde opsporingsbevoegdheden door de rechter-commissaris.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren,  Bontes en Wilders over 'Ramadandiensten' bij de politie

PVV MPs asked whether police receive extra Ramadan shifts, whether Ramadan and Eid generate more reported nuisance and crime, whether police adapt to Islamic practice, and whether extra deployment could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary confirmed the news report, said police and prosecutors do not record Ramadan-related incidents, stated that the mayor decides deployment based on safety needs, and saw no reason to recover costs.
Neither the police nor the Public Prosecution Service records how many reports are related to Ramadan or the Eid festival.
Er wordt door de Politie of OM niet bijgehouden hoeveel meldingen gerelateerd zijn aan de Ramadan of het Suikerfeest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat dertien politiechefs meer verdienen dan de minister

Member Bontes (PVV) asked why thirteen police chiefs earn more than the minister and how the government would end this situation that conflicts with the agreed pay framework for police leadership. The state secretary said the figures are WOPT income totals not directly comparable to the minister's salary, acknowledged that five salaries do not fit the new framework, and explained that without legal means to lower them, the government can only appeal to voluntary waiver, which was refused, so existing terms must be respected for now under a transitional arrangement.
As stated in the letter of 3 July to your House, there are no legal means to directly reduce the incomes of the five persons mentioned.
Zoals per brief van 3 juli jl. aan uw Kamer is bericht zijn er geen juridische mogelijkheden om de inkomens van bovengenoemde vijf betrokkenen direct te verlagen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de moord op Mostafa Talaie

An MP asked about the murder of Mostafa Talaie, a convert from Islam to Christianity, and about threats against converts in and outside asylum centres. The state secretary confirmed awareness of the broadcast, said COA has taken measures for Christian asylum seekers and that reporting and complaint rates should be raised, and reported 18 recorded incidents in 2012 across thirteen centres.
The number of reports of violence and threats against Christian asylum seekers amounted to eighteen in 2012, spread over thirteen different asylum centres.
Het aantal meldingen van geweld en bedreiging tegen christelijke asielzoekers bedroeg in het jaar 2012 achttien, verspreid over dertien verschillende azc's.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over illegale doorverkoop van airsoftwapens

MP Kooiman (SP) asked whether airsoft replicas that resemble real firearms can be resold without registration or serial numbers, and how resale is controlled, and whether replicas of real guns sold online are a problem. State Secretary Teeven answered that resale to unauthorised persons is a crime, that the erkenninghouder keeps a dealer register for first sales, and that no measures are needed as long as the exemptions are respected.
I therefore consider the current obligations regarding the sale and resale of airsoft devices sufficient.
Ik acht de huidige verplichtingen rond de verkoop en doorverkoop van airsoft apparaten dan ook afdoende.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Wilders over de gezochte Syrië-ronselaar die opduikt in Shariawijk

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether complaints had been filed three times against a jihad recruiter seen in a The Hague neighbourhood, why he and possibly others were not arrested, and whether he could be denaturalised. The minister declined to comment on individual criminal cases, confirmed complaints had been filed and an investigation is ongoing, but no arrests have been made.
I make no statements about individual criminal cases, partly to avoid harming possible investigative interests.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele strafzaken, mede om te voorkomen dat eventuele opsporingsbelangen zouden kunnen worden geschaad.
Antwoord vragen Segers over het bericht ‘Prostituees uitgebuit vanuit woning’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of exploitation of prostitutes from private homes, including whether the rising abuses reflect a lack of national coordination, the share of victims under 21, and police capacity. The minister answered that serious abuses exist, that enforcement and reporting have increased, that a novella will remove registration and vetting duties while keeping a uniform licensing system and age limit of 21, and that enforcement capacity is substantial.
It is not possible to state the number of reports coming from clients, since reporters to Meld Misdaad Anoniem are logically not registered.
Het is niet mogelijk om het aantal meldingen dat van klanten afkomstig is te benoemen, aangezien de aangevers bij Meld Misdaad Anoniem logischerwijs niet worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen De Wit over het weigeren van uitleveringsverzoeken vanwege een te kort strafrestant

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands refuses transfer of Dutch prisoners from Venezuela and Panama when the remaining sentence is under six months, and proposed alternatives. The minister answered that a remaining sentence of at least four months is needed for resocialisation, rejected the proposed alternatives, but agreed to examine how to shorten processing times for these transfer requests.
I am, however, willing to examine how the processing time of Wots requests for Dutch detainees in Venezuela and also Panama can be shortened.
Ik ben daarentegen wel bereid om na te gaan hoe de behandelingsduur van Wots-verzoeken ten behoeve van Nederlandse gedetineerden in Venezuela en ook Panama kan worden verkort.
Antwoord vragen Helder over de invloed van de EU op strafrechtelijke regelgeving

The PVV MP Helder asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the ministry has studied the EU's influence on criminal law, whether the subsidiarity principle is being applied to EU legislation, whether implementing EU rules that change nothing in Dutch law is pointless, and whether he opposes a European Public Prosecutor beyond EU fraud. The minister answers that no such study was made since no need was seen, that subsidiarity checks are done via BNC-fiches and national parliaments have a role under the Lisbon Protocol, that unchanged rules need only notification, and that the Netherlands is critical of a European Public Prosecutor and will keep taking an active position.
No research as meant by the questioner has been carried out by my ministry.
Er is vanwege mijn ministerie geen onderzoek als door vragenstelster bedoeld gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Terugvorderen opbrengst belastingfraude moeilijk”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance and other ministers about reports that recovering proceeds of tax and benefit fraud is difficult, including fraud amounts and fines in a Deventer case, foreign childcare allowances, unregistered persons receiving allowances, Polish recipients, and EU residence and coordination rules. The government answered in detail, providing figures, explaining controls, and acknowledging some untraceable recipients and data limitations, while promising maatregelen to improve pre-payment checks and a later overview.
The correct amount cannot be given.
Het juiste bedrag is niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘2 miljoen Nederlanders slachtoffer identiteitsfraude’

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about reports that two million Dutch citizens had fallen victim to identity fraud, including difficulties victims face in reporting and resolving cases. Minister Plasterk answered that a cabinet vision and an identity monitor would follow by year-end, that the intake and handling of reports is being improved, and that victim satisfaction is reported at 85%.
That is why I committed in the committee meeting of 10 April to inform the House before the end of the year about a broad, coherent cabinet vision on tackling identity fraud

Daarom heb ik in het AO van 10 april j.l. de toezegging gedaan uw Kamer voor het eind van het jaar te berichten over een brede, samenhangende kabinetsvisie met betrekking tot de aanpak van identiteitsfraude
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt over verschillende berichten over het bestuur op Bonaire

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked about reports of strained relations between the Bonaire governor, executive councillors and the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, alleged loss of trust over integrity, the removal of the supervision directorate from the governor's portfolio, and officials under criminal investigation remaining in office. The minister answered that reports are not always accurate, that portfolio allocation is a political matter for the college, that the governor informed the Rijksvertegenwoordiger in writing, and that integrity measures such as BIOS support and codes of conduct are underway.
It is and remains difficult to make statements with exact certainty about the motives of those involved on Bonaire.
Het is en blijft lastig om met exacte zekerheid uitspraken te doen over motieven van de betrokkenen in Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht “Anass (13) volgens OM niet aangezet tot zelfmoord”

MP Bergkamp asked the Education and Justice ministers about a case where the prosecutor found a 13-year-old was not incited to suicide by bullying, and what lessons follow, including whether the anti-bullying plan changes and when legislation comes. State Secretary Dekker answered that the case underlines the need for the existing anti-bullying plan, which will not be changed, that the Inspectorate will investigate the school after summer, and that a bill is planned for 2014 with a target of August 2015.
In this specific case, the Public Prosecution Service informed the Inspectorate of Education about the outcomes of the investigation.
In dit concrete geval heeft het Openbaar Ministerie de Inspectie van het Onderwijs geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over de brand bij chemiebedrijf ELD in Oosterhou

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice for a timeline of the June 2013 fire at chemical company ELD in Oosterhout, the GRIP escalation, prior inspections, emergency plans, public communication and the failure to sound sirens. The minister answered in detail, giving a timeline and communication record, but said the investigation into compliance was still ongoing and that communication is a local responsibility.
The investigation is still ongoing, so it is still unclear whether the company complied with all regulations at the time the fire broke out.
Op dit moment loopt het onderzoek nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is of het bedrijf op het moment van uitbreken van de brand aan alle voorschriften voldeed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het niet functioneren van de trajectcontrole op de A2

An SP MP asked why the A2 average-speed (trajectory) control between Utrecht and Amsterdam was split between two suppliers, why it is not yet operational, what it has cost and how speeding is enforced meanwhile. The minister answers that the split was a deliberate choice for competition and risk spreading, that delays stem from a difference of view on test quality which is now resolved, that the system goes live on 15 July 2013, and that mobile checks cover the gap.
The system will be put into operation on 15 July 2013.
Het systeem zal op 15 juli 2013 in werking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Vorm een Europees OM voor aanpak witwaspraktijken’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government will act on an advisory report recommending a European Public Prosecutor, and what it thinks of concerns about national sovereignty and coordination with national prosecutors. The minister replied that a Commission proposal is expected this summer, that the cabinet will form a view once it is published, and that the Netherlands has so far been critical of such an office, pointing to earlier letters and debates.
Once that draft regulation is published, the cabinet will form a view on it and share it with your House through the usual channel of a BNC fiche.
Zodra die ontwerpverordening gepubliceerd is, zal het kabinet zich daarover een mening vormen en deze delen met uw Kamer via het gebruikelijke kanaal van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen Hilkens en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Maastricht local triangle (mayor, police, prosecutor) is divided over raids on coffeeshops and whether local policy on the residency criterion is unclear. The minister replied that the partners operate in a unified way, that local tailoring within the national framework is preserved, and referred to an earlier letter to parliament.
I in fact observe that in Maastricht the partners in the triangle operate unambiguously and that sales to drug tourists are vigorously tackled both under criminal and administrative law.
Ik constateer juist dat in Maastricht de partners in de driehoek eenduidig opereren en dat de verkoop aan drugstoeristen zowel strafrechtelijk als bestuursrechtelijk voortvarend wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en De Wit over de vervolging van een van het (mede)plegen genocide verdachte Nederlander van Irakese afkomst

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that a Dutch national of Iraqi origin, listed by the Iraqi High Tribunal for alleged genocide-related crimes, has been under Dutch prosecution review since 2007, and whether extradition from Iraq would be sought. The state secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service cannot comment on possible involvement in criminal offences because of investigative and privacy interests.

The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, because of investigative and privacy interests, no statements can be made about possible involvement in criminal offences by the person named in the article.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat vanwege opsporings- en privacybelangen geen uitspraken kunnen worden gedaan over mogelijke betrokkenheid bij strafbare feiten van de in het artikel genoemde persoon.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur inzake de handhaving van het ingezetenencriterium

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Epicurus study showing many coffee shops sell to foreigners without checks, and whether enforcement of the residency criterion has been dropped in some municipalities such as Nijmegen and Hilversum. The minister answered that most coffee-shop municipalities have submitted enforcement plans, that the residency criterion is part of policy in over 70% of them, that Nijmegen has suspended its use of the criterion, and that talks with municipalities will follow where needed.
Municipalities that have not included the residency criterion in their enforcement policy, or do not intend to, will be engaged in talks.
Met gemeenten die in hun handhavingsbeleid het ingezetenencriterium niet hebben opgenomen of niet van plan zijn dit op te nemen wordt in gesprek gegaan.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over de foutmarge van de trajectcontroles

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the state secretary could know that the error margin of traffic-section speed cameras falls within the 1-in-10,000 norm, and asked how many motorists were wrongly fined, whether they will be refunded, and whether fines will be checked manually. The minister said the margin was agreed with the supplier, about 200 complaints fell within it pending validation, referred to a separate letter for the figures, and judged further measures unnecessary, citing the OM's planned optimisation and manual review by BOA officers.
For the answer to these questions I refer to the letter I sent to your House today about the traffic-section control systems.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief die ik uw Kamer heden stuurde over de trajectcontrolesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het publiceren van 112-meldingen op internet

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether P2000 emergency paging traffic will be encrypted from 2014, so that privacy-sensitive 112 messages stop appearing online and journalists lose access. The minister replied that encryption is under study with a decision only after consultation, that the current contract runs to 2017, and that journalists will be informed via a national press-alarm guideline drawn up with the Dutch journalists' association.
In consultation with the National Police and the Security Council, I will examine in the coming months the options for improving citizens' privacy on this point
In overleg met de Nationale Politie en het Veiligheidsberaad onderzoek ik in de komende maanden de mogelijkheden om de privacy van burgers op dit punt te verbeteren
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Bontes en Helder over de Nederlandse politie als islamitische huwelijksbemiddelaar

Three PVV MPs asked whether police and the subsidised organisation Fier Fryslân helped arrange an Islamic marriage of minors, how many police hours this cost, how many Islamic marriages occur, the link between Islam and honour-related violence, and whether perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor, that no data exist on Islamic marriages, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, that prosecution was suspended in favour of mediation, and that the Nationality Act does not allow denaturalisation for these offences.
That is not correct. Based on the factual account requested from Fier Fryslân and the official police report, both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor.

Dit klopt niet. Op basis van het bij Fier Fryslân opgevraagde feitenrelaas en het bij de politie opgevraagde ambtsbericht blijkt dat beide organisaties niet hebben meegewerkt aan een religieus huwelijk van een minderjarige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat een heftige tripdrug vrij verkrijgbaar is

An MP asked whether the government would ban Salvia divinorum, given expert warnings about its dangers, and whether long-term health research would be done. The state secretary answered that the risks are low, the user base is very small, and a ban is not desirable, so no research is planned.
Given the limited risks to public health and the fact that a ban could push sales into other, illegal channels, I do not consider a ban desirable.

Gezien de beperkte risico's voor de volksgezondheid en het feit dat een verbod er mogelijk toe zou kunnen leiden dat de verkoop zich via andere, illegale kanalen gaat afspelen, acht ik een verbod niet wenselijk.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de meldkamer van de veiligheidsregio Flevoland

MP Kooiman asked whether the Flevoland safety region's emergency control room is fit for a disaster, whether it lacks adequate calamity coordinators, and what the region and the minister are doing about it. Minister Opstelten answered that the inspectorate found no single-head leadership in the room, that the region is working on an interim solution with neighbouring regions without a merger, and that the minister will report on progress.
The safety regions Flevoland, Gooi en Vechtstreek and Utrecht, supported by my ministry, are working to implement the alternative solutions for the identified problems.
De veiligheidsregio's Flevoland, Gooi en Vechtstreek en Utrecht spannen zich, gesteund door mijn ministerie, in om de alternatieve oplossingen voor de geconstateerde problemen uit te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht dat slachtoffers van mensenhandel allereerst rust nodig hebben

MP Hilkens asks the Justice Minister about a study finding that trafficking victims first need rest, and whether reception, victim identification, the reflection period and central funding should change. The minister acknowledges the study and promises a government policy response after the summer recess, without substantive answers yet.
In accordance with the request of your House of 21 June 2013, the cabinet will prepare a policy response to this study, which will be sent after the summer recess.
Conform het verzoek van uw Kamer van 21 juni 2013 zal het kabinet een beleidsreactie opstellen op dit onderzoek, die na het zomerreces zal worden toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over de wettelijke problemen rond de vervolging van internetoplichting

An MP asked the minister about legal gaps in prosecuting online fraud, where sellers take payment and deliver nothing, and whether a civil claim by 20 victims should instead be handled in a criminal case, and whether a law change is planned. The minister answered that civil law is generally the appropriate route for such contract disputes, that victims may organise collective civil claims, and referred to earlier answers on the same issue.
I refer to the answer to questions 3, 4 and 5 from Member Recourt on fraud at Marktplaats.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar het antwoord op vragen 3, 4 en 5 van het lid Recourt over oplichting bij Marktplaats
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de inrichting van de politiedienstencentra

MP Kooiman asks the minister why police service centres are split across three locations, how this fits with commitments on staff and the police collective agreement, and how many support jobs will be lost. The minister replies that the split follows from efficiency and job-retention goals, that a social safety net and job-security guarantee apply, and that roughly 1,500 further FTE will decline through natural attrition without forced dismissals.

The police collective agreement (Arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord 2012–2014) includes a job-security guarantee, under which the employer will ensure that employees threatened by the reorganisation receive a suitable position within or outside the police.

In de politie-cao (Arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord 2012–2014) is echter een werkzekerheidsgarantie overeengekomen, waarbij met toepassing van het LSS de werkgever ervoor zal zorgdragen dat medewerkers «die bedreigd worden door de reorganisatie» een passende functie zullen krijgen binnen of buiten de politie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de aanbeveling van het VN-Comité tegen Marteling om af te zien van het gebruik van stroomstootwapens (Taser) bij de Nederlandse politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the UN Committee Against Torture's recommendation to stop using Tasers and abandon the planned pilot in regular police units. The minister replied that a Taser pilot in basic police care is planned for 2014, that Taser use is considered relatively safe when used correctly, and that the committee's call for a complete ban is not shared.
However, I do not believe there is reason to reconsider the pilot or abandon it.
Ik ben echter niet van mening dat er reden is om de pilot te heroverwegen of hiervan af te zien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over regelgeving met betrekking tot drones

An MP asks the Justice and Infrastructure ministers whether the repeal of the aerial photography decree and the rules on drones and model aircraft adequately protect privacy against high-resolution camera drones. The state secretary answers that existing criminal and data protection law suffices, that tighter model-aircraft and drone rules are being drafted, and that operators need an exemption in the meantime.
I consider the current and forthcoming laws and regulations sufficiently equipped to take account of protecting private life in the civil use of cameras mounted on unmanned aircraft.

Ik acht de geldende en aanstaande wet- en regelgeving hiermee voldoende toegerust om rekening te houden met het beschermen van de persoonlijke levenssfeer als het gaat om het civiele gebruik van op een onbemand luchtvaartuig gemonteerde camera's.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff over de opsporing van gestolen apparatuur

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police did not act immediately on reports of stolen Apple devices, whether theft without a complaint can lead to seizure, and what the results of tracking software are. The minister answered that police acted promptly, that tracking software helps but location accuracy and proportionality limit direct raids, and that police and prosecutors operate within legal safeguards.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep an overview of cases in which tracking software was used, whether successfully or not.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt geen overzicht bij van zaken waarin (al dan niet met succes) gebruik is gemaakt van volgsoftware.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en De Graaf over het zwichten voor islamitisch antisemitisme

PVV MPs asked whether a memorial plaque for Jewish WWII victims was dropped after Muslim residents objected, and about combating Islamic antisemitism and a national study of it. The minister says the earlier Joods Lyceum memorial debate was not a concrete initiative and no objections were known, and points to existing research and a round table rather than a new national study.
I am prepared to commission specific follow-up research if the expected research results provide too little knowledge
Ik ben bereid om specifiek vervolgonderzoek te laten uitvoeren als de te verwachten onderzoeksresultaten te weinig kennis opleveren

Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht dat toezichthouders van het Openbaar Vervoer in Amsterdam geen boete voor vernieling meer mogen geven van het Openbaar Ministerie wanneer er sprake is van

Two PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam public transport inspectors may no longer issue fines for vandalism when OV gates are forced open, and whether the government would reverse this and widen inspectors' powers. The state secretary answered that Amsterdam's VOV inspectors, who are employed by the municipality, cannot issue zwartrijden fines under article 70 of the Wet personenvervoer, so an OM policy line and an adjustment of working methods are being pursued, while refusing to withdraw the OM policy or change the regulations.
To achieve a more uniform method of settlement, the OM recently issued a policy line on fare evasion and electronic access gates.
Om tot een meer eenduidige afdoeningswijze te komen heeft het OM onlangs een beleidslijn uitgevaardigd over zwartrijden en elektronische toegangspoortjes.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de steun van Nederlandse moslims voor jihadgangers naar Syrië

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a survey showing that nearly three-quarters of Muslims view jihadist travellers to Syria as heroes reflects Islamic approval of violence, and what the government will do about the supposed large-scale support among Muslims for jihadists. Minister Asscher answered that the research confirmed emotional engagement and broad support for fighters against the Syrian regime, but did not examine support for jihadist motives, so the conclusion of majority support for jihadist travellers cannot be drawn.
Support for jihadist motives and jihadist factions in the Syrian conflict was not examined in this research.
De steun voor jihadistische motieven en jihadistische facties in het Syrische conflict is in dit onderzoek niet onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de uitspraken van een internist over het medisch beroepsgeheim en vreemdelingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether an internist's claims that detained foreign nationals are accompanied by guards or police during medical consultations, and that this breaches medical confidentiality, are accurate, and whether the government will change its policy. The State Secretary replied that detainees receive necessary care, that supervision during hospital visits is justified on security grounds with confidentiality balanced case by case, and that he sees no need to revise the policy, while complaints can follow the usual route.

All in all, I am of the view that for reasons of security it may be justified, after careful weighing against the respect owed to the doctor's professional secrecy, to infringe on the doctor-patient confidentiality.

Al met al ben ik van mening dat het uit oogpunt van veiligheid gerechtvaardigd kan zijn om – na zorgvuldige weging het te respecteren beroepsgeheim van de arts – een inbreuk te maken op de arts-patiënt vertrouwelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van  de imam al Mutawa

Two PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a cleric they described as a hate preacher who called for stoning women, including by denying him entry and questioning the Islamic University Rotterdam that invited him. The minister condemned calls to violence but said there were no indications the cleric incites violence, that visa applications are assessed under the Visa Code, and that the inviting institution has not shown itself harmful to integration.
However, I have no indications that the person in question calls for violence.
Ik heb echter geen aanwijzingen dat genoemde persoon oproept tot geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht meer tips over gedwongen prostitutie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of more tips on forced prostitution, including whether the anonymous reporting campaign should be intensified and extended to prostitutes. The minister said the campaign has contributed to better insight into trafficking, that talks with Stichting M. on continuing it are ongoing, and that minors will be a specific focus in the Task Force.
I am in consultation with Stichting M. to consider how the campaign 'Schijn bedriegt' will be continued.
Ik ben in overleg met Stichting M. om te bezien op welke wijze de campagne «Schijn bedriegt» wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Wit over de bureaucratische procedures na de vermissing van een persoon

MP De Wit asked ministers about bureaucratic obstacles faced by partners of missing persons with banks, insurers and municipalities, and whether a central desk or mayoral support could help. The government replied that the 2002 Civil Code changes already shorten the procedure, insurers and banks are encouraged to be accommodating, a helpline and information folder exist, and no central desk or new rules are needed.
It does not suit me to assess an individual case.
Het past mij niet om een individueel geval te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de band tussen de Moslimbroederschap en een Amsterdamse moskee

An MP asks whether the owner of an Amsterdam mosque is linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, whether the government will bar foreign-funded mosques or Islamic-cooperation-linked funding, and which mosques receive foreign funding. The minister answers that the government does not track such affiliations, that religious freedom limits intervention, that AIVD can investigate threats, and that a Parliament motion on foreign financing is being followed up.
This is not known to us. The government does not keep an overview of which individuals are affiliated with which organisations.
Dit is bij ons niet bekend. De overheid houdt geen overzicht bij van welke individuen aan welke organisaties zijn gelieerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over boogschieten op damherten

MP Thieme asked the ministers whether the perpetrator of a bow-and-arrow shooting of a fallow deer had been found, whether the government is aware of the Dutch archers' association's push to legalise bow hunting, and whether there are plans to legalise it. The minister replied that the police investigation was halted for lack of leads, that bow hunting remains prohibited under the Flora- and faunawet because of the risk of unnecessary suffering, and that there are no plans to legalise it.
There are no plans to legalise bow hunting.
Er zijn geen plannen om de boogjacht te legaliseren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over de kritiek van de Nationale ombudsman op de toepassing van het middel preventief fouilleren in de praktijk

MPs De Wit and Kooiman asked the Justice Minister how he responds to the National Ombudsman's criticism of preventive stop-and-search actions on the A2 and at a Maasdriel campsite, and whether misuse of powers will be prevented. The minister rejects the Ombudsman's broader concern, accepts some criticism on the written justification and timely publication of the area designation, and says existing legal safeguards suffice without additional measures.
The written justification for the necessity of the area designation could have been better.
De schriftelijke onderbouwing van de noodzaak van de gebiedsaanwijzing had beter gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over de inzet van onbemande vliegtuigjes (‘drones’) zonder toestemming van de gemeente door de Koninklijke Marechaussee en de politie in Soesterberg

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked whether the Royal Marechaussee and police used Raven drones for traffic checks in Soesterberg without informing the local authority, and how that fits with the military assistance procedure. The government admits the assistance procedure was not followed, that the local authority was not asked, that it has instructed all involved to follow the procedure in future, and that a police-wide drone policy is being developed.
Because the assistance procedure was not followed, the authority never got to the question of subsidiarity and proportionality.
Doordat de bijstandprocedure niet is gevolgd, is het gezag niet toegekomen aan de subsidiariteit- en proportionaliteitsvraag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam ver het bericht ‘Werden Deutsche Autofahrer im Ausland abgezockt?’

Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Dutch police regularly fine German drivers at the Denekamp border for a missing hyphen between letters and numbers in vehicle papers, and how this enforcement fits police priorities. The minister answered that he had made inquiries and the police and CJIB are not aware of such fines, so the third question does not arise.
I have made inquiries with the National Police. The Police and the CJIB state that they are not aware of such fines.
Ik heb bij de Nationale Politie navraag gedaan. De Politie en het CJIB geven aan niet bekend te zijn met dergelijke bekeuringen.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Fritsma over het bericht ‘België: bijna 20 criminele illegalen per dag’

MPs Helder and Fritsma asked whether the government tracks how many illegal migrants are arrested for crimes, their nationality, and how many lead to conviction and expulsion, following a report on Belgium. The state secretary answered that this data is not yet available, that linking criminal justice and migration databases is underway with expected data in 2014, and that in 2012 about 690 convicted or suspected foreigners were removed or left from the Dutch return caseload.
The requested information is not yet available.
De gevraagde informatie is nog niet voorhanden.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Nederland groot en snel groeiend leverancier jihadstrijders’ en het rapport ‘Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland’

An MP asked whether a sanction or travel-visa scheme could block unauthorised travel to designated jihadist conflict areas, and what preventive measures are planned. The minister replied that such a sanction would require new legislation, that a study of a destination-visa scheme will follow in line with a motion, and referred to a letter listing preventive measures.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de verplaatsing van de teelt van cannabis naar andere Europese landen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether cannabis cultivation is shifting from the Netherlands to other European countries, what causes this, whether he had contact with Europol and counterpart countries, and whether the Netherlands bears responsibility for supporting enforcement abroad. The minister confirmed reports of more foreign grow sites with some Dutch criminal involvement, cited the threat assessment and possible displacement from Dutch enforcement, and described ongoing Benelux, Hazeldonk and operational Europol contacts while stating that each country is responsible for its own enforcement.
The Netherlands will of course continue to play a (supportive) role in criminal enforcement abroad.
Nederland zal vanzelfsprekend een (ondersteunende) rol blijven spelen bij de strafrechtelijke handhaving in het buitenland
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Bosman over de kwaliteit van rechtspraak in Zeeland

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of quality concerns at the prosecution service and courts in Zeeland, whether he shares them, their causes and remedies, and whether budget cuts and reorganisation could worsen matters. The minister acknowledges the problems, attributes them to several factors including the 2013 court-map merger of the Breda and Middelburg prosecution offices, says he sees no structural signs and expects quick resolution, and refers to a separate letter on budget effects.
There is intensive monitoring. I have no indications that the identified problems are structural in nature and I expect them to be resolved soon.
Er is sprake van intensieve monitoring. Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de geconstateerde problemen structureel van aard zijn en ga ervan uit dat zij spoedig worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt  over het falende Nederlandse anti-dopingbeleid

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about reports that Dutch anti-doping policy is failing, including claims of a doubling of doping laboratories, online doping sales and cross-border cooperation with Belgium. The government answered that the picture is not recognised by the IGZ and the OM, outlined existing EU and national cooperation, announced an inter-ministerial consultation and a symposium, and said it sees no need to revise sports self-regulation for now.
The picture sketched in the broadcast is not recognised by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het in de uitzending geschetste beeld wordt door de Inspectie voor de gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en het openbaar ministerie (OM) niet herkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over dopingdealers

An MP asked ministers about doping dealers, including the risks of doping use, illegal laboratories, cooperation with Belgian and German authorities, and why doping use itself is not criminal. The ministers answered that enforcement is shared among several agencies, that the three IGZ investigations led to one conviction and two dismissals, and that doping use is a sporting rule rather than a crime, so the government focuses on prevention.
Whether this is mostly the case is not known to the OM.
Of dit veelal het geval is, is het OM niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over opsporing van dopinghandel

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about the investigation of doping trade, including illegal laboratories, online sales, cooperation with Belgium and with police, prosecution, customs and the Dutch Doping Authority, plus the estimated 160,000 doping users and a 2005 internal report. The government referred to earlier answers, said the Doping Authority has no investigative task, confirmed the 2009 prevalence study, and declined to publish the 2005 internal note because it was not a final product.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de gemeente Venray die in gesprek is met de Marokkaanse overheid over criminele jongeren

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked whether the municipality of Venray has received help from the Moroccan government in tackling criminal youths of Moroccan origin, and whether this is appropriate. The minister replied that the mayor only had informal, informative contacts with Moroccan officials, no agreements were made, that the problem is a Dutch responsibility, and that his ministry has itself provided support.
There is, however, no question of cooperation or assistance in tackling this problem.
Van samenwerking en hulp bij de aanpak van dit probleem is echter geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat criminelen in toenemende mate APAAN gebruiken als grondstof voor de productie van synthetische harddrugs

MP Oskam asked ministers whether criminals increasingly use APAAN as a precursor for synthetic hard drugs, and why it is not listed under the Dutch precursor law or the EU registered-substances list. The government confirmed rising seizures and conversion labs, explained that the Den Bosch ruling concerned precursor registration rather than drug status, said the appeal was partially withdrawn pending EU Court preliminary questions, and declined to ban APAAN under the Opium Act because it is not a psychoactive drug.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has argued at EU level that APAAN should be placed on the list of registered substances.
Verder heeft Nederland in EU verband bepleit dat APAAN op de lijst met geregistreerde stoffen komt te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat Eindhoven Airport een belangrijke schakel zou zijn in de internationale mensenhandel

MPs Oskam and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Eindhoven Airport is a key hub for international human trafficking and what steps are being taken there.
