The minister confirmed awareness, described a Public Prosecution Service project and Marechaussee information-building at the airport, and answered that no other small border-region airports hold a comparable position.
The Public Prosecution Service has started a project aimed at further improving the approach to criminal networks involved in human trafficking.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is met een project gestart dat zich richt op het verder verbeteren van de aanpak van criminele samenwerkingsverbanden inzake mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over euthanasie bij dementie

An MP asked the health minister about euthanasia for patients with dementia, including the status of written euthanasia declarations, whether the Euthanasia Act or the prosecution guideline should be amended, and whether physicians must communicate with patients. The minister said a working group will seek clarity on written declarations but declined to amend the Act or guideline, and the questions were not answered before the scheduled debate.
Together with those present at the consultation, I decided to have a working group including VWS, V&J and KNMG take up this issue quickly.
Ik heb samen met de aanwezigen bij het overleg besloten om een werkgroep van onder meer VWS, V&J en KNMG dit vraagstuk snel verder te laten oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de hack op het Groene Hart Ziekenhuis

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Security minister about the hack of Groene Hart Hospital, the journalist Brenno de Winter being invited as a witness, press source protection, the NEN-7510 security norm for healthcare, and priorities for responsible disclosure and enforcement. The minister answered that the witness invitation was voluntary and that journalists keep source protection, that the Voskuil ruling was not relevant here, that ethical hacking can still be prosecuted, that IGZ and CBP supervise healthcare information security, and that the investigation is ongoing so no figures on capacity can be given.
The investigation into the hack of the Groene Hart Hospital has not yet been concluded. For that reason I cannot say anything about the amount of investigative capacity deployed.
Het onderzoek naar de hack op het Groene Hartziekenhuis is nog niet afgerond. Om die reden kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de hoeveelheid opsporingscapaciteit die is ingezet
Antwoord op vragen Hilkens over de stijging van het aantal meldingen van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a 40% rise in reports of possible human trafficking victims, the reporting duty for youth care institutions, measures against loverboy exploitation, multilingual information, identifying victims in asylum centres, and CoMensha's call for a prostitution ban. The minister attributed the rise largely to broader registration of weak indications, rejected extending the reporting duty to youth care, listed existing prevention measures and COA cooperation, and rejected a prostitution ban.

Together with the National Rapporteur on Trafficking in Human Beings and Sexual Violence against Children (NRM) and CoMensha, given the greater uncertainty in the 2012 figures, it will be examined how the registration method used by CoMensha can be tightened.

Samen met de Nationaal Rapporteur Mensenhandel en Seksueel Geweld tegen Kinderen (NRM) en CoMensha zal vanwege de grotere onzekerheid in de cijfers over 2012 worden bezien op welke wijze de door Comensha gehanteerde registratiewijze aangescherpt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Van Tongeren over de Haagse spionagekastjes

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about hidden camera and recording cabinets found in The Hague's Schilderswijk, who placed them, whether the city was informed, and whether other such cabinets exist. The Justice minister replied that police placed them with prosecutor approval for an observation in a property-crime investigation, the city was not informed as no legal duty exists, and no overall inventory is available.
No overall overview is available of the cabinets and/or recording equipment placed in that context.
Er is geen algeheel overzicht beschikbaar van de in dat kader geplaatste kasten en/of opnameapparatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘OM te traag in verkrachtingszaak’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a rapist of a 14-year-old girl received a sentence reduction because the case stalled at police and the Public Prosecution Service, and what measures will prevent such delays. The minister answered that the prosecutor requested two years instead of the usual three because of the long delay, the court imposed 30 months (10 suspended), the verdict is under appeal, and that the delay in this case could not be explained and no measures against individuals are warranted, while stating that the justice chain's performance will be strengthened.
In this case it proved impossible to establish why additional investigation was not carried out already after the complaint was filed in 2003.
In de onderhavige casus bleek het niet mogelijk te achterhalen waarom niet reeds na het opnemen van de aangifte in 2003 aanvullend onderzoek is verricht.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de arrestatie van enkele protestanten op de Dam tijdens de inhuldiging van de koning

MPs Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest of protesters on the Dam during the 30 April 2013 inauguration, including police instructions, consistency with earlier ministerial letters on the right to demonstrate, the 'mistaken identity' explanation, and the role of plainclothes officers and the DKDB. The minister's further reply refers the House to earlier answers on the same events and to a supplementary letter from the Amsterdam mayor, and states that no reason is seen to change those answers.
I see no reason to change the answers to the above written questions.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de beantwoording van bovenstaande schriftelijke vragen te wijzigen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het preventief vastzetten van «gevaarlijke eenlingen» in verband met de troonswisseling

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many people were preventively detained as 'dangerous loners' around the 2013 royal succession, what policy the prosecution service and police follow, which categories qualify, and what legal remedies exist. The minister's reply refers the MP to earlier answers sent on 21 May 2013 on this topic and to a supplementary letter from the Amsterdam mayor, without restating substance.
I see no reason to change the answers to the above written questions.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de beantwoording van bovenstaande schriftelijke vragen te wijzigen.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanhouding van twee demonstranten op de Dam

MP Kooiman asked the Justice Minister why two demonstrators were arrested on the Dam during the 2013 inauguration, what rules were broken, whether the arrests stemmed from a mix-up of identity, why they were held for over two hours, and who ordered the arrests. The minister answers by referring to earlier replies sent on 21 May, a supplementary letter from the Amsterdam mayor, and states no reason to change the earlier answers.
I see no reason to change the answers to the above written questions.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de beantwoording van bovenstaande schriftelijke vragen te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van fotoherkenningsapparatuur om op internet bijstandsgerechtigden op te sporen

An SP MP asked whether municipalities use photo-recognition equipment to trace welfare recipients' holiday photos online without suspicion of fraud, and on what legal basis, including proportionality and privacy (ECHR art. 8). The state secretary replied that this has not been found to happen, that municipalities only use public sources such as Suwinet, Hyves and Facebook, that no prosecutor's permission is needed for administrative checks, and that guidance for municipalities is being prepared.
The finding that municipalities hire or use photo-recognition equipment to trace welfare recipients' holiday photos on the internet is, as far as is now known, incorrect.
De constatering dat gemeenten fotoherkenningsapparatuur inhuren of inzetten om op het internet vakantiefoto's van bijstandsgerechtigden op te sporen, is voor zover nu bekend, onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Meer mensenhandel, minder veroordeelden’

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the Netherlands ranks fourth among EU states for human trafficking victims and that convictions are falling. The minister answered that the high victim numbers reflect better identification and registration, that EU registration criteria differ so comparisons are misleading, and that no policy change is planned.
I therefore see no reason to adjust the policy aimed at combating human trafficking.
Ik zie hierin dan ook geen aanleiding om het beleid gericht op de bestrijding van mensenhandel aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens en Fokke over de aanpak van overlast bij coffeeshops

MPs Hilkens and Fokke asked the Minister of Security and Justice how nuisance around Maastricht coffeeshops should be tackled, including whether the mayor may relax enforcement of the residents-only criterion, whether extra police are needed, and whether illegal street dealers are run by coffeeshop owners. Minister Opstelten answered that local authorities set coffeeshop policy within the national framework, that police capacity will be made available on request, and that he has no evidence for the claim about coffeeshop owners sending runners onto the street.
I told the mayor of Maastricht that I wish to provide support where needed and I will do so.
Ik heb de burgemeester van Maastricht gezegd mijn steun te willen verlenen waar dat nodig is en dit zal ik ook doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de DigiNotar-affaire op basis van WOB-stukken

An MP asked the government twelve questions about how operational management of DigiNotar was taken over after its 2011 certificate breach, including the legal basis, the scope of the power of attorney and the user lists. The minister answered that only operational management was taken over under a power of attorney from VASCO, with no specific statutory basis, and pointed to the Wob decisions for the detailed description.
DigiNotar was not taken over de facto. Only operational management was taken over after good consultation with VASCO.
DigiNotar is niet de facto overgenomen. Alleen het operationeel management is overgenomen na goed overleg met VASCO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het gedogen van qat-gebruik

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether police and prosecutors will stop prosecuting small amounts of qat for personal use after it was listed under Opium Act list II, and how enforcement is ensured. The minister answered that there is no tolerance of qat offences, that possession and trade remain criminal with lower penalties for small amounts, and that local nuisance can be tackled via municipal bylaws.
There is and will be no question of tolerating criminal acts with regard to qat.
Er is en zal geen sprake zijn van het gedogen van strafbare handelingen ten aanzien van qat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat qat gedoogd zal worden

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the public prosecutor would tolerate qat use, whether illegal qat trade should be fought, and about laundering of criminal profits and cooperation with UK authorities. The minister answered that qat was placed on List II of the Opium Act, that there will be no toleration of criminal acts regarding qat, that existing tools suffice against laundering, and that cooperation with the UK goes well.
There is and will be no question of tolerating criminal acts with respect to qat.
Er is en zal geen sprake zijn van het gedogen van strafbare handelingen ten aanzien van qat.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen-Jansen over de overlast door criminele straatdealers en het handhaven van het ingezetenencriterium

An MP asked the Justice Minister about street-level drug dealing and nuisance linked to the coffeeshop residence criterion (ingezetenencriterium), including whether it displaced nuisance, whether the policy works, and how police capacity is used. The minister replied that nuisance has generally fallen, that the policy will be maintained, that police enforce on both street dealing and coffeeshops, and that he will report on enforcement by the summer recess.
As promised to your House, before the summer recess I will come with an interim report on the implementation of enforcement (local customisation) in the municipalities of the Netherlands.
Zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer kom ik voor het zomerreces met een tussenstand over de invulling van de handhaving (lokaal maatwerk) in de gemeenten in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat straatdealers staan te juichen na politie-invallen bij coffeeshops in Maastricht

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police raids on Maastricht coffeeshops were pursued instead of tackling street dealers, how many hours the raids cost, how the government views court rulings against the residence criterion, and whether it will scrap the criterion. The minister answered that both street dealing and the residence criterion are enforced, reported about 840 police hours across seven raids, said the criterion is working and an appeal is planned, and refused to scrap it.
I see no reason to withdraw the residence criterion and change the policy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het ingezetenencriterium in te trekken en het beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over het ingezetenencriterium en de bestrijding van straathandel

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the Justice Minister about the residency criterion for coffeeshops, street drug dealing and nuisance in Maastricht, court rulings, police capacity, and enforcement figures. Minister Opstelten answered that nuisance had fallen under the residency criterion but rose after Maastricht coffeeshops resumed selling to non-residents, that capacity is sufficient, that the criterion is enforced locally, and that a status report will follow before the summer recess.
As previously promised to your House, I will come before the summer recess with an interim status report on how local tailoring is being applied in municipalities across the Netherlands.
Zoals eerder toegezegd aan uw Kamer kom ik voor het zomerreces met een tussenstand over de invulling van het lokaal maatwerk in de gemeenten in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten al langer zuchten onder cyberaanvallen

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about reports of cyberattacks on US financial institutions by the group Cyber Fighters of Izz ad-Din al-Qassam, its links to Iran, funding, sanctions, and DDoS attacks on Dutch banks. Minister Opstelten answered that the group is not on any terrorism list, that investigations into origin and DDoS attacks are ongoing and no conclusions can yet be given, and that concrete measures such as a liaison at the NCSC and a strengthened cyber strategy are being taken.
At present the police High Tech Crime Team, on the orders of the Public Prosecution Service, is conducting an investigation into the DDoS attacks.
Op dit moment voert het Team High Tech Crime van de politie op last van het Openbaar Ministerie een onderzoek uit naar de DDos-aanvallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik van onbemande vliegtuigjes

The MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the rules protecting privacy against camera-equipped drones and whether those rules are enforceable, citing a College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens concern that they are likely to be violated. The minister answered that existing criminal provisions and statutory safeguards for government use are adequate, and that no concrete signals of enforcement gaps or violations have reached him.
The statutory regime for the performance of government duties contains sufficient safeguards for respecting the private life of those to whom that performance relates.
Het wettelijke regime voor de taakuitoefening door de overheid bevat voldoende waarborgen voor het respecteren van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van degenen op wie die taakuitoefening betrekking heeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht “Bonnenregen op A4 wekt ergernis”

MPs De Graaf and Helder asked why many speeding fines were issued on the A4 after average-speed (trajectory) checks started, and whether signage ambiguity should be fixed and fines dropped. The minister replied that the 100 km/h limit has long applied, signage was unchanged, warning signs and press releases preceded the checks, and that fines will not be dropped.
The maximum speed on the section of the A4 where the trajectory check is located has been 100 km/h for many years.
De maximumsnelheid op het gedeelte van de A4 waar de trajectcontrole staat, is al vele jaren 100 km/h.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanhouding van een jachtopziener voor illegale jacht

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the arrest of a gamekeeper for illegal hunting at estate De Eese, including whether employers, hunters, the crown prince and the gamekeeper's BOA status should be scrutinised. The minister declined to say more on the ongoing criminal investigation, stated the BOA powers were withdrawn, denied the crown prince had hunted there, and rejected changes to BOA oversight.
In the interest of the investigation, the Public Prosecution Service cannot currently make any further statements.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan het Openbaar Ministerie thans geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de aanpak van georganiseerde wietteelt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a television report claiming the approach to organised cannabis cultivation is failing, including capacity problems and the limits of following up on criminal organisations after finding a grow house. The minister said the report selectively quoted an expert meeting report, declined to release that report in full because it contains planned enforcement priorities, and argued an integrated approach works better than purely criminal investigation, denying capacity problems.
It is not in the interest of the approach to cannabis cultivation for it to become known which actions are expected and when.
Het is niet in het belang van de aanpak van de cannabisteelt als bekend wordt welke acties er wanneer zijn te verwachten.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht Kinderporno veel gemeld

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the sharp rise in child pornography reports in 2012, how to explain it, and whether prevention and care keep pace with digital realities. The minister reports 19,872 reports in 2012 versus 12,542 in 2011, says the trend cannot be fully explained or measured given hidden parts of the internet, and points to the integrated child-abuse action plan, the taskforce, police reorganisation and planned protocol changes for youth care.
It is very difficult to measure the total amount of child pornography on the internet.
Het is zeer lastig om de totale hoeveelheid kinderpornografie op het internet te meten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het bericht dat de Reparatiewet griffierechten problemen met innen niet oplost

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Reparatiewet griffierechten resolves problems lawyers face in paying court fees, including separate invoices causing delays or inadmissibility. The minister answered that the amendment does not address the administrative collection process, pointed to the national current account planned for 2014, the Rechtspraak's guidance to lawyers, and the hardship clause, and said the Kwaliteit en Innovatie programme will consider uniform procedures.
With the introduction of the national current account (target date 1 January 2014), separate invoices will no longer need to be sent to lawyers.
Met de invoering van de landelijke rekening-courant (streefdatum 1 januari 2014) zullen er geen losse nota's meer aan advocaten verzonden hoeven te worden.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Waar is de tiplijn’

MP Van Dekken asked the ministers about a report that no tip line exists for anonymous reports of match-fixing in Dutch football, and about whether a judicial preliminary investigation is needed. The minister answered that the anonymous line Meld Misdaad Anoniem was opened for match-fixing from 1 April 2013, that the KNVB has a tip line, and that the Public Prosecution Service has started a preliminary investigation into fraud in football, which may include the signals raised.
The Public Prosecution Service has started a preliminary investigation into various signals about, in short, fraud in the football sector, including match-fixing.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is begonnen met een voorbereidend onderzoek naar diverse signalen over, kort gezegd, fraude in de voetbalbranche, waaronder matchfixing.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacyvoorwaarden bij apps en ander mobiel telefoongebruik

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers about app privacy terms, Apple's user terms, and whether mobile location data can be traced to individuals. Minister Kamp answered that privacy law requires clear, readable terms and informed consent, that the matter of specific producer-consumer relations is not for him to judge, and that consumers can complain to the Autoriteit Consument & Markt and the College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens.
It is not for me to pass judgment on how that relationship is shaped.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel uit te spreken over de invulling van die relatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht van de Franse regering om er binnen de EU voor te ijveren dat country-by-country reporting verplicht wordt gesteld voor alle bedrijven

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports France's EU push for country-by-country tax reporting for all multinationals, and what it will do about it. The government supports international efforts against aggressive tax planning, would back France if it raises the proposal in the EU, but favours such reporting only if introduced at EU level.
The cabinet will therefore support the French government if it wishes to consult at EU level on an obligation for such reporting.
Het kabinet zal dan ook de Franse regering steunen als zij in EU-verband wenst te overleggen over een verplichting tot een dergelijke rapportage.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over het bericht dat ook Nederlandse patiënten in het buitenland organen kopen en deze laten transplanteren

An MP asked the government about a report that Dutch patients buy kidneys abroad and have them transplanted illegally, and whether the government would act on it. The minister confirmed the problem is unwelcome and illegal, pointed to pending criminal-law changes, an NTS proposal for periodic reporting, and a European study, and said more insight into the scale is expected.
To prevent people from resorting to an illegal transplant abroad, the website of the Dutch Transplantation Foundation points out the dangers and possible illegality of a transplant abroad.

Om te voorkomen dat mensen hun toevlucht zoeken tot een illegale transplantatie in het buitenland wordt op de website van de Nederlandse Transplantatie Stichting gewezen op de gevaren en het mogelijke illegale karakter van een transplantatie in het buitenland.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Angst on lot jihadtieners’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports of parents worried about children leaving for jihad in Syria, including whether signals were investigated and whether recruitment occurred. The minister answered that signals are taken seriously and part of ongoing investigations, that no organised recruitment is evident, and pointed to existing counter-terrorism measures, without giving case-specific detail.
Signals from society about support for jihadism are taken seriously and are included in ongoing investigations.
Signalen vanuit de samenleving over ondersteuning van jihadisme worden serieus genomen en worden betrokken bij lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het vastzetten van ‘gevaarlijke eenlingen’ in verband met de troonswisseling

An MP asked how many 'dangerous loners' were detained or monitored around the 30 April 2013 coronation, how police and prosecutors handle them, and what legal remedies they have. The minister said about twenty potentially violent loners were identified and monitored, with 11 ordered to leave the area, and that people can only be arrested on suspicion of a criminal offence, not preventively.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanhouding van 2 demonstranten op de Dam

The SP MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice why two demonstrators were arrested on the Dam in 2013, which laws were broken, why identity documents were doubted, and who ordered the arrests. The minister answered that the arrests were wrongful: one arrest resulted from a mistaken identity with a person the mayor had ordered to leave, the other's circumstances remained unclear, and the police's initial denial was based on incorrect information.
It is established that the arrest took place wrongly.
Vast staat dat de aanhouding onterecht heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de arrestatie van enkele protestanten op de Dam tijdens de inhuldiging van de Koning

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the wrongful arrest of two protesters on the Dam during the 2013 inauguration, including police instructions, consistency with earlier letters on protest rights, and the role of agents in plain clothes. The minister answered that the arrests were local police action under local authority, that the two individuals were wrongly detained due to an unfortunate combination of circumstances, that individual protest was permitted unless criminal, and referred to the local triangle's response and police fact report without committing to new action.
From the response of the triangle and the police fact report it appears that, through an unfortunate combination of circumstances, both persons were wrongly arrested.
Uit de reactie van de driehoek en het feitenrelaas van de politie blijkt dat door een ongelukkige samenloop van omstandigheden beide betrokkenen ten onrechte zijn aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Oskam over een gewelddadige roofoverval op een gelddepot van waardetransporteur Brinks

MPs Van Hijum and Oskam asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about a violent robbery of a Brinks cash depot and the rising number of ram and explosive raids, including what is being done to protect cash transport and staff, whether drones could be used in pursuits, and whether banks reducing ATMs is acceptable. The minister answered that ram and explosive raids on ATMs have risen while other robbery types have not, listed existing preventive and repressive measures, declined to give full operational detail for confidentiality reasons, judged drones largely impractical, and pointed to ongoing consultation in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer.
In the interest of the operational strategy, I cannot in this letter address all the measures taken to counter these serious robberies.
In het belang van de operationele strategie kan ik in deze brief niet ingaan op álle maatregelen die genomen worden om deze zware overvallen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens over de opslag van vingerafdrukken

Oosenbrug and Recourt (PvdA) asked the Justice Minister whether the ECtHR ruling M.K. v France on retaining fingerprints of acquitted persons affects Dutch law and practice, and whether it limits the planned retention rule under the Herziening ten nadele act. The minister answered that the ruling does not change Dutch rules since acquitted persons' fingerprints are destroyed, and that the planned rule includes restrictions absent in France, so it is compatible with Article 8 ECHR.

The ruling has no consequences for current Dutch regulations and practice, because under the Besluit identiteitsvaststelling verdachten en veroordeelden the fingerprints of a suspect are destroyed after an acquittal or dismissal.

Het arrest heeft geen gevolgen voor de Nederlandse geldende regelgeving en praktijk, reeds omdat op grond van het Besluit identiteitsvaststelling verdachten en veroordeelden de vingerafdrukken van de verdachte na een vrijspraak of sepot worden vernietigd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het mislukken van de linkse methode van 'pappen en nathouden'

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop funding social prevention projects such as street coaches, neighbourhood barbecues and combat sports in favour of harsher repression, after a study found such interventions did not reduce neighbourhood nuisance. The minister answered that the study will be shared with municipalities, that local authorities are primarily responsible for choosing combinations of preventive and repressive measures, and that the government will not change course toward minimum sentences or wider expulsion powers beyond existing policy.
It is therefore up to the local government and its partners to assess which (combinations of) measures are deployed.
Het is dan ook aan het lokaal bestuur en zijn partners om te beoordelen welke (combinaties van) maatregelen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over de inzet door hun ouders van minderjarige kinderen voor het plegen van misdrijven

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the Justice Minister about reports that parents from Roma families use their minor children to commit burglaries and thefts, and about related police, child protection, municipal registration and enforcement questions. The minister confirmed the problem is recognised, explained that children under 12 are not prosecuted while parents can be prosecuted for inciting offences though evidence is hard to gather in families, and outlined planned registration and multi-problem family measures.
I have no insight into numbers, neither for children in general nor for Roma children in particular.
Ik heb geen inzicht in aantallen, noch voor kinderen in het algemeen, noch voor Roma kinderen in het bijzonder.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over de rechts-extremistische organisatie “Blood&Honour”

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked whether statements on the Blood&Honour website could be criminal, whether Mein Kampf publication and SS race-theory content are punishable, and whether the organisation could be dissolved. The minister answered that criminality must be assessed case by case by the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that there are currently no grounds to start a dissolution procedure since Blood&Honour lacks legal personality.
That assessment of criminality must in an individual case first be made by the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately by the criminal judge.
Die beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat onbemande militaire vliegtuigen (“drones”) steeds vaker in Nederland worden ingezet als opsporingsmiddel van de politie

MPs Schouw and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether the police use Defence's unmanned Raven aircraft for investigations and public order, and about legal basis, costs, liability, privacy, oversight and public information. The minister answered that 14 requests were granted in 2012 (81 flights), that the legal basis is the assistance regime of the Politiewet 2012, that data are kept only if relevant to criminal cases, and that civilian drone use is governed by Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport permits.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over mogelijke verspilling van belastinggeld door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether the Public Prosecution Service pays an IT provider for 11,000 accounts, including accounts with no employee attached, and whether other government bodies do the same. The minister replied that billing is currently a fixed price rather than per account, that talks are underway on per-account billing, and that no central register of accounts exists across government.
There is no central register of accounts within central government.
Er is binnen het Rijk geen centraal register van accounts.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de toegezegde medewerking van de gemeente Haarlemmermeer aan de vestiging in Hoofddorp van wat het grootste sekscomplex van Europa gaat worden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the planned mega sex complex in Hoofddorp, Haarlemmermeer, conforms to local prostitution and zoning policy, what risks it poses (drug trade, trafficking), and how it could be prevented. The minister answered that no formal application exists yet, so conformity cannot be judged; the current zoning plan does not permit a sex business and a new plan would be needed; sector regulation addresses criminal risks; and municipalities may lawfully permit such businesses, so no reason exists to block it.
Since no concrete application has yet been submitted to the municipality for the sex business, the intended size of the establishment is not fixed.
Aangezien er nog geen concrete aanvraag is ingediend bij de gemeente voor de vestiging van het seksbedrijf staat de beoogde grootte van de vestiging niet vast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het bericht «Gemeenten vrezen toename verloedering door bezuinigingen Rijk»

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior whether the planned end to municipal reimbursement for enforcing nuisance fines (bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast, such as littering and illegal parking) would weaken local enforcement, and whether they had consulted the VNG. Minister Opstelten answered that consultations with the VNG on the reimbursement scheme are ongoing and that the Chamber will be informed once more is known.
I am still in consultation with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) about the reimbursement scheme for municipalities concerning the administrative penalty order for nuisance.
Ik ben nog in overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) over de vergoedingsregeling voor gemeenten met betrekking tot de bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het schrappen van de PV-vergoeding

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he plans to abolish the fee paid to municipalities per issued fine under local bylaws, and what this means for municipal enforcement, public order and the state treasury. The Minister answered that he is still consulting the VNG on the compensation scheme and will inform parliament once more is known.
I am still consulting with the Association of Netherlands Municipalities (VNG) on the compensation scheme for municipalities regarding the administrative penalty order for nuisance.
Ik ben nog in overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) over de vergoedingsregeling voor gemeenten met betrekking tot de bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de overheid laks is geweest na een aanval door een botnet

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister why the government reacted poorly after a botnet attack, why police did not pursue the case further, and whether the NCSC could use stolen data to alert operators of critical infrastructure. The minister replied that the NCSC acted within its existing powers, alerted 16 organisations whose IP ranges matched, lacked a legal basis to use the stolen data fully, and promised a review of its tasks and powers.
The NCSC could not, under its existing tasks and powers, receive the information and has no legal basis to do so.
Het NCSC kon op grond van haar bestaande taken en bevoegdheden de informatie niet in ontvangst nemen en heeft daar ook geen rechtsbasis voor.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over de reactie op een grote botnet-infectie door het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police and the NCSC allegedly reacted slowly to a large Pobelka botnet infection, and about IP-address sharing, notice-and-take-down, investigation, vital-sector cooperation and the need for regulation. The minister rejected the claim of inaction, explained the data handling and legal limits, reported an ongoing criminal investigation, and promised an updated cyber security strategy and forthcoming incident-reporting legislation.
The NCSC had no legal basis to view and process the remaining substantive and possibly sensitive data.
Het NCSC had geen rechtsbasis om de resterende inhoudelijke en mogelijk gevoelige gegevens in te zien en te verwerken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Marcouch en Ypma over een illegale verstandelijk gehandicapte jongen die in een schoolbus is opgepakt en een week in vreemdelingenbewaring heeft verbleven

MPs Recourt, Marcouch and Ypma asked the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice about a mentally disabled undocumented youth stopped in a car and held in immigration detention for about a week, asking why he was detained, whether his vulnerability was considered, and whether a 48-hour judicial review should be introduced. The state secretary answered that the vulnerability was unknown to police and not reported, detention was justified by the risk of absconding, compensation was offered, and a future policy vision would follow, while declining to examine the case further beyond answering the questions.
Personal information about the person concerned and his immigration status has been limited as much as possible in these answers, given his privacy.
Persoonlijke informatie over betrokkene en zijn vreemdelingrechtelijke status is zo veel als mogelijk beperkt in deze antwoorden, gelet op zijn privacy.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Commission to test the efficiency of national courts’ en ‘ook in uw stad een EU rechter’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the EU Justice Scoreboard amounts to European control over national judges and a step toward a single European legal system. The minister replied that the scoreboard is a voluntary Commission data-collection tool for improving national court efficiency and does not assess or control individual judges.
The system offers member states an instrument with which they can, on a voluntary basis, improve national legal systems
Het systeem biedt lidstaten een instrument aan waarmee deze – op vrijwillige basis – de nationale rechtssystemen kunnen verbeteren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes over afgebroken 100 procentcontrole op harddrugs op Schiphol

PVV MPs De Roon and Bontes asked whether a 100 percent drug control on a Paramaribo flight was stopped because passengers threatened to run amok, why it was not completed, what the usual seized weights are, and what guidelines apply to resistance. The minister refers to earlier answers on the same matter, gives 2012 seizure figures of 339 kilograms of net cocaine from couriers plus 128 kilograms in cargo, and states that the Customs service calls in the Royal Marechaussee in case of violence or threats.
In case of resistance with violence or threat of violence, Customs calls in the Royal Marechaussee.
In geval van verzet met geweld of dreiging met geweld schakelt de Douane de Koninklijke Marechaussee in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat een 100 procentcontrole door de Koninklijke Marechaussee is gestaakt vanwege het protest van passagiers

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence whether the Royal Marechaussee's full 100 percent check of a Suriname flight was halted due to passenger protest, and how such influence will be prevented in future. The minister confirmed the report, said the full check of all passengers and baggage found no weapons or narcotics and was not cut short, and stated that passengers cannot influence how checks are carried out, though a check may be stopped for passenger safety and welfare after a risk analysis.
Passengers cannot exert influence through protest over the manner in which the checks are carried out.
Passagiers kunnen door middel van protest geen invloed uitoefenen op de wijze van de uitvoering van de controles.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het bericht dat GHB de nieuwe heroïne is

Mr Van der Steur (VVD) asked whether GHB is becoming the new heroin, whether GHB addiction is rising sharply, and what the government will do about monitoring, detection, prevention, enforcement, asset confiscation, treatment costs and the newer drug Krokodil. Minister Opstelten answered that GHB addiction cases rose from about 60 in 2007 to nearly 800 in 2012, outlined treatment and prevention measures, and said existing enforcement tools are sufficient while declining to quantify illicit GHB profits.
Information on the unlawfully obtained benefit in GHB cases cannot be generated from the Public Prosecution Service's business process systems.
Informatie over het wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel in GHB-zaken kan niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht “Erdogan maakt werk van Yunus”

MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked whether Turkey taking the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights infringes Dutch sovereignty, and whether Turkey's EU accession should be rejected. The minister answered that it has not been confirmed Turkey has referred the case, and that the government sees no reason to change its policy supporting Turkey's accession perspective.
It has not been confirmed that Turkey is referring the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights.
Het is niet bevestigd dat Turkije de zaak Yunus aan het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens voorlegt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht  “Onrust over VKB-regeling”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism that the new Vkb small-business security scheme was rushed, unequal for suppliers, non-transparent in its criteria and lacking appeal options. The minister defended the open tender run by the CCV with an independent adviser, said the criteria were not specified in the invitation, denied that only one supplier was designated, and promised evaluation of the scheme in autumn 2013.
The Centre for Crime Prevention and Safety (CCV) is responsible for implementing the new approach and has partly its own freedom of action and assessment within the frameworks set by my ministry.

Het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid (CCV) is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering de nieuwe aanpak en heeft binnen de door mijn ministerie gestelde kaders deels een eigen handelings- en beoordelingsvrijheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Bergkamp over het capaciteitsverlies van de Koninklijke Marechaussee door het handhaven van het qat-verbod

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice how enforcement of the qat ban affects Marechaussee capacity, qat use, prices, illegal trade, addiction, and local nuisance. The Minister answered that qat enforcement is incidental for the KMar, that no data yet show reduced use or rising illegal trade, and that municipalities can already act under the Opium Act and the local Public Order Ordinance (APV).
There is as yet no data showing that the qat ban leads to less qat use.
Er zijn nog geen gegevens voorhanden waaruit zou blijken dat het qatverbod leidt tot minder qatgebruik
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de recente rechtspraak van de Hoge Raad met betrekking tot witwassen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a recent Supreme Court ruling that possessing proceeds of one's own offence may not qualify as money laundering unless it conceals criminal origin, and whether this undermines prosecution and asset confiscation. The minister answered that prosecution for laundering remains possible where possession conceals or disguises criminal origin, that the legislature intended both offences to be prosecutable, that no legislative change is currently considered, and that confiscation cannot follow an acquittal.
For the time being I see no reason to consider a legislative amendment.
Voorshands zie ik geen reden om een wetswijziging te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over tot geweld bereide moslima’s

PVV MPs asked whether Islam calls on Muslims to use violence, how large the group of Muslim women willing to commit violence is, and what measures will counter the long-term risk. The minister says the research sample is not representative so no extrapolation is possible, and refers to the terrorism threat assessment and existing counter-radicalisation measures.
Based on the study 'Radicaal (On)zichtbaar' referred to in the cited newspaper article, no estimate can be made here.
Op basis van het onderzoek «Radicaal (On)zichtbaar» waar het geciteerde krantenartikel naar verwijst kan hier geen schatting van gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat supermarktketens weigeren effectieve naleving van leeftijdgrenzen bij alcoholverkoop toe te passen

Two MPs asked the government about reports that supermarket chains resist effective age checks for alcohol sales, including remote age-verification systems. The state secretary answered that compliance is the supermarkets' own responsibility, that the burgomaster supervises compliance and can impose sanctions, and that the government has contacted the VNG and will evaluate the law after three years.
However, it is up to the supermarkets themselves to determine how the age limits for the sale of alcoholic beverages are complied with and which systems they use for this.
Het is echter aan de supermarkten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze de leeftijdsgrenzen bij de verkoop van alcoholhoudende dranken worden nageleefd en welke systemen zij daarvoor hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders over 100 Nederlandse Jihadisten die vechten in het buitenland

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked whether Dutch jihadists fighting abroad should be detained on return in a special terrorist wing, how many hold dual nationality or residence permits, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister answered that suspects would be placed in the existing Terrorist Wing, declined to give numbers or individual cases, said most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and described immigration measures and the possibility of revoking Dutch nationality after a terrorism conviction where statelessness does not result.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff en Aukje de Vries over het bericht banken te laks met de aanpak van cybercrime

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Finance about a report that banks were too lax in tackling cybercrime, questioning the banks' cooperation and the value of a working group. The ministers replied that cooperation is good, fraud fell 60% in late 2012, banks will place a liaison at the NCSC, and a mandatory breach-notification law is being prepared.
Given the seriousness of the cybercrime threat, a still greater effort than is already being made must be delivered across the board, including by the banking sector.
Gezien de ernst van de dreiging van cybercrime moet evenwel over de hele linie een nog grotere inspanning dan nu al het geval is worden geleverd, ook door de bancaire sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders over de enorme toename van het aantal «Nederlandse» jihadisten

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in Dutch jihadists, whether the government has oversight of them, their dual nationality, Islam's teaching on jihad, and deportation or denaturalisation of jihadists with dual nationality. The minister said the AIVD keeps as much oversight as possible, declined to give numbers or individual cases, noted most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and explained that citizenship can be revoked only for those with another nationality who are finally convicted of terrorism.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen Oskam over het bericht Intern onderzoek naar vervalsing telefoontaps

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a Alkmaar court found falsified wiretap transcripts, leading to the prosecution being declared inadmissible and the defendant being freed pending appeal. The minister confirmed the court's findings on four inaccurate transcripts and related concerns, and said an internal police investigation was launched instead of the Rijksrecherche, which could be called in later.
It was decided to have the investigation carried out by a separate unit within the Noord-Holland police, namely the Safety, Integrity and Complaints department.
Besloten is het onderzoek te laten verrichten door een aparte afdeling binnen de politie Noord-Holland, te weten de afdeling Veiligheid, Integriteit en Klachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het incassobeleid van het Centraal Justitieel Incasso Bureau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the CJIB's automatic surcharges on traffic fines, where a small underpayment (e.g. a EUR 6 typo) led to a large penalty. The minister defended the surcharge system as a payment incentive, declined to change the law, but committed the CJIB to fixed criteria for unreasonable cases and to clearer warnings on the payment notice.

To respond more specifically to the problem, I have asked the CJIB to develop, within the framework of the current implementation policy, fixed criteria for determining when an unreasonable situation exists.

Om meer gericht tegemoet te komen aan de problematiek heb ik het CJIB gevraagd om binnen de kaders van het huidige uitvoeringsbeleid te komen tot vaste criteria om te bepalen in welke gevallen sprake is van een onredelijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht «Nederland groot en snel groeiend leverancier jihadstrijders» en het rapport «Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland»

An MP asks the government about the reported growth of Dutch citizens joining jihadist fighters abroad, the risks of returnees, possible criminal liability, and whether citizenship can be revoked. The minister answers that about a hundred Dutch residents have joined, outlines the threat from returnees, explains that membership of a criminal organisation requires specific conditions, and states that citizenship can be withdrawn only after a final terrorism conviction for dual nationals, with AIVD reports usable as investigative starting points or evidence subject to judicial scrutiny.
However, it is not plausible that the Netherlands would stand out from various other European countries regarding jihad travellers.
Het is echter niet aannemelijk dat Nederland wat jihadreizigers betreft uit de pas zou lopen met diverse andere Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en De Liefde over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten kiezen voor het vrijwillig melden van cybersecurity incidenten

Two MPs from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about reports that the United States opts for voluntary reporting of cybersecurity incidents while the EU proposes a mandatory reporting duty, and about the consequences for Dutch citizens, businesses and cloud computing. The minister answered that the EU proposal does include a reporting obligation, that Dutch legislation on a reporting duty is being prepared, that the US executive order relies on voluntary sharing with privacy safeguards, and that the government will take the differences into account in EU negotiations.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Oskam en Keijzer over het bericht dat een meisje misbruikt is door haar groepsleider in de instelling van de Hoenderloo Groep waar zij verbleef voor behandeling als gevolg van misbruik door l

MPs Oskam and Keijzer asked whether a youth care group leader's abuse of a girl at the Hoenderloo Groep was reported to the Inspectie Jeugdzorg, what the institution did, whether other victims were investigated, the status of the criminal case, and whether the suspect could still work with minors. The government answered that the inspectorate required improved reporting and protocols, no other victims were found, the investigation is in its final phase, and mandatory VOG screening for youth care staff is being introduced.
The inspectorate pointed out to the Hoenderloo Groep that in future it must itself report such an incident promptly.
De inspectie heeft de Hoenderloo Groep (DHG) erop gewezen dat zij in het vervolg een dergelijke calamiteit zelf en tijdig dient te melden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel en Kooiman over de bedreiging van enkele jongeren uit Arnhem aan het adres van een stadsgenoot

MPs asked whether a Turkish man who publicly condemned antisemitic remarks by young Turks in Arnhem went into hiding after death threats, and whether the victim was supported and the perpetrators identified. The minister answered that the mayor advised him to stay elsewhere temporarily, police found no concrete threats, no complaint was filed, and the prosecutor opened an investigation into one minor for group insult, leading to a educational sanction.
Police research shows there is no question of concrete threats against the Turkish man or his family.
Uit onderzoek van de politie blijkt dat er geen sprake is van concrete bedreigingen tegen de Turkse man of zijn gezin.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over NL-Alert

An SP MP asks the Minister of Safety and Justice about the operation of the NL-Alert emergency warning system, including differing regional protocols, delays in use, message content and public awareness. The Minister replies that NL-Alert is still in its start-up phase, that agreements with the safety regions are in place and will be evaluated, and that a public campaign has been run.
Because NL-Alert is in its start-up phase, I am closely following developments and use in the regions.
Omdat NL-Alert in opstartfase verkeert, volg ik de ontwikkelingen en het gebruik in de regio's op de voet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Recourt en De Wit over een ontslagen notaris die als kandidaat op zijn eigen kantoor verder werkt

MPs asked why a notary struck from the office could re-register as a candidate notary and continue working at his own firm, and whether the law should be amended to close this gap. The minister answered that the candidate notary works under a notary's responsibility, that disciplinary and supervisory tools already address such cases, and that amending the law is not warranted given pending appeal proceedings.
Supervision and disciplinary law are therefore effective instruments to intervene in situations like this.
Het toezicht en het tuchtrecht zijn dus effectieve instrumenten om in situaties als deze in te grijpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Bontes over het bericht dat Europese superspionnen het recht krijgen om persoonlijke informatie zoals e-mails, websitebezoeken, medische data en politie bestanden in te zien

MPs Madlener and Bontes asked whether reports that EU 'super spies' would gain access to citizens' emails, website visits, medical data and police records are accurate, and whether the EU agency ENISA should be abolished. The minister replied that the report conflates a non-binding cybersecurity strategy with a Commission directive, that ENISA has no operational or investigative powers, and that the government will ensure the existing EU data protection framework is respected.
The report is not correct and, in my view, is not accurate.
Het bericht klopt niet en is mijns inziens niet accuraat.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat er een zelfbenoemde genezer actief is die beweert kanker te kunnen genezen

MP Van Gerven asked whether the government would act against a self-declared healer claiming to cure cancer, including IGZ intervention, tax checks, prosecution under unfair trade rules, and amending the Wet BIG. Minister Schippers said the claims are unacceptable, IGZ can only act once harm is shown, no criminal grounds exist yet, the ACM will be informed, and the Wcz amendment will let IGZ act against harmful alternative providers.
I will bring the broadcast about the Natuur Geneeskundig Centrum Energy Healing to the attention of the ACM.
Ik zal de uitzending over het Natuur Geneeskundig Centrum Energy Healing onder de aandacht brengen van het ACM.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken over berichten vanuit Oostenrijk met betrekking tot signalen van matchfixing in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports from Austrian bookmakers flagging suspicious betting on Dutch Eredivisie matches and whether the Dutch matchfixing investigation could use that information. The minister replied that no such Austrian warning system was found to exist, the information came from a UEFA analyst of doubtful relevance, and UEFA's betting fraud system found no irregular betting on the two matches checked.
Inquiries with the Austrian bookmakers' organisation revealed, however, that information about the Eredivisie matches in question was not provided by that organisation.
Navraag bij de Oostenrijkse organisatie van wedkantoren heeft echter geleerd dat informatie over de bedoelde wedstrijden uit de eredivisie niet door deze organisatie is verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over preventief fouilleren

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the current system of preventive frisking should be overhauled, given its privacy costs and disproportionate police effort, and whether frisking should be selective under judicial supervision. The minister agrees that targeting could be improved using objective selection criteria, but rejects leaving selection to police intuition under supervision of a rectercommissaris, and says the surprise effect already exists and training is adequate.
Without an objective, verifiable criterion, supervision by an examining magistrate of the lawfulness of the selection is not meaningful.
Zonder een objectief, controleerbaar criterium is toezicht door een rechter-commissaris op de rechtmatigheid van de selectie niet zinvol.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over het bericht ‘FBI-agenten hacken mee met de Nederlandse politie’ en de detentieomstandigheden van de Nederlander in de Verenigde Staten

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked the Justice Minister about reports that FBI agents work embedded in Dutch police cybercrime units and about the detention of Dutch national David S. in the US, including whether Dutch authorities were informed of his arrest in Romania and whether his transfer back to the Netherlands can be expedited. The minister answered that the Netherlands had no role in the arrest, that no investigative acts took place on Dutch soil without consent, that a liaison officer's role is governed by Dutch law, and that he is willing to contact US authorities to speed up a transfer request once the sentence is final.
I am willing to contact the American authorities in this case to expedite the procedure where possible.
Ik ben bereid in deze zaak met de Amerikaanse autoriteiten contact op te nemen om zo mogelijk de procedure te bespoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht Belagers hulpverleners zwaarder gestraft

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why prosecutors' sentence demands for violence against care workers fall below the BOS guideline, and whether the minister is responsible for steering the Public Prosecution Service. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a Tilburg replication study and to a College of Procurators-General investigation into deviations from the guideline, and promised to report the outcome to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Wit over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie gelogen heeft in een zedenzaak

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how police and the Public Prosecution Service could have lied and made errors in a Breda sex-crime case, and what consequences and redress would follow for the wrongly suspected man. The minister answered only by referring to a separate letter to parliament sent the same day, without addressing the questions on substance.
For the answers to these questions I refer to the letter (Parliamentary Paper II 33400-VI, no. 99) that I sent to your House today on this case.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief (Kamerstuk II 33400-VI, nr. 99 ) die ik uw Kamer heden heb toegezonden over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de uitzending van De Vijfde Dag op 27 februari 2013

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a broadcast showing a prosecutor allegedly lying was accurate, and whether the government would investigate, inform parliament and take action against the prosecutor. The minister referred all six questions to a separate letter to parliament sent the same day.
For the answers to these questions I refer to the letter (Parliamentary paper II 33 400-VI, no. 99) that I sent to your House today on this matter.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief (Kamerstuk II 33 400-VI, nr. 99 ) die ik uw Kamer heden heb toegezonden over deze zaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het bericht dat het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie slecht samenwerkt met de Nationale ombudsman

SP MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to respond to press reports that the ministry cooperates poorly with the National Ombudsman, whose criticism described it as immune to criticism and hard to work with. Minister Opstelten answered that he takes the criticism note of, responds to all requests, follows most recommendations, holds consultations where he does not adopt one, and will consult the ombudsman more often and improve deadline monitoring.
I answer all requests from the ombudsman.
Ik geef op alle verzoeken van de ombudsman antwoord.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het verwisselen van identiteitspapieren

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked about a RamBam broadcast showing identity documents being swapped, enabling bank accounts, car rentals, Schiphol border passage and an ID card with another person's photo. The ministers confirm the facts, describe the Marechaussee's checks and planned training, and announce a review of the reisdocument application process.
This also applies if a photo of someone else is accepted when applying for an identity card.
Dit geldt ook als een foto van iemand anders wordt geaccepteerd bij de aanvraag van een identiteitskaart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over het negeren van een rijverbod door een dronken chauffeur

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a drunk bus driver who kept driving despite a driving ban and whether employers are informed when an employee loses their licence. The minister said employers are not named in the licence regulations, that the public prosecutor can inform transport employers case by case, and that no general employer notification duty is planned.
In view of this, I see no reason to create, for example, a general notification duty for employers.
Gelet hierop zie ik geen aanleiding om bijvoorbeeld een algemene meldplicht aan werkgevers in het leven te roepen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat internetoplichting voortaan een zaak voor de civiele rechter zou zijn

MP Gesthuizen asked whether a Supreme Court ruling means internet fraud where payment is taken but goods are not delivered can no longer be prosecuted as embezzlement, and whether it should instead be treated as a civil matter. Minister Opstelten answered that embezzlement no longer applies but fraud (oplichting) may still apply in some cases, and that he will consult the Public Prosecution Service on whether new criminal options are needed.
Following the ruling, I will consult with the Public Prosecution Service to examine whether, and if so how, new criminal law options should be created.
Ik zal naar aanleiding van het arrest in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie bezien of, en zo ja op welke wijze, nieuwe strafrechtelijk mogelijkheden gecreëerd moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over in België woonachtige verdachten van een mishandeling te Eindhoven

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Belgium will still extradite minor residents suspected of crimes abroad after a Belgian Court of Cassation ruling, and who prosecutes them if not. The minister answered that nationality is not a ground for refusal under the EAW framework, that age can be, that the ruling concerned enforcement of a sentence so its effect on prosecution warrants is unclear, and that under aut dedere aut judicare Belgium must prosecute if it refuses extradition, including minors under Belgian youth law.
It remains to be seen whether the Court of Cassation will follow similar reasoning for a European arrest warrant for the purpose of prosecution.
Het valt te bezien of het Hof van Cassatie een analoge redenering zal volgen voor een aanhoudingsbevel ter fine van vervolging.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Oskam over het bericht dat ZZP’ers (zelfstandigen zonder personeel) slachtoffer zijn van cybercriminaliteit

MPs Agnes Mulder and Oskam asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice whether they recognise a trend of cybercriminals targeting sole traders and small firms, some going bankrupt, and what will be done about it. The government said it has no information on such a trend or on bankruptcy figures, points to an ongoing police study and a planned survey in Flevoland, and lists awareness campaigns and websites for SMEs and sole traders.
We have no information about the trend reported in the article that cybercriminals increasingly target sole traders and small firms.
Wij hebben geen informatie over de in het artikel gesignaleerde trend dat cybercriminelen het in toenemende mate voorzien hebben op eenmansbedrijven en kleine ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over de stijgende kosten van een aansluitovereenkomst brandbeveiligingsinstallaties

Two SP MPs asked why the fee for a fire alarm connection agreement in Noord-Holland Noord rose sharply and whether businesses are unfairly burdened as the regional safety board compensates lost income. The minister replied that the safety board, as the responsible authority, chose the tariff increase and that the matter is a local responsibility, while offering to take no action beyond noting the board's role.
The decision to compensate the shortfall from falling OMS subscriber numbers by raising the OMS tariff from 1 January 2013 was taken by the daily board of the safety region.

Het besluit om het tekort door de daling in de aantallen OMS-abonnees te compenseren door een verhoging van het OMS-tarief per 1 januari 2013 is genomen door het dagelijks bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Kooiman en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat er geen sms wordt verzonden via AMBER Alert na 22 uur

MPs Oskam, Kooiman and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether AMBER Alert SMS messages are withheld between 22:00 and 07:00 and why, and whether differentiated night-time delivery could be arranged. The minister confirmed that night-time SMS alerts were stopped after complaints about disturbed sleep, and promised a website option allowing participants to opt in to night-time SMS within one to one and a half months.
There was a risk that participants would drop out because they were disturbed at night by incoming SMS messages.
Het risico ontstond dat deelnemers zouden afhaken omdat ze ’s nachts gestoord worden door binnenkomende SMS-berichten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Bruins Slot over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Bruins Slot asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about matchfixing, including Belgian and German approaches, the claim that Dutch enforcement is lax, possible prosecution of Dutch nationals abroad, and the need for special investigative powers or a dedicated unit at the Public Prosecution Service. Minister Opstelten replied that there are no concrete indications of matchfixing in the Netherlands, that investigations will start if signals arise, that a German investigation concerns Dutch suspects and falls under territoriality, and that special powers and a new unit are not currently justified.
There is no question of concrete indications regarding matchfixing in the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake van concrete aanwijzingen met betrekking tot matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bontes over een inbreker die een klacht indient tegen een schietende agent en de reactie daarop van de politieleiding

An MP asked whether the police leadership wrongly abandoned an officer who shot a fleeing burglar, and whether the official instruction on firearm use should be changed. The minister replied that the shooting was found unlawful due to inadequate training on the instruction, that the officer cannot be prosecuted due to a successful mistake-of-law defence, and that the instruction needs no amendment, though training attention will be increased.
The investigation showed that the agent's use of the firearm in this specific situation was not lawful.
Uit het onderzoek is gebleken dat het gebruik van het vuurwapen door de agent in deze specifieke situatie niet rechtmatig was.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over illegale lozing door zeeschepen

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked the ministers about illegal night-time oil discharges by sea-going vessels, enforcement and detection chances, fines compared with Belgium and France, and port reception facilities. The minister acknowledged night-time discharges are harder to detect and that enforcement is difficult, promised further study of detection and fines, and said EU-level tightening of waste discharge obligations is preferred.

I of course also have the ambition to further reduce illegal discharges and will examine the report's conclusions and recommendations on increasing the chance of detection for feasibility and effectiveness.

Ik heb uiteraard ook de ambitie om de illegale lozingen verder terug te dringen en ga de conclusies en aanbevelingen uit het rapport inzake het verhogen van de pakkans onderzoeken op uitvoerbaarheid en effectiviteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Heijnen over het ontslaan van Hells Angels in dienst van de overheid

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers whether dismissing civil servants who belong to outlaw motorcycle clubs such as Hells Angels fits the criminal-justice approach, and whether central government employs such people. The government answered that membership is undesirable for civil servants, that existing integrity and employment law allows measures including dismissal, and that it will promote the norm to other governments and update the integrity code, without a separate investigation.
Since the procedure within the municipality is still ongoing, no further comment can be made on the specific status and functions of the employees.
Aangezien de procedure binnen de gemeente nog loopt, kan verder niet op de specifieke stand van zaken en de functies van de medewerkers worden ingegaan
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Sterfgevallen niet als verdacht herkend, talloze moorden blijven onbekend’ en ‘Slordig met slachtoffers’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether unnatural deaths are going unrecognised and murders unsolved because autopsies are not ordered, and whether a national protocol and a changed criterion for autopsy are needed. The minister said the procedure for non-natural deaths is clear, that the Public Prosecution Service orders autopsies whenever a coroner suspects a crime, that the two cases are under investigation and could not be discussed, and that no change of criterion is planned.
In the interest of these investigations, I cannot address whether the reporting on these cases is accurate.
In het belang van deze onderzoeken kan ik niet ingaan op de vraag of de berichtgeving over deze zaken correct is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over de aanhouding van Willem II fans te Utrecht

Two MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about the arrest of around 42 Willem II supporters in Utrecht and whether a combi-ticket scheme would have prevented it, plus what legal remedies the supporters had and how this fits the planned Voetbalwet changes. The minister explained the police and municipal reasoning for the arrests, said complaints and objections via a bestuurlijke strafbeschikking were available, and argued a combi-ticket scheme was unlikely to have prevented the incident.
The police surrounded and arrested a large group.
Door de politie werd een grote groep ingesloten en aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanbesteding van het dienstpistool van de politie

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about problems in the tender for the new police service pistol, including legal costs, the test ammunition, the PPQ valve-safety failure and the choice of the P99Q. The minister acknowledges the tender did not run smoothly, rejects an independent investigation, and defends the procedure and the safety of the chosen pistol.
I therefore see no reason to have an independent investigation carried out into these tenders.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden voor het laten uitvoeren van een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar deze aanbestedingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Oosenbrug en Eijsink over het Mandiant Intelligence Center-rapport over massale cyber-spionage in de Verenigde Staten door een groep hackers (APT1) in Shanghai

MPs Bonis, Oosenbrug and Eijsink asked whether the government would act on the Mandiant report on Chinese state-linked cyber-espionage (APT1) against firms in English-speaking countries, including possible targeting of Dutch firms, and on contacts with China and EU/UN action. The government answered that it lacks conclusive proof but the report fits the known threat picture, described existing AIVD/MIVD/NCSC measures and EU-China contacts, and said it will keep raising cyber-espionage internationally without committing to a new specific step.
We do not have conclusive evidence for this conclusion.
Wij beschikken voor deze conclusie niet over sluitend bewijs.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Ziengs over het vonnis van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland d.d. 20 februari 2013 en daaropvolgende publicaties op de website van VNO-NCW d.d. 21 februari 2013 inzake acquisitiefrau

MPs Van Oosten and Ziengs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a court ruling on acquisition fraud and VNO-NCW's call for political action, including whether legislation should protect small businesses as consumers are protected. The minister reported the damage figures, outlined preventive and enforcement measures, declined comment on the pending case, and said EU-wide action is preferred over national legislation, with alternatives still being explored.
Since the period for appeal in this court case is still running, I refrain from substantive comment on this ruling.
Aangezien de termijn voor hoger beroep in deze rechtszaak nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van inhoudelijk commentaar op deze uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over drugssmokkel via de Antwerpse Haven

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cocaine smuggling through the port of Antwerp, including enforcement against Dutch suspects, asset confiscation, the role of the Royal Marechaussee, cooperation with other EU states, and Belgian measures. The minister answered that police figures do not separate cocaine by country of origin, that about 8 million euros was confiscated in 2012 for cocaine and heroin related activity, that no overview of failed confiscations or sentences is kept, and that existing structures and cooperation are adequate.
The OM has informed me that no overviews are available of cases in which confiscation fails, or of the sentences imposed for this form of smuggling and the number of suspects successfully convicted.

Het OM heeft mij meegedeeld dat geen overzichten beschikbaar zijn van gevallen waarin ontnemen niet lukt, of van de straffen die zijn opgelegd voor deze vorm van smokkel en het aantal verdachten dat met succes is veroordeeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het optreden van de AIVD in de zaak Sabir K.

The SP MP Van Raak asked whether the AIVD investigated the Sabir K. case early on, whether it acted for the CIA or also examined CIA conduct, whether evidence obtained through torture in Pakistan can be excluded, and why the Netherlands does not prosecute K., a Dutch national, itself. The ministers declined to say publicly whether the AIVD investigated early, said the AIVD does no work on behalf of other services, relied on US court findings and treaty obligations on torture evidence, and explained that prosecution in the US is most logical given the location of the offence, evidence and extradition request.
I cannot make any public statements about this.
Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over de opvang van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP from the Labour party asks whether a merger of youth care institutions will remove closed-care places where girls who are victims of loverboys can be treated, and whether separate care for girls will remain available. The state secretary replies that places are not closed, that a mixed-gender pilot has started, that girl-only specialist groups still exist in youth care plus, and that Fier Fryslân will cooperate with Horizon on specialist trajectories.
No, there is a merger, not the closing of places.
Nee, er is sprake van een fusie, niet van het sluiten van plekken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Van der Steur over rechters die hun nevenfuncties niet opgeven
