MPs Recourt and Van der Steur asked the Justice Minister why some judges have not fully registered their ancillary positions, and whether this undermines trust in the judiciary. The minister answered that the registration duty took effect on 1 January 2013, that the courts' boards are checking the register, that he will press the Council for the judiciary and the judges' association to keep it complete, and that a bill on sanctions against judges will go to consultation by 1 April 2013.
I consider it, like the Council and the NVvR, of great importance that the register of ancillary positions is current and complete.
Ik acht het – evenals de Raad en de NVvR – van groot belang dat het register nevenbetrekkingen actueel en volledig is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de illegale import van qat in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice minister about illegal qat imports from England by ferry, the size of the trade, customs controls, enforcement measures, and cooperation with the UK, including a ban there. The minister answered that customs apply risk-based integral controls, that enforcement after the January 2013 criminalisation is showing early results, that only official-level contact with UK authorities has occurred, and that the UK does not intend to list qat.
Since qat was included in the Opium Act on 5 January 2013, I do not have figures on the scale and market value of illegal imports.
Sinds qat op 5 januari 2013 in de Opiumwet werd opgenomen beschik ik niet over cijfers over de omvang en marktwaarde van illegale importen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over inbeslagnames van qat

MP Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about qat seizures after the drug's ban, including whether flights and a warehouse trade had stopped and whether the Somali-community use had fallen. The minister replied that smuggling via cargo and passengers is checked on a sample basis, recent seizures came from England, and the ban will be evaluated after two years as the House requested.
In line with the House's wish expressed in motion 2, the government will evaluate the qat ban after two years, focusing on effectiveness and side effects.
Conform de wens die uw Kamer per motie 2 heeft uitgesproken zal de regering het verbod op qat na twee jaar evalueren, met aandacht voor effectiviteit en neveneffecten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over de vangst van 900 kilo qat tijdens een grenscontrole op de A16

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about a seizure of 900 kilos of qat at the A16 border check, whether qat trade has grown since the ban, and how the ban is being enforced and publicized among Somali communities. The minister answered that there are no signs of increased trade, that enforcement attention has increased and the seizures indicate success, and that information on the ban has been distributed to a broad network with further consultations planned.
Since 5 January 2013 the investigative services have given extra attention to the criminalisation of possession of qat.
Binnen de opsporingsdiensten is sinds 5 januari 2013 extra aandacht gegeven aan de strafbaarstelling van het bezit van qat
Antwoord vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten nog meer mogelijkheden heeft om in clouddata graaien

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw (D66) asked whether US law (the FISAA, extended on 30 December 2012) lets US authorities access personal data stored in the EU by US-based cloud providers, and what the consequences and remedies are. The state secretary answered that the Act grants no new powers, that no concrete cases of such demands for EU-stored data are known (US authorities say requests go via mutual legal assistance), and that the government will raise the issue in the EU data protection regulation negotiations.
Negotiations are under way in Brussels on a General Data Protection Regulation.
Er wordt in Brussel onderhandeld over een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het onderzoeken en het tijdig voorkomen van pedofilie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked about the lack of research on female paedophilia, the availability of help for people with paedophilic feelings, the Stop It Now! helpline and its funding. The minister answered that no separate figures on female offenders or the hidden group exist, that existing bodies do not distinguish offenders by sex, and that funding for Stop It Now! will be reviewed with VWS and reported in April 2013.
Figures on the size of the hidden group of (female) paedophiles do not exist as far as I am aware.
Cijfers over de omvang van de verborgen groep (vrouwelijke) pedofielen bestaan voor zover ik weet niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het publiceren van 112-meldingen op internet

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about websites publishing 112 emergency call details, including addresses of callers or incidents, and how this fits with privacy and the legal basis. The minister said the Police Act 2012 permits sharing incident data where serious privacy intrusion is absent, that a guideline is coming in early 2013, that encrypted P2000 messaging will end scanning, and that he will consult journalists' association on agreements.
I share your concerns about the publication of privacy-sensitive data on the internet.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de publicatie van privacy gevoelige gegevens op internet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de voormalige wethouder van Roermond de documenten die door het Openbaar Ministerie zijn gevorderd bij de gemeente Roermond heeft ingezien

MP Oskam asked ministers about a former Roermond alderman who obtained documents seized by the Public Prosecution Service from the municipality, including building project files, and whether rules exist for such requests. The government answered that the municipality handled his requests as Wob requests, that the decision is for the municipality and reviewable in court, that no specific rules exist, and that he must pay fees.
It is up to the municipality to take a decision on the requests.
Het is aan de gemeente om een besluit te nemen naar aanleiding van de verzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over de mogelijke komst van duizenden Marokkanen naar Nederland

Two PVV MPs asked whether the cessation of Dutch child benefit for children living abroad could drive thousands of Moroccan teenagers to the Netherlands, and asked about dual nationality and measures to prevent it. The minister replied that parents freely choose where their children live, that child benefit is only partial support, that the number of affected teenagers is about 1500, and that no measures to prevent such moves are planned.
I do not intend to take measures to prevent children currently living in Morocco from possibly moving to the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan om maatregelen te treffen om te voorkomen dat kinderen die op dit moment in Marokko wonen eventueel in Nederland gaan wonen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Albert de Vries over uitspraken van de president van het gerechtshof Den Bosch

MPs Recourt and De Vries asked the Justice Minister about remarks by the president of the Den Bosch appeals court suggesting higher-appeal hearings would not in principle be held in Middelburg, Zeeland, despite earlier assurances. The minister confirmed the zitting location designation, said court management decides venues, and rejected the claim that no appeal hearings would be held in Middelburg, reaffirming his commitments to Zeeland.
I cannot agree with the claim that in principle no appeal hearings will be held in Middelburg.
Met de stelling dat in beginsel geen hoger beroepzaken in Middelburg worden gedaan, kan ik mij niet verenigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘politie laks bij aangiften’

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police handle citizens' complaints (aangiften) lazily, citing the National Ombudsman's findings, and how this relates to survey data and the importance of reporting crime. The minister acknowledged room for improvement, pointed to the Inspectorate's report and to measures such as multichannel reporting, faster appointments, better website information and feedback on reports, and promised a letter to parliament by mid-2013 on improving the handling of reports.
By mid-2013 I will inform the House about the measures the police are taking to improve the handling of reports.
Medio 2013 zal ik de Kamer informeren over welke maatregelen de politie neemt om de afhandeling van aangiften te verbeteren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat tot tweemaal veroordeelde huisarts nog altijd als bevoegd arts in het BIG-register staat

The CDA MP Bruins Slot asked why a GP convicted twice for child pornography remained registered in the BIG register, why the IGZ did not pursue deregistration, and what options exist. The minister declined to discuss the case citing privacy, pointed to the IGZ-OM cooperation protocol, and announced a plan to require VOG certificates for all medical professionals including self-employed doctors.
Because of the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot go into the background of this specific case.
Omwille van de privacy van betrokkene kan ik niet ingaan op de achtergronden van dit concrete geval.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over een veroordeelde arts die veroordeeld is voor kinderporno, maar nog wel in het BIG-register staat

MP Bouwmeester asks whether it is troubling that a doctor convicted of child pornography remains registered in the BIG register, and how patients can learn of such convictions and how criminal, disciplinary and civil law are linked. The minister says privacy prevents discussing the case, that courts can impose only limited professional bans, that she is consulting on widening those powers, that register entries and publication are in place, and that the prosecutor decides whether to inform the Inspectorate.
I find it unsatisfactory that health professionals who have committed serious sexual or violent offences, and who may reoffend, can (again) practise their profession.
Ik vind het onbevredigend dat beroepsbeoefenaren die ernstige zeden- of geweldsmisdrijven hebben gepleegd, en bij wie een kans op recidive aanwezig is, hun beroep (opnieuw) kunnen uitoefenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over diefstal uit schuren in Oost-Nederland

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Justice Minister about the relatively high rate of theft from sheds in eastern Netherlands, the pursuit of perpetrators, whether stolen goods end up in Eastern Europe, and whether police presence at night and weekends is sufficient. Minister Opstelten answered that such burglaries are a police priority, that a 25% rise in clearance rates is targeted by 2014, that cross-border cooperation exists, and that capacity allocation is for local mayors and the chief public prosecutor to decide.
The number of reports or incidents specifically involving a burglary or theft from a shed is not registered by the police.
Het aantal aangiften of incidenten waarbij het een inbraak of diefstal uit specifiek een schuur betreft wordt niet door de politie geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat het opleiden van nieuwe politiemensen met onmiddellijke ingang is gestopt

MP Marcouch asked the minister whether the national police had halted recruitment and training of new officers, and whether this undermines the coalition goal of more police capacity. The minister denied any training or intake stop for 2013, explained a planned numerus fixus of 800 trainees and admitted that some applicants were wrongly notified before being recontacted.
The police will simply continue training new police officers in 2013.
De politie gaat in 2013 gewoon door met het opleiden van nieuwe politiemensen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over Turkije‘s oorlogstaal en de Nederlandse Patriotmissie

Two PVV MPs asked whether Turkey's accusation that Israel commits state terrorism, and Turkish minister Davutoglu's remarks urging Syria toward war, warrant summoning the Turkish ambassador and withdrawing Dutch Patriot missiles from Turkey. The government replied that Turkey said its remarks were criticism of Assad rather than an incitement to attack Israel, that the Netherlands will keep pressing for steps toward rapprochement, and that it has no information linking a Netherlands-based figure to the Ankara bombing; it rejected withdrawing the Patriots.
The Netherlands will continue to urge Turkey and Israel to take steps that make rapprochement possible.
Nederland zal verder bij Turkije en Israël blijven aandringen op stappen die toenadering mogelijk maken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Wilders over de berichten Werkstraf in plaats van tien weken cel, Oudjaarstuig lacht om straf en Hufters overal buitensluiten

PVV MPs Helder and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice why judges imposed lighter sentences than the prosecution demanded in New Year's Eve 'super-fast court' cases and whether harsher punishments and pink-overall community service should be used. The minister answered that most convictions matched or were close to prosecution demands, that the prosecution appealed some cases, that it raises demands by 75% (200% for assaults on public servants) for event-related crimes, and that the court decides the appropriate sentence.
It is for the judge, taking into account the concrete circumstances of the case, to impose an appropriate sentence.
Het is aan de rechter om, rekening houdend met de concrete omstandigheden van het geval, een passende straf op te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Steur over de berichten over lagere straffen na snelrecht Den Haag en lage straffen voor incidenten tijdens Oud en Nieuw

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why courts gave lighter sentences than the prosecution's 200% demand for violence against emergency workers during New Year's Eve 2012-2013, and whether summary procedures explain this. The minister answered that 732 people were arrested, the 200% surcharge was applied in settlements, the Hague court's lighter sentences were not significantly different from other courts, that courts may lower sentences for individual circumstances, and that the 200% demand will continue under the Veilige Publieke Taak programme.
A judge may impose a lower sentence if the circumstances of the case or the person of the offender give reason for it.
Een rechter kan een lagere straf opleggen als de omstandigheden van het geval of de persoon van de dader daartoe aanleiding geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat werkloze jongeren worden ingezet om de politie administratief te ontlasten

An SP MP asked the Justice minister whether unemployed youths would be deployed to relieve Drenthe police of administrative work from September 2013, and about their selection, duties, training, confidentiality, job prospects, pay, and possible job losses. The minister answered that a pilot in Assen is being evaluated, 10 youths have been placed, they do administrative support under on-the-job training and receive minimum wage, and that the placements do not replace regular police jobs, with no permanent employment prospect.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over regels die een snelle publicatie van beelden mishandeling belemmeren

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice Minister whether rules and waiting lists delay the rapid publication of camera footage of serious assaults, and whether these rules should be changed and police and prosecutors allowed to share footage with other media. The minister answered that publication depends on the case and that such investigative tools must stay under prosecutors' and police control with agreed procedures, and that existing possibilities are sufficient without a new legal basis.
The use of camera footage is already possible to a sufficient degree. Inclusion in the Code of Criminal Procedure as a special investigative power is not necessary for this.
Het gebruik van camerabeelden is reeds in voldoende mate mogelijk. Opname in het Wetboek van Strafvordering als bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid is hiervoor niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een onderzoek dat uitwijst dat een meerderheid van lokale bestuurders voorstander is van een vuurwerkverbod

An MP asked the government whether it would act on a DirectResearch survey showing that most local councillors and mayors favour a ban on consumer fireworks, and whether declining support for fireworks justifies a total ban. The minister answered that the survey sample (420 of 2000 respondents) may not be representative, that municipalities manage fireworks nuisance with existing tools and oppose shorter firing hours, and that most citizens still oppose a ban, so the government sees no reason to change course.
I do not know whether this outcome is representative of the total of around 10,000 councillors in the Netherlands.
Ik weet niet of deze uitkomst representatief is voor het totaal aantal van circa 10.000 raadsleden in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over het bericht dat de afstemming tussen ketenpartners bij de aanpak van huiselijk geweld beter moet

MP Hilkens asked the ministers about reports that coordination among partners in tackling domestic violence must improve, including a fatal Maastricht case, data sharing, and decentralisation. The minister answered that an external commission found inadequate integrated handling and weak steering in Maastricht, that recommendations are being implemented, and that privacy law is not seen as a blocking factor.

However, the commission also concluded that the agencies involved, deviating from the Directive on Domestic and Honour-Related Violence, did not handle this domestic violence case sufficiently in an integrated way.

De commissie heeft echter ook geconcludeerd dat de betrokken instanties, in afwijking van de Aanwijzing Huiselijk Geweld en Eergerelateerd Geweld 2 , deze huiselijk geweldzaak onvoldoende integraal hebben benaderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over het bericht dat kantonrechters regelmatig dubieuze beslissingen nemen

MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a study claiming cantonal judges often make wrong decisions (about 12,500 of 250,000 criminal cases) is valid, whether judges are swayed by prosecutors and whether further research is needed. The minister replied that the Judiciary Council rejects the study's methodology and conclusions, which are not solid enough to base policy or further research on.
Taking this into account, I consider the study's conclusions insufficiently solid to base policy measures or further research on them.
Dit in aanmerking nemende acht ik de conclusies van het onderzoek onvoldoende solide om hier beleidsmaatregelen of nader onderzoek mijnerzijds op te baseren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanpak van groepsgewijze jeugd-criminaliteit en de ontwikkeling van sfeerverbalen in het procesdossier

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about intimidation by youth criminal groups, victims' reluctance to report, and whether 'atmosphere reports' (sfeerverbalen) should be added to criminal case files. The Minister answered that prosecution is hard mainly because individual contributions are hard to establish, that such reports are already used in various districts with no legal obstacle, and that the OM will review experiences with them.
Specifically within the national approach to criminal youth groups, the OM will examine what the experiences with atmosphere reports in such cases are at the various prosecutors' offices.
Specifiek in het kader van de landelijke aanpak van criminele jeugdgroepen zal het OM nagaan wat bij de verschillende parketten de ervaringen met sfeerverbalen in dergelijke zaken zijn
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over opsporingsberichtgeving en eventuele afspraken tussen het openbaar Ministerie en de media

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecution filming shared with the media was delayed by agreements with media partners, and whether these agreements involve exclusivity or commercial interests. The minister replied that the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving allows urgent broadcasts, that there are fixed media partnerships but no exclusivity and no commercial role, and declined to explain the balancing in a pending case.
I cannot give details about the OM's considerations in an individual pending case on which the judge still has to rule.
Ik kan geen details geven over afwegingen van het OM in een individuele lopende zaak waarover de rechter nog moet oordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de strijd tegen de drugscriminaliteit en de wens van gemeenten wietteelt te legaliseren

MP Kooiman asks the Justice minister about the rising cannabis cultivation problem, police capacity and costs, insurer claims, and whether municipalities may experiment with regulated cannabis cultivation. The minister says the fight against organised cannabis cultivation remains a top priority and cites an integrated approach, but says police capacity is not earmarked and costs are not broken down, and rejects regulated cultivation as contrary to UN, EU and Dutch law, promising only an inventory and a study to be reported by year-end.
Police capacity is not specifically earmarked.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over de berichten ‘Bijbanenregister rechters nog vol hiaten’, ‘Veel rechters verzwijgen bijbaan’ en ‘Verbazing over het niet melden bijbanen rechters’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about press reports that the register of judges' side jobs was incomplete and that many judges concealed their secondary positions, and whether judges' independence, conflict-of-interest rules and sanctions should be tightened. The minister said the register is being updated, that the recusal and challenge instruments work well, that a broader disciplinary sanctions bill goes to consultation by 1 April 2013, but that failing to disclose a side job does not automatically imply conflict of interest.
I agree that conflict of interest on the part of a judge is unacceptable and that it is appropriate to respond with a sanction.
Ik deel de mening dat belangenverstrengeling van een rechter ontoelaatbaar is en dat het gepast is daarop te reageren met een sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de achterstand van Nederland in de strijd tegen matchfixing

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers why the Netherlands lags behind criminal networks in combating match-fixing, including whether football associations can detect it and whether reporters are protected. The minister answered that a study by the ministries started on 23 January 2013, that anonymous reporting is possible, and that protective measures will be considered after the study's results.
For that reason, reporters are given the opportunity to tell their story anonymously within the ministries' study, via a web survey and a telephone reporting option.
Om die reden wordt melders in het kader van het onderzoek van onze ministeries via een webenquête en een telefonische meldingsmogelijkheid de mogelijkheid gegeven om anoniem hun verhaal te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Marcouch over het vechten voor een schone vechtsport

MPs Van Dekken and Marcouch asked ministers about inadequate medical oversight, instructor quality, criminal links and the need for a sports commission in the martial arts sector. The minister acknowledged problems, reported a RIEC report finding criminal links at nearly half of events, noted municipalities are amending local rules, and said she would consult stakeholders on a commission before the summer recess.
I am willing to invite a number of relevant stakeholders to explore what could be a good and feasible way forward in this matter.
Ik ben bereid een aantal relevante stakeholders uit te nodigen om te verkennen wat in deze een goede en begaanbare weg zou kunnen zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de beveiliging van de website van het UWV

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked about an expired security certificate on the UWV complaints webpage, its risks, whether data was intercepted, and UWV's security policy. Minister Asscher answered that the outdated certificate was in use from 21 January to 1 February 2013, was fixed once discovered, that no misuse or intrusion was found, and that UWV's security measures are regularly audited.
Unfortunately, the outdated certificate was mistakenly used in that process.
Helaas is daarbij abusievelijk het verouderde certificaat gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over pedofiele praktijken door vrouwen

MPs from VVD, SP, D66 and CDA asked the Justice Minister about a broadcast on female paedophile practices, including whether the conduct is prosecutable, whether a new network exists, and whether police and prosecutors are aware of female offenders. The minister condemned the conduct, said the OM is cooperating with Greek investigators and will assess Dutch prosecution, and confirmed existing awareness of female offenders while referring to earlier answers.

In light of the findings within the Greek investigation, it will be examined whether the conduct is prosecutable under Dutch law, individually or in association, and whether a criminal investigation in the Netherlands is warranted.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen binnen het Griekse opsporingsonderzoek zal worden bezien of gedragingen individueel dan wel in verenigingsverband naar Nederlands recht vervolgbaar zijn en een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland aangewezen is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat GGD Nederland, het Trimbos-instituut en het Nederlands Instituut voor Alcoholbeleid (STAP) adviseren zo snel mogelijk over te stappen op effectieve leeftijds

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether they support calls by GGD Nederland, Trimbos and STAP for supermarkets to adopt effective age verification for alcohol sales, and what they will do to ensure this. The government supports the call, notes that enforcement has passed to municipalities with new sanction powers, and agrees that effective age checks would reduce municipal supervision burden.
We support the call of these parties.
Wij ondersteunen de oproep van deze partijen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aangifte wegens valsheid in geschrifte in een strafzaak tegen het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a criminal case in which a terrorism suspicion was added to the charges only after months, whether oil bunkering in Nigeria can be prosecuted in the Netherlands, and whether the prosecution relied on Nigerian intelligence. The minister confirmed the terrorism element was later dropped, that bunkering is not a listed terrorist offence, that prosecution of such acts abroad is a matter of international cooperation, and declined to say whether intelligence from Nigeria was used due to the ongoing investigation.
No statements are made about the possible cooperation of the Public Prosecution Service with intelligence services.
Over de mogelijke samenwerking van het Openbaar Ministerie met inlichtingendiensten worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat politieagenten nog steeds vaak betrokken zijn bij ongelukken op de weg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police officers are still often involved in road accidents, and why collisions remain high despite driving training becoming obligatory. The minister answered that police driving skills are a priority, that refresher driving training is an internal police policy rather than a statutory requirement, and that new prevention measures and a 2012 damage report will be used to reduce accidents.
After that, there is no statutory obligation for driving training.
Daarna is er geen sprake van een wettelijk verplichte rijtraining.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Merkies over het bericht dat Nederland laks is in de bestrijding van corruptie

Two SP MPs asked the government how it can tolerate that 14 of 22 signalled foreign bribery cases were never investigated and none led to conviction, and what it will do about it. The minister replied that the OECD evaluation is part of three pending reviews, that an integrated policy response is due in autumn 2013, that a new prosecution guideline was adopted, 150 extra FIOD investigators are being recruited, and several legislative and prosecution measures are underway, but gave no firm timetable for the OECD-recommended legislative changes.

The cabinet letter presenting the OECD report stated that the cabinet aims to present an integrated policy response on Dutch anti-corruption efforts to the House after the three evaluations are complete.

In de Kamerbrief ter aanbieding van het OESO-rapport 2 is aangegeven dat het kabinet ernaar streeft om na afloop van de drie evaluaties een integrale beleidsreactie over de Nederlandse corruptiebestrijding aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Tristan van der V. een wapencontract tekende met zijn vader en politie

An SP MP asked whether Tristan van der V. and his father signed a written agreement to surrender his weapons upon a new depression, and whether police co-signed it. The minister answered that the document was a note from Tristan to his father, found after April 2011 and unknown to police, and that such police-signed agreements with weapon permit holders are not made.
The "contract" referred to in the interrogation concerns a note from Tristan to his father.
Het «contract» waar in het verhoor naar wordt verwezen betreft een briefje van Tristan aan zijn vader.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht Rechter kent wet niet goed

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that judges misapply the law on human trafficking, releasing traffickers, and whether this conflicts with the government's stated aim to fight trafficking harder. The minister acknowledges the high acquittal rate, points to specialisation of judges and expertise-building in courts since 1 January 2013 as the response, and says he shares the concern that traffickers should not be freed through judicial ignorance.
To prevent unnecessary acquittals in human trafficking cases, specialisation and building expertise within the courts is necessary.
Om onnodige vrijspraken in mensenhandelzaken te voorkomen is specialisatie en opbouw van expertise binnen de gerechten nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Jacobi en Van der Steur en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie verlaat Leeuwarden’

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is leaving Leeuwarden for Groningen, what that means for Leeuwarden as a justice city, and whether Friesland was promised anything to protect jobs. The minister answered that Leeuwarden remains a full justice city with OM workplaces, that the regional ZSM and local cooperation are secured, and that no specific commitments were made to Leeuwarden or Friesland beyond attention to employment effects.
No commitments have been made to Leeuwarden and Friesland.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen gedaan aan Leeuwarden en Friesland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het voorgeschreven hermelijnenbont in het kostuum- en titulatuurbesluit voor de rechtelijke organisatie

MP Thieme asks whether the 1997 robes decree, which prescribes ermine trim for Supreme Court judges' gowns and berets, should be amended given the ban on fur farming and ermine's protected status under the Flora and Fauna Act. The minister replies that the Supreme Court already uses imitation ermine in practice, so the decree is applied in spirit and no amendment is planned.
In practice, the prescriptions of Article 5(2) and Article 12(1) of the robes and titles decree for the judiciary are thereby implemented in the spirit of the law.

In de praktijk wordt daarmee aan de voorschriften uit artikel 5, tweede lid, en artikel 12, eerste lid, van het kostuum- en titulatuurbesluit rechterlijke organisatie, in de geest van de wet, uitvoering gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de enorme groei van het aantal salafisten aan de Nederlandse grens

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Interior about reports of a rising number of radical salafists near the German-Dutch border, including possible Dutch targets, contacts with German intelligence, and mosques under monitoring. The state secretary replied that there are no indications of a threat to Dutch targets, declined to detail contacts with German services citing confidentiality, and said no mosque leaders are currently known to threaten public order.
I cannot make further public statements about the content of these contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over de inhoud van deze contacten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het rapport "Mensenhandel in en uit beeld"

Van der Steur (VVD) asked the minister of Security and Justice about under-registration of trafficking victims, whether Bureau Jeugdzorg and Nidos report minor victims, and the low conviction rate in trafficking cases, citing the National Rapporteur's report. Minister Opstelten answered that police have the reporting duty, that Nidos has agreed to report suspected minor victims to the Rapporteur and is examining direct reporting to CoMensha, that trafficking convictions are about 56% plus 22% for other offences, and that specialisation of judges and prosecutors is being introduced from 1 January 2013.
It is currently being examined whether Nidos can also report directly to CoMensha.
Er wordt op dit moment bekeken of melding door Nidos ook rechtstreeks bij CoMensha plaats kan vinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hilkens en Ypma over het bericht dat er in Nederland meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

PvdA MPs Hilkens and Ypma asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that more children are being sexually exploited in the Netherlands, the National Rapporteur's figures, underreporting by mandatory reporting bodies, and shelter capacity. The minister said he would send the National Rapporteur's report, referred to earlier answers on reporting and shelter capacity, and held that the existing anti-trafficking priority, including the loverboy programme, is sufficient without further intensification.
I will send the NRM report in question to your House shortly.
Ik zal het rapport in kwestie van de NRM binnenkort aan uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat meer kinderen seksueel worden uitgebuit

MPs Bergkamp and Berndsen-Jansen (D66) asked about reports that more children are sexually exploited, including whether agencies under-report victims and whether the government underestimates the problem. The minister answered by referring to earlier answers, saying CoMensha records age at the time of reporting, describing pilots and training to spot trafficking signals, and denying a structural shortage of shelter places.
It is being examined whether additional information on victims can be supplied to CoMensha and recorded in a new registration system.
Er wordt bekeken of het mogelijk is aanvullende informatie over slachtoffers aan CoMensha te leveren en te registreren in een nieuw registratiesysteem.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het bericht van het lekken van gevoelige informatie door 50.000 harddisks en scanners

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to a broadcast showing tens of thousands of internet-accessible hard drives, scanners and printers with weak security, and whether producers should build in security or inform consumers. The minister said users and businesses bear primary responsibility, pointed to NCSC guidance, the DigiVeilig programme and a website for businesses, and noted that suppliers should also take responsibility, with the Economic Affairs ministry exploring a security standard and certification for software.
That is and remains primarily a responsibility of businesses and consumers themselves.
Dat is en blijft primair een verantwoordelijkheid voor bedrijven en consumenten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de onstuitbare opmars van de Marokkaanse crimineel

PVV MPs asked whether Moroccan youth are an unstoppable rise in crime and whether the government will confront a 'Moroccan problem' head-on. The minister rejects the claim in general terms, notes overrepresentation in specific crimes, says policy applies no ethnic distinction and points to existing prevention and enforcement measures.
The cabinet acknowledges that certain groups cause more nuisance and crime than others.
Het kabinet onderkent dat bepaalde groepen meer overlast en criminaliteit veroorzaken dan andere.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Rog over het blowverbod op scholen in Amsterdam

MPs Oskam and Rog asked whether the government supports a legal basis for a cannabis-smoking ban around schools in Amsterdam, how it squares with the Council of State ruling on municipal bans, and what enforcement tools municipalities have. The minister answered that the government is exploring stricter school rules, that municipalities can set coffee shop distances and local bans through the Opium Act enforcement guideline, and that court cases on the Amsterdam ban are pending.
The ministries involved are cooperating to strengthen a healthy school environment and are exploring the possibilities to tighten the rules.
De betrokken ministeries trekken samen op om een gezonde schoolomgeving te versterken en verkennen de mogelijkheden om de regels aan te scherpen.
Antwoord vragen Thieme (PvdD) over gewonden door jachtongelukken

An MP asked the state secretary about hunting accidents that injured passers-by and a relative, whether such incidents are tracked, and whether shooting-skill tests and hunting-licence validity should be tightened. The government answered that no centralised data on such injuries exists, that the existing hunting exam and annual licence renewal are adequate, and that the incidents give no reason to tighten the rules.
The requested data on the number of passers-by or other people hit by hunting rifle bullets are not kept in a centralised system.
De gevraagde gegevens over het aantal passanten of andere mensen dat geraakt werd door kogels uit jachtgeweren, worden niet in een gecentraliseerd systeem bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over een uitzending van Omroep Brabant over drugssmokkel via de Antwerpse haven

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a regional broadcast claiming cocaine smuggling had shifted from Rotterdam to Antwerp, the role of Dutch criminal groups, police structure, and EU cooperation. The minister confirmed the shift and Dutch leadership of networks, pointed to existing cooperation with Belgium and other states, and stated that the Marechaussee's mobile controls are primarily aimed at illegal migration, with no plan to expand its drug-enforcement task.
The extent of cocaine imports from other EU member states and the amount of money this would generate is not known to the OM.
De omvang van de invoer van cocaïne vanuit overige EU-lidstaten en het bedrag dat dit zou opleveren is het OM niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over sharia-patrouilles in Londen

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Muslim patrols in a London suburb, including their remarks about white women, whether such patrols show Islam's nature, the existence of 'Muslim areas' in a major European city, and whether shariah-promoting movements should be banned. Minister Opstelten rejected the remarks and intimidation, said Islam's nature is not shown by the conduct of a few, and that courts would assess any dissolution request case by case under article 20 of the Civil Code.
If the public prosecution service so requests, the judge will have to assess each individual case on the basis of article 20 of the Civil Code.
In het geval dat het openbaar ministerie daartoe verzoekt, zal de rechter elke afzonderlijke zaak moeten beoordelen aan de hand van artikel 20 Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over mijn toezegging om de slachtoffers van het schietincident in Alphen aan den Rijn het onderzoeksrapport van de Rijksrecherche integraal openbaar te maken

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the promise to give shooting victims in Alphen aan den Rijn the full Rijksrecherche report was kept, and whether victims have received the readable report and other documents. The minister answered that victims were given an anonymised version of the report on 18 January 2013 after agreement with their lawyer, but access to the post-mortem psychiatric report was refused on medical confidentiality and privacy grounds, a point the court later upheld.
The OM, given the applicable regulations and case law, saw no room to grant access to this medical file.
Het OM heeft gelet op toepasselijke regelgeving en jurisprudentie geen ruimte gezien om inzage in dit medische dossier te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de islamitische opvoeding als vrijbrief voor verkrachting

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether a UK court's decision not to jail a rapist because of his Islamic upbringing shows the misogynistic nature of Islam, and whether the government would condemn it and ensure Dutch judges never act similarly. The minister answered that one individual's statements say nothing about a religion and that it is not for the Dutch government to judge a British judge's application of British law in an individual criminal case.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements about the correct application of British law by a British judge in an individual criminal case.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om uitspraken te doen over de juiste toepassing van het Britse recht door een Britse rechter in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over de positie van forensische accountants bij onderzoek naar fraude

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether forensic accountants must report suspicious past fraudulent transactions under the Wwft, and whether an advocate-led investigation exempts them from that duty. The minister answered that reporting duties apply, with administrative and criminal sanctions for non-reporting, and that the derived legal privilege of a lawyer only exempts accountants where the lawyer's role is restrictively defined as legal representation.
It must be prevented that merely engaging a lawyer renders supervision and the reporting duty illusory (abuse of the derived legal privilege).
Voorkomen dient te worden dat door het enkel inschakelen van een advocaat het toezicht en de meldplicht illusoir worden gemaakt (misbruik afgeleid verschoningsrecht).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over vervolgingen en veroordelingen wegens majesteitsschennis

D66 MPs Pechtold and Schouw asked the Justice Minister about prosecutions and convictions for lèse-majesté after a press report claimed they were rising. The minister replied with yearly OM figures showing no clear increase, said the offence is not a priority for prosecution, and refused to draft a bill equalising insult penalties.
Enforcement of the criminal provisions on insult and lèse-majesté is not a priority.
De handhaving van strafbaarstellingen van belediging en majesteitsschennis heeft geen prioriteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over NL-Alert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why millions of phone users did not receive the NL-Alert test message, why iPhones and some Samsung phones are not supported, why the test messages are spaced so far apart, and when networks and phones will be ready. The minister answered that NL-Alert is a supplementary system still in development, that Apple has made no commitments, that test messages twice a year are considered sufficient for now, and promised a report on the survey and evaluation within three months.
I will inform your House within three months about this survey and the evaluation.
Ik zal uw Kamer over uiterlijk drie maanden nader informeren over deze peiling en de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht «Bejaarde is leven niet meer zeker na massale afranseling»

PVV MPs asked the government whether criminal Moroccan youths terrorising neighbourhoods and committing racist violence should be harshly punished, sent to re-education camps, and deprived of Dutch nationality with family deportation. The minister answered that policy does not distinguish by ethnicity, outlined prevention and tough enforcement, rejected re-education camps as unproven, and said revoking nationality for common crimes is not possible.
In this approach no distinction is made by ethnicity.
In deze aanpak wordt geen onderscheid naar etniciteit gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over het racistische Marokkaanse geweld

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a claim that Moroccan-origin youths cause a structural problem of violence, asked for the causes of police contact among young Moroccan men, and asked whether dual-nationality offenders could be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that socio-economic and demographic factors explain over-representation in crime, that enforcement applies no ethnic distinction, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common offences is not possible.
Of course, it is the case that the groups that more often cause problems will accordingly come into contact with this approach more often.
Wel is het uiteraard zo dat de groepen die vaker problemen veroorzaken navenant meer met deze aanpak in aanraking zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de rapportage ‘Drugshaven’

MP Oskam (CDA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Omroep Brabant report on cocaine smuggling through Antwerp and whether 95% of it transits to the Netherlands, and what is being done on cooperation with Belgium. The minister said the 95% figure is not based on OM data and cannot be confirmed, that cooperation with Belgium is intensifying, and that Europol prioritises cocaine smuggling.
The public prosecution service (OM) has informed me that the stated percentage is not based on their data.
Het openbaar ministerie (OM) heeft mij meegedeeld dat het genoemde percentage niet is gebaseerd op hun gegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Karabulut over de uitwerking van amendement 32418, nr. 15 over de samenvoeging van vorderingen ter berekening van de vergoeding van buitengerechtelijke incassokosten

MPs Van Oosten and Karabulut asked whether the amendment on combining claims for extrajudicial collection costs leads to higher costs for consumers than intended, and whether repair is needed. The minister denies this, arguing the amendment means one reminder for multiple claims, lowering costs in the example given, and that the current rules balance creditor and debtor interests.
The image that the amendment leads to higher collection costs is therefore not correct.
Het beeld derhalve dat het amendement tot hogere incassokosten leidt, is niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de Grensoverschrijdende samenwerking tussen de Duitse en Nederlandse politie

The MP asks whether cross-border police cooperation with Germany is too slow, since a stolen-goods case required a formal mutual legal assistance request, and whether weekend handling is weaker. The minister replies that the house was searched the same morning of the tip-off, that direct police contact is already possible but coercive measures need a prosecutor and formal request, and that a 24/7 coordinating system exists on the Dutch side.
In cases of cross-border crime, swift and effective action must be possible.
In gevallen van grensoverschrijdende criminaliteit moet er spoedig en doeltreffend actie ondernomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen De Wit over de schikking van het Openbaar Ministerie met Ballast Nedam

MP De Wit asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the OM's out-of-court settlement with Ballast Nedam (EUR 17 million, avoiding public court proceedings) is desirable, whether it creates precedent for other cases, and whether it will leave the role of a Dutch provincial official unclarified. The Minister defends the settlement as an appropriate case-specific disposal, says it creates no rights for future cases, that prosecution of the official continues in open court, and that he sees no reason to reconsider settlement policy.
The mere fact of this settlement does not mean that there will be no public accountability before the criminal court in this investigation.
Het enkele feit van deze schikking betekent niet dat er in dit onderzoek geen openbare verantwoording voor de strafrechter zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vermeende aangifte wegens ambtelijke corruptie tegen dhr J. van Rey

The MP Omtzigt asked whether a Belastingdienst official filed a corruption complaint against sitting Senator J. van Rey, how suspects are notified, what rules apply to complaints against parliamentarians, and who in government was informed. Minister Opstelten answered that the procedure was followed without deviation, that no specific rules exist for complaints against MPs, and that a criminal investigation is ongoing so further details cannot be given.
Given the interests of this criminal investigation, which is still ongoing, I cannot go into further detail.
Gelet op de belangen van dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat nog gaande is, kan ik niet verder in detail treden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Hilkens over multi level marketing

MPs Mei Li Vos and Hilkens asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Security and Justice about multi-level marketing practices (including ACN's telecom sales), whether they are misleading or illegal pyramid schemes, and whether consumer and gambling authorities are informed. The government answered that MLM is a lawful sales method, that the Consumer Authority and Gambling Authority supervise compliance with existing law, that no change to legislation is currently needed, and that it will not judge individual companies.
It does not befit me to give a judgment on the conduct of individual companies.
Het past mij niet een oordeel te geven over de handelwijze van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht dat de gemeente Hoorn de kosten die zijn gemaakt na een oproep tot een Project-X feest niet kan verhalen op de oproeper

MP Dijkhoff asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is true that Hoorn municipality cannot recover costs of a Project-X party call from the instigator, after legal advice said the municipality would have little chance in court, and whether the ministry advised pursuing the case. The minister answered that the legal advice estimates success below 35% due to the doctrine of doorkruising, that no statutory basis exists, that courts have allowed recovery of police costs in other cases, and that the correspondence and advice are provided to the Chamber.
Made available for inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives
Ter inzage gelegd bij het Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en De Wit over de financiële tekorten bij het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Kooiman and De Wit asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of excessive workload at the Public Prosecution Service (OM) in Breda, delayed cases, and whether large budget cuts (up to 23 percent) are planned. The minister confirmed the Breda situation is likely not unique, said cuts are needed under the coalition agreement but declined to pre-empt decisions, and promised to inform the House before the spring memorandum.
I am currently considering options to implement the cuts arising from the coalition agreement. I do not consider it appropriate to anticipate these.
Momenteel bezie ik mogelijkheden om uitvoering te geven aan de uit het regeerakkoord voortvloeiende bezuinigingen. Ik acht het niet dienstig daarop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Omtzigt over het bericht dat dhr. Jansen Steur zich in 2006 geregistreerd heeft in Duitsland als arts?

MPs Bruins Slot and Omtzigt asked whether Jansen Steur registered as a doctor in Germany in 2006, which bodies knew, how the IGZ and prosecutors handled the matter, and why he was allowed to work abroad. The minister confirmed the German registration, explained the IGZ's 2006 decisions and the ongoing criminal case, and said he cannot work in the Netherlands because he is not BIG-registered.
The Public Prosecution Service sent several requests for legal assistance to the German authorities in the investigation that led to the case now pending before the Almelo court.

Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft in het kader van het onderzoek dat heeft geleid tot de rechtszaak die nu aanhangig is bij de rechtbank Almelo, meerdere rechtshulpverzoeken doen uitgaan naar de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de moskee als toevluchtsoord voor schietende criminelen

PVV MPs asked whether a group of men fleeing a shooting incident in Rotterdam hid in a mosque, whether police entered promptly, and whether the minister would close the mosque. The minister answered that the building was an annex (library, barber) rather than a prayer space, that police entered and found no one, and that closing a mosque is a municipal competence.
The possible closure of a mosque is a municipal competence.
Eventuele sluiting van een moskee is een gemeentelijke bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en De Rouwe over het gevaar van krachtige laserpennen

MPs Oskam and De Rouwe asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the dangers of high-powered laser pointers, including pilot complaints, sales, and possible prohibition. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to new criminal provisions on endangerment and sales restrictions already in place, and saw no need for Wet wapens en munitie changes, noting some municipalities have local bans.
I see no reason for that.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Van Klaveren over een politiesnoepreisje naar Marokko

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether Dutch police trips to Morocco, reported as a costly study trip, were necessary and whether police diversity policy was absurd. Minister Opstelten answered that the trip's necessity is tested by the Landelijke korpschef under a new Gedragscode Buitenlandse Dienstreizen, and that non-operational trips are reported in advance to his ministry.
The starting point of this code of conduct is that foreign business trips undertaken by the police must always be integrity-based, useful and necessary.
Het vertrekpunt van deze gedragscode is dat buitenlandse dienstreizen die door de politie worden ondernomen altijd integer, nuttig en noodzakelijk dienen te zijn.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over het gevaar van matchfixing in het Nederlandse voetbal

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the danger of match-fixing in Dutch football, citing a criminologist's claim that police and prosecutors do not take it seriously. The minister denied this, pointed to an ongoing study of match-fixing, noted the new gambling regulator's enforcement, and welcomed the KNVB's own anti-match-fixing plans.
As your House is aware, the Ministries of Health, Welfare and Sport and of Security and Justice are currently commissioning research into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend is laten de Ministeries van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie momenteel onderzoek doen naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over dreigende deportatie van een islam-kritische filmmaker

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Spain is deporting Pakistani-born anti-Islam filmmaker Imran Firasat on national security grounds, whether the Netherlands will protest given possible blasphemy prosecution at home, and whether his film can be published in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Spain must assess the security threat, that Dutch intervention is not warranted, that free expression carries responsibilities for courts to judge, and that the film is already online.
It is for the Spanish authorities to assess whether this person residing in Spain poses a threat to national security.
Het is aan de Spaanse autoriteiten om te beoordelen of deze in Spanje verblijvende persoon wel of niet een bedreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen Segers over het bericht ‘Explosion of trafficking linked to legalised prostitution’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the government would take account of a study linking legalised prostitution to more trafficking, and whether it would research or reconsider Dutch prostitution policy. The minister acknowledged the study's findings but noted its methodological limits, said the Netherlands' legalisation has positive effects, and declined to reconsider legalisation or commission new research, pointing to existing monitoring by the National Rapporteur.
I therefore consider it unnecessary to reconsider the legalisation of prostitution in the Netherlands.
Ik acht het dan ook onnodig om de legalisering van prostitutie in Nederland te heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over matchfixing in de topsport

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about press reports that tennis player Raemon Sluiter was approached about match-fixing, and why the government said there was no evidence of it in the Netherlands, and about an anonymous reporting line and the handling of old reports. The minister replied that a broad study into the nature and extent of match-fixing is underway, that an anonymous reporting line is being considered, and that the Public Prosecution Service can investigate reports that meet the criminal-law criteria.

That is why I am having, together with my colleague of Justice and Security, an in-depth study carried out into the nature and extent of match-fixing in the Netherlands and the possibilities to prevent, detect and tackle it.

Vandaar dat ik samen met mijn ambtgenoot van Veiligheid en Justitie een diepgaand onderzoek laat uitvoeren naar de aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland en de mogelijkheden om matchfixing te voorkomen, op te sporen en aan te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over de toenemende onrust binnen de rechterlijke macht

An MP asked the Justice Minister about growing unrest among judges and a manifesto against the erosion of the judiciary, asking whether the minister would talk with judges and commit to protecting quality against production demands. The minister said the Judiciary Council will hold the dialogue first, that he will follow it and engage if needed, and will inform parliament after the consultation rounds conclude.
I consider it primarily a task for the Judiciary Council to engage in dialogue with the judges and councillors who have expressed their concerns.
Ik acht het in de eerste plaats een taak voor de Raad voor de rechtspraak om het gesprek aan te gaan met de rechters en raadsheren die hun zorgen hebben geuit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaveren en Helder over de dodelijke schietpartij bij een kickboksgala

Two PVV MPs asked about a fatal shooting at a kickboxing gala, the suspect's reported school-shooter background, the overrepresentation of Moroccan and Turkish youths in violent crime statistics, and whether a suspect with a serious criminal record should be deported. The minister said the overrepresentation is partly explained by demographic and socioeconomic factors, declined to comment on individual cases, and described the general rules on deportation after conviction and a planned tightening of the sliding scale.
I will not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over Bedreiging van demonstranten door medewerkers van de Iraanse Ambassade

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Iranian embassy staff threatening demonstrators with scissors, whether the incident was reported as required, whether diplomatic immunity blocks prosecution, what diplomatic measures are available, whether the Vienna Convention should change, and whether the ambassador would be summoned. The minister replied that a complaint was filed and police contacted the ministry the same day, that immunity under the Vienna Convention prevents prosecution, that diplomatic steps such as a note or waiver request are possible but weighed against risks to Dutch diplomats, and that the ambassador was summoned pending the police investigation.
Under the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, embassy staff with diplomatic status have immunity.
Op grond van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer hebben ambassademedewerkers met een diplomatieke status immuniteit.
Antwoord vragen Segers over de inzet van paragnosten door de politie

MP Segers asked the minister whether the police may use psychics (paragnosten), why the Instruction on Unorthodox Investigation Methods is not public, and whether it should be amended to ban such methods. The minister answered that the instruction is an internal procedural rule for exceptional cases, that the Public Prosecution Service controls method choice and must approve use, and that it will not amend the instruction.
Criminal investigations take place under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service. That is also where responsibility lies for choosing which investigative methods are used.
Opsporingsonderzoeken vinden plaats onder het gezag van het Openbaar Ministerie. Daar ligt ook de verantwoordelijkheid voor de keuze welke opsporingsmethoden worden ingezet.
Antwoord vragen Helder over een blog “Politie zet mogelijke getuigen op internet”

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police publishing photos of possible witnesses to an assault online, and whether prior approval from the prosecution was obtained, and whether this endangers witnesses. The minister confirmed the photos were posted on the prosecutor's instruction after no other means were available, said the people were hard to recognise, acknowledged the risk was considered, and stated the photos have been removed.

Since no other investigative means were available and the conditions set in the Guideline on publication of investigative information were otherwise met, the public prosecutor ordered the publication of a number of photos of possible witnesses on the internet.

Aangezien er geen andere opsporingsmiddelen voorhanden waren en er ook overigens is voldaan aan de voorwaarden die werden gesteld in de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving, is in opdracht van de officier van justitie besloten tot het plaatsen van een aantal foto's op internet
Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug en Marcouch over de privacy van getuigen van misdrijven

MPs Oosenbrug and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a police appeal for witnesses to a severe assault on two gay men was publicised, and on what criteria privacy of witnesses is weighed against investigation needs. The Minister answered that public appeals for witnesses are used only in exceptional cases, that the prosecutor must approve footage that intrudes on privacy, and that the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving is being updated with explicit safeguards.
Currently work is underway to update the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan actualisering van de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Bontes over het bericht “Misdaad loont weer, criminaliteit kan stijgen”

PVV MPs Helder and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether misdaad pays and whether the minister will raise sentences and the chance of arrest after a newspaper report that criminality could rise. Minister Opstelten said he agrees crime should not pay, disputed the report's claim of low arrest odds citing clearance rates, and pointed to regeerakkoord measures (more police, minimum sentences for recidivism, a tougher Voetbalwet) while deferring some points to later letters and referring elsewhere.

I will inform the House before the spring memorandum in more detail about how the coalition agreement measures to strengthen the police and improve the performance of the criminal justice chain will be implemented.

Ik zal uw Kamer voor de voorjaarsnota nader berichten over de uitwerking van de maatregelen uit het regeerakkoord die zijn gericht op versterking van de politie en verbetering van de prestaties van de strafrechtsketen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over onredelijke schuldeisers waardoor er onnodig bedrijven failliet gaan

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Dutch bankruptcy law gives creditors too strong a position, causing firms to fail unnecessarily or relocate abroad, and whether a court could bind unreasonable creditors before bankruptcy. Minister Opstelten acknowledged the problem, announced a bankruptcy law reform programme with stakeholder consultation and comparative research, but gave no firm commitment to a quick bill and said fraud prevention currently has priority.
That is why I have also announced legislation providing for the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.
Daarom heb ik ook wetgeving aangekondigd die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over het bericht ‘Chaos troef bij Topklasser FC Chabab; zwart geld, witte lijnen.’

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a former main sponsor of FC Chabab used the club to launder drug money, whether drug money laundering via football clubs has occurred before, and what will be done about it. Minister Opstelten answered that the investigation concerned drug dealing rather than laundering through the club, that no convictions for laundering via football clubs are known, and that anti-laundering measures and a bill raising penalties are in preparation.

The criminal investigation by the National Public Prosecutor's Office into the former main sponsor of FC Chabab, referred to in the article cited in question 1, did not concern laundering drug money through this club.

Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van het Landelijk Parket dat plaatsgevonden heeft naar de voormalige hoofdsponsor van FC Chabab en waaraan in het in vraag 1 aangehaalde artikel wordt gerefereerd had geen betrekking op het witwassen van drugsgelden via deze vereniging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over het bericht bankroet van bedrijven vaak onnodig

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether a single dissenting creditor can block a viable company's restructuring plan under Dutch bankruptcy law, and whether a judge should be able to force such a creditor to accept a reasonable plan as in England. Minister Opstelten answered that the government will broaden its bankruptcy law reform programme, including a power to impose binding arrangements on individual creditors, and will report on progress next spring.

To this end I announced in my letter a series of legislative initiatives, including facilitating agreements outside bankruptcy and silent administration, as well as introducing the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.

Daartoe heb ik in mijn brief een reeks aan wetgevende initiatieven aangekondigd, waaronder de vergemakkelijking van de totstandkoming van akkoorden buiten faillissement en de stille bewindvoering alsmede de invoering van de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oosten over aanpassing faillissementsrecht

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch insolvency law unduly protects creditors, harming competitiveness and allowing minority creditors to block rescue plans, and whether the law should change. The minister acknowledged the concern, announced a broad insolvency law reform programme including forced binding settlements against holdout creditors, and said Parliament would be informed in spring.

I recognise that picture and have therefore announced in the aforementioned letter that legislation will come that provides for the possibility of a settlement that can be imposed on obstructive individual creditors.

Ik herken dat beeld en heb daarom in de voornoemde brief aangekondigd dat er wetgeving komt die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan dwarsliggende individuele schuldeisers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de veroordeling van een van pedoseksueel misdrijf verdachte Nederlander in Cambodja

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Cambodian conviction of a Dutch national for child sexual abuse, whether Cambodia was informed about a possible mutual legal assistance request, and why a travel ban for convicted paedophiles has not yet been legislated. The minister answered that Cambodia was informed but has not filed a request, that Dutch officers can act abroad only with local consent, and that a travel-ban bill is expected in the first half of 2013.
I therefore tackle child sex tourism to reduce the risk that children abroad fall victim to sexual abuse by Dutch nationals.
Ik pak kindersekstoerisme dan ook aan om het risico dat kinderen in het buitenland slachtoffer worden van seksueel misbruik door Nederlanders te verkleinen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over het bericht dat er jaarlijks ongeveer voor 1 miljard euro faillissementsfraude wordt gepleegd

MPs Recourt and Kerstens asked ministers whether they recognise the estimate of about 1 billion euro yearly losses from bankruptcy fraud, whether the 2.5% detection rate is adequate, and what has been done since the last committee debate. Minister Opstelten answered that about 700 million euro of the 4 billion euro in bankruptcy debts stems from fraud, that the FIOD handles about 40 complex cases a year, and referred to a letter of 27 November 2012 for the measures taken.
For that reason I am of the view that the detection rate must go up further and work on this is under way.
Mede daarom ben ik van mening dat de pakkans verder omhoog moet en wordt daar ook volop aan gewerkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de bouw van de Amsterdamse Westermoskee

An MP from the PVV asked ministers about the Westermoskee in Amsterdam: whether construction will resume, who finances it, which organisations are involved, whether links exist to Milli Gorus, and what measures could block it. The answer states construction resumes in Q1 2013 financed by Manderen BV, that the AIVD has no information indicating threats, and that the municipality cannot stop the mosque because a permit and leasehold contract already exist.
Manderen BV holds an irrevocable building permit issued in 2007.
Manderen BV beschikt over een onherroepelijke bouwvergunning die is afgegeven in 2007.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kerstens over de gebrekkige handhaving van de wet controle rechtspersonen en faillissementsfraude

Two MPs asked why the Wet controle rechtspersonen and its Radar system, meant to block convicted bankruptcy fraudsters from founding companies, have produced only about ten referrals, why costs rose to 18.7 million euro, and whether the law is a paper tiger. The minister replied that the system was deliberately started small, that Radar already can analyse other legal persons, that risk reports are valued by users, and that a separate letter on bankruptcy fraud was sent on 27 November 2012.

Supervision of legal persons was started in a limited and controlled way, in consultation with the supervisory and investigative bodies, and was tailored as far as possible to the needs of the receiving parties.
Het toezicht op rechtspersonen is, in overleg met de toezichthoudende en opsporende instanties, beperkt en beheerst gestart en is zoveel mogelijk toegesneden op de behoefte van de afnemende partijen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over de rechtmatigheid van en verantwoording over targeted killings

MPs Van Bommel and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would share internal legal advice on US targeted killings, condemn such strikes as unlawful, and press the US for transparency and accountability on drone strikes. Minister Timmermans answered that the advice will be submitted to the CAVV, that prohibitions on attacks on protected persons and extrajudicial executions apply, that more openness from the US is welcomed, but that a judgement on specific strikes requires facts the government does not have.

I consider it useful to have the lawfulness and conditions for the use of armed drones further analysed and have decided to refer this question for advice to the Advisory Committee on Issues of Public International Law (CAVV).

Ik acht het nuttig om de rechtmatigheid en voorwaarden voor het gebruik van bewapende drones nader te laten analyseren en heb besloten om dit vraagstuk ter advisering aan de Commissie van Advies inzake Volkenrechtelijke Vraagstukken (CAVV) voor te leggen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de oude economische eigendomsrechten

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about problems with old economic property transfers (koop without levering), including revocable powers of attorney lapsing on bankruptcy, the cost of the art. 2:23c BW procedure, and possible remedies. The government answered that buyers bear the risks of this chosen form, that the procedure is a deliberate safeguard, and that it opposes an amnesty for these fiscal constructions.
I am therefore not in favour of an amnesty scheme, as advocated by the KNB.
Ik ben daarom ook geen voorstander van een amnestieregeling, zoals bepleit door de KNB.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de structurele straatterreur in Hilversum

An MP asked the ministers about street terror and youth nuisance in Hilversum, whether the troublemakers could be expelled from the neighbourhood, whether benefits could be cut for nuisance, and why Turkish people are overrepresented in sexual coercion. The government answered that municipalities hold the tools and Hilversum is acting on youth nuisance, referred to a 2010 VROM report, and said prevention through awareness and open discussion is the approach to sexual coercion.
Municipalities have a broad range of measures at their disposal to tackle nuisance.
Gemeenten hebben een breed scala aan maatregelen tot hun beschikking om overlast aan te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over geweld tegen NS-medewerkers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether violence against NS railway staff is a structural societal problem, the respective responsibilities of NS, police and prosecutors, and what protection citizens who intervene have under self-defence law. The minister replied that violence against public-facing workers is a structural problem tackled jointly with BZK, that responsibilities are shared, and that existing self-defence rules (art. 41 Sr) offer adequate protection.
This cabinet regards aggression and violence against workers with a public task, including NS staff, as a societal problem, not merely isolated incidents.
Agressie en geweld tegen werknemers met een publieke taak, waaronder NS-personeel, ziet dit kabinet als een maatschappelijk probleem, niet enkel als losse incidenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mishandeling van katten voor de productie van een film

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether filming that mistreated cats in Antwerp's city hall, and possible criminal bans on making or showing such films, should be pursued in the Netherlands. The minister said the incident abroad falls outside Dutch jurisdiction, and declined a new ban, relying on existing animal welfare and criminal law and on broadcasters and internet providers to refuse such material.
Unlike with sex with animals, I do not intend to enforce the social norm through a ban.
Anders dan bij seks met dieren ben ik niet voornemens om de maatschappelijke norm door een verbod af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over medische verzekeraars

An MP asked the government about medical insurers' handling of malpractice claims after a TROS Radar broadcast, including dossier delays, the GOMA code, and transparency of medical advisers' reports. The government answered that it considers such practices unacceptable, cites insurers' commitments under the GOMA and the Letselschade Raad's oversight, and says it will monitor developments.
Losing files on purpose and threatening lengthy procedures I do not consider acceptable.
Zoekgemaakte dossiers en dreigen met langdurige procedures acht ik niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het blokkeren van gestolen mobiele telefoons

An MP asked whether the ministry is negotiating with telecom providers to remotely block stolen mobile phones, and how this fits with police investigation practice and the goal of raising arrest rates. The minister answered that a working group with providers, police and the Public Prosecution Service expects results this year, and that blocking is expected to deter theft.
These talks led me, together with my colleague of EZ and representatives of the telecom providers, to set up a working group.
Deze gesprekken hebben ertoe geleid dat ik samen met mijn ambtgenoot van EZ en vertegenwoordigers van de telecomproviders een werkgroep heb geformeerd
