Antwoord vragen Oosenbrug over het bericht dat de overheid gegevens van miljoenen burgers aan de Mormonen heeft verstrekt

Oosenbrug asked whether the government unlawfully gave personal record cards of millions of deceased Dutch citizens to the Mormon Genealogical Society, whether privacy law was breached, and whether the data can be reclaimed. Minister Plasterk answers that the 1973 arrangement likely conflicted with the 1967 population registry decree, that current rules are stricter, that the CBG keeps the cards, and that he will verify and secure access with a letter in early 2013.
Against this background, it is plausible that the provision must be regarded as contrary to the Population Registry Decree of 1967 then in force.
Tegen deze achtergrond is het aannemelijk dat de verstrekking gezien moet worden als in strijd met het toenmalige Besluit bevolkingsboekhouding uit 1967.
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over de privacy van internetters

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether personal data of a 16-year-old was handed to the state by Skype without a valid request, and how many such cases occur per year. The minister explains that police may not request voluntary data disclosure, that spontaneous third-party disclosures are permitted with a proces-verbaal, and that no statistics on such cases are kept.
The Public Prosecution Service does not keep statistics on the number of cases in which personal data was spontaneously provided to investigators.
Het Openbaar Ministerie houdt geen statistieken bij over het aantal gevallen waarin spontaan persoonsgegevens aan de opsporing zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen-Jansen over de hackplannen van de minister

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Nederlands Juristenblad article criticising police hacking plans, including claims of identity theft, undermined judicial oversight by the rechter-commissaris, conflicts with antivirus software, and fundamental rights. The minister defended the plans as not constituting identity theft, promised further study of secure logging and the rechter-commissaris role in a forthcoming bill, and rejected a constitutional explicitation of computer confidentiality as of limited added value.
Regarding the role of the rechter-commissaris, the differences between the analogue and digital worlds are in my view not as large as the author claims in his article.
Met betrekking tot de rol van de rechter-commissaris zijn de verschillen tussen de analoge en digitale wereld mijns inziens niet zo groot als de auteur in zijn artikel stelt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over een bericht over toegenomen geweld tegen politieagenten

MP Marcouch asked the minister whether reported increases in violence against police officers, based on press-release data from a website, reflect a real rise and whether the government will change its policy. The minister answered that the website data cannot establish an increase, that victimisation surveys show stable levels, and that the government sees no reason to change its policy beyond existing measures.
That does not mean, however, that the number of violent incidents has risen; after all, not every violent incident against the police leads to a press release.
Dat wil echter niet zeggen dat het aantal geweldsincidenten is gestegen; immers, niet elk geweldsincident tegen de politie leidt tot een persbericht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het waarborgen van een effectieve bestrijding van faillissementsfraude

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about insufficient capacity at the FIOD and police to tackle bankruptcy fraud, proposed dedicated police units, and urged criminalising absence of proper bookkeeping in bankruptcy and a professional ban for fraudsters. The minister answered that a letter of 27 November outlines concrete actions on expertise, capacity and detection, a broader revision of bankruptcy criminal law including inadequate administration, and a civil-law administrative ban.
In the letter sent to your House on 27 November I addressed strengthening the role of criminal law in combating bankruptcy fraud in practice.
In de brief die op 27 november aan uw Kamer is gestuurd ben ik ingegaan op de versterking van de rol van het strafrecht bij bestrijding van faillissementsfraude in de praktijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over seksueel misbruik door zorgverleners

MP Hilkens asked the state secretary and minister about reports of sexual abuse of patients by care workers, including whether the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) reports these complaints, its enforcement, referral to prosecutors, training, and mandatory certificates of conduct (VOG). The minister answered that the IGZ publishes only aggregate totals, lists enforcement outcomes such as criminal and disciplinary tracks, and says a legal basis for mandatory VOGs in health care is lacking, promising to consider it for non-youth care workers.
I will consider including a mandatory VOG for other care workers.
Ik zal mij beraden over het opnemen van een verplichte VOG voor overige werknemers in de zorg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Fritsma over het overbrengen van piraten naar Nederland

PVV MPs asked whether the foreign minister is involved in deciding to transfer captured Somali pirates to the Netherlands for prosecution, why transfer to the region or flag state was not chosen, whether pirates could be tried under Dutch law in the region and serve sentences there, and whether they could obtain asylum or stay in the Netherlands. The minister answered that prosecution is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service coordinated with the foreign and defence ministers, that a clear Dutch interest (attempted murder of Dutch marines) justified prosecution here, that trial under Dutch law in the region is not possible and sentence execution in Somalia is currently not possible though capacity-building is supported, and that asylum is expected to be refused under Article 1F and sentences of 24 months or more.
Instituting criminal prosecution in the Dutch criminal justice system is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het instellen van strafrechtelijke vervolging is in het Nederlandse strafrechtelijke stelsel voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een mogelijke preventieve aanval op Iran

An SP MP asked the foreign and justice ministers whether the Netherlands had been approached about, or assisted in, preparations for a possible preventive attack on Iran, and whether legal advice existed on its legality. Minister Timmermans answered that the Netherlands had not been approached or assisted, that the British internal legal advice is not known to him, and that internal legal advice on pre-emptive action remains confidential.
Internally, written advice has been given on international legal questions concerning possible pre-emptive or preventive action.
Intern is schriftelijk geadviseerd over volkenrechtelijke vragen met betrekking tot mogelijk preëmptief of preventief optreden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink mer over het militaire strafproces

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Justice whether officier-raadsmen (military officers acting as defence counsel) can provide adequate legal defence in military criminal proceedings, and whether they should be replaced by lawyers. The state secretary rejected abolishing the role, explaining that officier-raadsmen give free assistance in minor cases, receive training, and must act with functional independence, while noting Salduz-related access to counsel is guaranteed via lawyers and the military bar.
No record is kept of this.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over Eritrese praktijken

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked about Eritrean consulate practices of taxing diaspora Dutch nationals with threats of withheld services, and whether international law and UN Security Council resolution 1907 were breached. The minister says extraterritorial taxation is not itself contrary to the Vienna Conventions, extortion is unacceptable and existing law suffices, that no further investigation of the arms embargo question is needed now, and that complaints depend on victims filing reports, with anonymity only conditionally possible.
Once a report has been filed, the police under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service will investigate it.
Zodra er aangifte is gedaan zal de politie onder leiding van het OM daar onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold en Bergkamp over de kunstroof in Rotterdam

MPs Pechtold and Bergkamp asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the theft of seven paintings from the Kunsthal in Rotterdam, including whether one security guard was sufficient and whether the unit for art crime and the stolen-art database were adequately resourced. The minister regretted the theft, left security arrangements to the museum and insurer, explained that the art-crime group was expanded from three to four FTE and that the database holds about 1,700 stolen objects, and said regional art-crime contact persons are being appointed.
I deeply regret that these paintings were stolen from the Kunsthal.
Ik betreur het zeer dat deze schilderijen gestolen zijn uit de Kunsthal.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat allochtone verdachten met een psychiatrische stoornis vaker gedwongen worden opgenomen dan vergelijkbare autochtone verdachten

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the minister whether forensic psychiatric reports (pro justitia) assess and recommend compulsory admission differently for allochtone and autochtone suspects. The state secretary confirmed a published study finding such differences, said the NIFP has transcultural expertise and training measures, and stated that reports are advisory and the final verdict may differ.
The pro justitia report is advice to the judiciary, which takes this advice into consideration when issuing a ruling.
De pro justitia-rapportage is een advies aan de Rechterlijke Macht, die dit advies in overweging neemt bij het doen van een uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over WOTS-verzoeken uit Panama

MP Marcouch asked whether Dutch prisoners in Panama seeking transfer under the WOTS are routinely refused, on what grounds, and whether agreements with Panama exist. The minister answers that requests are assessed individually, that transfer requires roots in the Netherlands and at least four months of remaining sentence, that all six 2012 and one 2011 Panama requests were refused for insufficient remaining sentence, and that Panama is bound only by the Council of Europe transfer convention, with no further agreements needed.
All requests made from Panama in 2011, namely one, and so far in 2012, namely six, were rejected by the Netherlands because the remaining sentence was insufficient.
Alle aanvragen die in 2011, te weten één, en tot op heden in 2012, te weten zes, vanuit Panama zijn gedaan zijn door Nederland afgewezen omdat er een onvoldoende strafrestant was.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het opzeggen van het lidmaatschap van de Pompidou Groep

MPs Kooiman (SP) asked why the Netherlands ended its membership of the Council of Europe's Pompidou Group, whether its wider harm-reduction work is lost, and whether Dutch drug policy abroad is abandoned. The government answers that the overlap with EU and UN work and budget efficiency justified the exit, that the Netherlands still pursues its drug policy through other international channels, and that the group's added value had eroded.
The Netherlands indeed ended its membership of the Pompidou Group because the overlap with the tasks and scope of the European Union and also the UN has increased.
Nederland heeft inderdaad het lidmaatschap van de Pompidou Groep opgezegd omdat de overlap met de taken en het werkterrein van de Europese Unie en ook de VN zijn toegenomen.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt over de sterk gestegen criminaliteit in Noord-Holland

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a sharp rise in burglaries, car theft and public violence in Noord-Holland, and what is being done about it. The minister confirmed the increases over 2008-2011 (burglary tracking the national trend, car theft and violence diverging), reported declines in 2012, and said an intensified approach already exists through burglary teams and a regional taskforce on robberies, with the new national police expected to help.
For burglaries this matches the national trend in that period, but the rise in car thefts and public violence deviates from the national picture.

Ten aanzien van woninginbraken komt dit overeen met de landelijke ontwikkeling in die periode, maar de stijging van het aantal autodiefstallen en openlijke geweldplegingen wijkt af van het landelijk beeld.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over een zelfmoord in de gevangenis Vught

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the minister about a reported suicide in the Vught prison and whether structural problems at the facility warranted a broader inquiry beyond individual cases. State Secretary Teeven replied that the facility generally functions well, that six deaths occurred in 2012 including four suicides, and that the Inspectorates of Justice and Health have been asked to investigate whether there is a causal link to care, with results due spring 2013 and no immediate additional measures planned.
Because of this relatively high number of deaths, I have asked the IVenJ and the IGZ to jointly investigate whether there is a causal link between these suicides and the care provided by DJI.
Vanwege dit relatief hoge aantal sterfgevallen heb ik de IVenJ en de IGZ gevraagd gezamenlijk te onderzoeken of er een causaal verband tussen deze suïcides en de door DJI verleende zorg is.
Antwoord vragen Hilkens over het bericht waarin sprake is van het toestaan van virtuele kinderporno

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports suggesting virtual child pornography might be permitted, including whether the Lanzarote Convention and claimed therapeutic benefits or safety evidence support that. The minister answered that virtual child pornography must remain punishable, that the law already handles realistic images without difficulty for enforcement, that the Convention requires criminalisation with no reservation taken by the Netherlands, and that the therapeutic debate is unresolved.
I share the view that the production, viewing and possession of virtual child pornography must remain punishable.
Ik deel de mening dat het produceren, bekijken en bezitten van virtuele kinderporno strafbaar moet blijven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over illegale bordelen in massagesalons

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about half of Chinese massage parlours in the Netherlands are in fact illegal brothels, including whether the OM research would be shared, whether massage parlours should be subject to licensing and Bibob screening, and whether victim support and information for Chinese-speaking sex workers is adequate. The minister confirmed the research estimates illegal prostitution in roughly half the parlours, said it does not change existing rules, noted parlours offering sexual services need a municipal permit that allows Bibob screening, and pointed to a Chinese-language brochure and planned Chinese translation of a victim-rights leaflet, with a separate letter promised on the report.

Following a request from the Security and Justice committee of your House dated 8 November 2012 for a response on the state of efforts against Chinese massage parlours, I will address the research report in more detail in a separate letter.

Naar aanleiding van een verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Veiligheid en Justitie van uw Kamer van 8 november 2012, waarin wordt gevraagd om een reactie op de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de aanpak van Chinese massagesalons, zal ik in een aparte brief nader ingaan op het onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over gedwongen prostitutie en mensenhandel

An MP asked the Justice minister about forced prostitution and human trafficking, including cooperation with Hungary, awareness campaigns, EU strategy, victims who cannot report abuse, and prosecution statistics. The minister answered that the broadcasts contained no new facts, described bilateral police and prosecutor cooperation with Hungary and other source countries, outlined prevention and detection measures, and said prosecution data does not distinguish between ex officio cases and complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service's registration systems do not distinguish between a prosecution initiated ex officio and one initiated following a complaint.
In de registratiesystemen van het Openbaar Ministerie wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen een ambtshalve vervolging of een vervolging die is ingesteld naar aanleiding van een aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de grote toename van het aantal Hongaarse prostituees die gedwongen worden te werken voor pooiers

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the rise in Hungarian women forced into prostitution by pimps in the Netherlands, including whether legal prostitution attracts traffickers and whether sentencing and cooperation with Hungary are adequate. The minister said prostitution's legality is not the cause, that cooperation with Hungarian police and prosecutors is being intensified, that maximum sentences for trafficking will be raised via a bill, and that further research into sentencing is unnecessary.
I cannot make statements about the practice of the Amsterdam court without case-file research.
Over de praktijk van de Amsterdamse rechtbank kan ik geen uitspraken doen zonder dossieronderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing in Nederland

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about the arrest of Paul R. for handling stolen masterpieces, whether Germany seeks to prosecute him over the Bochum bribery scandal, and whether they should hear him and launch criminal investigation into match-fixing. The minister confirmed the German prosecution and European arrest warrant, said a thorough in-depth study of match-fixing is being commissioned, but no criminal investigation will start because the Netherlands lacks information on possible offences committed here.
Since the Netherlands does not currently have such information, no criminal investigation will be started.
Nu Nederland tot op heden niet over dergelijke informatie beschikt, wordt dan ook geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het gebruik van het pistool door agenten in stresssituaties

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers are adequately trained to use firearms under stress, whether the 32-hour annual shooting norm is met, and whether training and instruction will be improved. The minister replied that police firearm decisions are generally adequate, that the 32-hour norm applies with a pass rate above 93%, that the Integrale Beroepsvaardighedentraining is being revised with the Politieacademie and instructors, and that the report on the topic is attached.
I will take the findings of the report 'Shoot or not shoot' into account in the revision of the Integrated Professional Skills Training.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van het rapport Schieten of niet schieten betrekken bij de herziening van de Integrale Beroepsvaardigheids Trainingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over jurisprudentie in mensenhandelzaken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the National Rapporteur on Trafficking's findings on inconsistent sentencing and compensation in trafficking cases, and whether judicial specialisation and guidelines will follow. The minister answered that specialisation is being arranged from 1 January 2013, sentencing guidelines await a LOVS assessment expected this year, and a judicial Best Practice on victim compensation is due in spring 2013, while declining to reopen talks with the judiciary.
From 1 January 2013, each court will concentrate the handling of trafficking cases with a small number of judges and legal staff with expertise in this area.
Per 1 januari 2013 wordt per gerecht de behandeling van mensenhandelzaken geconcentreerd bij een klein aantal rechters en juridisch medewerkers met expertise op dit gebied.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Van Gerven over het gebruik van DNA uit ziekenhuizen voor opsporingsdoeleinden in strafzaken

MPs Leijten, Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether draft legislation would let justice examine hospital-held DNA for criminal investigations, and whether this breaches purpose limitation and deters patient participation in research. The minister confirmed that draft texts of a Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal were circulated for pre-consultation, that they are not government-approved, and that the dilemmas will be for the new cabinet to decide, referring to an earlier letter.
The draft texts have therefore not yet been approved by me or by the cabinet.
De concept-teksten zijn dus nog niet door mij of het kabinet geaccordeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hilkens over kindslaven uit Afghanistan

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Afghan boys, possibly child slaves ('dancing boys'), transit through the Netherlands to Scandinavia, and what evidence exists of trafficking or abuse in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Marechaussee noticed many Afghan illegal migrants transiting to Scandinavia, launched a joint investigation with the police whose results are being analysed, and that the Public Prosecution Service knows of no related cases, so discussion with the Afghan community is not warranted now.
The information obtained from this joint action is currently being analysed.
De uit deze gezamenlijke actie verkregen informatie wordt momenteel geanalyseerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de gevolgen van een uitspraak van het Europese Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens over de waardering van getuigenbewijs

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the ECtHR ruling in Vidgen v. Netherlands on the admissibility and weight of absent-witness evidence should be interpreted, its consequences for Dutch practice, its relation to the unus testis rule, and whether it affects pending cases and the crown witness scheme. The Minister answered that the ruling applies an existing framework differently to the facts, has limited general consequences, leaves the unus testis rule and the crown witness regulation unchanged, and that the Supreme Court will further concretise the principles.
The Court has however indicated that this starting point should not be applied in a rigid manner.
Het Hof heeft evenwel aangegeven dat dit uitgangspunt niet op een starre wijze dient te worden toegepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Bontes over het artikel ‘Drugrunners vechten met NS-personeel’

MPs De Graaf, Helder and Bontes asked whether a permanent public transport ban, a permanent police post at Rotterdam CS, tasers for NS staff, and broader group liability should follow a violent attack on NS staff by drug runners. The minister answered that a travel and stay ban bill is being prepared, that the police post will return after renovation, that tasers have no legal basis for NS staff, and that existing criminal law suffices.
A bill amending the Passenger Transport Act 2000 to allow a stay ban at stations, for example, is currently being prepared.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een voorstel tot wetswijziging van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 ten behoeve van een verblijfsverbod op bijvoorbeeld een station.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bisschop over de TV-serie Barbie’s Baby en het bericht ‘Holleeder-geknuffel moet stoppen’

MP Bisschop asked ministers whether broadcasting a TV series featuring a baby and a planned Holleeder interview were acceptable, and whether child labour rules and child protection were adequately applied. The minister answered that broadcasters are responsible for content and that the Labour Inspectorate issued a fine report because the producer had no exemption for child work, while stating that parents are primarily responsible and child protection intervention was not triggered.
The Labour Inspectorate has drawn up a fine report.
De Inspectie SZW heeft een boeterapport opgemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over de straf- en civielrechtelijke verjaringstermijnen bij diefstal in het algemeen en kunstroof in het bijzonder

MPs Van der Steur and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criminal and civil limitation periods for theft in general and art theft in particular, following the Kunsthal and Noortman thefts. The minister explained the 12-to-24-year criminal limitation periods, the 20-year civil acquisitive prescription that does not run in favour of a concealing thief, and comparisons with other EU states and US states, and said he does not intend to change the rules.
Since the answers to questions under 2 show that neither the thief nor the receiver becomes owner of the stolen item, I do not intend to change the rules on limitation periods.
Nu uit de beantwoording van de vragen onder 2 blijkt dat de dief noch de heler eigenaar wordt van de gestolen zaak, ben ik niet voornemens de regels met betrekking tot verjaring te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Segers over onvrijwillige prostitutie in Utrecht

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether he has noted the Utrecht mayor's claim that 80 to 90% of prostitutes work involuntarily, whether comparable estimates exist, how victims are helped, and whether exit programmes should be funded nationally. The minister confirms awareness, says no reliable estimate exists, describes victim-identification and support measures, and declines to change the locally based responsibility for exit programmes.
As stated in earlier letters to the House, responsibility for exit programmes lies with the municipalities, because prostitution policy is primarily a local matter.

Antwoord 4 Zoals aangegeven in eerdere brieven aan uw Kamer 4 ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor uitstapprogramma’s bij gemeenten, omdat prostitutiebeleid in eerste instantie een lokale aangelegenheid is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de aanpak van koperdiefstal

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about copper theft, including low arrest rates, registration of thefts by the KLPD, and delays on the railways. The government answered that arrest rates rose slightly, that registration is handled through agreed codes, and that the Actie Koperslag convenant progress report was sent to parliament.
In the first half of 2012, 13 suspects of copper theft (mainly on the railways) were arrested.
In de eerste helft van 2012 zijn 13 verdachten van koperdiefstal (vooral op het spoor) aangehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over dekkingspercentage en sluiting posten veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord

MP Kooiman asks the minister about fire-service coverage below 50% in Limburg-Noord and planned closures of posts such as Swalmen. The minister says the region must show compliance with response times and coverage plans, that the regional board is responsible for closures after regionalisation, and that the inspectorate will re-examine coverage in early 2013.
Furthermore, I have asked the chairs of the safety regions to inform me before the end of the year about the update of the regional coverage plan.
Verder heb ik de voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's verzocht om mij vóór het einde van het jaar te informeren over de actualisatie van het regionale dekkingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de sluiting van de brandweerpost in Swalmen

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asked the minister whether the Limburg-Noord safety region's decision to close the Swalmen fire post, given its low response-time compliance, complied with the required coverage plan, and what would be done to improve response times. The minister answered that closure is a municipal responsibility now and a regional one from 2013, pointed to the regional board's actualisation of the coverage plan, and said the Inspectorate will re-examine response times in early 2013.
If the findings of the Inspectorate give cause for it, I will call the chair of the safety region to account.
Indien de bevindingen van de Inspectie VenJ daartoe aanleiding geven, zal ik de betreffende voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat diefstal uit kerken en kloosters een onderschat probleem lijkt te zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether theft from churches and monasteries is underestimated and whether a national prosecutor for art and heritage crime should be restored, plus questions on opening the stolen-art database and a separate reporting code. The minister answered that art crime is being addressed through dedicated police task-accent holders and national OM contacts, that the national database is not public but feeds Interpol's, and that a separate reporting code is not favoured.
One of the measures is appointing a task-accent holder for art crime within each (future) regional police unit.
Een van de maatregelen is het aanstellen van een taakaccenthouder kunstcriminaliteit binnen elke (toekomstige) regionale politie-eenheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kuiken over het niet afnemen van criminele winsten van henneptelers

MPs Recourt and Kuiken asked why the Public Prosecution Service reduced confiscation claims against cannabis growers in Breda, whether this reflected backlogs or poor case files, and how many other prosecutors have weak confiscation. Minister Opstelten answered that the claims were lowered because initial calculations of illegal gains were too high, denied backlog or horse-trading motives, and said no further investigation was needed, promising a 2012 target of 49 million euros which he expects to meet.
In the relevant cases the adjustments were necessary because the initial calculation of the confiscation amount was too high.
In de desbetreffende zaken waren de aanpassingen noodzakelijk door een te hoge initiële berekening van het ontnemingsbedrag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet afpakken van misdaadgeld door Justitie

MP Kooiman (SP) asked whether the Breda prosecution service reduces confiscation claims against cannabis growers to clear backlogs, and whether this is acceptable. Minister Opstelten answered that crime must never pay and the aim remains full confiscation, refers to earlier answers on the same questions, and says that capacity is addressed in those answers.
Crime must never pay. The aim is and remains to confiscate the financial benefit from all arrested cannabis growers.
Misdaad mag nooit lonen. Het doel is en blijft om bij alle aangehouden hennepkwekers het genoten financiële voordeel af te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “OM Breda laat tonnen van wiettelers liggen”

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Breda public prosecution service lets large sums from cannabis growers slip and imposes community service instead, and whether community service should be abolished. The minister refers to earlier answers on the same matter, states that community service is not always suitable, and notes that legislation excluding community service for serious sexual and violent offences and recidivists took effect in early 2012.
I refer to the answer to questions 2 and 3 from members Recourt and Kuiken.
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar het antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 van de leden Recourt en Kuiken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de toegang van de VS tot data in de cloud

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether the US access to cloud-stored data of Dutch users, including protected data, is a problem and whether the government will advise against cloud use and consult US and EU counterparts. The state secretary replied that the risk is known, that responsibility lies primarily with data controllers, that no advice against cloud use is needed, and that the issue is being raised in EU negotiations on the data protection regulation.
I consider this an undesirable situation. This problem is known within the European Union, and the proposal for a General Data Protection Regulation seeks to offer a solution.
Ik acht dit een onwenselijke situatie. Dit probleem is bij de Europese Unie bekend, en het voorstel voor een Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming poogt daarvoor een oplossing aan te reiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over Amerikaanse toegang tot cloud-gegevens

The MP Oosenbrug asked whether US authorities can access Dutch cloud users' data more easily than assumed, whether Dutch users have limited legal protection under US law, and whether US constitutional safeguards apply to them. The state secretary answered that cloud users must be aware their data may be subject to US requests, that he cannot judge foreign law, and referred to earlier answers to similar questions without committing to new action.
It is not my role to give a judgment on the law of a third country.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg om een oordeel over het recht van een derde land te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen over ambulances die nog steeds niet over de busbaan mogen rijden

An MP asked ministers why ambulances still cannot use bus lanes despite a 2011 motion, and questioned the delay in implementing it. The minister acknowledges the delay, says overlap with a related Kamervragen answer caused it, and points to a reply sent to the Tweede Kamer stating no regulatory change is needed.
Unfortunately, a response to the motion and answering the questions from MP Wiegman required much consultation, which caused delays in handling.
Tot mijn spijt heeft een reactie op de motie en de beantwoording van de vragen van lid Wiegman veel overleg gekost, waardoor vertraging in de afhandeling is opgetreden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de constructie van tenten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about tent collapses at events, the inspection of a festival tent in Steenwijkerwold, the division of oversight between the Inspectorate and municipalities, and whether tent safety rules are adequate. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for event permits and oversight, that the Inspectorate has no direct role, that the 2012 inspection report was sent to municipal councils with recommendations, and that the inspectorates will review progress in 2013 while a decree on fire safety of temporary structures is in preparation.
Municipalities are responsible for and authorised to grant permits for events under the General Local Regulations (APV), which are based on the Municipalities Act.
De gemeenten zijn op grond van Algemene Plaatselijke Verordeningen (APV), die gebaseerd zijn op de Gemeentewet, verantwoordelijk voor en bevoegd tot het verlenen van een vergunning voor evenementen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de rechtmatigheid van Amerikaanse targeted killings

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the legality of US targeted drone killings in Pakistan, Yemen and Somalia, including signature strikes, attacks on rescuers and funerals, and UN recommendations. The minister said international humanitarian law may apply in an armed conflict with Al Qaida, that the legal framework is clear enough, that internal legal advice was received, and that she would not press US allies for a moratorium.
Regarding specific attacks in the countries concerned, I do not have the factual information needed to give a responsible judgement on their legality.
Ten aanzien van specifieke aanvallen in betreffende landen beschik ik niet over de feitelijke informatie die nodig zou zijn om een verantwoord oordeel te kunnen geven over de rechtmatigheid ervan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch en Van Dam over drugssmokkel naar Schiphol

Opposition MPs Marcouch and Van Dam asked the minister about drug smuggling via Curaçao to Schiphol, including whether Curaçao's detention facilities for swallowers are adequate and whether suspects are wrongly allowed to fly on. The minister replied that Curaçao is responsible for its own law enforcement, cells are available for non-swallowers, the swallower toilets are not working optimally, and a broader integrated approach including the Schiphol team is being reviewed with a later update promised.
Law enforcement in Curaçao is the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
De rechtshandhaving in Curaçao betreft de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht dat het woonrecht van krakers zwaarder weegt dan het belang van ontruimen

An MP from the PVV asks the Justice Minister about a ruling that a squatter's right to housing outweighed the State's interest in eviction, and about the limits of the criminal-eviction rule in Article 138a Sr, including whether the law should be changed so squatters are always prosecuted. The minister says the ruling is under appeal, defends the proportionality test set by the Supreme Court, sees no need for legislative change, and points to consistent eviction policy in Amsterdam.
I see no reason to amend the law.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot een wetswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Visser over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter te Groningen inzake de strafrechtelijke ontruiming van krakers op grond van art. 551a Sv.

MPs Van der Steur and Visser asked the ministers about a Groningen interim judge's refusal to allow criminal eviction of squatters under art. 551a Sv, and how this affects enforcement of the squatting ban. The minister said the case is under appeal so he will not judge it, that enforcement is not undermined since other courts allowed evictions, and gave statistics showing most court challenges to criminal evictions succeeded for the state.
As long as the case is before the court, I refrain from passing judgment.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is, onthoud ik me van een oordeel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een dodelijk jachtongeluk in Zwiggelte

An MP asked the government about a fatal hunting accident in Zwiggelte, the legality of night hunting with lights, and whether such hunts should be banned. The minister said the victim was a bystander, an investigation is ongoing, foxes fall outside the statutory night-hunting ban, provinces can grant exemptions, and no change to the framework is planned while the case and court proceedings are pending.
The answer from the Benelux Court on those questions is awaited.
Gewacht wordt op het antwoord van het Beneluxgerechtshof op die vragen.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Recourt over de rechtsmacht over militairen die koopvaardijschepen tegen piraten beschermen

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Dutch military protection teams on merchant ships could be prosecuted by other states, who holds jurisdiction in different maritime zones, and whether SOFAs are needed. The government answered that UNCLOS gives clear jurisdiction, Dutch flag vessels remain under Dutch criminal law, the Dutch prosecutor reviews any use of force, and there is no criminal immunity.
There is no question of criminal immunity.
Van strafrechtelijke immuniteit is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over handhaving van de Visserijwet 1963

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether police and green BOAs can check compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963 and whether the designation decree should be changed, and about staffing for fisheries poaching enforcement. The state secretary answered that existing powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure and Article 55 of the Act are sufficient, so no new designation is needed, and gave staffing figures.
I therefore am of the view that enforcement officers, including BOAs and police officers, have sufficient powers to carry out checks on compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963.
Ik ben derhalve van mening dat opsporingsambtenaren, waaronder BOA's en politieagenten, voldoende bevoegdheden hebben om controle uit te voeren op naleving van de Visserijwet 1963.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat Albert Heijn een betalingskorting oplegt aan haar leveranciers

An MP asked the ministers whether Albert Heijn's imposed two-point payment discount on suppliers is lawful, what role the government sees for itself in curbing abuse of purchasing power, and whether the NMa should supervise purchasing power preventively. The minister replied that the relationship is private law between firms, that Albert Heijn suspended the discount, that the ministry is facilitating a code of fair trading practices, and that studies on enforcement of the abuse-of-dominance ban and on existing law are forthcoming.
However, I also note that in practice it is difficult to demonstrate abuse of an economic dominant position.
Ik constateer echter ook dat het in de praktijk lastig is om misbruik van een economische machtspositie aan te tonen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van der Burg over het bericht dat een serieverkrachter tijdens een proefverlof ontsnapt is en dat het Openbaar Ministerie de ontsnapping heeft stil gehouden

MPs Van der Steur and Van der Burg asked why a serious rapist was granted leave from a juvenile institution despite being deemed dangerous, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not publicise his escape. The State Secretary explained that the leave was an authorised medical visit under supervision, that the escape was reported and investigated, and that the prosecution service judged publicity would harm the investigation; he committed to reviewing the policy after analysing recent escapes.
Following this, I will examine whether there is reason to tighten the policy.
Naar aanleiding hiervan zal ik bezien of er reden is tot aanscherping van het beleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de gevaren van het spionagevirus Flame voor Nederland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Flame spy virus had infected Dutch systems and what research and steps were planned. The minister answered that eight Dutch IP addresses do not mean eight infected computers, that there are no current indications of Dutch infections, and that the intelligence services are already investigating and will inform parliament if warranted.
If the investigation by the intelligence and security services gives cause for it, the House of Representatives will be informed via the appropriate channels.
Indien het onderzoek van de I&V-diensten hier aanleiding toe geeft dan zal de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd worden via de geëigende kanalen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over de inzet van lokpubers bij de bestrijding van internetdating en kinderporno

An MP asked the Justice minister whether a court ruling that police decoy 'lokpuber' operations could not lead to prosecution of a man targeting an apparent 13-year-old was correct, and whether law should be changed to allow police fake accounts on social media. The minister confirmed the ruling, said the prosecution service is appealing, and will consider a legal amendment only after the outcome is known.
Only once the outcome of this is known can it be considered whether a legislative amendment is required.
Pas als het resultaat hiervan bekend is kan worden bezien of een wetswijziging geboden is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodschieten van een stier die is gevallen uit een omgeslagen aanhangwagen op de A2

Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) asked why a bull fell from an overturned trailer on the A2 and was shot by police, whether transport rules were breached, whether the NVWA checks small transports, and what protocol applies. The state secretary answered that the transport fell under the lighter rules for trips under 50 km, no breach was found, NVWA samples such transports, police guidelines allowed shooting when the vet lacked sedative, and a joint protocol is being drafted.
It is not known whether, and if so why, the animals in the trailer were restless.
Het is niet bekend of, en zo ja waarom, de dieren in de aanhangwagen onrustig waren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hilkens over agressie tegen medewerkers van de NS door drugsrunners op Rotterdam CS

Labour MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the Minister of Security and Justice about aggression against NS railway staff by drug runners at Rotterdam Centraal, including whether the wietpas (cannabis pass) caused their return, and whether a full police post should be present. The minister said the incident involved a drunk youth rather than a drug runner, that a small number of drug runners are handled by a local supervision model, and that the police post was moved during renovation and will return.
Information from the Rotterdam-Rijnmond police shows there are no indications that the person who fought with the NS employees was a drug runner.

Uit informatie van het korps Rotterdam-Rijnmond blijkt dat ten aanzien van het in de media genoemde incident geen aanwijzingen bestaan dat de persoon die in gevecht raakte met de NS-medewerkers een drugsrunner was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Agema over het bericht “Woning oudere steeds vaker overvallen”

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why burglaries of elderly people's homes are rising while overall robberies fall, and what will be done to protect seniors. The minister says the risk of victimisation is lower for the elderly but impact is greater, cites existing prosecution guidelines and sentencing considerations, and lists preventive measures such as information meetings, video doorbells and a toolkit for municipalities.
Precisely because of that great impact, tackling robberies is a national priority for the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Juist vanwege die grote impact is de aanpak van overvallen een landelijke prioriteit voor politie en Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanpak van homogeweld als prioriteit bij de Nationale Politie

MP Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the anti-violence-against-gays approach in Amsterdam should become national policy, whether it should be a separate priority for the new National Police, and whether specialised 'Roze in Blauw' capacity should be created. The minister answered that the Amsterdam practice is being rolled out nationally, that anti-gay violence is handled within broad priorities rather than as a separately labelled category, and that a further progress letter will follow this autumn.
This autumn I will again inform your House about the progress of the approach to discrimination.
Dit najaar zal ik uw Kamer wederom informeren over de voortgang van de aanpak van discriminatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch met betrekking tot de halvering van de politie inzet voor zakkenrollerij

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Amsterdam police pickpocketing team had been halved and how many officers it had, and whether this explained a rise in pickpocketing reports during Gay Pride. The minister confirmed the team is a flexible, non-fixed unit whose size depends on available capacity, said reports rose from 21 to 42 on the busiest Gay Pride day, and denied a demonstrable link to team cuts while committing to continued attention to pickpocketing.
As a result, the deployment of this target group team is difficult to quantify in terms of the number of police officers who carried out work within this temporary arrangement.
Hierdoor is de inzet van dit doelgroepenteam lastig te kwantificeren in termen van aantallen politiemensen die werkzaamheden hebben verricht binnen dit tijdelijke verband.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het transport van gevaarlijke stoffen over de weg

An MP asked ministers about inspection findings that around 30% of trucks carrying dangerous goods failed safety rules, mostly minor lapses, and about gaps in emergency-services knowledge and incident management. The government accepted the inspection finding, said most violations are minor and the industry is primarily responsible, pointed to ongoing ILT inspections and existing emergency-response arrangements, and disputed that cooperation with emergency services is insufficient.
I endorse the conclusion of the ILT.
Ik onderschrijf de conclusie van de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de aanpak van homogeweld als prioriteit bij de Nationale Politie

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether a gay man in Helmond who has not returned home for seven weeks after alleged anti-gay violence shows that a national anti-homophobic-violence policy and specialised 'Roze in blauw' police capacity are needed. The minister answers that the police and prosecutor handled the complaints, the prosecutor dropped them for lack of evidence and partial contributory fault, and that the national police will have national oversight of such violence without announcing new specialised capacity.
Within the national police there will be national oversight of the approach to anti-homosexual violence.
Binnen de nationale politie zal er landelijk zicht zijn op (de aanpak van) anti-homogeweld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de verzekeringsmaatschappij van DigiNotar niet meewerkt aan verzoek van de curator

An SP MP asked whether the insurer of bankrupt DigiNotar refusing the curator's request for policy documents should be met with legal action, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister replied that the report was misquoted, the insurer had sent the file, the curator has ample statutory powers including court orders, and he has neither the power nor need to intervene in a specific bankruptcy.
I have neither the power nor the need to interfere in a specific bankruptcy.
Ik heb noch de bevoegdheid noch de behoefte om mij in een specifiek faillissement te mengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat het succesvolle Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit door de minister wordt opgeheven

MP Marcouch asks the minister why the successful Landelijk Team Transportcriminaliteit is being dissolved, why the House learned of it from the press, and whether the successful approach to cargo theft will be maintained. The minister answers that the team's knowledge and expertise will be secured within the National Police through the Landelijke Eenheid, that cargo theft has fallen sharply, and that the public-private convenant runs until end 2013 with continuation after 2013 under consideration.
This does not mean, however, that existing successful working methods, such as the deployment of the police in tackling transport crime, will be ended.
Dit betekent echter niet dat bestaande succesvolle werkwijzen, zoals de inzet van de politie bij de aanpak van transportcriminaliteit, worden beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob over de aanpak van transportbendes

MP Slob asks why the national transport crime team and the dedicated prosecutor are being abolished with the arrival of the national police, and how the team's successes will be secured. The minister replies that the team's knowledge and expertise will be secured within the national police, that an evaluation and prosecution advice is being considered by the College of Procurators-General, and that the public-private approach will not be abandoned.
I will ensure that the intended objectives of establishing the transport crime team and the national prosecutor for transport crime, and the approaches they developed, are secured.

Ik zal erop toezien dat de beoogde doelstellingen van de instelling van het team transportcriminaliteit en de landelijk officier transportcriminaliteit en de door hen ontwikkelde aanpakken worden geborgd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oskam over het vrijgeven van persoonsgegevens van relschoppers door het Openbaar Ministerie aan het Verbond van Verzekeraars

An MP asked the minister whether privacy rules prevent the Public Prosecution Service from giving convicted rioters' personal data to the Dutch insurers' association, which wants to pursue damage claims collectively. The minister explained that insurers of directly involved persons may receive such data under existing rules, that the association is not named as a recipient, and that talks are ongoing to see whether changes are desirable.
On that basis it will be assessed whether, and if so which, changes in the manner of providing data are possible or desirable.
Op basis daarvan zal worden beoordeeld of en zo ja welke wijzigingen in de wijze van verstrekking van gegevens mogelijk of gewenst zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het onderzoek naar de moord op Marianne Vaatstra

MP Brinkman asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the investigation into the murder of Marianne Vaatstra, including the handling of threats, the identification of suspect Ali H., the transfer of F.M., and DNA testing of a fellow inmate. The Minister answers that no complaint was filed about the threat, that the Turkish arrest was confirmed by fingerprints, that DNA testing was done in 2010 and found no match, and declines to order further DNA testing.
It is not in the interest of the investigation to release further information.
Het is niet in het belang van het onderzoek om nog meer informatie naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen in Haren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the months-long inquiry into the Haren riots is too slow, given the lessons police need and the need for interim findings, and whether the minister would discuss speeding it up with the inquiry committee. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said the committee is working carefully and will issue recommendations as soon as possible, and said the inquiry will be finished earlier if that is possible without sacrificing thoroughness.
The committee is doing its work carefully and thoroughly and will come with recommendations for the police, municipalities and the Public Prosecution Service as soon as possible.
De commissie doet zorgvuldig en degelijk haar werk en zal zo spoedig mogelijk met aanbevelingen komen voor politie, gemeenten en OM.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen met betrekking tot de onduidelijke taakopvatting en bevoegdheden van buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren

Berndsen (D66) asks the Minister of Security and Justice how the growing role of municipal enforcement officers (boa's) alongside the police fits with earlier statements that they are not a substitute for police, and what steps will clarify their tasks and powers and the police-boa division. The Minister says cooperation and information-sharing are being reviewed with partners, the police hold operational direction while municipalities hold strategic direction, and a VNG vision on boa's is expected by year-end.
Based on this inventory, I will determine together with the parties involved in early 2013 which actions are needed to improve information exchange.
Op grond van deze inventarisatie bepaal ik begin 2013 samen met betrokken partijen welke acties nodig zijn om tot een verbetering van de informatieuitwisseling te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over berichten dat ouderen steeds vaker slachtoffer van misdrijven worden

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that elderly people are increasingly victims of crime, including figures on Slachtofferhulp Nederland clients aged 65 and over and whether the risk is rising. The minister answers that the rise in elderly clients reflects automatic referral and greater vulnerability rather than proven growth in crime, that elderly victims remain less likely to be victimised than others but are more vulnerable to impact, and lists preventive measures and sentencing practice.
On the basis of the figures from Slachtofferhulp Nederland no conclusion can be drawn about an actual increase in violence against the elderly.
Op basis van de cijfers van Slachtofferhulp Nederland is geen conclusie te trekken over de daadwerkelijke toename van geweld tegen ouderen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bemmel over het bericht dat curatoren maar liefst dertig miljoen declareerden bij de afwikkeling van het DSB faillissement

The MP asks whether curator fees of about 30 million euro in the DSB bankruptcy are excessive, whether the appointment system gives curators no incentive for value, and whether the Bankruptcy Act should be changed to tender curator assignments by price. The minister defends the costs as justified by complexity and existing court and creditor oversight, says the appointment system is linked to specialist training, and offers to discuss reform with the judiciary and INSOLAD without judging the DSB case.
I am willing to enter into discussion on this with the Council for the Judiciary and INSOLAD.
Ik ben bereid om hierover het gesprek met de Raad voor de Rechtspraak en INSOLAD aan te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat er in Amsterdam tenminste 200 vrouwen “gekooid” leven

An MP asked the ministers whether a report that at least 200 women in Amsterdam are kept confined by their families is accurate, what the government is doing about it, whether such confinement is criminal, and whether national data exists. The government answered that it shares the goal of women's participation and points to existing programmes and the Wet inburgering, that forced confinement can constitute deprivation of liberty under the Criminal Code, and that no national figures exist, with a research study promised for the first half of 2013.
There is no national data on the number of women who are forced to stay indoors and may not have contact with others.
Er zijn geen landelijke gegevens over het aantal vrouwen dat gedwongen wordt binnenshuis te blijven en geen contact met anderen mag hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over mogelijke Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij 'rendition' naar Libië

MP El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Security and Justice and Immigration about alleged Dutch involvement in unlawful rendition of detainees to Libya, including the handling of asylum claimant Abu Farsan, and whether independent investigation would be conducted. Minister Leers answers on behalf of the ministers, but the text provided is cut off before the substantive answers appear, so the responsiveness and commitments cannot be confirmed.
I hereby provide you confidentially with the answers, on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice, to the written questions
Hierbij bied ik u vertrouwelijk de antwoorden*), mede namens de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, aan op de schriftelijke vragen
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het verdwijnen van het Openbaar Ministerie uit Zeeland

MP Recourt asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether promises were made to keep a local public prosecution office in Zeeland, and about the consequences of its closure for the criminal justice chain, proximity to mayors, jobs, and the court's status. The minister replied that no decision on housing the prosecution offices has been taken yet, no promises were made for the new Zeeland-West-Brabant district, service quality is paramount, consultations with three regions are ongoing, and Middelburg will be designated a court location.
Contrary to what the question assumes, I have not yet taken a decision on the housing of the various OM prosecution offices in the new districts.
Anders dan in de vraagstelling wordt verondersteld heb ik nog geen beslissing genomen over de huisvesting van de verschillende OM-parketten in de nieuwe arrondissementen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de geplande islamitische betogingen voor het Amerikaanse consulaat

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of planned Islamic demonstrations near the US consulate in Amsterdam, which organisations were behind them, whether AIVD monitors those involved, and whether violence would be met with firm action. The minister confirmed awareness, named the two organising groups, declined to say whether the AIVD monitors anyone, and declined to pre-announce how police would act, saying only that any response would be effective and proportionate.
I cannot publicly disclose anything about groups or individuals who are or are not under investigation by the AIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over groepen/individuen die al dan niet in onderzoek zijn bij de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marcouch over de staat van de Politieacademie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the minister about the Police Academy's deficit, its governance and budget approval, exam backlogs, examiner withdrawals and external training purchases by police forces. The minister answered that the supervisory board did not approve the 2012 budget over a financing risk, that a financial and operational audit and an improvement plan were ordered, that exam backlogs were largely cleared by August 2012, and that a Rekenkamer investigation was not warranted.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans, Recourt en Marcouch over neonazi’s in Duitsland

MPs Timmermans, Recourt and Marcouch asked the Justice minister about the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia banning three far-right groups and a large police raid, and whether this threatens spillover into the Netherlands and whether closer cooperation is needed. The minister answered that cooperation with German police and the AIVD is good and structural, that the raid led to no Dutch link so far, and that action will follow if Dutch links emerge.
Should facts emerge later in the investigation that relate to the Netherlands, action will be taken on this.
Mochten er in het verdere verloop van het onderzoek alsnog feiten boven tafel komen die verband houden met Nederland, dan zal hier actie op worden ondernomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de georganiseerde escorte van de begrafenisstoet van een lid van de motorclub Satudarah

MP Marcouch asked whether police escorted the funeral procession of a Satudarah motorcycle club member, how such escorts are decided, and how to avoid giving the impression of endorsing criminal clubs. The minister replied that no police escort took place, that the club was not allowed to escort the procession, that police only enforced traffic rules, and that no disorder or safety problems occurred.
There has been no police escort.
Van een politiële escorte is geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over nieuwe berichten over «middeleeuwse belastingheffing»

MP Heijnen asked ministers about reports that municipalities such as Woerden may face the medieval 'dertiende penning' land levy, including whether it can be imposed at any time and on what legal basis. The government answered that Woerden had not yet received an assessment, that the right persists until 2015 under a 1984 law, that the state's own position is being examined with a commitment to inform parliament, and that the levy rests on a surviving medieval property right.
The position of the State is currently being mapped and it is being examined whether it is opportune for the State to exercise its rights, and if so how.
Momenteel wordt de positie van de Staat in kaart gebracht en wordt onderzocht of het opportuun is dat de Staat haar rechten zal effectueren
Antwoord vragen van het lid Recourt over oplichters werkzaam in de schuldsanering

Recourt (PvdA) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he knew of a rise in fraudulent debt-restructuring trustees and budget coaches, what was being done about it, and whether emotional support is addressed for people with debts. Minister Opstelten answered that the growth is unproven, pointed to a pending bill setting quality standards for protective trustees and the Wet op het consumentenkrediet and DNB/BEH supervision, and noted municipalities' responsibility for quality of debt assistance.
It is not certain that the number of fraudulent trustees and budget coaches is increasing rapidly.
Het is niet zeker of het aantal malafide bewindvoerders en budgetcoaches snel toeneemt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat winkeliers moeten opdraaien voor letsel dat personeel bij een overval oploopt

An MP asked the minister whether employers can be held liable for injuries their staff suffer in robberies, whether damages should first be recovered from the offender, and whether employers or insurers can get an advance from the State's victim-advance scheme. The minister answered that employers can be held liable mainly for failing their duty of care, that the State's advance scheme covers only direct victims not employers or insurers, and that no figures on such liability claims are known.
Figures on how many liability claims are brought by employees against employers where the employee suffered injury from a robbery or other crime are not known to me.

Cijfers over hoeveel aansprakelijkheidsstellingen er plaatsvinden door werknemers van werkgevers waarbij vanwege een overval of andere vorm van criminaliteit de werknemer letselschade heeft opgelopen, zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over slachtoffers van internetoplichting die in de kou blijven staan

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about victims of internet fraud left unprotected, including police capacity, the role of marketplace sites and banks, and reversing payments. The minister says the Meldpunt Internetoplichting and the Fraudehelpdesk have improved the approach, that consumers must act cautiously, and that banks decide on action themselves.
A lot has been invested in improving the approach to fraud via auction and sales sites.
Er is veel geïnvesteerd om de aanpak van oplichting via veiling- en verkoopsites te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over klachten over het politie-uniform

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about shortages and waiting lists for police uniform trousers caused by a supplier's failure, and whether budget cuts played a role. The minister answered that the supplier defaulted and went bankrupt, that the shortage has been resolved by contracting new suppliers and building a stock, and that budget cuts played no role.
In September 2011 the contract with the then supplier was extended.
In september 2011 is het contract met de toenmalige leverancier verlengd.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over het bericht dat een VVD-raadslid te Noordwijk van mening is dat de politie medeverantwoordelijk is voor agressie tegen ambulancemedewerkers

An opposition MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police were partly responsible for aggression against ambulance staff during disturbances in Noordwijk, and requested a factual account of police conduct. The minister reported the incident, denied police shared responsibility, said the conduct was discussed locally and noted one complaint had been filed under the standard procedure.
One complaint has been filed with the Hollands-Midden police regarding the police conduct on the Grent.
Er is bij de politie Hollands-Midden één klacht ingediend omtrent het politieoptreden op de Grent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de mishandeling van een Oegandese Gaypride bezoeker

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether suspects in the assault of an Ugandan Gay Pride visitor had been arrested, whether they belonged to a Ugandan party, their nationality, whether a doubled prosecution demand applies for discriminatory assault, and what measures will be taken against homophobia imported from other countries. The minister answered that an investigation is ongoing so no details can be shared, that the Discrimination Directive would apply with a 50% or 100% increase in the demand if the case is prosecuted, and that discriminatory expression and violence are punishable regardless of the convictions behind them.
This investigation is still ongoing, which is why I make no further statements about it.
Dit onderzoek loopt nog, reden waarom ik daar verder geen mededelingen over doe.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zoveelste brute mishandeling door Marokkaans tuig en de bizarre reactie door de politie

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration about a brutal assault by a group they describe as Moroccan youths and about an alleged police failure to assist the victim. The government confirmed awareness of the report, said the investigation is ongoing, denied that police left the victim behind, and stated that it does not distinguish by ethnicity in tackling youth nuisance while leaving sentencing to the courts and noting that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The criminal investigation into the precise facts and circumstances of this case is still ongoing.
Het opsporingsonderzoek naar de precieze feiten en omstandigheden in deze zaak is nog gaande.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over schending door Eritrea van het VN wapenembargo

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the government about Eritrea's reported 2% diaspora tax funding its military in apparent breach of the UN arms embargo, and whether such practices occur in the Netherlands. The minister said the tax is not judged to breach the embargo, that police and prosecutors depend on victim complaints, that the Eritrean chargé was summoned, and that the issue is raised in EU fora.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ormel over vernieling van proefvelden met aardappelen in Valthermond en Lelystad

An MP asked ministers about the vandalism of potato trial fields in Valthermond and Lelystad, including its importance for food security, progress on investigations, and whether the attacks were linked. The state secretary condemned the vandalism, stressed the research's value and the public consultation on the permit, said the Valthermond case is under investigation and police are monitoring Lelystad, and that the two attacks differed and no group has claimed responsibility.
I cannot anticipate the results of the investigation.
Ik kan niet op de resultaten van het onderzoek vooruit lopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over een tekort aan opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the Justice minister about a shortage of shelter for victims of human trafficking and domestic violence, and whether responsibility lies with the national government or municipalities. The minister replied that there is currently no shortage of beds for trafficking victims after capacity was raised from 50 to 70, that funding responsibility is clarified through existing arrangements, and that a separate recovery claim against perpetrators is unnecessary.
At present 70 shelter places are sufficient to accommodate the victims in the reflection period.
Op dit moment zijn 70 opvangplaatsen voldoende om de slachtoffers in de bedenktijd op te vangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de gedwongen uithuwelijking van een Nederlands meisje in Somalië

An MP asked ministers whether they were aware of the case of a Dutch girl forced into marriage in Somalia and abandoned there, how the embassy handled her case, and whether a Forced Marriage Unit like the British one should be set up in the Netherlands. The government answered that embassy assistance is limited by foreign legal systems, declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, and said an analysis of options, including the British model, will be sent to parliament in spring 2013.
In view of the protection of the privacy and safety of S., we cannot go into the individual case.
In verband met de bescherming van de privacy en veiligheid van S. kunnen wij niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het bericht dat de verkoop van wiet is verplaatst naar de straat

An MP asked the Justice minister about reports that cannabis sales had moved from coffeeshops to the street after the wietpas introduction, asking about complaints, arrests, member-list obligations, and an earlier evaluation. The minister said street dealing has occurred and police act on it, gave 386 arrests in Limburg (not all drug-dealing related), said a full national complaint count does not exist, confirmed coffeeshops must produce controllable member lists, and promised a report to parliament in October 2012 with the evaluation's interim report expected in spring 2013.
A quantitative overall picture does not exist.
Een kwantitatief totaalbeeld is er niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat gemeenten woonwagenkampen mijden

An MP asked whether municipalities avoid enforcing law on caravan (woonwagen) sites, whether residents or staff face disproportionate aggression, and about victim support and training; the minister said 44 municipalities may face 'vrijplaats' problems, police do not record residence on caravan sites so no data exist, and referred to handbooks, anonymous reporting options and the Veilige Publieke Taak programme, with no concrete new commitment.
Police registration systems do not record whether a person lives on a caravan site.
In de registratiesystemen van de politie wordt niet vastgelegd of een persoon woont op een woonwagenlocatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over het gebrek aan regels bij het opzetten van een filefuik bij autoachtervolgingen

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister why police officers deciding on creating a traffic blockade (filefuik) during car chases have no clear rules, and about prosecution after the A2 incident. The minister said a national framework is being drafted within three months, police will show restraint meanwhile, and the Public Prosecution Service found the risk to road users too high, but corporate criminal liability and individual prosecution were ruled out.
In the meantime, restraint will be exercised in creating a traffic blockade to arrest a suspect.
In afwachting hiervan zal terughoudendheid worden betracht met het creëren van een filefuik ter aanhouding van een verdachte.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over budget voor wijkenaanpak voor de wijk Kalsdonk in Roosendaal

An MP asked whether national funds were given to Roosendaal for the Kalsdonk neighbourhood, what they aim at, and how residents' concerns about youth nuisance, drug dealing and benefit fraud were being handled. The minister confirmed EUR 1 million for a socio-economic programme plus EUR 100,000 for resident budgets, said monitoring is primarily by the municipal council with yearly progress reports to parliament, and said the municipality is responsible and no further national involvement is planned.
Tackling the problems is primarily a responsibility of the municipality.
De aanpak van de problematiek is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, Van Toorenburg en Van der Staaij over de schadelijke gevolgen door blowen

MPs asked the government about harms of heavy cannabis use among young people, including effects on brain development and psychosis risk, and whether schools should act more strictly and the minimum age for softdrugs be raised to 21. The minister replied that existing drug policy already reflects these risks, that schools are tightening enforcement and drug use is declining, that the research shows no case for raising the age to 21 on current evidence, and that the 350-metre coffeeshop distance rule takes effect in 2014 after a transition period.
This report does not give cause for this at present.
Daartoe geeft dit bericht vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht dat cannabis slecht is voor de ontwikkeling van de hersenen van jongeren

The MP asks whether a youth substance-use action plan will be made, whether parents will be informed, whether names of pupils using soft drugs should be disclosed, and about coffeeshop compliance and the wietpas effects. The minister says existing prevention programmes continue, no new action plan is launched due to the caretaker cabinet, incident registration is the tool for schools, and a coffeeshop report will follow in October 2012.
I do not have recent figures on coffeeshops' compliance with the two criteria you mention, but I expect to receive the results of a study commissioned from Intraval shortly.
Ik beschik niet over recente cijfers over de naleving door coffeeshops van de twee in uw vraag genoemde criteria, maar op korte termijn verwacht ik de uitkomsten te ontvangen van een onderzoek
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de islamitische waarschuwing voor rellen

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Immigration ministers whether reported Muslim warnings of riots in Amsterdam reflect Islamisation and what measures have been taken against it. The minister answered that there are currently no concrete indications of riots and that the quoted views are illustrative only, not evidence of Islamisation.
At this moment I do not have concrete indications that riots, as described in the article, threaten in Amsterdam.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over concrete aanwijzingen dat er rellen, zoals beschreven in het artikel, dreigen in Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de wietpas in Maastricht

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the cannabis 'wietpas' in Maastricht, which reportedly pushed buyers toward illegal street dealing, should be reversed given rising nuisance and public health concerns. The Minister says police act against street dealing, he is in continuous consultation with the regional tripartite bodies, drug tourism has fallen sharply, and he will report to parliament in October 2012 without committing to reversal.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over kinderen die in Maastricht in drugs handelen

The MP asks whether children in Maastricht are involved in selling cannabis, what the government will do about it, and about school attendance, diplomas and seizing criminal assets. The minister answers that police and truancy officers address juvenile street dealing with criminal and school-return approaches, promises a report to parliament in October 2012, and points to existing education in youth detention and planned legislation.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de toegenomen drugsoverlast en straathandel in Breda door de wietpas

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported increases in street drug dealing, nuisance and drug runners in Breda after the national introduction of the cannabis pass, and whether the rollout should be halted pending assessment and a parliamentary debate.
