The minister answered that police act on street dealing, he is in continuous consultation with regional tripartite bodies, early reporting shows fewer drug tourists, and he will report to parliament in October 2012, while declining to halt the policy and noting temporary extra police capacity is being assessed through regional reports.

I am in continuous and intensive consultation with the tripartite bodies in Limburg, North Brabant and Zeeland in order to draw a complete and detailed picture of their experiences in implementing the tightened coffeeshop policy.

Ik ben in continu en intensief overleg met de driehoeken in Limburg, Noord-Brabant en Zeeland ten einde een compleet en gedetailleerd beeld van hun ervaringen in de uitvoering van het aangescherpte coffeeshopbeleid op tekenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het Haarlemse alternatief voor de wietpas

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he welcomes Haarlem's own alternative to the national cannabis pass for coffeeshops and whether it could replace the national rollout. The minister confirmed the report, praised Haarlem's attention to prevention, and described the Haarlem keurmerk as a bundling of existing national policy and instruments, without committing to examine a national roll-out.

The Haarlem keurmerk concerns a collection of existing policy (as it stood before 1 January 2012) from the ministries of Security and Justice and of Health, Welfare and Sport, and existing instruments.

Het keurmerk in Haarlem betreft een verzameling van bestaand beleid (zoals dat gold voor 1 januari 2012) van de ministeries van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en bestaande instrumenten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over Kamervragen over het ronselen van gehandicapte meisjes voor seks

An MP asked the government how it responds to reports that girls with intellectual disabilities were recruited by loverboys for sex, and what protection, aftercare, reporting and prosecution measures exist. The government answered that a cross-departmental action plan applies, that seven suspects in Limburg have been arrested, that victims were heard by certified officers, and that further measures will follow the ongoing inventory and GIA reporting.
The public prosecution service does not record the extent to which victims of human trafficking have intellectual disabilities.
Het OM houdt niet bij in welke mate de slachtoffers van mensenhandel verstandelijk beperkt zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Groot over de werkwijze van gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs Recourt and Groot asked whether bailiffs allocate collected payments first to costs, then interest, then principal, and whether this creates tax or legal issues, notably in ABN AMRO cases. The government answered that the Article 6:44 BW order applies, found no indications of tax avoidance or criminal conduct, and said the Bureau Financieel Toezicht is conducting an exploratory investigation into bailiffs' interest calculations, expected to conclude in October.
In January 2012 the Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) started an exploratory investigation into interest calculation by bailiffs.
In januari 2012 is het Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) gestart met een verkennend onderzoek naar renteberekening door gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de bedreiging van Turkse homo’s

An MP asked the Justice and Education ministers about threats against Turkish gay pride boat participants, including whether complaints led to prosecution and whether victims were supported. The minister reported five police reports, no formal complaints filed, no ex officio prosecution for now, and that contact and emancipation support continue.
Discrimination offences such as articles 137c and 137d of the Criminal Code can be prosecuted ex officio, but the Public Prosecution Service currently sees no reason to do so in this case.

Discriminatiedelicten zoals artikel 137c en 137d van het Wetboek van Strafrecht kunnen wel ambtshalve worden vervolgd, maar het Openbaar Ministerie ziet hiervoor in dit geval vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Toorenburg over problemen bij het zuiver aanvaarden van een nalatenschap

MPs Omtzigt and Van Toorenburg asked about heirs who unknowingly accepted an inheritance purely (zuiver) and so became liable for debts, including whether bank forms, emptying the estate and court fees trap heirs, and why minors are protected but not uninformed adults. The state secretary answered that heirs can get free public information and notary advice, that certain acts count as pure acceptance, that protecting minors reflects their inability to judge, and that beneficiary acceptance mostly causes unnecessary burdens, while promising only to consult the profession if a law change is considered.
I maintain my position that beneficiary acceptance will in most cases lead to unnecessary administrative burdens for citizens.
Ik blijf bij mijn standpunt dat beneficiaire aanvaarding in de meeste gevallen zal leiden tot onnodige administratieve lasten voor de burger.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Jong en Helder over het bericht Controle A2 op 23 juli in werking

Two PVV MPs asked whether traffic enforcement should focus on urban roads rather than motorway speed checks, whether the 100 km/h limit on the A2 should be raised, and whether the A2 speed trajectory checks should stop as a revenue measure. The minister replied that speed enforcement on motorways serves safety, air quality and noise goals, that the limit may be raised to 130 km/h at night and evening between Vinkeveen and Maarssen via a forthcoming traffic decision, and that the checks will not be stopped because they were agreed with neighbouring municipalities.
I am therefore not willing to stop this.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid hiermee te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Eijsink over de bestrijding van drugssmokkel via Schiphol

MPs Marcouch and Eijsink asked whether the Schiphol team combining Customs and Marechaussee officers is effective against drug smuggling and whether it is being dismantled. The minister denied plans to split the teams, said the integrated approach will be extended, and promised to inform parliament once an ongoing review of the team's functioning is complete.
Once the review is completed, I will inform your House of the outcomes and the consequences for the Schiphol team.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond, informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten en de consequenties hiervan voor het Schipholteam.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken met betrekking tot het niet langer in beslag nemen van scooters

An MP (PvdA) asked why police no longer seize tampered mopeds on a second offence, and requested seizure figures and enforcement intensity per region. The minister said the change only concerns registration-document impoundment to reduce administrative workload, that direct seizure still applies in dangerous cases or repeat offences within two years, and that the police and prosecution do not keep the requested statistics.
The police and the public prosecution service do not keep statistics on the reason for seizure, the number of scooters seized, or the eventual outcome.
Politie en OM houden geen statistieken bij van de aanleiding tot inbeslagname, het aantal in beslag genomen scooters en de uiteindelijke afloop.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de vele kwaadaardige websites die in Nederland worden gehost

MPs Gesthuizen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Dutch servers host a large share of malicious websites, and whether Dutch policy on hosting providers and rogue ISPs is adequate and enforced. The minister disputes the reported figures as inconsistent, says Dutch cybercrime enforcement is strong, promises to put enforcement on the Platform Internetveiligheid agenda, and states that the NCSC is not a supervisor and imposes no sanctions.
The NCSC is not a supervisor and therefore imposes no sanctions.
Het NCSC is geen toezichthouder en legt daarmee geen sancties op.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over dubieuze faillissementen en doorstarters in de transportsector

MP Gesthuizen (SP) asked ministers about bankruptcy fraud and abusive re-startups in the transport sector, including whether curators' criminal complaints and Dutch-German cross-border transport permits are adequately handled. The ministers answered that an integrated anti-fraud approach is underway, an analysis of bankruptcy fraud is being prepared, and Dutch and German authorities have strengthened cooperation on transport licences, but they declined to add further measures or meet with the unions and foundation.

In addition to this report, I can inform your House that an analysis of bankruptcy fraud is being drawn up, on the basis of which the information position and cooperation in the chain can be further strengthened.

In aanvulling op deze rapportage kan ik uw Kamer melden dat er een analyse faillissementsfraude wordt opgesteld op basis waarvan de informatiepositie en de samenwerking in de keten verder kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MP Van Raak asked whether a corruption probe on Bonaire, triggered by 2007 information from a governance foundation, was stalled and whether the Bonaire state reform or political pressure played a role in ending it, and what the minister would do to ensure independence. The minister answered that the investigation was halted by the investigating judge's decision and resumption ordered by the Court, that he has confidence in judicial independence and sees no sign of political interference, and referred to earlier answers for the timing questions.
I have firm confidence in judicial independence, and have no indication that the decisions mentioned are the result of political pressure or interference.
Ik heb vast vertrouwen in de rechterlijke onafhankelijkheid, en heb geen enkele aanwijzing dat de genoemde beslissingen het gevolg zijn van politieke druk of inmenging.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked why the government did not act on long-standing corruption rumours on Bonaire, why the international corruption investigation was halted, and how public integrity will be strengthened. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service is pursuing criminal investigations, that earlier reports were forwarded to prosecutors, that the case was dismissed in 2011 but partly revived by a court in 2012, and that integrity is primarily the responsibility of the local administration with ministry-set preconditions.

On 13 September 2012 the Court declared the complaint well-founded for two dossiers forming part of the total investigation and instructed the Public Prosecution Service to prosecute the suspects for those offences.

Het Hof heeft deze klacht op 13 september 2012 gegrond verklaard voor twee dossiers die deel uitmaakten van het totale onderzoek, en het OM opgedragen de verdachten alsnog voor die feiten te vervolgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren  over Odfjell: “Heeft u kennis kunnen nemen van het artikel ‘Onafhankelijkheid inspectie is bijna geheel verdwenen’?”

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the government would act on the Chemie-Pack and Odfjell cases, why enforcement in the chemical sector lagged, whether budget cuts were to blame, and whether an independent supervisor should be created. The state secretary admitted compliance problems, pointed to uniform enforcement strategy, legal safeguards and regional consolidation of inspections, and declined to pre-empt the Safety Board's ongoing investigation.
I do not want to anticipate the conclusions of that investigation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de conclusies van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dijsselbloem over de (on)veiligheid op en rond het water

Two MPs asked ministers about drowning risk, reduced lifeguard supervision in the Gelderland river area, subsidies to lifeguard organisations and who is responsible for supervision. The state secretary answered that supervision is a local decision, that the ministry funds a regional lifeguard cooperation but not local brigades, and that no supervision requirements will be included in the new Zwemwaterwet.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

MP De Roon asks whether the Dutch shipping sector's use of armed private security guards aboard vessels, absent a legal basis, is acceptable, and whether the government will guarantee affordable, flexible naval protection or legislate for certified private guards. The minister answers that the government prioritises naval Vessel Protection Detachments, will keep monitoring level-playing-field effects and may consider further measures, while stating that the current demand for VPDs is below capacity and that Defence does not compete commercially with private firms.
The cabinet will examine whether, and if so which, additional measures, such as a further reduction of the shipowners' contribution, are needed.
Het kabinet zal bezien of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende maatregelen, zoals een verdere verlaging van de bijdrage van de reders, nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

Mr Van Bommel asks whether the government will prosecute shipowners who illegally deploy armed private guards on Dutch merchant ships, and what measures it has taken. The government answers that such use is a criminal offence the Public Prosecution Service can pursue, that it has lowered the shipowners' contribution and processes all navy protection requests, and that prosecution decisions and sentencing are for the prosecutor and courts.
The Dutch public prosecution service has jurisdiction over this and can therefore institute criminal prosecution.
Het Nederlandse OM heeft hierover de jurisdictie en kan derhalve strafrechtelijke vervolging instellen.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik, die als kind onder verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid in tehuizen of pleeggezinnen zijn geplaatst tussen wal en schip dreigen te

MP Arib asks whether a broad reporting point for victims of sexual abuse in state-responsible youth care will be operational by 8 October 2012, when the Samson commission reports, and how victims who have not yet come forward can still report. The state secretary answers that a national telephone line via Slachtofferhulp Nederland will open on 1 October 2012, linked to existing reporting points, and that she will not anticipate the Samson report's findings.
A reporting point for all victims of sexual abuse will be realised from 1 October 2012 via a national telephone number at Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Een meldpunt voor alle slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik zal vanaf 1 oktober 2012 gerealiseerd zijn via een landelijk telefoonnummer bij Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht “over de campagne tegen huwelijksdwang”

An MP asked ministers whether the state adequately protects women facing forced marriage, marital captivity and abandonment, including criminal law, consular aid, registration, and whether a UK-style Forced Marriage Unit should be set up. The government answered that existing criminal provisions, civil-court routes, Steunpunt Huiselijk Geweld and embassy help suffice for now, that data registration will be assessed in 2013, and that an analysis including a possible unit will be sent to parliament in spring 2013.
To offer more effective help in cases of abandonment and forced marriage, the cabinet is currently making an analysis of the problem and of possible solutions.
Om slagvaardiger hulp te bieden bij gevallen van achterlating en huwelijksdwang maakt het kabinet op dit moment een analyse van de problematiek en welke oplossingen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Marcouch over een verplichte alcohol- of drugstest

MPs Bouwmeester and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the commitment to systematically record alcohol and drug use in violent incidents, made in 2005, and the promised mandatory drug/alcohol test have taken so long to turn into action. The minister answered that pilots and an evaluation were carried out, registration was introduced, and a bill allowing mandatory drug and alcohol tests in violent offences went to consultation in August 2012, with entry into force planned for 2013.
It provides for the possibility of a mandatory drug and alcohol test in cases of violent offences.
Het voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een verplichte drugs- en alcoholtest bij geweldsdelicten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitslag en Çörüz over het bericht ‘In de zorg is fraude oké’

MPs Uitslag and Çörüz asked the government about a report that two care agencies allegedly defrauded 1 million euro, whether the Public Prosecution Service deprioritises care fraud, and how fraud detection and pgb fraud will be strengthened. The minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution of the reported cases, denied that care fraud lacks priority, listed the many detection bodies and the 2011 fraud figures, and promised a proposal on the extra pgb anti-fraud funding this autumn.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether criminal prosecution is indicated in this case.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of in dit geval strafrechtelijk optreden geïndiceerd is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt over het toezicht op vrijgekomen ernstige zware delinquenten

Two MPs asked whether police supervision of released violent and sex offenders is unclear and poorly coordinated with probation, and whether dangerous offenders are reliably checked. The state secretary answered that a 2011 national cooperation agreement and the new conditional sanctions law (in force 1 April 2012) clarify roles, with probation primarily responsible and police providing a signalling function, and that mayors are informed of certain returning offenders.
Probation is primarily responsible for supervision and always contacts the neighbourhood police officer when restrictive conditions have been imposed (and in other cases when necessary).

De reclassering is primair verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht en neemt indien vrijheidsbeperkende voorwaarden zijn opgelegd altijd (en in andere gevallen indien daar noodzaak toe is) contact op met de wijkagent.
Antwoord vragen van het lid  Kooiman over het straffen en behandelen van grafschennisplegers

MP Kooiman asked why desecrating or damaging a grave carries a lower penalty than general property damage, why grave desecration is not listed in the pre-trial detention provision, and how mentally ill offenders could get treatment. Minister Opstelten explained the legal distinction, said detention is usually possible when property damage is also an offence, and pointed to reclassering advice, treatment conditions and compulsory care under existing and proposed law.
Why the legislature did not also add article 149 of the Criminal Code to that list is not known, because it was never considered.
Waarom de wetgever aan bedoelde opsomming van strafbare feiten niet ook artikel 149 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht heeft toegevoegd, is niet bekend omdat dit nooit is overwogen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over de asielverlening van de heer Assange

An MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about Ecuador's asylum grant to Julian Assange, UK threats to enter the embassy, and whether the Netherlands would press the UK to let him leave. The minister confirmed the facts, noted UK extradition obligations to Sweden and that the matter is between the UK and Ecuador, and declined to take further steps.
This concerns a matter between the United Kingdom and Ecuador.
Dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Ecuador.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over de kritiek van de Nationale Ombudsman op de benoemingsprocedure van de vice-president van de Raad van State

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked why the government will not implement a motion giving parliament a role in appointing the Raad van State vice-president, and whether the appointment procedure lacked transparency as the Ombudsman found. The ministers answered that appointments are a government power, that a constitutional change would be needed for a parliamentary role, and that the procedure was transparent, with the speculation not proving coordinated conduct.
Giving the Tweede Kamer a statutory role in the appointment procedure, for example in the form of a nomination right, is therefore only possible if the Constitution is amended in this respect.

Het toekennen van een wettelijke rol aan de Tweede Kamer in de benoemingsprocedure, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van een voordrachtsrecht, is daarom slechts mogelijk als de Grondwet in deze zin wordt gewijzigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over een verbod op het in groepsverband dragen van jasjes (MC leden in colors)

Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) asked whether a ban on groups of outlaw motorcycle club members wearing 'colors' could be introduced in municipal bylaws after intimidating crowds in Enschede, and whether Arnhem-style agreements with bars and a UK ban could be followed. Minister Opstelten answered that wearing colors cannot itself be banned, but that existing tools (assembly ban, public order powers, group bans, bar house rules) can address intimidating conduct, and that he will draw municipalities' attention to these and the UK has no specific ban only a gang injunction.
I will draw extra attention to the possibilities these instruments offer against this form of public order disturbance to the municipalities.
Ik zal de mogelijkheden die genoemde instrumenten bieden tegen deze vorm van ordeverstoringen extra onder de aandacht brengen bij de gemeenten.

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about witness protection, including division of responsibilities, procedural safeguards, the limits of anonymous testimony, protection versus the general protection scheme, financial compensation and identity changes. The minister answered that consultations are ongoing, that the current separation of tracks is justified, and that concrete proposals will be sent to parliament in autumn 2012.
I am consulting with the Public Prosecution Service and the police on witness protection. I will inform your House about this in the course of this autumn.
Ik ben in overleg met het openbaar ministerie en de politie over getuigenbescherming. Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in de loop van dit najaar berichten
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bestoken van ondernemers met spooknota’s

An SP MP asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers why fake invoices (spooknota's) causing an estimated 400 million euro in losses to businesses are not clearly criminalised, and how many fraudsters have been convicted. The minister answered that sending such invoices rarely constitutes a criminal offence because the victim usually consented to the contract, that a Criminal Code change is not the right tool, that prevention is the focus, and that the prosecution service cannot separate these cases from broader data.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over een zwarte lijst van helers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a blacklist of fences (helers) should be created and whether markets such as gold buyers and auction sites should be obliged to supervise themselves, including ID checks. The minister answered that police and prosecutors act on suspicions of handling stolen goods, that existing initiatives such as stopheling.nl and a pilot digital buyers' register continue, and that current rules already require buyers' registers, without committing to new obligations.
Police and justice therefore act when there is a suspicion of handling stolen goods.
Politie en justitie treden daarom op bij een vermoeden van heling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat twee meisjes in Hilversum zwaar zijn mishandeld door Marokkaans tuig

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked minister Opstelten about two severe assaults on girls in Hilversum, the second this year, and about the police response, the ethnic share of youth suspects, and whether dual-national perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that suspects were arrested, extra measures were taken with partners, the wider approach does not single out ethnicity, and denaturalisation for common offences is not possible.
The police and municipality, with the other safety partners, have taken additional measures.
Politie en gemeente hebben met de overige veiligheidspartners extra maatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Aanpak op maat voor zwaarste criminelen”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Rotterdam's person-focused approach to repeat violent and property offenders, why such criminals remain free after repeated convictions, and whether a three-strikes rule should apply. The Minister confirmed the approach aims to prevent offences through personal action plans and strict enforcement of breaches, declined to comment on judicial sentencing, and did not adopt the three-strikes proposal.
I do not intervene in the assessment of the sentences the judge imposes.
Ik treed niet in de beoordeling van de straffen die de rechter oplegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Facebook de activiteiten van zijn gebruikers scant op mogelijke criminele activiteiten

An MP asked the Dutch ministers of Security and Justice whether they knew of reports that Facebook scans user activity for possible criminal activity, how this fits EU and Dutch data protection law, whether detection of criminals should be solely a government task, whether other firms do this, and whether Dutch authorities systematically use such information. The minister answered that he lacks details, that privacy supervisors (Ireland and the Article 29 group) are examining the matter, that Article 22 of the Dutch data protection act allows private parties to process criminal data in their own interest under conditions, that crime detection is a government task, and that Dutch authorities do not systematically use such information.

The Dutch Data Protection Authority informed me that the Irish privacy supervisor, where Facebook's European office is located, is investigating Facebook on behalf of the privacy supervisors of the other 26 EU member states.

Het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft mij in dit verband meegedeeld dat de privacytoezichthouder in Ierland, waar het Europese kantoor van Facebook is gevestigd, mede namens de privacytoezichthouders van de 26 overige EU-lidstaten onderzoek doet naar Facebook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het weigeren van medewerking van Nederland aan de veroordeling van een van pedoseksueel misdrijf verdachte Nederlander in Cambodja

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands had not cooperated with Cambodian proceedings against a Dutch national suspected of child sexual offences, and whether he could be prosecuted in the Netherlands. The minister said contacts with Cambodian authorities had taken place via the Dutch police attaché, that information would not be disclosed, and that a Dutch prosecution was legally possible but its opportunity could not yet be judged.
This concerns a case that is currently before the court in Cambodia.
Het betreft hier een zaak die op het moment in Cambodja onder de rechter is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over straffeloosheid van sleutelfiguren in de Somalische piraterij

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Somali and Puntland authorities shield Somali piracy kingpins, why the UK blocked UN Security Council sanctions on pirate leaders, and the status of a regional anti-piracy prosecution centre. The minister found the reports worrying, said Somali authorities must respond to the UN Monitoring Group findings, noted international debate on whether sanctions would criminalise ransom payments, and reported that the RAPPICC centre is being set up with a Dutch commitment of EUR 300,000 and two experts, expected to be operational in early 2013.
I find these reports worrying. The Somali authorities must provide an account and explanation of the findings of the UN Monitoring Group.
Ik vind deze berichten zorgwekkend. De Somalische autoriteiten moeten tekst en uitleg geven over de bevindingen van de UN Monitoring Group.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders met betrekking tot het advies van de politie om rustig toe te kijken bij een woningoverval

PVV MPs Bontes and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether police advice to watch calmly during a home robbery encourages criminals, and whether burglary victims may defend themselves and police should arrive quickly and robbers should face high minimum sentences. The minister answered that victims must prioritise their own safety and may defend themselves proportionately, that police aim to catch robbers in the act, and that prosecutors seek a three-year starting sentence raised for aggravating circumstances.
Victims of a home robbery or burglary must always put their own safety first.
Slachtoffers van een woningoverval of woninginbraak moeten altijd hun eigen veiligheid vooropstellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het niet reageren op het gillen van een meisje dat werd uitgehuwelijkt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police did not intervene when a girl screaming against a forced marriage was seen, and whether police should be trained on forced marriage. The minister rejected the characterization of inaction, listing search actions, phone contact with the adult woman who declined to file a complaint, and existing expert involvement, and saw no added value in separate training.
Inquiries with the force show that after a report of a possible abduction came in, the police immediately took various actions.
Navraag bij het korps leert dat na binnenkomst van een melding van een mogelijke ontvoering de politie direct diverse acties heeft ondernomen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen met betrekking tot de politietop en de wietpas

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that police leadership must keep quiet about the wietpas (cannabis pass) policy, including whether critical views exist and whether officials were reprimanded or removed. The minister replied that the police committed to enforce what was agreed, that a gag order is not at issue, and that no officials were reprimanded or removed.
A gag order is not an issue.
Een spreekverbod is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Timmermans over Rechtshulpverzoeken door Spanje inzake de Gürtel-corruptiezaak

Parliamentarian Timmermans asked whether the Netherlands has for three years refused to provide Antillean bank account information to Spanish prosecutors in the Gürtel corruption case, and why, given Spanish requests. The minister answered that the Netherlands has assisted the 2008 Spanish request, that additional information was needed and received in 2010, that a FIOD investigation ran until late 2011 and a court permission procedure is pending, and that any remaining evidence in Curaçao is for Curaçao's own authorities to handle.
That investigation lasted until the end of 2011, after which the permission procedure was started at the court, which has not yet reached a final decision.
Dit onderzoek heeft tot eind 2011 geduurd waarna de verlofprocedure bij de rechtbank is gestart welke nog niet tot een eindbeschikking is gekomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Schouw over het bericht dat Nederland moet terughacken

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked the Justice minister about reports that the Netherlands should 'hack back' against foreign servers spreading viruses, including what actions the government takes and the risks and legal safeguards of such measures. The minister replied that cyber security is primarily the responsibility of individuals and providers, the government protects its own infrastructure and informs the public via NCSC, that hack-back is not an official government term and would be addressed in a forthcoming legislative proposal on cybercrime, and that an international treaty comparable to the law of the sea is interesting but premature.
However, I note that in the rapidly changing digital world, legislation and international agreements have fallen behind.
Wel constateer ik dat in de snel veranderende digitale wereld de wetgeving en internationale afspraken zijn achter gebleven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over identiteitsfraude

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked about identity fraud in which a criminal opened a PostNL business mail-forwarding account in a victim's name and redirected post, including private mail. The state secretary said attempts are rare (under 0.03%), PostNL has taken measures, the police investigation found no suspect, and the matter is being looked into, but declined to give details on the specific case.
In the interest of the investigation and with a view to possible future fraud attempts, no further information can be given about specific cases.
In het belang van het onderzoek en met het oog op eventuele toekomstige fraudepogingen kan over specifieke zaken geen verdere mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over trage teruggave van gestolen goederen

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister why stolen goods recovered by police were returned to the victim only after more than half a year, and what will be done to speed up such returns. The minister agreed goods should be returned once no prosecutorial interest remains, regretted the one-month delay after the investigation ended, denied the return was forced by publicity, and pointed to victim-care policy and pending legislation without giving a fixed timeframe.
The importance of prompt handling of seizures, including the options of article 116 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, will be emphasised within the Public Prosecution Service.
Het belang van een snelle afhandeling van beslag, waaronder de mogelijkheden van artikel 116 Sv., zal binnen het OM worden benadrukt.
Vragen van het lid Bashir (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de RET die gesprekken zou opnemen of afluisteren (ingezonden 11 mei 2012).

MP Bashir asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether RET tram and bus operators record or listen in on passengers' conversations, when recording began, how long recordings are kept, whether the privacy regulator knows, and whether there is a legal basis. The state secretary answered that there is no link between radios and recording equipment, that cameras with audio have been in use since 2008 and in new trams since mid-2011, that the recordings were recently reported to the privacy regulator, and referred to earlier answers for retention and legal basis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Burg over het bericht dat Bureaus Jeugdzorg en rechtbanken afspraken hebben gemaakt over automatisch verlengen van indicatiebesluiten

MP Van der Burg asked whether courts in the Arnhem district and provinces agreed to automatically extend youth care indication decisions without new decisions, and about the implications under Article 8 ECHR. The state secretary said courts accepted indications without valid duration pending a bill removing the duration requirement, that no national agreements exist, that the Arnhem appeal court rulings are for courts to judge, and that talks with the IPO on a pragmatic solution will be held.
It is not for me to intervene in a judgment of the court.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in een uitspraak van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over grootschalige schending van de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police forces widely violate privacy rules and what emergency measures and safeguards will be taken. The minister confirmed awareness, clarified the law at issue is the Police Data Act, described an action plan on authorisation, logging and privacy officers, and pointed to audit cycles and the data protection supervisor as safeguards.
The regional police chiefs drew up an action plan in early 2012 following the external privacy audit report.
De verantwoordelijke korpsbeheerders hebben naar aanleiding van de rapportage van de externe privacy audit bij de korpsen aan het begin van 2012 een actieplan opgesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Steur over het verlenen van gratie

An MP asked the minister about pardon (gratie) statistics, the gap between pardon requests received and decisions taken, the criteria and conditional pardons, and whether life sentences without realistic release prospects conflict with the ECHR. The minister answered that pardon decisions are made case by case under the Gratiewet, that 2010 saw 340 unconditional and 192 conditional pardons, and that the life-sentence procedure does not render pardon illusory.
There is no registration of the type of sentences for which pardon is granted and the form in which this occurs.
Er vindt geen registratie plaats van de aard van de straffen waarvan gratie wordt verleend en de vorm waarin dit gebeurt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes, Van Klaveren en Wilders met betrekking tot de inzet van politie tijdens de Ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked whether extra police deployment against Ramadan-related crime existed, its cost, whether police see a link between Ramadan and crime, and whether the costs could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary answered that no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan, only capacity management of existing rosters, that no data exist on the suggested link, and that cost recovery is not warranted.
In both The Hague and Utrecht no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan.
In zowel Den Haag als Utrecht wordt geen extra politiecapaciteit ingezet gedurende de Ramadan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de aanpak van kindersekstoerisme

MP Dibi asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about child sex tourism, including a Limburg suspect in Ghana who was released on bail and can travel freely, and whether Dutch enforcement lacks effectiveness. State Secretary Teeven answered that no separate offence exists, that cases are not registered separately, that the suspect was not pursued for lack of hard evidence, and that a follow-up campaign and a crime analysis are planned.
Child sex tourism is therefore not registered separately in the Public Prosecution Service systems, so it cannot be stated how many cases ended in a conviction.
Kindersekstoerisme wordt derhalve niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd in de systemen van het Openbaar Ministerie, zodat niet aan te geven is hoeveel zaken in een veroordeling zijn geëindigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een zeer lage straf voor ernstige dierenmishandeling

An MP asked why a very light sentence was imposed for serious animal cruelty to 115 birds of prey, whether supervisors failed, and whether bans on keeping animals or hunting licences should follow. The state secretary answered that individual criminal cases are not communicated, that inspections found no welfare problems, that the company went bankrupt, and that existing law already allows refusing hunting licences, while withholding details on privacy grounds.
It is not for me to communicate about individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te communiceren over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over het wetsvoorstel transseksualiteit

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Justice Minister why the sterilisation requirement for transgender people in the pending gender-recognition bill has been announced since 2009 but not yet tabled, and whether it will be sent to Parliament quickly. The state secretary confirmed the Council of State advised in May 2012, that the bill removes the infertility condition, and that it will be sent to Parliament after the cabinet discusses the reply to the advice on 17 August 2012.
Naturally, once the Council of Ministers agrees, the bill can find its way to the House without delay.
Vanzelfsprekend zal na het akkoord van de ministerraad het wetsvoorstel zonder vertraging zijn weg naar de Kamer kunnen vinden.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over sancties voor een jager in overtreding

An MP asked about the delayed prosecution of hunters for Flora and Fauna Act violations, sanctions, membership of the hunting association, and withdrawal of hunting licences. The government answered that the case is before the economic police court, that hunting licences were revoked by the police chief and upheld by the Council of State, and that some statistics are not centrally recorded.
The requested data are not kept by the Public Prosecution Service in a centralised system.
De gevraagde gegevens worden door het Openbaar Ministerie niet in een gecentraliseerd systeem bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de waarschuwing van het Industrial Control System Cyber Emergency Response Team

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the government responded to a US ICS-CERT warning about vulnerabilities in Siemens SCADA/ICS software, and whether Dutch operators had applied the recommended protections. The state secretary called the warning valuable, said it is unknown whether and how widely these Siemens products are used in the Netherlands, pointed to NCSC factsheets and checklists, and noted that organisations are primarily responsible while sectoral regulators supervise vital sectors.
It is not known whether, or to what extent, the SCADA and ICS-related Siemens web and software applications mentioned are used in the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend of en in welke mate er in Nederland gebruik wordt gemaakt van de genoemde SCADA en ICS gerelateerde web- en software applicaties van Siemens.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitlevering van een Nederlandse hacker David S. aan de Verenigde Staten door Roemenië

MP Van Bommel asked ministers how Dutch authorities were involved in the US investigation of Dutch hacker David S., who was arrested in Romania and extradition-bound to the US, and why he was not arrested in the Netherlands. Teeven answered that Dutch authorities received US information but took no investigative action, were not informed of the arrest in advance, received only a pending US mutual legal assistance request, and cannot discuss details of the Romanian extradition proceedings.
I cannot go into the further content of that request, because doing so could harm an ongoing foreign criminal investigation.
Op de verdere inhoud van dat verzoek kan ik niet ingaan, omdat daardoor een lopend buitenlands opsporingsonderzoek zou kunnen worden geschaad.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over het nut en de noodzaak van een Nationaal Fraude Autoriteit

Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) asked whether the roughly 23 fraud reporting points hinder a coherent information position and systematic financial enforcement, and whether a National Fraud Authority should be set up under the minister. Teeven answered that multiple reporting points are acceptable if citizens know where to go and the bodies cooperate, that the Fraudehelpdesk is becoming a central point, and that he is studying the UK model without yet deciding on responsibility.
Are you willing to have yourself informed in the short term about the possibilities of establishing a National Fraud Authority and to inform the House of Representatives about it?
Bent u bereid om u op korte termijn nader te laten informeren over de mogelijkheden om tot een Nationale Fraude Autoriteit te komen en de Tweede Kamer hierover in te lichten?
Antwoord vragen Dibi over het bericht 'Honderden ontslagen door de wietpas'

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that hundreds were dismissed due to the 'wietpas' (cannabis pass) and whether the policy should be ended immediately. Staatssecretaris Teeven acknowledged the report and refused to end the stricter coffeeshop policy, stating implementation is proceeding as expected.
I therefore see no reason to stop the policy.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om het beleid stop te zetten.
Antwoord vragen Sterk en Hachchi over Nederlands-Pakistaanse vrouw die in huwelijkse gevangenschap in Pakistan verkeert

MPs Sterk and Hachchi asked about a Dutch-Pakistani woman held in a forced marriage in Pakistan, what the embassy had done, and whether the government would act on religious divorce and women's rights. The minister said he could not comment on the individual case for privacy reasons, that the embassy assists consular cases on request, and that he would raise the issue in EU settings.
To protect the identity of the person concerned, I cannot make a substantive statement about the case.
Ter bescherming van de identiteit van betrokkene, kan ik over de zaak geen inhoudelijke uitspraak doen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het deskundigenregister

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the forensic expert register (NRGD) lacks independence, including its admission criteria, links of registered experts to NFI and NIFP, and an alleged letter to a judge. The State Secretary replied that the NRGD is independent, criteria are objective and unchanged since 2010, no misconduct is found, and an evaluation is planned for 2011-2015.
As may be apparent from the answers to the previous questions, in my view there is no question of misconduct.
Zoals mag blijken uit de antwoorden op de voorgaande vragen is er naar mijn mening geen sprake van misstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verknipte en gevaarlijke advies extremistische islamitische organisaties invloed te geven op beleid

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they agree that an advisory report by Forum recommending engagement with extremist Islamic organisations is dangerous, whether the Forum subsidy will be stopped, and whether all Islamic organisations will be monitored and sanctioned. The government disagrees with the advice's clarity but will not adopt it, keeps the Forum subsidy, and rejects blanket monitoring of all Islamic organisations, while pointing to targeted AIVD investigation and existing legal tools.
Should the researchers' advice be to let extremist organisations exert influence on policy, I assure you I will not adopt that advice.
Mocht het advies van de onderzoekers zijn om extremistische organisaties invloed te laten uitoefenen op beleid, verzeker ik u dat ik dat advies niet overneem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over gegevensbeheer binnen het KLPD

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether data management on the BVH case system at the KLPD was not properly set up, whether people may wrongly be listed as suspects, and whether the KLPD complies with the Wet politiegegevens. The minister admitted the system was temporarily not up to standard, that a small number of people may wrongly be recorded as suspects, and that improvement measures will be completed by October 2012 with an external audit by the end of 2012.
It cannot be entirely ruled out that in a very limited number of cases, persons are wrongly recorded as suspects in the system.
Het is niet geheel uit te sluiten dat in een zeer beperkt aantal gevallen, personen onterecht als verdachte in het systeem staan vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht Rechter laat notoire geweldpleger snel vrij: slachtoffer verbijsterd

An MP asked the Justice Minister why a judge-commissioner suspended pre-trial detention of a repeat violent offender, questioning past sentences and the impact on public trust. The minister answered that the commissioner weighed the age of prior offences, the suspect's self-referral and treatment, and set conditions, declined to judge the commissioner's reasoning, and defended judicial lifetime appointments.
It is not for me to give a judgment on the judgment of the judge-commissioner.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over het oordeel van de rechter-commissaris.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het niet naleven van het SWIFT-akkoord over de doorgifte van bankgegevens

An MP (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the EU-US SWIFT agreement on bank data transfers is being implemented, including Europol's secret report, public access rights, and the Commission's delayed filtering system. The minister answered that the implementation is in line with the TFTP agreement, that the report is classified and access is governed by EU rules, and that the Commission has not failed its obligations.
The report is classified as 'Secret' and is therefore a sensitive document within the meaning of Article 9 of this regulation.
Het rapport is geclassificeerd als «Secret», en is daarmee een gevoelig document in de zin van artikel 9 van deze verordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Drugsinfiltrant VS actief in Nederland’

MPs Çörüz and Gesthuizen asked whether a newspaper report about a US drug informant operating in the Netherlands was accurate and what rules apply to foreign and criminal civilian informants. The minister said the US denied any DEA undercover operation in the Netherlands, that foreign police may not act independently on Dutch soil, and that criminal civilian informants are in principle not permitted except in exceptional terrorism cases with safeguards.
Investigation in the Netherlands on behalf of another state always takes place under the supervision and direction of the Dutch public prosecution service and the police.
Onderzoek in Nederland ten behoeve van een andere staat vindt altijd plaats onder toezicht en leiding van het Nederlandse openbaar ministerie en de politie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over invallen bij Duitse salafisten

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether Dutch police should raid mosques and homes of salafist groups as Germany did, whether such groups should be banned, and what measures the government will take. Minister Opstelten answered that the German group term covers a narrower spectrum than the Dutch use of salafism, that AIVD has observed no threatening activities by Dutch salafists so far, and that measures will be taken if the security services find cause.
The AIVD has so far not observed any activities by Dutch salafists that pose a threat to national security or that justify the measures you propose.
De AIVD heeft bij Nederlandse salafisten vooralsnog geen activiteiten waargenomen die een bedreiging vormen voor de nationale veiligheid of die de door u voorgestelde maatregelen rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over het bericht “Dode apen op Schiphol”

An MP asked the State Secretary about 13 monkeys found dead at Schiphol, their cause of death, whether the transport was checked for animal welfare, and how many monkeys transit Schiphol yearly. The government said an NVWA investigation is ongoing, the surviving monkeys met health and CITES requirements for onward transport, and it will not speculate on further measures until the investigation concludes.
Once the investigation is concluded I will inform the House of the results.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond zal ik de kamer informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de dood van een Turkse arrestant in een politiecel

MP Dibi asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether the relatives of a Turkish man who died in a police cell have been given full access to the investigation files, and if not, why not and whether all information will be shared. The minister replies that the public prosecutor keeps the relatives informed and has shared all information currently available, but that full sharing is not possible while the investigation is ongoing.
Because the investigation is still ongoing, it is however not possible to share all available information with them.
Omdat het onderzoek nog loopt is het echter niet mogelijk om alle beschikbare informatie met hen te delen.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het afnemen van crimineel vermogen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the FIOD interview on fragmented expertise and cooperation in confiscating criminal assets, and whether a single national confiscation agency would help. The minister answered that expertise overlap is efficient, that cooperation problems are being addressed through an integrated approach and a letter to parliament, and that a single agency is not decisive for success.
I sent your House a letter this week describing all the efforts and the related results.
Ik heb uw Kamer deze week een brief gestuurd waarin alle inspanningen en de bijbehorende resultaten worden beschreven
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de aanpak van faillissementsfraude en het strafbaar stellen van het ontbreken van een juiste en volledige administratie in een faillissement

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a bankruptcy fraud case reported by the curator in 2011 was not pursued, why earlier answers said no complaint had been filed, and whether the proposal to criminalise incomplete bankruptcy administration would be considered. The minister admitted the complaint had reached the FIOD in September 2011 but was not investigated because a related case was already advanced, apologised for the earlier omission, pointed to an existing integrated fraud approach, and argued existing civil liability already sanctions incomplete administration.
Further investigation revealed that the relevant complaint was received by the FIOD in September 2011.
Uit nader onderzoek is gebleken dat de betreffende aangifte in september 2011 bij de FIOD is binnengekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hennis-Plasschaert over C2000 en P2000

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the aging P2000 paging network, the C2000 maintenance contract timeline, outsourcing options and governance of C2000. The minister answered that a preference for upgrading P2000 is being elaborated, the C2000 maintenance tender will be completed before the deadline, outsourcing options will be examined, and a final choice on tactical management will be made in the tender.
The tender for the maintenance of C2000 will be completed before the stated date.
De aanbesteding van het onderhoud van C2000 zal voor de genoemde datum zijn afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Klaver over werkgevers die particuliere recherchebureaus inschakelen

MPs Dibi and Klaver asked ministers whether private detective agencies hired by employers are inadequately supervised after licensing, whether this violates employees' privacy, and whether such agencies should access government databases. Minister Opstelten replied that a risk-based police inspection and a privacy-focused CBP supervision effort are being strengthened, that privacy violations are for courts to judge, and that private detectives get no access to the municipal population register or sensitive vehicle registry data.
In consultation with the police and the CBP, I am examining how supervision of compliance with privacy rules by private detective agencies can be strengthened.
In samenspraak met politie en CBP onderzoek ik op welke wijze het toezicht op de naleving van de privacyregels door particuliere recherchebureaus kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over de inzet van studenten bij internet patrouilles

Berndsen (D66) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a police pilot using students to patrol the internet for cybercrime, asking about the legal basis, privacy safeguards, entrapment risks, scope, duration and whether parliament will be informed. The minister answered that the students only screen open internet sources without investigative powers, work anonymously on police computers, the pilot ran until 30 June 2012 targeting illegal drugs, fake medicines and online loverboys, results go to the Raad van Korpschefs, and that there is no entrapment.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over de verhouding tussen handhaving door stadswachten en de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Amsterdam stadswachten (municipal enforcement officers) incident and how expanding boa powers relates to the police monopoly on force and the risk of municipal policing replacing neighbourhood police officers. The minister replied that boa's work alongside the police, that municipalities have their own enforcement role, and that uniform standardisation and public information are being explored with stakeholders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over "de gemeente Nijmegen die camera’s inzet tegen bijstandsfraude"

MP Karabulut (SP) asked whether it is acceptable for Nijmegen to aim observation cameras at welfare recipients' front doors without an objective suspicion of fraud, and how this relates to Dutch criminal procedure, proportionality, privacy (ECHR art. 8), and costs. The state secretary answered that municipalities decide their own methods, that camera observation requires a reasonable suspicion and subsidiarity, cited a 2005 Central Raad van Beroep ruling, and said no cost-benefit data is held and no study is planned.
It is therefore primarily up to the Nijmegen mayor and aldermen and the municipal council to determine which investigative methods they consider desirable for proper implementation.

Het is dan ook in de eerste plaats aan het College van Burgemeester en Wethouders en aan de gemeenteraad van Nijmegen om te bepalen welke onderzoeksmethoden zij voor een juiste uitvoering wenselijk achten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de afhandeling van aangiften in Amsterdam

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the high share (68%) of Amsterdam reports to police that lead to no investigation, its causes, police staffing, and the effect on reporting willingness and crime statistics. The Minister explains that investigation depends on seriousness and available leads, denies a staffing shortage, notes reporting rates have not significantly fallen, and describes ongoing measures to improve the reporting process.

I am of the view that it is necessary to make a selection from all reports and complaints that come in, and I trust that where it is established that further investigation is not called for, this decision is well founded.

Ik ben van mening dat het noodzakelijk is om een selectie te maken uit alle meldingen en aangiften die binnen komen, en vertrouw erop dat indien wordt vastgesteld dat verder onderzoek niet aan de orde is, dit besluit gegrond is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving eind mei jongstleden over de vermeende terreurcel van Al Shabaab in Nederland

The PVV MP Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a sleeper terror cell of Al-Shabaab in the Netherlands, whether this warranted investigation, whether residence permits or nationality had been revoked for Somalis linked to Al-Shabaab, and how journalists could interview a former Al-Shabaab commander. The minister replied that the intelligence services have no indications of sleeper cells, cannot comment publicly on specific measures, that no revocations linked to Al-Shabaab have occurred, and that he cannot discuss how the services operate.
However, I cannot make concrete public statements about how the services conduct these investigations and with whom they speak.
Ik kan in het openbaar echter geen concrete uitspraken doen over de wijze waarop de diensten deze onderzoeken uitvoeren en met wie zij spreken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch met betrekking tot het toenemend aantal woninginbraken

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the rising number of home burglaries, the police priority and new approach, forensic investigation, the Politiekeurmerk Veilig Wonen certification and financial incentives for burglary prevention. The minister answers that burglaries rose about 7% but the detection chance also increased, that a forensic pilot is still running, that municipalities decide on certification and subsidies, and that a website already exists.
This pilot is still running. Once the pilot is completed, insight can be provided into the results and the possible nationwide rollout.
Zodra de pilot is afgerond kan er inzicht worden verschaft in de resultaten en het mogelijk uitrollen op landelijke niveau.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman inzake de geplande reorganisatie in verband met de invoering van de nationale politie

Brinkman asks whether forensic assistants in Limburg will be cut in the reorganisation for the national police, whether this affects home burglary investigation, and how staffing changes nationally. Minister Opstelten answers that the inrichtingsplan is still being prepared with the kwartiermaker and consulted with authorities, so no figures can yet be given.
Statements on the size of the various parts of the organisation, per regional unit or nationally, are therefore premature.
Uitspraken over de omvang van de diverse onderdelen van de organisatie, per regionale eenheid danwel landelijk, zijn dan ook prematuur.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Çörüz over het bericht `Politie `laks' bij grote wietzaak Nederhorst'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Gooi en Vechtstreek give too little priority to cannabis grow operations, given the national drugs policy, and about one reported case in Nederhorst. The minister denied neglect, describing a regional cannabis covenant, specialised investigators, cooperation with neighbouring regions, and 63 raids in 2011 and 26 in 2012 so far, and said the main suspect has been arrested in another case.

No. The Gooi en Vechtstreek police force concluded a cannabis covenant in December 2011 with municipalities, the Public Prosecution Service, housing corporations, the Tax Authority, UWV, SVB and grid operators.
Nee. Het korps Gooi en Vechtstreek heeft in december 2011 een hennepconvenant afgesloten met gemeenten, Openbaar Ministerie, woningcorporaties, Belastingdienst, UWV, SVB en netbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de onrechtmatige huiszoeken tegen Megaupload

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked whether Dutch police and justice cooperated with a US request in the Megaupload case after a New Zealand court ruled the search warrants unlawful for lack of specificity, and whether an independent judicial review will be arranged. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no role in US-to-New Zealand requests, that the incoming request was tested against treaty and Dutch law and carried out under an investigating judge, and that all incoming requests are checked before execution with the same safeguards as domestic investigations.
The Netherlands has no role in legal assistance requests that the American authorities address to the New Zealand authorities.
Nederland heeft geen tussenkomst bij rechtshulpverzoeken die de Amerikaanse autoriteiten richten tot de Nieuw-Zeelandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het onderzoek naar de moord op Marianne Vaatstra

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about the investigation into the 1999 murder of Marianne Vaatstra, including why reported threats and suspect-related leads (F.M., A.H., a Turkish arrest, a transfer of F.M. from an asylum centre) were not pursued and why DNA comparisons were not made. The minister answered that the information was assessed, referred to a public prosecutor's summary report, and that DNA evidence excluded F.M. and the cellmate identified by G.V., without committing to new investigative steps.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht  ‘Afluisterproject splijt AIVD en MIVD’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether the intelligence services AIVD and MIVD obstruct each other in intercepting foreign satellite and radio communications and how cooperation within the National Sigint Organisation would be improved. The minister replied that cooperation has been intensified since 2007, that the services are forming a joint Sigint-Cyber unit to optimise support and use of technical expertise, and that the processing of intercepted communications is under review.
The joint MIVD-AIVD research teams are examples of this.
De gezamenlijke MIVD-AIVD onderzoeksteams zijn hier voorbeelden van.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over een nieuwe, levensgevaarlijke drug

An MP asked the health and justice ministers whether a new dangerous drug ('badzout') linked to a fatal-looking incident in Miami should be scheduled, and why generic criminalisation of such drugs was not adopted, and how the motion on this is being implemented. The minister answered that the incident was abroad and only toxicology can confirm the substances, that scheduling requires the statutory criteria of Article 3a of the Opium Act, and that RIVM has been asked to study generic criminalisation with results to follow.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over het weigeren van hulp aan gewonde dieren waarvan de eigenaar onvindbaar is

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police and emergency services left an injured sheep unaided for days because its owner could not be found, and why the 144 animal-emergency line passed a caller around. The minister answered that the 144 line only routes reports, that police and other services may help animals without a known owner, and that the handling problem is being addressed by an improved animal-aid convenant.
It is not correct that the animal police and emergency services may only help animals when the owner is known and can be found.
Het is niet correct dat de dierenpolitie en hulpdiensten alleen dieren hulp mogen bieden wanneer de eigenaar bekend en vindbaar is.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht “Levensgevaarlijke messentrekker vrij na blunder”

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a violent offender was released because the Public Prosecution Service filed a conditional-release request five days late, and how such errors will be prevented. The minister confirmed the late filing, explained the offender was released with special conditions, and described measures taken at the Utrecht parket and by the central conditional-release body.
This request was mistakenly filed five days late.
Deze vordering is abusievelijk vijf dagen te laat gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het plukken van criminele winsten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the FinEC anti-financial-crime programme was replaced by the Afpakken (asset recovery) programme, about asset-recovery teams and their results, the 3-4x return assumption, information-sharing with the Tax Service, FIU access for financial investigators, OM and judicial financial expertise, and extra financial investigators. The minister answered that asset-recovery programmes build on FinEC, reported 44.6 million euro recovered in 2011, cited the 3x return from FinEC results, said data access rules allow inquiry on serious suspicion, described the FIU system change and expertise training, and said financial investigation will be secured in the national police plans.
As promised during the 14 June committee debate on organised crime, I will send your House a letter on government-wide asset recovery before the summer recess.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het algemeen overleg van 14 juni jongstleden over georganiseerde criminaliteit stuur ik uw Kamer nog voor het zomerreces een brief over het overheidsbreed afpakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht dat kinderen elkaar misbruiken in Almelose jeugdinstelling

MP Arib asked the ministers whether sexual abuse between minors persists at the Almelo youth institution Commujon, whether sanctions for not reporting abuse are adequate, whether a reporting duty should cover adult and peer abuse, and how many criminal complaints youth institutions have filed. Minister Schippers answered that no recent signals exist, that the institution was placed under intensified supervision in 2010 and lifted in 2011, that she opposes a broader reporting duty in favour of a reporting code, and that complaints are not centrally registered.
I do not have the figures on the number of criminal complaints filed by youth care institutions.
Ik beschik niet over de cijfers van het aantal aangiftes gedaan door jeugdzorginstellingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de angst bij zorgmedewerkers om aangifte te doen

An MP asks the ministers of Justice and of Health whether healthcare workers fear reporting violence because their names are disclosed, and about the handling of reports filed under personnel numbers and why this is absent from the action plan. The Minister replies that anonymous or personnel-number reporting is possible, that a scheme for reporting on personnel numbers across the public sector is being developed, and that a letter with details will follow in September.

During the general consultations on safe working in healthcare of 23 May 2012 and on the safe public task of 5 June 2012 I promised that a scheme will be introduced enabling reporting under a personnel number.

Tijdens de algemeen overleggen veilig werken in de zorg van 23 mei 2012 en veilige publieke taak van 5 juni 2012 heb ik toegezegd dat er een regeling komt die het mogelijk maakt aangifte op nummer te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch met betrekking tot de verhouding tussen de politie en buitengewone opsporingsambtenaren (boa’s)

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the relationship between police and municipal enforcement officers (boa's), including the risk of a fragmented, overlapping framework and calls for a single municipal enforcement service. The minister replies that existing rules are adequate, that municipalities set their own arrangements, and that exam standards for boa's will be tightened from 1 October.
I do not intend to make further changes to this.
Ik ben niet voornemens hier verder wijzigingen in aan te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het tekort aan rechters

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that courts are hesitant to hire judges and that case quality and backlogs are under strain. The State Secretary answered that judicial staffing fell 1% in 2011, that backlogs are generally decreasing although some sectors still miss targets, and that he meets periodically with the judiciary and will inform parliament via the Council's reports.
I am periodically in discussion with the judiciary about the state of affairs regarding the administration of justice and any bottlenecks experienced.
Ik ben periodiek in gesprek met de Rechtspraak over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de rechtspleging en de eventuele knelpunten die worden ervaren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over de onbegrijpelijke uitspraak van Marokkaans scootertuig

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the acquittal of suspects in a fatal scooter chase, which they found incomprehensible, and whether the suspects were effectively rewarded for silence. The State Secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service disagrees with the acquittal and has referred the case to the Supreme Court, and that the appellate ruling must now be tested by the cassation judge, so no further substantive comment is given.
Since no final judicial ruling has yet been handed down in this case, I cannot go into this further.
Nu in deze zaak nog geen finaal rechterlijk oordeel is geveld kan ik hierop verder ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het opsporen van de daders van een misdrijf op het platteland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Justice minister about the investigation into the shooting of a cow on a farm and whether a reward would be offered for tips. The state secretary answered that the public prosecutor has launched an investigation with witness appeals, cannot disclose more while it is ongoing, and that a reward has been offered by an animal-welfare foundation but the prosecution sees no reason yet to offer one.
Since the investigation is still ongoing, I cannot provide further information on it.
Aangezien het onderzoek nog gaande is, kan ik daarover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het negeren van adviezen van artsen bij de dreigende overlevering van een suïcidale Palestijn aan Zweden

An SP MP asked why the extradition court allowed transfer of a traumatised Palestinian man to Sweden despite psychiatric and psychological advice that extradition was medically unacceptable and posed a suicide risk, and asked whether prosecution in the Netherlands and talks with Sweden were possible. The state secretary replied that the court did not examine health issues under the Extradition Act framework, that the public prosecutor may postpone surrender on humanitarian grounds, that a further health investigation was ordered, and that the actual surrender is not imminent due to a summary proceeding.
Moreover, that also does not form part of the assessment framework prescribed for the judge by the Extradition Act.
Overigens vormt dat ook geen onderdeel van het in de Overleveringswet voorgeschreven beoordelingskader van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brinkman over het artikel “Grote schoonmaak binnen GVB-top”

MP Brinkman asked whether GVB Amsterdam mismanaged public funds, whether prosecution and the national police detective unit should be involved, whether pay supervision in public administration should be tightened, and what measures will prevent such practices. The state secretary answered that an independent audit commissioned by GVB's supervisory board found governance failures but not fraud, that the municipality and supervisory board are responsible for further steps, that no criminal report has been filed, and that the Wopt and forthcoming Wnt do not cover this public limited company.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to take further steps if desired and to account for them to the Amsterdam municipal council.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om desgewenst verdere stappen te zetten en daarover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad van Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brinkman over het artikel “Grote schoonmaak binnen GVB-top”

An MP asked whether the GVB report on the company's top management could be kept confidential and whether it should be made public. The state secretary answered that the Amsterdam city council imposed confidentiality under the Municipal Act and that the decision on the report's status rests with the GVB supervisory board and the city of Amsterdam, not with him.
Since the GVB is an independent public limited company, it is not for me but for the supervisory board and the city of Amsterdam to determine the status of this report.
Aangezien het GVB een zelfstandige NV is, is het niet aan mij maar aan de RvC en de gemeente Amsterdam om de status van dit rapport te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Van Gent over het bericht dat de RET gesprekken in trams afluistert

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister whether the Rotterdam transport company RET secretly eavesdrops on passengers via cameras with audio in trams and buses, and whether this is lawful and proportionate. The state secretary confirmed some cameras record sound, retrievable only afterwards and not zoomed in on individual conversations, said the data protection authority sees no reason for further investigation, and declined to investigate other transport companies, leaving that to the regulator.
The assessment of the legitimacy and proportionality of recordings such as these is not for me to make but for the CBP.
Het oordeel over de legitimiteit en proportionaliteit van registraties zoals de onderhavige komt niet aan mij toe maar aan het CBP.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elissen en De Jong over de RET die passagiers afluistert

PVV MPs Elissen and De Jong asked whether Rotterdam's RET tram operator secretly records passenger conversations, on what legal basis, how recordings are used and stored, and whether the minister will investigate. The state secretary answered that the audio question is for the privacy regulator CBP to judge, described RET's access protocol limited to police and justice, and referred back to earlier answers for retention periods and any investigation.
The final judgment on this, however, does not rest with me but with the CBP.
Het uiteindelijke oordeel hierover komt echter niet aan mij toe, maar aan het CBP.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Arib en Timmermans over een 14-jarig Marokkaans meisje dat gedwongen werd haar verkrachter te trouwen

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the Dutch government whether it would press Morocco, bilaterally and within the EU, to reform article 475 of its penal code after a 14-year-old girl was forced to marry her rapist, and what concrete steps it would take. The minister answered that the issue is raised through the UN Universal Periodic Review and the EU-Morocco neighbourhood dialogue, that a bilateral working group is not the right forum, and that Morocco's national debate on the article has not yet started.
That is why I have had this case raised in Morocco's review under the UN Human Rights Council's Universal Periodic Review.
Daarom heb ik deze zaak aan de orde laten stellen in het landen-examen van Marokko in het kader van de Universal Periodic Review van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en De Boer over drugsdealers in kraakpanden in Rotterdam

MPs Van der Steur and De Boer asked about drug dealers occupying squats in Rotterdam, the number involved, the municipal and police response, and whether other cities see similar activity. The state secretary answered that police raided nine properties on 22 May 2012, arrested six suspects, that the investigation is ongoing, and that the action focused on drug trade rather than evicting squatters, while structural squat-drug activity elsewhere is not established.
The investigation is still ongoing, so I cannot make any further statements about this at this time.
Het opsporingsonderzoek is nog gaande waardoor ik hierover thans geen verdere mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Opvang Roma-familie kostte Utrecht nog meer dan 29.000”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the reported costs of housing a Roma family in Utrecht, reportedly over 29,000 euros and possibly higher, are correct, why the municipality withholds details of cash allowances on privacy grounds, and whether the total costs should be reclaimed. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports and referred back to earlier answers, stating that accountability for the choices made lies with the Utrecht municipal government and its council.
In it I indicated, among other things, that it is a matter for the Utrecht municipal executive to account to the municipal council for the choices made in this case.
Daarin heb ik onder andere aangegeven dat het een zaak is van het gemeentebestuur van Utrecht om verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad over de in dit geval gemaakte keuzes.
