Antwoord vragen van de leden Joldersma en Çörüz over minderjarigen die zich na alcoholgebruik schuldig maken aan misdrijven en (uitgaans)geweld

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about under-16s committing offences and violence after drinking, including how incidents are recorded, whether police should register alcohol use, whether public drunkenness by minors should be punished more harshly, and how higher sentence demands for alcohol-related offences are implemented. Minister Opstelten answered that police registration of alcohol use is being prepared with a bill on testing powers, that public drunkenness by youths is mostly fined already and an objective promille norm is undesirable, and that prosecutors will seek higher sentences once the testing powers take effect.
Before this registration process can be implemented, the police must be given the power to use substance tests.
Alvorens dit registratietraject te implementeren dient de politie de bevoegdheid te krijgen om middelentesten in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Ten Broeke inzake Antwoorden het bericht 'Politieweb aan grens in gevaar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether the national police merger would end the mobile cross-border police teams at the German border, and about results, funding and possible use of Koninklijke Marechaussee teams. The minister answered that cross-border cooperation under the Treaty of Enschede continues, that the Twente joint team's funding runs to July 2013 with a continuity commitment, and that the team's form may change after evaluation.
The ministry is periodically informed about project progress and the (interim) results and deployment of the GPT.
Het ministerie wordt periodiek geïnformeerd over de projectvoortgang en de (tussentijdse) resultaten en de inzet van het GPT.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over illegale besnijdenissen in Engeland

An MP asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports of illegal female genital cutting in England, whether Dutch at-risk families send girls abroad, and whether a Europe-wide study and joint approach are planned. The state secretary answered that the reports could not be confirmed, cited ongoing European and Dutch prevalence studies, reported that no one has yet been convicted in the Netherlands, and committed to a European strategy on violence against women that will address this practice.
Yes. The European Commission intends to develop a European strategy on violence against women.
Ja. De Europese commissie is voornemens te komen tot een Europese strategie over geweld tegen vrouwen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Çörüz over het arrest van de Hoge Raad met betrekking tot het uitmaken van een agent voor “mierenneuker”

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the Supreme Court ruling on calling a police officer a "mierenneuker" and its impact on zero-tolerance policy toward insults against police. The minister answered that the case was remanded because context was insufficiently reasoned, and that zero-tolerance policy continues unchanged.
The zero-tolerance policy toward insult, intimidation and assault of police officers continues unchanged.
Het «zero-tolerance»-beleid ten aanzien van belediging, intimidatie en mishandeling van politiemedewerkers wordt onverkort voortgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over rondreizende radicale moslims

An MP from the SGP asked the ministers whether they share concern about itinerant radical Muslims who reject the democratic rule of law and are ambiguous about violence, and whether the AIVD monitors these youths and their foreign imam contacts. The government shares concern about rejection of democracy and ambiguity toward violence, notes religious outreach is protected by freedom of expression and religion, describes its counterterrorism strategy, and declines to comment publicly on current AIVD investigations while pointing to the AIVD annual report.
We cannot make public statements about current AIVD investigations.
Wij kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over actueel onderzoek van de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over zelfverrijking door fondsenwerving kankeronderzoek

An MP asked the government about the Dutch Wereld Kanker Onderzoek Fonds, including allegations of self-enrichment, outsourced fundraising owned by insiders, and paid board members. The state secretary answered that no facts showing self-enrichment were found, board members are unpaid, and the CBF chose not to renew the fund's quality mark because it no longer met standards.
I do not have information regarding the founders.
Ik beschik niet over informatie met betrekking tot de oprichters
Antwoord vragen van het lid Irrgang over de mogelijkheden in het privaatrecht bonussen terug te vorderen

An MP asked whether private law allows clawing back or refusing excessive bonuses that cause public outrage, and whether contractual freedom is absolute. The minister answered that contractual freedom is not absolute, that bonus contracts are not untouchable under Civil Code provisions on reasonableness and fairness, and pointed to a bonus-adjustment bill and other measures such as pay caps in the public and semi-public sector.
The cabinet does not consider contracts in which high bonuses have been agreed to be untouchable.
Het kabinet acht contracten, waarin hoge bonussen zijn afgesproken, niet onaantastbaar.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over antiterrorisme controles op Utrecht Centraal Station

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about a large police 'spotter' control at Utrecht Centraal station in March 2012 and its legal basis, purpose, frequency, public impact and proportionality. The minister answered that it was a preventive KLPD action without a terrorism threat, that such actions recur without advance notice, that citizens are not informed beforehand, and that the method is proportionate and effective, but declined to commission a new study.
The usefulness and necessity of the spotter actions have been proven during earlier actions.
Het nut en de noodzaak van de spotteracties zijn tijdens eerdere acties bewezen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht “Utrechtse Romafamilie logeert gratis in hotels”

An MP asked the Justice minister about reports that a Roma family in Utrecht has been housed for free in hotels and holiday parks at municipal expense, and asked why such people are not arrested and whether the mayor will repay the costs. The minister answered that the municipality provided temporary humanitarian shelter, that accountability for the costs lies with the Utrecht municipal council, and referred to earlier correspondence on 'tuigdorpen'.

It is a matter for the Utrecht municipal government to account to the municipal council for the choices made, the housing costs and the payment arrangement agreed with those involved and paid by them.

Het is een zaak van het gemeentebestuur van Utrecht om verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad over de gemaakte keuzes, de kosten van de huisvesting en de met de betrokkenen overeengekomen en door hen afbetaalde betalingsregeling.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Dijsselbloem over de verplaatsing van de verkoop van drugs van het zuiden van het land naar Nijmegen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice minister whether he anticipated the shift of cannabis sales from southern Netherlands to Nijmegen after the 'wietpas' was introduced, whether he would act on resulting nuisance, and whether he still backs the policy given public skepticism. The minister answered that displacement was limited and as expected, straathandel is manageable and police act on it, and he sees no need for further steps at present.
In view of the above, I see no need to take further steps at this time.
Gezien het bovenstaande zie ik geen noodzaak om op dit moment nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over mishandeling van zwangere vrouwen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the assault on a pregnant woman that led to her unborn child's death warrants stronger sentencing, and whether Article 82 convictions for such cases are recorded. The minister answered that the forensic investigation is ongoing with no date for results, that no separate statistics exist on Article 82 convictions, and that existing maximum penalties and sentencing discretion already allow the pregnancy to be taken into account.
The investigation in this case is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek in deze zaak loopt nog.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de evaluatie van het NICAM over de naleving van artikel 240a van het Wetboek van Strafrecht

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Education about the NICAM evaluation of compliance with article 240a of the Criminal Code on age limits for films and games. The state secretary reports that compliance rose from 14% to 49% since 2008, that the government will continue the convenant approach without declaring the Kijkwijzer code generally binding, and that further proposals on internet sales will be sent to parliament by June 2012.
As promised during the committee debate on alcohol policy of 9 February 2012, your House will be informed by letter by June 2012 at the latest.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO alcoholbeleid van 9 februari 2012 zal uw Kamer uiterlijk juni 2012 hierover bij brief geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over de honderdprocentscontrole op Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether an Advocate-General's opinion that there is no statutory power to question travellers at Schiphol without further cause means the 100% checks must stop. The minister answered that refusing to cooperate remains punishable under the Customs Act, that the Supreme Court's ruling is awaited, and that the checks involve more than questioning, so they continue.
Moreover, the 100% checks consist of more activities than asking questions, and other control instruments and powers are also deployed.
Overigens bestaan de honderprocentscontroles uit meer activiteiten dan het stellen van vragen en worden ook andere controlemiddelen en -bevoegdheden ingezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de dood van een baby na de racistische mishandeling van de moeder door Marokkaans straattuig

An MP asked the ministers whether suspects in a fatal street assault on a pregnant woman were released too quickly and whether they should be locked up longer and deported after denaturalisation. The Minister of Justice replied that the decision to lift or suspend pre-trial detention belongs to the examining judge, that the prosecutor appealed some of these decisions, and that he will not comment on sentencing in a pending case; denaturalisation for common offences is not currently possible.
It is not for me to pass judgment on the examining judge's decision to lift or suspend the pre-trial detention.
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te vellen over de beslissing van de rechter-commissaris tot de opheffing en/of schorsing van de voorlopige hechtenis.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over de betrekkelijkheid van anonieme gegevens

An MP asks whether anonymised government data can be re-identified using postcode and birth date, and whether current privacy law and the EU privacy proposal adequately protect citizens. The state secretary says he had not yet studied the underlying thesis, that anonymised data must not remain easily traceable to individuals, and that the existing and proposed legal framework appears adequate, pointing instead to weak safeguards by some processors and citizen carelessness.
Rather, the reporting seems to point to inadequate protective measures taken by certain processors of personal data
Veeleer lijkt de berichtgeving te wijzen op ontoereikende beschermingsmaatregelen die bepaalde verwerkers van persoonsgegevens hebben getroffen
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing in Finland, reports of exploitation of young foreign players, and whether the government would investigate and take responsibility. The minister answered that she lacks knowledge of Finland, sees no concrete signs of such practices in the Netherlands and no reason for a study, while placing primary responsibility on players and the KNVB, relying on the existing criminal law system.
Because there are no concrete indications that such practices occur in the Netherlands, I also see no reason to start such an investigation.
Omdat er geen concrete aanwijzingen zijn dat dergelijke praktijken zich in Nederland voordoen zie ik ook geen aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de komst van een geweldpredikende imam

An MP asked whether the government knows of a planned conference by Sharia4Belgium and of a Belgian preacher convicted for incitement, and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister confirmed awareness, said the venue is unknown, said such preachers can threaten democracy, and said he does not expect the preacher to visit, while noting Belgium's refusal to extradite its nationals.
The precise location has not been made public.
De precieze locatie is niet bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en De Jong over grote problemen op het spoor

MPs Elissen and De Jong asked about union criticism of Keyrail, alleged manipulation of punctuality figures, safety on the Betuweroute, and the relationship between Keyrail and ProRail. The minister says there is no evidence of manipulation, describes the controls and the inspectorate's view that safety is comparable to ProRail's, and promises to keep the interfaces limited and to consider an audit.
ProRail is one of the three shareholders of Keyrail.
ProRail is één van de drie aandeelhouders van Keyrail.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een jager die een auto op de A15 raakt met een kogel

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a hunter who hit a car on the A15 motorway with a bullet, including whether a report was filed, whether his hunting permit was revoked, and whether lead ammunition and hunting near public roads should be banned. The minister answered that a criminal investigation is ongoing, the permit may be revoked after review, no general ban on lead ammunition or hunting near roads is planned, and details cannot be given while the case is pending.
In the interest of the investigation, no statements can be made about that.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen daarover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asked ministers of Justice and Security and of Infrastructure and Environment about copper theft on and near the railways, including concrete measures, statistics, risk locations, sentencing, registration rules and European cooperation. Minister Opstelten answered with figures from ProRail, an action plan with ID requirements for copper purchases planned for 2013, a sentencing guideline expected in autumn 2012, and ongoing cooperation in the Waakzaam Koperslag project, while stating some conclusions are premature.
The Public Prosecution Service expects that the present guideline can take effect in autumn 2012.
Het Openbaar Ministerie verwacht dat de onderhavige richtlijn in het najaar van 2012 van kracht kan zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het aangiftevolgsysteem bij de politie

SP MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked which police forces use the case-tracking systems (AVS, MVS, BVS), whether they are satisfied, how they relate to the new victims' law, and whether forces developing their own software should stop pending the national police. The minister answered that four forces use AVS, twelve use BVS, MVS is nowhere operational, forces are satisfied, a national AVS is being planned, and he agrees forces should stop developing their own software.
I am not aware of this.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over digitale onveiligheid van de site meermetminder.nl

An MP asked ministers whether the Meer Met Minder subsidy website collects sensitive data such as citizen service numbers and bank details, and what security protects them against identity fraud. The minister confirmed the data collection, described the security architecture (single sign-on, separate database, encrypted transfer to Agentschap NL), reported no unauthorised access so far, and referred to the Wabb and Wbp privacy rules.
The bank account number is needed to transfer the lawful subsidy amount.
Het bankrekeningnummer is nodig om het rechtmatige subsidiebedrag over te maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de sluiting van brandweerposten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported closures of fire stations, the regional sign-off process, the link to response times and the role of municipal councils. The minister said the responsibility lies with regional safety boards, deferred concrete figures and response-time findings until the IOOV inspection report due in May 2012, and declined to suspend closures.
Responsibility for closing fire stations lies with the boards of the regional safety regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het sluiten van brandweerposten ligt immers bij het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over het wegpesten van overspannen agenten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police forces push out officers suffering from PTSD, and whether the minister recognises the signals, sees friction between legal and medical aspects of PTSD, and shares the need for uniform policy. The minister referred to earlier answers on the related questions, said he wants a uniform approach across the police with a registration guideline and implementing rules in preparation, and announced a further research project on PTSD as an occupational illness.
Yes, I want the Dutch police to have a uniform approach to this kind of issue.
Ja, ik wil dat Politie Nederland een eenduidige aanpak heeft voor dit soort kwesties.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe, Van der Werf en Bruins Slot over de erfpacht in Amsterdam

Three CDA MPs asked several ministers about municipal ground leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including canon increases, the lack of a right to buy the land, the legal remedies available, the threat of fines, and whether the municipality meets banking-sector criteria. The minister answered that leasehold is a private-law matter for the landowner (the municipality), that objection is possible only via the civil courts, that the municipality is revising its terms, and that the fine clause is rarely used.
Because leasehold is a private-law figure, public-law objection and appeal are not open here; the route to the civil court must be followed.
Omdat erfpacht een privaatrechtelijke figuur is, staan publiekrechtelijk bezwaar en beroep hier niet open, maar moet de weg naar de burgerlijke rechter worden gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het dumpen van getraumatiseerde agenten

An SP MP asks the Justice minister why police forces reportedly try to get rid of traumatised officers, whether officers with PTSD are denied help, docked pay, forced to pay medical costs, dismissed with hush money, and whether the Haaglanden force erred after Pijnacker. The minister says he has asked forces to follow the registration guideline, will issue an implementing guideline before summer, and has commissioned research into PTSD cases in the police, with results promised before summer's end.
I have meanwhile commissioned an investigation into the number of PTSD cases in the police and the amount of related labour disputes.
Ik heb inmiddels een onderzoek laten opstarten naar het aantal gevallen van PTSS bij de politie en de hoeveelheid daaraan gerelateerde arbeidsconflicten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çörüz en Joldersma over het bericht ‘Verkopers schoonmaakmiddel verdienen fors aan partydrug GHB’

MPs Çörüz and Joldersma (CDA) asked ministers about reports that GBL sellers profit from GHB, including hospital admissions, Netherlands as distribution country, RIVM/CAM purity findings, licensing, denaturation and the FIOD reporting point. Minister Schippers answered that GHB is being moved to list I, GBL purity bans are not desired, prevention will be analysed, and the FIOD reporting point is adequately publicised.
Very soon GHB will be moved from list II to list I of the Opium Act.
Zeer binnenkort zal GHB van lijst II naar lijst I van de Opiumwet worden verplaatst.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman over het bericht dat een Serviër dreigt aanslagen te plegen op dijken in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports of a Serbian man threatening to blow up Dutch dikes are credible and whether he has been arrested, and why action took long. The minister confirmed the videos, said an investigation is under way and declined to assess the threat publicly or give details, citing investigative and security reasons.
An investigation has been opened, about which I cannot make any further statements during this inquiry.
Er is een opsporingsonderzoek gestart, waarover ik gedurende dit onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over de vraag wie de handhaving van de wietpas voor zijn rekening neemt

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Security and Justice who is responsible for enforcing the 'wietpas' (membership pass for cannabis coffeeshops), privacy aspects and whether implementation should be delayed. The minister replied that responsibility remains with the mayor and police as before, that the privacy advice was already sent to parliament, and that no delay is needed.
There is no lack of clarity. The tightened coffeeshop policy brings no changes to the existing enforcement responsibilities.
Er is geen sprake van onduidelijkheid. Het aangescherpte coffeeshopbeleid brengt geen wijzigingen in de bestaande verantwoordelijkheden in de handhaving.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de bezuinigingen op jongerenwerkers

MP Kooiman asked the state secretaries whether cuts to youth work in municipalities, and possible disappearance of youth work, would increase nuisance and crime and raise long-term costs, and whether the government would act. The government replied that municipal authorities decide on youth work, that youth work is one intervention among others, and that it has confidence in local choices and no role in agreements on youth work.
It is up to the local government to decide who fulfils which role and therefore how much is invested in local youth work.
Het is aan het lokaal bestuur om te besluiten wie welke rol vervult en dus ook hoeveel wordt geïnvesteerd in lokaal jongerenwerk.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over uitlatingen van een politiewoordvoerder in Den Haag

An SP MP asked why a police spokesperson publicly linked the arrests of two protesters carrying a coffin to a memorial in Lommel, and whether this was proper. The minister answers that the arrests were based on breaking agreements and not complying with police orders, that the spokesperson merely pointed out the coffin could be seen as inappropriate, and that no ban on the coffin existed.
There has explicitly been no ban on carrying a coffin.
Van een verbod tot het meevoeren van een lijkkist is nadrukkelijk geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over een storing in het C2000 communicatiesysteem

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported outage of the C2000 emergency communication system in the Haaglanden region. The minister answered that only a technical fault in the status-box function at meldkamer workstations occurred, that C2000 communication itself continued, and that the fault was fixed the same day.
The fault reported by the Telegraaf on 12 April 2012 was not a fault in the C2000 network.
De storing waarvan de Telegraaf melding maakte op d.d. 12 april 2012 betrof geen storing in het C2000 netwerk.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Krakers blij in gemeentepand’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Amsterdam failed to file police reports for all squatted municipal buildings, contrary to the Squatting and Vacancy Act, and why the mayor says the owning districts should decide. The minister answered that the owner decides whether to report squatters, that Amsterdam's districts filed in 3 of 6 cases, and that districts are accountable to their own councils rather than the central city.
It is up to the owner to decide what it does with its property, provided the use causes no nuisance or disturbs public order.
Het is aan de eigenaar om te bepalen wat deze met zijn pand doet, mits het gebruik geen overlast geeft of de openbare orde verstoort.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Recourt over de rapportage van gerechterlijke psychologen en psychiaters

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a study of forensic psychologists and psychiatrists in criminal cases, including whether reports are based on seeing the suspect, whether recidivism tools are used, and whether the findings link to the Visser committee on tbs. The state secretary's answer, sent as a reply to the parliamentary agenda request, is a cross-reference to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 143) dated 30 March, with no substantive answers included in this document.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MPs Bouwmeester and Recourt (both PvdA) to the Minister of Security and Justice on the reporting of forensic psychologists and psychiatrists (submitted 23 March 2012) were answered on 30 March.

Hierbij bericht ik u dat de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Recourt (beiden PvdA) van uw Kamer aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de rapportage van rechterlijke psychologen en psychiaters (ingezonden 23 maart 2012) zijn beantwoord op 30 maart

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over der artikelen “De Alpenzwendel. In het spoor van de voetbalmaffia”en “Enveloppen in Huis ter duin. Talloze lijntjes lopen naar Nederland”en matchfixing

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked whether Dutch police and prosecutors had contact with German authorities about match-fixing, whether Interpol and Dutch participation in anti-match-fixing cooperation were adequate, and whether new legislation was needed. The government answered that only a 2009 German mutual legal assistance request concerned a Dutch national, that no Dutch criminal offences were found, that existing criminal law (art. 328ter) suffices, and that prevention is mainly the responsibility of the Dutch football sector and KNVB.
For tackling criminal conduct related to match fixing in our country, the national criminal law system is sufficient.
Voor de aanpak van criminele gedragingen gerelateerd aan match fixing in ons land volstaat het nationale strafrechtelijke stelsel.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over islamitische censuur

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister would act against billboard ads covered over by alleged Islamic censorship and whether he knew of similar cases. The minister answered that no state censorship occurred because private parties apparently covered the ads, saw no reason to intervene, and knew of no comparable cases.
Censorship in that sense does not arise in this concrete case, in which an advertising message was apparently covered by private individual(s).
Van censuur in die zin is in dit concrete geval, waarin een reclameboodschap schijnbaar door (een) particulier(en) is afgeplakt, geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over het niet aanpakken van een ‘schoolvoorbeeld van faillissementsfraude’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a transport company bankruptcy, described as a textbook case of bankruptcy fraud, had not been prosecuted, and what would be done about the liquidator's lack of funds and the involvement of TNT. The minister answered that no criminal complaint had been filed so far, so no investigation was underway, that bankruptcy handling is primarily a private-law matter for the curator, and that a revised liquidator guarantee scheme takes effect on 1 May 2012.
Specifically regarding the bankruptcy of this transport company, the Public Prosecution Service has informed me that to date the curator has not filed a complaint of bankruptcy fraud.
Specifiek over het faillissement van het onderhavige transportbedrijf heeft het OM mij bericht dat er tot op heden door de curator geen aangifte van faillissementsfraude is gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Fritsma over het bericht dat Roemenen en Bulgaren vaker betrokken zijn bij mensenhandel

MPs Elissen and Fritsma asked whether the rising share of Romanians and Bulgarians in human trafficking cases warrants 100% border checks on their nationals and a firm stance on Schengen accession. The minister answered that border controls are already applied, that the KMar pilot has been scaled up nationally, and that the Netherlands will judge Schengen accession only after the July 2012 CVM report.
The cabinet's position on the Schengen accession of Bulgaria and Romania is known.
Het standpunt van het kabinet inzake de Schengentoetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenie is bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over het bericht dat mensen die lid worden van een coffeeshop twee familieleden mogen meenemen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether coffeeshop members may bring two relatives, as reported in the press. The minister said the report was incorrect: Breda only discussed a request for visitor passes for a coffeeshop owner's relatives, which would conflict with the closed-club criterion, and he considers no measures necessary now.
Issuing visitor passes to relatives of club members is contrary to the (tightened) coffeeshop policy.
Het verstrekken van bezoekerspassen aan familieleden van clubleden is in strijd met het (aangescherpte) coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Monasch over het ontstaan van no-go area’s in de grote steden

Two PvdA MPs asked whether neglected neighbourhoods in Rotterdam and Amsterdam risk becoming no-go areas, how the government supports municipalities and measures investment there, and how cuts to municipal safety and neighbourhood policy fit with that risk. The minister rejects the professor's conclusion, describes the monitoring instruments and the continued neighbourhood approach, and refers back to earlier answers without committing to new action.
The total investment in the neighbourhoods is not tracked at national level.
Het totaal aan investeringen in de wijken wordt niet op rijksniveau bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Koopmans en Koppejan over de inhuur van flexibele arbeidskrachten via de aanbestedingskalender

MPs Van Hijum, Koopmans and Koppejan (CDA) asked why central government spends over 45 million euro on temporary agency staff during spending cuts, whether this undoes departmental downsizing targets, and about the tender's lot structure, CAO application, SME access and an overview of framework contracts. The minister answered that the 10% external-hire norm applies, that agency staff are used for peaks and temporary tasks rather than replacing permanent staff, that the CAO Rijk does not apply to them but the inlenersbeloning does, and listed current framework contracts and their durations.
For years the House of Representatives has been informed about the scale of external hiring of personnel by central government, including temporary agency workers.
Sedert jaren wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de omvang van de externe inhuur van personeel bij het Rijk, waaronder uitzendkrachten.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over huiszoekingen in aanloop naar Koninginnedag

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether the Rhenen mayor could carry out house searches and arrests before Queen's Day 2012 when residents refused entry, and whether this breaches constitutional home protections. Minister Spies replied that no search was planned, entry without consent requires a legal basis and warrant under the Koninginnedag emergency ordinance and general bylaw, and proportionality is reviewable by courts, but declined to talk to the mayor.
Entry without the resident's consent is a restriction of the right to the home, as guaranteed in Article 12 of the Constitution.
Binnentreden zonder toestemming van de bewoner is een inperking van het huisrecht, zoals gegarandeerd in artikel 12 van de Grondwet.

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Lyme disease is recognised as an occupational disease under the police legal status decree and whether it therefore qualifies for pain-and-suffering compensation. The minister confirmed both points, answering all three questions in the affirmative.
Yes, Lyme disease is recognised as an occupational disease within the meaning of the General Legal Status of Police Decree.
Ja, De ziekte van Lyme is erkend als een beroepsziekte in de zin van het Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de verstoorde 112 dienstverlening

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the minister why a back-up system for the 112 emergency line was not used immediately during the KPN outages and whether such a system should always be deployed at once. The minister answered that a back-up network exists, was used during the 31 March outage, and that deploying it immediately is not always necessary, with additional agreements made with KPN.
Additional agreements have now been made with KPN on the accessibility and risk management of the 112 network.
Met KPN zijn inmiddels aanvullende afspraken gemaakt over de bereikbaarheid en het risicomanagement van het 112-netwerk.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de mogelijkheden voor justitie om een gestolen en gelokaliseerde iPad te achterhalen

An SP MP asked why police could not pursue a stolen, app-located iPad traced to a house, and whether the government would propose changes. The minister said the OM judged the location too imprecise for a home search warrant, outlined alternative investigative powers, and considered the existing toolkit adequate.
The OM operated within a balanced system of criminal procedural powers.
Het OM heeft geopereerd binnen een afgewogen stelsel van strafvorderlijke bevoegdheden.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert en Van der Steur over het bericht "frustratie na 'vondst'gestolen ipad"

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van der Steur asked why the public prosecutor refused a house search even though an owner had located his stolen iPad via an app, and whether this could change. The minister answers that the law sets strict proportionality and subsidiarity requirements for house searches, refers to earlier answers, and sees no reason to think police and prosecution do not use available techniques.
The law sets strict requirements for the use of the intrusive coercive measure of searching a home, including the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
De wet stelt zware eisen aan het inzetten van het ingrijpende dwangmiddel van doorzoeking van een woning, waaronder de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht “Vuurwerkwerper op vrije voeten”

An MP asks why a suspect in an attack on police officers was released from pre-trial detention and whether criminal group liability should be broadened. The minister explains the court suspended detention on personal circumstances rather than sentence length, and that Dutch criminal law rests on individual liability with a low evidentiary bar for public violence, pointing to a pending private member's bill.
The reason the court suspended pre-trial detention was not that the expected sentence on conviction is lower than the six months already served.
De reden voor de rechtbank om de voorlopige hechtenis te schorsen was niet dat de naar verwachting bij veroordeling op te leggen straf lager is dan de 6 maanden
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Koolmees over het doorgeven van van Europese data aan de Verenigde Staten

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked about the Netherlands joining a US-G5 government-to-government approach to FATCA, its data-protection implications for EU data sent to US authorities, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary answered that the joint statement is a non-binding intention, that the Commission is studying the data-protection issues, that no Dutch cases of forced US data disclosure are known, and that the matter is for the Commission and member states to resolve.
The Netherlands has declared its willingness to join the statement of intent for this government-to-government approach.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard om aan te sluiten bij de intentieverklaring voor deze »government to government approach».
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘In cel gezet na aanrijden dief’

An MP asked whether a mother and son were detained after accidentally driving into a caught diesel thief, whether the self-defence guidelines were applied, and how the public would be informed. The minister said suspicion of attempted manslaughter arose from doubts about the incident, that both were released after further investigation found no intentional ramming, and that the self-defence guideline did not apply because the suspect had fled and the car chase did not amount to noodweer.
Further investigation by the police and consultation with the public prosecutor led to the conclusion that there was no intentional ramming.
Nader onderzoek van de politie en overleg met het OM heeft tot de conclusie geleid dat er geen sprake is van opzettelijk aanrijden.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de voedingsbodem voor extremisme gelet op de schokkende aanslagen op een joodse school in Toulouse, een moskee in Brussel en diepgewortelde islamofobie in Nederland

An MP asked ministers how intelligence services will stay alert to online jihadist mobilisation and Islamophobia after the Toulouse and Brussels attacks, and whether a dialogue with Jewish and Islamic organisations will be initiated. The ministers answered that the counterterrorism strategy prioritises jihadism and that the AIVD investigates jihadist networks online, while on Islamophobia and dialogue they pointed to existing contacts and monitoring without committing to new steps.
The cabinet is always vigilant regarding discrimination and/or extremism, regardless of the ideology underlying it.
Het kabinet is altijd waakzaam waar het gaat om discriminatie en/of extremisme, ongeacht welke ideologie daar aan ten grondslag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hilkens over criminele vreemdelingen

MPs Marcouch and Hilkens asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration about criminal foreigners in Amsterdam, including their share among suspects, their illegal residence, and whether removal powers or capacity should be expanded. The government said national data are not available for the largest cities, that expulsion tools exist and the sliding scale will be tightened from July 2012, and that a targeted use of existing capacity is preferred to new specialist capacity.
We do not have data specific to the situation in the ten largest cities.
Wij beschikken niet over gegevens specifiek voor de situatie in de tien grootste steden.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over financiering in de rechtspraak

MP Recourt asks whether the government will change the court financing system, including linking court fees to pre-trial hearings and adding incentives for efficiency. Minister Opstelten rejects a new system, defends the current budget and fee structure as best practice, and declines to consult on alternatives.
No. See the answers to questions 1 through 4.
Nee. Zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 tot en met 4.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Arib over politieprioriteiten in Twente

MPs Marcouch and Arib asked the Minister of Security and Justice about local police priorities in Twente, after reports that local CDA and VVD prefer animal police to address sex crimes and that a motion urged broader use of animal cops. The state secretary answered that local input on police priorities is welcome under existing and proposed law, that animal police work within the general police task with regular powers, and that both animal welfare and child pornography are national priorities.
I welcome that municipalities are thinking about how to fill in police priorities.
Ik juich het toe dat in de gemeenten wordt nagedacht over de invulling van politieprioriteiten.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over het gratis toegankelijk maken van informatie uit basisregistraties ten behoeve van opsporing

MP Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether police and prosecutors are hampered by paying per query for Chamber of Commerce and cadastral register data, and whether free access should be restored as the Emergo report recommends. The government replied that budget financing since 1 January 2012 removed invoicing for police and prosecution, that free use of basic registers is the aim by 2015, and that a decision on the end-state is expected at the end of 2012.
The cabinet aims to remove as far as possible the financial barriers to using basic registers, not only within government but also outside it, and to increase their use.

Het kabinet streeft ernaar dat de financiële drempels voor het gebruik van basisregistraties, niet alleen binnen de overheid maar ook daarbuiten, zo veel mogelijk verdwijnen en dat het gebruik ervan toeneemt.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de aanhouding van een journalist van de omroep Zeeland tijdens een oefening

MP Dibi asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police wrongly detained a regional broadcaster's journalist during an exercise on the Oosterscheldekering, and whether press freedom is being hindered by police discretion, and proposed agreed conduct rules with the journalists' association. The minister confirmed the detention due to confusion with an exercise actor, expressed regret, announced an evaluation, and stated journalists may report freely but must follow local rules, declining to commit to new agreements with the journalists' association.
The day after the incident, a conversation took place between the journalist and representatives of the police and defence.
De dag na het incident heeft een gesprek tussen de journalist en afgevaardigden van politie en defensie plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de financiële consequenties van het Europees Arrestatie Bevel en de veroordeling in de proceskosten van een strafzaak

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the financial consequences of a European Arrest Warrant surrender to Poland, including a fine, a bail forfeiture and procedural costs imposed on a Dutch citizen, and about legal aid and suspension of cooperation. The minister answered that the Polish case is for the suspect, his lawyer and Polish authorities, that EU law does not regulate fine collection or costs, that other countries also impose costs, and that cooperation will not be suspended.
I therefore see no reason to consult with my Polish counterpart about this criminal case.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding tot overleg met de Poolse ambtgenoot over deze strafzaak.
Antwoord vragen Arib en Timmermans over de zelfmoord van het 16-jarige Marokkaanse meisje Amina Filali

MPs Arib and Timmermans asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Foreign Affairs about the suicide of a 16-year-old Moroccan girl forced into marriage with her rapist under Article 475 of Morocco's penal code, and whether the Netherlands would press Morocco on it. The minister of Foreign Affairs acknowledged the article's effect on women's rights, said the Moroccan government will address the issue itself and that EU human rights dialogue will cover progress, and declined to commit to a working-group meeting.
Because the Moroccan government has indicated it will address this issue itself, it is now mainly up to the Moroccan government and society to study the legal context and revise the legislation.

Omdat de Marokkaanse regering heeft aangegeven deze kwestie zelf te zullen aanpakken, is het nu vooral aan de Marokkaanse regering en de Marokkaanse samenleving om de juridische context te bestuderen en de wetgeving te herzien.
Antwoord vragen Bontes over advocaten die blind blijven voor verdachte transacties

An MP asked the minister whether lawyers' failure to report unusual transactions under the anti-money-laundering law creates an appearance of involvement, whether measures should be taken against lax lawyers, and whether the Dutch Bar's supervision is adequate. The state secretary answered that reporting rates alone prove nothing, that supervision falls to the Bureau Financieel Toezicht and the Bar's disciplinary powers, and that the government considers current supervision insufficient and will tighten it via an Advocatenwet amendment and a forthcoming WWFT bill.
The cabinet considers the existing supervision of compliance with the WWFT by lawyers not adequate.
Het kabinet acht het bestaande toezicht op de naleving van de WWFT door advocaten niet toereikend.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Van den Besselaar en Helder over de Midden- en Oost-Europese misdaadgolf die over ons land trekt

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Immigration and of Security and Justice about a Central and Eastern European crime wave, including whether the open borders policy was naive, whether a dedicated police chief should be appointed, and whether expulsion and entry bans are the most effective response. The minister replied that free movement brings economic benefits alongside crime risks, that measures on mobile gangs have been taken, that a separate police chief is unnecessary, and that expulsions and unwelcome declarations are used alongside preventive and European cooperation measures.
The cabinet has therefore taken measures to combat and prevent crime committed by mobile gangs from Central and Eastern Europe.
Het kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om criminaliteit die gepleegd wordt door mobiele bendes uit Midden- en Oost Europa te bestrijden en te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over illegale prostitutie in massagesalons

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about illegal prostitution in massage parlours, including whether it spreads beyond Amsterdam and whether such businesses should be subject to the Bibob integrity-screening regime. The minister confirmed signals in other cities, announced a research study on trafficking in the Chinese beauty sector, and pointed to the pending prostitution regulation bill that would require licensing of all sex businesses, with Bibob screening available in licence applications.
This study is expected to be completed around the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal naar verwachting rond de zomer zijn afgerond.
Antwoord vragen Dibi, Hilkens, Schouw, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over het groeiende aantal gemeenten dat kritiek uit op het illegalenbeleid

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about municipalities criticising the government's policy on undocumented migrants and whether municipalities may set their own police priorities on this. Minister Leers answered that the police keep priority on criminal and nuisance-causing foreigners, that municipal mayors have authority over local police priorities, and that the police will still address vulnerable illegals with due regard for their situation.
Within his authority, the mayor can independently set priorities regarding police deployment in his municipality.
In het kader van zijn gezag kan de burgemeester eigenstandig prioriteiten stellen met betrekking tot de politie-inzet in zijn gemeente.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over liegende politieagenten

MP Dibi asked the Justice Minister about police officers who allegedly lied in official reports, whether internal integrity investigations and suspensions had followed, how many integrity investigations occurred over five years, and whether the minister will report annually on police integrity. The minister answered that the prosecutor is appealing a court ruling, that no separate investigation or suspension is planned pending appeal, that about 1,400 internal investigations occur yearly with around 450 involving the prosecutor, and that annual integrity reporting will be included in the police annual report.
I have previously committed to reporting on this. I intend to include the annual report in the Dutch Police annual report.
Ik heb eerder toegezegd hierover te rapporteren. Ik ben voornemens de jaarlijkse rapportage op te nemen in het jaarverslag Nederlandse Politie.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman en Helder over autodiefstal met stoorzender

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about car theft using signal jammers, including whether such devices should be banned and how police and justice tackle Eastern European theft gangs. The minister replied that jammers are already prohibited under the Telecommunications Act, that enforcement has been intensified with the Agentschap Telecom, and that stolen cars are flagged through Schengen and Interpol channels, though no figures on the scale of the problem are available.
It is known that this method is used. No figures are known about the scale of this problem.
Het is bekend dat deze methodiek wordt gebruikt. Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de omvang van dit probleem.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester over zero tolerance bij de wietpas

An MP asks the Justice minister about a Maastricht mayor's hard line against coffeeshops, the expected effect of the cannabis pass on tourist visits, enforcement of illegal sales, and privacy advice on the pass. The minister replies that local authorities set coffeeshop policy within the national framework, that restricting non-resident access should reduce drug tourism, and that the privacy advice from the CBP is still awaited.
It is for the mayor to set coffeeshop policy within the national framework (the Opium Act and the tolerance criteria) and to lead on it.
Het is aan de burgemeester om het coffeeshopbeleid binnen het landelijke kader (de Opiumwet en de gedoogcriteria) vast te stellen en daarover de regie te voeren.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Recourt over de berichtgeving dat er vals spel wordt gespeeld op de huizenveiling

MPs Monasch and Recourt asked about reports of cheating at house auctions and the WEW's decision to stop auctioning NHG-guaranteed homes. The minister said the WEW works with financiers to avoid auctions, a bill on forced-sale procedures is planned, existing sanctions suffice against cartel conduct, and the WEW refused 25% of executive auction requests in 2011.
This proposal is expected to be submitted to your House this summer.
Dit voorstel wordt naar verwachting in de zomer van dit jaar bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Passchaert en Ziengs over het doen van aangifte door bedrijven

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister why companies filing online reports are still asked to come to the police station, why camera evidence cannot be attached, and whether reports are refused when employees damage company vehicles off-duty. The minister replied that evidence should be collected fully, that the police are expanding internet reporting and a tracking system, that complex cases are invited to the station, and that police must take a report unless no offence is possible.
The law prescribes that investigating officers are obliged to record a report (article 163, fifth paragraph, Sv).
De wet schrijft voor dat opsporingsambtenaren verplicht zijn een aangifte op te nemen (artikel 163, vijfde lid Sv).
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven en Schouw over het opslaan van adresbestanden door Twitter

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether Twitter's storage of users' full address books breaches privacy and the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said the assessment and any enforcement belong to the independent CBP and OPTA, which do not comment on ongoing investigations, and the government itself takes no action.
The judgement on whether there is a breach of the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens in this case, and any enforcement measures, is not for me but for the College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Het oordeel of er in casu sprake is van een schending van de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, en het eventueel inzetten van handhavende maatregelen, is niet aan mij, maar aan het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).
Antwoord vragen Helder en Bontes over het bericht ‘Angst rondtrekkende bendes bij winkelier’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that organised Eastern European mobile gangs are driving large-scale theft from shops, whether politicians concealed the scale of this crime before EU accession, and what will be done to recover the losses. The minister said the precise scale is unknown, denied deliberate concealment, noted a pilot for sharing camera images with retailers, and referred to a separate letter for the remaining questions.
To answer these questions I refer to the letter I sent to your House on 26 March 2012.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de brief die ik uw Kamer op 26 maart 2012 gestuurd heb
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de toepassing van het Europees Arrestatie Bevel door Duitsland dat twee keer overlevering vraagt voor hetzelfde feitencomplex

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether Germany's second European Arrest Warrant for the same drug-plantation facts, after a sentence already served in the Netherlands, breaches ne bis in idem and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that the offences are similar but not identical, that the court found no ne bis in idem violation, and that he sees no reason to change the grounds for refusal or to consult the German minister.
I see no reason to consult with my German counterpart.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om met mijn Duitse ambtgenoot te overleggen.
Antwoord vragen Bruins Slot en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Enveloppen in Huis ter Duin. Talloze lijntjes Duitse gokmaffia lopen naar Nederland’

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dekken asked whether the government will act on reports of Dutch involvement in match fixing and bribery in international football. The minister answers that the sports sector is primarily responsible, that no Dutch criminal offences have been identified so far, and that the government will share knowledge and support prevention at national and EU level.
The sports world is primarily responsible for the integrity of sport and gives substance to this itself.
De sportwereld is primair verantwoordelijk voor de integriteit van de sport en geeft daar ook invulling aan.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra en Hachchi over onveilige software in pacemakers

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about security vulnerabilities in SCADA software in pacemakers and insulin pumps, including whether manufacturers must report flaws and whether certification should be mandatory. The minister answered that no central registry exists, that manufacturers must validate software and carry out post-market surveillance, that reports go to notified bodies or the IGZ, and that tightening of the existing regime is planned.
In my letter dated 27 March 2012, I informed you of my plans to tighten the current legal regime.
In mijn brief d.d. 27 maart 2012, heb ik mijn voornemens voor aanscherpingen binnen het huidige wettelijke regime aan u kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over de euthanasie bij dementie

An MP asks the ministers of Health and Justice about a euthanasia case involving a dementia patient, including whether the Regional Euthanasia Review Committee's ruling is reliable, whether a Public Prosecution Service investigation is warranted, and the legal status of advance written declarations. The minister defends the committee's ruling, says no prosecution investigation is needed, states that the law clearly allows written declarations, and points to KNMG guidance and the upcoming evaluation of the Euthanasia Act.
The ruling of the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees contains a description of the committee's assessment of the notification.
Het oordeel van de Regionale toetsingscommissies euthanasie bevat een weergave van de beoordeling van de melding door de commissie.

Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over een EU-pilot voor een Europees elektronisch patiëntendossier en de uitspraken van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland inzake het verplicht stellen van aansluiting bij het Landelijk Schak

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked about privacy safeguards in the EU-pilot EPSOS for a European electronic patient record and about insurers' plans to make connection to the national switchpoint (LSP) a contracting requirement. The minister said EPSOS pilots run only between other countries, that data stays at source with explicit patient consent, and that connection requirements are for the care providers' profession to set, with insurers not yet imposing one.
At this moment there is not yet any requirement to connect to the LSP.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een eis tot aansluiting op het LSP.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over het verzwijgen van feiten rondom een wapenvergunning voor Tristan van der V.

An MP asks the Justice minister whether police concealed facts about the gun permit granted to Tristan van der V., including whether the officer knew of his psychiatric problems and whether the 2005 refusal and the 2008 grant were discussed or documented. The minister answers that the Rijksrecherche investigation found no evidence the officer knew of the psychiatric problems in 2005, that the 2005 letters were lost in a system migration, and that the 2008 file contains no psychiatric information.
The Rijksrecherche conducted an extensive investigation into the granting of the gun permit to Tristan van der V.
De Rijksrecherche heeft uitvoerig onderzoek gedaan naar het verlenen van de wapenvergunning aan Tristan van der V.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over omkoping en bedrog in het internationale voetbal

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked ministers about match-fixing and betting-syndicate involvement in international football, including risks to Dutch youth players and whether the Dutch authorities acted after German arrests. The minister said the Dutch federation KNVB leads prevention, that no Dutch cases of youth players being approached are known, and that the German case produced no Dutch investigation, while the government will join Council of Europe negotiations on a match-fixing convention.
First and foremost, sport is in the lead and is doing a great deal on this front with various preventive measures.
Eerst en vooral is de sport aan zet en die zetten hier fors op in met verschillende preventieve maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen Arib over slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik

Labour MP Arib asks the Justice Minister whether the OM's renaming of 'slachtoffer' to 'aangever' in the sexual abuse prosecution guideline signals distrust of victims, and about false-report figures and victim experience. The minister replies that the term aims at objectivity without distrust of victims, that victims' rights remain, that false-report estimates are limited, and that a victim monitor is underway but the guideline wording will not change.
The use of the more neutral term 'aangever' has nothing to do with distrust of victims, but aims to do more justice to the pursuit of objectivity in the truth-finding process in sexual offence cases.

Het gebruik van de neutralere term «aangever» heeft met wantrouwen jegens de slachtoffers niets te maken, maar beoogt meer recht te doen aan het streven naar objectiviteit in het proces van waarheidsvinding bij zedenzaken.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Ruim 2600 veroordeelden ontlopen cel met succes’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports that over 2,600 convicts evaded prison through expiry of their sentences in 2010, and how many are actively at large. The state secretary confirmed the figures, attributed part of the rise to CJIB registration starting in 1996, outlined enforcement measures such as the Team Executie Strafvonnissen and tracking projects, and declined to extend pre-trial detention grounds.
I consider it of great importance that the penalties imposed by the judge are also actually carried out.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat de door de rechter opgelegde straffen ook daadwerkelijk ten uitvoer worden gelegd.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over verschillen in straftoemeting in soortgelijke zaken

Mr Van der Steur (VVD) asked the minister about a study finding that suspects with foreign-looking appearance and poor Dutch may receive harsher sentences, and whether measures will be taken with the judiciary to prevent arbitrariness. The minister refers to his answers to earlier questions from Mr Recourt on the same subject, without restating substance here.
I refer to my answers to the questions from Mr Recourt of your House
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het bericht dat verdachten met een buitenlands uiterlijk strenger gestraft worden dan andere verdachten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a Leiden study suggesting suspects with a foreign appearance receive harsher sentences, and whether judges are trained against stereotyping. The minister answered that appearance and language must play no role in sentencing, that the WODC found the study's conclusions insufficiently justified, and that judicial training already covers impartiality and no new measures are needed.
The appearance and language proficiency of the suspect may not play a role in sentencing.
Het uiterlijk en de taalbeheersing van de verdachte mogen geen rol spelen bij de straftoemeting.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de strengere bestraffing van verdachten met een buitenlands uiterlijk

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police judges sentence suspects with a foreign appearance more harshly than Dutch suspects, what causes this, and whether further research will be done. The minister referred to his earlier answers to parliamentary questions from another MP, without restating substance here.
I refer to my answers to the questions from Mr Recourt of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij en Sterk over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether statements by an extremist imam, Al Haddad, that the minister called reprehensible, possibly including calls to violence, justified refusing his entry into the Netherlands, and how entry decisions are made. The minister answered that the statements may not be criminal in isolation, that without concrete indications of serious threat entry could not lawfully be refused, and that entry decisions for EU and non-EU nationals follow Schengen rules and case-by-case checks.
The law does not give me the room to refuse someone entry to the Netherlands solely on the basis of his statements, without concrete indications of imminent serious criminal offences.
De wet biedt mij niet de ruimte om zonder concrete aanwijzingen voor dreigende ernstige strafbare feiten iemand de toegang tot Nederland te ontzeggen louter op basis van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman over de uitlating van de burgemeester van Almere over de dierenpolitie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Almere mayor refused to introduce an animal police unit, as quoted. The minister said the mayor denies the statement, that the Flevoland force supports the unit but wants it staffed by part-time task-accent holders, and that the minister will reiterate the national policy that animal police officers must be fully dedicated.
I will once again bring this line to the attention of the head of the Flevoland police force.
Ik zal deze lijn nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen van de korpsbeheerder van Flevoland.
Antwoord vragen Arib over de aanpak van kindermisbruik en kinderporno via anonieme internetnetwerken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how police and prosecutors tackle child abuse material distributed over anonymous networks such as Tor, and why they seemed slow to act. The minister answered that the scale cannot be measured, that some websites were taken offline in summer 2011 under judicial authorisation, and that capacity and expertise are being expanded.
Given the anonymity mentioned above, and because not all communication over anonymous networks is structurally monitored, no statements can be made about the number of (Dutch) users.

Gezien de hiervoor genoemde anonimiteit, en omdat niet alle communicatie die via anonieme internetnetwerken wordt gevoerd structureel wordt gemonitord, zijn geen uitspraken te doen over het aantal (Nederlandse) gebruikers
Antwoord vragen Arib over het bericht ‘zorgen over seksueel misbruik in orthodox-protestantse kring’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of concern over child sexual abuse in orthodox Protestant communities, including whether helpers receive signals and whether research is planned. The minister said Movisie's exploratory study found some helpers received such signals but did not investigate them, that the OM would act on any complaint filed, and pointed to a planned multidisciplinary study on abuse in dependency relationships.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over een mogelijk verband tussen de sterftepiek in het katholieke jongensinternaat huize St. Joseph in Heel en castraties aldaar

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the criminal investigation into the high death toll at St. Joseph's boys' home in Heel covers possible castrations and related offences. The minister answered that the OM investigation was limited to the 1952-1954 peak, found no indication of castrations, and will decide on extending the inquiry only after the final report.
The Public Prosecution Service limited its investigation to the peak of deaths in 1952-1954 at Huize St. Joseph in Heel.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft het onderzoek gericht op en beperkt tot de piek van sterfgevallen in de jaren 1952–1954 in Huize St. Joseph te Heel.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken met betrekking tot de aanrijdtijden in de gemeente Zundert

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police response times in Zundert, which allegedly exceeded the norm frequently in 2011, and whether the police would be closer to citizens and whether the minister would consult the mayor and force manager. The minister confirmed the figures, said the district as a whole meets the 15-minute norm, attributed most overruns to second or third-instance calls and the timing of the meldkamer, described a night-time and 24-hour emergency car in the area, and said force capacity allocation is the responsibility of the Regionaal College and the mayor rather than the minister.
Allocating police capacity within a regional force is a responsibility of the Regionaal College and the authority, not of the Minister of Security and Justice.

Het indelen van capaciteit bij de politie binnen een regiokorps is een verantwoordelijkheid van het Regionaal College en het gezag en geen verantwoordelijkheid van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over een internationale aanpak van voetbalhooligans

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked whether an international approach to football hooliganism exists, whether an international combined-ticket scheme should be introduced, and whether municipalities should be compensated for extra costs. Minister Opstelten answered that EU cooperation and information exchange already exist, that a combined-ticket scheme is impractical, that police deployment figures are given, and that municipalities remain responsible and need no compensation.
Maintaining public order remains the responsibility of mayors under article 172 of the Municipalities Act.
De handhaving van de openbare orde is en blijft een verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeesters ingevolge artikel 172 van de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elissen en Graus over het bericht dat de luchtvaart in rep en roer is door een nieuwe methode van drugssmokkel

PVV MPs Elissen and Graus asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about a reported case in which someone hid cocaine in an aircraft wing, asking about passenger risk, airport security measures, and the investigation. Minister Opstelten answered that the access itself is a serious security problem, that existing ICAO-based measures and 100% drug controls on flights from the overseas territories are considered adequate and will not be tightened, and that a joint investigation led by the Openbaar Ministerie is underway, though no further details can be given.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over een bij strenge vorst buiten vastgeketende hond in Breskens

An MP asked why police did not act on repeated reports of a labrador kept chained outside without adequate shelter or water in Breskens during severe frost, and whether current rules and enforcement are adequate. The minister answered that police found no criminal offence, that existing rules offer sufficient grounds for enforcement, that a forthcoming decree will clarify animal cruelty, and that no data exist on how many dogs are chained 24 hours a day.
The police have been unable to establish a criminal offence concerning the dog in this case.
De politie heeft geen strafbaar feit met betrekking tot de hond in deze casus kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt met betrekking tot het gebrek aan tijd bij de politie om winkeldieven aan te pakken

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked whether police lack time to tackle shop theft and whether municipal enforcement officers (BOA's) should handle minor shop theft. The minister replies that shop theft is a serious crime but that BOA's are a complement to police, that a pilot with shop-theft BOA's runs in five municipalities, and that a convenant on sharing camera images with retailers has been signed.
To speed up the handling of shop theft, a pilot with shop BOA's is now being carried out in five municipalities.
Om de afhandeling van winkeldiefstal te versnellen wordt er nu een proef uitgevoerd met winkelboa's in een vijftal gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman met betrekking tot de inzet van BOA’s

An SP MP asks the Justice minister whether BOAs (special investigating officers) will take over police tasks, which tasks, training, and whether this weakens police quality and structure. The minister answers that BOAs in shopping areas will be allowed to handle simple shoplifting without violence as a complement to police, with additional training, and that the total enforcement capacity will be used effectively.
These BOAs are only deployed for shoplifting where no violence is used.
De boa’s worden alleen ingezet bij een winkeldiefstal waar geen geweld bij is gebruikt.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over het beheer van belangrijke politiespullen

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a former police officer who kept police equipment after leaving service, and about how police administer issued and returned equipment. The minister said the former officer returned the items, that equipment administration is kept per force without a national protocol, and that the national police reform will simplify and standardise administration.
I consider it important to properly administer important police equipment within the new police organisation in order to prevent societal risks.
Ik acht het van belang om binnen de nieuwe politieorganisatie belangrijke politiespullen goed te administreren om maatschappelijke risico's te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marouch over het sluiten van de helft van de politiebureaus in Amsterdam

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the minister whether half of Amsterdam's police stations would close under the national police reorganisation and how this squares with promises of local presence and accessibility. The minister said plans were not yet fixed, that the national police will stay rooted locally, that online reporting is being expanded, and that accessibility is a matter of ongoing discussion with the local authority.
Statements about the possible closure of neighbourhood police stations are premature in relation to the national police.
Uitspraken over het mogelijk sluiten van wijkbureaus zijn prematuur in relatie tot de nationale politie.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de sluiting van politiebureaus in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether 15 of Amsterdam's 32 neighbourhood police stations would close under the new national police, and about accessibility, staffing cuts and whether plans were being made to close stations. The Minister denied the 15-station figure, called closure statements premature, said plans would not be adopted before the Senate approved the police bill, and stated that operational strength would remain at 49,500 fte.
Statements about the possible closure of neighbourhood offices are premature.
Uitspraken over het mogelijk sluiten van wijkbureaus zijn prematuur.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Recourt over veroordeelde criminelen die nog niet in de gevangenis zitten

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Justice Minister about convicted offenders who have not yet served their prison sentences, including figures on warrants, statute-of-limitations expiry and the TES team. State Secretary Teeven answered that the government takes the problem seriously, gave case figures from the CJIB and OPS, and listed measures to speed up enforcement, though he could not give a precise forecast of future non-enforcement.
I therefore consider it of great importance that the sentences imposed by the judge are actually enforced.
Ik acht het daarom van groot belang dat de door de rechter opgelegde straffen ook daadwerkelijk ten uitvoer worden gelegd.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bekeuren door particuliere beveiligers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Amsterdam will appoint private security guards as temporary special investigating officers to issue fines, how they are screened and trained, and who is responsible for their conduct. The minister answered that these guards are limited to enforcing local bylaws and parking rules, are screened and examined like other boa's, and that the municipality as employer and the police and Public Prosecution Service supervise them.
The lending company and the borrowing employers take labour-law measures where necessary if the conduct of the boa or supervisor is not acceptable.
Het uitlenende bedrijf en de inlenende werkgevers nemen zo nodig arbeidsrechtelijke stappen als de gedragingen van de boa/toezichthouder niet door de beugel kunnen.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Recourt, Dibi, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over quotum aanhouden illegalen’

MPs from five parties asked the immigration and justice ministers about reports that police were given a quota of undocumented migrants to apprehend, and how this affects their access to care and education. The minister answered that the agreement aims to keep the police migration-enforcement task prioritised within existing capacity, that illegal residents keep their right to necessary care and minors to education, and that police decide how to implement the task.
The WODC presented in 2011 the results of a study estimating the number of illegal residents in the Netherlands in 2009.
Het WODC heeft in 2011 de resultaten van een onderzoek naar het geschatte aantal illegalen in Nederland in 2009 gepresenteerd.
Antwoord vragen Recourt over het oprukken van ‘Ndrangheta in de Nederlandse samenleving’

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Ndrangheta poses a serious threat in the Netherlands, whether intelligence and investigative capacity are fragmented, and whether it may infiltrate government. The minister acknowledges some involvement in drug trafficking and money laundering, says existing structures (National Recherche, Public Prosecution Service, National Threat Picture) are adequate, sees no signs of government infiltration, declines to set up a dedicated team, and promises a working group review.
It is important that the matter in question is looked at again carefully.
Wel is van belang dat de desbetreffende problematiek nog eens goed tegen het licht wordt gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over problemen bij de vorming van de nationale politie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Justice Minister about problems in forming the national police, including a technocratic approach, planning delays, local discretion, centralisation of support services and leadership. The minister rejects the technocracy claim, says the implementation and realisation plans will only be adopted after the law is published, and promises ongoing consultation and communication.
I have promised your House not to take irreversible steps before parliamentary approval of the bill.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten voor parlementaire goedkeuring van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marcouch over overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet door de politie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported widespread violations of the Working Time Act by the police, including whether this amounts to overwork of officers and whether exemptions for special police units are being pursued. The Minister answered that about 180,000 violations were counted in the first half of 2011, that the problem is serious but not proof of systematic overwork given compensation rules, and that part of the issue lies in police pay regulations to be addressed in CAO negotiations, with a letter on the Inspectorate report promised.
The number the Telegraaf describes is therefore its own conclusion.
Het aantal dat de Telegraaf beschrijft, is daarmee een eigen conclusie.
Antwoord van het lid Kooiman over overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet door de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported violations of the Working Hours Act by police forces, including causes, consequences for officers, and whether staffing is adequate. The minister answered that monitoring showed about 180,000 violations in the first half of 2011, that causes and measures are deferred to an Inspectorate SZW report, and that police capacity choices and productivity are the government's focus.

For the causes of the violations and the short- and long-term measures I intend to take, I refer you to the recently conducted Inspectorate SZW investigation and my response to it, which you will receive from me in the coming days.

Voor de oorzaken van de overschrijdingen en de korte en lange termijn maatregelen die ik wil treffen, verwijs ik u naar het recent uitgevoerde onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW en mijn reactie daarop, die u een dezer dagen van mij ontvangt.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over de zorg van hoofdcommissarissen van politie over de toename van criminaliteit en onveiligheid in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police chiefs' warnings about rising crime, young repeat offenders, and cuts to youth care and mental health services are justified.
