The minister replied that crime has fallen since 2005, described police networks and programmes against repeat offending, and said youth-care funding was raised and reforms aim at earlier, integrated support.
Despite the economic crisis, crime in the Netherlands has fallen.
Ondanks de economische crisis is de criminaliteit in Nederland gedaald.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over een dreigend tekort aan gediplomeerde technisch rechercheurs met kenmerk

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a looming shortage of certified forensic technical detectives, including reports of backlogs in examinations at the Police Academy and EU rules on forensic expertise. The Minister replied that backlog agreements exist for all exams, that 2012 examinations are planned with no mandatory certifications at risk, and that EU impacts are not yet known pending an action plan due June 2013.
As I indicated in my answers to the parliamentary questions of 6 January 2012, agreements have been made on clearing backlogs in examinations at the Police Academy.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op de Kamervragen van 6 januari 2012 heb aangegeven, zijn er afspraken gemaakt over het wegwerken van achterstanden in de examinering bij de Politieacademie.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over openbaarmaking van gegevens van 112-bellers

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about websites publishing personal data of 112 callers relayed over the P2000 alarm system, and whether this breaches data protection. The minister found it undesirable, will ask meldkamer boards to be more restrained, and plans encryption when P2000 is replaced around 2014.
I will therefore once again point out to the boards of control rooms that they should be more restrained in disclosing private data in relaying messages via the P2000 alarm system.
Ik zal daarom de besturen van meldkamers er nogmaals op wijzen om terughoudender om te gaan met het verstrekken van privé gegevens in de doormelding via het P2000 alarmeringssysteem.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff en Hennis-Plasschaert over het artikel 'Politici verzwegen bewust omvang Oost-Europese misdaad'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice whether politicians deliberately concealed the scale of Eastern European organised crime before EU accession, and what is being done about it. The government denies deliberate concealment, says organised crime is addressed within accession Chapter 24 and EU bodies, and promises a separate letter on mobile criminal gangs from Central and Eastern Europe, without giving figures.
The problem of crime from Eastern Europe was not deliberately concealed or covered up in the run-up to the respective accessions.
Het probleem van misdaad uit Oost-Europa is in aanloop naar de respectievelijke toetredingen niet bewust verzwegen of toegedekt.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het bericht dat slachtoffers van seksueel misbruik binnen katholieke instellingen veel langer moeten wachten op een schadevergoeding dan voorzien

An MP asked the Justice minister about reports that victims of sexual abuse in Catholic institutions face longer waits for compensation than promised, and about the state's oversight and prosecution role in past abuse. The minister said the delay is regretted but reflects careful assessment, that no general conclusion on state oversight can be drawn from the Deetman findings, and that no evidence shows justice authorities knowingly ignored abuse.
I cannot, on the basis of the delay in handling the first compensation requests, give a judgement on the follow-up the Roman Catholic Church gives to the Deetman Commission's recommendations.

Ik kan niet op basis van de vertraging in de afhandeling van de eerste compensatieverzoeken een oordeel geven over de opvolging die de Rooms-Katholieke Kerk geeft aan de aanbevelingen van de Commissie Deetman.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over de structurele terreur in Utrechtse wijken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration, Integration and Asylum about reported structural intimidation of a family in Utrecht neighbourhoods, whether mayors would be convened, and whether a police crackdown, neighbourhood evictions and denaturalisation would solve it. Minister Opstelten answered that the recent events fall within an earlier mayors' meeting, that the council judges the mayor's functioning, that the government is pursuing an ethnicity-neutral approach to youth crime, and that police investigated and arrested suspects.

Specifically regarding the events of 19 and 20 February 2012 in Utrecht, I can inform you that the police immediately launched an investigation and that suspects have since been arrested and taken into custody.

Specifiek ten aanzien van de gebeurtenissen op 19 en 20 februari 2012 in Utrecht kan ik u melden dat de politie direct onderzoek heeft ingesteld en dat er inmiddels verdachten zijn aangehouden en in hechtenis genomen.
Antwoord vragen Helder en De Roon over het bericht ‘Ruim helft diplomaten betaalt boetes niet’

MPs Helder and De Roon asked whether foreign diplomats fail to pay over half of traffic fines and what the government does about it. The minister confirmed non-payment rates, explained that diplomatic immunity limits enforcement, and described diplomatic pressure and a planned annual reminder operation with CJIB and RDW.
That is not really possible for the period mentioned.
Dat is voor de genoemde periode niet goed mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen over de oprichting van een nationaal anti-fraudebureau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the UK National Fraud Authority model, a single national anti-fraud bureau, should be created in the Netherlands, citing estimates of savings and fraud volume. The minister replied that Dutch fraud policy already aligns with NFA goals through prevention, public-private cooperation and repressive measures, cited a 2006 estimate of 6 to 12 billion euro in fraud proceeds, and did not commit to creating a national bureau.
In my previous answers I indicated that the Cabinet's current fraud policy corresponds with the objectives the NFA in the United Kingdom pursues.

In mijn vorenstaande antwoorden heb ik aangegeven dat het ingezette Kabinetsbeleid op het terrein van de fraudebestrijding overeenkomt met de doelstellingen die de NFA in het Verenigd Koninkrijk nastreeft.
Antwoord vragen Arib over het gebrek aan toezicht op escortbedrijven

MP Arib asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the lack of oversight of escort agencies, including unlicensed firms, advertising, trafficking risks and enforcement capacity. The minister answers that the pending prostitution regulation law will require licences, a national register of refusals and withdrawals, and advertising limits, and that trafficking remains a priority with no exact count of specialised officers.
The national register also includes refusals and withdrawals of municipal licences, including for escort agencies.
In het landelijk register zijn tevens weigeringen en intrekkingen van gemeentelijke vergunningen van onder meer escortbedrijven opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen Leijten over aanpak van fraude met persoonsgebonden budgetten

Leijten (SP) asked the state secretary and Justice minister about court cases on fraud with personal budgets (pgb) not leading to convictions, the SIOD report on pgb fraud-sensitivity, and enforcement priorities. The government rejects the claim that pgb fraud goes unpunished, cites new measures and ongoing investigations, and promises a central fraud-reporting point and a cooperation agreement.

The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that most of the cases mentioned in a Volkskrant article of 27 January 2012 are still under investigation, and that the conclusion that prosecution is lacking is premature.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij medegedeeld dat het merendeel van de zaken dat wordt genoemd in een artikel in de Volkskrant van 27 januari 2012 nog in onderzoek is, en dat de conclusie dat vervolging uitblijft, voorbarig is.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de bescherming van privacygevoelige gegevens van Nederlandse burgers tegenover de overheid van de Verenigde Staten

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Dutch citizens' sensitive data held by cloud providers can be accessed by US authorities under the Patriot Act, and how the government will protect it. The state secretary answered that US law may compel US-headquartered firms to disclose data regardless of location, that the proposed EU Data Protection Regulation does not yet clarify the consequences, and that the Commission is primarily responsible; a letter on the state's own data would follow in about six weeks.

Specifically on the question of what consequences US legislation has for personal data belonging to the State, the Minister of the Interior will inform your House in more detail by letter in about six weeks.

Specifiek over de vraag welke consequenties de wetgeving van de Verenigde Staten heeft voor persoonsgegevens die aan de Staat toebehoren zal de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties uw Kamer over circa zes weken per brief nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de programmatische onafhankelijkheid van omroepen

An MP asked whether broadcasters' programmatic independence should be limited for content such as eating human flesh, whether the public broadcaster should be held morally accountable, and what criminal-law criteria apply. The minister answered that programmatic independence is not restricted in advance, that eating human flesh as such is not punishable though obtaining it may be, and that it is not for the government to set standards of decency.
No, as minister I do not decide on the moral choices a broadcaster makes.
Nee, als minister ga ik niet over de morele keuzes die een omroep maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Recourt en Marcouch over het strafrechtelijk afkopen van vervolging na het lastigvallen en bedreigen van een scheidsrechter

MPs asked why three men who harassed and threatened a referee received a 210 euro settlement offer roughly ten months after the incident, and how this fits the government's tough approach to football violence. The minister replied that evidence was insufficient for harassment and threats, that the suspects were offered a 210 euro transaction for theft in association, and that the delay stemmed from further investigation needed after the first report.
For this offence, in line with the applicable guidelines, the Public Prosecution Service offered each of the suspects a transaction proposal of 210 euros.
Het OM heeft voor dit feit – overeenkomstig de daarvoor geldende richtlijnen – aan ieder van de verdachten een transactievoorstel van € 210,– aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elissen naar aanleiding van een nieuwsbericht over digitale spionage van China en Rusland

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about digital espionage by China and Russia against travellers and businesses, including device tampering, government protective measures and the risks posed. The minister answered that the risk is real, listed espionage methods and existing AIVD/MIVD advisory, awareness and information-security measures, while withholding country-specific details as classified.
I cannot provide further information on which countries engage in espionage, as this concerns the knowledge level and sources of the AIVD and MIVD.
Nadere informatie over landen die zich schuldig maken aan spionage kan ik niet verstrekken aangezien dat raakt aan het kennisniveau en de bronnen van de AIVD en de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over de geschiktheid van Nederlandse wetgeving voor het gebruik van spyware

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the KLPD's use of spyware, the Big Brother Award it received, and whether Dutch law, including article 126l of the Code of Criminal Procedure, is adequate for such tools. The minister acknowledged the award and the KLPD's use of spyware, and referred back to an earlier answer rather than stating a new position on whether specific legislation is needed.
I refer to my answer to question 2 from Member Recourt of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2 van het lid Recourt van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over problemen bij de examinering in het politieonderwijs

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about examination backlogs at the Police Academy, which he links to ending side-job examiners, and asks whether the policy was ill-advised, how large the backlog is and how candidates will be informed. The minister explains the change as a principled shift to on-duty certified examiners, acknowledges a backlog of 264 exams, promises resolution by 1 August 2012 and notification with apologies to affected candidates.
I have agreed with the Police Academy's executive board that the examination problems will be resolved by 1 August 2012 at the latest.
Ik heb met het college van Bestuur van de politieacademie afgesproken dat uiterlijk per 1 augustus 2012 de problemen met de examinering zullen zijn opgelost.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Kuiken over problemen bij de examinering in het politieonderwijs

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the minister about exam chaos at the Police Academy, including whether budget cuts caused a shortage of examiners, delays for students, and whether unions had warned in advance. The minister replied that the shift to a new system of police staff serving as examiners within working hours caused a temporary shortage, delaying some exams with priority for final-year students, and that backlogs will be cleared by 1 August 2012.
I have agreed with the Police Academy's executive board that all backlogs will be resolved by 1 August 2012 at the latest.
Met het college van bestuur van de politieacademie afgesproken, dat alle achterstanden uiterlijk 1 augustus 2012 zullen zijn opgelost.
Antwoord vragen Hachi en Schouw over de risico’s van software voor het op afstand besturen van industriële processen

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about security risks of SCADA systems controlling industrial processes, including whether attacks require exceptionally advanced software, what security requirements and oversight apply, the risks of USB sticks and internet connections, and European activity. The minister answered that operators are themselves responsible, sectoral supervisors oversee SCADA safety, the NCSC advises, and that European initiatives exist.
Organisations within government and the commercial sector are themselves responsible for their SCADA systems.
Organisaties binnen de overheid en de commerciële sector zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun SCADA-systemen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Recourt over matchfixing en het verkopen van de voetbalwedstrijden

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the ministers about match-fixing in football, criminal bookmakers' influence, and whether the KNVB's concerns warrant investigation. The minister answered that data is insufficient to judge the scale, that the sports sector and betting operators bear primary responsibility for prevention, and that existing criminal law suffices, with no concrete information yet of bribery in the Netherlands.
I do not have hard research data indicating how large the influence of criminal bookmakers in football is.
Ik beschik niet over harde onderzoeksgegevens die aangeven hoe groot de invloed is van criminele gokbazen in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over de uitzending “Undercover in Nederland”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice how easy it is to order hard drugs online, whether action has been taken before, and whether steps will follow after a television broadcast. The minister found this undesirable, announced a police quickscan to gauge the scale of online drug trade, and said the Public Prosecution Service acts where possible against online drug sales and the websites involved.
To this end, I will have a quickscan carried out by the police.
Ik laat daartoe een quickscan uitvoeren door de politie.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Dikkers over het ontbreken van een deugdelijk rampenplan bij TWO Chemical Logistics

Two PvdA MPs asked why TWO Chemical Logistics in Nijmegen reportedly lacks an adequate disaster plan and what inspections found. The minister reported 2011 Brzo and environmental inspections with remedial deadlines, and said the regional safety board aims to adopt an updated disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
The board of the Gelderland Zuid Safety Region aims to adopt the new disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
Het bestuur van de Veiligheidsregio Gelderland Zuid streeft naar vaststelling van het nieuwe rampbestrijdingsplan op 10 mei 2012.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Van Bemmel over het kwijtmaken van het archief van het Nationale Cyber Security Centrum

MPs Elissen and Van Bemmel asked whether Govcert/NCSC could no longer access its pre-2009 hacking incident records, whether SCADA systems had been hacked before 2009, and whether the archive handling complied with the Wob and Archiefwet. The minister replied that the pre-2009 records are accessible with extra effort, that the NCSC acted carefully and warned about SCADA risks, and that the Erfgoedinspectie found the archive sufficiently accessible under the Archiefwet.
The registration of incidents from before 2009 is accessible.
De registratie van incidenten van vóór 2009 is toegankelijk.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over 2578 onderschepte dode zeepaardjes op Schiphol

MP Hazekamp asked why a Peruvian woman caught with 2,578 dead seahorses at Schiphol paid only a fine, and questioned enforcement against wildlife trafficking and its deterrent effect. The minister answered that a €3,500 transaction was accepted per Openbaar Ministerie policy, that prison sentences are reserved for complex organised cases, and that a CITES-related pilot against organised wildlife crime will start in 2012.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that in this case a settlement of €3,500 was offered, which the suspect accepted.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat in dit geval een transactie is aangeboden van € 3500, die door verdachte is geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Helder over het bericht ‘Dader doodrijden Floor van der Wal vervroegd vrij’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that the driver who killed Floor van der Wal was released early, questioning the sentence's proportionality, a reported cultural motive, the decision not to appeal, how victims' families were informed, and the reintegration programme. The minister said the court weighed reckless driving and leaving the scene, that the OM dropped appeal because a manslaughter conviction was unlikely, that the family was informed, and that the detention-phasing rules will be changed and conflicting advice will be escalated.
It does not befit me to pass judgment on the height of a sentence imposed by the judge.
Het past mij niet een oordeel uit te spreken over de hoogte van een door de rechter opgelegde straf.
Antwoord vragen Bashir over heling van gestolen koper van ProRail

MP Bashir asked the ministers whether they would act against fencing of stolen copper from ProRail and whether railway scrap dealers could be summoned, and asked about measures against copper theft and alternatives to copper. The ministers said they were alarmed, pointed to a convenant and action group, listed prevention measures and planned steps, but declined to name the scrap dealers, citing journalistic source protection.
PowNews then indicated it did not want to provide that information, invoking the protection of journalistic sources.
PowNews heeft toen aangegeven die gegevens niet te willen verstrekken met een beroep op de bescherming van journalistieke bronnen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat Nederland de hoogste boetes heeft van Europa

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister whether Dutch traffic fines were raised to fill the state treasury, whether this relates to ending ticket quotas, and what evidence links higher fines to road safety. The minister replied that fines aim to improve compliance and road safety, cited WODC research showing deterrent effects, estimated extra revenue of about €70 million, and reported no clear discretionary shift among officers.
The increase in traffic fines is primarily intended to improve compliance with traffic rules.
De verhoging van de verkeersboetes is primair bedoeld om de naleving van de verkeersregels te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht dat de islamitische schaamtecultuur medepalend is voor de strafmaat

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the Justice minister whether the 'Islamic shame culture' should influence sentencing and whether incidents like refusing to stand for judges signal Islamisation of the judiciary. Minister Opstelten answered that sentencing considers case-specific circumstances proven to be relevant, not group membership, and that the isolated incidents do not show Islamisation.
These are special circumstances that must be shown to exist and be relevant in the specific case brought before the judge, and not something assumed in general for certain categories of suspects.

Het gaat hier om bijzondere omstandigheden waarvan moet worden aangetoond dat zij zich voordoen en relevant zijn in het specifieke geval dat aan de rechter is voorgelegd, en niet om iets dat in zijn algemeenheid wordt aangenomen voor bepaalde categorieën verdachten
Antwoord vragen Elissen over de gemeente Terneuzen die jarenlang een coffeeshop ondersteunde

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the municipality of Terneuzen, by supporting coffeeshop Checkpoint, took part in criminal acts, and what this means for other municipalities and coffeeshop policy. The minister answered that only the coffeeshop operator and staff are being prosecuted, that the courts judge the municipality and its officials, and that the Public Prosecution Service is appealing, so the implications cannot yet be stated.
It is for the judge to give a verdict on the conduct of the municipality and its administrators.
Het is aan de rechter om een oordeel te geven over het optreden door de gemeente en haar bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen Van Bommel over de uitzending “KRO reporter internationaal”

An SP MP asked three ministers about a KRO broadcast on Dutch private security contractors operating abroad, including the absence of registration of firearms incidents, screening of personnel, and liability for offences. The government replied that Dutch firms operating only abroad fall under the law of the host country, that MFA-contracted guards are screened by the AIVD and meet strict criteria, and that liability depends on the facts and host-country criminal law.
The principle that for security activities the law of the country of deployment, not of origin, applies, I consider logical and correct.
Het uitgangspunt dat voor het uitvoeren van beveiligingswerkzaamheden niet de wetgeving van het land van herkomst maar die van het land van inzet leidend is acht ik logisch en juist.
Antwoord vragen Bontes over tientallen vaders die jaarlijks vals beschuldigd worden door ex’en van misbruik of mishandeling

An MP asked the Justice Minister about dozens of fathers each year falsely accused of abuse by ex-partners, and why false reports by mothers are rarely prosecuted. The minister said false reports are prosecutable only when intent is provable, that the scale is unknown, and pointed to a public-prosecution policy of press statements and remedies in civil custody proceedings.
The Public Prosecution Service has no figures on this.
Bij het OM zijn hiervan geen aantallen bekend.
Antwoord vragen de leden Taverne, Hennis-Plasschaert, Van der Steur en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de wet zou wijken voor religieuze regels

Four VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice whether a reported court ruling in The Hague, that religious obligations could take precedence over statutory duties such as showing identification, accurately reflects the judgment and whether it has been appealed. The minister confirmed the press report matches the oral ruling, that an appeal has been lodged, and referred the question of general principle to answers given to other MPs' questions.
The ruling itself provides no basis for those consequences.
Daarvoor biedt de uitspraak zelf geen grondslag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over de uitspraak van een kantonrechter dat de religieuze plicht zwaarder weegt dan de plicht te voldoen aan de Nederlandse wet

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a cantonal court ruling that a religious duty outweighs the duty to obey Dutch law undermines the rule of law and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that everyone must obey Dutch law, exceptions exist only where the law provides them, interpretation is for the courts, and he will not comment further because the prosecution has appealed.
The Public Prosecution Service has lodged an appeal against the cantonal judge's ruling.
Het OM heeft beroep tegen de uitspraak van de kantonrechter ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de bevalling van een koe op Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about a pregnant cow that gave birth during export transport at Schiphol, whether pregnant animals should be exported given Schmallenberg virus, export and inspection statistics, and whether the NVWA investigation results will be shared. The state secretary answered that the transport met the rules, that a ban on pregnant animal exports would be disproportionate, that inspection statistics are provided, and that the Chamber will be informed of the investigation results depending on whether criminal steps follow.
Depending on whether the investigation leads to criminal steps, I will inform the Chamber of the results of the investigation.
Afhankelijk van het antwoord op de vraag of het onderzoek leidt tot strafrechtelijke stappen zal ik de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over het bericht ‘Londen boos op Europese Hof na uitspraak over radicale Aboe Katada’

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Foreign Affairs about the European Court of Human Rights ruling blocking the deportation of Abu Qatada to Jordan, including how many similar suspects are in the Netherlands and how Europe can avoid becoming a safe haven for extremists. The minister answered that only a very small number of such persons are in the Netherlands, explained the Court's reasoning (diplomatic assurances sufficient on Article 3, but a flagrant denial of justice risk under Article 6), and said the government will keep exploring options such as removal to third countries.
An exact number is not given in cases like these because of the nature of the files.
Een exact aantal wordt in gevallen als deze niet gegeven in verband met de aard van de dossiers.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over de veroordeling van twee directeuren van Eternit in Italië

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice whether he knew of the Italian conviction of two Eternit directors for asbestos deaths, how many deaths in the Netherlands are known, and whether a criminal investigation would follow in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed the conviction, said he has no data on deaths but referred to a letter and an asbestos victims institute report, and said the Public Prosecution Service decides on investigations and has no case known against Eternit.
The Public Prosecution Service determines in which cases there is reason to start a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie bepaalt in welke gevallen er aanleiding is een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman Identiteitsfraude op sociale media

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether identity theft on social media causes serious harm, what civil and criminal remedies victims have, and whether a new criminal offence of identity theft (proposed by Bénédicte Ficq) is needed. The Minister answered that existing civil remedies, platform abuse procedures and criminal provisions are sufficient, that a new offence would be hard to enforce given online anonymity and foreign-based platforms, and that he does not support the proposal.
In my expectation, no adequate solution can be expected from the use of criminal law to stop the use of another person's name on social media sites.
Naar mijn verwachting valt van de inzet van het strafrecht kortom geen adequate oplossing te verwachten om het gebruik van andermans naam op sociale mediasites te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen en Schouw over gebruik van andermans naam op sociale media

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of other people's names on social media, such as Twitter, and whether current law is adequate, including whether criminal prosecution should be possible and when it amounts to identity fraud. The minister confirmed awareness of the incidents and referred the MPs to earlier answers given to other MPs on the same subject.
I refer to my answer to the questions from member Kooiman of your House
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kooiman van uw Kamer
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over de Amerikaanse actie tegen Megaupload en de arrestatie van een Nederlander

MPs El Fassed and Dibi (GroenLinks) asked about the US shutdown of Megaupload, the arrest of a Dutch national, Dutch cooperation via mutual legal assistance requests, and the seizure of Dutch servers. The minister said Dutch cooperation rested on existing treaties, that the servers were seized at US request under a pending foreign investigation, and declined to disclose further details.
I cannot provide further information on the background of the seizure or the content of the servers, because this concerns an ongoing foreign investigation.
Over de achtergronden van de inbeslagname en over de inhoud van de servers kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen omdat het hier een lopend (buitenlands) onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de jacht op illegale werksters door de vreemdelingenpolitie

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether police hunting undocumented domestic workers based on ethnic appearance, and continuing after a court ruling, was lawful and why it was not stopped or compensated. Minister Leers answered that the police kept acting until the Council of State ruled, found no reason for a special compensation scheme, and said the victims can claim damages via the detention-related appeal route.
In doing so, the general profile relied on the physical features of part of the target group in a way that is not compatible with the applicable provisions.
Daarbij is bij het algemene signalement geleund op de uiterlijke kenmerken van een deel van de doelgroep op een wijze die zich niet verhoudt met de daarvoor geldende bepalingen.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over een aanhouding voor ontucht op een kinderdagverblijf in Vlissingen

MP Hamer asked the ministers about the arrest of a childcare worker in Vlissingen for suspected sexual abuse of a 3-year-old, the information given to parents, the investigation, and progress on childcare quality measures. Minister Kamp answered that details are withheld for the investigation, parents were informed through meetings, a helpline and letters, and the 'four-eyes principle' will be anchored in law.
In the interest of the investigation, it is not possible to make any statements about the content of the investigation that has since continued.
Het is in het belang van het onderzoek niet mogelijk om over de inhoud van het onderzoek dat sindsdien is voortgezet, mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over het onderwerp de uitlating van de Amsterdamse korpschef dat boerkadragers niet altijd beboet zullen gaan worden

An MP asks the ministers whether the Amsterdam police chief's remark that face-covering (boerka) wearers will not always be fined is acceptable, and whether he has taken note of the minister's pledge to enforce the ban loyally. The minister confirms awareness of the article, restates that police must always enforce the law, and states there is no doubt the police will enforce the ban once it takes effect.
The police must at all times enforce the law.
De politie dient te allen tijde de wet te handhaven.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen en Kuiken over het bericht dat ‘politie getraumatiseerde agenten in de steek laat’

MPs Berndsen and Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a RTL report that police forces do not recognise or treat officers' psychological trauma, including court cases against officers and differing approaches to PTSD as an occupational illness. The Minister said the report troubled him, pointed to the Professional Resilience programme, and said he has asked police forces to apply one nationally uniform approach based on objective medical criteria and the NCvB registration guideline, with a further study announced.
I have therefore asked the force managers to conform to the registration guideline of the Dutch Centre for Occupational Diseases (NCvB) on PTSD.
Ik heb de korpsbeheerders daarom verzocht om zich te conformeren aan de registratierichtlijn van het Nederlands Centrum voor Beroepsziekten (NCvB) betreffende PTSS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çörüz over de Wet Bibob

An MP asks the minister why a Bibob integrity screening of a coffeeshop operator did not lead to withdrawal of permits while police suspect illegal gambling, cannabis trade and money laundering, and whether Bibob screening and monitoring always apply. The state secretary declines to discuss the specific case citing the strict confidentiality of the Bibob Act, says screening is discretionary for municipalities, and promises to ask the Bibob quality commission to review the advice in its annual quality analysis.
To address any concerns arising from this case, I will ask the Bibob quality commission to examine the Bibob advice issued in this case.
Om tegemoet te komen aan eventuele zorgen naar aanleiding van deze casus zal ik de kwaliteitscommissie Bibob verzoeken om het Bibob-advies dat in deze casus is afgegeven te onderzoeken
Antwoord vragen Recourt over de voorlopige hechtenis van dhr.R.

MP Recourt asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the pre-trial detention of a man R., who has been held for over five years awaiting first-instance trial, and whether the answers will take that duration into account. State Secretary Teeven replies briefly that he is aware of the earlier questions and will take the five-year detention into account.
Will you take into account in answering these questions that R. has already been in pre-trial detention for more than five years pending his first-instance trial?
Wilt u bij de beantwoording van de vragen betrekken dat R. al meer dan vijf jaar in voorlopige hechtenis zit hangende zijn berechting in eerste aanleg?
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de onbeheersbaarheid van de populatie wilde zwijnen bij het Leenderbos door toedoen van jagers

An MP asked the state secretary whether hunters have made the wild boar population near Leenderbos uncontrollable, whether night hunting with artificial light breaches Benelux rules, and whether rivalry between hunters and farmers poses security risks, and asked about a provincial official's remark against joint hunting. The state secretary answered that the Benelux light-hunting ban does not apply to damage control for non-huntable species, that the province is responsible for management, that no armed conflict or threat exists, and that regional hunters are capable of contributing.
The province of Noord-Brabant is responsible for managing damage-causing species in the province.
Provincie Noord-Brabant is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van schadeveroorzakende soorten in de provincie.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman over de zoveelste gewelddadige straatroof in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren, Helder and Brinkman asked ministers about repeated violent street robberies in Utrecht, whether they still trusted Utrecht mayor Wolfsen, what measures would be taken against him, and whether heavy sentences and denaturalisation of dual nationals would largely solve the problem. The government replied that the municipal council judges mayoral performance, referred to earlier answers on youth groups, stated that repressive and preventive measures are both needed, left sentencing to judges, and said a bill is being prepared so that Dutch nationality lapses after a final conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years.
It is primarily for the municipal council to judge the functioning of a mayor.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om te oordelen over het functioneren van een burgemeester.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het bericht dat een vermeende stroper die een vergoeding heeft ontvangen van de gemeente Putten

An MP asked whether a suspected poacher acquitted over a bait trap with a dead deer and bird was truly cleared on legal grounds, whether the prosecution will appeal, and whether the municipal compensation sends a wrong signal. The minister answered that the case was dismissed on a prosecution drafting error (wrong statutory basis), not a substantive finding, that no appeal will be lodged, and that the compensation covered legal costs rather than the bait use.
An error was made when drafting the summons.
Bij het opstellen van de dagvaarding is een fout gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Leijten over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op de GGZ voor de politie

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked whether cuts to mental health care (GGZ) and the introduction of patient contributions would increase police workload and crime, and whether such effects will be monitored and registered. The ministers answer that a monitor will track whether patient charges deter care use, that the police and GGZ have agreed new cooperation arrangements, and that registration of GGZ-related nuisance is only partly in place and will be developed regionally.
Whether the introduction of the patient contribution actually leads to avoidance of care will be closely monitored by the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport via a monitor this year.
Of de invoering van de eigen bijdrage daadwerkelijk leidt tot zorgmijding volgt de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport dit jaar nauwlettend via een monitor.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch over een vuurwerkverbod

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a possible ban on private fireworks, citing news reports, a No Ties poll and enforcement costs. The minister declines to pursue a total ban for now, calls the No Ties poll less representative than a 2008 TNS NIPO study, and notes municipalities can only designate specific no-fireworks zones.
The No Ties research is, as far as I can tell, more limited in design, and I therefore consider it less representative.
Het onderzoek van onderzoeksbureau No Ties is voor zover ik na kan gaan beperkter van opzet en acht ik daardoor minder representatief.
Antwoord vragen Ormel over een vrijwillig wetenschappelijk moratorium van 60 dagen op onderzoek naar levensgevaarlijk vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a voluntary 60-day scientific moratorium on research into H5N1 bird flu virus, the planned international forum, publication safeguards, licensing of other potentially dangerous micro-organisms, and bioterrorism risk oversight. The minister answered that the government supports the WHO-facilitated international discussion, that transparency on licensed projects is limited for state security reasons, and that a body to review risks is under consideration, with a letter to follow.
Precisely in the interest of state security, no public overview of those projects can be given.
Juist in het belang van de staatsveiligheid kan er geen openbaar overzicht van die projecten worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Turkse moslimextremist asiel heeft aangevraagd in Nederland

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about a Turkish national seeking asylum despite a Turkish conviction, and about the number of asylum seekers excluded under Article 1F of the Refugee Convention who remain in the Netherlands. Minister Leers answered that extradition is pending, that about 810 people have had 1F applied, around 240 are still in the country (about 200 for over ten years), and that no clear solution is planned for those who cannot be removed.
At this stage I do not consider it appropriate to provide information about the sentence imposed or the facts stated in the extradition request.
Ik acht het in dit stadium niet dienstig om mededelingen te doen over de opgelegde straf of over de feiten die in het uitleveringsverzoek worden genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij, Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Ormel over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether a British cleric known for antisemitic and misogynistic statements, invited to a VU symposium, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The government answered that it had examined an entry ban but found the statements insufficient grounds under EU free-movement rules, which require a current, genuine and serious threat to public order.
The objectionable statements, however, are insufficient indication that such a danger exists.
De verwerpelijke uitspraken zijn echter onvoldoende aanwijzing dat een dergelijk gevaar aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over de nieuwe veelpleger

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about reports of a 'new repeat offender', the role of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond police chief, juvenile criminal law for 12-year-olds, and ethnic overrepresentation in crime statistics. The minister answered that the term distinguishes younger, more violent offenders from the 'old' repeat offender, that existing juvenile law suffices for 12-year-olds, and that all offenders should be prosecuted regardless of origin.
The cabinet is making a strong effort to reduce boundary-crossing behaviour among at-risk young people, individually and in groups.
Het kabinet zet stevig in op het terugdringen van grensoverschrijdend gedrag van risicojongeren, individueel en in groepen.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen over de beslissing van de rechter dat het dienstwapen van de politie opnieuw moet worden aanbesteed

Berndsen (D66) asks why the minister did not hold a fresh tender after cancelling the SIG-Sauer contract, and about the cost, budget, safety and timing consequences of the court ordering a new tender for the police service pistol. The minister answers that returning to the earlier tender was the fastest option, that the court ruled it a new contract, that a new tender takes 12 to 18 months at extra cost of roughly 3 to 4 million euro, and that existing pistols are maintained through periodic inspection and spare parts.
Returning to the result of the earlier tender procedure and to the second-ranked bidder appeared the fastest option and seemed, based on case law, well defensible.

Het teruggaan naar het aanbestedingsresultaat van de eerder afgesloten aanbestedingsprocedure en naar de als nummer twee geëindigde inschrijver bleek de snelste optie en leek op basis van de jurisprudentie goed verdedigbaar.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Van Dekken over de vertraging en het nut van een Nationaal Noodnet voor communicatie bij rampen

Marcouch and Van Dekken (PvdA) asked why the Nationaal Noodnet replacement for disaster communication is delayed and whether it is useful. Minister Opstelten answered that migration to the NCV is slower than expected because users are reconsidering, the old network still functions, the NCV has extra functions, and the government will not terminate the KPN contract.

In line with the commitment made during the consultation of 8 February 2012 on the amendment of the Safety Regions Act, I will inform the House further about the management, monitoring and execution of various ICT projects.

Conform de toezegging tijdens het overleg van 8 februari 2012 inzake de wijziging van wet Veiligheidsregio's, in verband met de oprichting van het Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid, zal ik u de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over het beheer de monitoring en de uitvoering van verschillende ICT-projecten.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Brinkman over het artikel “Man steekt twee agenten in gezicht”

MPs Brinkman and Helder asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a case in which a man stabbed two police officers in the face and headbutted a third, and asked whether the offender would stay in custody, receive a prison sentence rather than a community service order, and how prosecutors and judges would be pressed to punish such attacks harshly. The minister confirmed the facts, said the suspect remains in custody with a 90-day extension though the trial date is unknown, pointed to higher prosecution demands and a planned Raad voor de rechtspraak study for 2011 data, and declined to guarantee a prison sentence or abolish community service as a main penalty.
I have promised your House to send the results of this study before summer 2012.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd de resultaten van dit onderzoek voor de zomer van 2012 toe te zenden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Steur over de ongelijke behandeling van ouders die zich niet houden aan de omgangsregeling

An MP asked whether the criminal provision on unlawful removal of a minor (art. 279 Sr) creates unequal treatment between parents who fail to honour a custody/visitation arrangement, and whether the law should be equalised. The minister answered that both parents exercising joint custody can be prosecuted under art. 279 Sr, so no inequality exists, but justice intervention in visitation disputes should remain strictly limited.

From the answer to question 2 it appears that both the parent who has care and the parent who does not have care can be prosecuted under article 279 Sr if both exercise parental authority over the child.

Uit het antwoord op vraag 2 blijkt dat zowel de ouder die de zorg heeft als de ouder die de zorg niet heeft, kunnen worden vervolgd ter zake van artikel 279 Sr indien zij beiden het ouderlijk gezag over het kind uitoefenen.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman, Helder en Van Klaveren over slechts een taakstrafje na mishandeling van een agent

PVV MPs Brinkman, Helder and Van Klaveren asked why a community sentence was imposed for assaulting a police officer, whether such sentences undermine public trust, and whether the community sentence should be removed from the Criminal Code and denaturalisation used. Minister Opstelten said the prosecution regrets not demanding a partly unconditional prison term and has appealed, that the cabinet wants to keep the community sentence but restrict it for serious violent crimes, and that a bill on loss of Dutch nationality for serious offences is in preparation.
Following this case, the prosecution leadership spoke with all officials involved to learn lessons from this case.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus heeft de parketleiding gesproken met alle betrokken functionarissen om uit deze casus lering te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over malafide verhuurmakelaars

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they support a private certification mark for rental brokers, whether it should be made mandatory, and whether a national licensing requirement for rental brokers would help sanction malpractice. The minister supports voluntary quality measures but sees no reason to make a certificate mandatory, and rejects reinstating a state licensing requirement as it would conflict with the policy of a compact government; rental owners remain responsible for their own tenant selection and can hold brokers liable.
However, I see no reason to make a certificate mandatory, so that the certificate or one of the certificates becomes a establishment requirement for brokers.
Ik zie echter geen reden voor het verplicht stellen van een keurmerk, zodat het keurmerk of een van de keurmerken een vestigingsverplichting wordt voor makelaars.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Kuiken over het geven van een taakstraf na mishandeling agent

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why a Utrecht man who struck a police officer received a partly suspended 40-hour community service sentence, and whether the prosecution's demand was adequate. The minister said the prosecution had itself judged a partly unconditional prison sentence more appropriate, that it has appealed, and that a local group-based approach to the Terwijde neighbourhood is underway.
On reflection, according to the Public Prosecution Service, demanding a (partly) unconditional prison sentence would have been appropriate.
Bij nader inzien had volgens het Openbaar Ministerie het eisen van een (deels) onvoorwaardelijke gevangenisstraf in de rede gelegen.
Antwoord vragen Helder over het bericht ‘Agent mikpunt oudejaarsgeweld’

An MP asks the minister about reports of violent attacks on police during New Year's Eve 2011–2012, including molotov cocktails and pepper spray, and whether preparing molotov cocktails constitutes a serious crime, attempted manslaughter, or terrorism warranting pretrial detention. The state secretary answers by referring to an earlier letter, explaining the legal framework (art. 46, 157, 287, 289, 83 Sr, arts. 67/67a Sv) and leaving the assessment of specific facts to the Public Prosecution Service and courts.

Whether in a concrete case preparing molotov cocktails is punishable preparation of a serious crime depends on the circumstances and is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the criminal court to assess.

Of in een concrete casus het klaarmaken van molotovcocktails een strafbare voorbereiding van een ernstig misdrijf is, hangt af van de omstandigheden van het geval en staat ter beoordeling van het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de strafrechter.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het FD-bericht 'Klimaateconoom: opwarming kan leiden tot een nieuwe kredietcrisis'

An MP asked the ministers how climate damage affects financial stability in Europe, whether the government will act further, and how insurance premiums and Dutch climate finance are affected. The government answered that DNB and the ECB supervise climate-related financial risks, that current measures are sufficient to address these risks, and that it already contributes to clean electricity in developing countries.
The cabinet believes that appropriate mitigation and adaptation measures are necessary.
Het kabinet vindt dat passende mitigatie- en adaptatiemaatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de afhankelijkheid van de financiële sector van Amerikaanse techgiganten

An MP asked the government about the financial sector's dependence on American tech giants, including DNB and AFM warnings, scenario analysis, European coordination, and procurement exclusion. The minister acknowledged the risks, pointed to DORA, the vifo screening law, EU-level digital autonomy efforts and cloud policy, but said procurement exclusion of non-European firms is constrained by non-discrimination rules and the cloud policy review is delayed.
I will discuss with the supervisors how we can follow up on the recommendations.
Ik ga met de toezichthouders in gesprek hoe we opvolging kunnen geven aan de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het NGT-voorstel naar aanleiding van het Argos artikel

An MP asks the agriculture and economic affairs ministers about Dutch lobbying to loosen EU rules on new genomic techniques (NGT) after an Argos report, including whether the parliamentary motion against patents on NGT traits was respected in trilogue negotiations and whether small breeders' concerns were given priority. The Staatssecretaris answers that the Dutch government is not directly in the trilogues, that it pursued the motion's aim of avoiding patent blockades and transparency, that patent issues have only been discussed exploratively, and that the Raad agreement is a fair compromise on labelling, choice and patents, while promising to inform parliament before votes.
I always inform the House about votes in the Agriculture and Fisheries Council via the annotated agenda, and I will continue to do so.
Ik informeer uw Kamer altijd over stemmingen in de Landbouw- en Visserij Raad middels de geannoteerde agenda, dit zal ik blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over de sluiting van fabriek Fibrant op Chemelot

Wingelaar asked the government about the planned closure of Fibrant's caprolactam plants at Chemelot, the subsidies Fibrant received, effects on the cluster, and past closures. The minister responded that the decision is not yet final, that the government is in close contact with the company and province and is pursuing a plan for the cluster, and that it cannot yet say whether subsidies would be reclaimed.
At this moment, however, it is premature to speak of a definitive decision.
Het is op dit moment echter te voorbarig om te spreken over een definitief besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Postma en Saris over de teloorgang van de iconische fietsenfabriek Batavus in Heerenveen en nieuwe kansen voor de maakindustrie

Three NSC MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the relocation of Batavus bicycle production from Heerenveen to Hungary, job losses, private equity motives, Hungarian industrial policy and state aid, and possible national programmes to keep manufacturing in the Netherlands. The minister replied that the move is a company decision within Accell's transformation programme, that the government cannot prevent it, had no direct contact with Accell, and that no new national programme is currently needed.
This concerns a company decision by the company itself, in which the government has no formal role and which cannot be stopped.
Het betreft een ondernemingsbeslissing van het bedrijf zelf, waarin de overheid geen formele rol heeft en die niet kan worden tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het mijnbouwbedrijf dat sneller wil beginnen met het mijnen in de Stille Oceaan

MP Teunissen asked the government about commercial deep-sea mining plans in the Clarion Clipperton Zone, the ecological risks, Dutch involvement (Allseas), sanctions for unlicensed mining, and critical metals supply. The government answered that the science is not yet sufficient, that Dutch involvement is not known beyond Allseas which it cannot comment on individually, that it opposes licences before a mining code exists, and that it has discussed the integrity of UNCLOS with Allseas without committing to specific sanctions.
Of course, the cabinet will, should developments give rise to it, consider possible steps to take, within the framework of the Authority.
Uiteraard zal het kabinet zich, wanneer de ontwikkelingen daar aanleiding toe geven, beraden op eventuele te nemen stappen, binnen de kaders van de Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Idsinga over het behoud en exploitatie van de bruine vloot

MPs Van Vroonhoven and Idsinga asked about the preservation and commercial viability of the historic brown fleet (bruine vloot), including support for safety and sustainability upgrades and recognition as heritage. The minister acknowledged the sector's value and its safety and environmental pressures, but said the government supports it only through the Regio Deal, declined to revive the NBTC storylines or involve provinces and municipalities further, and found further exploration of UNESCO heritage status unnecessary.
No. The storylines are no longer applied.
Nee. De verhaallijnen worden niet langer toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verouden over de berichtgeving van de ACM dat boodschappen in Nederlandse supermarkten duurder zijn dan in omringende landen

MP Verouden asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about the ACM investigation into higher supermarket prices than in neighbouring countries, including territorial supply restrictions, market concentration, and whether New Competition Tool-style monitoring is desirable. Minister Karremans answered that the ACM investigates independently, that the government is pushing for EU action on territorial supply restrictions, is exploring a New Competition Tool with a letter to follow, and that Dutch food prices were below the EU and eurozone averages in 2023.
The ACM, as an independent supervisor, carries out the investigation independently. The ministry plays no role in it.
De ACM voert als onafhankelijke toezichthouder het onderzoek zelfstandig uit. Het ministerie speelt daarin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel ‘Economic sanctions now the EU is Israel’s largest investor

An MP asks the government about a SOMO article claiming the Netherlands is Israel's largest investor and about possible national economic sanctions, a review of the tax treaty and suspension of the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister says Dutch direct investment in Israel is largely foreign capital routed through the Netherlands, that the government favours EU-level action but is pursuing national measures such as discouraging activity in settlements, and that it is not yet suspending the tax treaty.
The government has limited influence on this.
Het kabinet heeft hierop beperkte invloed.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Bikkers over de artikelen ‘Picnic en Flink vallen onder supermarkt-cao, zegt rechter’ van RTL-nieuws en ‘Online-supermarkten krijgen bijval van ACM in discussie rond cao

MPs Martens-America and Bikkers asked whether the government will act on court and ACM signals that online supermarkets Picnic and Flink fall under the supermarket collective labour agreement, and whether the AVV and dispensation framework needs updating for innovative firms. The minister says he is reviewing the cao and AVV system, will not comment on the pending dispensation request, and points to existing dispensation criteria while promising a fuller update after the summer.
The dispensation request is currently being handled by me.
Momenteel is het dispensatieverzoek bij mij in behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de bezorgtijden van PostNL in relatie tot de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen

MP Sneller asked how PostNL's move to 48-hour delivery for letter post affects the upcoming Tweede Kamer election, including delivery of voter cards and postal votes, and whether the five-day deadline for requesting replacement voter cards is still adequate. The minister replies that the 48-hour standard applies only to universal postal service mail, not election mail, which is governed by contracts with PostNL, and that the new rule does not take effect until July 2026; the government stresses timely delivery, asks municipalities to use alternative couriers for late replacement cards, and says the replacement-card deadlines will be examined in the candidate-nomination bill.
That is why I earlier indicated that I would examine the Electoral Act deadlines for delivering voting documents and include them in the bill on the candidate nomination procedure.
Daarom heb ik eerder aangegeven de termijnen in de Kieswet voor de bezorging van stembescheiden te onderzoeken en te betrekken bij het wetsvoorstel over de kandidaatstellingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Verkuijlen en Kisteman over de storing bij de radiosystemen van de Kustwacht op 1 juli jl.

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a July 2025 radio system failure at the Kustwacht, its cause, whether lives were endangered, its link to the 2024 NAFIN outage, backup and cyber protection. The government answered that the radio systems are operational again, the cause was investigated with measures taken, no critical situations arose, but it withheld details on cyber protection for security reasons and gave limited detail on the causes.
For security reasons I cannot go into this any further.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik hierop verder niet ingaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Dobbe over de eerdere beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in religieuze context

MPs Becker and Dobbe asked about the effectiveness of border indicators, awareness campaigns, training and follow-up on female genital mutilation risks at Schiphol, and the status of related programmes and research. The government answered that indicators and training are in place, the Marechaussee sees no need for evaluation or stronger controls, campaigns ran with reach figures but no formal evaluation, and a comparative study on preventive protection orders is expected before summer 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het RIVM-advies om geen particuliere eieren meer te eten

MP Flach (SGP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Agriculture about the RIVM advice to stop eating eggs from backyard hens, why locational factors and the English-only report were not examined or published in Dutch, and what keepers can do to reduce PFAS uptake. The government answered that the wider investigation into PFAS sources is ongoing, that findings on bio-accumulation via worms and housing options are expected by year end, and that a Dutch public summary will follow later this year.
The RIVM report is part of a longer-running investigation aimed at identifying the sources of elevated PFAS levels in eggs.
Het RIVM-rapport is onderdeel van een langer lopend onderzoekstraject met als doel de bronnen van verhoogde PFAS-gehaltes in eieren te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht “Lokale wielrenners balen van afgelast NK wielrennen”

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether sports events, including the NK wielrennen, are being cancelled due to police capacity shortages linked to the NATO summit, and about police deployment data and protocols for small events. The minister answered that local authorities decide on event permits, no national figures are kept, and no protocol is planned, while pointing to burgermotorverkeersregelaars as an alternative.
There is no overview of the number of sports events that cannot proceed due to a lack of police capacity.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal sportevenementen dat niet kan doorgaan wegens een gebrek aan politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over artiesten en concert-/festivalgangers met een beperking

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Health, Welfare and Sport about the accessibility of concerts, festivals and theatre for artists and audiences with disabilities, referring to a manifesto, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and shortages of accessible seating and sign-language interpreters. The minister acknowledges remaining gaps but states that the cultural sector itself is primarily responsible, that the ministry sets frameworks and funds initiatives such as the Routekaart Toegankelijke Festivals and a planned Kennispunt Toegankelijke Cultuur, and that a work agenda on the UN Convention will be sent to Parliament.
The ministry takes its responsibility by setting preconditions and creating frameworks.
Het ministerie neemt zijn verantwoordelijkheid door randvoorwaarden te stellen en kaders te scheppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de uitsluiting van het Afghaanse vrouwen voetbalelftal van de kwalificatie voor het WK door de Taliban

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government would press FIFA to recognise and finance the Afghan women's football team excluded by the Taliban from World Cup qualifiers, and how it viewed the erosion of women's rights in Afghanistan. The government condemned the systematic repression of Afghan women, said it would not interfere in FIFA's decision-making, and noted that the timing of FIFA's plan for Afghan players was unknown.
However, the cabinet is not responsible for the decision-making or policy of FIFA.
Het kabinet gaat echter niet over de besluitvorming of het beleid van de FIFA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ruim honderd vrouwen met spiraaltje van Ballerine tóch zwanger, gros klachten niet gemeld bij inspectie'

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that over a hundred women with a Ballerine IUD became pregnant and that most complaints were not reported to the inspectorate, asking about information, certification, reporting and oversight. The minister answered that the EU certification system functioned adequately, that the 2021 IGJ review found no need for further action, and that she will explore a clearer reporting structure for users and providers.

I want to look into how I can arrive at as clear a reporting structure as possible for users and healthcare providers, so that they always know where to go for complaints and side effects of medical devices.

Ik wil kijken hoe ik tot een zo helder mogelijke meldstructuur kan komen voor gebruikers en zorgverleners, zodat zij altijd weten waar zij terecht kunnen voor klachten en bijwerkingen bij medische hulpmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Westerveld over het beboeten van dakloze mensen

MPs Beckerman and Westerveld asked why municipalities still fine homeless people for sleeping rough, begging and camping, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary agrees fines worsen homelessness, says municipalities set these rules under their own powers, and says talks with the VNG about alternatives are ongoing.
Municipal councils have, however, under Article 147 of the Municipalities Act, the power to adopt bylaws that they consider necessary in the interest of the municipality.
Gemeenteraden hebben echter op grond van artikel 147 Gemeentewet de bevoegdheid om verordeningen vast te stellen, die zij in het belang van de gemeente nodig achten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Veerle (27) wil nooit meer een spiraaltje zonder verdoving: ‘Deze pijn is het niet waard’'

An MP asks the health minister and state secretary about reports that women experience severe pain when a coil is inserted without anaesthesia, and about options such as cervical spray, guidance and information. The government says it is aware of the concerns, refers pain management decisions to clinicians, notes NHG guideline revision and existing information channels, and declines to take further concrete steps beyond what it already committed to.
At the same time, the Minister of VWS is not responsible for how healthcare providers deliver care, insofar as medical-substantive considerations are concerned.
Tegelijkertijd gaat de Minister van VWS niet over de manier waarop zorgverleners zorg verlenen, voor zover het medisch-inhoudelijke overwegingen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er op een derde van de mbo’s sport- en beweeglessen geen structureel onderdeel van het curriculum zijn

MP Van Nispen asked about a report finding that sport and movement lessons are not a structural part of the curriculum at a third of mbo schools, and about barriers such as accommodation, timetables and funding. The state secretary replied that vocational schools themselves decide how to organise movement education, pointed to voluntary tools and programmes such as TestJeLeefstijl, the Gezonde School approach and quality funds, and said there is no statutory hours norm in vocational education.
It is up to the vocational schools themselves whether and how they organise movement education.
Het is aan mbo-instellingen zelf of en hoe zij bewegingsonderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Korte over het NIVEL rapport over oversterfte

Two MPs (Omtzigt and De Korte) asked the state secretary for health about cancer and other cause-specific mortality risks after COVID-19 vaccination, and why unvaccinated groups had much higher excess mortality in a NIVEL report. The state secretary answered that the requested probability tables cannot be built from the report, which describes cause-of-death distributions, and declined new research on cost and priority grounds, while explaining the healthy-vaccinee effect and the small size of the unvaccinated groups.
A table with this content cannot be constructed from the indicated tables in the report.
Een tabel met deze inhoud is niet te construeren uit de aangegeven tabellen in het rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Wilders en Blaauw over de benoeming van de ambassadeurs van de vrijheid door het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

MPs Boon, Wilders and Blaauw asked whether the National Committee 4 and 5 May's choice of Freedom Ambassadors, including a performer alleged to have joined an antisemitic fundraiser, was acceptable and whether the government would intervene. The State Secretary answered that the Committee is independent, that the selection process was careful, and that the government respects its choices and will not intervene.
The National Committee 4 and 5 May is independent and independently determines how the National Commemoration on 4 May and Liberation Day on 5 May are shaped.
Het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelfstandig hoe de Nationale Herdenking op 4 mei en Bevrijdingsdag op 5 mei worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht ‘‘Den Haag laat kinderen op straat slapen’, woede over beperken opvang van dakloze gezinnen’

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked about The Hague's decision to restrict shelter for non-entitled homeless families, and whether it conflicts with children's rights and national homelessness ambitions. The State Secretary replied that municipalities are responsible for solutions, that the ambition of no children on the street is essential, and that the government is mapping homeless families and discussing regional housing measures.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to arrive at appropriate solutions for (threatened) homeless persons, including cases involving minor children.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te komen tot passende oplossingen voor (dreigend) dakloze personen, inclusief gevallen waar dat minderjarige kinderen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat bij GGZ Veenendaal het omzetplafond van Zilveren Kruis/Achmea al in januari bereikt is

An SP MP asked the government to respond to reports that GGZ Veenendaal reached Zilveren Kruis/Achmea's revenue cap in January, leaving insured patients without access to mental health care for most of the year, and whether the government would hold the insurer to account. The State Secretary answered that insurers remain bound by the duty of care and must mediate patients to other providers, that the NZa supervises this duty, and that the government is considering broader measures to improve mental health care access, with a letter to parliament expected.
It is not for me to call an health insurer to account for its duty of care. The NZa independently supervises health insurers' duty of care.
Het is niet aan mij om een zorgverzekeraar aan te spreken op hun zorgplicht. De NZa houdt onafhankelijk toezicht op de zorgplicht van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht dat de genderpoli van het Amsterdam UMC voorlopig geen nieuwe volwassenen in behandeling neemt vanwege overbelasting

MPs Westerveld and Slagt-Tichelman asked about reports that the Amsterdam UMC gender clinic stopped inviting new adult patients for intake due to overload, the long waiting times, staff shortages, the state's efforts to address them, and whether patients are being pushed abroad in breach of the duty of care. The minister confirms the pause for adults, says waiting times cannot be predicted, points to a coordinating platform, extra funding for mental health care and the duty of insurers, and says the revised quality standard is due in September 2025.
It is not possible to say anything about the overall duration of the waiting time.
Het is niet mogelijk om een uitspraak te doen over de algehele duur van de wachttijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel 'Kinderrechten en de toetsende taak van de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming'

An MP asks the Minister and State Secretaries whether the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, a government advisory body, should be stripped of its review role over non-extension of child protection measures in favour of an independent children's judge, citing ECHR Article 6 and a Dutch Juristenblad article. The State Secretary answers that the RvdK's review is lawful and independent, that the judge decides on extensions, that children are heard where possible, and that the current arrangement is not to be changed.
In case of doubt about the existence of grounds for extension, this can be submitted, with the final decision reserved for the judge.
Bij twijfel over het bestaan van gronden voor de verlenging, kan dit worden voorgelegd, waarbij het uiteindelijke besluit is voorbehouden aan de rechter.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van der Wal over uitvoering van de motie Van der Wal en Mohandis en eerder onbeantwoorde schriftelijke vragen over de bevrijdingsfestivals in het kader van 80 jaar vrijheid

MPs Mohandis and Van der Wal asked whether the government would fund Bevrijdingsfestivals in 2025 through a guarantee scheme, given a Chamber-adopted motion. The state secretary replied that interdepartmental talks ended with a one-off, final contribution of EUR 700,000 for 2025 but explained that a guarantee scheme would imply a structural relationship the government does not intend.
The cabinet, however, sees the contribution as incidental.
Het kabinet ziet de bijdrage echter als incidenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kathmann over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdiensten

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked about the digital accessibility of government services, citing a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report and raising issues such as the non-compliance of many public websites, IDO funding, accessibility in healthcare and education, and emergency services. The State Secretary responded that the government is working on a work agenda, accessibility standards, a planned 2028 deadline, and reform of IDO financing, while acknowledging compliance is too low but declining to commit to sanctions for now.
The Ministry of BZK considers the number of government websites and apps that meet the legal requirement to be too low.
Het Ministerie van BZK vindt het aantal overheidswebsites en -apps die aan de wettelijke verplichting voldoen te laag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Geweld, intimidatie en homofobie – hoe Feyenoord zijn meest gevreesde hooligans dichtbij houdt’

MPs Van den Hil and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that Feyenoord keeps its most feared hooligans close, including stadium-ban evasion and possession of stadium keys, and about how bans are enforced nationally. The State Secretary replied that the government leaves local enforcement to the mayor and the local OM-police triangle, offered help if requested, pointed to national programmes and bodies, and said the stadium-key claim was not confirmed while giving ban and enforcement statistics.
It is not appropriate for the national government to intervene here, but if the local authority wishes, I am willing to offer my help.
Het past niet dat de landelijke overheid hier in treedt, maar als het lokale gezag daar prijs op stelt, dan ben ik bereid mijn hulp aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de brief van de NORTH group

An MP from FVD asks the Minister-President and the State Secretary for Health about a NORTH group letter claiming COVID-19 mRNA vaccines were never tested for stopping transmission, caused excessive serious adverse effects and deaths, contained residual plasmid DNA, and asks whether the vaccines should be halted, recalled, independently investigated, and whether there is proof that human DNA cannot be harmed. The State Secretary answers that the vaccine policy rests on independent advice, refers to earlier answers, rejects stopping or recalling the vaccines and extra investigation, rejects the DNA claims, and explains why the vaccines cannot alter human DNA.
I see no reason to commission additional research into the manner of approval and use of COVID-19 vaccines.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om extra onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de wijze van goedkeuring en het gebruik van COVID-19-vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de effectiviteit van medische genderbehandelingen bij kinderen

An SGP MP asked the government about the effectiveness of gender-affirming medical treatment for minors, citing an Amsterdam academic article questioning how such effectiveness should be judged, and asked how this fits with passende zorg criteria and the Zorgverzekeringswet. Minister Agema answered that treatment follows careful psychological evaluation and monitoring, that the Gezondheidsraad is advising on the matter, that coverage follows the 'stand van de wetenschap en praktijk' criterion, and that Zorginstituut work on the scope of transgender care is ongoing without a fixed end date.
It is legally stipulated that all insured care under the Health Insurance Act must meet the criterion of 'the state of science and practice'.
Het is wettelijk bepaald dat alle te verzekeren zorg in de Zorgverzekeringswet dient te voldoen aan het criterium « de stand van de wetenschap en praktijk ».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Slagt- Tichelman over de financiering van de bevrijdingsfestivals

MPs Mohandis and Slagt-Tichelman asked whether the government will keep financially supporting the Dutch liberation festivals, which are at risk, and about the status of a broad future vision for 5 May. State Secretary Karremans answers that the national committee receives structural funding, that one-off direct aid was given in 2024 and no structural state guarantee is provided, and that talks with other ministries on a final one-off contribution are ongoing.
I have at least reserved budgetary space for a one-off contribution from VWS in 2025.
Ik heb in ieder geval budgettaire ruimte gereserveerd voor een incidentele bijdrage vanuit VWS in 2025.
