Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over het bericht dat de Campagne van Platform Zorg voor Leven geweerd is vanwege “te veel negatief commentaar”

MPs Van Dijk and Bikker asked whether the government considers it acceptable that schools and education bodies refused an anti-abortion campaign from Platform Zorg voor Leven that was not in conflict with advertising rules, and how students are informed about alternatives to abortion. The State Secretary said schools decide their own advertising and curricula under constitutional autonomy, pointed to existing sexual education, counselling and information services, and did not commit to any new action.
Schools and educational institutions themselves determine how they shape their education.
Scholen en onderwijsinstellingen bepalen zelf hoe zij hun onderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Slagt-Tichelman over wachtlijsten voor genderzorg

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about waiting lists for gender care after the Mutsaersstichting restricted its gender care to Limburg, and whether budget cuts and service gaps would be addressed. The state secretary answered that gemeenten are responsible for youth gender care, national waiting-time data are not kept, the Mutsaersstichting has a continuity plan with added municipal and subsidy funding, and a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg is being set up with a work agenda expected in early 2025.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including gender care. Figures on the number of waiting lists and average waiting times are therefore not kept nationally.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, dus ook genderzorg. Cijfers over aantallen wachttijden en gemiddelde wachttijden worden daarom niet landelijk bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht dat vier op de tien vrouwen die abortus kiest niet deed aan anticonceptie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a report that 41% of women undergoing abortion had not used contraception, and about contraception access, sex education, support for pregnant women and wait lists. The State Secretary answered that the findings are not surprising, outlined existing sex-education and contraception programmes, said no extra policy on affordable contraception is needed, and promised a new approach to unintended pregnancy in spring 2025.
So I cannot say whether waiting times for this specific form of supervised housing have risen nationally.
Ik kan dus niet aangeven of wachttijden voor deze specifieke vorm van woonplekken met begeleiding landelijk gestegen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bushoff over het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis en de gevolgen voor ggz-patiënten

MPs Westerveld and Bushoff asked about the disappearance of restitution policies for mental health care and the effects on patients, including waiting lists and contracting. The minister answered that insurers may replace these policies with in-kind combination policies with a one-year transition period, and that insurers' own decisions and contracting are outside her direct control while the NZa supervises the duty of care.
However, it is not for me to change this decision by health insurers; health insurers themselves determine which policies they offer and which they do not.
Het is echter niet aan mij om iets aan dit besluit van zorgverzekeraars te veranderen; zorgverzekeraars bepalen zelf welke polissen zij aanbieden en welke niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over de politiecapaciteit voor de begeleiding van wielerwedstrijden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk asked about the status of a motion on keeping cycling races going, the timing of an Antea Group study on volunteer motorcycle traffic controllers, and the effect of reduced police capacity around the 2025 NATO summit. The Staatssecretaris replied that the study is finished and will be shared soon with a letter on how its findings will be followed up, that local mayors decide on permits, and that police cannot guarantee escort for races from January to August 2025 except possibly a limited selection.
The Antea Group study will be shared with your House as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek van Antea Group wordt zo spoedig mogelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Psychiater Boudewijn Chabot introduceert eigen stikstofgasmethode voor mensen die humaan willen sterven'

An MP asked the government about a psychiatrist's film promoting nitrogen gas as a self-death method and media and cultural responsibility. The state secretary condemned the film as dangerous, said prosecution is for the OM and courts, and refused to ban it on free-expression grounds while pointing to existing media guidelines.
Taking measures to restrict in advance the publication of interviews and films about suicide is, however, not desirable in my view because it is disproportionate.
Het nemen van maatregelen door op voorhand de publicatie van interviews en films over zelfdoding te beperken, acht ik echter niet wenselijk omdat het disproportioneel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe en Westerveld over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the State Secretary whether budget caps imposed by health insurers on Pro Persona mental health care are effective, why the minister cites treatment-norm safeguards that are often breached, and what the effects of such caps are on patients served and on access. The State Secretary answered that caps help insurers allocate scarce staff, that safeguards exist but are insufficiently effective, that the NZa is monitoring insurers' duty of care, and that no detailed effect data exist, while committing to further measures and talks with the affected client councils.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht dat er voor het eerst iemand stierf in een zelfdodingsmachine

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a suicide capsule reportedly built in the Netherlands and used in Switzerland is lawful, whether its builder needs a patent or permit, whether it can be exported, and whether the government will act against its designer. The minister said the Swiss criminal investigation is ongoing and that the prosecutor (OM) decides on prosecution independently, declining to consult the OM, while stating that export and patenting face no obstacle and that suicide prevention policy continues.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to make this assessment independently and without political interference.
Het is aan het OM om deze beoordeling eigenstandig en zonder politieke inmenging te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the state secretary about budget caps imposed on Pro Persona GGZ by health insurers and whether this conflicts with insurers' duty of care amid long mental health waiting lists. The state secretary says caps are a legitimate tool for allocating scarce capacity, insurers retain a duty of care and must refer patients elsewhere, and he is discussing improvements with the sector without intervening in contracts.
Making agreements, including on budget caps, is a matter between individual providers and individual health insurers.
Het maken van afspraken, ook over budgetplafonds, is een zaak tussen individuele aanbieders en individuele zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over kindermarketing door varkenshouderijen

An MP asks the state secretary why the pig sector's classroom material 'The Pig Story', judged by the Advertising Code Committee to be misleading child marketing, is still offered to schools, and whether it should be banned or corrected. The state secretary says schools are responsible for lesson content under constitutional educational freedom, that the committee's rulings should be respected, but that government will not ban or order a rectification of the material.
Given the constitutional freedom of education regarding teaching materials, I feel restraint is appropriate in going into the substance of such materials.
Gezien de grondwettelijke onderwijsvrijheid ten aanzien van leermiddelen past mij terughoudendheid om inhoudelijk in te gaan op dergelijke materialen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht Ministerie stopte acht ton subsidie in verlieslijdend festival: 'Zeer kwalijk’

An MP asked why the health ministry gave a one-off subsidy of about €597,000 to the Tong Tong Fair despite legal warnings, whether the decision was transparent, and why Indies war widows' backpay remains unresolved. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was lawful under the block exemption, that the irregularity was only in the payment schedule, that the Chamber was informed via the 2020 letter and annual report, and that backpay is a separate matter to be addressed in a written consultation.
Accepting an irregularity falls within the competence of ministers.
Het accepteren van een onrechtmatigheid behoort tot de bevoegdheid van bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het artikel 'Psychiaters eisen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar euthanasie van Milou (17)'

Paulusma (D66) asked about psychiatrists' demand for a criminal investigation into the euthanasia of a 17-year-old, after the regional review committee judged it careful. The government answered that criminal investigation is only warranted where the review committee finds a breach, that the Public Prosecution Service saw no reason to investigate, and that it supports ThaNet efforts to build expertise on euthanasia in psychiatric cases.
The Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to start a criminal investigation in this case.
Het OM ziet geen reden om in dit geval een strafrechtelijk onderzoek te starten.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verouden, Kouwenhoven en Saris over de ingreep bij Nexperia

MPs Verouden, Kouwenhoven and Saris asked Minister Karremans about the government's intervention at Nexperia under the Goods Availability Act, including legal advice, timing, consultation with Europe and China, and information provision to parliament. The minister largely referred to earlier letters and a timeline, withheld advice and documents citing confidentiality and company information, and defended the intervention as necessary to protect supply security.
Because of the classified nature of this file, the cabinet cannot make these advices public.
Vanwege het geclassificeerde karakter van dit dossier kan het kabinet deze adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Beantwoording vragen van het lid Oualhadj over de situatie omtrent de ingreep bij Nexperia

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for a full account of the cabinet's decision-making, legal basis, proportionality, foreign and EU coordination, and lessons learned behind the Goods Availability Act order against Nexperia, including why it remained in force after the Enterprise Chamber intervened. The Minister answered that the order was a proportionate, exceptional last resort to protect chip production capacity, pointed to an earlier timeline shared with parliament, and committed to a later evaluation, while declining to publish the detailed assessment framework and criteria in full.
That is why the cabinet is keeping the order in reserve, so that the ultimate goal, preserving very strategic capacity in legacy chips, can also be achieved in the long term.

Daarom houdt het kabinet het bevel achter de hand, zodat het uiteindelijke doel, namelijk het behouden van zeer strategische capaciteit op legacy chips, ook op de lange termijn verwezenlijkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Frederik Jansen over de overname van Solvinity door Kyndryl

An FVD MP asked whether foreign powers could access citizens' data via the takeover of Solvinity (which runs DigiD and MijnOverheid) by Kyndryl, whether the government saw it coming, whether sensitive projects can be moved to a Dutch firm quickly, and whether EZ was involved. The State Secretary acknowledged in theory US laws (CLOUD Act, FISA) could reach the data, said talks on mitigation measures are ongoing without a timeline, noted the embargo-limited early warning and that moving services quickly is not feasible for some organisations, and denied EZ involvement.

Talks are currently being held with Solvinity and Kyndryl about taking measures aimed, among other things, at mitigating as far as possible the risk of access by a foreign authority to the data Solvinity processes for the Dutch government.

Momenteel worden gesprekken gevoerd met Solvinity en Kyndryl over het treffen van maatregelen die er, mede, op zijn gericht om het risico op toegang door een buitenlandse autoriteit tot de gegevens die Solvinity verwerkt ten behoeve van de Nederlandse overheid zoveel mogelijk te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de Amerikaanse overname van het Nederlandse cloudbedrijf Solvinity

An MP asked the government about the American takeover of Dutch cloud company Solvinity, including exposure of government data to US surveillance laws and contract options. The state secretary answered that the risk of US data access already existed, that an inventory of critical dependencies is underway, that the Landsadvocaat is reviewing whether a change-of-control clause allows termination, and that further measures will be decided case by case.
An inventory is currently being carried out to determine whether critical processes depend on the services provided by Solvinity.
Momenteel wordt geïnventariseerd of er kritieke processen afhankelijk zijn van de dienstverlening door Solvinity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over het bericht: ‘Servische regering treitert buitenlandse supermarkten, Ahold Delhaize gaat winkels sluiten’

SGP MPs Stoffer and Flach asked whether Ahold Delhaize closed 25 stores in Serbia due to a retail margin cap, whether the measure breaches the internal market and the Stabilisation and Association Agreement, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Netherlands has raised concerns repeatedly with Serbian ministers, judges the measure market-distorting and at odds with EU accession criteria, and has asked the Commission to raise it, but did not commit to any formal sanction.
The cabinet considers the measure market-distorting and believes it is at odds with the economic criteria for EU accession.
Het kabinet acht de maatregel marktverstorend en is van mening dat deze op gespannen voet staat met de economische criteria bij EU-toetreding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de overname van Zivver door een Amerikaans bedrijf

An MP asks the government about the acquisition of Dutch encrypted email provider Zivver by a US company, raising concerns about US surveillance law, data sovereignty and whether overheid use should continue. The government answers that US law could apply and risks must be reassessed under DPIA procedures, but it cannot fully exclude data reaching US or Israeli hands, leaves the decision on continued use to individual departments, and says existing investment screening laws do not cover Zivver, while promising no specific new oversight measure beyond reviewing risk analyses and exploring a sovereign cloud.
The cabinet currently has no indications that data held by the government ends up in the US or Israel in breach of data protection law, but it cannot fully rule this out with complete certainty.

Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat gegevens in strijd met het gegevensbeschermingsrecht in handen van de overheid in de VS of Israël terechtkomen, maar kan het ook niet met volledige zekerheid uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verouden over nationale toepassing staatssteunregels bij scale-ups (OIM problematiek)

MP Verouden asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the national application of EU state aid rules to scale-ups, specifically the 'undertaking in difficulty' (OIM) definition that excludes many young firms from subsidies, and whether national rules are stricter. The minister answered that the problem stems from EU rules and CBb case law, that Dutch practice is not stricter, that the EU definition should be revised, and that the Netherlands submitted proposals to the Commission in its consultation.
Adjusting Dutch rules offers unfortunately no solution.
Aanpassing van de Nederlandse regels biedt helaas geen oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de resultaten van PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about PostNL's Q3 2025 results, how infrastructure, labour and internal cost allocations are split between UPD post, non-UPD post and parcels, whether UPD losses are overstated, and working conditions at PostNL. The minister declined to disclose the detailed cost split citing competition sensitivity, stated there are no signs of overstated UPD losses given accountant checks and ACM oversight, and said he would convey the working-conditions signals and talk with unions and the Inspectie SZW without committing to a new meeting.

Further breaking down infrastructure and labour costs by separate activities such as UPD post, non-UPD post and parcels is not part of the KTS and directly concerns competitively sensitive information.

Het verdergaand uitsplitsen van infrastructuur- en arbeidskosten naar afzonderlijke activiteiten zoals UPD-post, niet-UPD-post en pakketten is geen onderdeel van het KTS en raakt direct aan concurrentiegevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over TikTok- algoritmes en extremisme

An MP asked the government about TikTok recommendation algorithms favouring far-right content, their role in radicalisation and extremism, election interference via donations to online creators, and possible national regulation. The government answered that platforms are responsible under the DSA, that the Commission supervises VLOPs, that national regulation is not currently needed beyond the DSA and TOI regulation, and that it will pursue dialogue, a pilot with Meta, and evaluation in 2027.
The cabinet therefore believes the priority should lie with effective and uniform application and enforcement of the DSA.
Het kabinet is daarom van mening dat de prioriteit moet liggen bij de effectieve en uniforme toepassing en handhaving van de DSA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over inflatie

The MP Thijssen asks why inflation stays high, how wages and prices have moved over ten years, whether profits rather than wages drive inflation, and what a shift of income from wages to profits would mean for government revenue. The minister answers with CPI and CAO wage figures, notes that wages have outpaced inflation and purchasing power has risen, states that there are no concrete signs profits drove October 2025 inflation, and declines to quantify the wage-profit shift, citing uncertainty about investment effects.
Because of this it is not possible to give an accurate answer to this question.
Hierdoor is het niet mogelijk om een accuraat antwoord te geven op deze vraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Frederik Jansen over de beoogde AI-fabriek in Groningen

The MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the planned AI factory in Groningen: how the 200 million euro will be spent, its technical specifications, the HPC plan, access rules for users, why six ministries fund it, and whether the government can use it. The minister answers that about 150 million goes to hardware and operations and 50 million to an expertise centre, that technical design depends on an EuroHPC tender run with SURF, and that the national part will be accessed through a call mechanism still to be set up.
What exactly the supercomputer will look like technically still depends on the tender to be run by the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) in cooperation with SURF on behalf of the consortium.

Hoe de supercomputer er precies technisch uit zal komen te zien, is nog afhankelijk van de aanbesteding die door de EuroHPC Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) zal worden uitgevoerd in samenwerking met SURF namens het consortium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over Nexperia

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for an update on the Nexperia intervention, the options considered, an overview of critical production capacities and companies, and a target for keeping them in Europe. The minister referred to earlier letters and briefings, said the wet beschikbaarheid goederen was the only suitable measure, and described existing industrial and economic security policy without providing a new overview or formal target.
These letters also regularly refer to which capacities are important for the Netherlands and Europe, though for example for commercial confidentiality reasons not everything is always made public.

In deze brieven wordt ook regelmatig verwezen naar welke capaciteiten er belangrijk zijn voor Nederland en Europa, waarbij om bijvoorbeeld bedrijfsvertrouwelijke redenen niet altijd alles openbaar wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Thijssen, Sneller en Inge van Dijk over de kabinetsinzet bij de Ministeriële Conferentie van ESA 2025

MPs Postma, Thijssen, Sneller and Inge van Dijk asked the Economy Minister why the Netherlands would hold its ESA contribution at 170 million euro nominal, why this falls well short of the ESA norm and the NSO warnings of a real cut of about 25%, and what the consequences are for industry, geo-return and ESTEC. The minister answered that budget constraints under the caretaker cabinet limit funding, that the cabinet is exploring additional funds before the conferences, and that detailed programme allocations and results will only be shared after the conference.
No, I cannot commit to this, since the final distribution of ESA funds across the various programmes is only determined during the Ministerial Conference.
Nee, dit kan ik niet toezeggen aangezien de definitieve verdeling van de ESA-middelen over de verschillende programma’s pas tijdens de Ministeriële Conferentie wordt bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kouwenhoven en Saris over de ingreep van de Nederlandse overheid bij het bedrijf Nexperia

MPs Kouwenhoven and Saris ask the Minister of Economic Affairs about the government's Wbg order placing Nexperia under state supervision, including its economic and legal risks, the US 50% rule, Chinese export measures, and precedent for other multinationals. The minister defends the order as a targeted, independent decision based on the CEO's conduct, says it was not driven by US pressure, and states that the Wbg will very unlikely be used again.
Regarding the content of contacts with the US government in the context of export or sanctions regimes, I cannot make statements due to their confidential nature.
Over de inhoud van contacten met de Amerikaanse regering in het kader van export- of sanctieregimes kan ik vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter daarvan geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het besluit van de rechter dat Meta aanbevelingsalgoritmen moet aanpassen

An MP asked whether the government would push for the stricter Dutch court-ordered timeline choice on Meta's recommender algorithms as a European standard, whether supervisors rather than courts should enforce the DSA, and how government will support supervisors and civil society organisations like Bits of Freedom. The government replied that the court only interprets existing DSA norms, that it sees no need for a European push, that civil enforcement alongside public supervision is legitimate, that supervisors are adequately funded, and that it will not provide financial aid to civil lawsuits.
It is important to note that Facebook and Instagram are supervised by the European Commission and the Irish supervisory authority.
Het is hierbij van belang op te merken dat Facebook en Instagram onder toezicht staan van de Europese Commissie en de Ierse toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de vermeende ontheffing van het deponeren van een jaarrekening met stikstofwinst

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that an environmental adviser's company was exempted from publishing its annual accounts, and whether ANBI status and a commercial BV can be combined. The minister explained the legal conditions for ANBI status and exemptions from filing accounts, and stated that no exemption was granted to the BV in question, calling the premise of the questions incorrect.
No exception or exemption was granted. The premise of questions 8 to 10 is incorrect.
Er is geen uitzondering of vrijstelling gegeven. De premisse in de vragen 8 t/m 10 is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitvoering van Project Beethoven

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the implementation of Project Beethoven, including municipal capacity, international talent, rail station funding, infrastructure cuts, and nitrogen and grid congestion risks for the Brainport region. Minister Karremans answered mostly by referring to earlier letters and debates, stating that work continues via the Bestuurlijk Overleg Brainport and that infrastructure projects proceed, without providing concrete new figures on several points.
At a next opportunity I will inform you about this.
Bij een volgende gelegenheid zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Kouwenhoven over de aangekondigde reductie van 500 regels in het actieprogramma regeldruk

MPs Idsinga and Kouwenhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the 500-regulation reduction target in the regulatory burden action programme is defined, which measures make up the first tranche, how reductions are calculated and reported, and how it relates to the Kisteman motion. The minister answered that the list of 500 regulations is still being compiled, that reductions will be calculated under the standard cost model, and that progress will be shown in real time on the regeldrukmonitor website, with timelines and legal instruments to follow later.
At present the cabinet is compiling a list of the intended 500 regulations, which will be shared with the House by the end of the year.
Op dit moment maakt het kabinet een lijst met de beoogde 500 regels die voor het einde van het jaar met de Kamer zal worden gedeeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid White over ‘verhuisberichten die niet goed doorkomen bij de Belastingdienst waardoor ondernemers in de financiële problemen komen’

An MP asked whether address changes sent to the Chamber of Commerce are sometimes not processed correctly by the Tax Authority, leaving entrepreneurs with blocked bank accounts, and what safeguards, compensation and faster procedures exist. The State Secretary acknowledged such cases occur in a very limited number of instances, saw no need for a structural investigation, pointed to existing correction procedures, contact moments before seizure, a Stellateam for urgent cases, and extra attention to address mutations with the Chamber of Commerce.
Given the small number of cases and the existing procedures, it is not appropriate to investigate this.
Gezien het kleine aantal gevallen en de bestaande procedures is het niet aan de orde om hier onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over machtsvorming via overnames in de huisdierenbranche

An SP MP asked the ministers about market concentration through acquisitions in the pet sector, including harm to animal welfare and affordability, and whether the ACM should review such takeovers more strictly. The minister acknowledges concerns but defends case-by-case market supervision, announces plans to extend merger control to smaller acquisitions, declines a new study on pet-care prices and rejects price caps, while the ACM can only act on concrete signals.
That is why I am positive about the intention to update merger control so that smaller acquisitions that may have anti-competitive effects can also fall under ACM supervision.

Daarom sta ik positief tegenover het voornemen het concentratietoezicht te actualiseren, zodat ook kleinere overnames die mogelijk mededingingsbeperkende gevolgen kunnen hebben, voortaan onder het toezicht van ACM kunnen vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘PostNL dreigt briefbezorging te versoberen, als het kabinet niet ingrijpt’

Rep. Idsinga asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL will scale back mail delivery after its request to withdraw the universal postal service designation, and how vulnerable groups, urgent post and continuity will be protected. The minister replied that he will not grant PostNL's request, is consulting on a Postbesluit change to lengthen delivery times, judges risks limited, and says the ACM is responsible for enforcement.
It is the responsibility of the ACM to act as an independent regulator when PostNL does not comply with the law.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de ACM om als onafhankelijk toezichthouder op te treden wanneer PostNL de wet niet naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Thijssen over de arbeidsinkomensquote (AIQ), de investeringsquote en pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the Economy Minister about the fall in the labour income share since 2019 and 1980, the investment ratio, profit ratio, and whether extra profits reach workers via pensions or wages. The minister answered with figures (labour share down 3.6 points since 2019, profit ratio up 2.3 points) and argued profits fund investment and that pension funds benefit from profits, without committing to any action.
As is well known, there is no public shareholder register for all Dutch companies.
Er is zoals bekend geen publiek aandeelhouderregister voor alle Nederlandse bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ‘de opslag van miljoenen door Israël afgeluisterde Palestijnse belgesprekken in Nederland’

An MP asked whether Dutch Microsoft datacenters store intercepted Palestinian phone calls from Israeli military intelligence, and what the government will do about it. The minister said he cannot confirm the storage, has no legal basis to investigate data held by third parties, sees no complicity, and refers to Microsoft's own inquiry and to EU and criminal law enforcement by the authorities.
Government investigation of data stored by third parties in a datacenter requires a legal basis. I do not have one.
Voor het van overheidswege onderzoeken van door derden opgeslagen data in een datacenter is een wettelijke grondslag nodig. Ik beschik daar niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de Kamerbrief ‘Investeren in een weerbare en toekomstbestendige economie: het 3%-R&D-actieplan’

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why the 3% R&D target is still upheld despite past R&D budget cuts, and presses on wage sharing, the role of business tax revenue, ARPA exploration, the R&D launch platform, institutional investors, defence, TTO/KTO funding, the EU cofinancing facility, regulatory burden and climate change. The minister replies that the action plan aims to mobilise private R&D with public funds, that more public money will be needed but is for a future cabinet, and that most items are at exploration or design stage with no concrete budgets or measurable targets yet.
Decisions on this are now for a next cabinet.
Beslissingen ten aanzien hiervan zijn nu aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de rol van de overheid om gebrekkige marktwerking

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about insurers charging loyal customers higher premiums (margepersonalisatie), price gaps in care insurance and telecom subscriptions, and whether to ban such practices. The government answered that the AFM and ACM supervise these practices under existing law, no new ban is planned for now, and it is leaving enforcement to the supervisors while noting ongoing studies.
It is up to the supervisor to act if necessary.
Het is aan de toezichthouder om indien nodig op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over zijn vragen ten aanzien van het nieuwsbericht over verplichte e-facturatie per 2026

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a report that only one in ten SMEs is ready for mandatory e-invoicing in 2026, and about preparation, consequences, and possible postponement. The minister corrected the date to 1 July 2030 under the EU VIDA package, said the government will involve businesses, pay attention to administrative burden, and commit to submitting the legislation at least two years before entry into force, while stating that businesses remain responsible for knowing the rules.
The cabinet aims to submit to parliament the legislation on the part of VIDA covering e-invoicing and digital reporting at least two years before entry into force.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om de wetgeving betreffende het deel van VIDA dat ziet op e-facturatie en digitale rapportage bij uw Kamer in te dienen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'gerommel met stikstofcijfers voor de bouw bij Natura 2000 van vakantieparken'

An SP MP asks the state secretary about nitrogen calculations for the restructuring of the Sandevoerde holiday park near Natura 2000 Kennemerland-Zuid, including claims that deposition exceeds limits and that earlier calculations are invalid. The state secretary answers that the province of Noord-Holland, as competent authority, is assessing the permit and will review any counter-report in the objection procedure, and that the rules apply equally to all projects, deferring substantive judgement to the competent authority.
The competent authority, namely the province of Noord-Holland, is currently assessing the permit application.
Het bevoegd gezag, i.c. de provincie Noord-Holland, is momenteel bezig met de beoordeling van de vergunningaanvraag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het uitblijven van uitvoering van de aangenomen moties Van Zanten en Vermeer over het opzetten van sectorale regeldrukreductieprogramma’s en over de afschaffing van de CO2-rapp

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why motions adopted in April 2025 (abolishing CO2 reporting for firms under 250 employees and sectoral red-tape reduction programmes targeting 20%) have not yet been implemented. The minister says he is working on an SME exemption for the CO2 reporting duty to be assessed in 2026, that about 25% of the most burdensome obligations are being addressed with a target of 100% reviewed by end-2026, and that a new approach to red tape is being pursued.
With the State Secretary of IenW I recently agreed to work out proposals for an exemption for SMEs.
Met de Staatssecretaris van IenW heb ik onlangs afgesproken om voorstellen uit te werken voor een uitzondering voor het mkb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de motie-Dijk met het voorstel om de ACM het mandaat en de middelen te geven om de prijzen van boodschappen te reguleren

SP MP Dijk asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about implementing a motion to give the ACM competition authority powers to regulate and block grocery prices, and about price levels, ACM powers, market power and possible investigations. The minister replied that the government will not give the ACM price-regulation powers, citing a planned-economy risk and lower Dutch grocery prices than the EU average, while pointing to EU action on territorial supply restrictions and ACM's possible investigations.
Apart from territorial supply restrictions, the cabinet will not regulate grocery prices or give the ACM a power to do so.
Los van territoriale leveringsbeperkingen, gaat het kabinet de boodschappenprijzen niet reguleren, of de ACM hiervoor een bevoegdheid geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de nieuwe voorwaarden van WeTransfer om data van gebruikers te gebruiken voor verkoop en het trainen van AI

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and the State Secretary of the Interior whether WeTransfer's new terms allowing use of user data for sale and AI training are lawful, and whether users should be able to opt in. The government answered that data protection and consumer complaints lie with the independent regulators (AP and ACM), that AI training on personal data can rest on legitimate interest under the GDPR, that EU copyright law uses an opt-out rather than opt-in regime, and that it will not interfere with the regulators' independence.
That would be a task for the independent regulator, if it considers this opportune.
Dat zou een taak van de onafhankelijke toezichthouder zijn, indien deze dat opportuun vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Investeerder Blackstone

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the takeover of RCN holiday parks by private equity firm Blackstone threatens social missions, affordability and tax transparency, and whether rules such as a public-interest test should be introduced. The minister answered that no legal guarantees exist for social activities, that the competition authority ACM cleared the deal without weighing public values, that tax questions cannot be discussed, and that a study of a public-interest test will be reported by year end.
Governments, such as municipalities, provinces or the national government, are legally obliged to prepare decisions carefully and to take the relevant facts and interests into account.
Overheden, zoals gemeenten, provincies of het Rijk, zijn wettelijk verplicht om besluiten zorgvuldig voor te bereiden en daarbij de relevante feiten en belangen mee te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kisteman over het bericht ‘Duizenden banen op de tocht door nieuwe Postwet, regionale postbedrijven dreigen te verdwijnen’

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the new Postal Act's effect on regional postal companies, including the phase-out of discounted access to PostNL's national network, pricing after five years, and job impacts. The minister defends the transitional access regime, rejects sector-specific job protections, and commits to a further response before the 3 September round table.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over structureel falen van GI Stichting Samen Veilig Midden-Nederland (SAVE), rechterlijke ongehoorzaamheid en schending van Europees recht

An MP asked the state secretaries about GI SAVE's placement of a minor in Spain without the Brussels II-ter approval procedure, its deliberate non-compliance with a court-ordered contact arrangement, and whether court rulings are being ignored more broadly. The minister confirmed the rulings, called the non-compliance contrary to the rule of law, said the inspectorate does not register such cases, and pointed to ongoing supervision, sector guidance and the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd without committing to new sanctions or rule changes.
GIs must always implement court rulings, even if the institution disagrees with the ruling.
GI's moeten altijd uitvoering geven aan rechterlijke uitspraken, ook als de instelling het niet eens is met de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de uitvoering van een aangenomen motie over strategische autonomie

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why a motion on economic security and strategic autonomy has not yet been implemented and when it will be. The minister says it is already being acted on and refers to a letter of 1 July 2025 for the status.
I am aware of this motion. However, further implementation has already been given to it.
Ik ben op de hoogte van deze motie. Hier is echter al wel nader uitvoering aan gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de schijnveiligheid van jongeren op sociale media

An MP asks the government about the 'false security' of teen accounts on Instagram and related issues: addictive design, Meta's responsibility, EU regulation, age limits and parental guidance. The government answers that the DSA and European Commission investigation are the main tools, that enforcement rests with independent regulators, and that it will pursue a public campaign, a parenting guideline and further study of addictive design.
Ultimately it is up to the regulators to determine whether there is a breach of legal obligations.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de toezichthouders om vast te stellen of er sprake is van schending van wettelijke verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Postma over de ‘Mogelijk lichtpuntje voor werknemers Apollo Vredestein’ bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the Apollo Vredestein plant in Enschede, including whether state aid rules should be revised, how the ESF+ and EGF funds could support affected workers, and whether the minister would visit Enschede. The government sees no need to revise the state aid anti-relocation rules for now, explains that ESF+ is available via the labour market region, notes SZW is exploring EGF options, and declines to commit to a visit until the company's plans are clearer.
On the basis of this assessment, the cabinet currently sees no need for revision, but continues to monitor closely
Op basis van deze afweging ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen noodzaak tot herziening, maar blijft aandachtig volgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het rapport 'Zorgen over kinderen die wachten op jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering'

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the inspectorates' report on children waiting months for a permanent youth protection worker and on the lack of timely help at certified institutions, questioning oversight, accountability of managers, and publication of court decisions. The government acknowledges the waiting lists, says workload has fallen 26% and the waiting list 29% since December 2022, cites staffing and funding measures, and says legal routes to hold directors accountable already exist, while committing to ongoing monitoring and periodic updates to parliament.
I already regularly inform your House about the number of clients, the waiting lists and the workload in youth protection.
Ik informeer uw Kamer reeds periodiek over het aantal cliënten, de wachtlijsten en de werkdruk in de jeugdbescherming.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dral, Van den Hil en Tielen over het artikel '‘Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen’; Malafide medewerkers in de jeugdzorg maken misbruik van de positie van kwetsbare jongeren’

MPs Dral, Van den Hil and Tielen (VVD) asked the State Secretaries about a Telegraaf report that malicious youth-care workers exploit vulnerable youths for crime, and about fraud with EVC certificates and training points in the youth-care register. The government answered that it does not know the numbers, is sampling 274 of about 3,500 EVC-based registrations, has suspended 490 pending applications, and is pursuing wider anti-fraud measures.
Therefore the SKJ started with a sample of 274 files to determine the content and pace of the follow-up on that basis.
Daarom is de SKJ gestart met een steekproef van 274 dossiers om op basis daarvan de inhoud en het tempo van het vervolg te kunnen bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over screening in de pleegzorg

An MP asks the State Secretaries about foster-care screening after a court referred questions to the Supreme Court on Youth Act article 5.1, and about inspection findings on the foster provider Enver, which failed most screening norms. The government says it awaits the Supreme Court's ruling before deciding on measures, points to inspection-enforced improvements and a planned review of continuous screening, and states that the youth protection system's oversight is being strengthened.
I am awaiting the Supreme Court's assessment of the preliminary questions before deciding whether to take any measures.
Ik wacht de beoordeling van de prejudiciële vragen aan de Hoge Raad af, voordat ik besluit of ik eventuele maatregelen moet nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de verwachte toename van geslachtsziekten en ongewenste zwangerschappen door bezuinigingen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether cuts to sexual health services and prevention would increase STIs and unwanted pregnancies, and what the effects, capacity impacts and monitoring would be. The State Secretary answered that the 10% cut to the ASG sexual health scheme from 2026 will mainly reduce care, that effects were not studied, that the impact is hard to quantify, and that the Chamber was informed on 18 June 2025.
No study has been carried out into the expected effects of this cut.
Er is geen onderzoek verricht naar de verwachte effecten van deze bezuiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht 'Huidkanker is snelst toenemende vorm van kanker in Nederland'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the rising incidence of skin cancer, the adequacy of prevention measures, and whether prevention should be a policy priority. The State Secretary answered that the Voorkom Huidkanker campaign runs until 2025 with no structural funding yet, that EU sunscreen standards are being revised with Dutch involvement, and that skin cancer prevention is now part of the national prevention strategy pending evaluation.
At this moment there are no structural funds available.
Op dit moment zijn er geen structurele middelen beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over wachttijden binnen de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 (Wmo) en de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An MP asked the state secretaries about long waiting times in Wmo and mental health care (ggz) and how these relate to the Integraal Zorgakkoord and GALA targets. The government acknowledged long ggz waiting times, listed measures under the IZA and noted that effects are not yet visible, and said there is no national picture for Wmo waiting times.
For the Wmo there is no national picture of waiting times.
Voor de Wmo bestaat er geen landelijk beeld van wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bestuurders van sportclubs afhaken

MPs asked whether the government shares concerns that board members of sports clubs are withdrawing due to regulatory burden and the Wbtr's director-liability risks, and whether proposals and timelines will follow. The government answered that it is running a regulatory-burden review and a Significant Public study on whether volunteer insurance covers liability risks, with results expected before summer recess, and that the Wbtr evaluation (due before 1 July 2026) will examine unintended effects on volunteer liability.
The expectation is that the outcomes of this study will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Het is de verwachting dat de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek voor het zomerreces naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Inspectie grijpt in bij instelling pleegmeisje Vlaardingen: ’Risico’s voor veiligheid meer pleegkinderen Enver’'

An MP asked the State Secretary about Inspectorate findings that foster care provider Enver has safety shortcomings (screening, matching, dossier documentation), whether placing children in incompletely screened foster homes violates the Youth Act, how the problems stayed hidden, what immediate measures apply and whether consequences follow if Enver fails the deadline. The State Secretary answered that the IGJ found protocols not sufficiently applied, that the Youth Act permits placement before screening is complete under conditions, that a thematic inspection of all foster care providers is planned for autumn 2025, that Enver must comply by end January 2026 under intensified supervision, and that the IGJ may take administrative measures if needed.
Enver must implement the necessary improvements by the end of January 2026 at the latest.
Enver moet uiterlijk eind januari 2026 de noodzakelijke verbeteringen doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over het bericht ‘Pleegzorg ver onder de maat bij organisatie die Vlaardings meisje begeleidde’

An MP asked the state secretaries about a news report on poor foster care quality at the organisation Enver, which supervised a girl from Vlaardingen, and about safety measures for its foster children. The government answered that Enver must fix the deficiencies identified by the Inspectorate (IGJ) by end January 2026 under enhanced supervision, that the IGJ is running thematic supervision of the foster care sector with results due this autumn, and that the IGJ will review the foster care providers' safety oversight.
During the period of enhanced supervision, the inspectorate will closely monitor Enver, for example through announced or unannounced visits and by requesting progress reports.
In de periode van het verscherpt toezicht zal de inspectie Enver nauwlettend volgen, bijvoorbeeld met aangekondigd of onaangekondigd bezoek en het opvragen van voortgangsrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Pleegzorg ver onder de maat bij organisatie die Vlaardings meisje begeleidde'

An MP asks how the government responds to the IGJ's finding that foster care provider Enver falls short on safety of foster children, whether children are safe during remediation, and what the IGJ will do if Enver fails. The Secretary of State answers that the IGJ has placed Enver under heightened supervision with a deadline of January 2026, that the IGJ has not yet confirmed risks are removed, and outlines measures on independent confidants for foster children and the IGJ's thematic inspection.
The IGJ has placed Enver under heightened supervision because the quality of the foster care provided does not meet the required standards.
De IGJ heeft Enver onder verscherpt toezicht gesteld, omdat de kwaliteit van de geboden pleegzorg niet voldoet aan de gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Noodkreet GGZ-instelling de Waag: wachtlijsten plotseling nog langer door aanpassing van beleid'

MP Westerveld asks the minister why roughly 1,000 child and youth psychologists are no longer getting BIG registration as health psychologists despite comparable training, and asks about the impact analysis, the motion on consultation, and possible transitional arrangements. The minister defends not proceeding with the draft bill after negative internet consultation, says child and youth psychologists can keep working in youth care without BIG registration, and rejects a transitional arrangement because of higher costs.
At this moment I see no reason to change the professional structure of mental health care in the BIG Act.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de beroepenstructuur van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg in de Wet BIG te wijzigen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Danëlle Jansen over het Ichthus College in Veenendaal, dat een speciale rookplek op het schoolterrein heeft ingericht voor leerlingen met toestemming van hun ouders en een rookpas, terwijl

MP Danëlle Jansen asked the State Secretary for Health about a Veenendaal school that set up a designated smoking spot for pupils with parental consent and a smoking pass despite the nationwide ban on smoking on school grounds since 1 August 2020. The State Secretary said breaking the law is not the solution, that schools must enforce the ban, pointed to support tools and NVWA inspections, and reported that a few warnings and fines were issued to secondary schools in 2024, while promising to keep monitoring signals.
Under the law, schools are required to introduce, designate and enforce the smoking ban across the entire school grounds.
Het is volgens de wet verplicht voor een school het rookverbod op het gehele schoolterrein in te stellen, aan te duiden en te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat fysiotherapie buiten het basispakket zal vallen

The SP MP Dijk asked whether physiotherapy would be excluded from the basic health insurance package, with questions on access, costs, and evidence. The Minister answers that no decision has been taken to remove physiotherapy from the basic package, that access is not changing, and that the Health Care Institute has assessed the evidence for several indications.
No, this is not correct. There are no planned changes that would remove physiotherapy from the basic package.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Er zijn geen wijzigingen gepland waarmee fysiotherapie uit het basispakket wordt gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smitskam en Crijns over het bericht ‘Malafide jeugdzorgmedewerkers ronselen jongeren voor criminaliteit: ’Ik heb zelfs een huis opgeblazen''

PVV MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that fraudulent youth care workers recruit young people for crime, asking about oversight, a независимый investigation, victim numbers and reforms. The government acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to planned measures such as a vergewisplicht in the Jeugdwet and a Zorgfraudebrief, but declined a new independent investigation and said it does not register how many children were affected.
Given the measures the parties are taking, I currently see no reason for additional investigation.
Gezien bovenstaande maatregelen die partijen nemen, zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over de uitzending van de Oranjezondag van 9 maart

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about doping oversight, safety and enforcement in Dutch bodybuilding, after three bodybuilding federations stayed outside NOC*NSF and the national doping rules. The state secretary answered that sport bodies bear responsibility for doping rules and events, that legislation would undermine sport autonomy and is not desirable, and that enforcement of the Geneesmiddelenwet by the IGJ is general rather than sport-specific, with a commitment to consult on an independent integrity centre later.
It is not known how many people in the Netherlands do bodybuilding in total, structurally or incidentally, and at amateur or top-sport level.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel mensen in Nederland in totaal, structureel of incidenteel, en op amateurniveau of als topsport, aan bodybuilding doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over de uitvoering van een aangenomen motie over landelijke regie pakken op de wijze van financiering van de jeugdzorg en beschikbaarheidsfinanciering de standaard make

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked how implementation of their adopted motion on national steering of youth care financing and making availability-based financing the standard is progressing, including research on which care types need it. The Secretary of State answered that standardisation of care types is underway with municipalities and providers, that availability-based financing is being researched, and that it can support stable, placement-based youth care while cost control limits its use for a fixed home.
Through the Youth Reform Agenda, I am working with municipalities and youth care providers on standardising the care types.
Vanuit de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd werk ik met gemeenten en jeugdhulpaanbieders aan het standaardiseren van de zorgvormen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Werf over de BNN/VARA-documentaire ‘Hoe familievloggers zoals de Bellinga’s hun kinderen in gevaar kunnen brengen’

An MP asked the state secretaries about the BNNVARA documentary on family vloggers and children's exposure to commercial exploitation, including regulation, children's wellbeing, the Children's Ombudsman's concerns, and platform responsibility. The government acknowledges current law is not suited to 'kidfluencing', announces amending regulation and parents' awareness campaigns, but leaves platform and age-verification matters to EU-level coordination.
To better protect children from the harmful influence of this, I will amend the existing laws and regulations.
Om kinderen beter te beschermen tegen de nadelige invloed hiervan ga ik de bestaande de wet- regelgeving aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over reclames van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor een Vrijwillig Levenseinde (NVVE)

An MP asked the state secretary about NVVE billboards reading 'it is enough' and 'what if your life feels complete', arguing they suggest euthanasia on grounds of a completed life and are unsuitable near vulnerable young people. The state secretary rejected the suggestion, pointed to the Advertising Code Commission complaint route and limited municipal powers over ideological advertising, and said the government promotes careful messaging on end-of-life and mental health.
Ideological advertising falls within the scope of the right to freedom of expression.
Ideële reclame valt onder de reikwijdte van het recht van vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Pijpelink over de Week van de Lentekriebels

MPs Westerveld and Pijpelink asked the state secretaries of Education and Health about misinformation campaigns against the Week van de Lentekriebels and its effect on school participation. The government acknowledged the misinformation as harmful, noted participation fell from 43.2% to 35%, and promised continued support, information efforts and curriculum safeguards while stressing school autonomy.
Spreading incorrect and incomplete information is harmful.
Het verspreiden van onjuiste en onvolledige informatie is schadelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Aantal gevallen van mazelen blijft oplopen: nu al meer dan heel vorig jaar'

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary about rising measles cases, a cluster in Amsterdam, a school outbreak in Helmond, vaccination coverage, traveller information and vaccine procurement. The state secretary answered that municipal and GGD responsibilities are primary, that outreach to low-coverage neighbourhoods will be intensified via a pilot, and that existing travel and worker information is already available, committing to some further communication and a future evaluation of funding.
I am willing to bring this information further to the attention of the employers' associations.
Ik ben bereid om deze informatie extra onder de aandacht te brengen bij de werkgeversverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Elines dochter (10) kreeg anorexia: ‘gewacht op hulp tot ze letterlijk een ons woog’'

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about reports of long waiting times for children with anorexia, the lack of data on waiting times and treatment places, and the response to calls from the sector. The State Secretary answers that waiting times are not registered nationally, points to the Ketenaanpak Eetstoornissen, planned legislation obliging municipalities to cooperate, and ongoing research, while committing to no specific new measures beyond existing initiatives.

Exact numbers of children, young people and young adults in comparable situations are unfortunately not available because waiting times are not recorded nationally and by diagnosis for children and young people.

Exacte aantallen van kinderen, jongeren en jongvolwassenen in vergelijkbare situaties zijn helaas niet beschikbaar doordat wachttijden niet landelijk en diagnosespecifiek worden geregistreerd voor kinderen en jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het bericht dat bij voormalige bewoners van Rijnwijk verschillende vormen van kanker vaker dan gemiddeld voorkomen

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the state secretary for health about reports of higher-than-average cancer rates among former residents of Rijnwijk in Arnhem, near a heavily polluting former industrial site, and why soil and health effects were not investigated earlier. The state secretary said the municipality of Arnhem and the GGD will first run an exploratory study, that earlier soil investigations found no health risk, and that a separate national study is not considered appropriate.
I think it is good that the municipality of Arnhem has the GGD explore what is going on.
Ik denk dat het goed is dat de gemeente Arnhem de GGD laat verkennen wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Karremans wil harder optreden tegen ongezond eten'

PVV MP Crijns asked the state secretary for Health about the reported plan to act harder against unhealthy food, questioning whether the Nationaal Preventieakkoord has delivered measurable health gains, whether the approach restricts consumer choice and burdens poorer families, and whether the money would be better spent on lowering VAT on groceries. The state secretary replied that the RIVM modelling shows the agreement reduces smoking, overweight and problem drinking though targets will be missed by 2040, and defended legal measures on child-targeted marketing and supermarket shelf agreements, while rejecting a VAT cut.
That is why I am also working on a coherent prevention approach, the first outlines of which I presented to your House on 8 April.
Daarom werk ik ook aan een samenhangende preventieaanpak waarvan ik uw Kamer 8 april jl. de eerste contouren heb laten zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Bushoff over de oproep van Stichting Donorkind tot persoonlijk geïnformeerd worden vanwege overschrijdingen aantal donorkinderen per donor

MPs Paulusma and Bushoff asked the state secretary about donor-limit breaches in Dutch fertility clinics and whether affected donor children, mothers and donors would be contacted personally, plus steps against cross-border donation. The state secretary confirmed 85 donors exceeded the 25-offspring guideline, said clinics and the CdkB are responsible for communication, promised a faciliterende role, and described the new Wdkb monitoring and planned BRP authorisations, while declining to know cross-border donor use.
The clinics and the CdkB are responsible for communication towards all those involved.
De klinieken en het Cdkb zijn verantwoordelijk voor de communicatie richting alle betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht 'Belangrijke wetswijzigingen voor donorkinderen: is dit hoe we massadonatie kunnen voorkomen?'

MPs asked the state secretary about reported exceedances of the limit on children per sperm donor and the communication about them, and why donor children were not informed directly. The government answered that 85 donors had more than 25 offspring, that clinics and the Cdkb are responsible for communication, that BRP authorisation is being pursued, and that monitoring will run via the Cdkb annual report.
The Cdkb only registers the data of the donors and the treated women.
Het Cdkb registreert alleen de gegevens van de donoren en de behandelde vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport ‘Alpha Quick Scan: een zoektocht naar flakka’

MP Sneller asked the state secretary about the Alpha Quick Scan report on flakka, including market chaos after the alpha-cathinone ban, police burden, the balance between care and enforcement, the lack of clear aims of Opium Act listings, and the planned cut to subsidy for Stichting Mainline. The government answered that the ban reduced use, that investments in integrated care are expected to lower costs over time, that the ban aims mainly at health protection, and that the Mainline subsidy cut is justified because other parties can fill its role.
The aim of the ban is primarily the protection of health.
Het doel van het verbod is primair de bescherming van de gezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de gemeente Haarlem ouders vraagt om minder of zelfs helemaal niet meer te werken om de vraag naar jeugdzorg in te dammen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Haarlem's request that parents work less or stop working to reduce youth care demand is acceptable, and about gender equality and financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that Haarlem does not ask parents to reduce work, only discusses their own capacity and problem-solving under a regional ordinance grounded in the Youth Act and case law, and that financial capacity cannot be weighed under the Jeugdwet.
The municipality of Haarlem does not ask parents to work less or stop working when parents have a youth care request.
De gemeente Haarlem stelt niet de vraag om minder of niet meer te werken, als ouders een jeugdhulpvraag hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het bericht ‘Oud-turnster Petra Witjes heeft eindelijk geen nachtmerries meer. ‘Ik wil de mensen die mij verkeerd hebben beha

An MP asks the state secretary whether experience experts are represented in the talks on the integrity centre for sport, and how their input is secured given that an internet consultation is not suitable for personal experiences. The state secretary answers that some consulted organisations include experience experts, that a concept bill goes to internet consultation around summer, and that a kwartiermaker will be asked to involve experience experts in the centre's working processes long term.
Some of the organisations consulted for the bill establishing the independent integrity centre also represent the views of experience experts.

Een deel van de organisaties die om input wordt gevraagd ten behoeve van het wetsvoorstel dat de oprichting van het onafhankelijk integriteitscentrum regelt, neemt ook de stem mee van ervaringsdeskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over bezuinigingen op de jeugdzorg

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about municipal cuts to youth care, a harmful abrupt termination of care, workforce and funding pressures, and the Youth Authority's continuity-risk monitoring. Karremans answered that municipalities are responsible for youth care funding, that the 511 million structural cut was dropped but a 1 billion savings target remains, that talks on the Van Ark advice are ongoing with a letter promised before 18 June, and that 17 providers were in continuity-risk procedures in 2024.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their financial position and the adequate performance of the tasks and responsibilities incumbent on them.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de financiële positie en adequate uitvoering van de taken en verantwoordelijkheden die op hen rusten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de uitvoering van de aanbevelingen van de Commissie-Van Ark en de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd

MP Bruyning asked the State Secretary for Health about implementing the Van Ark Commission and Youth Reform Agenda recommendations, including financial risk-sharing between the state and municipalities, the VNG's concerns, planned Youth Act amendments and income-dependent contributions. The State Secretary repeatedly deferred substantive answers, stating that talks with parties are ongoing and that the Chamber will be informed before the 18 June youth policy debate, while listing several bills in preparation.
I will inform the Chamber of the outcomes as soon as possible, and at the latest before the youth policy debate on 18 June.
Over de uitkomsten informeer ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk, uiterlijk voorafgaand aan het debat over het jeugdbeleid op 18 juni a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over overbodige regels waardoor vrijwilligers voor carnavalsoptochten dreigen af te haken

An MP asked the State Secretary about excessive rules (APK inspection, registration, insurance) making volunteers building carnival floats drop out, and whether exemptions are possible. The government answered that existing exemptions apply, insurance rules protect third parties, no national data on premiums exists, and it will address the issue within its volunteer regulatory-burden approach.
No national data are available on the development of insurance premiums for carnival floats or on the number of insurers that had to pay out claims.
Er is op landelijk niveau geen data beschikbaar over de ontwikkeling van de hoogte van verzekeringspremies voor carnavalswagens en het aantal verzekeraars dat schade heeft moeten uitkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Geen baby's anoniem achtergelaten in eerste jaar vondelingenkamer: "Nul is een mooi cijfer"'

MPs Bikker asked the state secretary about anonymous abandonment of babies in a foundling room, the fate of a migrant worker dismissed after giving birth, and support for vulnerable pregnant women. The state secretary replied that the foundling rooms are a private initiative outside government control, that Fiom is examining the situation of migrant workers and will report before summer, and described existing support and aftercare arrangements.
The fact that the foundling rooms are not used can be regarded as confirmation of the effectiveness of the current procedure for adoption relinquishment.
Het feit dat de vondelingenkamers niet worden gebruikt kan worden beschouwd als een bevestiging van de effectiviteit van de huidige procedure rondom het doen van afstand ter adoptie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de recente wachttijdcijfers in de ggz

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the state secretary for Health about rising mental health care waiting times, the failure to meet the IZA target of five weeks, possible duty-of-care breaches, and budget cuts. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to structural causes and planned measures to be set out in a letter before the committee debate, while deferring responsibility for enforcement to the NZa and insurers.
As I previously shared with your House, I therefore want to take additional measures to increase the accessibility of mental health care, particularly for people with serious, complex problems.
Zoals ik eerder met uw Kamer deelde, wil ik daarom aanvullende maatregelen nemen om de toegankelijkheid van de ggz te vergroten, met name voor mensen met ernstige, complexe problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht dat supermarkten alcohol dubbel zo vaak in de aanbieding hebben als vier jaar geleden

MP Danielle Jansen asked about reports that supermarkets doubled alcohol promotions between 2020 and 2024, the failure of self-regulation to curb alcohol marketing reaching youth, and micro-influencer and student-targeted alcohol promotion, asking whether regulation should be tightened. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the rise, pointed to the amended advertising code and monitoring by the RCC and STIVA, and said he will await the Monitor Kidsmarketing and include measures in a forthcoming prevention strategy without committing to new legislation now.
I am currently working on a coherent prevention strategy that includes preventing problematic alcohol use, and parties such as the CBL are being asked to contribute.
Ik werk op dit moment aan een samenhangende preventiestrategie waarin het voorkomen van problematisch alcoholgebruik wordt meegenomen en partijen als het CBL worden gevraagd hieraan bij te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over de uitzending van De Oranjezondag van 9 maart 2025

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a broadcast suggesting anabolic steroid use is normalised in bodybuilding, and about controls, integrity oversight and the government's role. The State Secretary acknowledged the impression of normalisation, said there is no coordinated oversight because three bodybuilding federations, none under NOC*NSF, have not adopted the national doping rules, and pointed to information programmes by the Dopingautoriteit rather than mandatory regulation.
Specific figures on drug use in bodybuilding are therefore not available to me.
Specifieke cijfers over het middelengebruik in bodybuilding heb ik daarom niet ter beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Inge van Dijk over het artikel 'Scherpe kritiek op onderzoek Jeugdbescherming naar eigen rol bij gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire'

MPs Krul and Inge van Dijk asked why the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming's self-reflection on child removals of childcare-benefit scandal victims relied only on file review and professional interviews, without speaking to parents and children. The State Secretary defends the self-initiated reflection, acknowledges the missing parent and child perspective, notes other studies did include them, and promises a policy response and possible further research by June 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het antwoord op vragen over het bericht 'Kinderen in bedwang gehouden met pijnprikkels, commissie tegen martelen kijkt mee in Nederland'

MP Bruyning asks the state secretaries whether the government accepts system failures leading to incidents in youth care institutions, whether institutional boards should be liable, whether youths can report abuse to police, and whether abuse should carry higher penalties or compensation. The government answers that it cannot eliminate incidents but rejects any tolerance of violence, states that board liability is an exception decided by courts, says it sees no need to expand compensation options, and offers to inquire about a university study on alternatives to closed youth care.
Ultimately it is up to the judge to assess whether unlawful conduct has occurred.
In dat geval is het uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te beoordelen of sprake is van onrechtmatig handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de oproep van het Nederlands Genootschap van Abortusartsen (NGvA), om tegen de motie De Korte / Bikker (Kamerstuk 36600-XVI-174) te stemmen

MP Paulusma asks the state secretary for health how he reflects on the NGvA abortion doctors' call to vote against the De Korte/Bikker motion and whether registering reasons for abortion undermines women's autonomy and access to care. The state secretary says mandatory registration of reasons is unacceptable and not legally provided for, that the motion's evaluation of rising abortion numbers does not require reason-gathering, and that researchers will be asked to look at broader factors such as contraception and disinformation.
A registration obligation for motives does not fit here and may give a woman the feeling that she must justify her decision.
Een registratieplicht van motieven past hier niet bij en kan een vrouw het gevoel geven dat ze zich moet verantwoorden voor haar besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de Sportpas

Van Nispen (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about his view of a sports pass for youth, its development since December 2024, and when and where the pilot and effectiveness study will take place. Karremans said he is enthusiastic, is commissioning a study on the sports pass effects, and will inform the House in June before the next committee debate, without yet naming pilot municipalities.
I aim to inform you in June, ahead of the next committee debate, about what the study will look like exactly and in which municipalities the sports pass will be tried out.
Ik streef ernaar u in juni, voorafgaand aan het eerstvolgende commissiedebat, te informeren over hoe het onderzoek er precies uitziet en in welke gemeenten de sportpas uitgeprobeerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Oud- turnster Petra Witjes heeft eindelijk geen nachtmerries meer. ‘Ik wil de mensen die mij verkeerd hebben behandeld niet laten winnen’’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the experiences of abuse victims such as Petra Witjes are included in setting up an independent integrity centre for sport, and about the timeline, independence, and CVSN reporting. The State Secretary answered that the bill is delayed by privacy and governance complexity, that consultation is planned around summer, and that CVSN will be separated from NOC*NSF.
That is why it has not yet been possible to submit the bill for consultation.
Daarom is het nog niet gelukt om het wetsvoorstel ter consultatie aan te bieden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Westerveld over het toepassen pijnprikkels in jeugdzorginstellingen

Westerveld asks the state secretary to explain how the use of pain stimuli (bokkepootjes) at Woodbrookers can fall under child abuse while the OM found no intentional misconduct, and asks about permitted restraint methods, youth complaint routes, dossier access, and legal support for former residents. The secretary declines substantive comment on the ongoing case, states restraint is only allowed under strict conditions without pain stimuli, notes complaint and civil routes, and promises an evaluation by WODC expected before summer.
The Public Prosecution Service decided in September 2024 to end the investigation into possible abuse.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft in september 2024 besloten om het onderzoek naar mogelijke mishandelingen te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Bikker, Krul en Van der Plas over abortus vanwege geslacht

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA and BBB asked whether sex-based abortion after prenatal sex disappointment is discriminatory, whether it conflicts with the Embryowet ban on sex selection, and whether verification or regulation of pre-technical sex-determination ultrasounds is possible. The state secretary answered that such abortions are rare and multi-motivated, that a study of reasons would be unreliable and undesirable, and that private ultrasounds fall outside state regulation and cannot be influenced by law.
I have made inquiries with the professional groups of midwives (KNOV), sonographers (BEN) and abortion doctors (NGvA) on this.
Ik heb hierop navraag gedaan bij de beroepsgroepen van verloskundigen (KNOV), echoscopisten (BEN) en abortusartsen (NGvA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over informatie van FIOM over abortus

Two MPs (SGP and ChristenUnie) question the state secretary about FIOM's web page on abortion, asking whether its petri-dish photos and its claims on fetal pain are misleading and whether the subsidy-funded content is neutral. The state secretary defends the photos as accurate, says FIOM and the NGvA may clarify the accompanying text, and states that fetal pain is a matter for clinicians rather than legislation.
Fiom and the NGvA are considering whether this can be further clarified in the accompanying text on the website.
