Fiom en het NGvA bekijken of dit verder kan worden verduidelijkt in de begeleidende tekst op de website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident op 2 januari in Den Dolder

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether the 2017 promise that the Fivoor clinic would leave Den Dolder by 2025 would be honoured, and what options exist to relocate Fivoor or restore residents' sense of safety. The state secretaries answered that no formal promise on a departure date was made, that they lack the competence to order a relocation or an admission stop, and that they will explore use of Rijksvastgoed and continue talks with the municipality.
No formal commitment was made by the Minister for Legal Protection regarding the departure date of the Fivoor clinics from Den Dolder.
Er is door de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen formele toezegging gedaan over de vertrekdatum voor de klinieken voor de klinieken van Fivoor uit Den Dolder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het aantal verhuizingen van kinderen in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretary about the high number of placement changes of children in youth care, referencing reports, the UN Children's Rights Convention, earlier promises and motions, and asks what concrete measures will be taken. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, points to monitoring gaps, the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, a bill on regional cooperation, and says the recommendations are endorsed and largely the responsibility of providers and municipalities.
There are currently no national figures available on when and how often a young person is transferred.
Er zijn op dit moment namelijk geen landelijke cijfers beschikbaar over wanneer en hoe vaak een jeugdige wordt doorgeplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp na seksueel misbruik

An MP asked the state secretary about help for victims of sexual abuse: recognition and training, waiting lists in mental health care, access for vulnerable groups, use of restraint and isolation in closed youth care, the victim website, and access to sexological care. The state secretary described training and platforms, acknowledged long waiting times and pointed to the insurer's duty of care, noted measures on restraint in closed youth care, said the victim website was taken offline, and stated that sexological care is covered when part of GGZ treatment.
The number of girls placed in closed youth care has since decreased by 35%.
Het aantal meisjes dat geplaatst wordt in de gesloten jeugdhulp is sindsdien met 35% afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het bericht ‘Zorgen over sluiting zwembaden in Zuid-Limburg’

An MP asked the state secretary about the closure of the Mosaqua pool in Zuid-Limburg, municipal finances, and whether the state should intervene (handremprocedure or a statutory duty) to keep pools open. The state secretary says pools are a municipal responsibility, rules out a handremprocedure for now, and says research into a municipal pool duty will finish in autumn 2025.
There is currently no statutory duty for municipalities to keep swimming pools open.
Er bestaat momenteel geen wettelijke zorgplicht voor gemeenten om zwembaden in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident in Den Dolder

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the unrest after a fatal stabbing in Den Dolder, the promised relocation of the Fivoor forensic clinic by 2025 or 2027, and whether the clinic will close. The government answers that it has no power to force a relocation or closure, that the 2025 date was an intention by the owner and not a promise by the minister, and that it will explore support such as Rijksvastgoed for a move.
It is not for the Minister to close the clinic or to steer towards a timeline for the intended departure.
Het is niet aan de Minister om de kliniek te sluiten of aan te sturen op een tijdspad richting het voorgenomen vertrek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de helft van de jongvolwassenen hun mentale gezondheid niet goed noemt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that half of young adults rate their mental health as not good, and about waiting lists in mental health care, school performance pressure, housing insecurity, and a budget cut to pandemic preparedness. The State Secretary notes that 51% rate their mental health good or very good, says youth mental health still needs attention, points to a first recovery in youth data, and promises a broader letter on mental health care access and a mental health work agenda before summer 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht 'Diagnose prostaatkanker nu bijna net zo vaak als borstkanker, vorig jaar 15.000 keer'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Health about rising prostate cancer diagnoses, early detection, and whether a national screening programme should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that a screening programme needs proof of benefit, will consult the Health Council (per a motion), and that primary responsibility for early detection lies with care providers, while MRI-based diagnostics are being promoted.
In accordance with the motion by MP Bushoff, I will also consult the Health Council to examine what scientific evidence currently exists for a population screening programme for prostate cancer.

Conform de in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 genoemde motie van het lid Bushoff, ga ik in gesprek met de Gezondheidsraad om te bekijken welke wetenschappelijke evidentie op dit moment aanwezig is voor een bevolkingsonderzoek prostaatkanker.
Antwoord op van het lid Bruyning over de Kamerbrief Inspectierapport incident pleegmeisje Vlaardingen

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the Vlaardingen foster-care case, the WSS screening of 3,300 files, long waiting lists and court rulings signalling structural child-safety problems in youth protection. The government answers that the case was a calamity with serious shortcomings but not isolated, that WSS found 64 files needing a new safety assessment (now completed), that it cannot compare earlier cases in detail yet, and that it has not itself ordered other certified institutions to conduct safety checks.
It was never our intention to present the calamity as a one-off, exceptional incident.
Het is niet onze bedoeling geweest de calamiteit te presenteren als een incident dat eenmalig en uitzonderlijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Pierik over overheidssubsidie voor het Taboer-platform

Two MPs from BBB asked the government about its funding for Taboer, a platform breaking taboos on mental health in agriculture, including whether the subsidy is being phased out and why it sits under Agriculture rather than Health. The minister confirmed the current programme ends in April 2025, said he wants to continue funding and is in talks with the sector on terms, and stated that the sector and government share responsibility for the costs.
I am willing to make a financial contribution in the coming years as well to cover Taboer's costs.
Ik ben bereid om ook de komende jaren een financiële bijdrage te leveren om kosten van Taboer te dekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thiadens en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht inzake de aanhouding van de 27-jarige verdachte voor de moord op een 76-jarige vrouw in Den Dolder

MPs Thiadens and Emiel van Dijk (PVV) asked about the fatal stabbing of a 76-year-old woman in Den Dolder by a 27-year-old patient on leave from a clinic, questioning who authorised the leave, the risk assessment, and safety measures. The state secretaries largely declined to answer on the specific case pending an Inspectorate investigation, pointed to the provider Fivoor's responsibility, and described general measures and a planned relocation.
Pending this investigation, we cannot address questions about this specific incident.
In afwachting van dit onderzoek kunnen we niet ingaan op vragen over dit specifieke incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Blauwe bessen AH mogelijk besmet met hepatitis A’ en de Kamerbrief daarover

An MP asked whether the NVWA could have detected the hepatitis A contamination in frozen blueberries earlier, and who is responsible for food safety. The State Secretary answered that the batch was not in the NVWA's sampling selection, that producers bear primary responsibility under an EU system that works well, that the NVWA acted quickly once signalled, and that no tightening of rules is currently seen as necessary.
The batch of blueberries that was withdrawn from the market did not fall within the (random sample) selection for analysis under the NVWA's monitoring programme.
De partij blauwe bessen die uit de handel is gehaald, viel niet binnen de (steekproefsgewijze) selectie voor analyse van het monitoringsprogramma van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over sportcomplexen die zonder extra geld uit de BOSA snel verouderen

An MP asks the state secretary about the sports facilities subsidy (BOSA) being oversubscribed within days, the transition to the DUMAVA sustainability scheme, its differing conditions, and monitoring of funds for sport. The state secretary answers that applications closed at 155% of budget, sets out the differences between the schemes, and commits to informing parliament by Prinsjesdag 2025 on the share of DUMAVA funds reaching sport.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Dral over het bericht 'Jeugdzorginstellingen onder verscherpt toezicht: 'Jongeren opgesloten in kamer''

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that youth care institutions under stricter supervision confine youths to their rooms, and how the transition away from closed youth care will be supported and monitored. The state secretary answered that EUR 176 million is available for the transformation, that a supplementary implementation programme is being discussed with providers, that the IGJ can escalate to instructions if needed, and that a national project organisation monitors the transformation toward near-zero closed placements by 2030.
Improving the legal position of young people in closed youth care and reducing the use of restrictive measures are two important objectives for me.
Het verbeteren van de rechtspositie van jeugdigen in de gesloten jeugdhulp en het terugdringen van het gebruik van vrijheidsbeperkende maatregelen vind ik twee belangrijke doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over de beantwoording van Kamervragen d.d. 3 oktober 2024 over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen ask about the responsibility of dance sport federations (NADB) for misconduct, the lack of apology and recognition for a whistleblower, the absence of mandatory VOG checks, the independence of the CVSN reporting centre, and the reach of the Alliantie Dans Veilig. The Secretary of State answers that federations have limited responsibility, that a whistleblower meeting will be arranged, that VOG remains voluntary and that a law to create an independent integrity centre is in preparation.
To strengthen social safety in sport, I am currently working on a bill that will lead to the establishment of an independent integrity centre, which will also separate the CVSN from NOC*NSF.

Om sociale veiligheid in de sport te versterken, werk ik momenteel aan een wetsvoorstel dat zal leiden tot de oprichting van een onafhankelijk integriteitscentrum, waarmee het CVSN tevens wordt losgekoppeld van NOC*NSF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over het rapport van de Raad Volksgezondheid en Samenleving ‘Gezond in de Bonus, via supermarkten betere voeding stimuleren’

MP Slagt-Tichelman asked the State Secretary for Health about the RVS report proposing a legally anchored bonus-malus system to reward supermarkets for selling healthier food. The State Secretary acknowledged the public health problem and the supermarkets' role, but preferred negotiated agreements and monitoring first, citing legal and regulatory hurdles to a bonus-malus scheme and promising a broader prevention strategy.
I first focus on concrete agreements with supermarkets and annually monitoring their progress.
Ik zet allereerst in op concrete afspraken met de supermarkten en het jaarlijks monitoren van de voortgang hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Tielen over het bericht ‘Kind van ouders met verstandelijke beperking: 'Eigenlijk was ik de ouder'’

MPs Van den Hil and Tielen asked the state secretary about a report on children of parents with intellectual disabilities and the Nu Niet Zwanger programme on childbearing wishes, including registration of KOPP/KOV families and reach to other vulnerable groups. The state secretary answered that the programme is voluntary and not registered by target group, that participating organisations and municipalities are not fully tracked nationally, and that the government is monitoring implementation via the GALA monitor and exploring funding.
This data is not registered nationally.
Deze gegevens worden niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht dat de Mutsaersstichting genderzorg beperkt tot Limburg

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Mutsaersstichting limiting gender care to Limburg, and whether this reflects ideological priorities and whether gender care should yield to other youth care. The State Secretary answered that the decision is part of the foundation's continuity plan, that youth outside the region are referred elsewhere, and that the government is working on youth care availability and a transgender care platform while holding that all children with acute needs should receive timely care.
The decision the Mutsaersstichting took is part of its continuity plan.
Het besluit dat de Mutsaersstichting heeft genomen is onderdeel van haar continuïteitsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over de SuperlijstGezondheid2024 en het bericht dat 64 procent van de volwassenen overgewicht heeft in 2050

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the SuperlijstGezondheid2024 report showing supermarkets promoting alcohol and unhealthy products, and about RIVM projections of 64 percent adult overweight by 2050, questioning preventive policy, budget cuts and enforcement. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, promises a preventive strategy, a monitor, and legislation restricting child-directed unhealthy marketing, while relying mainly on voluntary agreements for now.
I am therefore working, among other things, on legislation to restrict child-directed marketing of unhealthy products.
Ik werk daarom onder andere aan wetgeving om kindermarketing op ongezonde producten in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het niet vervolgen van medewerkers van Woodbrookers naar aanleiding van aangiften van oud-cliënten

An MP asked the state secretaries why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute Woodbrookers staff after former clients filed complaints, and whether painful stimuli and physical force in closed youth care are permissible. The government answered that staff acted within the FMT protocols and the OM found no criminally culpable conduct, that painful stimuli are not permitted under the Jeugdwet, and that a CPT visit and a review of the complaints system are under way.
The OM examined to what extent the staff of the Woodbrookers treatment centre acted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and the protocols then in force relating to the FMT method.

Het OM heeft onderzocht in hoeverre de medewerkers van het behandelcentrum van Woodbrookers hebben gehandeld in overeenstemming met geldende wet- en regelgeving en de toen geldende protocollen die betrekking hadden op de FMT-methode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White, Gabriëls en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Bewoners Bonaire geëvacueerd na grote brand bij de vuilstort’

MPs White, Gabriëls and Slagt-Tichelman asked about a large fire at the Selibon waste dump on Bonaire, its health and environmental effects, and the permit and oversight failures at the site. The government answered that the underground fire is not yet controlled, that the acting Kingdom Representative has taken over permitting and enforcement from the island authority due to neglect of duty, and that a waste plan and asbestos and biomedical waste measures are being prepared.

This led to a decision by the acting Kingdom Representative (on 15 November 2024) to step in for the island executive and make a number of decisions on permitting, supervision and enforcement at Selibon/Lagun.

Dit heeft geleid tot een besluit van de waarnemend Rijksvertegenwoordiger (op 15 november 2024) om indeplaats te treden van het bestuurscollege en daarmee te voorzien in een aantal beslissingen op het gebied van vergunningverlening, toezicht-, en handhaving (VTH) bij Selibon/Lagun.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over uitspraak rechtbank Noord-Holland: Pleegzorgorganisatie moet kosten kinderopvang vergoeden aan pleegzorgouders

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government will respond to a court ruling that a foster care organisation must reimburse childcare and after-school care costs to foster parents, and how to resolve the unclear responsibility between the Rijk, municipalities and foster care providers. The State Secretary welcomed the ruling, acknowledged the problem, and promised talks with foster parents, municipalities and providers on structural solutions in the short term, while noting the matter also falls under the Social Affairs ministry.
Based on the court ruling, I will shortly enter into discussions with foster parents, municipalities and care providers about possible structural solutions.
Op basis van de uitspraak van de rechtbank, ga ik op korte termijn in gesprek met pleegouders, gemeentes en zorgaanbieders over mogelijke structurele oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de wereldwijde gevaren van gokken voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked how the government views the Lancet Commission's warnings that gambling poses a global public health threat, and whether Dutch policy (led by the Ministry of Justice and Security) sufficiently protects vulnerable people. The State Secretary responded that player protection is being strengthened through new rules on deposit limits and contact moments, a tougher KSA responsible-gambling policy rule, a planned law revision after the Wet koa evaluation, and continued international cooperation, while rejecting a WHO resolution as currently unnecessary.
Protecting people from the negative effects of gambling is my primary concern.
Het beschermen van mensen tegen negatieve effecten van gokken staat voor mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Bikker over het bericht ‘Wachttijden ggz niet goed vastgelegd, zeggen onderzoekers’

MPs Van den Hil and Bikker asked the Secretary of State for Health about research finding that ggz waiting times are poorly recorded, and about how the NZa monitors and enforces data delivery and whether insurers can get waiting-list information. The Secretary of State acknowledged the research, described ongoing NZa monitoring and improvement efforts and a pilot using declaration data, and promised to inform the House by spring 2025 on privacy-bound options, while declining to commit to a specific recalculation of incorrect waiting times.
I intend to inform the House further on this before spring (planned Q1 2025).
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer voor het voorjaar (planning Q1 2025) hierover verder te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over smartvapes

MP Slagt-Tichelman asks the state secretary about smartvapes, enforcement against illegal vapes, and cuts to Trimbos Institute, prevention programmes and addiction-related funding. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, promises €3 million structural extra NVWA enforcement from 2026 and an action plan on vaping in spring 2025, but defends the budget cuts as manageable and declines to fund separate guest lessons.
From 2026 I will therefore structurally make an additional 3 million euros available for NVWA enforcement.
Vanaf 2026 stel ik dan ook structureel 3 miljoen euro extra beschikbaar voor de handhaving van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paulusma over het artikel 'Aidsfonds maakt zich zorgen over stijging hiv-infecties bij jonge mannen'

MPs Rooderkerk and Paulusma asked the State Secretary of Health about rising HIV diagnoses among young men, the effectiveness of PrEP and condom campaigns, budget cuts to prevention, and whether Amsterdam's approach can be scaled nationally. The State Secretary acknowledged the rise, described PrEP-care and prevention measures, said that cuts to specific grants are under review with decisions due early next year, and promised a monitoring update before summer.
I will inform your House about this in more detail before the summer.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover voor de zomer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paulusma over de voorbereiding op het vaker opduiken van fentanyl in Nederland

MPs Sneller and Paulusma (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health about preparedness for fentanyl and synthetic opioids appearing more often in the Netherlands, including warnings from Belgium, monitoring of vulnerable groups, prevention budgets and the planned cuts to prevention, harm reduction and the Mainline subsidy. The State Secretary answered that no signals yet show synthetic opioids gaining ground, that a preparedness scan and a ban on risky new psychoactive substances are underway, but defended the budget cuts as necessary while stating that enough funding remains.
The Trimbos Institute has been commissioned in this context to produce a preparedness scan aimed at preventing harmful effects of synthetic opioids.
Het Trimbos-instituut heeft in dat kader opdracht gekregen om te komen tot een preparedness-scan gericht op voorkoming van schadelijke effecten van synthetische opioïden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over een nieuwe Gesloten Jeugdzorginstelling in Friesland

An MP asks the state secretary about a new small closed youth care facility in Drachten, Friesland, and whether it fits the policy to phase out closed youth care, citing past abuses and a critical expert article. The state secretary answers that it is an interim step toward zero closed placements by 2030, a contract with Jeugdhulp Friesland runs to end 2025, and that the municipalities and the Inspectorate oversee quality.
The Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth (IGJ) supervises closed youth care.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) houdt toezicht op de (gesloten) jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over vrijwillige verenigingsbestuurders die persoonlijk aansprakelijk gesteld kunnen worden

An MP asked the state secretaries whether volunteer association board members face growing personal liability, whether the Wbtr (Wet bestuur en toezicht rechtspersonen) was intended to change liability, and what is being done about the risks. The government answered that the Wbtr extended bankruptcy-based liability for board members of informal and non-commercial associations, that no cases are known in published case law, that information campaigns and support measures are planned, and that the law will be evaluated by 2026.
It is difficult to say whether the total number of liability claims against association board members has increased.
Het is moeilijk te zeggen of het totaal aantal aansprakelijkheidsstellingen van verenigingsbestuurders is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht 'Einde van het melktappunt’

MPs Van der Plas and Rikkers-Oosterkamp (BBB) asked the state secretary for Health why raw milk must now be tested monthly for Salmonella, Campylobacter and STEC from 1 January 2025, arguing the costs threaten farm milk-tap sales. The state secretary answered that the testing protects consumer health, that costs are proportionate, that frequency can be halved after six months of compliant results, and that the measure will be evaluated after two years.

In addition, given the concerns raised by MPs Van der Plas and Rikkers (both BBB), I intend to evaluate this measure after two years, with attention also to the burden on (milk) farmers in relation to the public health interest to be protected.

Daarnaast ben ik, gezien de geuite zorgen van de leden Van der Plas en Rikkers (beiden BBB), voornemens om deze maatregel na twee jaar te evalueren waarbij ook aandacht zal zijn voor de lasten van (melk)veehouders in relatie tot het te beschermen volksgezondheidsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht dat een huisarts machteloos staat om hulp te krijgen voor hulpbehoevende jongere

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a GP's report that she could not get help for a vulnerable young patient, and about long youth care waiting lists. The state secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, the Integraal Zorgakkoord, a planned youth care bill and regional expert teams, but gave no concrete remedy for this case.
Young people in the most vulnerable situations, who really need help and support, must be able to rely on timely available and appropriate (specialist) youth care.
Jeugdigen in de meest kwetsbare situaties, die hulp- en ondersteuning echt nodig hebben, moeten kunnen rekenen op tijdig beschikbare en passende (specialistische) jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het rapport ‘Van wet naar werkelijkheid: Bewegingsonderwijs op de Basisschool’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about a Mulier Institute report finding about a third of primary schools fail the 90-minute weekly physical education norm, and asked what support, facilities, teacher recruitment and enforcement steps would follow. The government says it expects all schools to comply, notes the earmarked subsidy ended and funds moved into the general subsidy budget, delegates facility duties to municipalities, and says the Inspectorate can issue a remedial order.
I expect all schools to comply with the statutory obligations that apply to education, including the hours norm for physical education.
Ik verwacht van alle scholen dat ze voldoen aan de wettelijke verplichtingen die gelden voor het onderwijs, inclusief de urennorm voor bewegingsonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht ‘Nutri-score dreigt fiasco te worden: producenten stappen af van ’onbegrijpelijk’ voedselstoplicht’

An MP from the PVV asked the State Secretary for Health whether the Nutri-Score front-of-pack label is misleading, what it costs, and why cheese scores worse than some biscuits. The State Secretary defended Nutri-Score as a shopping aid within product categories, cited consumer research and a Health Council evaluation, reported a 1.2 million euro campaign, and argued that cheese generally scores D while most biscuits score E.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over de zin en onzin van de Nutri-Score

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about the Nutri-Score: whether it helps curb overweight, whether category-based comparison misleads, why manufacturers are dropping it, and whether it should be mandatory. The State Secretary defends the voluntary logo, promises monitoring, communication and product-improvement measures, and says mandatory rules are being examined under EU law.
I am willing to use legal measures where necessary.
Ik ben bereid indien nodig wettelijke maatregelen in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht 'Toezichthouder: toegankelijkheid jeugdzorg onder druk'

MP Paulusma asked the State Secretary for Health about the Youth Authority's finding that access to youth care is under pressure, including waiting lists, data quality, personnel shortages, municipal overspending and prevention. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Reform Agenda, the bill on availability of youth care, data and monitoring work, and a forthcoming expert commission advice, but gave no national waiting-list figures and declined further research on municipal top-up spending.
Figures on waiting times are not available at the national level.
Cijfers over wachttijden zijn niet op landelijk niveau beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over de brief van de Nederlandse Stichting Water- & Zwemveiligheid (NSWZ) betreft het verzoek tot heroverweging van de voorgenomen btw-verhoging op zwemlessen

An MP asks the State Secretary to reconsider the planned VAT increase on swimming lessons, citing differences between commercial and non-profit providers, litigation risk, accessibility and a possible two-tier outcome. The State Secretary largely defends the policy, says the VAT rise is expected to hold in court under EU case law, and promises a schoolswimming study in early 2025 while refusing to reconsider the decision.
Are you willing to reconsider the planned cabinet decision on the VAT increase on swimming lessons given the two-tier system it creates?
Bent u bereid om het voorgenomen kabinetsbesluit van de Btw-verhoging op zwemles te heroverwegen gegeven de tweedeling die het creëert?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de Jaarrapportage van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd over de Wet afbreking Zwangerschap 2023

An SGP MP asked the state secretary for health about budgets, realised spending and forecast abortion numbers for subsidised abortion clinics in 2021-2025, and whether the IGJ should publish first-half 2024 figures. The state secretary gave the budget figures, said the ministry makes no abortion forecasts (clinics estimate their own activity), declined to draw conclusions about 2024-2025 or post-2025 trends, and refused to request early publication of 2024 data, citing the need for careful processing.
The Ministry of VWS does not make estimates or calculations of abortion rates.
Het Ministerie van VWS maakt geen ramingen of berekeningen van abortuscijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en het lid Westerveld over genderzorg voor jeugd

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the threatened disappearance of gender care for under-18s in Noord-Brabant after BuroJIJ's possible exit, and about waiting lists and measures. The government acknowledged shortages of specialist youth care, pointed to the bill on availability of youth care and the Aanpak Wachttijden, said no current national waiting-list or wait-time data exist, and promised a Landelijk Platform Transgenderzorg and further work on protocols.
For (specialist) gender care for under-18s, no current figures are known on the number of people waiting or average waiting times.
Voor (specialistische) genderzorg voor jeugdigen onder 18 jaar zijn geen actuele cijfers bekend van aantallen wachtenden en gemiddelde wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over mishandelingen in een jeugdzorginstelling

An MP asks the State Secretaries about the use of pain-inducing restraint (bokkepootje) on minors in a youth care institution, whether such practices are permitted, how they relate to children's rights, and what redress exists for victims. The government answers that pain-inducing measures are prohibited under the Jeugdwet and the UN Convention, that victims can use complaint procedures, criminal complaints or civil action, and that existing recognition measures are being evaluated.
An action aimed at causing pain, such as a bokkepootje, may not be used as a restrictive measure.
Een handeling die erop gericht is pijn te veroorzaken, zoals een bokkepootje, mag niet als vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht «Uithuisgeplaatste kinderen overgeleverd aan hardhandige invalkrachten»

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that out-of-home placed children were handed to violent, unqualified temporary staff at a youth care provider, and about the provider's oversight, the role of staffing agencies, and whether the sector's market structure causes such practices. The State Secretary condemned the practices, said the IGJ inspection report is due in early 2025, stated the provider remains ultimately responsible for staff qualifications, said the IGJ lacks powers over staffing agencies, and rejected the link to marketisation.
The IGJ has no powers to supervise placement or staffing agencies.
De IGJ heeft geen bevoegdheden om toe te zien op bemiddelings- of uitzendbureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht «Uithuisgeplaatste kinderen overgeleverd aan hardhandige invalkrachten»

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports on unqualified temporary staff and mistreatment of out-of-home placed children at youth care provider D3 in Hoenderloo, including inspection oversight, municipal responsibility, staffing rules, and remedies for young people. The State Secretary answered that the IGJ inspection report is expected in early 2025, responsibility is shared between municipalities, providers and the IGJ, and that promised measures include a sector conduct code for staffing agencies and a campaign on self-employment, while rejecting reopening the compensation scheme.
Currently the IGJ is conducting oversight of the D3 location in Hoenderloo.
Momenteel loopt er toezicht van de IGJ op de D3 locatie in Hoenderloo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht «Jorinde van Klinken zwijgt niet langer: «Ik heb echt heel serieuze zaken gehoord, ook verkrachtingen»»

An MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about an athlete's account of sexual misconduct in elite sport, the lack of clarity on where to report it, slow handling of complaints, and the plans for an independent integrity centre. The state secretary said prevention and reporting channels already exist, outlined integrity measures, and said the bill for an independent integrity centre is being prepared with no firm timeline given.
In parallel, VWS is working on a bill that will lead to the establishment of an independent integrity centre for sport, to handle reports of misconduct as well as possible.
Parallel hieraan werkt VWS aan een wetsvoorstel dat gaat leiden tot de totstandkoming van een onafhankelijk integriteitscentrum voor de sport
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Westerveld over het artikel ‘Wat vrouwen niet mogen weten over hun eigen borsten’

MPs Tielen and Westerveld asked about a Volkskrant article on breast screening for women with dense breast tissue, and whether women's concerns and the option of extra MRI are being taken seriously. The State Secretary says extra MRI capacity is insufficient, that density reporting offers no actionable options, and that he will consult stakeholders and the Health Council on improvements and inform the House.
I find this a difficult dilemma. That is why I will enter into discussion with the parties involved.
Ik vind dit een lastig dilemma. Daarom zal ik in gesprek gaan met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Kinderen in bedwang gehouden met pijnprikkels, commissie tegen martelen kijkt mee in Nederland’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that children in youth care were subjected to pain stimuli and about the Council of Europe anti-torture committee's visit. The state secretary replied that pain stimuli are prohibited, the Inspectorate has incidentally found such practices, no national figures exist, and the CPT findings are awaited with a report due in June 2025.
No national figures are known about this.
Hierover zijn geen landelijke cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Blaauw over het bericht ''Supporters Vitesse onwel en afgevoerd naar ziekenhuis met hartritmestoornissen na derby de Graafschap''

An MP asked why illegal fireworks entered the stadium, why alarm was not raised during the match, whether the regional safety authority's escalation to GRIP-1 was a security concern, and whether costs would be recovered from those responsible. The minister answered that the club searches selectively, two EHBO cases were handled without escalation, a new plan on fireworks in football is in preparation, and escalation costs are publicly financed and not recovered.
The Regiegroep Voetbal en Veiligheid is currently working on a new action plan on fireworks in football as part of implementing reinforcement plan 2.
Momenteel werkt de Regiegroep Voetbal en Veiligheid – als onderdeel van de uitvoering van het versterkingsplan 2 – aan een nieuw plan van aanpak Vuurwerk in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vrouwensporten

An MP from FVD asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport whether biological differences justify separate women's sports categories and whether biological men should be excluded from women's sport. The state secretary said separate categories should be kept, but left eligibility rules and exclusion decisions to the individual sports federations and the IOC.
It is up to the national federations and the international sports federations to make agreements about this per sport.
Het is aan de nationale bonden en de internationale sportfederaties om hier per sport afspraken over te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Gevaarlijke Ozempic-handel vraagt om aanpak én preventie'

An MP asks why prescription-only medicines like Ozempic are sold online without a prescription, whether the online trade should be curbed, and whether the IGJ acts forcefully enough with sufficient resources. The minister says illegal online sales are unacceptable, the IGJ works with partners to remove websites and sanctions them, but does not commit to new resources or specific new measures.
The illegal online supply of (illegal) medicines, on the other hand, I find very undesirable.
Het illegale online aanbod van (illegale) geneesmiddelen daarentegen vind ik zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht ‘Anabole steroïden nog gevaarlijker dan gedacht'

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports that anabolic steroids are more dangerous than thought, illegal online doping trade, and awareness and research on doping. The state secretary acknowledged the health risks, pointed to existing cooperation and funding for the Dopingautoriteit, and said the government would not add further consultation with other ministries but would leave research priorities to the Dopingautoriteit.
I endorse the statement of the chair of the Dopingautoriteit and therefore make the activities of the Dopingautoriteit financially possible.
Ik onderschrijf de uitspraak van de voorzitter van de Dopingautoriteit en maak daarom de activiteiten van de Dopingautoriteit financieel mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Een leeg shirt voor de 20-jarige voetballer, want die mag geen reclame maken voor een gokwebsite’

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the July 2025 ban on online gambling sponsorship in sport also covers amateur clubs and whether loopholes like Belgian-style foundations are closed. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies to amateur clubs too, that public advertising including sports venues is also prohibited, and promised a policy response on the Wet kansspelen op afstand evaluation before year end.
Under article II, paragraph 1, sub a of the Besluit ongerichte reclame kansspelen op afstand, from 1 July 2025 licensed remote gambling providers are prohibited from sponsoring sport.

Op grond van artikel II, lid 1, sub a van het Besluit ongerichte reclame kansspelen op afstand (Besluit orka) is het vanaf 1 juli 2025 verboden voor vergunde aanbieders van kansspelen op afstand om de sport te sponsoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kwart van ouders met lager inkomen doet kind niet op zwemles, oplopende kosten vaak de reden’

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the state secretary about low-income parents not enrolling children in swimming lessons due to rising costs, including VAT, municipal provision, a motion on subsidies and school swimming. The state secretary said municipal schemes and the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur exist, that no budget is available now, and that school swimming scenarios will be presented around early 2025.
I expect the results of a study by the Mulier Institute this autumn, which will clarify the obstacles for municipalities to join one or more funds.
Ik verwacht dit najaar de resultaten van een onderzoek van het Mulier Instituut waarin duidelijk wordt wat de belemmeringen voor gemeenten zijn om aan te sluiten bij één of meerdere fondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slagt-Tichelman en Bushoff over de stand van zaken omtrent seksuele gezondheid in Nederland

MPs Slagt-Tichelman and Bushoff asked about the state of sexual health in the Netherlands, including falling condom and pill use, rising STIs, access to STI testing and PrEP, HPV vaccination, and sexual misconduct prevention. State Secretary Karremans answered largely by describing existing and planned measures, committing to a study of condom-promoting interventions and a review of the ASG subsidy, while declining to commit to reinstating Vrij Veilig campaigns yet.
I aim to inform the House early next year about the steps I will take to revise the system.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer begin volgend jaar te informeren over de stappen die ik ga zetten om te komen tot een herziening van het stelsel.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Claassen over het bericht dat tieners geen vaccinaties meer krijgen in verband met de aanpassing van het Rijksvaccinatieprogramma per 2025

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about reports that teenagers will no longer receive certain vaccinations under the 2025 revision of the national vaccination programme, including the mumps risk for teens. The state secretary answered that the Health Council advised moving the second MMR dose from age 9 to 2-4 to prioritise measles, that mumps risk figures vary and the effects will be monitored, and that the advice is adopted with implementation from 1 January 2025.
Naturally, the effects of bringing forward the second MMR vaccination will be closely monitored so that the vaccination strategy can be adjusted if necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend zullen de gevolgen van het vervroegen van de 2 e BMR-vaccinatie nauwgezet worden gemonitord zodat de vaccinatiestrategie – als dat nodig blijkt – kan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over logeerfaciliteiten voor kinderen met een (zeer) ernstige meervoudige beperking

MP Westerveld asks the government about the shortage of respite care places for children and adults with severe multiple disabilities, the role of the ministry, pgb-funded respite and equipment problems. The state secretary agrees the shortage is real, points to the raised tariff, a pilot allowing pgb teams to accompany clients in care locations, and a forthcoming regulatory change, but says pgb coverage of location costs cannot be realised before 1 July 2025.
From 2022 a considerably higher tariff applies to respite care for Wlz clients with ZEVMB.
Vanaf het jaar 2022 geldt een aanzienlijk hoger tarief voor logeeropvang van Wlz-cliënten met een ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het artikel 'Onderzoek naar discriminatie bij Raad voor de Kinderbescherming hapert'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a newspaper report that independent research into discrimination at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming (child protection board) has stalled, and about whether independent research into the childcare benefits affair and child removals is adequate. The government answers that independent inquiries (Inspectie JenV, the Hamer commission, and internal reflection tracks) are underway, explains the delays and the planned scope of the Verwey-Jonker research, and says it will decide on further research once those reports are in.
Independent research is already being carried out.
Er is en wordt reeds onafhankelijk onderzoek verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Crijns over het bericht 'Gesloten jeugdhulp in Fryslân komt terug: vijf opvangplekken in Drachten'

An MP asked the State Secretary about the reopening of closed youth care in Drachten, Friesland, after past abuses at Woodbrookers, and how abuses would be prevented and why the policy of zero closed placements by 2030 is being bent. The State Secretary answered that a contract for ten closed places was agreed for lack of alternatives, that the Inspectorate will carry out an entry check after six months, and that the goal of zero closed placements by 2030 remains.
The IGJ will carry out an entry check at the new location in Drachten after six months.
De IGJ voert na zes maanden een entreetoets uit op de nieuwe locatie in Drachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruyning en Jansen over het bericht ‘Zorg Curaçao op instorten: 'Rekening is onvermijdelijk voor Nederland'

MPs Bruyning and Jansen asked the State Secretaries about reports that the Curaçao Medical Center faces financial collapse and what it means for the Netherlands, including loans, support, and patient impact. The answers state Curaçao is responsible for healthcare, no request for aid has been received, Curaçao plans an additional ANG 253 million for 2025-2028, and several questions are answered as lacking information.
Healthcare is a country matter and therefore falls under the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Gezondheidszorg is een landsaangelegenheid en valt dus onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het aanbod van (hoog)specialistische GGZ-behandelingen en de reductie van High Intensive Care-capaciteit bij GGz Breburg

MP Westerveld asks the state secretary about the planned concentration and bed reduction of high-intensive care at GGz Breburg, and whether this conflicts with earlier promises to protect cruciale ggz capacity and with the goal of shortening waiting lists. The state secretary confirms awareness, states the reduction is due to staff shortages rather than finances, says the ministry has contacted the provider and insurer and will discuss the case with partners, but offers no concrete plan to reverse the cut and few data on capacity loss.
There is, however, no data available on the scope, reduction or build-up of cruciale ggz capacity.
Er zijn echter geen gegevens voorhanden over omvang, afbouw of opbouw van capaciteit van cruciale ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dral ver de oproep van Doarpswurk m.b.t. de wet- en regelgeving omtrent bingo in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the planned exemption allowing small games of chance like bingo in licensed hospitality venues would address municipalities threatening to ban bingo where alcohol is served, and what they would tell affected elderly people. The state secretary answered that bingo is not banned in general, that the Alcohol Act ban on hospitality venues will be lifted through a bill, and that the VNG will be asked to show restraint in enforcement meanwhile.
I have asked about this and the VNG indicates that it does not have these figures and that it is not possible to obtain the relevant data.
Ik heb dit nagevraagd en de VNG geeft aan dat zij niet over deze cijfers beschikken en dat het niet mogelijk is om de betreffende gegevens te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘KNVB sloot sponsordeal met omstreden gokbedrijf dat onderdeel was van Chinese georganiseerde misdaad’

An MP asked the State Secretaries whether the KNVB had a responsibility to check the source of money in a sponsorship deal with a gambling company linked to Chinese organised crime, and whether sports bodies and clubs should review such deals. The State Secretary replied that the KNVB handled its own due diligence and was not legally obliged to publish sponsorship contracts, that the government will examine EU anti-money-laundering rules, and that it has informed NOC*NSF and the KNVB about the research.
The KNVB is responsible for its own sponsorship contracts.
De KNVB gaat over zijn eigen sponsorcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het artikel “Studenten vinden drugs gebruiken de normaalste zaak van de wereld”

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about an article on normalisation of drug use among students, trends in hard-drug use and treatment among young people, and related policy gaps. The State Secretary answers that drug use is not normal, cites monitoring data showing rising hard-drug use among 18-35 year olds and rising youth treatment numbers, acknowledges missing data on overall harms, and promises a letter in autumn on drug policy.
I am concerned about drug use among young people and young adults.
Ik maak mij zorgen over het drugsgebruik onder jongeren en jongvolwassenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hil over het artikel 'Bedden voor psychische noodgevallen in de regio Breda en Tilburg verdwijnen: Dit is precies waar we al langer voor vreesden'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the closure of high-intensity care (HIC) beds for psychiatric emergencies in Breda and Tilburg and whether it fits the Integrated Care Agreement on accessible crucial mental health care. The State Secretary answered that the decision lies with GGz Breburg and the insurer, that the NZa was informed, and that the matter will be discussed with the national parties on crucial mental health care to learn from the case.
It is up to GGz Breburg and the health insurer, under the latter's duty of care, to ensure that this is the case in the region.
Het is aan GGz Breburg en de zorgverzekeraar, vanuit diens zorgplicht, om ervoor te zorgen dat dit in de regio het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het bericht ‘Wat nou smaakjesverbod? Nepsigaret met menthol en fruit op de markt dankzij ‘truc’ van tabakgigant

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the nicotine-containing, tobacco-free Levia sticks from Philip Morris circumvent tobacco rules, excise taxes and the flavour ban, and whether the law should be tightened. The government answered that Levia falls under the pending bill on nicotine products without tobacco, that a flavour ban is being prepared, that excise rules will be revised in 2025, and that a RIVM risk assessment has been commissioned, while declining to commit to a total ban for now.
I have instructed the RIVM to carry out a risk assessment for these new products.
Ik heb het RIVM de opdracht gegeven een risicobeoordeling voor deze nieuwe producten uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht Nederland zorgt niet goed voor kwetsbare kinderen: ‘We zakken als land door het ijs’

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the government will respond to a KidsRights report saying the Netherlands is failing vulnerable children, including cuts to youth care and rising child poverty. The state secretary answered that the government is working on the issues through the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, vaccination measures and child-rights monitoring, and rejected the claim that youth care cuts are unjustified.
I see this report as a call on the cabinet to properly safeguard children's rights.
Ik zie dit rapport als een oproep aan het kabinet om kinderrechten goed te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over olympische sporters die moeite hebben met rondkomen

MPs asked whether the topsport stipend is adequate for elite athletes who struggle to make ends meet, whether it should be seen as a job, and about claw-back rules, the income threshold, and the ongoing review of the support package. The state secretary answered that NOC*NSF and the Fonds voor de Topsporter are primarily responsible for the stipend rules, that a new support model is being explored, and that an update will follow in autumn 2024.
It is my intention to inform your House in autumn 2024 about the progress.
Het is mijn voornemen om uw Kamer in het najaar van 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de situatie op het voormalige terrein van de Hoenderloo Groep

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the situation at the former Hoenderloo Groep site, including safety of youths, fragmentation of youth care across 342 municipalities, and unclear placement oversight. The state secretary answered that Apeldoorn has set up a local platform, the IGJ is conducting oversight, and a bill on regional cooperation in youth care is pending, while placing responsibility mainly with municipalities and providers.
Whether the care provided is now appropriate for the young people living on the former Hoenderloo Groep site is something I cannot assess.
Of de geboden zorg nu passend is voor de jeugdigen die nu op het terrein van de voormalige Hoenderloo Groep verblijven kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de berichten van Follow the Money en Pointer over de jeugdzorgbedrijven op het Hoenderlooterrein

MP Westerveld asks the state secretary for health, welfare and sport about reports on youth care providers at the former Hoenderloo site, including incidents, unclear municipal oversight of placements, and IGJ inspection of new providers. The state secretary answers that a local platform has been set up, the IGJ conducts risk-based oversight, municipalities remain responsible for data and suitable care, and that the Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid jeugdzorg will strengthen regional cooperation.
The IGJ makes no statements about the precise content and handling of reports.
Over de precieze inhoud en de afhandeling van meldingen doet de IGJ geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het onderzoek van de Kinderombudsman naar de gevolgen van scheidingen voor kinderen

An MP asked the government about the Children's Ombudsman's study on the effects of divorce on children, including whether policy should focus more on preventing relationship problems and on family group plans. The government answered that it shares concern, points to ongoing pilots, a new online platform and a forthcoming advice on child-friendly divorce procedures, but sees no need to repeat earlier research or launch a new programme.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hertzberger over het interview met Hoogleraar Psychiatrie Damiaan Denys in NRC Handelsblad 'De wens om niet te willen leven mag je niet gelijk stellen aan de wens om dood te zijn.'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a professor's NRC interview on euthanasia for psychiatric suffering, the rising number of such notifications among under-30s, psychiatrists' willingness to perform euthanasia, and whether the procedure and guideline should change for young patients. The government denied any loosening of the euthanasia law, gave the notification figures, said the guideline is being revised, and declined to propose a new multi-clinician decision body.
It is not known how much support exists within the profession for granting euthanasia requests from younger patients.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel steun bestaat voor het inwilligen van euthanasieverzoeken van jongere patiënten binnen de beroepsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het rapport ‘Nederlandse jongeren weten te weinig over risico’s vapen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a UNICEF report showing young people know too little about vaping risks and back a ban on vapes and cigarettes, asking about prevention, the stalled motion for a disposable-vape ban, international obstacles, the Smokefree Generation goal, excise increases and retail-point limits. The State Secretary answered that prevention efforts exist but more action is needed, that a national vape ban is legally blocked by the EU Tobacco Products Directive, that no structural excise increase is planned, and that no licensing scheme for retailers will be introduced, while promising to inform parliament on further steps.
I am considering the further steps I want to take to curb e-cigarette use.
Op dit moment ben ik mij aan het beraden op de verdere stappen die ik wil zetten om het e-sigaretgebruik terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over het bericht 'Aanbieders jeugdzorg komen niet of nauwelijks meer rond'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that youth care providers are barely breaking even, their causes, measures to prevent bankruptcies, plans to tackle waiting times and staff shortages, and the rollout of the Hervormingsagenda. The state secretary attributes financial pressure to rising personnel and energy costs and points to the Jeugdautoriteit analysis, a continuity subsidy, and a bill on youth care availability, while noting that tariffs and provider management also play a role.
I cannot currently explain the average profit figure of 0.1% in the youth care sector cited by A-Insights based on the data available to me, and will look into it further.

Ik kan het door A-Insights genoemde percentage van 0,1% gemiddelde winst in de jeugdzorgsector op dit moment niet verklaren op grond van de bij mij aanwezige gegevens en laat hier nog nader naar kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over een voorgenomen volledige risicobeoordeling van LSD en MDMA

MP Bikker asked why the former minister ordered a full risk assessment of LSD and MDMA by the CAM, despite the CAM seeing no urgency for LSD and the low prevalence, and asked about consultation with justice bodies and international obligations. The State Secretary answered that, following the CAM's conclusion that LSD research is not urgent, no full assessment of LSD will be requested, LSD stays on List I, and that a response on MDMA will follow after the summer.
I follow the CAM in its conclusion and will therefore not ask the CAM for a more extensive further study now.
Ik volg het CAM in haar conclusie en zal het CAM daarom nu niet verzoeken om een nader uitgebreid onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slagt-Tichelman over de Netflixserie 'The man with a 1000 kids'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the Netflix series on a sperm donor with many offspring, including donor limits, registers, international sperm banks, information for parents, consanguinity risks, and reimbursement of anonymous-donor treatment abroad. The government answered that a 12-family cap per donor via Dutch clinics takes effect in 2025, opposed a private-donor register, referred parents to information sites, and said it will report to parliament in 2025 on limiting reimbursement for anonymous-gamete treatment abroad.

Therefore, with the amendment of the Donor Data Artificial Insemination Act (Wdkb) entering into force on 1 January 2025, it will be ensured that it is not possible through a Dutch clinic to conceive children with one donor's sperma with more than 12 women.

Daarom zal met de wijziging van de Wet Donorgegevens Kunstmatige Bevruchting (Wdkb) die per 1 januari 2025 in werking treedt, worden geborgd dat het niet mogelijk is via een Nederlandse kliniek bij meer dan 12 vrouwen kinderen te verwekken met het sperma van één donor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht Focus minder op BMI, stellen wetenschappers: ‘Buikvet is een veel betere voorspeller van gezondheidsproblemen’

An MP asked why, despite guidelines naming waist circumference alongside BMI, professionals and the public still focus mainly on BMI, and about health literacy and prevention policy. The state secretary said implementation of waist measurement is being pursued through the sector (PON, Care4Obesity, JOGG, Voedingscentrum, GP practice) and existing policy, without new research or policy changes.
Determining quality standards and care content is up to the field itself.
Het bepalen van kwaliteitsstandaarden en zorginhoud is aan het veld zelf.
